sphere_base_ability_authority.effect:
#### Spending a Waning Mark
Once per round, when a marked creature you can perceive performs a triggering act, you may spend its Waning Mark without using an Action. Choose one Diminishing Response appropriate to the trigger.
**Diminish Force**
Trigger: the marked creature deals damage. Reduce one damage roll by 1d6 + your Key Ability modifier. This reduction increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
**Diminish Aim**
Trigger: the marked creature makes an attack roll. Subtract 1d4 from the attack roll. At CL 11, subtract 1d6 instead.
**Diminish Power**
Trigger: the marked creature forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw. Choose one creature making that saving throw. The chosen creature adds 1d4 to the saving throw. At CL 11, the bonus becomes 1d6.
**Diminish Step**
Trigger: the marked creature begins movement, including teleportation. Reduce one of the creature’s Speeds by 10 feet until the end of the current turn, or reduce the distance of one teleportation effect by 10 feet. At CL 11, the reduction becomes 20 feet.
**Diminish Recovery**
Trigger: the marked creature regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, restores CP, or benefits from regeneration. Reduce the amount gained or restored by your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier, to a minimum of 0.
**Diminish Readiness**
Trigger: the marked creature takes a Reaction or would gain Advantage on a roll. The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, or the triggering Advantage is canceled for that roll.

sphere_base_ability_authority.effect:
#### Base Ability - Draw the Line
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or replace one attack when you take the Attack action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row_with_attack_replacement_mode
Split Review Decision: same_bucket_attack_replacement_mode
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_DRAW_THE_LINE->action, ATTACK_REPLACEMENT_DRAW_THE_LINE->action
Range: Mundane 20 feet, Qi Thread 30 feet.
Cost: None for mundane thread if you have thread stock; 1 CP for Qi Thread or to ignore mundane stock.
Target: One creature, object, weapon, surface, or unattended item within range.
Effect: Make a Thread Attack. On a hit, you create a Thread Line between yourself or an anchor you control and the target. The line lasts until the end of your next turn. Choose one basic effect.
Pull: Move the target 5 feet toward you or toward the anchor if it is your size or smaller. Larger creatures are not moved unless they fail a Strength saving throw.
Snare: The target’s speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Guide: The next attack roll you make against the target before the end of your next turn ignores half cover.
Trip: The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone. This option requires the target to be no more than one size larger than you.
Disarm: The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or drop one held object of your choice in its space. This option requires a mundane line, Qi Thread, or needle to reach the object.
Damage: Draw the Line does not deal damage unless you choose Cutting Thread or another talent modifies it.

sphere_base_ability_authority.effect:
#### Base Ability - Listen Through Tension
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: One active Thread Line you maintain.
Cost: None.
Effect: You read vibration, breath, resistance, and movement through a Thread Line. Until the end of your next turn, choose one benefit against the connected target or object.
You know whether the target is moving closer, farther, or staying still.
You know whether the target is holding the line, cutting the line, or ignoring it.
You have advantage on one Wisdom (Insight), Wisdom (Perception), or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check involving the line.
If the target is Invisible but physically connected by a mundane or Qi Thread, you know its space until the line ends, though this does not by itself let you see the target.

sphere_base_ability_authority.effect:
#### Base Ability - Spool and Strand
Action Type: Special Trigger
Canonical Action Type: Special Trigger
Factory Combat Bucket: passive
Timing Detail: No action for ordinary handling; part of the action for Thread talents
Factory Routing: triggered_passive_modifier_row
Range: Self.
Cost: None for mundane thread; 1 CP to create or reinforce Qi Thread for combat use.
Effect: You can prepare, draw, control, and conceal combat-ready strands. You may use mundane thread, silk, wire, cord, needles, and hooks as thread tools. If you spend 1 CP, you can create Qi Thread from your fingertips, breath, weapon, sleeve, hair, blood, or dantian pressure for 1 minute.
Ordinary Uses: You can sew, bind, stitch, tie knots, mend cloth, mark a path with thread, set a simple cord, prepare a hidden sleeve spool, or handle fine threadwork without a check unless the situation is difficult.
Combat Use: Spool and Strand enables your Thread talents. It does not by itself restrain creatures, deal damage, or create traps.

#### Base Ability - Threaded Strike
Action Type: Linked Modifier
Canonical Action Type: Linked Modifier
Factory Combat Bucket: passive
Factory Routing: linked_modifier_row
Split Review Decision: linked_modifier_not_standalone_action
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ON_HIT_THREADED_STRIKE->passive
Timing Detail: Part of a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike
Range: The attack’s normal reach.
Cost: None.
Effect: When you hit a creature with a melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike, you may wrap, hook, guide, or tension a thread as part of the hit. Until the start of your next turn, you gain one of the following benefits against that target.
Follow the Sleeve: You may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that target.
Tighten the Wrist: The target has disadvantage on the next Opportunity Attack it makes before the start of your next turn.
Draw the Guard: Your next Thread Attack against the target before the end of your next turn has advantage.
Weighted Knot: Add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage of the triggering attack. You can use Weighted Knot only once per round.
Threaded Strike is the common martial face of this sphere. Many Body Refiners learn Thread this way before ever projecting visible Qi Thread.

### Dart Mechanism — Dart Pattern
Construct a spring, wire, blade, needle, bolt, or comparable projectile mechanism.
When triggered, choose one space occupied by the trap as the point of origin. The dart flies in a straight line up to 90 feet in a direction chosen when you set the trap.
The projectile stops at the first solid surface or creature in its path.
If the first creature in the path would be struck, make a ranged Cultivation Attack against that creature.
Hit: Deal Piercing damage.
Dart damage:
CL 1–4: 1d6
CL 5–10: 2d6
CL 11–16: 3d6
CL 17–20: 4d6

sphere_base_ability_authority.effect:
### Tripwire — Snare Pattern
Stretch wire, rope, thread, or a comparable low obstruction through the trap’s spaces.
When a creature enters one of those spaces for the first time on a turn, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature has the Prone condition.
Successful Save: The creature avoids the effect and becomes aware of the trap.
Tripwire is not destroyed when triggered.
A creature aware of the Tripwire has Advantage on its saving throw against it.
A creature that already has the Prone condition does not trigger Tripwire.

sphere_base_ability_authority.effect:
### Command Responses
A Command Response spends Momentum to turn battlefield order into immediate action.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
spending a Momentum Mark is not an Action;
you may use only one Command Response per round;
the target must be within Command Range and able to perceive your command;
a Command Response is not magical unless the talent says otherwise.
You know the following Command Responses.
#### Step on My Count
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see starts its turn, ends its turn, or is missed by an attack roll.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally moves 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature you can see.
This movement cannot move the ally through an occupied space or through terrain it could not normally enter.
#### Brace the Line
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see is hit by an attack roll or fails a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw against an effect that deals damage.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally reduces the triggering damage by:
Proficiency Bonus + Warleader key ability modifier
If the triggering attack roll would miss after adding +2 to the ally’s AC, the attack misses instead of dealing reduced damage.
#### Strike on My Count
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see hits with an attack roll.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally adds your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll from the triggering attack.

##### Shape Current
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: One 10-foot square or a 10-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You gather water into a simple Current or Basin. Choose one form when you use this ability.
Flowing Current. The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. When you create the Current, choose one creature in the area. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed or pulled 10 feet along the Current into a legal space.
Mist Basin. The area becomes Lightly Obscured. A creature inside it can attempt to Hide normally if it has appropriate cover or concealment.
Cleansing Basin. The first time each round you or an ally enters the area or starts its turn there, it may end the Soaked state on itself, extinguish ordinary flames on itself, or gain Advantage on the next saving throw before the start of its next turn against Poisoned, a disease, smoke, heat, or mundane contamination.
Pressure Basin. The area presses down and around. The first hostile creature each round that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
You may move a Basin or Current up to 10 feet as a Bonus Action on your turn.

### BASE ABILITY 3: CLOUD SHROUD
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You hang a private weather around a target: frost around the joints, rain inside the breath, dust in the eyes, heat against the skin, wind around the limbs, or thunder over the heart.
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know and apply its Shroud effect.
A creature can be under only one of your Cloud Shrouds at a time. Placing a second Cloud Shroud from you on the same creature ends the first.
Unless a sign says otherwise, a creature makes the listed saving throw when the Shroud is placed and again at the end of each of its turns. A Shroud’s damage or condition applies on a failed save. A successful save prevents that round’s damage or condition but does not end the Shroud unless the Shroud says otherwise.
##### Three-Success Escape
If a Shroud no longer requires your Concentration because of a talent or feature, it ends once the target has succeeded on three saving throws against it.
##### Objects
A Shroud can target an unattended object. The GM decides whether the object is vulnerable to that weather. For example, rain may douse flame, heat may warp wax, cold may freeze water, aridity may dry ink, and wind may scatter papers.

sphere_base_ability_authority.effect:
### BASE ABILITY 4: GATHER WEATHER
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You gather a Weather Sign you know into a local field.
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know other than Thunder Sign, unless Thunder Sign is being gathered through Storm rules. The area becomes severity 1 of that sign’s weather category.
Gathered weather counts as active weather for Sky Mantle and other Weather talents.
At Mortal Realm, Gather Weather creates atmosphere and combat-scale conditions, but it does not usually inflict long-duration travel hazards such as dehydration checks, hypothermia checks, or heat-exhaustion checks unless a talent specifically says so.
##### Shelter and Barriers
Gather Weather does not pass through sealed walls, closed rooms, airtight barriers, sealed formations, or spaces physically isolated from the area unless a feature says otherwise.
##### Opposing Weather
If you gather Cold into Heat, Heat is reduced first. If you gather Heat into Cold, Cold is reduced first. If you gather Aridity into Precipitation, Precipitation is reduced first. If you gather Precipitation into Aridity, Aridity is reduced first.
##### Storm Formation
A full storm requires Wind and either Precipitation or Aridity. If both supporting categories are severity 1 or higher, Thunder Sign and storm talents can treat the area as Storm severity equal to the lower supporting severity.

### BASE ABILITY 1: READ THE SKY
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes for a careful reading
Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_careful_reading_procedure
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=IMMEDIATE_READING_ACTION, CAREFUL_READING_TEN_MINUTES, BATTLE_READING_NO_ACTION
Range: Self
Cost: 0 CP
Duration: Instantaneous
You study pressure, humidity, temperature, scent, cloud motion, insects, skin-prickle, spiritual pressure, and the shape of Heaven’s breath.
Choose one of the following readings.
##### Immediate Reading
As an Action, learn all current weather categories and their severity within 1 mile, assuming you are outdoors or in contact with air that leads outdoors.
You also learn whether the weather within 300 feet is natural, supernatural, cultivation-made, or being sustained by Concentration.
##### Careful Reading
After 10 minutes, predict natural weather within 5 miles for the next 48 hours, unless stronger cultivation, sealed terrain, divine concealment, or narrative conditions interfere.
##### Battle Reading
When you cast a Weather sphere effect, you may also identify one active Weather Sign in the scene without using an action.
A sign is active if its category is severity 1 or higher, if you have placed it through a Mantle or Shroud, or if you have gathered it with Gather Weather.

### BASE ABILITY 2: SKY MANTLE
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes as a ritual
Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_ritual_and_refresh_variant
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_SKY_MANTLE->action, BONUS_ACTION_REFRESH_MANTLE->bonus_action; procedures=TEN_MINUTE_SKY_MANTLE_RITUAL
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute if cast as an Action; up to 1 hour if cast as a 10-minute ritual
Cost: 1 CP if cast as an Action; 0 CP if cast as a 10-minute ritual
You wrap a creature in a weather sign so that Heaven favors its movement, breath, skin, weapon, or spirit.
When you place a Sky Mantle, choose one Weather Sign talent you know. The target gains that sign’s Mantle effect if at least one of the following is true:
the surrounding area currently has that weather category at severity 1 or higher;
you have gathered that sign with Gather Weather and the target is inside the area;
you spend 1 additional CP to force that sign through your own cultivation.
A creature can benefit from only one of your Sky Mantles at a time. Placing a new Sky Mantle from you ends the old one.
##### Refreshing the Mantle
On your turn, you may spend 1 CP and use a Bonus Action to change the Mantle to another Weather Sign talent you know, provided the new sign is active or you force it with CP.
##### Defensive Weather
When a creature with your Sky Mantle makes a saving throw against a Weather sphere effect, it has Advantage if the Mantle’s sign matches or opposes the effect’s sign.

sphere_base_ability_authority.effect:
#### Applying a Slam
When you learn Wrestling, choose one Slam talent for which you meet the prerequisites.
You may apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you in any of the following ways:
##### Establish the Hold
When one creature gains the Grappled condition from your Unarmed Strike Grapple option or one of your Wrestling talents, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to that creature.
##### Work the Hold
When you begin your turn grappling one or more creatures, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you.
##### Punish the Escape Attempt
When a creature fails an Action check to escape one of your grapples, use your Reaction to apply one Slam talent to it.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
one use applies one Slam talent;
the target must still be Grappled by you when the Slam resolves;
the Slam lasts until the start of your next turn or until the grapple ends, whichever happens first;
a Slam requiring a saving throw uses your Wrestling Save DC.

You also learn Gather Current and Wind Lash.

automatic_base_abilities.duration: Until the start of your next turn
automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Gather Current
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
You stir a small controlled Air Current in a 10-foot cube you can see within range.
When you create the Current, choose one Vector:
Lift: A willing creature that starts in or enters the Current before it ends may add 5 feet to one jump or ignore the first 10 feet of falling damage before the Current ends.
Press: The first hostile creature that starts in or enters the Current before it ends treats the Current’s space as Difficult Terrain.
Scatter: Nonmagical smoke, loose dust, harmless vapor, light fog, or similar airborne material in the Current is dispersed or shifted 10 feet.
Carry: A whisper, scent, ribbon, Tiny unattended object weighing no more than 1 pound, or comparable harmless sign may be carried from one point in the Current to another point in the Current.
Turn: The first ordinary Tiny projectile that passes through the Current before it ends has Disadvantage on its attack roll.
At Foundation Realm, the Current increases to a 15-foot cube. At Core Formation, it increases to a 20-foot cube.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Wind Lash
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object you can see
Cost: None
You release a cutting or battering current at a target.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On a hit, the target takes bludgeoning or slashing damage equal to 1d8 + your Path key ability modifier.
The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17.
When Wind Lash hits, choose one basic Vector:
Push: Push the target 5 feet directly away from you if it is no more than one size larger than you.
Pull: Pull the target 5 feet directly toward you if it is no more than one size larger than you.
Cut: The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
Lift: The target’s next jump before the start of your next turn is increased by 5 feet if the target is willing. If the target is unwilling, this option has no effect.
Scatter: One Tiny unattended object within 5 feet of the target moves up to 10 feet in a direction you choose.
Wind Lash is a Cultivation Attack, not a weapon attack, unless a talent says otherwise.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Air Qi Expression: Primary — Wind Qi; Supporting — Breath Qi, Motion Qi, Sky Qi. “The mountain thinks the sky is empty because it has never tried to command a breath.” Common Name: Air Sphere Sphere Type: Power Sphere; Elemental Sphere; Mobility and Battlefield-Control Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Paths: Body Refining and Spirit Awakening Key Themes: breath, wind, pressure, currents, lightness, flight, sound-carried motion, airless pressure, cutting wind, projectile denial, sky roads, storm authority Primary Resource Hooks: CP, Concentration, Formation/terrain support, prepared environment, Martial Focus only when a talent explicitly says so ### Air Dao Air is the cultivation of breath, current, and invisible pressure. Earth asks what can bear weight. Water asks where flow returns. Fire asks what can be transformed by burning. Air asks why the body believes distance, balance, and breath belong to it. A novice Air cultivator pushes a cloak, redirects an arrow, or leaps farther than muscle allows. A Foundation cultivator rides unseen currents and turns the battlefield into moving pressure. A Core Formation master claims the air as territory. A Nascent Soul Air sovereign can make a sect army discover that every breath they take is permission. Air is not empty space. It is the world touching everything at once. ### Realm Progression Mortal Realm: Air is breath control, wind-handed pressure, gliding steps, falling safely, small currents, projectile interference, clearing smoke, and cutting gusts. Foundation Realm: Air becomes externalized Qi. The cultivator creates lasting currents, walks the sky briefly, steals breath, builds wind walls, hurls vertical pressure, and expands their current control. Core Formation Realm: Air becomes a court. The cultivator arranges the battlefield through wind gates, cyclone prisons, storm eyes, sky roads, and layered currents that decide who may move, aim, breathe, or fly. Nascent Soul Realm: Air becomes body and domain at once. The cultivator becomes a sovereign atmospheric presence, moving as a storm center, denying arrows, cutting from impossible angles, and attacking the breath of armies. Secret Inheritance: The Air cultivator commands a moment when heaven itself exhales, rewriting movement, breath, and projectile fate across a battlefield. ### 2024 Fifth-Edition Rules Baseline This sphere assumes the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline used by Tianxia. Ranged Attacks: Ranged weapon and spell attacks follow ordinary attack roll rules unless a talent changes them. Air talents that interfere with arrows, thrown weapons, or projectile lines define their own trigger and effect. Cover: Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover, and Total Cover use ordinary rules. Wind does not automatically ignore Cover. A talent must say when a current bends an attack around Cover or blocks a projectile. Obscurement: Air does not automatically create Heavy Obscurement. Moving dust, smoke, ash, sand, fog, or loose debris may create obscurement only when the scene provides material or a talent creates it. Flying and Falling: A flying creature falls if something causes it to fall, loses the ability to fly, or is otherwise forced down by the rules. Air talents that slow falling, permit hovering, or drive flyers downward say so directly. Forced Movement: Forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks unless a feature says otherwise. Air often pushes, pulls, lifts, or drops creatures; this is forced movement. Prone: A flying creature knocked Prone may fall unless it can hover or the GM determines its flight method prevents it. Air talents call out special cases for flyers when needed. Grappled and Restrained: Air does not automatically break Grapples or Restrained. It can assist movement, push creatures apart, or create pressure, but conditions end only when a talent says so. Concentration: Talents with ongoing areas may require Concentration. Damage or Incapacitated can break Concentration normally. A talent that says it persists without Concentration follows that talent. Breathing and Suffocation: Air talents that disrupt breath are not universal instant suffocation tools. They create short tactical windows unless a higher-Realm talent says otherwise. Creatures that do not breathe or do not rely on lungs may be immune or may use an equivalent exposed animating pressure only if the talent allows it. Objects and Projectiles: Arrows, thrown weapons, darts, needles, bolts, bullets, and similar projectiles can be affected by Air talents. Siege ammunition, falling boulders, massive weapons, or supernatural attacks require explicit permission. Underwater, Vacuum, or Sealed Chambers: Air techniques are weaker where air cannot move. Some talents can create air temporarily; they do not automatically solve all vacuum, underwater, sealed-room, or planar air problems unless stated. ### Core Air Rules #### Air Source An Air technique normally requires at least one of the following: breathable air; open atmosphere; wind, smoke, mist, dust, or loose airborne material; the cultivator’s breath; a physical fan, sleeve, cloak, bellows, feather, flute, flag, weapon, or body movement used to stir air; Qi-created air from an Air talent. In a sealed vacuum, underwater environment, or airless planar region, Mortal and Foundation Air techniques may fail unless a talent provides Created Air or the cultivator has prepared an appropriate forged technique, item, talisman, formation, or GM-approved source. #### Breath, Current, Vector, and Release Air uses four shared terms. Breath is the cultivator’s internal rhythm, exhalation, lung Qi, body pressure, or spiritual respiration. Current is a controlled movement of air. Currents may be lines, cones, emanations, spheres, or localized zones depending on the talent. Vector is the direction and purpose assigned to a Current: lift, press, pull, scatter, cut, carry, muffle, or turn. Release is the moment a Current is spent or expressed through a technique. Most Air techniques follow this loop: Gather or identify an Air Source. Create or claim a Current. Assign a Vector. Release the Current as movement, defense, attack, pressure, or utility. #### Air Current An Air Current is a temporary controlled area of moving air created by an Air talent. Unless a talent says otherwise: a Current lasts until the start of your next turn; a Current is visible through dust, hair, cloth, leaves, weapon ribbons, condensation, or disturbed air when the scene provides signs; a Current does not block line of sight; a Current does not count as a solid wall; a Current can push, lift, scatter, or impede only when a talent says so; you can maintain one active Current at a time. #### Current Intensity Some talents refer to Current intensity. Light Current: enough to stir cloth, carry whispers, slow a fall, disturb aim, or move Tiny unattended objects. Driving Current: enough to push creatures, redirect projectiles, create difficult movement, lift willing creatures briefly, or buffet flyers. Storming Current: enough to threaten multiple creatures, impose saving throws, create storm terrain, or contest flight. If a talent does not name an intensity, it creates a Light Current at Mortal Realm, a Driving Current at Foundation Realm, and may create Storming Currents only through Core Formation or higher talents. #### Air Control Limit You can actively maintain a number of Air effects with a duration longer than instantaneous equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Effects that require Concentration still obey ordinary Concentration limits. Minor atmospheric signs, flavor movement, harmless breeze, and instantaneous attacks do not count against this limit. If you exceed the limit, choose one existing Air effect to end immediately. #### Cultivation Save DC and Air Checks When an Air talent calls for a saving throw, use your Cultivation Save DC. When a talent calls for an Air Check, roll: d20 + Proficiency Bonus + your Path key ability modifier If a Path synergy changes the ability used for Air, use that ability for Air Checks and Cultivation Save DCs. #### Breath-Dependent Targets A creature is breath-dependent if it relies on breathing, vocal channels, lung pressure, or equivalent internal atmosphere. Creatures that do not breathe are immune to ordinary breath-disrupting talents. At Foundation or higher, Spirit Awakening or Qi Cultivation expressions may affect equivalent exposed animating currents, such as ghost-breath, furnace pressure, elemental circulation, or corpse-wind, if the talent permits it. #### Projectiles and Wind Interception When an Air talent affects a projectile, it can affect ordinary ranged weapon attacks and thrown weapon attacks unless stated otherwise. It does not affect: spell attacks with no physical projectile; siege ammunition; falling terrain; boulders hurled by giants; line effects; breath weapons; spiritual attacks with no moving projectile; attacks protected by a stronger technique, unless the talent allows an opposed Cultivation Check. #### Air and Body Refining Body Refining practitioners do not normally project complex detached wind patterns at range. Their Air techniques usually begin from breath, skin, footwork, sleeves, weapons, armor vents, fans, flags, or objects they physically move. A Body Refining Air cultivator may still use the sphere, but distant, free-floating, or long-duration external currents require a talent, Insight, item, forged technique, or GM permission. ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Wind-Hand Training When you first gain the Air sphere, gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Acrobatics, Athletics, Perception, Performance, or Survival. If you already have proficiency in the chosen skill, choose one Mortal Realm Air talent instead. You also learn Gather Current and Wind Lash. #### Gather Current Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: None You stir a small controlled Air Current in a 10-foot cube you can see within range. When you create the Current, choose one Vector: Lift: A willing creature that starts in or enters the Current before it ends may add 5 feet to one jump or ignore the first 10 feet of falling damage before the Current ends. Press: The first hostile creature that starts in or enters the Current before it ends treats the Current’s space as Difficult Terrain. Scatter: Nonmagical smoke, loose dust, harmless vapor, light fog, or similar airborne material in the Current is dispersed or shifted 10 feet. Carry: A whisper, scent, ribbon, Tiny unattended object weighing no more than 1 pound, or comparable harmless sign may be carried from one point in the Current to another point in the Current. Turn: The first ordinary Tiny projectile that passes through the Current before it ends has Disadvantage on its attack roll. At Foundation Realm, the Current increases to a 15-foot cube. At Core Formation, it increases to a 20-foot cube. #### Wind Lash Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature or unattended object you can see Cost: None You release a cutting or battering current at a target. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On a hit, the target takes bludgeoning or slashing damage equal to 1d8 + your Path key ability modifier. The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17. When Wind Lash hits, choose one basic Vector: Push: Push the target 5 feet directly away from you if it is no more than one size larger than you. Pull: Pull the target 5 feet directly toward you if it is no more than one size larger than you. Cut: The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn. Lift: The target’s next jump before the start of your next turn is increased by 5 feet if the target is willing. If the target is unwilling, this option has no effect. Scatter: One Tiny unattended object within 5 feet of the target moves up to 10 feet in a direction you choose. Wind Lash is a Cultivation Attack, not a weapon attack, unless a talent says otherwise. ### Air Talent Tags Current Talents modify Gather Current, create new Currents, or change Current intensity. Vector Talents add new Vectors to Wind Lash or a Current. Breath Talents affect breathing, speech, exhalation, pressure, or internal air. Sky-Step Talents improve movement, falling, jumping, gliding, or flight. Guard Talents turn wind into defense, interception, or projectile denial. Cutting Talents use wind as a blade, pressure seam, or invisible edge. Storm Talents create large, violent, or sustained battlefield winds. Domain Talents create Core Formation or higher courts. Realm Evolutions change how the entire sphere functions at a new Realm. ### Mortal Realm Talents #### Flowing Step - Sky-Step When you move at least 10 feet on your turn, you may ignore 5 feet of Difficult Terrain caused by nonmagical rubble, mud, shallow water, loose sand, snow, or crowding. If you pass through a space affected by your Gather Current, you may also move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature of your choice. #### Feather-Fall Breath - Sky-Step Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or a creature within 30 feet falls 10 feet or more Cost: None You create a cushioning current. Reduce the fall distance used to calculate fall damage by 30 feet for the target. At CL 5, reduce it by 60 feet. At CL 11, the target may also land on its feet if it is not Incapacitated. At CL 17, you may affect a number of falling creatures within range equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Gale Push - Vector When Wind Lash hits, you may replace its basic Vector with Gale Push. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Push the target 10 feet directly away from you. Successful Save: Push the target 5 feet. If the target collides with a solid obstacle during this movement, it falls Prone instead of moving the final 5 feet. #### Drawing Breath - Vector When Wind Lash hits, you may replace its basic Vector with Drawing Breath. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Pull the target 10 feet directly toward you. Successful Save: Pull the target 5 feet. This movement cannot pull a creature into a space that cannot support it unless the creature can fly or hover. #### Cutting Wind - Cutting When Wind Lash deals slashing damage, the target takes additional slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 11, if the target is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the start of your next turn. #### Arrow-Turning Breath - Guard Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you can see within 30 feet is hit by an ordinary ranged weapon attack Cost: None Roll an Air Check against the attack roll. Success: Reduce the attack’s damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. Success by 5 or more: The attack misses instead. At Foundation Realm, you may use this against magical ammunition and thrown weapons. At Core Formation, you may use it against a physical projectile created by a non-Secret technique if the GM agrees it has a clear moving projectile. #### Wind-Sense - Breath You learn to read disturbances in air. You have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice: moving creatures that displace air within 30 feet; hidden creatures that are not behind Total Cover and are moving within 30 feet; incoming arrows, darts, needles, thrown weapons, or similar projectiles; gas, smoke, or pressure changes; whether a sealed door has air moving beneath or around it. Wind-Sense does not reveal creatures that do not move, creatures behind airtight barriers, or creatures concealed by superior stealth, illusion, or Void techniques without an opposed check. #### Whisper-Carrying Wind - Current When you use Gather Current, you may choose Whisper as its Vector. You may carry a message of no more than twenty-five words to a creature within the Current’s range that you can see or whose exact location you know. The message is audible only to the intended creature unless another creature has a feature capable of intercepting subtle sound or Air techniques. At Foundation Realm, the range becomes 120 feet. At Core Formation, it can pass through small cracks, vents, arrow slits, and similar air gaps, but not through airtight seals or Total Cover without an air path. #### Clear the Air - Current When you use Gather Current, you may choose Clear as its Vector. Clear disperses nonmagical smoke, harmless gas, dust, pollen, light fog, incense, or similar airborne material in the Current. If the material is magical or generated by a cultivation effect, make an Air Check against the effect’s save DC. On a success, suppress that material in the Current until the start of your next turn. Clear does not neutralize poison already inhaled or remove conditions already suffered. #### Breath-Braced Body - Breath You may use your breath to stabilize your body. When you make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw against being pushed, pulled, knocked Prone, or moved by wind, pressure, or forced movement, you may add your Proficiency Bonus to the roll if you are not already adding it. Once you use this benefit, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn. #### Wind-Riding Weapon - Cutting When you make a ranged weapon attack with a thrown weapon or ammunition while a target is inside one of your Air Currents, you may cause the attack to count as magical for the purpose of overcoming Resistance and Immunity to nonmagical bludgeoning, piercing, or slashing damage. At CL 5, you may also ignore Disadvantage from long range once per turn if the attack travels through one of your Currents. #### Sleeve-Fan Method - Current You may use a fan, sleeve, cloak, ribbon, spear tassel, banner, robe hem, scarf, feather, or similar object as an Air Source. When you do, increase the range of Gather Current by 10 feet and the range of Wind Lash by 10 feet. If the object is taken, bound, destroyed, or soaked in heavy material, you lose this benefit until you replace or free it. #### Airless Step - Sky-Step When you take the Dash action, you may move across fragile surfaces, thin branches, loose snow, shallow water, unstable rubble, or narrow rails without requiring an ability check, provided you end your movement on a surface that can support you. This does not allow you to walk on empty air. At Foundation Realm, if you pass through one of your Air Currents during the Dash, you may cross up to 10 feet of empty space during that movement. ### Foundation Realm Talents #### Breath Beyond the Skin - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Your Air Qi can exist outside your lungs and limbs as a stable local current. Gain the following benefits: Your Gather Current duration becomes 1 minute if you maintain Concentration. You may maintain two Air Currents at the same time. Wind Lash’s forced movement options can affect creatures up to two sizes larger than you. Your Air techniques can affect magical smoke, spiritual mist, ghost-breath, corpse-wind, and similar supernatural airlike phenomena if the GM agrees they have an exposed current. You may create temporary breathable air for yourself for 10 minutes once per short or long rest. Breath Beyond the Skin does not grant unrestricted flight, vacuum immunity, or control over all weather. #### Sky-Step - Sky-Step Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you use Gather Current, you may choose Step as its Vector. A willing creature that starts in or enters the Current may move up to 10 feet vertically or horizontally through the air without falling during that movement. The creature must land in a space that can support it unless it has a Fly Speed or another talent keeps it aloft. At CL 11, this movement increases to 20 feet. #### Wind Wall - Guard, Current Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 1 CP Create a wall of Driving Current up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 5 feet thick. The wall grants Three-Quarters Cover against ordinary ranged weapon attacks that pass through it. Ordinary Tiny projectiles that pass through the wall have Disadvantage on attack rolls. Loose gas, smoke, dust, and Tiny unattended objects are pushed to one side of the wall when it appears. A creature that enters the wall for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. At Core Formation, the wall may bend once at a right angle. #### Breath-Stealing Palm - Breath Prerequisite: CL 5+ When Wind Lash hits a breath-dependent creature, you may replace its basic Vector with Steal Breath. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the target cannot speak above a strained whisper, cannot shout commands, and has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws made to maintain Concentration. Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on the next check requiring speech, breath control, song, chant, roar, or verbal command. This does not prevent all technique activation. It affects techniques that clearly require breath, voice, mantra, lungs, or exhalation. #### Pressure Break - Vector Prerequisite: CL 5+ When Wind Lash hits, you may replace its basic Vector with Pressure Break. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Push the target 20 feet away from the point of origin of the attack. If it collides with a solid obstacle or another creature, it falls Prone. Successful Save: Push the target 10 feet. This is the Air expression of destructive pressure imbalance. #### Updraft Gate - Current, Sky-Step Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 1 CP Create a vertical cylinder of rising wind with a 10-foot radius and 30-foot height. A willing creature that enters the Updraft or starts its turn there may rise up to 20 feet without spending movement. An unwilling creature that enters the Updraft for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: It rises 10 feet and is suspended until the start of its next turn or until it leaves the Updraft. Successful Save: It is not lifted, but the Updraft’s space is Difficult Terrain for it. A suspended creature falls when the effect ends unless it can fly, hover, cling, or land on a surface. #### Downburst Seal - Current, Storm Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 10-foot-radius, 30-foot-high cylinder Cost: 1 CP You slam air downward. Creatures in the area make a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: A creature takes Wind Lash damage, is pushed to the ground, and falls Prone if it is on a surface. If it is flying and does not hover, it descends up to 30 feet before falling Prone if it lands. Successful Save: It takes half damage and does not fall Prone. #### Cloud-Sleeve Guard - Guard Prerequisite: CL 5+ While you have an active Air Current, you may use your Reaction when an attack roll is made against you. Roll 1d6 and subtract the result from the attack roll. If this causes the attack to miss, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker. At CL 11, the die becomes 1d8. #### Wind-Borne Body - Sky-Step Prerequisite: CL 5+ You gain a Fly Speed of 20 feet until the end of your turn whenever you begin your turn inside one of your Air Currents or use Gather Current as a Bonus Action on that turn. If you end your turn in the air without another feature keeping you aloft, you fall. At CL 11, the Fly Speed increases to 30 feet. #### Vacuum Needle - Cutting, Breath Prerequisite: CL 5+ When Wind Lash deals slashing damage, you may compress the line into a pressure needle. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It takes additional slashing damage equal to 1d8 and cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: It takes no additional damage. At CL 11, the additional damage becomes 2d8. This does not affect creatures without bodies or pressure channels unless the GM agrees an equivalent animating current is exposed. #### Wind-Script Delivery - Current Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may use an Air Current to carry a Tiny talisman, folded paper, ribbon-script, incense spark, feather mark, or similar prepared object. When you use Gather Current, you may move one such object up to 30 feet along an open air path. If the object is a talisman or consumable, this movement does not activate it unless its own rules permit activation. At Core Formation, this movement can pass around one corner if air can pass around that corner. ### Core Formation Realm Talents #### Court of the Four Winds - Domain Prerequisite: CL 12+, Breath Beyond the Skin Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 60-foot Emanation Duration: 1 minute Cost: 2 CP Use Limit: Once per short or long rest You establish a court of moving air around yourself. Choose four winds when the court appears: North, South, East, and West. Each wind is assigned one Vector: Lift, Press, Cut, Carry, Turn, or Scatter. You cannot assign the same Vector to more than two winds. For the duration: You may maintain up to four Air Currents without counting them against your Air Control Limit. Once on each of your turns, you may use Gather Current without an action. When a creature starts its turn inside the court, you may move one active Current up to 20 feet. Your Wind Lash may originate from any active Current inside the court. Allied creatures inside one of your Currents gain +10 feet to Speed while moving in the direction you choose. Hostile creatures moving against one of your Currents treat the space as Difficult Terrain. Once per round when an ordinary ranged weapon attack passes through one of your Currents, you may impose Disadvantage on that attack without using your Reaction. The court ends early if you are Incapacitated or if you enter an airless sealed region that prevents currents from existing. #### Cyclone Prison - Current, Storm Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 15-foot-radius, 40-foot-high cylinder Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP You create a rotating prison of violent air. When the Cyclone appears, creatures in the area make a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: A creature is pulled 10 feet toward the center, lifted 10 feet, and Restrained by wind until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: A creature is pulled 5 feet and is not Restrained. A creature Restrained by the Cyclone may repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the Restrained effect on itself on a success. The Cyclone’s area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. Ordinary ranged weapon attacks into, out of, or through the Cyclone have Disadvantage. #### Sky Road - Sky-Step, Current Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes Cost: 2 CP Create a road of stable wind up to 120 feet long and 10 feet wide. The road may be horizontal, sloped, or gently curved, but it cannot pass through solid objects. Creatures you designate may stand, walk, run, or fall Prone on the road as though it were solid ground. Other creatures treat the road as Difficult Terrain and must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw the first time they enter it on a turn or fall through. If the effect ends while a creature is unsupported in the air, it falls. #### Storm-Eye Stillness - Guard, Domain Prerequisite: CL 10+ You can make the center of your storm calm. While you maintain a Storming Current or Court of the Four Winds, choose a 10-foot-radius space inside the effect at the start of each of your turns. Allied creatures in that space ignore the Difficult Terrain and projectile Disadvantage created by your Air talents. Hostile creatures do not gain this benefit. Once per round, when a creature in the calm space would take bludgeoning, slashing, or thunder damage from wind, falling debris, or pressure, reduce the damage by your Cultivation Level. #### Invisible Blade Current - Cutting Prerequisite: CL 10+, Cutting Wind When you use Wind Lash from an active Air Current, you may choose to make the attack invisible until it strikes. The target makes a Wisdom (Perception) check against your Cultivation Save DC before the attack roll. Failure: The attack has Advantage. Success: The attack is resolved normally. A creature with blindsight, tremorsense that can read air pressure, Wind-Sense, or a comparable feature may have Advantage on this check. #### Turn the Hundred Arrows - Guard Prerequisite: CL 10+, Arrow-Turning Breath Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: Two or more ordinary ranged weapon attacks are made against creatures inside one of your Air Currents Cost: 1 CP Choose a number of triggering attacks equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each chosen attack has Disadvantage. If an attack misses, you may move its projectile up to 30 feet before it falls harmlessly or sticks into a surface. You cannot redirect the projectile into a new damaging attack unless another talent permits it. #### Breathless Chamber - Breath, Current Prerequisite: CL 10+, Breath-Stealing Palm Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP You create a pressure chamber where breath becomes difficult. Breath-dependent hostile creatures in the area make a Constitution saving throw when they enter the area for the first time on a turn or start their turn there. Failed Save: The creature cannot speak above a whisper, cannot take Reactions, and has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: The creature cannot shout or use long-distance vocal commands until the start of its next turn. This is not full suffocation. It does not affect creatures that do not breathe unless a talent or Path synergy permits an equivalent target. #### Wind Gate Geometry - Current Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you have two active Air Currents, you may designate them as paired Wind Gates. Once per turn, a willing creature that enters one gate may exit from the other gate by spending 10 feet of movement. The creature must be able to fit through both Currents and both gates must be within 120 feet of each other with an open air path between them. This is not teleportation. The creature is carried along a visible or traceable wind path. If that path is blocked by a sealed barrier, the gate fails. #### Gale-Command Banner - Current, Domain Prerequisite: CL 10+ You may anchor an Air Current to a banner, flag, sleeve, war fan, spear tassel, kite, sail, or formation pennant that you carry or plant. While anchored, the Current moves with the object. If the object is planted, the Current remains centered on it. If the object is broken, stolen, sealed, or placed in an airtight container, the Current ends. Allied creatures who can see the banner gain Advantage on saving throws against being pushed, pulled, or knocked Prone by wind while within 30 feet of the Current. #### Sky-Cleaving Pressure - Vector Prerequisite: CL 10+, Pressure Break When you use Pressure Break, you may apply the forced movement vertically where the environment permits. A flying creature that fails its saving throw may be driven toward the ground, hurled upward, or thrown away from protected airspace. If it impacts a surface, it falls Prone and takes additional bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus d6. A creature cannot be moved into a space too small for it or through a solid object. ### Nascent Soul Realm Talents #### Sky-Sovereign Incarnation - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+, Court of the Four Winds Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest You become a sovereign center of atmosphere. For the duration: You gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can Hover. You may maintain up to six Air Currents without counting them against your Air Control Limit. Your Wind Lash range becomes 300 feet. Once on each of your turns, you may use Wind Lash or Gather Current without an action. You may use Arrow-Turning Breath without spending your Reaction once per round. Hostile flying creatures that start their turn within 60 feet of you must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have their Fly Speed reduced by half until the start of their next turn. Breath-dependent hostile creatures within 30 feet have Disadvantage on checks requiring speech, breath control, or verbal command. You can speak and be heard clearly by chosen creatures within 1 mile if there is an open air path. This incarnation does not function in a true vacuum unless you supply Created Air or another appropriate source. #### Heaven-Splitting Gale - Cutting, Storm Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300 feet Area: 300-foot line, 10 feet wide Cost: 3 CP Release a line of sky-cutting wind. Creatures in the line make a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: A creature takes 8d8 slashing damage, is pushed 30 feet in a direction perpendicular to the line, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: It takes half damage and is pushed 10 feet. Objects, ordinary projectiles, banners, ropes, wooden doors, sails, and exposed siege mechanisms in the line may be severed or damaged at the GM’s discretion. #### Ten-Thousand Arrow Reversal - Guard Prerequisite: CL 15+, Turn the Hundred Arrows Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A volley, barrage, ordinary ranged weapon attack, or non-Secret physical projectile technique targets creatures in a 60-foot-radius area you can see Cost: 3 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Make an Air Check against the highest attack roll among the triggering attacks or against the attacker’s Cultivation Save DC if the volley uses saving throws. Success: Negate the volley against creatures you choose in the area. You may redirect a number of projectiles equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus as harmless impacts or as attacks against new targets within the volley’s original range. Use your Cultivation Attack Modifier for redirected attacks. Failure: Chosen creatures in the area gain Resistance to the volley’s damage. Secret Inheritances, artifacts, siege-scale weapons, and domain-scale calamities may require an opposed Cultivation Check or may be immune. #### Breath of No Distance - Breath, Current Prerequisite: CL 15+ You can carry breath through the world’s air. As an Action, choose one creature you know on the same plane within 10 miles. You must have a clear symbolic or physical connection: name, token, blood mark, talisman, familiar scent, active formation link, or current line of sight. You may send a spoken message of up to one hundred words to that creature. If the creature is willing, it may answer with up to one hundred words. If the path between you is blocked by sealed barriers, underground isolation, planar interference, a stronger Formation, or Void concealment, make an Air Check against the obstacle’s DC. On a failure, the message scatters and both creatures hear only wind. #### Empty-Lung Edict - Breath Prerequisite: CL 15+, Breathless Chamber Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Target: One breath-dependent creature Cost: 3 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest per target You command the target’s breath to stop obeying it. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, the target is Silenced, cannot take Reactions, cannot cast or activate techniques requiring speech, mantra, roar, song, or breath control, and has Disadvantage on attack rolls. Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration. This is not permanent suffocation. Creatures without breath are immune unless the GM permits an equivalent animating current to be targeted. #### World-Wind Road - Sky-Step, Domain Prerequisite: CL 15+, Sky Road When you create Sky Road, you may extend it up to 1 mile, provided you can see the destination or have a formation, talisman, ally signal, or known landmark to anchor the end. The road lasts for 1 hour with Concentration. It can carry a number of creatures equal to ten times your Proficiency Bonus at a time. Strong hostile weather, enemy Air techniques, anti-flight formations, sealed barriers, or Void concealment can break or divert the road. #### Storm Without Direction - Storm Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 120-foot Emanation Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP You create a storm of contradictory currents around yourself. Hostile creatures in the area cannot benefit from Advantage on ranged attack rolls unless the Advantage comes from a Secret Inheritance, artifact, or higher authority. Flying hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. Ordinary fog, smoke, dust, ash, leaves, cloth, and unsecured Tiny objects whirl through the area. At the start of each of your turns, choose one additional effect until the start of your next turn: No Straight Line: Ranged attacks passing through the area have Disadvantage. No Steady Foot: Hostile creatures that move more than half their Speed must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone at the end of that movement. No Safe Breath: Breath-dependent hostile creatures have Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration. No Fixed Direction: When a hostile creature is pushed or pulled in the area, increase that movement by 10 feet. ### Secret Air Inheritance #### When Heaven Exhales Secret Air Inheritance Prerequisites: Sky-Sovereign Incarnation, CL 17+, access to a true sky scripture, storm-gate inheritance, or heavenly breath revelation Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 1-mile-radius sky and ground region centered on you Duration: Instantaneous, with aftermath until the end of your next turn Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per week You make the sky exhale once. Choose up to three of the following decrees. Each hostile creature, projectile, flying object, or active windlike technique in the area is affected as appropriate. The Breath Returns: Breath-dependent hostile creatures make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they cannot speak, shout, chant, command, or use breath-required techniques until the end of your next turn. On a success, they cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. The Arrows Lose Their Road: Ordinary ranged weapon attacks, thrown weapons, volleys, and non-Secret physical projectile techniques in the area fail against targets you choose until the start of your next turn. The Sky Rejects Weight: Allied creatures you choose gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and Hover until the end of your next turn. The Ground Receives the Proud: Hostile flying creatures make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, they descend up to 300 feet, land if possible, and fall Prone. On a success, their Fly Speed is halved until the end of their next turn. The World Turns Sideways: Choose a direction. Hostile creatures and unattended objects not anchored to the ground are pushed 60 feet in that direction. A creature may make a Strength saving throw to halve the distance. The Gate Opens: Create a Sky Road up to 1 mile long that lasts until the end of your next turn without Concentration. After resolving the decrees, you may immediately move up to your Speed or Fly Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Limits: When Heaven Exhales does not create regional weather permanently, erase mountains, move sealed buildings, kill breathless creatures automatically, or bypass stronger domain-scale authority without an opposed Cultivation Check. Creatures inside airtight sealed structures are affected only if the chosen decree can reach them through an air path or through a superior inheritance-level contest. ### Air Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures Air drawbacks are optional sphere-specific limitations. A drawback grants the listed bonus talent or benefit but changes how your Air cultivation works. Unless a drawback says otherwise, choose at most one Air drawback when first learning the sphere or during a major Air initiation. Removing the drawback removes the bonus talent or benefit. #### Breath-Bound Scripture You cannot use Air talents while unable to breathe, speak, exhale, or move air through your body. You also cannot use Air talents in a true vacuum unless you already have Created Air available. You gain Breath-Braced Body as a bonus talent. This drawback suits lung cultivators, mantra-breath lineages, and Body Refining bellows arts. #### Grounded Wind Scripture You cannot gain a Fly Speed from Air talents before Nascent Soul Realm. Sky-Step talents may still improve jumps, slow falls, glide, or move briefly through the air, but you must land by the end of the movement. You gain Arrow-Turning Breath as a bonus talent. This drawback suits defensive wind sects, banner guards, and anti-projectile lineages. #### Sleeve-Fan Dependency Your Air techniques require a fan, sleeve, banner, flute, feather, scarf, robe hem, weapon tassel, or comparable focus. If the focus is restrained, stolen, destroyed, sealed, or unavailable, you must succeed on an Air Check against DC 15 to use any Air talent. On a failure, the action and CP are spent but the effect fails. You gain Sleeve-Fan Method as a bonus talent. #### Still-Center Doctrine Your Air cultivation rejects reckless storms. You cannot learn Storm talents unless they are required by a Secret Inheritance or granted by a sect initiation. You gain Cloud-Sleeve Guard as a bonus talent. #### Open-Sky Requirement You have Disadvantage on Air Checks and Air attack rolls while underground, inside sealed buildings, underwater, or in spaces with low ceilings and poor airflow. You ignore this drawback in courtyards, open halls, caves with strong wind, ships, towers, mountaintops, and battlefields with clear air circulation. You gain Wind-Sense as a bonus talent. ### Path Synergies #### Body Refining - Bellows Body Body Refining Air begins inside the body. You may use Constitution as your Air key ability for Cultivation Save DCs and Air Checks. When you use Air through Body Refining: your Air techniques must originate from your breath, skin, footwork, lungs, sleeves, worn armor vents, held weapon, fan, banner, or a surface you physically strike; your Gather Current range is reduced by 10 feet unless the Current is centered on you or a physical object you are touching; you cannot create invisible, detached, long-duration external Currents at range unless an Insight, item, forged technique, or GM permission allows it; when you take the Attack action or Dash action, you may use Gather Current as part of the same action once per turn. While inside one of your own Currents, you gain Advantage on saving throws against being pushed, pulled, knocked Prone, or suffocated by non-Secret Air effects. #### Qi Cultivation - Outer Wind Circulation Qi Cultivation is the most natural path for external Air manipulation. You may use Intelligence or Charisma as your Air key ability. When you spend CP on an Air talent, choose one: increase the range by 30 feet; increase one Current’s size by 5 feet in one dimension; move one active Current up to 15 feet; change one Current’s Vector; reduce the CP cost of one Air forged technique used before the end of your turn by 1, minimum 1. #### Spirit Awakening - Wind-Intent Perception Spirit Awakening cultivators hear intent in breath and pressure. You may use Wisdom as your Air key ability. You may apply Breath talents to spirits, ghosts, possessed bodies, and spiritual projections if they have visible or perceivable spirit-breath, ghost-wind, possession pressure, or soul resonance. Once per round when a creature inside one of your Air Currents speaks, casts, chants, roars, uses a command, or begins a breath-based technique, you may learn one: whether it is concentrating; whether it relies on breath, voice, or mantra; whether it is possessed or spiritually projected; whether a current around it is natural, magical, spiritual, or formation-made; whether it is protected from suffocation or breath disruption. This does not reveal complete thoughts, exact Path, full Realm, or secret techniques. ### Cultivation Insights #### Cloud-Step Novice Prerequisite: Air sphere, CL 4+ When you use Feather-Fall Breath on yourself, you may also move 10 feet horizontally before landing. Once per short or long rest, when you would fall after ending your turn in the air, you may delay the fall until the end of your next turn. #### Living Bellows Body Prerequisite: Air sphere, Body Refining Path, CL 6+ Your lungs and ribs can act as a temporary Air Source. When you create a Current centered on yourself, you may make it a Driving Current even if you are not Foundation Realm, but only until the start of your next turn. Once per short or long rest, when you fail a saving throw against inhaled poison, suffocation, smoke, or breath disruption, you may choose to succeed instead. #### Wind-Line Archer Prerequisite: Air sphere, Sniper or Barrage sphere, CL 6+ When you make a ranged weapon attack through one of your Air Currents, ignore Disadvantage from long range for that attack. Once per turn, if the attack hits, you may move the target 5 feet in the direction of the Current if it is no more than one size larger than you. #### Four-Wind Adept Prerequisite: Air sphere, Breath Beyond the Skin, CL 8+ When you use Gather Current, you may choose two Vectors instead of one. A creature or projectile can be affected by only one of those Vectors each time it enters the Current. Once per short or long rest, when you roll initiative, you may create one Light Current centered on yourself without using an action. #### Storm-Eye Disciple Prerequisite: Air sphere, Court of the Four Winds, CL 12+ When you activate Court of the Four Winds, choose one allied creature. That creature may ignore the first instance of Difficult Terrain created by your Air talents each round. In addition, when a hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Air talents inside the court, you may move one Current 10 feet. #### Breath-Thread Listener Prerequisite: Air sphere, Spirit Awakening Path, CL 8+ You can hear the thread of breath behind speech. You have Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks against creatures you can hear breathing or speaking within 30 feet. Once per short or long rest, when such a creature lies, begins a command technique, or attempts to hide panic, you may ask the GM whether its breath is steady, strained, false, absent, or spiritually masked.

#### Gather Current
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
You stir a small controlled Air Current in a 10-foot cube you can see within range.
When you create the Current, choose one Vector:
Lift: A willing creature that starts in or enters the Current before it ends may add 5 feet to one jump or ignore the first 10 feet of falling damage before the Current ends.
Press: The first hostile creature that starts in or enters the Current before it ends treats the Current’s space as Difficult Terrain.
Scatter: Nonmagical smoke, loose dust, harmless vapor, light fog, or similar airborne material in the Current is dispersed or shifted 10 feet.
Carry: A whisper, scent, ribbon, Tiny unattended object weighing no more than 1 pound, or comparable harmless sign may be carried from one point in the Current to another point in the Current.
Turn: The first ordinary Tiny projectile that passes through the Current before it ends has Disadvantage on its attack roll.
At Foundation Realm, the Current increases to a 15-foot cube. At Core Formation, it increases to a 20-foot cube.

resolved_automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Wind Lash
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object you can see
Cost: None
You release a cutting or battering current at a target.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On a hit, the target takes bludgeoning or slashing damage equal to 1d8 + your Path key ability modifier.
The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17.
When Wind Lash hits, choose one basic Vector:
Push: Push the target 5 feet directly away from you if it is no more than one size larger than you.
Pull: Pull the target 5 feet directly toward you if it is no more than one size larger than you.
Cut: The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
Lift: The target’s next jump before the start of your next turn is increased by 5 feet if the target is willing. If the target is unwilling, this option has no effect.
Scatter: One Tiny unattended object within 5 feet of the target moves up to 10 feet in a direction you choose.
Wind Lash is a Cultivation Attack, not a weapon attack, unless a talent says otherwise.

### Alchemy Check
When a refinement, recipe, or alchemical project calls for an Alchemy Check, roll:
d20 + Proficiency Bonus + Alchemy key ability modifier
Before rolling, you may spend CP to steady the refinement. Spend up to your Proficiency Bonus CP. Each CP spent this way adds +1 to the Alchemy Check.
Unless a feature says otherwise, spending CP this way must be declared before the roll.

### Field Formula
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock
Requirement: Alchemist’s supplies and a cauldron, portable furnace, crucible, medicine gourd, smoke tube, formula satchel, or Body as Cauldron access
Release one prepared alchemical formula. Field Formula represents smoke packets, volatile pellets, corrosive dregs, sealed medicine fumes, powdered irritants, and quick-release pill shells prepared during the day’s refinement. It does not mean the cauldron itself attacks.
Choose one Field Formula you know and resolve its effect. You know the following Field Formulae when you learn Alchemy:
#### Medicinal Smoke
Choose yourself or one ally within range.
The target gains Temporary HP equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and may immediately repeat one saving throw against the Poisoned condition.
The Temporary HP increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
#### Numbing Smoke
Choose a point within range. Smoke briefly fills a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered there. Each hostile creature of your choice in the area makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes Poison damage equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and suffers no Reaction loss.
The damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
#### Corrosive Dregs
Choose one creature or one 5-foot space within range. The target or each hostile creature of your choice in that space makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes Acid damage equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and is covered in unstable residue until the start of your next turn. The first time it takes damage before then, it takes additional Acid damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not covered in residue.
The initial damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.

### Reagent Stock
Reagent Stock represents sealed combat vials, volatile pellets, powdered dregs, premeasured furnace fuel, medicinal smoke packets, and quick-release pill shells.
During a Long Rest, you may prepare a number of Reagent Stock uses up to:
Proficiency Bonus + Alchemy key ability modifier, minimum 1
Each use costs 10 gp in common reagents unless a talent states a different cost.
Unused Reagent Stock remains stable until your next Long Rest. At the end of that Long Rest, unused stock spoils or must be folded into the next day’s preparation.
A talent that spends Reagent Stock consumes one prepared use. Reagent Stock is not an item another creature can normally use unless a talent says so.
