spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Alchemy Qi Expression: Primary — Furnace Qi; Supporting — Medicinal Qi, Fire Qi, Refinement Qi, Earth-Digestive Qi. “The cauldron does not judge. It only refines.” Common Name: Alchemy Sphere Sphere Type: Restricted Power Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Rare Body Access: Body Refining through the Body as Cauldron Insight Resources: CP, prepared ingredients, alchemist’s supplies, and a cauldron or portable furnace Common Effects: Pill forging, medicinal refinement, volatile elixirs, explosive pills, field formulae, poison smokes, invigorating fumes, volatile pellets, antidotes, purification, cultivation support, pill saturation, pill impurity, pill spirits, sect pill halls, grand refinement projects ### Alchemy Dao Alchemy is the cultivation of refinement. A mortal cook changes ingredients with heat. An alchemist changes fate by deciding what must be burned away, what must be preserved, and what may be condensed into one impossible pill. The Sphere of Alchemy does not grow the herb, hunt the beast, or bless the field. Those belong to future harvesting, gathering, nature, beast, or sect infrastructure rules. Alchemy begins when the substance has already been placed beside the furnace and the cultivator asks what truth can be extracted from it. The recurring loop is: Assess the material. Identify the nature, grade, conflict, and hidden poison of the ingredients. Open the furnace. Choose the flame, cauldron pressure, timing, and refinement method. Separate essence from dross. Remove impurity, stabilize violent reactions, and draw useful essence together. Condense the result. Create a pill, elixir, smoke, volatile pellet, medicinal ash, or volatile formula. Pay the residue. Track cost, saturation, impurity, failed batches, and backlash. Alchemy rewards money, preparation, recipe access, correct ingredients, patience, and controlled risk. A wealthy alchemist with a better cauldron and rarer materials has a higher ceiling than a poor one, but the sphere should still function at the table without turning every combat round into an accounting exercise. ### What Alchemy Covers Alchemy governs refinement, pills, elixirs, volatile pellets, prepared medicinal formulae, poison smokes, medicinal vapors, corrosive dregs, volatile pellets, purification, antidotes, body-tempering medicine, and sect-scale pill production. Alchemy does not govern: growing herbs; locating spiritual gardens; harvesting beast cores; breeding rare plants; farming medicinal fields; creating ingredients from nothing; permanent formations; talisman inscription; general poison mastery; cooking as mundane hospitality; broad transmutation of any matter into any other matter. The future growing and harvesting sphere should decide how rare materials enter the campaign. Alchemy decides what those materials become once they reach the cauldron. ### Alchemy Access Alchemy is a Restricted Power Sphere by default because pill refinement and field formula techniques manipulate spiritual essence directly. Qi Cultivation is the cleanest default access. Spirit Awakening can practice Alchemy through perception of spiritual essence, pill spirits, karmic residue, and soul medicine. Body Refining does not gain Alchemy automatically. A Body Refiner may learn Alchemy through the Body as Cauldron Cultivation Insight. That version uses Constitution, Stamina, and internal furnace discipline, but it is riskier because failed refinement harms the body that served as the cauldron. ## Core Alchemy Rules ### Alchemy Key Ability When you learn Alchemy, use Intelligence as your Alchemy key ability. If a Path synergy, Insight, or talent explicitly replaces the key ability, use that ability for Alchemy Checks, Cultivation Save DCs, and Alchemy Cultivation Attacks. ### Alchemy Training When you learn Alchemy, gain proficiency with alchemist’s supplies. If you already have proficiency with alchemist’s supplies, choose one Mortal Realm Alchemy talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. You also gain the following base abilities: Alchemy Check; Pill Forging; Field Formula; Reagent Stock. ### Alchemy Check When a refinement, recipe, or alchemical project calls for an Alchemy Check, roll: d20 + Proficiency Bonus + Alchemy key ability modifier Before rolling, you may spend CP to steady the refinement. Spend up to your Proficiency Bonus CP. Each CP spent this way adds +1 to the Alchemy Check. Unless a feature says otherwise, spending CP this way must be declared before the roll. ### Cauldrons and Furnaces Alchemy normally requires a cauldron, furnace, portable pill stove, crucible, or comparable refinement focus. A basic travel cauldron costs 50 gp and is sufficient for Common and Uncommon recipes. Higher-rarity recipes require better equipment unless the GM allows a dangerous improvised method. If you lack a proper cauldron, you may attempt Common or Uncommon Alchemy at a -4 penalty. You cannot refine Rare or higher pills without appropriate equipment unless a talent says otherwise. A cauldron is an object. It is a refinement focus, furnace, or staging point, not an ordinary weapon. If a scene places your cauldron in danger, use ordinary object rules unless the talent gives special statistics. ### Cauldron Investment Alchemy intentionally has a high ceiling from monetary investment. Better cauldrons, pill halls, recipe libraries, ingredient vaults, purification chambers, and sect backing do not replace Alchemy talent access, but they improve reliability, scale, and high-rarity access. Suggested cauldron grades: Travel Cauldron. Cost 50 gp. Supports Common and Uncommon recipes. No bonus. Bronze Pill Cauldron. Cost 500 gp. Supports Rare recipes. Once per long rest, reduce the CP spent to steady one Common or Uncommon Alchemy Check by 1, minimum 0. Spirit-Bronze Cauldron. Cost 2,500 gp. Supports Very Rare recipes. Gain +1 to Alchemy Checks made with proper ingredients. This bonus does not stack with another cauldron bonus. Jade-Fire Cauldron. Cost 10,000 gp and a suitable rare furnace core. Supports Legendary recipes. Gain +2 to Alchemy Checks made with proper ingredients. Once per week, reroll one failed Alchemy Check, keeping the new result. Heavenly Cauldron. Cost 50,000 gp, one Heavenly Material, and GM approval. Supports Secret recipes. Gain +3 to Alchemy Checks made with proper ingredients. When you roll a natural 1 on an Alchemy Check, treat the backlash as one rarity tier lower. A cauldron bonus never applies to harvesting, gathering, growing, purchasing, bargaining, or identifying ingredients unless a feature specifically says so. ### Ingredient Cost and Quality Recipe costs assume appropriate ingredients of the correct grade. Gold cost is a campaign-facing abstraction for herbs, beast cores, mineral powders, spirit dew, venom, incense, jade dust, furnace fuel, and stabilizing reagents. If the GM tracks exact ingredients, the listed cost is a guideline for total value. Inferior ingredients increase the Alchemy Check DC by 2 to 5. Exceptional ingredients may reduce the DC by 1 or 2, improve the result on a success, or permit a recipe that would otherwise be unavailable. ### Pill Rarity Common Recipe. DC 12. Ingredient cost 25 gp. Refinement time 1 hour. Uncommon Recipe. DC 15. Ingredient cost 100 gp. Refinement time 2 hours. Rare Recipe. DC 18. Ingredient cost 500 gp. Refinement time 8 hours. Very Rare Recipe. DC 22. Ingredient cost 2,500 gp. Refinement time 7 days. Legendary Recipe. DC 28. Ingredient cost 10,000 gp plus one Heavenly Material. Refinement time 30 days. Secret Recipe. Special DC, cost, and time. Secret recipes are campaign events, not routine purchases. ### Refinement Results Success. Create the intended pill, elixir, pellet, ash, or formula. Success by 5 or More. Create a Refined product. Choose one benefit appropriate to the recipe: add Proficiency Bonus to one healing or restoration roll; increase the duration by 50 percent; reduce Saturation by 1, minimum 0; increase the recipe’s Save DC by 1; increase granted CXP by 25 percent; remove one minor side effect; create one extra dose if the recipe is Common and not a permanent enhancement. Success by 10 or More. Create a Perfect or Veined product if the recipe could reasonably have one. Choose two benefits from the Refined list, or choose one stronger benefit with GM approval. Failure by 5 or Less. Create a Broken product. It may still function, but it gains one flaw chosen by the GM or rolled from the Broken Product list. Failure by More Than 5. The ingredients are lost. Natural 1. The ingredients are lost and you suffer backlash. Take 1d6 Fire, Poison, Acid, or Force damage per rarity tier of the recipe. The GM chooses the type based on the failed refinement. #### Broken Product Flaws The product has half duration. The product restores half as much HP or CP. The product increases Saturation by 1. The product gives the Poisoned condition until the end of the consumer’s next turn. The product imposes Disadvantage on the next Alchemy Check made with the same cauldron before it is cleaned during a Short Rest. The product works, but the consumer gains 1 Pill Impurity. ### Pill Saturation A creature safely consumes one Cultivation or Enhancement pill per Long Rest. Each additional Cultivation or Enhancement pill consumed before the creature finishes a Long Rest requires a Constitution saving throw. DC: 10 + 2 x the number of Cultivation or Enhancement pills already consumed since the creature’s last Long Rest. Successful Save: The pill functions. The creature gains 1 Pill Impurity. Failed Save: The pill has no beneficial effect. The creature gains 1 Pill Impurity and has the Poisoned condition until it finishes a Long Rest. Failure by 5 or More: The creature also gains 1 Exhaustion level. Medicinal pills, emergency antidotes, battle pellets, and purely offensive products do not count against Pill Saturation unless their recipe says otherwise. ### Pill Impurity Pill Impurity represents residue from imperfect refinement, overeating pills, unstable shortcuts, and medicinal conflict. Each Pill Impurity imposes a -1 penalty to breakthrough checks. Pill Impurity can be removed by: a Purification Pill or similar Alchemy recipe; appropriate Life, Blood, or Purification techniques; a successful cultivation cleansing process during downtime; a Realm event or tribulation reward; GM-approved treatment. ### Cultivation Pills and CXP Cultivation pills may grant CXP, but they do not replace ordinary cultivation, breakthrough requirements, or Realm Tribulations unless a Secret recipe explicitly says otherwise. Suggested CXP values: Common Cultivation Pill: 50 CXP. Uncommon Cultivation Pill: 150 CXP. Rare Cultivation Pill: 400 CXP. Very Rare Cultivation Pill: 1,000 CXP. Legendary Cultivation Pill: Recipe-specific. A character cannot repeatedly benefit from the same exact CXP pill recipe more than once per Long Rest unless a talent says otherwise. ### Reagent Stock Reagent Stock represents sealed combat vials, volatile pellets, powdered dregs, premeasured furnace fuel, medicinal smoke packets, and quick-release pill shells. During a Long Rest, you may prepare a number of Reagent Stock uses up to: Proficiency Bonus + Alchemy key ability modifier, minimum 1 Each use costs 10 gp in common reagents unless a talent states a different cost. Unused Reagent Stock remains stable until your next Long Rest. At the end of that Long Rest, unused stock spoils or must be folded into the next day’s preparation. A talent that spends Reagent Stock consumes one prepared use. Reagent Stock is not an item another creature can normally use unless a talent says so. ### Field Formula Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock Requirement: Alchemist’s supplies and a cauldron, portable furnace, crucible, medicine gourd, smoke tube, formula satchel, or Body as Cauldron access Release one prepared alchemical formula. Field Formula represents smoke packets, volatile pellets, corrosive dregs, sealed medicine fumes, powdered irritants, and quick-release pill shells prepared during the day’s refinement. It does not mean the cauldron itself attacks. Choose one Field Formula you know and resolve its effect. You know the following Field Formulae when you learn Alchemy: #### Medicinal Smoke Choose yourself or one ally within range. The target gains Temporary HP equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and may immediately repeat one saving throw against the Poisoned condition. The Temporary HP increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17. #### Numbing Smoke Choose a point within range. Smoke briefly fills a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered there. Each hostile creature of your choice in the area makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes Poison damage equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and suffers no Reaction loss. The damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17. #### Corrosive Dregs Choose one creature or one 5-foot space within range. The target or each hostile creature of your choice in that space makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes Acid damage equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and is covered in unstable residue until the start of your next turn. The first time it takes damage before then, it takes additional Acid damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not covered in residue. The initial damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17. ### Field Formula Delivery A normal cauldron is too heavy to carry around as a combat weapon. In battle, Alchemy normally uses prepared packets, pellets, incense sticks, flasks, smoke tubes, and sealed doses that were refined beforehand. A portable pill stove, crucible, medicine gourd, smoke tube, formula satchel, or Body as Cauldron practice allows you to use Field Formula while moving normally. Unless a talent says otherwise, a Field Formula originates from you, from a formula packet you throw or release, or from a prepared burner or cauldron within your reach. Total Cover blocks the effect normally. The cauldron is a refinement focus, not a standard weapon. This draft intentionally avoids treating alchemy cauldrons as thrown or striking attacks. ## Alchemy Talent Tags Recipe Talents. A Recipe talent teaches one or more pills, elixirs, pellets, ashes, or formulae. Furnace Talents. A Furnace talent improves Field Formula, furnace pressure, cauldron use, formula delivery, or combat deployment. Medicine Talents. A Medicine talent heals, purifies, stabilizes, or supports allies. Volatile Talents. A Volatile talent creates smoke, corrosive residue, poison vapor, explosive pellets, burning powder, or unstable formulae. Refinement Talents. A Refinement talent improves Alchemy Checks, recipe quality, batch size, time, or ingredient handling. Dregs Talents. A Dregs talent weaponizes waste, ash, residue, sludge, failed pills, or impurity. Realm Evolutions. A Realm Evolution represents Alchemy that has become openly supernatural. Unique Alchemy Talents. A Unique Alchemy Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another tag. ## Mortal Realm Alchemy Talents ### Rapid Refinement - Refinement When refining a Common or Uncommon recipe, you may spend +2 CP to reduce the refinement time to one quarter of normal. You may use Rapid Refinement a number of times per Long Rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Ingredient Substitution - Refinement You may replace one required ingredient with another compatible ingredient of equal value. Each substitution increases the Alchemy Check DC by 2. Ingredient Substitution does not create rare ingredients from common ones. The replacement must still make narrative and alchemical sense. ### Furnace Mastery - Refinement Gain +2 to Alchemy Checks made with a proper cauldron. This bonus does not stack with a cauldron quality bonus. Use the higher bonus. You may use an improvised cauldron for Common and Uncommon recipes without the usual -4 penalty. ### Pill Appraisal - Refinement You have Advantage on Study checks to identify pills, elixirs, alchemical powders, medicinal ashes, cauldrons, and recipe fragments. With 10 minutes of study, you can identify a Common or Uncommon pill automatically unless it has been deliberately disguised by a higher-Realm technique. This talent identifies ingredients but does not locate, grow, or harvest them. ### Clean Furnace Method - Refinement When you finish a Short Rest, you may clean and stabilize one cauldron you used since your last Long Rest. The next Alchemy Check made with that cauldron before your next Short or Long Rest ignores one Broken Product flaw or reduces backlash damage by your Proficiency Bonus. ### Sealed Dose Method - Refinement Your Reagent Stock maximum increases by your Proficiency Bonus. In addition, one ally may carry one sealed dose you prepared. The ally can administer that dose as an Action if the dose is a Medicinal Smoke, Healing Pill, Antidote Pill, or another recipe the GM agrees is safe for field use. ### Fasting Pill - Recipe You learn the Fasting Pill recipe. Rarity: Common. Consumption: Action. Effect: The consumer needs no food or water for 7 days. This does not remove existing Exhaustion from starvation or thirst. ### Calming Heart Pill - Recipe, Medicine You learn the Calming Heart Pill recipe. Rarity: Common. Consumption: Bonus Action. Effect: For 1 hour, the consumer gains +1 to saving throws against the Charmed condition, the Frightened condition, Heart Demon effects, and effects that would disturb cultivation meditation. ### Healing Pill - Recipe, Medicine You learn the Healing Pill recipe. Rarity: Common. Consumption: Bonus Action. Effect: Restore 2d4 + 2 HP. A creature can benefit from this exact recipe a number of times per Long Rest equal to its Proficiency Bonus. ### Antidote Pill - Recipe, Medicine You learn the Antidote Pill recipe. Rarity: Common. Consumption: Bonus Action. Effect: The consumer has Advantage on the next saving throw it makes against poison before it finishes a Short Rest. If the consumer currently has the Poisoned condition from an effect that allows repeated saves, it immediately repeats one save against that effect. ### Spirit-Gathering Pill - Recipe You learn the Spirit-Gathering Pill recipe. Rarity: Common. Consumption: During a 10-minute cultivation meditation. Effect: Gain 50 CXP. This is a Cultivation pill and counts against Pill Saturation. ### Furnace Vent - Furnace, Volatile You learn the Furnace Vent Field Formula. Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Field Formula Factory Routing: combat_action_row; field_formula_detail Area: 15-foot cone. Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock. You crack a sealed heat-packet, smoke tube, or small furnace vent, releasing scalding medicinal vapor and bitter fumes. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes Poison or Fire damage equal to 1d8 + your Alchemy key ability modifier, chosen when you use this formula, and has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Half damage and no Disadvantage. The damage increases to 2d8 at CL 5, 3d8 at CL 11, and 4d8 at CL 17. ### Corrosive Distillate - Furnace, Volatile When you use Corrosive Dregs or another Field Formula that deals Acid damage, choose one nonmagical object worn or carried by one affected creature that you can see. Until the start of your next turn, the object takes a -1 penalty to AC if it grants AC, or the target takes a -1 penalty to the next attack roll made with that object. This talent cannot destroy an object by itself and cannot affect artifacts unless the GM permits it. ### Numbing Powder - Furnace, Volatile You learn the Numbing Powder Field Formula. Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Field Formula Factory Routing: combat_action_row; field_formula_detail Range: 30 feet. Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock. Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target takes 1d6 Poison damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Half damage and no Reaction loss. The damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17. ### Binding Dregs - Furnace, Dregs You learn the Binding Dregs Field Formula. Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Field Formula Factory Routing: combat_action_row; field_formula_detail Range: 30 feet. Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock. Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the target is standing on a solid surface, it also cannot take the Dash action until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn. ### Cauldron Guard - Cauldron When a creature you can see hits you with an attack while you are adjacent to your cauldron or using Body as Cauldron, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP to gain a +2 bonus to AC against the triggering attack. If this causes the attack to miss, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker. ### Bitter Dregs - Dregs, Volatile When you create a Broken product, you may preserve its failed residue as Bitter Dregs instead of discarding it. You may maintain a number of Bitter Dregs up to your Proficiency Bonus. Each Bitter Dregs spoils when you finish a Long Rest. When you use Field Formula, you may spend one Bitter Dregs instead of one Reagent Stock. If the technique deals damage, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll, but if the attack misses or all targets succeed on their saves, you take Poison damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ## Foundation Realm Alchemy Talents ### Batch Refinement - Refinement Prerequisite: CL 5+. When refining a recipe, you may refine multiple pills or doses of the same recipe simultaneously. Maximum products in one batch: your Proficiency Bonus. You must provide ingredients for each product. Increase the refinement time by 50 percent. Spend +1 CP for each product beyond the first. Roll one Alchemy Check for the batch. If the batch fails, all products share the failed result. ### Qi Infusion Pill - Recipe Prerequisite: CL 5+. You learn the Qi Infusion Pill recipe. Rarity: Uncommon. Ingredient Cost: 150 gp. Refinement Cost: 3 CP. Consumption: Bonus Action. Effect: Recover 2d6 + Proficiency Bonus CP. A creature can benefit from this recipe once per Short Rest. ### Stamina Boiling Pill - Recipe Prerequisite: CL 5+. You learn the Stamina Boiling Pill recipe. Rarity: Uncommon. Ingredient Cost: 150 gp. Refinement Cost: 3 CP or 3 Stamina if created through Body as Cauldron. Consumption: Bonus Action. Effect: Recover 2d6 + Proficiency Bonus Stamina. A creature can benefit from this recipe once per Short Rest. ### Pill of Restoration - Recipe, Medicine Prerequisite: CL 5+. You learn the Pill of Restoration recipe. Rarity: Uncommon. Ingredient Cost: 150 gp. Refinement Cost: 3 CP. Consumption: Action. Choose one effect: remove one disease; end the Poisoned condition if caused by a poison or alchemical effect; reduce Exhaustion by one level if the Exhaustion was caused by poison, disease, suffocation, starvation, thirst, or alchemical backlash; end one minor alchemical side effect; grant Advantage on the next saving throw against a curse or Heart Demon effect before the consumer finishes a Long Rest. ### Meridian-Sealing Pill - Recipe, Volatile Prerequisite: CL 5+. You learn the Meridian-Sealing Pill recipe. Rarity: Uncommon. Ingredient Cost: 150 gp. Refinement Cost: 3 CP. You may administer the pill to a willing or helpless creature as an Action, or release it as a Field Formula pellet. When released as a Field Formula, choose one creature within 60 feet. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target cannot recover CP until the end of its next turn. Successful Save: The target cannot recover CP until the start of its next turn. This does not remove CP the target already has. ### Poison Pill - Recipe, Volatile Prerequisite: CL 5+. You learn one poison pill formula: Venom Pill, Nerve Pill, or Rotting Pill. You may learn this talent multiple times, choosing a different formula each time. Rarity: Uncommon. Ingredient Cost: 150 gp. Refinement Cost: 3 CP. When released as a Field Formula, choose one creature within 60 feet. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Venom Pill Failed Save: 6d6 Poison damage and Poisoned for 1 minute. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the Poisoned condition on a success. Venom Pill Successful Save: Half damage and Poisoned until the start of your next turn. Nerve Pill Failed Save: 3d6 Poison damage, and the target cannot take Reactions or Bonus Actions until the start of your next turn. Nerve Pill Successful Save: Half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Rotting Pill Failed Save: 3d6 Necrotic or Poison damage, and the target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Rotting Pill Successful Save: Half damage. ### Explosive Pill - Recipe, Volatile Prerequisite: CL 5+. You learn the Explosive Pill recipe. Rarity: Uncommon. Ingredient Cost: 150 gp. Refinement Cost: 3 CP. Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet. Area: 10-foot-radius Sphere. Throw or launch one prepared Explosive Pill. Each creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Poison when you refine the pill. Failed Save: The creature takes damage based on your CL. Successful Save: Half damage. CL 5-10: 4d6. CL 11-16: 6d6. CL 17-20: 8d6. ### False Medicine Pill - Recipe Prerequisite: CL 5+. You learn the False Medicine Pill recipe. Rarity: Uncommon. A False Medicine Pill resembles one beneficial recipe you know. Identifying the deception requires a Study action using Intelligence (Investigation), Intelligence (Arcana), or an appropriate alchemical check against your Cultivation Save DC. When consumed, the pill has no beneficial effect and the consumer must make a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The consumer is Poisoned until it finishes a Short Rest. Successful Save: The consumer is Poisoned until the end of its next turn. False Medicine Pill is a treacherous technique. Open sects may forbid it. ### Enhanced Pill Effect - Refinement Prerequisite: CL 5+. When refining a pill, spend additional CP to add one enhancement. +2 CP: Increase rolled healing or CP recovery by 50 percent. +3 CP: Double duration, maximum 24 hours. +4 CP: Increase the affected recipe's Save DC by 2. +4 CP: Reduce Saturation by 1, minimum 0. +6 CP: Apply two compatible enhancements. The GM may forbid incompatible enhancements. ### Choking Smoke Pellet - Volatile Prerequisite: CL 5+. You learn the Choking Smoke Pellet Field Formula. Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Field Formula Factory Routing: combat_action_row; field_formula_detail Range: 60 feet. Area: 10-foot-radius Sphere. Cost: 2 CP and one Reagent Stock. A pellet bursts into acrid smoke, ash, and bitter medicinal vapor. Each hostile creature of your choice in the area makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 2d6 Poison damage, cannot speak above a hoarse whisper, and cannot supply Verbal components until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Half damage and no speech restriction. At CL 11, the damage becomes 3d6. At CL 17, it becomes 4d6. Creatures that do not breathe have Advantage on this save unless the GM decides the formula attacks their spiritual circulation instead. ### Backdraft Fumes - Furnace, Volatile Prerequisite: CL 5+. When a creature within 10 feet of you hits you with a melee attack, you may use your Reaction, spend 1 CP, and spend one Reagent Stock to burst a packet of volatile fumes between you. The attacker makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The attacker takes Poison or Fire damage equal to 2d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier, chosen when you use this talent, and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Half damage and no Disadvantage. The damage increases to 3d6 at CL 11 and 4d6 at CL 17. ### Smoke of Returning Breath - Medicine Prerequisite: CL 5+. When you use Medicinal Smoke, the target may also choose one: end the Deafened condition; end the Blinded condition if caused by smoke, powder, poison, or alchemical irritation; stand from Prone without spending movement; gain Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn. ## Core Formation Alchemy Talents ### Advanced Pill Forging - Refinement Prerequisite: CL 10+. You may craft Rare and Very Rare recipes. When you fail an Alchemy Check for a Rare or Very Rare recipe, you may spend 5 CP to reroll the check. You must use the new result. You may use this reroll once per recipe attempt. ### Pill Spirit Creation - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 10+. When refining a Rare or higher recipe, you may spend +8 CP after a successful Alchemy Check to attempt to awaken a Pill Spirit. Make a second Alchemy Check. DC: 20 + the recipe’s rarity tier. Success: The product awakens a minor Pill Spirit. A minor Pill Spirit has AC 15, 1 HP, Fly Speed 30 feet, can speak in a faint voice, and understands its own recipe, ingredients, flaws, and intended effect. It can take the Help action. It can identify herbs, pills, poisons, and medicinal residue within 30 feet. It can sacrifice itself to grant Advantage on one Alchemy Check made within 30 feet. A Pill Spirit is not a familiar, servant, combat creature, or permanent companion unless another feature says otherwise. ### Court of the Three-Legged Cauldron - Alchemy Domain Prerequisite: CL 10+. Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self. Area: 30-foot-radius Emanation. Duration: 1 minute. Cost: Expend Martial Focus if you have it, or spend 5 CP if you do not. Use Limit: Once per Short Rest. You manifest an alchemical court of furnace heat, rotating medicinal smoke, floating pill sigils, and visible dregs of failed refinement. While the Domain lasts: your Alchemy Checks gain +2; your Field Formula range increases by 30 feet; once per turn when you use Field Formula, reduce its CP cost by 1, minimum 0; allies of your choice who start their turns in the Domain gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; hostile creatures of your choice treat the Domain as lightly obscured by medicinal steam, though this does not hide you from creatures that can still see you clearly; the first time each turn a hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Alchemy techniques in the Domain, it takes extra Acid, Fire, Poison, or Force damage equal to your Alchemy key ability modifier. The Domain is magical. ### Formula Intensification - Cauldron Prerequisite: CL 10+. When you use Field Formula, you may spend +2 CP to choose one additional effect: increase the damage dice by one step, from d6 to d8 or d8 to d10; increase the range by 30 feet; increase an area by 5 feet; move yourself 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks immediately after the technique resolves; push one affected creature 10 feet on a failed save or hit. You may choose only one additional effect per use. ### Pill Devouring - Refinement, Volatile Prerequisite: CL 10+. Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Use Limit: Once per Short Rest. Consume one ingredient worth at least 100 gp or one pill you created. For 1 minute, gain: 5d8 Temporary HP; +2 to saving throw DCs for Field Formulae you use; +10 feet Speed. When the effect ends, choose one: gain 1 Pill Impurity; take 2d6 Poison damage and have the Poisoned condition until the end of your next turn. If you practice Demonic Cultivation or an equivalent corrupt method, the GM may allow you to take 1 Corruption instead of the listed cost. ### Eternal Pill Formula - Recipe, Refinement Prerequisite: CL 10+. Learn one Eternal Pill Formula. You may learn this talent multiple times, choosing a different formula each time. Each Eternal Pill is Very Rare, costs 2,500 gp in ingredients, costs 10 CP to refine, requires 7 days, and benefits a creature only once per Realm. Choose one: Longevity Pill: Slow ordinary aging and stabilize bodily decline. The exact lifespan effect is campaign-facing and set by the GM. Vitality Pill: Increase maximum HP by 5. Meridian Pill: Increase maximum CP by 2. Resistance Pill: Gain Resistance to one damage type chosen when the pill is refined. The GM may forbid Force, Psychic, Radiant, Necrotic, or another rare type unless the ingredients justify it. Ability-Refining Pill: Increase one ability score by 1, within the campaign’s Realm maximum. These pills are Enhancement pills and count against Pill Saturation. ### Purification Formula - Recipe, Medicine Prerequisite: CL 10+. You learn the Purification Formula. Rarity: Rare. Ingredient Cost: 500 gp. Refinement Cost: 5 CP. Consumption or Administration: Action. Choose one effect affecting the target: remove one major poison; remove one disease; remove 1d4 Pill Impurities; end one alchemical side effect; grant Advantage on the next saving throw against a curse, possession, Heart Demon, or spiritual injury before the target finishes a Long Rest. The GM may require a higher-rarity version to treat Legendary, Secret, divine, or artifact-grade afflictions. ### Ten Thousand Dregs Field - Dregs, Volatile Prerequisite: CL 10+. Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet. Area: 20-foot-radius Sphere. Duration: 1 minute. Cost: 3 CP and two Reagent Stock. You scatter alchemical residue, ash, oil, wasted powder, and cauldron sludge over the area. The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. The first time a hostile creature enters the area on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 3d6 Poison damage and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Half damage and no Disadvantage. At CL 17, the damage becomes 5d6. ### Seven-Flavor Furnace - Volatile Prerequisite: CL 10+. When you finish a Long Rest, choose up to three damage types from Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Poison, Radiant, and Thunder. When an Alchemy technique lets you choose Acid, Fire, Poison, or Force damage, you may choose one of your selected damage types instead. You must have ingredients, furnace fuel, or recipe logic that supports the selected damage types. ### Sect Pill Hall - Refinement Prerequisite: CL 10+. You may construct or supervise a Sect Pill Hall. Cost: 5,000 gp. Time: 30 days. A Sect Pill Hall requires space, ventilation, storage, assistants, fuel, records, tools, and at least one proper cauldron. Benefits while using the Pill Hall: Common and Uncommon refinement time is halved; Batch Refinement maximum increases by your Proficiency Bonus; ingredients stored there do not spoil under ordinary conditions; the hall can produce bulk Common and Uncommon pills during downtime if supplied with ingredients and trained assistants; the hall grants Advantage on checks to identify pills and alchemical contamination. This does not grow ingredients. ## Nascent Soul Alchemy Talents ### Heaven-Defying Pill - Recipe, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+. You may attempt Legendary recipes known as Heaven-Defying Pills. DC: 28. Ingredient Cost: 10,000 gp and one Heavenly Material. Refinement Time: 30 days. Refinement Cost: 20 CP paid across the refinement. Use Limit: One successful Heaven-Defying Pill per year per alchemist unless a Secret Inheritance says otherwise. Choose one formula when you learn this talent. You may learn this talent multiple times, choosing a different formula each time. Breakthrough Formula: The consumer gains enough CXP to attempt the next CL. The next breakthrough check made within 24 hours automatically succeeds. Realm advancement still requires any required Tribulation. Ability Formula: Increase one ability score by 2, within the campaign’s Realm maximum. A creature can benefit from this formula once per lifetime. Heavenly Purification Formula: Remove one major curse, severe poison, spiritual injury, alchemical corruption, Pill Impurity crisis, or comparable affliction. This may require an opposed check against Secret, divine, or artifact-grade conditions. Heavenly Resistance Formula: The consumer gains one use of Legendary Resistance per Long Rest. A creature can benefit from this formula once per lifetime. ### Nine-Revolution Refinement - Refinement Prerequisite: CL 15+. When refining a Rare or higher recipe, you may declare Nine-Revolution Refinement before rolling. Increase the refinement time by 50 percent and pay an additional ingredient cost equal to 25 percent of the recipe’s base cost. Make the Alchemy Check with Disadvantage. If the check succeeds, treat the result as though it succeeded by 10 or more. If the check fails, the backlash damage increases by one rarity tier and the product is destroyed. ### Living Pill Spirit - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+, Pill Spirit Creation. When you awaken a Pill Spirit from a Very Rare or higher recipe, you may bind it as a Living Pill Spirit. A Living Pill Spirit remains for up to 7 days or until consumed, sacrificed, or released. While within 60 feet of you, it can: take the Help action for Alchemy Checks; warn you if a pill, poison, or ingredient within 30 feet is flawed or contaminated; carry one Tiny pill or dose; deliver one medicinal pill to a willing creature within 30 feet as an Action on your turn; sacrifice itself to turn one failed Alchemy Check into a success, though not a success by 5 or more. You may maintain only one Living Pill Spirit at a time. ### World Within the Furnace - Furnace, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+. Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet. Area: 30-foot-radius Sphere. Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute. Cost: 8 CP and three Reagent Stock. You unfold a temporary alchemical environment: layered medicinal smoke, rotating ash, bitter vapor, unstable dregs, and flickering pill seals. This is not a thrown cauldron or a physical wall. It is the battlefield behaving like the inside of a refinement chamber. When you create the area, choose Acid, Fire, or Poison. Hostile creatures of your choice that start their turns in the area make a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 5d6 damage of the chosen type and suffers one of the following effects, chosen when you create the area: Burn Away Dross: The creature cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn. Numb the Meridians: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Clog the Breath: The creature cannot speak above a whisper or supply Verbal components until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Half damage and no additional effect. Allies of your choice that start their turns in the area gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Alchemy key ability modifier. The area is not a wall and does not provide cover. ### Resurrection Pill - Recipe, Medicine, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+, Heaven-Defying Pill. You learn the Resurrection Pill recipe. DC: 30. Ingredient Cost: 25,000 gp, a Phoenix Feather or equivalent rebirth material, the heart or core of a CR 20+ creature or equivalent spirit beast, and preserved blood or soul-resonant remains. Refinement Time: 30 days. Refinement Cost: 25 CP paid across the refinement. Use Limit: One successful Resurrection Pill per alchemist lifetime unless the campaign is intentionally mythic. The pill must be administered within 1 minute of death. The target returns to life with: full HP; half maximum CP; no ordinary resurrection penalty. The pill fails if the soul is destroyed, trapped, unwilling, reincarnated, or the body is completely unavailable. ### Grand Pill Hall - Refinement Prerequisite: CL 15+, Sect Pill Hall. You may construct or supervise a Grand Pill Hall. Cost: 50,000 gp. Time: 1 year. A Grand Pill Hall can support: army supply; city relief; epidemic treatment; sect cultivation; bulk Common and Uncommon pill production; modest Rare pill production; ingredient preservation; training of apprentice alchemists; safe storage for one Heavenly Material. This project requires logistics, guards, materials, labor, and political protection. It is a strategic asset, not a portable talent. ## Secret Inheritance ### Realm Ascension Pill - Secret Recipe Prerequisite: CL 17+, Heaven-Defying Pill, lost scripture, GM approval. DC: 32 or higher. Ingredient Cost: 100,000 gp, three Heavenly Materials, one Realm-specific treasure, and one personal karmic price chosen by the GM. Refinement Time: 1 year. Use Limit: Once per lifetime per alchemist and once per lifetime per consumer. You refine a pill that condenses an entire Realm crossing into one dangerous miracle. If the refinement succeeds and the consumer survives the administration, the consumer immediately advances to the first CL of the next Realm. Then resolve: a Heavenly Tribulation; a foundation-stability check; a Pill Impurity crisis; any story consequences of forcing Heaven to answer. Foundation-Stability Check: Constitution, Wisdom, or the consumer’s Path key ability, chosen by the GM based on the consumer’s method. DC: 20 + the number of CLs effectively skipped. Failure: The consumer advances but gains a severe lasting flaw, unstable foundation, damaged meridian, warped soul mark, corrupted body, or comparable defect. Realm Ascension Pill cannot bypass a sealed destiny, destroyed soul, divine prohibition, Secret curse, campaign-specific cultivation lock, or GM-declared impossibility. This Secret Inheritance should be legendary, feared, politically explosive, and rarely safe. ## Variants ### Field Alchemist You do not learn Pill Forging when you first learn Alchemy. You gain Furnace Vent and Numbing Powder as bonus talents. Your Reagent Stock maximum increases by your Proficiency Bonus. You cannot learn Rare or higher Recipe talents unless you later learn Pill Forging through an Insight, teacher, or story reward. ### Pill Hall Traditionalist You cannot use Field Formula as an Action in combat. You gain Batch Refinement as a bonus talent at CL 5, or Rapid Refinement if you are below CL 5. When you refine pills in a proper workshop or pill hall, gain +1 to Alchemy Checks. You cannot take Field Alchemist. ### Poison Furnace Your Alchemy emphasizes dangerous, forbidden, or hostile refinement. You gain Poison Pill as a bonus talent when you reach CL 5, or Corrosive Distillate if you are below CL 5. Medicinal pills you refine cost 25 percent more ingredients. You have Disadvantage on social checks with orthodox alchemists who recognize your method unless your sect openly accepts poison refinement. ### Body Furnace Adept Prerequisite: Body as Cauldron Insight. You do not require an external cauldron for Common or Uncommon recipes and may release Field Formula through breath, sweat, blood heat, palm smoke, or swallowed pellet preparation. When you suffer alchemical backlash, increase the damage by one die per rarity tier. When you consume a medicinal pill you refined yourself, you may do so as a Bonus Action. ## Path Synergies ### Qi Cultivation - Qi Flame Refinement You can refine without an ordinary heat source by using controlled Qi flame. When refining a Common or Uncommon recipe, you may spend CP to replace missing ingredients worth 25 gp per CP spent. You may replace a maximum amount of ingredient value this way equal to 25 gp x your Proficiency Bonus per recipe. This cannot replace rare named ingredients, Heavenly Materials, monster cores, personal vows, blood samples, or story components. ### Spirit Awakening - Spiritual Herb Sense You may use Wisdom instead of Intelligence as your Alchemy key ability. You can sense pills, poisons, beast cores, spiritually active ingredients, medicinal residue, and alchemical contamination within 120 feet if they are not behind Total Cover or sealed by a stronger effect. This sense reveals presence and general nature, not exact recipe, value, ownership, or full properties. ### Body Refining - Body as Cauldron Requires the Body as Cauldron Cultivation Insight. You may use Constitution as your Alchemy key ability. You may pay Alchemy CP costs with Stamina instead of CP. You may refine internally. While refining internally, you count as having a proper cauldron for Common and Uncommon recipes. Rare or higher recipes still require special preparation, dangerous internal furnace training, or an external cauldron unless the GM says otherwise. When you fail an Alchemy Check while refining internally, take 3d6 Poison damage per rarity tier and gain 1 Pill Impurity. ## Cultivation Insights ### Body as Cauldron Prerequisite: Body Refining, CL 4+, Constitution 15+. You may learn Alchemy despite it being a Restricted Power Sphere. You gain the Body Refining path synergy for Alchemy. You may use Stamina for Alchemy CP costs and Constitution as your Alchemy key ability. ### Alchemical Prodigy Prerequisite: Alchemy, CL 4+. Once per Long Rest, when you successfully refine a Common or Uncommon recipe, you may create a second product of the same recipe. You must provide ingredients for both products. At CL 10, this Insight may affect Rare recipes. ### Alchemical Constitution Prerequisite: Alchemy or Body Refining, CL 8+. You have Advantage on saving throws against poison and alchemical backlash. Once per Long Rest, you may consume one additional Cultivation or Enhancement pill without making a Pill Saturation saving throw. You still gain 1 Pill Impurity. ### Pill Master’s Eyes Prerequisite: Alchemy, CL 8+. You automatically identify Common and Uncommon pills, poisons, alchemical ingredients, and obvious alchemical contamination after 1 minute of study. You have Advantage on checks to identify Rare or higher alchemical substances. ### Medicine Saint Prerequisite: Alchemy, CL 12+. When you administer a Medicinal pill to a creature, you may do so as a Bonus Action. If the pill restores HP, add your Alchemy key ability modifier to the healing. The target gains Advantage on one Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn. ### Furnace-Tyrant’s Stomach Prerequisite: Alchemy, CL 12+. You have Resistance to Poison damage. When you take Poison damage from your own Alchemy talent or product, reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus. If you already have Resistance to Poison damage, gain Advantage on saving throws against the Poisoned condition. ### Pill Sovereign’s Ledger Prerequisite: Alchemy, CL 12+. When you invest at least 1,000 gp in ingredients during downtime, record one Ledger Credit. You may hold Ledger Credits equal to your Proficiency Bonus. When you fail an Alchemy Check, spend one Ledger Credit to reduce the failure margin by 2. If this changes a failure by more than 5 into a failure by 5 or less, create a Broken product instead of losing the ingredients. Ledger Credits represent extra stabilizers, backup reagents, assistant labor, and redundant furnace preparation. They cannot turn a failed check into a success.

### Field Formula
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 1 CP and one Reagent Stock
Requirement: Alchemist’s supplies and a cauldron, portable furnace, crucible, medicine gourd, smoke tube, formula satchel, or Body as Cauldron access
Release one prepared alchemical formula. Field Formula represents smoke packets, volatile pellets, corrosive dregs, sealed medicine fumes, powdered irritants, and quick-release pill shells prepared during the day’s refinement. It does not mean the cauldron itself attacks.
Choose one Field Formula you know and resolve its effect. You know the following Field Formulae when you learn Alchemy:
#### Medicinal Smoke
Choose yourself or one ally within range.
The target gains Temporary HP equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and may immediately repeat one saving throw against the Poisoned condition.
The Temporary HP increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
#### Numbing Smoke
Choose a point within range. Smoke briefly fills a 5-foot-radius Sphere centered there. Each hostile creature of your choice in the area makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes Poison damage equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and suffers no Reaction loss.
The damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
#### Corrosive Dregs
Choose one creature or one 5-foot space within range. The target or each hostile creature of your choice in that space makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes Acid damage equal to 1d6 + your Alchemy key ability modifier and is covered in unstable residue until the start of your next turn. The first time it takes damage before then, it takes additional Acid damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not covered in residue.
The initial damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.

### Reagent Stock
Reagent Stock represents sealed combat vials, volatile pellets, powdered dregs, premeasured furnace fuel, medicinal smoke packets, and quick-release pill shells.
During a Long Rest, you may prepare a number of Reagent Stock uses up to:
Proficiency Bonus + Alchemy key ability modifier, minimum 1
Each use costs 10 gp in common reagents unless a talent states a different cost.
Unused Reagent Stock remains stable until your next Long Rest. At the end of that Long Rest, unused stock spoils or must be folded into the next day’s preparation.
A talent that spends Reagent Stock consumes one prepared use. Reagent Stock is not an item another creature can normally use unless a talent says so.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Ash Qi Expression: Primary — Remnant Qi; Supporting — Fire-Residue Qi, Death Qi, Earth-Burial Qi. Sphere Type: Power / Elemental / Remnant Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Rare Access: Body Refining through ash-body, funeral-body, or GM-approved internal remnant cultivation Resource: CP, Ash Terrain, Ashen Brand, Remnants, and Concentration when a talent says so Core Chassis: Ash Terrain, Ashen Brand, Remnant, Smothered, Cinder Brand, Ashfall Ash cultivates residue, burial, and the pressure left after destruction. Its basic loop is to create Ash Terrain, apply Ashen Brand, and turn destruction into Remnants that fuel later techniques. ### Rules Baseline This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Concentration, Cover, difficult terrain, Hide, Invisible, Bloodied, Exhaustion, and Damage Threshold unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### Barriers, Domains, and Formation Anchors A Barrier is a temporary supernatural barrier, including a Protection-sphere Barrier or another effect that explicitly identifies itself as a Barrier. A Domain is a high-rank cultivation effect that says it is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove a Domain unless the technique explicitly says otherwise. A Formation Anchor is an anchor point explicitly created by a Formation or identified by the GM as part of a Formation project. These spheres do not create Formation Anchors automatically. ### Core Ash Rules #### Ash Terrain Ash Terrain is ground or air filled with cultivated cinders, soot, and spiritual residue. Unless a talent says otherwise: Ash Terrain is Lightly Obscured. Ash Terrain is difficult terrain for hostile creatures. Allies you designate ignore your Ash Terrain. A hostile creature moving more than 10 feet through your Ash Terrain for the first time on a turn makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, that creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Identical Ash Terrain effects do not stack with themselves. #### Ashen Brand An Ashen Brand is a visible residue mark left on a creature or object. Unless a talent says otherwise: Ashen Brand lasts until the start of your next turn. A branded creature cannot gain Temporary HP. A branded creature leaves a faint visible cinder trail. spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Athletics Qi Expression: Primary — Motion Qi; Supporting — Breath Qi, Sinew Qi, Earth-Grounding Qi. “The battlefield is not a floor. It is a question asked by distance, height, pressure, and timing. The body answers before the enemy understands the question.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Movement, tumbling, climbing, jumping, pursuit, evasion, tool-assisted mobility, wall-running, air-stepping, physical positioning The Sphere of Athletics teaches deliberate movement. Its practitioners turn distance, elevation, terrain, momentum, and timing into tactical advantages. Athletics governs trained physical movement: tumbling, climbing, jumping, pursuit, rope work, wall-running, air-stepping, and positional control. It does not replace the Space sphere or ordinary movement rules unless a talent explicitly says otherwise. Core Athletics Rules ### MARTIAL FOCUS Athletics uses Martial Focus. Unless a broader martial-sphere rule later replaces this wording: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, you regain it only if it is currently absent. Martial Focus is a state of physical readiness, breath, posture, and intent. It is not CP. ### MOTION TALENT Some Athletics talents have the Motion tag. A Motion talent adds an effect to one movement sequence. Unless a talent says otherwise: apply only one Motion talent to a single movement sequence; a movement sequence may include movement from your Speed, Dash, Disengage, or another effect; spending additional movement inside the sequence does not create a new sequence; teleportation is not ordinary movement unless a talent explicitly allows it. ### ATHLETIC TECHNIQUE Athletics preserves mundane and wuxia movement tools. A technique may use: poles; spears; ropes; chains; grappling hooks; daggers; shields; cloaks; terrain; walls; larger creatures; momentum from an enemy attack. The GM should reward clever physical interaction with the environment. ### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES #### Athletic Training When you learn the Athletics sphere, gain proficiency in one: Strength (Athletics); Dexterity (Acrobatics). If you are already proficient in both, choose one Athletics talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. #### Coordinated Movement Whenever you take the Dash or Disengage Action as your Action, regain Martial Focus. This does not trigger when taking Dash or Disengage as a Bonus Action. ### ATHLETIC MANEUVERS AND TABLE RULES These are core movement options supported by the Athletics sphere. The GM may allow any character to attempt an appropriate maneuver, but Athletics talents make these techniques faster, safer, and more reliable. #### Aided Acrobatics Some movement problems can be solved with the correct tool. When using an aided technique, the GM may call for a hard: DC 20 Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check Failure may cause the movement to fail, leave the character Prone, or expose them to another appropriate consequence. #### Climb onto a Bigger Creature A creature at least two sizes smaller than another creature may treat that larger creature as terrain. After reaching the larger creature, use an Action to make: Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) contested by the target’s: Dexterity (Acrobatics) Success: Enter the target’s space and cling to its body. While clinging: move with the target; gain Advantage on attacks against the target; move around within its space as difficult terrain; the GM determines which attacks the larger creature can reasonably make against you. The larger creature may use an Action to dislodge you by making: Strength (Athletics) contested by your: Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) You choose which skill to use. #### Rope Swing Use one: secured rope; chain; grappling hook; whip; tendril; appropriate tether technique. Attach it to a viable anchor as an Action. A grappling hook has a 30-foot reach for this purpose. You may anchor to a creature at least two sizes larger than you by making an attack roll. While attached, as part of ordinary movement: move to one legal ground space within the tether’s reach; do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from this movement; require a clear path; detach as an Action. #### Tumble As an Action or Bonus Action, make: Dexterity (Acrobatics) contested by one hostile creature’s: Dexterity (Acrobatics) Success: Move through that creature’s space once during this turn. ### ATHLETICS TALENT TAGS #### Motion Talents A Motion talent modifies one movement sequence. #### Technique Talents A Technique talent improves one athletic maneuver, environmental interaction, or physical practice. #### Focus Talents A Focus talent modifies Martial Focus recovery or expenditure. #### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents wuxia movement beyond ordinary mortal training. Some evolutions remain physical. Others allow motion so refined that it approaches supernatural movement. #### Unique Athletics Talents A Unique Athletics Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another category. ### MORTAL REALM ATHLETICS TALENTS #### Dizzying Tumble - Motion When you exit a space adjacent to a hostile creature, spend 10 feet of movement to force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: It becomes immune to your Dizzying Tumble until you complete a short or long rest. #### Moving Target - Motion When you move more than 20 feet during your turn, gain Half Cover against ranged attacks and ranged supernatural effects until the start of your next turn. If you move at least 40 feet, expend Martial Focus to gain Three-Quarters Cover instead. ##### Second Purchase Take Moving Target a second time. Its cover applies against melee attacks as well. #### Sudden Flank - Motion When you successfully Tumble through a hostile creature’s space, gain Advantage on your next attack against it before the end of your turn. #### Capoeira Spin - Technique You do not have Disadvantage on unarmed strikes merely because you are Prone. When you start your turn Prone, stand as a Bonus Action and make one unarmed strike as part of that Bonus Action. #### Close Quarters Training - Technique You may enter, move through, and fight inside a hostile creature’s space. To enter its space, make: Dexterity (Acrobatics) contested by the creature’s: Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) The creature chooses which skill to use. Failed Check: Your movement ends in the previous space and the creature may make an opportunity attack against you. Attacks you make while sharing a hostile creature’s space have Disadvantage unless made with: Light weapons; natural weapons; unarmed strikes. ##### Cover If you and the hostile creature are the same size, each grants the other Half Cover against creatures outside the shared space. If one creature is larger, the smaller creature gains Three-Quarters Cover and the larger creature gains no cover. If this cover causes an outside attack to miss, resolve the attack against the other creature using the original attack roll. #### Mighty Conditioning - Technique Whenever you make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, use Strength or Dexterity for the check, choosing each time. You may use Dexterity instead of Strength when determining jump distance or height. #### Mobility - Motion Opportunity attacks made against you for leaving a creature’s reach have Disadvantage. #### Multiple Motions - Focus When moving, expend Martial Focus to apply two Motion talents to the same movement sequence. #### Polearm Vaulter - Technique You no longer need to spend an Action or pass a check to pole vault. When pole vaulting, expend Martial Focus as a Bonus Action to increase: horizontal jump distance by 10 feet; or jump height by 5 feet. This increase does not depend on Strength, Dexterity, or remaining movement. #### Powerful Wings - Technique If you possess a Fly Speed through physical wings, you may Hover. #### Rope Swing Adept - Technique Attach an appropriate Rope Swing item as a Bonus Action. Detach it without spending an Action. While swinging: end movement in the air as though you possessed a temporary Fly Speed; swing upward to the anchor point as a quick climb. #### Rapid Motion - Technique Dash as a Bonus Action. #### Scale Foe - Technique Climb onto a Bigger Creature as a Bonus Action instead of an Action. A creature you cling to has Disadvantage on attacks made against you. This does not apply to checks made to dislodge you. ##### Cross-Sphere Notes If you possess an appropriate Beast Taming talent, use an approved handling skill in place of Strength (Athletics) where reasonable. If you possess the Wrestling sphere, climbing a larger creature may count as Grappling it for appropriate Wrestling talents. Close Quarters Training applies while clinging to a larger creature. #### Strong Lungs - Technique Gain: Advantage on saving throws against inhalation effects and suffocation; Advantage on Constitution saving throws against exhaustion from forced march; multiply normal breath-holding duration by your Proficiency Bonus. #### Sure Grip - Technique Gain: Advantage on Athletics checks made to climb or prevent falling; as a Reaction, make an Athletics check to catch yourself or one creature within natural reach while falling; never drop held objects merely because you become Frightened, Stunned, or Unconscious; Grapples you maintain do not automatically end merely because you become Incapacitated. #### Swift Movement - Focus While holding Martial Focus, increase all movement Speeds by 10 feet. #### Training Gain one: proficiency in Strength (Athletics); proficiency in Dexterity (Acrobatics). If already proficient in the chosen skill, gain Expertise instead. Take Training more than once. #### Tumbling Recovery - Technique Drop Prone at any time, including outside your turn. Whenever you fall Prone or deliberately drop Prone, use a Bonus Action or Reaction to move up to 10 feet in one direction. When used to avoid an attack or area effect: impose Disadvantage on the attack roll; gain Advantage on one Dexterity saving throw against the area effect. #### Unimpeded Positioning - Focus While holding Martial Focus, ignore nonmagical difficult terrain. #### Unwilling Boost - Technique Convert another creature’s attack into momentum. When your movement provokes an opportunity attack from a creature at least your size, increase movement for the round by: 5 feet x the creature’s Strength modifier minimum 5 feet. Choose horizontal movement or half as much vertical movement. To gain this movement: the attack must hit; or if it misses, use your Bonus Action to convert the attack into momentum. An ally may use its Reaction to assist as though making an opportunity attack against you. You must still use your Bonus Action to exploit a missed assisted attack. #### Wall Stunt - Technique Run up or along walls as though they were ground. Treat the wall as difficult terrain. You may treat a creature at least two sizes larger than you as a wall, with GM approval. Doing so provokes an opportunity attack from that creature. If you end your turn on a wall without something to hold onto, you fall. #### Whirlwind Flip - Focus Whenever you succeed on a Tumble check against a hostile creature, regain Martial Focus. ### FOUNDATION REALM ATHLETICS TALENTS #### Afterimage - Motion Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you move more than 20 feet during your turn, leave one visible afterimage until the start of your next turn. When a creature that can see the afterimage attacks you or targets you with a visible targeted supernatural effect, roll a d2. 1: The creature targets the afterimage instead. 2: The creature targets you normally. The afterimage is destroyed when targeted successfully. Afterimage has no effect if the attacker cannot perceive it. #### Air Stunt - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Wall Stunt, CL 5+ Treat the air as a wall for Wall Stunt. If you end your turn unsupported in the air, you still fall unless another talent prevents it. #### Helicopter Descent - Technique Prerequisite: Polearm Vaulter or Rope Swing Adept, CL 5+ When you end your turn in the air while wielding an appropriate polearm, rope, chain, whip, or tether item, use your Reaction and expend Martial Focus. For rounds equal to your Proficiency Bonus: fall no faster than 60 feet per round; take no falling damage if you land before the effect ends; land on your feet. #### Shark Swim - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Gain Swim Speed equal to your land Speed. If you possess Strong Lungs, instead hold your breath for hours equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1 hour. #### Speed Boost - Focus Prerequisite: CL 5+ When taking Dash or Disengage as an Action, move an additional 10 feet. You may also expend Martial Focus to increase all movement Speeds by 50 feet for rounds equal to your Constitution modifier, minimum 1 round. When the duration ends, gain one level of Exhaustion until completing a short or long rest. This Exhaustion applies even if you are normally immune. You cannot activate this boost while your Exhaustion exceeds 2. #### Spider’s Touch - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Gain Climb Speed equal to your land Speed. If you possess Sure Grip: climb vertical surfaces; climb upside down across ceilings; keep at least one hand free while climbing. #### Sparrow’s Path - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Air Stunt, Wall Stunt, CL 7+ Gain Fly Speed equal to half your base land Speed. This flight expresses continuous wuxia stepping, body control, and cultivated momentum. It is not automatically silent. #### Flowing Pursuit - Motion Prerequisite: CL 7+ When you move at least 20 feet toward one creature during your turn, choose one: ignore Opportunity Attacks from that creature; gain +2 AC against that creature until the start of your next turn; add 5 feet to one jump during the movement; move through one allied creature’s space without treating it as difficult terrain. ### CORE FORMATION REALM ATHLETICS TALENTS #### Flash Step - Motion Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you take the Dash Action, expend Martial Focus. Teleport into your final destination without passing through intervening spaces. The destination: must be visible; must be legal and unoccupied; must be within the distance you could move through the Dash; cannot cross a Dimensional Lock; cannot cross a sealed boundary. Flash Step is cultivated motion approaching spatial transcendence. It does not grant general Space-sphere control. #### Terrain Glide - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Shark Swim, CL 10+ Swim through soil, snow, loose earth, and sand as though they were water. This counts as difficult terrain. Terrain Glide does not grant: sight through soil; breath through soil; movement through worked stone; movement through metal; movement through sealed barriers. #### Meridian-Threading Dash - Focus Prerequisite: CL 10+ When Coordinated Movement restores Martial Focus, choose one: move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; stand from Prone without spending movement; end one ordinary Grappled effect affecting you; gain Advantage on your next Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check before the end of your next turn. #### Unbroken Pursuit - Motion Prerequisite: CL 10+ When a creature within your Speed moves willingly, use your Reaction and expend Martial Focus. Move up to half your Speed. This movement: must end closer to the triggering creature; does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature; may include Wall Stunt, Air Stunt, or Rope Swing movement when legal. #### Court of Ten Thousand Steps - Martial Domain “The court did not contain roads. The cultivator made roads by stepping.” Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest For the duration: increase all movement Speeds by 20 feet; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain; stand from Prone without spending movement; move through allied spaces normally; climb ordinary surfaces without a check; once per turn after moving at least 20 feet, regain Martial Focus; once per turn when a hostile creature misses you, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Court of Ten Thousand Steps ends early if you become Incapacitated. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM ATHLETICS TALENTS #### Heaven-Treading Body Prerequisite: CL 15+ Your cultivated motion no longer requires ordinary support. Gain: Fly Speed equal to land Speed; Hover; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain; move across water, fragile surfaces, falling debris, and open air as though they were stable terrain; reduce falling damage to 0. Heaven-Treading Body is visible as impossible physical mastery, pressure ripples, brief footholds, or another appropriate expression. #### One Breath, Ten Thousand Steps Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Until the end of your turn Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Until the end of your turn: take Dash as part of this Bonus Action; take Dash again without spending an Action; ignore Opportunity Attacks; move through hostile spaces as though they were difficult terrain; move across walls, water, air, and fragile surfaces; each time you move at least 20 feet, regain Martial Focus; apply any number of known Motion talents during the turn, but apply each Motion talent only once; make one weapon attack or unarmed strike at any point during the movement. This technique does not allow movement through sealed barriers or Dimensional Locks. #### Body Beyond Distance Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 hour Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Enter a sustained travel state. For the duration: multiply overland travel pace by 10; ignore ordinary exhaustion from travel; traverse cliffs, rivers, forests, and broken terrain without slowing; carry one willing creature of your size or smaller without reducing pace; continue moving across ordinary water and vertical surfaces. Body Beyond Distance ends early if you enter combat, become Incapacitated, or stop moving for more than 1 minute. ### SECRET ATHLETICS INHERITANCE #### The Step Taken Before Intention “The enemy decided to strike. The cultivator had already stepped beyond the meaning of the attack.” Classification: Secret Athletics Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Flash Step, Heaven-Treading Body, hidden movement scripture Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You are targeted by an attack, trapped by an area effect, or would fail a Dexterity saving throw Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Move up to your Speed. This movement: occurs before the triggering effect resolves; does not provoke Opportunity Attacks; may cross air, walls, water, hostile spaces, and fragile surfaces; may use Flash Step once during the movement without spending additional Focus; cannot cross sealed barriers or Dimensional Locks. After movement: if you are outside the triggering attack’s reach, line, or area, the effect misses you; otherwise, gain Advantage on the triggering Dexterity saving throw or impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll. Until the end of your next turn: hold Martial Focus even after expending it; increase all movement Speeds by 30 feet; ignore ordinary Restrained and Grappled effects caused by physical contact. ### OPTIONAL ATHLETICS CULTIVATION VARIANTS An Athletics cultivation variant changes what the practitioner believes motion requires. These variants are mutually exclusive. #### Limited Athleticism You do not gain proficiency through Athletic Training. You cannot learn the Training talent. ##### Benefit Gain one Motion talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. #### Pure Physical Discipline “No talisman carries my weight. No folded space shortens the road. The body crosses because the body was trained to cross.” You cannot learn: Flash Step; Waking or Space-based Athletics Forged Techniques; Realm Evolutions explicitly described as teleportation. ##### Benefits gain one Mortal Realm Technique talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; when Coordinated Movement restores Martial Focus, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn; add your Proficiency Bonus to one Athletics or Acrobatics check once per turn; Court of Ten Thousand Steps requires no supernatural visual effect. #### Tool-Path Acrobat “A rope is a second arm. A spear is a temporary bridge. A wall is only a road that forgot its direction.” You must visibly incorporate an appropriate tool, terrain feature, or physical prop when using one of the following: Polearm Vaulter; Rope Swing Adept; Helicopter Descent; Wall Stunt; Unwilling Boost; aided movement maneuvers. ##### Benefits gain Polearm Vaulter or Rope Swing Adept as a bonus talent; draw or stow one movement tool once per turn without spending an Action; gain Advantage on one aided movement check per turn; when using a tool-assisted maneuver, regain Martial Focus on a successful DC 20 Athletics or Acrobatics check. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Body Refining - Tempered Motion Use Constitution as the key ability for Cultivation Save DCs. When you regain Martial Focus through Coordinated Movement: reduce falling damage by 5 x Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn; gain Advantage on one Strength (Athletics) check before the end of your next turn; if you spend at least 1 Stamina during the same turn, increase land Speed by 5 feet until the end of the turn. #### Qi Cultivation - Meridian Flow Step Use Intelligence or Charisma as the key ability for Cultivation Save DCs. Once per turn when you expend Martial Focus: move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; or reduce the CP cost of one movement-related Forged Technique by 1, minimum 1. At CL 10, increase this free movement to 10 feet. #### Spirit Awakening - Intent Before Footfall Use Wisdom as the key ability for Cultivation Save DCs. Once per round when a hostile creature within 30 feet begins moving, choose one: know its intended direction before resolving the first 5 feet of movement; gain +2 AC against its next opportunity attack before the start of your next turn; move 5 feet toward an ally without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Intent Before Footfall does not read private thoughts. It reads commitment expressed through movement. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Body Like a Bow Prerequisite: Athletics sphere, CL 4+ Increase jump distance by 10 feet and jump height by 5 feet. When using Unwilling Boost, treat the triggering creature’s Strength modifier as at least your Proficiency Bonus. #### Giant-Climbing Adept Prerequisite: Athletics sphere, Scale Foe, CL 6+ While clinging to a larger creature: gain Half Cover against attacks originating outside its space; move around its body without treating its space as difficult terrain; once per turn when it moves, reposition to another reasonable location on its body without spending movement. #### Rope-and-Spear Acrobat Prerequisite: Athletics sphere, Rope Swing Adept or Polearm Vaulter, CL 6+ Once per turn, draw, attach, detach, or stow an appropriate movement tool without spending an Action. After using Rope Swing or pole-vault movement, gain Advantage on your next Tumble check before the end of the turn. #### Focused Footwork Prerequisite: Athletics sphere, CL 8+ Once per short rest, when you would expend Martial Focus, retain it instead. #### Movement-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Athletics sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation or training project, use one Athletics maneuver, terrain route, or Realm Evolution you know as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. The project still requires: preparation time; terrain; tools; anchors; safety measures; maintenance; Formation-specific vulnerabilities where applicable.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### Cast Axe
Action Type: Action
Canonical Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail
Parent Action: Attack
Replaces Attacks: 1
Range: Weapon thrown range, or 20/60 feet for a handaxe-like thrown axe
Target: One creature or object
Cost: None
Requirement: You must throw an axe weapon with the thrown property or a GM-approved throwing axe.
Make a thrown weapon attack with the axe. On a hit, the attack deals normal weapon damage. Then choose one Cast rider.
**Shock Cast.** The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
**Lodging Cast.** The axe lodges and the target gains Bite from you until the start of your next turn. A creature can remove the lodged axe as an Object Interaction if it has a free hand and is not Incapacitated.
**Turning Cast.** If the target is no more than one size larger than you, it must choose either to be pushed 5 feet or to have its Speed reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
**Splinter Cast.** If the target is an unattended object, wooden barrier, fragile cover, shield, banner pole, rope, vine, or similar object, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage.
If you throw your only axe, you are no longer wielding it until you retrieve it, draw another weapon, or a talent returns it.
