### Hewing Strike
Action Type: Action
Canonical Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail
Parent Action: Attack
Replaces Attacks: 1
Range: Weapon reach
Target: One creature or object within reach
Cost: None
Requirement: You must be wielding an axe weapon.
Make a melee weapon attack with an axe weapon. On a hit, the attack deals its normal weapon damage. Then choose one Hewing rider.
**Bite.** The target gains Bite from you until the start of your next turn.
**Drive.** If the target is no more than one size larger than you, push it 5 feet directly away from you.
**Hook.** If the target is no more than one size larger than you, pull it 5 feet toward you or move it 5 feet to another space within your reach.
**Split Guard.** Until the end of your current turn, the target cannot benefit from Shield AC against the next axe attack you make against it.
**Hamper.** The target's Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
You may choose only one rider unless a talent says otherwise.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Axes Qi Expression: Primary — Hewing Qi; Supporting — Metal Qi, Wood-Cleaving Qi, Earth-Weight Qi, Severance Qi, Impact Qi, Execution Qi, War-Authority Qi, Haft-Leverage Qi. "The sword asks where the line should be. The axe asks what was foolish enough to stand joined." Common Name: Axes Sphere Sphere Type: Martial Sphere; Weapon-Intent Sphere; Hewing, Hooking, Guard-Breaking, and Execution Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Key Themes: committed edge, weight behind a short line, hook and beard control, shield breaking, haft leverage, poleaxe play, thrown axe disruption, object and barrier pressure, armor joints, execution authority, tree-felling metaphors, formation weak points, battlefield standards, giant-killing, vow-cutting. Primary Resource Hooks: Martial Focus, weapon attacks, Special Attacks, Stamina for Body Refining expressions, CP for Qi or Spirit expressions, Bite states, axe weapons, thrown axes, poleaxe weapons, held standards or ceremonial axes when a talent says so. ## Axes Dao Axes cultivate decisive hewing. Sword asks what line must be chosen. Spear asks what distance must be claimed. Brute asks what obstacle must be overpowered. Shield asks what face must meet danger. Axes ask what joined thing is ready to split. A novice axe cultivator chops a shield aside, bites a blade into a limb, drags an enemy off balance, or throws a handaxe to break a charge. A Foundation cultivator hooks armor joints, splits guard lines, lodges an axe in a target and hauls them by the wound, and hews objects, doors, roots, and weak barriers with cultivated certainty. A Core Formation master turns every axe stroke into a structural judgment: shield wall, monster limb, formation panel, oath banner, and false courage all become things with grain. A Nascent Soul axe sovereign raises a blade and makes armies remember that even mountains can be felled if the cut finds the root. Axes are not merely large damage dice. They are weight, bite, hook, haft, leverage, and the dreadful promise that a thing once whole may become two. ## Axe Traditions - Short axes and handaxes support fast disruption, thrown openings, shield harassment, and close work. - Battleaxes and greataxes support committed hewing, limb pressure, guard breaking, and finishing blows. - Poleaxes, halberds, bardiches, and similar axe-polearms support hook, thrust, butt, spike, lever, and armored-combat control. - Ceremonial war axes support execution authority, mandate, clan judgment, and command symbolism. - Work axes support tree-felling, door-splitting, barricade breaking, root cutting, and practical frontier utility. The sphere should allow an imperial headsman, mountain woodcutter, poleaxe duelist, shieldbreaker, thrown-axe skirmisher, giant-killer, sect executioner, or ceremonial warlord to all use the same core mechanics without becoming identical. ## Neighboring Sphere Boundaries Axes overlaps several spheres but should not replace them. Weapons is the broad arsenal and implement sphere. Weapons answers what tool this moment requires. Axes answers how weight, edge, hook, and haft split a specific structure. Sword remains the specialist sphere for sword intent, sword qi, flying swords, sword heart, sword soul, meridian-cutting line, and refined severance. Axes may sever, but its method is hewing impact and structural failure rather than perfect line. Spear remains the specialist sphere for spear line, point-first reach, interception, and thrusting geometry. A halberd or poleaxe can qualify for selected Axes talents when used through its axe head, hook, beard, spike, or chopping edge; it qualifies for Spear only when used through thrust and line. Brute remains the specialist sphere for body leverage, shove, collision, and raw physical overpowering. Axes uses leverage through a weapon shape. Berserker remains the specialist sphere for committed fury, Adrenaline, Batter, and exertion risk. Axes can be fierce but is not rage by default. Shield remains the specialist sphere for active defense, carried cover, catching, and redirection through a shield face. Axes can break or hook shields, but does not become a defense sphere. Metal governs metal qi, refinement, armor, weapons, and conductive hardness. Blacksmith governs forging, tempering, and making. Axes governs fighting with axe-method. Destruction governs direct cultivated ruin. Axes can split objects, barriers, and weak structures when an axe can meaningfully bite them, but it does not replace general blasting, terrain erasure, or domain-scale destruction. ## Realm Progression Mortal Realm: Axes are trained edge, hook, haft, thrown disruption, shield pressure, object chopping, and close-range control. The cultivator learns to place Bite, use Hewing Strike, hook enemies off balance, and turn weight into disciplined contact. Foundation Realm: Axes become cultivated structure-breaking. The cultivator deepens Bite, lodges thrown axes, pulls targets by the wound, splits shields and weak barriers, performs cleaving arcs, and begins execution marks against bloodied or exposed enemies. Core Formation Realm: Axes become a grammar of structural failure. The cultivator reads grain in objects, guard lines, monster limbs, formation panels, and battle standards; hooks larger foes; contests temporary barriers; and turns one decisive hew into fear or battlefield repositioning. Nascent Soul Realm: Axes become authority over division. The cultivator can manifest hewing intent across lines of battle, challenge major barriers by striking their named weak point, sever command symbols, punish regeneration, and briefly make every enemy feel the falling-tree law. Secret Inheritance: The axe cultivator invokes the instant when Heaven chooses the root rather than the branch. What is improperly joined, falsely protected, or wrongly standing may be hewn at its point of dependence. ## 2024 Fifth-Edition Rules Baseline This sphere assumes the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline used by Tianxia. Attack rolls, saving throws, Cover, Total Cover, Concentration, conditions, object rules, opportunity attacks, forced movement, falling, grappling, disarming, mounted movement, and environmental hazards follow ordinary rules unless this sphere explicitly changes them. Axes talents do not automatically ignore armor, shield AC, Cover, Resistance, Immunity, Damage Threshold, Barriers, Domains, or Formation Anchors. A talent must say when it suppresses, bypasses, damages, contests, or ignores a defense. Axes talents that say Special Attack replace one attack when you take the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different action type. Forced movement from Axes talents does not provoke Opportunity Attacks unless a talent says otherwise. Axes talents do not create a universal Disarm action. When a talent can disarm, it gives the procedure. Axe object-breaking follows ordinary object rules unless a talent modifies the damage, Damage Threshold, or target type. Axes do not automatically inflict lingering wounds, sever limbs, execute creatures, destroy shields, destroy weapons, or cut through formations. Such effects occur only when a talent, special narrative situation, or GM ruling permits them. ## Core Axes Rules ### Axes Key Ability When an Axes talent uses a weapon attack, use the normal ability score and proficiency rules for that weapon unless the talent says otherwise. When an Axes talent calls for an Cultivation Save DC, use: 8 + Proficiency Bonus + your Axes key ability modifier. When an Axes talent calls for an Axes Check, roll: d20 + Proficiency Bonus + your Axes key ability modifier. When you first learn Axes, choose Strength or your Path key ability as your Axes key ability. Body Refining characters usually choose Strength or Constitution through Path synergy. Qi Cultivation characters usually choose Intelligence or Charisma through Path synergy. Spirit Awakening characters usually choose Wisdom through Path synergy. ### Axe Weapons The default Axe weapons are: - handaxe; - battleaxe; - greataxe. The GM may also approve setting-appropriate axes, including wood axes, war axes, crescent axes, bearded axes, hooked axes, double-bitted axes, great cleavers, moon axes, execution axes, boarding axes, poleaxes, bardiches, halberds, glaives, axe-spear hybrids, and ceremonial yue-like axes. A hybrid polearm qualifies for Axes talents only when the technique uses its axe head, hook, beard, chopping edge, spike, or haft leverage. If the technique uses its point and thrusting line, use Spear. If it uses broad weapon literacy rather than axe doctrine, use Weapons. ### Axe Profiles For play clarity, an approved axe may have one or more profiles. **Short Axe.** Handaxe, hatchet, boarding axe, throwing axe, paired axe. Best for throwing, fast hooks, shield harassment, and close work. **War Axe.** Battleaxe, bearded axe, crescent axe, war cleaver. Best for one-handed or versatile hewing, shield splitting, and disciplined melee. **Great Axe.** Greataxe, execution axe, great cleaver, two-handed war axe. Best for committed hewing, object damage, finishing blows, and wide arcs. **Poleaxe.** Poleaxe, halberd, bardiche, axe-spear hybrid. Best for hook, pull, spike, haft, armor leverage, and controlling larger targets. **Ceremonial Axe.** Yue-like ritual axe, headsman's axe, clan execution axe, mandate axe, ancestral war axe. Best for authority, fear, oath-cutting, execution marks, and Spirit Awakening or Warleader synergies. An axe's profile does not change its weapon statistics unless the campaign defines a custom weapon. Profiles only determine which Axes talents can reasonably apply. ### Martial Focus Axes uses Martial Focus. Until a global Martial Focus rule replaces this reminder: - you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; - some Axes talents expend Martial Focus; - expending Martial Focus is not an action; - you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; - when a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is absent. ### Bite Bite is the core Axes state. A Bite means the axe head, beard, hook, spike, haft pressure, or hewing intent has found purchase in the target's guard, body, armor, weapon, shield, object, barrier, posture, or spiritual structure. Unless a talent says otherwise: - Bite lasts until the start of your next turn; - one creature, object, or effect may bear only one Bite from you at a time; - you can maintain a number of Bites equal to your Proficiency Bonus; - if you would exceed your Bite limit, choose one of your existing Bites to end; - Bite is visible as a lodged blade, hooked shield, split guard, torn armor strap, marked surface, spiritual notch, or disrupted posture; - Bite does not reveal a hidden target's location by itself; - Bite does not prevent movement, attacks, reactions, or spellcasting by itself; - Bite exists to be consumed or exploited by Axes talents. A Bite placed on an unattended object, door, barricade, shield, weapon, armor plate, or barrier represents a weak point or purchase, not automatic destruction. ### Hew A Hew is a committed axe strike. Talents with the Hew tag usually require an axe weapon and replace one attack when you take the Attack action. A Hew is not automatically reckless. It is the cultivated agreement of edge, weight, step, and intent. ### Hook A Hook is an axe control technique using the beard, inner curve, spike, haft, back hook, or chopping angle. Hook effects may pull, drag, disarm, trip, open a guard, catch a shield, unhorse a rider, ground a flyer, or keep a creature inside your reach. Hook effects normally require the target to be within your axe reach unless a thrown axe, chain, rope, qi projection, or talent says otherwise. ### Split Split effects attack a defined structure. A structure may be a shield guard, armor joint, weapon grip, barricade, door, root, chain, vine, weak barrier, formation panel, summoned shell, or command banner. Split is not general Destruction. If there is no meaningful structure, seam, purchase, guard, or weak point for an axe to answer, a Split talent may fail or become an ordinary attack at the GM's discretion. ### Lodged Axe Some thrown or committed axe talents lodge the axe. Unless a talent says otherwise: - a lodged axe is no longer in your hand; - the lodged axe remains in the target, object, or space until removed; - you can remove your own lodged axe from an adjacent target or object as an Object Interaction if the target is willing, helpless, unattended, or no longer resisting; - removing a lodged axe from an unwilling creature may require a contested Strength (Athletics) check or a talent; - if a lodged axe is attached by rope, chain, spirit thread, or qi line, the talent defines the pull and break rules; - a lodged axe does not create ongoing damage unless a talent says so. ## Base Sphere Abilities When you first gain the Axes sphere, gain proficiency with handaxes, battleaxes, and greataxes. You may also choose one of the following proficiencies: Athletics, Intimidation, Survival, woodcarver's tools, carpenter's tools, smith's tools, or one GM-approved regional axe weapon. If you already have proficiency with handaxes, battleaxes, and greataxes, choose one Mortal Realm Axes talent instead. You also learn Hewing Strike and Cast Axe. ### Hewing Strike Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Parent Action: Attack Replaces Attacks: 1 Range: Weapon reach Target: One creature or object within reach Cost: None Requirement: You must be wielding an axe weapon. Bite Talents create, extend, consume, or exploit Bite. Hook Talents pull, trip, drag, disarm, catch shields, or control targets through axe geometry. Split Talents break guards, shields, objects, barriers, roots, chains, vines, armor joints, or formation weak points. Cast Talents improve thrown axes, lodged axes, returning axes, shock casts, and opening volleys. Poleaxe Talents use haft, spike, butt, hook, reach, armor leverage, and two-ended weapon play. Execution Talents punish bloodied, helpless, condemned, oath-bound, or structurally exposed targets without granting automatic death. Authority Talents use ceremonial axes, command symbols, mandate, fear, and public judgment. You can use Axes talents only while wielding a War Axe, Great Axe, or Poleaxe profile weapon in two hands. You gain Two-Handed Commitment as a bonus talent. ### Headsman's Oath Your Axes cultivation is bound to visible judgment. You cannot use Execution or Authority talents against a creature that has not been warned, condemned, challenged, marked by your sect/clan law, or made openly hostile in the scene. You gain Headsman's Calm as a bonus talent. This drawback does not prevent ordinary axe attacks. ### Woodcutter's Earthbound Scripture Your Axes cultivation is practical and earthbound. You cannot learn talents that return thrown axes supernaturally, project axe qi beyond weapon reach, or create domain-scale execution authority unless a later Insight or Secret Inheritance removes this limit. You gain Work-Axe Eye as a bonus talent. ### Cast-Iron Skirmisher Method Your Axes cultivation favors thrown disruption. You must carry at least three Short Axe profile weapons or a returning axe line to use Cast talents. You have Disadvantage on Axes Checks made to break large objects or barriers with a single two-handed hew. You gain Francisca Opening as a bonus talent. ### Mercy of the Blunt Haft Your lineage refuses killing strokes. You cannot learn Execution talents that add extra damage against Bloodied creatures unless they can be expressed as blunt haft strikes, disarms, or nonlethal takedowns. You gain Haft Guard as a bonus talent. ## Path Synergies ### Body Refining - Bone-Axe Body Body Refining Axes begins from grip, shoulder, spine, breath, hips, tendons, footwork, and impact. You may use Strength or Constitution as your Axes key ability for Cultivation Save DCs and Axes Checks. When you use Axes through Body Refining: - your Axes talents must originate from a wielded axe, thrown axe, body movement, armor contact, footwork, or physical impact; - you may spend Stamina in place of CP for Axes talents that list CP or Stamina; - when you use Hewing Strike after moving at least 10 feet, you may add your Proficiency Bonus to one Strength (Athletics) check made before the start of your next turn to shove, drag, climb, hold, break, or contest a target bearing Bite; - you cannot project detached axe qi, return axes through empty air, cut distant structures, or mark spiritual authority at range unless a talent, Insight, item, manual, or GM-approved scripture allows it. ### Qi Cultivation - Outer Hewing Qi Qi Cultivation Axes externalizes the principle of hewing through axe qi, projected edge-weight, magnetic metal intent, and weapon shadows. You may use Intelligence or Charisma as your Axes key ability. When you spend CP on an Axes talent, choose one: - increase the talent's range by 10 feet if it already has a range beyond weapon reach; - cause the axe strike to count as magical for overcoming ordinary Resistance; - treat one visible object, barrier panel, or formation node within 30 feet as if it were within reach for a Split talent that targets structures; - return one thrown axe to your hand after the talent resolves, if no creature is holding it and no Total Cover blocks the return path; - change the damage type of one added Axes damage packet to force or slashing qi. Qi Cultivation does not remove the need for an axe focus unless a talent or forged technique says so. ### Spirit Awakening - Execution Name and Ancestral Axe Spirit Awakening Axes treats the axe as a symbol of judgment, fear, vow, ancestral office, severed relation, or spirit punishment. You may use Wisdom as your Axes key ability. When you place Bite with an Execution, Authority, or Ceremonial Axe profile talent, you may make the Bite spirit-visible instead of physical. A spirit-visible Bite can affect ghosts, possessed bodies, spiritual projections, oath spirits, and summoned assets if the talent's target type allows it. Once per round, when a creature bearing Bite from you speaks a false oath, violates a declared judgment, commands a bound spirit, or attempts to flee after being condemned by your Authority talent, you may learn one: - whether it is frightened of you; - whether it is bound by an oath, contract, or spirit command; - whether its current body is possessed, animated, or projected; - whether it is protected by a stronger spiritual authority; - whether the Bite is physical, spiritual, or both. This does not reveal complete thoughts, hidden names, full Realm, or secret techniques. ## Cultivation Insights ### Shieldhook Adept Prerequisite: Axes sphere, Shield-Catching Beard, CL 4+ When you use Shield-Catching Beard, you may choose to move the target's shield aside for one ally instead of yourself. On a failed save, the chosen ally's next attack against the target before the start of your next turn ignores Shield AC. On a successful save, the chosen ally's next attack before the end of your current turn ignores Shield AC. ### Logging Breath Body Prerequisite: Axes sphere, Body Refining Path, Work-Axe Eye, CL 6+ Your breath and shoulder rhythm are trained for repeated hewing. When you hit an unattended object or a creature bearing Bite with Hewing Strike, you may gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once per short or long rest, when you fail a Strength saving throw against being pushed, pulled, knocked Prone, or disarmed while wielding an axe, you may choose to succeed instead. ### Poleaxe Door-Guard Prerequisite: Axes sphere, Poleaxe Gate, CL 6+ While wielding a Poleaxe-profile weapon, creatures provoke Opportunity Attacks from you when they move from a space within your reach to another space within your reach if they are bearing Bite from you. If the opportunity attack hits, the creature's Speed becomes 0 until the end of the current turn. ### Red Execution Discipline Prerequisite: Axes sphere, Execution Mark, CL 8+ When a creature bearing Execution Mark from you drops to 0 HP, teleports, or becomes Invisible before the mark ends, you may regain Martial Focus if it is absent. In addition, once per long rest, when you hit a creature bearing Execution Mark with Headsman's Mandate or Rending Hew, you may reroll one damage die and use either result. ### Formation-Wedge Cutter Prerequisite: Axes sphere, Axe Bites the Formation, CL 12+ When you succeed on Axe Bites the Formation, you may choose one ally within 30 feet. Before the start of your next turn, that ally may ignore the suppressed section, panel, or node for one movement, attack, or technique, provided the effect's scale allows a person-sized opening. If you succeeded by 5 or more, two allies may benefit instead. ### Ceremonial Yue Bearer Prerequisite: Axes sphere, Spirit Awakening or Warleader-compatible doctrine, Mandate Axe Presence, CL 12+ When you make a public declaration using Mandate Axe Presence, you may name one lawful group, sect, clan, office, army, sworn band, or protected village you represent. If listeners recognize that authority or fear its consequences, you gain Advantage on the Axes Check. If you abuse this authority for a false judgment and the lie is exposed, you cannot benefit from this Insight again until you complete a public restitution, sect punishment, or karmic cleansing scene.

### Cast Axe
Action Type: Action
Canonical Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail
Parent Action: Attack
Replaces Attacks: 1
Range: Weapon thrown range, or 20/60 feet for a handaxe-like thrown axe
Target: One creature or object
Cost: None
Requirement: You must throw an axe weapon with the thrown property or a GM-approved throwing axe.
Make a thrown weapon attack with the axe. On a hit, the attack deals normal weapon damage. Then choose one Cast rider.
**Shock Cast.** The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
**Lodging Cast.** The axe lodges and the target gains Bite from you until the start of your next turn. A creature can remove the lodged axe as an Object Interaction if it has a free hand and is not Incapacitated.
**Turning Cast.** If the target is no more than one size larger than you, it must choose either to be pushed 5 feet or to have its Speed reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn.
**Splinter Cast.** If the target is an unattended object, wooden barrier, fragile cover, shield, banner pole, rope, vine, or similar object, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage.
If you throw your only axe, you are no longer wielding it until you retrieve it, draw another weapon, or a talent returns it.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Barrage Qi Expression: Primary — Projectile Qi; Supporting — Metal Qi, Wind Qi, Repetition Qi. “One projectile tests the defense. The second decides whether the defense was real.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Paths: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Ranged pressure, thrown weapons, arrows, bolts, needles, rapid follow-up shots, redirection, suppression, ammunition discipline, battlefield shaping The Sphere of Barrage teaches sustained ranged pressure. Its practitioners sequence projectiles so that each shot tests the defense and the next shot exploits the answer. Barrage governs follow-up shots, thrown-weapon chains, arrows, bolts, needles, suppressive fire, ricochets, rapid draws, and high-Realm volleys. It does not automatically grant weapon proficiency or ammunition. ### CORE BARRAGE RULES #### Barrage A Barrage is a coordinated pair or sequence of ranged attacks created through the Barrage special attack. Unless a talent says otherwise: use one thrown weapon or ranged weapon; the primary attack is made as an Action; the follow-up attack is made as a Bonus Action; the follow-up attack does not add a positive ability modifier to damage; a negative ability modifier still applies; resolve the follow-up attack before or after the primary attack; apply only one Blitz talent to one Barrage; all ammunition and thrown weapons must be legally available. #### Blitz Talent A Blitz talent changes the rhythm of one Barrage. A Blitz may: trade accuracy for control; exchange the follow-up attack for another maneuver; redirect a projectile; increase the number of shots; suppress movement; split targets; exploit Martial Focus. Unless a talent says otherwise, apply one Blitz talent to one Barrage. #### Ranged Weapon A ranged weapon includes a weapon normally used to make a ranged weapon attack. A thrown weapon qualifies when thrown. A melee attack with the same weapon does not qualify unless a talent such as Mixed Barrage says otherwise. #### Ammunition Discipline A Barrage cultivator is expected to track ammunition when the weapon requires it. Thrown weapons must also be available unless a talent, item, Forged Technique, or project returns or reproduces them. Barrage may reduce ammunition pressure at higher Realms, but it should not make the material reality of an arsenal meaningless at Mortal Realm. #### Martial Focus Barrage uses Martial Focus. Unless a broader martial-sphere rule later replaces this wording: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, you regain it only if it is currently absent. Base Sphere Ability #### Barrage Action Type: Multi-Mode Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode Factory Combat Bucket: split_required Split Candidate Buckets: action, bonus_action Timing Detail: Special Attack Action plus Bonus Action Factory Routing: split_modes_before_character_action_programming Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets Recommended Factory Realization: modes=PRIMARY_ATTACK->action, BONUS_ATTACK->bonus_action Requirement: One thrown weapon or ranged weapon Cost: None Make one ranged weapon attack with a thrown or ranged weapon. You may then make one additional ranged weapon attack with the same weapon as a Bonus Action. Resolve the Bonus Action attack before or after your other Barrage attack. Do not add a positive ability modifier to the damage of the Bonus Action attack. A negative ability modifier still applies. The two attacks together are your Barrage. Choose one Blitz talent you know when making the Barrage. ### BARRAGE TALENT TAGS #### Blitz Talents A Blitz talent modifies one Barrage. Apply only one Blitz talent unless another talent explicitly allows more. #### Volley Talents A Volley talent attacks multiple creatures, threatens an area, or converts repeated fire into battlefield pressure. #### Arsenal Talents An Arsenal talent improves ammunition use, thrown-weapon handling, projectile recovery, drawing, or weapon switching. #### Focus Talents A Focus talent modifies Martial Focus recovery or expenditure. #### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents projectile control beyond ordinary martial skill. #### Unique Barrage Talents A Unique Barrage Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another category. ### MORTAL REALM BARRAGE TALENTS #### Distracting Shot - Blitz Intentionally forgo the Bonus Action attack from your Barrage. Gain Advantage on the primary Barrage attack. The sacrificed attack represents a feint, warning shot, debris strike, or projectile used to force the target’s guard open. #### Mixed Barrage - Blitz Replace the Bonus Action ranged attack from your Barrage with one: melee weapon attack; unarmed strike; Shove attempt. Mixed Barrage supports hybrid styles such as: thrown knife into close strike; arrow into spear thrust; dart into shoulder check; sling stone into kick. #### Redirection - Blitz Forgo the Bonus Action attack from your Barrage. Choose one other weapon attack made as part of the Barrage. Redirect its course once by up to 90 degrees. This may: strike around a corner; bypass ordinary cover; shoot through an opening; exploit a reflective surface; attack from an unexpected angle. Redirection requires a physically plausible route unless combined with another sphere or Forged Technique. #### Spinning Shot - Blitz Expend Martial Focus. Make two Bonus Action attacks instead of one. Every attack in the Barrage must target a different creature. #### Suppressing Fire - Blitz Forgo the normal Bonus Action attack. Fire two wild shots at one creature. The target chooses: ##### Evade The shots automatically miss. Until the end of the target’s next turn: Speed is halved; attacks have a -2 penalty; Wisdom (Perception) checks have a -2 penalty. ##### Ignore the Pressure Roll both attacks with Disadvantage. The target suffers no suppression penalties. #### Battlefield Scavenger - Arsenal When recovering non-firearm ammunition after combat, recover three-quarters of spent ammunition instead of half. Draw one thrown weapon or piece of ammunition from: the environment; a corpse; an unattended object; a willing creature; a living creature within reach. Draw it as part of the same Action used to attack with it. ##### Extracting from an Unwilling Creature The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Extract any number of embedded thrown weapons or ammunition pieces up to the amount present. The creature takes 1d4 Slashing damage per extracted piece. Successful Save: The attempted attack Action is wasted because the ammunition was not secured. If you possess an appropriate Scoundrel talent, apply one compatible Trick to the extraction. #### Blitz Focus - Focus Whenever at least two attacks hit during one Barrage, regain Martial Focus. #### Blowback Barrage When the same creature is hit at least twice during one Barrage, it makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Push it 5 feet. Successful Save: No movement. If the forced movement would drive the creature into a solid object, it falls Prone instead. #### Hammering Shots - Focus When making a Barrage, expend Martial Focus. Bonus Action attacks in that Barrage add your ability modifier to damage normally. #### Vigilant Sharpshooter While holding Martial Focus, make Opportunity Attacks with a ranged weapon you wield. Treat the weapon as though it had Reach for this purpose. You still require ammunition or a throwable weapon. #### Quick-Draw Arsenal - Arsenal Once per turn, draw one: thrown weapon; piece of ammunition; quiver; case; sling stone; needle bundle; comparable projectile container without spending an Action. You may stow one appropriate ranged or thrown weapon at the same time. #### Mobile Barrage - Blitz Move up to 10 feet between your primary attack and your Bonus Action attack. This movement: does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from a creature hit by your primary attack; must use a legal route; does not increase your total movement for the turn. #### Covering Volley - Blitz Forgo the Bonus Action attack. Choose one ally within 30 feet. Until the start of your next turn, the first opportunity attack made against that ally has Disadvantage. If the attack misses, the ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. ### FOUNDATION REALM BARRAGE TALENTS #### Cone of Death - Volley Prerequisite: Spinning Shot, CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Make one ranged weapon attack against every creature of your choice within a 30-foot cone. Requirements: spend one projectile or thrown weapon per target; make a separate attack roll for each target; apply weapon range and ammunition rules normally. Cone of Death is a Volley, not a Barrage. #### Ceaseless Ammunition - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ When carrying at least 10 pieces of one nonmagical ammunition type, fire as many pieces of that ammunition as required without reducing the tracked amount during combat. After combat: do not retrieve more ammunition than you began with; end with the same quantity you had when combat began. This is a cultivated supernatural effect. Ceaseless Ammunition does not reproduce: magical ammunition; artifacts; poisons; consumable talismans; explosive projectiles; rare alchemical payloads. #### Stair Shot - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Requirement: Ammunition suitable for embedding into a surface Spend 10 pieces of ammunition to create a temporary stair, bridge, or ledge of projectiles along a mostly vertical surface. The structure: extends up to 5 feet x CL; may travel horizontally, upward, or downward; cannot rise or descend more steeply than 45 degrees; requires a wall, cliff, structure, large creature, or comparable surface; supports ordinary movement at the GM’s discretion. Expend Martial Focus to create the structure as a Reaction, such as when catching a falling creature or building an emergency platform. Stair Shot normally requires arrows, bolts, or comparable ammunition. #### Returning Arsenal - Arsenal Prerequisite: CL 5+ Thrown weapons used in your Barrage return to your hand at the end of your turn if: they remain within 60 feet; no creature securely holds them; no sealed barrier blocks the route. You may catch a number of returning weapons equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Excess weapons land in unoccupied spaces near you. #### Intercepting Shot Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A visible ranged weapon attack passes within 30 feet Cost: Expend Martial Focus Make a ranged weapon attack against the incoming projectile. If your attack roll equals or exceeds the triggering attack roll, choose one: negate the attack; reduce its damage by your weapon damage roll plus Proficiency Bonus; redirect the attack into one legal unoccupied space within 10 feet of its original target. Intercepting Shot does not normally stop: huge siege projectiles; area effects; beams; intangible supernatural effects; attacks with no physical projectile. #### Ricochet Scripture - Blitz Prerequisite: Redirection, CL 5+ When using Redirection, redirect the attack twice instead of once. Each turn may bend the projectile by up to 90 degrees. A physically plausible route is still required unless another sphere or Forged Technique changes that rule. #### Pinning Volley - Blitz Prerequisite: CL 5+ When at least two attacks in your Barrage hit the same creature, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. Pinning Volley represents projectiles catching clothing, armor, limbs, terrain, or movement rhythm. Creatures without a meaningful body may be immune. #### Splitting Rhythm - Focus Prerequisite: CL 7+ When Blitz Focus restores Martial Focus, choose one: move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; draw or stow one weapon; gain +2 AC against one ranged attack before the start of your next turn; add your Proficiency Bonus to the next damage roll made with a thrown or ranged weapon before the end of your next turn. #### Needle-Rain Burst - Volley Prerequisite: CL 7+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Weapon range Area: 10-foot-radius sphere Cost: Expend Martial Focus Spend five pieces of ammunition or five thrown weapons. Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take damage equal to two weapon damage dice plus your ability modifier. Successful Save: Take half damage. Needle-Rain Burst may use: arrows; bolts; darts; needles; knives; stones; other appropriate projectiles. ### CORE FORMATION REALM BARRAGE TALENTS #### Court of Falling Stars - Martial Domain “The sky did not become crowded. The cultivator simply stopped accepting empty angles.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest For the duration: ##### You increase ranged and thrown weapon normal range by 30 feet; ignore Half Cover; draw ammunition and thrown weapons without spending an Action; regain Martial Focus once per turn when at least two Barrage attacks hit; make one ranged opportunity attack each round without expending your Reaction when a hostile creature willingly moves more than 10 feet within your normal weapon range. ##### Allies Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus allies when activating the Court. They gain: +2 to Wisdom (Perception) checks against visible creatures you have attacked this round; Advantage on one attack roll against a creature hit by at least two of your Barrage attacks before the start of your next turn. Court of Falling Stars ends early if you become Incapacitated. #### Hundred-Arrow Passage - Volley Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120-foot line, 10 feet wide Cost: Expend Martial Focus Release a dense lane of projectiles. Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take damage equal to four weapon damage dice plus your ability modifier and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage. Spend one ammunition unit or thrown weapon per 10 feet of line, minimum 10 projectiles. Ceaseless Ammunition may satisfy ordinary nonmagical ammunition requirements. #### Cascading Barrage - Blitz Prerequisite: CL 10+ When one Barrage attack reduces a creature to 0 HP or scores a critical hit, make one additional ranged weapon attack against a different legal target within range. This additional attack: is part of the Barrage; does not require an Action; does not add a positive ability modifier to damage unless Hammering Shots applies; cannot trigger Cascading Barrage again. #### Arrow-Catching Reversal Prerequisite: Intercepting Shot, CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You successfully negate or reduce a physical projectile attack through Intercepting Shot Choose one: catch the projectile if you have a free hand; redirect it into one legal target within your weapon range by making a ranged weapon attack; use it as ammunition for your next Barrage before the end of your next turn. The projectile must be physically suitable. #### Sky-Net Suppression - Volley Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: Expend Martial Focus Fill an area with threatening projectiles. A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside chooses: ##### Slow Down movement costs 2 feet for every 1 foot traveled; cannot Dash; attacks have a -2 penalty until the start of its next turn. ##### Push Through Make one ranged weapon attack against that creature. On a hit, deal weapon damage normally and reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. Each creature triggers this attack once per turn. #### Ten-Angle Shot - Blitz Prerequisite: Ricochet Scripture, CL 12+ When using Redirection: ignore Three-Quarters Cover; bend the projectile up to three times; treat one visible reflective, hard, or angled surface as a legal redirection point; attack a target you cannot see directly if you can see a valid projectile path to it. Total Cover still blocks the attack unless the path genuinely reaches the target. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM BARRAGE TALENTS #### Sovereign Arsenal Incarnation “The cultivator drew one weapon. The battlefield supplied the rest.” Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest For the duration: create spiritual copies of ordinary nonmagical ammunition or thrown weapons you currently carry; Barrage Bonus Action attacks add your ability modifier to damage; Barrage may apply two different Blitz talents instead of one; regain Martial Focus once per turn when one Barrage attack hits; increase ranged and thrown weapon range by 60 feet; ordinary projectiles return or reform at the end of your turn; ignore Half and Three-Quarters Cover; make ranged Opportunity Attacks against hostile creatures willingly moving more than 10 feet within normal range. Sovereign Arsenal Incarnation does not reproduce: artifacts; magical ammunition; rare poisons; explosive payloads; talismans; unique weapons. #### Ten-Thousand Projectile Rain Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 150 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Release a sky-filling rain of projectiles. Choose hostile creatures inside the area. Each chosen creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take damage equal to eight weapon damage dice plus your ability modifier and become Pinned until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage. ##### Pinned A Pinned creature: has Speed reduced to 0; cannot take Reactions; may use an Action to remove or break free from the projectile pressure, ending Pinned. Spend at least 20 ordinary projectiles. Ceaseless Ammunition or Sovereign Arsenal Incarnation may satisfy this requirement. #### Heaven-Splitting Line Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300-foot line, 10 feet wide Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Release a condensed line of projectiles and martial intent. Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take damage equal to ten weapon damage dice plus twice your ability modifier and fall Prone. Successful Save: Take half damage. Objects and temporary Barriers inside take double damage. Heaven-Splitting Line does not automatically destroy: artifacts; Formation cores; Realm-defining barriers; Domains; Secret Inheritances. ### SECRET BARRAGE INHERITANCE #### One Arrow Becomes Ten Thousand “The master did not loose a volley. The master released the certainty that one projectile had ever been alone.” Classification: Secret Barrage Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Sovereign Arsenal Incarnation, hidden projectile scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Weapon range or 300 feet, whichever is greater Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Make one ranged weapon attack against one creature, object, Barrier, or structure section. On a hit, the single projectile becomes a perfect converging storm. ##### Creature Deal: 12 weapon damage dice + twice your ability modifier Then choose three: push the target 20 feet; knock it Prone; reduce Speed to 0 until the end of your next turn; prevent Reactions until the end of your next turn; ignore ordinary Resistance to the weapon’s damage type; strike up to three additional hostile creatures within 30 feet for half damage; create a 20-foot-radius Sky-Net Suppression area centered on the target until the start of your next turn. ##### Object, Barrier, or Structure Deal: 16 weapon damage dice + twice your ability modifier This damage ignores ordinary hardness. ##### Miss On a miss, the projectile divides imperfectly. Choose one hostile creature within 30 feet of the original target and make one additional ranged weapon attack against it. One Arrow Becomes Ten Thousand does not reproduce artifacts, talismans, rare ammunition, or unique payloads. ### OPTIONAL BARRAGE CULTIVATION VARIANTS A Barrage cultivation variant changes what the practitioner believes a projectile rhythm requires. These variants are mutually exclusive. #### Hidden-Weapon Scripture “A battlefield is generous. It offers needles, stones, knives, nails, hairpins, shards, and mistakes.” You may use Barrage only with: thrown weapons; darts; needles; sling stones; improvised projectiles; hidden weapons; comparable small ranged weapons. You cannot use Barrage with bows, crossbows, or firearms. ##### Benefits gain Battlefield Scavenger or Quick-Draw Arsenal as a bonus talent; draw one qualifying projectile per attack without spending an Action; increase thrown-weapon normal range by 10 feet; when using an improvised projectile, treat it as dealing 1d4 damage unless it would deal more. #### Archer’s Rhythm “The bow does not hurry. The bow repeats one perfect breath until the enemy mistakes repetition for inevitability.” You may use Barrage only with weapons that require ammunition. You cannot use Barrage with thrown weapons. ##### Benefits gain Distracting Shot or Redirection as a bonus talent; increase normal weapon range by 30 feet; ignore Half Cover after moving no more than half your Speed during the turn; when holding Martial Focus, draw ammunition without spending an Action. #### Mobile Fusillade “Stillness belongs to targets.” You cannot use Barrage unless you moved at least 10 feet during the turn or move at least 10 feet between Barrage attacks. ##### Benefits gain Mobile Barrage as a bonus talent; Opportunity Attacks caused by your movement have Disadvantage while wielding a ranged or thrown weapon; when Blitz Focus restores Martial Focus, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; increase land Speed by 5 feet. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Body Refining - Iron-Rain Body Use Strength or Dexterity for Barrage saving throw DCs, choosing when learning the sphere. When using thrown weapons: increase normal range by 10 feet; draw one thrown weapon per attack without spending an Action; once per round when Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, make one ranged weapon attack with a thrown weapon against a creature within normal range. This attack does not create a Barrage by itself. #### Qi Cultivation - Meridian-Guided Volley Use Intelligence or Charisma for Barrage saving throw DCs. Once per turn when you expend Martial Focus on a Barrage talent: bend one projectile’s path slightly to ignore Half Cover; or move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; or treat one ordinary thrown weapon as returning at the end of the turn. At CL 10, ignore Three-Quarters Cover instead of Half Cover when bending a projectile. #### Spirit Awakening - Intent-Piercing Shot Use Wisdom for Barrage saving throw DCs. Once per round when a hostile creature within weapon range willingly moves, attacks, or begins casting a visible technique, choose one: gain +2 to one ranged attack roll against it before the end of your next turn; know whether it intends to move toward, away from, or around you during its current action; make one Wisdom (Perception) check with Advantage to detect an opening, concealed weapon, or projectile route. Intent-Piercing Shot does not read private thoughts. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Hidden-Weapon Adept Prerequisite: Barrage sphere, CL 4+ Gain proficiency with improvised thrown weapons and one hidden-weapon tool set appropriate to the setting. Once per turn when using a dart, needle, knife, stone, or improvised projectile: draw it without spending an Action; add +1 to the attack roll; recover it after combat if physically possible. #### Archer’s Breath Prerequisite: Barrage sphere, CL 6+ When you do not move more than half your Speed during your turn: increase normal range by 30 feet; add +1 to ranged weapon attack rolls; gain Advantage on one Wisdom (Perception) check related to ranged targeting before the start of your next turn. #### Returning-Weapon Disciple Prerequisite: Barrage sphere, Returning Arsenal, CL 6+ Returning Arsenal may return weapons from 120 feet instead of 60 feet. Once per turn when a returning thrown weapon reaches your hand, choose one: move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; draw a second thrown weapon; gain +2 AC against one ranged attack before the start of your next turn. #### Fusillade Focus Prerequisite: Barrage sphere, CL 8+ Once per short rest, when you would expend Martial Focus on a Barrage talent, retain it instead. #### Projectile-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Barrage sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation or training project, use one Volley, Arsenal, or projectile-route talent you know as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. The project still requires: preparation time; projectiles or anchors; materials; a suitable site; maintenance; Formation-specific vulnerabilities.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Tamer Package You cultivate patience, hierarchy, instinct, and training.
Gain Tame.
##### Tame
Train one non-sapient Beast to obey commands in and out of combat.
Requirements:
find, purchase, rescue, raise, or capture the creature;
spend 8 hours training one creature;
make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The DC is:
10 + the creature’s Challenge Rating
Successful Check: The creature becomes Tame.
Failed Check: The creature is not Tame. You may train again after addressing an appropriate narrative obstacle.
You may train only one creature at a time.
##### Tamer Capacity
You may maintain:
a number of Tame Creatures no greater than your Proficiency Bonus;
a total combined Challenge Rating no greater than the table. After the first CR 0 creature, treat each additional CR 0 creature as CR 1/8.
If training a creature would exceed a cap, release enough Tame Creatures to remain within the limit.
##### Commands
Tame Creatures follow your commands to the best of their ability.
Giving ordinary commands requires no Action unless a talent says otherwise.
Without a command, a Tame Creature acts according to its nature, training, and circumstances.
##### Contested Control
When another creature attempts to control one of your Tame Creatures, it must first make:
Charisma check
opposed by your:
Wisdom (Animal Handling) check
Failed Opposed Check: The control attempt fails.
Successful Opposed Check: Resolve the controlling effect normally.
##### Awakening
A beast that becomes sapient is no longer an ordinary Tame Creature.
Its future relationship should be resolved through:
consent;
narrative agreement;
a Beast Companion bond;
Beast-sphere cultivation;
Spirit practices;
or another appropriate feature. Combat Rule Reminders

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Beastmastery Qi Expression: Primary — Beast Qi; Supporting — Wood-Life Qi, Bloodline Qi, Bond Qi. “A beast does not become less wild because it walks beside you. The true art is learning which part of the wild agreed to answer.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Path: Spirit Awakening Secondary Paths: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Animal handling, mounts, trained beasts, packs, joint actions, riding, battlefield coordination, spirit-beast covenants, practical beast lore The Sphere of Beastmastery teaches cooperation between cultivator and beast. Some practitioners ride trained mounts. Others guide animal allies, cultivate spirit-beast bonds, or command a coordinated pack. Beastmastery uses the companion rules when a creature becomes a bonded companion. A talent that coerces an unwilling creature is labeled clearly. ### CORE BEASTMASTERY RULES #### Martial Focus Beastmastery uses Martial Focus. Unless a broader martial-sphere rule later replaces this wording: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is absent. #### Joint Action Some Beastmastery talents use a Joint Action. A Joint Action requires both you and one participating beast ally to pay the listed Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction cost together. If either participant cannot pay the cost, the Joint Action cannot be used. #### Beast Ally A Beast Ally is one of: a willing mount; a Tame Creature; a Bonded Companion; another allied beast permitted by the talent. A Beast Ally is not automatically mindless. It may refuse obviously suicidal commands, commands violating a bond, or commands it cannot understand. #### Sapient Beasts Beastmastery does not turn sapient beings into property. A spirit beast, demon beast, awakened beast, or other intelligent creature capable of meaningful consent may cooperate, negotiate, or form a Bonded Companion relationship. Ordinary Tame normally applies only to non-sapient creatures. A coercive talent may affect a sapient beast only when the talent explicitly allows it, and such use may carry narrative, legal, karmic, or sect consequences. Base Sphere Ability #### Beastmastery Training When you learn Beastmastery: gain proficiency in Wisdom (Animal Handling); if already proficient, choose one Beastmastery talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; choose one Beastmastery Package: Rider or Tamer. You may later gain the other Package through Extra Beastmastery Package. Beastmastery Packages #### Rider Package You cultivate partnership through the saddle, harness, rein, knee, breath, and shared momentum. Gain Skillful Riding. ##### Skillful Riding While you ride a willing mount, when the mount makes a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage: it takes no damage on a success; it takes half damage on a failure. #### Tamer Package You cultivate patience, hierarchy, instinct, and training. Gain Tame. ##### Tame Train one non-sapient Beast to obey commands in and out of combat. Requirements: find, purchase, rescue, raise, or capture the creature; spend 8 hours training one creature; make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The DC is: 10 + the creature’s Challenge Rating Successful Check: The creature becomes Tame. Failed Check: The creature is not Tame. You may train again after addressing an appropriate narrative obstacle. You may train only one creature at a time. ##### Tamer Capacity You may maintain: a number of Tame Creatures no greater than your Proficiency Bonus; a total combined Challenge Rating no greater than the table. After the first CR 0 creature, treat each additional CR 0 creature as CR 1/8. If training a creature would exceed a cap, release enough Tame Creatures to remain within the limit. ##### Commands Tame Creatures follow your commands to the best of their ability. Giving ordinary commands requires no Action unless a talent says otherwise. Without a command, a Tame Creature acts according to its nature, training, and circumstances. ##### Contested Control When another creature attempts to control one of your Tame Creatures, it must first make: Charisma check opposed by your: Wisdom (Animal Handling) check Failed Opposed Check: The control attempt fails. Successful Opposed Check: Resolve the controlling effect normally. ##### Awakening A beast that becomes sapient is no longer an ordinary Tame Creature. Its future relationship should be resolved through: consent; narrative agreement; a Beast Companion bond; Beast-sphere cultivation; Spirit practices; or another appropriate feature. Combat Rule Reminders #### Climb onto a Bigger Creature A creature at least two sizes smaller than another creature may treat that larger creature as terrain. After reaching the larger creature, use an Action to make: Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) contested by the target’s: Dexterity (Acrobatics) Success: Enter the target’s space and cling to its body. While clinging: move with the target; gain Advantage on attacks against it; move around its space as difficult terrain; the GM determines which attacks the larger creature can reasonably make against you. The larger creature may use an Action to dislodge you by making: Strength (Athletics) contested by your: Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) You choose which skill to use. #### Overrun As an Action or Bonus Action, attempt to move through a hostile creature’s space. Make: Strength (Athletics) contested by the target’s: Strength (Athletics) Gain Advantage if larger than the target. Suffer Disadvantage if smaller. Success: Move through the creature’s space once during the turn. ### BEASTMASTERY TALENT TAGS #### Rider Talents A Rider talent requires the Rider Package. #### Tamer Talents A Tamer talent requires the Tamer Package. Tamer talents cannot be learned temporarily, placed into switchable martial loadouts, or granted to summoned proxies. #### Pack Talents A Pack talent coordinates multiple beast allies. #### Bond Talents A Bond talent interacts with a Beast Companion or another Bonded Companion. #### Focus Talents A Focus talent recovers, expends, or modifies Martial Focus. #### Coercive Talents A Coercive talent temporarily overrides a creature’s will. These talents are not automatically forbidden, but use against sapient creatures may carry serious consequences. #### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents high-level Beastmastery beyond ordinary training. ### MORTAL REALM BEASTMASTERY TALENTS #### Acrobatic Mount - Rider While mounted, substitute Wisdom (Animal Handling) for Athletics or Acrobatics checks made by your mount. If you possess Athletics, apply your Motion talents during the mount’s movement where reasonable. Use Wisdom (Animal Handling) in place of your Athletics or Acrobatics check. #### Defensive Rider - Rider When an attack targets your mount, redirect the attack to yourself. No Action is required. You must be riding the mount and remain a legal target. #### Meat Shield - Rider Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Until ended Cost: None While mounted on a creature of your size or larger, choose one edge of your space. Your mount grants Total Cover against attacks targeting you that cross that edge. The mount remains targetable normally. You cannot use Defensive Rider while using the mount as cover. ##### Reactive Cover Expend Martial Focus to activate Meat Shield as a Reaction when targeted by an attack roll. The attack targets the mount instead. End Meat Shield without spending an Action on your turn. #### Mounted Maneuvers - Rider Your mount may take: Dash; Disengage; Dodge; Attack, but only to Shove. When you Shove while mounted, use the mount’s Strength modifier instead of your own. #### Mounted Offense - Rider While mounted, gain Advantage on melee attacks against unmounted creatures smaller than your mount. #### Run Down - Rider Your mount may attempt Overrun as an Action or Bonus Action. #### Skirmish Rider - Rider Your mount may Disengage as a Bonus Action. #### Accomplice - Tamer Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Joint Bonus Action Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve named 5.5e action detail You or one Beast Ally within reach takes the Help Action to assist the other. The assisted participant gains Advantage on one attack roll before the end of your turn. #### Defensive Teamwork - Tamer Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row While within one Beast Ally’s reach, when an attack targets you or that ally, the other participant grants: +2 AC against the triggering attack. #### Double Team - Tamer Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row When one Tame Creature or Bonded Companion succeeds on a Grapple or Shove, make one weapon attack or unarmed strike against the same target. #### Focusing Connection - Tamer, Focus Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Joint Bonus Action Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve named 5.5e action detail Make physical contact with one Tame Creature or Bonded Companion within your natural reach. Regain Martial Focus. #### Lookout - Tamer While within 30 feet of your Beast Allies, you and those allies use the highest Passive Perception score among the group. #### Mount Training - Tamer Your Tame Creatures are considered trained mounts when their anatomy permits riding. #### Pack Attack - Tamer, Pack Your Tame Creatures gain Advantage on attacks against one creature when at least one allied Tame Creature is within 5 feet of the target and not Incapacitated. A Beast Companion counts as a Tame Creature for this talent. #### Extra Beastmastery Package Choose one Beastmastery Package you do not possess. Gain that Package. #### Steady Handler - Focus Before rolling Wisdom (Animal Handling), expend Martial Focus. Treat the d20 roll as 10. #### Trainer Gain Expertise in Wisdom (Animal Handling). ### FOUNDATION REALM BEASTMASTERY TALENTS #### Bronco Buster - Rider, Coercive Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you Grapple a larger Beast or climb onto a larger Beast, attempt to force it to act as your mount. The creature makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Until the start of its next turn: it acts as a willing mount; it takes only Actions you direct; it cannot take other Actions. Successful Save: It resists. At the start of each turn, it repeats the saving throw. If it escapes control while you remain mounted, use an Action to attempt control again. If you possess Tamer and Broad Skills, use Bronco Buster against another creature eligible for Tame. A non-Beast gains: +2 to its saving throw. #### Broad Skills - Tamer Prerequisite: CL 5+ Tame may affect a non-humanoid creature with permanent Intelligence 4 or lower. You have Disadvantage on the Animal Handling check if the creature is not a Beast. Broad Skills may include suitable: Monstrosities; spirit beasts; demon beasts; giant insects; unusual animals; magical beasts. Broad Skills does not allow ordinary Tame to enslave a sapient creature. #### Call Beast Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Call all Beast Allies to your side. They must be within: 1 mile x Cultivation Level They travel at their best safe speed, using their normal Actions and avoiding obvious hazards. At CL 11+, Beast Allies need only remain on the same plane, but travel time still applies unless another effect changes it. #### Wild Speaker - Tamer Prerequisite: CL 5+ Speak with ordinary Beasts. This grants communication, not automatic friendship. A Beast’s answers reflect: intelligence; temperament; memory; priorities; fear; hunger; loyalty. At CL 10+, communicate with spirit beasts and demon beasts when they share a meaningful language of instinct, emotion, or spirit. #### Swarm Master - Tamer, Pack Prerequisite: Trainer, CL 5+ Increase the number of Tame Creatures you may maintain by your Cultivation Level. This does not increase total Tame CR. #### Beast Tamer - Tamer, Coercive Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Duration: 10 minutes Cost: Expend Martial Focus Choose one creature eligible for Tame. The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: It serves as a temporary Tame Creature for the duration and counts against your limits. Successful Save: It becomes immune to your Beast Tamer until you complete a long rest. The effect ends early if: you or your allies harm the creature; you command an obviously suicidal action; the creature exceeds your Tamer capacity; a stronger control effect succeeds. A non-Beast gains: +2 to its saving throw. Beast Tamer is temporary dominance, not friendship. #### Distant Tamer - Tamer Prerequisite: Beast Tamer, CL 7+ Increase Beast Tamer range to 120 feet. #### Enduring Control - Tamer, Coercive Prerequisite: Beast Tamer, CL 7+ Increase Beast Tamer duration to 8 hours. #### Spirit-Beast Covenant - Bond Prerequisite: Tamer Package, CL 7+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 8 hours Target: One willing spirit beast or demon beast Form a negotiated covenant with one sapient beast ally. Choose one: the creature becomes a narrative ally; the creature becomes your Beast Companion if your variant permits; the creature becomes eligible for an appropriate Companion Rules bond; the creature agrees to serve as a mount or pack leader. Spirit-Beast Covenant requires consent. It is not ordinary Tame and does not bypass Companion Rules. #### Trampling Line - Rider Prerequisite: Run Down, CL 7+ When your mount succeeds on Overrun, choose one: push the target 10 feet; knock the target Prone; deal Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus; allow the mount to move 10 additional feet. Use Trampling Line once per turn. #### Shared Saddle Rhythm - Rider, Focus Prerequisite: CL 7+ When your mount takes Dash, Disengage, or Dodge while you ride it, choose one: regain Martial Focus; move 5 feet after the mount’s movement without provoking Opportunity Attacks; grant the mount Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Use Shared Saddle Rhythm once per round. ### CORE FORMATION REALM BEASTMASTERY TALENTS #### Mass Tame - Tamer, Coercive Prerequisite: Beast Tamer, CL 10+ When using Beast Tamer, target creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus within range. Each target saves separately. Your Tamer capacity still applies. #### Permanent Control - Forbidden Tamer Talent Classification: Forbidden Beastmastery Talent Prerequisite: Beast Tamer, Enduring Control, CL 10+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 8 hours Target: One creature currently affected by Beast Tamer Attempt to turn temporary dominance into permanent control. The target makes a Charisma saving throw with Advantage. Failed Save: It remains under your control until the bond is broken. Successful Save: It becomes immune to your Permanent Control. Permanent Control: does not create trust; does not create a Bonded Companion; does not grant Companion Archetypes; does not grant Beast Nature; does not grant Realm Evolutions; may be recognized as coercive spiritual injury; is forbidden or heavily restricted in most orthodox sects. A sapient creature may receive additional protections at the GM’s discretion. #### Great Beast Charge - Rider Prerequisite: Trampling Line, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Joint Action Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve named 5.5e action detail You and your mount move up to the mount’s Speed. During this movement: ignore nonmagical difficult terrain; do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from one chosen creature; move through one hostile creature’s space if your mount succeeds on Overrun. At the end, you or the mount makes one melee attack. Hit: Add: 3d8 Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Force damage. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Push 15 feet or knock Prone. Successful Save: Push 5 feet. #### Pack Encirclement - Tamer, Pack Prerequisite: Pack Attack, CL 10+ When at least two Beast Allies threaten one creature: that creature cannot Disengage from those Beast Allies; the first Beast Ally hitting it each round reduces its Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn; when it attacks one Beast Ally, another Beast Ally within reach may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. #### Shared Guard - Bond Prerequisite: Beast Companion or another Bonded Companion, CL 10+ Your Bonded Companion gains Shared Guard according to the Companion Rules chapter. If it already possesses Shared Guard through automatic Realm Evolution, improve one use per round: when adjacent to you, either participant may grant the other +2 AC against one attack as a Reaction; or when one participant takes damage, the other may move 5 feet toward them without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Shared Guard does not grant an additional Reaction. #### Court of Fang and Rein - Martial Domain “The beasts did not become soldiers. The soldiers finally learned to move like a pack.” Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest For the duration: ##### You and Beast Allies gain +10 feet Speed; gain Advantage on checks against being shoved or moved; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain created by natural terrain; use the highest Passive Perception among allies within 60 feet; move through allied spaces normally. ##### Once Per Turn After one Beast Ally hits, choose one different Beast Ally within 30 feet. It may: move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; take Help as a Reaction; gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Court of Fang and Rein ends early if you become Incapacitated. #### Beastback Relay - Rider Prerequisite: CL 12+ When you begin your turn riding one willing mount, transfer onto another willing mount within 15 feet without spending an Action. This movement: does not provoke Opportunity Attacks; may occur during movement; allows one mounted attack before or after the transfer. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM BEASTMASTERY TALENTS #### One Rider, One Beast Prerequisite: Rider Package, CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest You and one willing mount enter perfect battle rhythm. For the duration: use the higher Speed between you and the mount for both participants; both gain +2 AC; both gain Advantage on Dexterity saving throws; both ignore nonmagical difficult terrain; neither provokes Opportunity Attacks from movement; once per turn after either participant hits, the other may move 10 feet or make one Shove as a Reaction. You and the mount remain separate creatures with separate Actions and Reactions. #### Ten-Thousand-Beast Procession Prerequisite: Tamer Package, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 60-foot-radius aura centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest A spiritual procession of beast silhouettes moves with your allies. ##### Beast Allies gain +10 feet Speed; gain Advantage on attack rolls against creatures threatened by another Beast Ally; gain Resistance to Frightened; gain Temporary HP equal to 2 x Proficiency Bonus when the effect begins; may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks after hitting. ##### Hostile Creatures When one hostile creature starts its turn inside and is adjacent to one Beast Ally, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Become Frightened of the nearest Beast Ally until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. #### Call Across the Wild Worlds Prerequisite: Call Beast, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Call one Beast Ally, mount, or Bonded Companion on the same plane. The creature appears in one visible unoccupied space within 30 feet. This effect cannot call: an unwilling creature; a creature sealed behind a Dimensional Lock; a creature imprisoned by a stronger effect; a creature on another plane. #### Sovereign Pack Mind Prerequisite: Tamer Package, CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest For the duration, communicate with Beast Allies within 1 mile through: intent; emotion; simple images; prey direction; danger; formation changes. Once per round when one Beast Ally within 120 feet makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check, grant: +Proficiency Bonus to the roll after seeing the result but before knowing the outcome. Sovereign Pack Mind does not erase individuality. ### SECRET BEASTMASTERY INHERITANCE #### The First Pact Beneath Heaven “Before saddle, collar, whistle, or scripture, two creatures stood beneath the same storm and chose not to abandon one another.” Classification: Secret Beastmastery Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Spirit-Beast Covenant or One Rider, One Beast, hidden primordial pact scripture Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You, one Beast Ally, or one Bonded Companion within 120 feet would drop to 0 HP, fail a saving throw against control, or be separated by forced movement Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Choose one: the protected creature drops to 1 HP instead of 0 HP; the protected creature succeeds on the triggering saving throw; negate the forced movement; call one willing Beast Ally on the same plane into an adjacent unoccupied space; end one ordinary hostile control effect affecting one Beast Ally. Until the end of your next turn: Beast Allies within 60 feet cannot be Charmed or Frightened; Beast Allies within 60 feet gain Resistance to all damage; you and one Beast Ally may move up to half Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks; your commands cannot force suicidal behavior. The First Pact does not create ownership. It reveals the relationship that existed strongly enough to answer. ### OPTIONAL BEASTMASTERY VARIANTS A Beastmastery variant changes what kind of relationship the practitioner cultivates. These variants are mutually exclusive unless a talent says otherwise. #### Beast Companion Prerequisite: Tamer Package You may maintain only one Tame Creature. Choose one Beast: size Medium or smaller; CR 1/4 or lower; willing or successfully trained through Tame. It becomes your Bonded Companion under the Companion Rules chapter. ##### Companion Integration Your Beast Companion: gains one shared Companion Archetype; gains Beast Nature in addition to that Archetype; automatically gains Realm Evolutions at normal thresholds; gains Shared Guard and other shared evolutions according to Companion Rules; uses Companion Rules scaling instead of ordinary Tamer scaling. The maximum starting CR increases: You cannot select Beast Companion and Monster Tamer together. #### Monster Tamer Prerequisite: Tamer Package Gain Broad Skills as a bonus talent. You cannot use Tame on ordinary Beasts. You specialize in unusual non-humanoid creatures with Intelligence 4 or lower. Examples may include: giant insects; Monstrosities; lesser spirit beasts; lesser demon beasts; cave predators; unusual magical fauna. Monster Tamer does not allow ordinary Tame to enslave sapient creatures. You cannot select Monster Tamer and Beast Companion together. #### Offensive Rider Prerequisite: Rider Package You do not gain Skillful Riding. Gain Skirmish Rider as a bonus talent. When your mount moves at least 20 feet before you hit with a melee attack, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll. #### Gentle Herdkeeper Prerequisite: Tamer Package You cannot learn Coercive talents. ##### Benefits gain Wild Speaker or Trainer as a bonus talent; Tame training time becomes 4 hours; when one Tame Creature completes a long rest under your care, it gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; gain Advantage on Animal Handling checks made to calm, heal, rescue, or negotiate with beasts. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Spirit Awakening - Beast-Heart Resonance Use Wisdom as your Beastmastery key ability. You may communicate through emotional impressions with willing: Beasts; spirit beasts; demon beasts; Bonded Companions. When a Beast Ally within 30 feet succeeds on a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, or hostile control, it gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once per round, when a Beast Ally fails one of those saving throws, add your Wisdom modifier to the result. #### Body Refining - Iron-Saddle Body Use Constitution as your Beastmastery key ability where a talent requires a save DC. While mounted or adjacent to one Beast Ally: gain Advantage on Strength saving throws against forced movement; reduce falling damage by 5 x Proficiency Bonus; when Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, one adjacent Beast Ally gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. When using Great Beast Charge, add your Constitution modifier to one damage roll. #### Qi Cultivation - Meridian-Rein Command Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Beastmastery key ability. Once per turn when a Beast Ally within 60 feet takes Dash, Disengage, Dodge, Help, Grapple, or Shove: move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; or reduce the CP cost of one Beastmastery Forged Technique before the end of your next turn by 1, minimum 1. At CL 10+, increase the free movement to 10 feet. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Bonded-Beast Adept Prerequisite: Beastmastery sphere, Beast Companion, CL 4+ Choose one physical and one mental ability score of your Beast Companion. Increase each chosen score by: +2 This is Beast Tamer’s Bond. Apply normal Companion Rules limits. #### Cavalry Adept Prerequisite: Beastmastery sphere, Rider Package, CL 6+ While mounted: mount or dismount without spending movement; gain Advantage on checks made to remain mounted; draw or stow one mounted weapon without spending an Action once per turn; when your mount Disengages, you may also ignore Opportunity Attacks until the end of the movement. #### Pack Strategist Prerequisite: Beastmastery sphere, Tamer Package, CL 8+ When two Beast Allies threaten one creature, choose one Beast Ally at the start of your turn. Until the start of your next turn, it gains one: +2 AC; +10 feet Speed; Advantage on one Shove or Grapple check; Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Spirit-Beast Diplomat Prerequisite: Beastmastery sphere, Wild Speaker, CL 8+ Gain Advantage on checks made to: negotiate with spirit beasts; recognize beast territory; calm demon beasts; interpret instinctive warnings; recognize when an animal ally is being controlled; form Spirit-Beast Covenants. #### Stable-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Beastmastery sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation or long-term beast project, use one Beastmastery Package, Pack talent, Bond talent, or training principle as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. The project still requires: suitable terrain; food; caretakers; training time; materials; Formation anchors where appropriate; maintenance; narrative access to beasts.
