#### Tamer Package You cultivate patience, hierarchy, instinct, and training.
Gain Tame.
##### Tame
Train one non-sapient Beast to obey commands in and out of combat.
Requirements:
find, purchase, rescue, raise, or capture the creature;
spend 8 hours training one creature;
make a Wisdom (Animal Handling) check. The DC is:
10 + the creature’s Challenge Rating
Successful Check: The creature becomes Tame.
Failed Check: The creature is not Tame. You may train again after addressing an appropriate narrative obstacle.
You may train only one creature at a time.
##### Tamer Capacity
You may maintain:
a number of Tame Creatures no greater than your Proficiency Bonus;
a total combined Challenge Rating no greater than the table. After the first CR 0 creature, treat each additional CR 0 creature as CR 1/8.
If training a creature would exceed a cap, release enough Tame Creatures to remain within the limit.
##### Commands
Tame Creatures follow your commands to the best of their ability.
Giving ordinary commands requires no Action unless a talent says otherwise.
Without a command, a Tame Creature acts according to its nature, training, and circumstances.
##### Contested Control
When another creature attempts to control one of your Tame Creatures, it must first make:
Charisma check
opposed by your:
Wisdom (Animal Handling) check
Failed Opposed Check: The control attempt fails.
Successful Opposed Check: Resolve the controlling effect normally.
##### Awakening
A beast that becomes sapient is no longer an ordinary Tame Creature.
Its future relationship should be resolved through:
consent;
narrative agreement;
a Beast Companion bond;
Beast-sphere cultivation;
Spirit practices;
or another appropriate feature. Combat Rule Reminders

## Core Ability: Adorn the Moment
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self, or one willing creature or object within touch
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 0 CP
You refine the appearance, bearing, aura, or symbolic presence of yourself, a willing creature, or an object.
Choose one:
- The target gains Advantage on the next Charisma (Performance), Charisma (Persuasion), Dexterity (Acrobatics), or Wisdom (Insight) check made before the effect ends, if the check depends on grace, poise, first impressions, etiquette, dance, beauty, or emotional presentation. A creature can benefit from this option only once per scene.
- The target becomes visually memorable. Creatures that see it during the duration have Advantage on checks to remember or identify it later.
- The target's aura becomes soft, graceful, haunting, radiant, refined, tragic, elegant, or terrible. This has no direct combat effect, but it may make certain social approaches possible.
A creature can benefit from only one use of Adorn the Moment at a time.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Beauty Qi Expression: Primary — Beauty Qi; Supporting — Harmony Qi, Blossom Qi, Light Qi, Desire Qi. Sphere Type: Power / Spirit-Social / Influence Sphere Primary Path: Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation Rare Access: Body Refining through perfected posture, graceful body methods, bloodline allure, voice training, dance, movement, presence, skin/bone/eye refinement, hosted spirits, or body-bound aura Resource: CP, Beauty Marks, Charmed effects, Captivated attention, social positioning, emotional restraint, and action-block state objects Core Chassis: Beauty Mark, Captivating Presence, Moment of Hesitation, Catch the Eye, Adorn the Moment, Turn the Blade Aside "Beauty is not softness. Beauty is the moment the blade hesitates because the world remembers it was meant to be whole." Common Name: Beauty Catalogue Name: Sphere of Beauty Sphere Type: Power / Spirit-Social / Influence Sphere Primary Path: Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation Body Refining Access: Legal through perfected posture, graceful body methods, bloodline allure, voice training, dance, movement, presence, skin/bone/eye refinement, hosted spirits, or body-bound aura. A Body Refiner does not personally project external qi through Beauty unless a feature explicitly permits it. Resource: CP, Beauty Marks, Charmed effects, Captivated attention, social positioning, emotional restraint, and action-block state objects. Core Chassis: Beauty Mark, Captivating Presence, Moment of Hesitation. Core Abilities: Catch the Eye, Adorn the Moment, Turn the Blade Aside. ## Dao of Beauty Beauty is the cultivation of attention, harmony, desire-for-wholeness, poise, proportion, elegance, awe, tenderness, and unbearable presence. Beauty is not merely physical appearance. A scar can be beautiful. A song can be beautiful. A sword draw can be beautiful. A vow kept under impossible pressure can be beautiful. A terrifying ghost bride, a solemn executioner, a jade-faced prince, a one-armed dancer, a radiant monk, and a battlefield general standing alone under arrows can all cultivate Beauty. The Dao of Beauty asks: What does the heart refuse to harm? What draws the eye before reason can defend itself? What shape makes cruelty feel ugly? What face does the soul show when it wants to be remembered? ## What This Sphere Is For Use Beauty when a character's power comes from charm, poise, grace, elegance, captivating presence, social magnetism, heart-stirring appearance, performance, prestige, glamour, refinement, awe, or the spiritual force of being unforgettable. Beauty can: - charm and soften hostility; - draw attention; - impose hesitation; - protect through awe; - make violence feel spiritually difficult; - turn social presence into battlefield influence; - mark people with admiration, envy, fascination, reverence, pity, curiosity, terror, or longing; - create a courtly, terrifying, radiant, graceful, or haunting presence; - support social scenes without replacing roleplay. Beauty should not become mindless domination. It influences the heart; it does not erase the person. ## Sphere Boundaries Illusion. Illusion creates false images, sensory deception, and unreal appearances. Beauty may make something compelling, radiant, graceful, or emotionally overwhelming, but it does not automatically create false images unless a talent says so. Music. Music governs rhythm, song, measure, chord, and ordered resonance. Beauty can use voice or performance, but Music remains the sphere of structured sound and musical cultivation. Jester. Jester disrupts pride, reverses social position, reveals absurdity, and humiliates false dignity. Beauty draws, softens, elevates, fascinates, and compels attention. Radiance. Radiance reveals, purifies, and blesses through light. Beauty may shine, but its power is heart-attention and aesthetic force, not necessarily holy light. Puppetry. Puppetry controls bodies, puppets, strings, and forced movement. Beauty can make a creature hesitate, listen, or obey a simple non-destructive command, but it does not seize a body like a puppet. Dreams. Dreams governs sleep, dreamwalking, nightmare, memory-dream, and inner vision. Beauty may be dreamlike, but it does not create dream realms or dream attacks by default. Karma. Karma governs debt, consequence, vow, and return. Beauty can make cruelty feel shameful, but it does not automatically create karmic debt. Spirit Awakening. Spirit Awakening governs the soul, Resonance, marks, dreams, identity, and spiritual pressure. Beauty is especially natural for Spirit Awakeners, but it is a sphere of cultivated presence rather than the whole soul system. ## PG and Consent Boundary Beauty is a charm and influence sphere, not a sexual coercion sphere. Beauty effects may create admiration, awe, attention, hesitation, fascination, softened hostility, reverence, emotional openness, or social magnetism. They do not force romance, sexual attraction, intimacy, or consent. A Beauty effect cannot force a creature to perform sexual acts, accept sexual contact, enter a romantic relationship, or treat abuse as affection. If a table wants romance, that remains a roleplaying matter outside the mechanical force of this sphere. Beauty can make someone pause, listen, blush, admire, envy, obey etiquette, hesitate to strike, or prefer a peaceful answer. It cannot erase personhood. ## Path Expression Spirit Awakening. Beauty is a natural Spirit Awakening sphere. A Spirit Awakener expresses Beauty through Resonance, soul pressure, heart-impressions, gaze, presence, dreamlike memory, names, vows, or the unbearable impression of identity. Beauty Marks may feel like spiritual impressions rather than visible marks. Qi Cultivation. A Qi Cultivator expresses Beauty through refined aura, fragrance, color, light, movement, cultivated clothing, flower wind, artful qi shaping, talismanic presentation, or elegant pressure. Qi Cultivators may project Beauty outward normally through legal sphere effects. Body Refining. A Body Refiner expresses Beauty through posture, motion, breath, eye refinement, skin and bone tempering, bloodline allure, dance, voice, terrifying grace, scarred perfection, or body-bound aura. A Body Refiner does not personally project external qi through Beauty unless a feature explicitly permits it. If a hosted spirit creates an external Beauty expression, the spirit is the source. ## Key Terms ### Beauty Mark A Beauty Mark is a temporary spiritual impression of fascination, admiration, awe, envy, tenderness, terror, pity, curiosity, or social attention. A creature bearing your Beauty Mark is easier for your Beauty talents to affect. Unless a feature says otherwise, a Beauty Mark lasts for 1 minute, until the scene ends, or until you dismiss it. A creature can bear only one Beauty Mark from you at a time. You may maintain a number of Beauty Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier, minimum your Proficiency Bonus. If you would exceed this limit, choose one existing Beauty Mark to end. A Beauty Mark is not itself the Charmed condition. It is a state object that records attention, presence, and emotional imprint. ### Charmed Many Beauty talents use the Charmed condition. A creature Charmed by you cannot willingly attack you while the condition lasts, and you have Advantage on ability checks to influence it socially, following the normal meaning of the Charmed condition. Beauty charms are fragile. Unless a talent says otherwise, a Beauty charm ends early if you or your allies damage the Charmed creature or force it to make a saving throw that deals damage. ### Captivated Some Beauty talents cause a creature to become Captivated. A Captivated creature is not fully Charmed. Instead, until the effect ends: - it has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice creatures other than you; - it cannot make Opportunity Attacks against creatures other than you; - the first time on each of its turns that it targets a creature other than you with an attack or hostile action, it must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. On a failure, it must choose you as the target if you are a legal target, choose a different legal non-hostile action, or lose that attack or hostile action. Captivated ends early if you become Hidden from the creature, if the creature can no longer perceive you, or if you or your allies damage it. Captivated is not mind control. It represents attention being pulled toward you. ### Charm Immunity and Beauty A creature immune to the Charmed condition is immune to Beauty talents that directly impose Charmed. Captivated and Beauty Marks are not Charmed, but a creature immune to Charmed has Advantage on saving throws against Beauty talents unless the talent states otherwise. A creature that cannot perceive you cannot be affected by Beauty talents that require perception. A creature that lacks emotion, attention, social awareness, or selfhood may be immune to Beauty effects at the GM's discretion unless the Beauty expression is specifically suited to that creature, such as perfect symmetry for a construct, ancestral reverence for a ghost, or sacred iconography for a spirit. ### Cultivation Save DC When a Beauty talent calls for a saving throw, use your normal Cultivation Save DC. ### Fragile Beauty Many Beauty effects collapse when the affected creature is harmed. If a talent says the effect ends when you or your allies damage the target, this means damage after the effect is established. Harm that occurred earlier in the fight does not automatically prevent the talent unless the talent says so. ## Core Ability: Catch the Eye Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature that can perceive you Duration: Until the end of your next turn for Captivated; 1 minute for Beauty Mark Cost: 0 CP Save: Wisdom You arrange posture, voice, gaze, movement, spiritual pressure, or cultivated presence into a moment that the target cannot ignore. A creature can benefit from this option only once per scene. - The target becomes visually memorable. The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the triggering attack has Disadvantage. On a successful save, the attack is resolved normally, and the Beauty Mark ends. This ability cannot affect creatures immune to the Charmed condition unless another feature says otherwise. ## Mortal Talents ### Courtly Grace When you use Adorn the Moment on yourself, you may choose two of the listed skill options instead of one. The first qualifying check using either skill gains the benefit. In addition, you gain proficiency in one of the following skills: Performance, Persuasion, Insight, or Deception. If you already have proficiency in the chosen skill, choose another from the list. ### Gentle Smile Method When you successfully place a Beauty Mark on a creature outside combat, you may ask the GM one of the following questions: - What would make this creature willing to listen? - What kind of beauty, status, kindness, or etiquette does this creature respect? - What would offend this creature's dignity? - Is this creature more moved by admiration, pity, pride, curiosity, or longing? The answer may be symbolic or incomplete, but it should be useful. ### Disarming Courtesy When a creature bearing your Beauty Mark makes a hostile ability check against you in a social scene, such as Intimidation, Deception, or Insight, you may spend 1 CP as a Reaction. The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has Disadvantage on the triggering check. This talent does not prevent honest disagreement or justified suspicion. ### Fragrant Sleeve Diversion Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: 1 CP Save: Wisdom A gesture, scent, sleeve movement, smile, turn of the head, or ripple of presence pulls the target's attention. On a failed save, the target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it can still take Reactions, but not Opportunity Attacks against you until the start of your next turn. ### Unapproachable Poise When you use Turn the Blade Aside and the target fails its saving throw, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature. At Foundation Realm, this movement increases to 15 feet. ### Admiring Crowd Method When you use Catch the Eye outside combat before an audience, crowd, court, sect hall, market, banquet, performance, or public gathering, you may target a small group rather than one creature. Choose a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus. Each target must be able to perceive you and must not be actively hostile. Each target makes its saving throw separately. On a failed save, a target is Charmed by you for 1 minute or until you or your allies harm it. This effect does not make the crowd obey commands. It makes them willing to listen, watch, admire, or give you social space. ### Beautiful Warning When you roll Initiative, you may use Adorn the Moment as part of the same moment without spending a Bonus Action. Once per long rest, when you do so, choose one enemy that can perceive you. It gains your Beauty Mark until the end of your next turn. ### Envious Glance Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 1 CP Save: Wisdom You twist admiration into envy. On a failed save, the target is Captivated by you for the duration. While Captivated this way, it has Disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes against a creature other than you on each of its turns. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. The effect also ends if you or your allies damage the target. ### Lovely Monster Bearing Your beauty may be unsettling, predatory, scarred, ghostly, demonic, corpse-pale, inhuman, or terrible. When a Beauty talent would normally rely on elegance, softness, charm, refinement, or attractiveness, you may instead express it through awe, fearsome grace, tragic horror, alien symmetry, or overwhelming presence. In addition, when you use Catch the Eye, you may choose whether the Beauty Mark feels like admiration, fear, reverence, pity, envy, curiosity, or fascination. This talent does not make Beauty effects count as fear effects unless another talent says so. ### Mirror of the Heart When a creature bearing your Beauty Mark speaks with you for at least 1 minute, you may spend 1 CP and make a Wisdom (Insight) check contested by the target's Charisma (Deception). On a success, you learn one of the following: - what the target wants from you right now; - what the target fears losing face over; - whether the target is pretending not to care; - what emotion your presence most strongly stirs in the target. This does not reveal deep secrets or hidden memories unless the GM decides the scene supports it. ### Perfect Posture When you make a saving throw against being knocked Prone, moved against your will, humiliated by a social technique, or forced to kneel, bow, grovel, or lose face, you may add 1d4 to the roll. You may use this talent after seeing the d20 roll but before the result is declared. You may use this talent a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest. ### Red Lip Command Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: One creature Charmed by you or bearing your Beauty Mark Duration: Until the end of the target's next turn Cost: 1 CP Save: Wisdom You issue a short, graceful command. The command must be simple and non-suicidal, such as: - stop; - listen; - kneel; - wait; - look at me; - step aside; - put that down; - answer politely; - leave them alone. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it follows the command until the end of its next turn, provided the command does not directly harm it, force it to betray a core vow, violate an obvious survival instinct, or force romance, intimacy, or sexual conduct. A command to kneel, bow, or step aside does not automatically knock the creature Prone unless the GM rules that the creature chooses such a posture. On a successful save, the target ignores the command, and its Beauty Mark ends. ### Shared Spotlight When you use Adorn the Moment, you may affect yourself and one willing ally within 30 feet. The ally's benefit must be the same kind of presentation: graceful, radiant, tragic, terrifying, courtly, solemn, or another shared aesthetic. ### Softened Heart When you make a Charisma check to de-escalate hostility, ask for mercy, request a pause in violence, negotiate surrender, or prevent cruelty, you may spend 1 CP to add 1d4 to the roll. You may use this talent after seeing the roll but before the result is declared. ### Tears Like Pearls Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature that can perceive you Duration: 1 minute Cost: 1 CP Save: Wisdom Your beauty becomes vulnerable, tragic, or painfully sincere. On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it cannot willingly attack you unless you attack it, harm it, or command harm against it. The target repeats the saving throw whenever one of its allies is harmed by you or your allies, ending the effect on a success. A creature immune to Charmed is unaffected. ## Foundation Talents ### Captive Audience Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30-foot cone Target: Creatures of your choice in the area that can perceive you Duration: Until the end of your next turn Cost: 2 CP Save: Wisdom You seize the attention of a room, battlefield line, court, or mob. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target is Captivated by you until the end of your next turn and gains your Beauty Mark for 1 minute. On a successful save, it is not Captivated, but gains your Beauty Mark until the end of its next turn. ### Awe Before Violence Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP Save: Wisdom Your presence makes violence against you feel ugly, improper, or spiritually difficult. For the duration, the first time on each creature's turn that a creature that can perceive you targets you with an attack, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it must choose a different legal target or lose that attack. On a successful save, it can attack you normally and is immune to this talent until the start of its next turn. A creature that succeeds on three saving throws against this talent during the same scene becomes immune to your Awe Before Violence for 24 hours. This effect ends early if you damage a creature or force a creature to make a saving throw that deals damage. ### Beloved Voice You may use Catch the Eye, Red Lip Command, Tears Like Pearls, and Captive Audience through your voice instead of sight. A target must be able to hear you clearly. If the target can hear but not see you, it has Advantage on its saving throw unless your voice is especially appropriate to the scene, such as a song, public speech, whispered confession, formal challenge, or prayer. ### Beauty in Motion When you move at least 10 feet on your turn, you may spend 1 CP to leave a trail of graceful motion until the start of your next turn. During this time, the first creature that makes an Opportunity Attack against you must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the Opportunity Attack misses automatically. On a successful save, the attack is made with Disadvantage. ### Court of One Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP Save: Wisdom You make the target feel as if the scene has narrowed to only the two of you. On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for the duration. While Charmed this way, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. This effect ends early if you or your allies damage the target. ### Grace That Shames the Cruel Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Trigger: A creature bearing your Beauty Mark damages a creature other than you Duration: Until the end of the triggering creature's next turn Cost: 2 CP Save: Wisdom Your presence makes the act feel crude, shameful, or spiritually dissonant. The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it takes Psychic damage equal to 1d8 + your key ability modifier, and it has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn. At CL 11, the Psychic damage increases to 2d8 + your key ability modifier. At CL 17, it increases to 3d8 + your key ability modifier. ### Imperial Face Method When you enter a formal social scene where status, face, etiquette, reputation, or public dignity matters, you may spend 1 CP to establish an Imperial Face. For 10 minutes, creatures that can perceive you understand that insulting, dismissing, or crudely interrupting you is socially dangerous unless they have higher status, overwhelming confidence, or a reason to ignore etiquette. This does not force obedience. It changes the social stakes. The GM may grant Advantage on one Charisma check that relies on dignity, poise, etiquette, or reputation during the scene. ### Lotus Gaze Pacification Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature that can perceive you Duration: 1 minute Cost: 2 CP Save: Wisdom You look at the target with unbearable compassion, beauty, sadness, or serenity. On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it cannot willingly make attacks unless it or one of its allies was damaged since the end of its last turn. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. ### Perfect Entrance When you enter a scene, audience chamber, duel ground, banquet, battlefield, or public space, you may spend 1 CP to make your arrival spiritually memorable. Choose a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus that can perceive you. Each target gains your Beauty Mark until the end of your next turn. If no combat is occurring, the mark lasts 1 minute instead. ### Unforgettable Face A creature that has failed a saving throw against your Beauty talent remembers you clearly for one year unless memory alteration, reincarnation, curse, or stronger magic interferes. You may also choose to leave a gentler impression. In that case, the creature remembers not your exact face but the emotion your beauty left behind. ## Core Formation Talents ### Aura of Unapproachable Elegance Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Duration: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP You surround yourself with an aura of refined distance. For the duration, creatures bearing your Beauty Mark treat the area within 5 feet of you as difficult terrain. In addition, when a marked creature enters a space within 5 feet of you for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it cannot willingly attack you until the start of its next turn. This effect ends for a creature if you damage it. ### Beauty That Judges Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark Duration: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Save: Wisdom Your beauty becomes a mirror of the target's own ugliness, cruelty, envy, or shame. On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you and spiritually judged for 1 minute. While judged, the first time on each of its turns that it damages a creature other than you, it takes Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. This effect ends early if you damage the target. ### Face That Halts the Army Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: Creatures of your choice up to your Proficiency Bonus Duration: Until the end of your next turn Cost: 3 CP Save: Wisdom You reveal a level of presence that makes even trained killers hesitate. Each target must be able to perceive you and must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target is Captivated and cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it is only Captivated until the start of your next turn. ### Jewel-Mind Reflection When you succeed on a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, possession, social compulsion, or a Spirit Awakening effect that attempts to alter your emotions, you may use your Reaction and spend 2 CP to reflect beauty through the attack. The creature that forced the saving throw must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it gains your Beauty Mark for 1 minute and is Captivated by you until the end of its next turn. ### Lotus Court Aura Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 15-foot emanation Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP You create an aura of courtly beauty, solemn grace, ghostly elegance, or sacred refinement. For the duration, when a hostile creature starts its turn in the aura and can perceive you, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it has Disadvantage on the first attack roll it makes before the start of its next turn unless that attack targets you. On a successful save, it is immune to this aura until the start of your next turn. ### Name Written in Silk When a creature is Charmed by one of your Beauty talents for at least 1 minute, you may spend 2 CP to leave a lingering Beauty Mark. The mark lasts for 24 hours. While the mark remains, you have Advantage on the first social check you make against that creature during a peaceful interaction. The mark ends immediately if you betray, humiliate, or harm the creature. ### Radiant Rivalry Choose one creature bearing your Beauty Mark. Until the end of the scene, whenever that creature succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Beauty talents, you gain a Rivalry Mark against it. You may hold only one Rivalry Mark at a time. Before the end of the scene, you may spend the Rivalry Mark in one of the following ways: - add your Proficiency Bonus to one Beauty-related attack roll or social check made against that creature; - before the creature rolls a saving throw against one of your Beauty talents, increase your Cultivation Save DC against that saving throw by 2. The Rivalry Mark then ends. ### World-Adorning Gesture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Duration: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP You make a place beautiful: lanterns seem brighter, petals drift, dust turns gold, shadows become elegant, rain sings, ruined stone looks holy, or blood on the ground becomes tragically vivid. The area becomes Adorned Terrain. While in Adorned Terrain, creatures of your choice gain Advantage on Charisma (Performance) checks, Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks, and Wisdom saving throws against Frightened. Hostile creatures in the terrain that can perceive the beauty have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks to notice creatures other than you. The terrain is not difficult terrain unless another feature says so. ## Nascent Soul Talents ### Domain of the Perfect Moment Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30-foot emanation Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Save: Wisdom You create a temporary domain where every gesture, breath, drop of blood, and falling leaf seems arranged around you. When you activate this talent, choose any number of creatures in the area. Each hostile target must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, it is Charmed by you until the end of its next turn and gains your Beauty Mark for 1 minute. For the duration, the first time a marked hostile creature starts its turn in the domain, it must repeat the saving throw. On a failed save, it cannot willingly attack you until the start of its next turn. This effect ends for a creature if you damage it. ### Heaven Cannot Look Away When you use Captive Audience, Face That Halts the Army, or Domain of the Perfect Moment, you may spend 2 additional CP. Targets that fail their saving throws are also unable to become Hidden from you until the effect ends, as their own attention and spiritual presence remain caught in the exchange. This does not reveal invisible creatures unless they failed the saving throw while you could perceive them. ### Beauty That Ends War Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature that can perceive you Duration: 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Save: Wisdom You reveal beauty so sincere, terrible, tragic, or sacred that violence feels like sacrilege. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for 1 minute. While Charmed this way, it cannot willingly make attacks or force creatures to make damaging saving throws. The effect ends early if the target takes damage, if one of its allies is killed, if you command it to suffer humiliation or betrayal, or if you or your allies resume obvious aggression after it stops fighting. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Once a creature succeeds on a saving throw against this talent, it is immune to your Beauty That Ends War for 24 hours. ### Thousand Faces of the Heart When you use Adorn the Moment, you may choose one emotional face: - compassion; - authority; - innocence; - grief; - joy; - terror; - longing; - serenity; - judgment; - wonder. Until the effect ends, your Beauty talents may express through that emotional face. Once before the effect ends, when a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Beauty talents, you may learn whether that emotional face was effective, resisted, painful, offensive, or strangely familiar to the target. ### Unbearable Splendor Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature bearing your Beauty Mark Duration: 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Save: Wisdom Your beauty overwhelms the target's ability to act naturally. On a failed save, the target is Charmed by you for 1 minute. Until the end of its next turn, it is also Overwhelmed by Splendor. While Overwhelmed by Splendor, the target cannot take Reactions, and on its turn it may do only one of the following: move, take an Action, or take a Bonus Action. After the Overwhelmed state ends, the target remains Charmed for the duration. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the Charmed condition on a success. This effect ends early if you or your allies damage the target. ## Immortal Talent ### Beauty Beyond Form Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Target: Creatures of your choice up to twice your Proficiency Bonus that can perceive you Duration: 1 minute Cost: 8 CP Save: Wisdom Your beauty no longer depends on face, body, voice, clothing, youth, gender, species, or form. For one minute, you become a spiritual principle of awe, harmony, longing, terror, mercy, perfection, or impossible memory. Each target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failed save, a target is Charmed by you for 1 minute and gains your Beauty Mark. While Charmed this way, the target cannot willingly attack you. The first time on each of its turns that it targets one of your allies with an attack or damaging effect, it must repeat the saving throw. On a failure, it loses that attack or damaging effect. On a success, it acts normally and the Charmed condition ends. The effect ends early for a target if you damage it. A creature that succeeds on its initial saving throw is immune to your Beauty Beyond Form for 24 hours. ### Cultivation Insights Beauty Insights deepen control over attention, poise, and the ethical limits of influence. They do not create romance, erase consent, or override the PG and Consent Boundary. #### Courtly Presentation Prerequisite: Beauty sphere, CL 4+ Gain proficiency in one of Performance, Persuasion, Insight, or Deception. If you already have proficiency in the chosen skill, gain Expertise with that skill for checks involving etiquette, presentation, reputation, sincere confession, formal challenge, or public poise. This Insight does not make a hostile creature friendly by itself. #### Poise-Tempered Presence Prerequisite: Beauty sphere, CL 4+ Once per short rest, when you succeed on a saving throw against being Charmed, Frightened, humiliated, magically compelled to lose face, or forced to kneel, bow, grovel, or flee, you may place one Beauty Mark on the source if the source is within 60 feet and can perceive you. This mark lasts until the end of your next turn. #### Unbroken Grace Prerequisite: Beauty sphere, CL 6+ When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Beauty talents, you may keep one existing Beauty Mark on that creature until the end of your next turn instead of losing it. Use this Insight once per round. #### Blade-Hesitation Adept Prerequisite: Beauty sphere, Turn the Blade Aside or another Beauty reaction talent, CL 8+ When a creature with your Beauty Mark misses you with an attack after one of your Beauty talents imposed Disadvantage, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature. This movement must preserve visible spatial causality; it is poise, footwork, or hesitation, not teleportation. #### Face Without Falsehood Prerequisite: Beauty sphere, CL 8+ When you reveal a painful truth, keep a vow, confess a real identity, accept blame, or refuse to beautify a lie, gain Advantage on the next Beauty check or Beauty saving throw DC contest you make before the end of the scene. Once this benefit is used, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest. #### Beauty-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Beauty sphere, Formations, Talismans, Ink, Music, or Sect Stewardship sphere, CL 10+ You may use presentation, costume, ritual posture, music, fragrance, calligraphy, rank tokens, banners, or ceremonial arrangement as supporting components for a noncombat project. This can support a Formation, sect ceremony, oath scene, morale rite, diplomatic entrance, memorial, or performance. It does not create the project automatically and never bypasses consent, cost, time, or GM approval. ## Beauty Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures Beauty is especially suited to variant scriptures because every lineage defines beauty differently. ### Veiled Face Scripture You must keep your true face, true aura, or true spiritual appearance veiled. Drawback: If your veil, mask, glamour, hood, or concealment is removed without your consent, your Beauty talents cost +1 CP until you complete a short rest and restore your presentation. Benefit: You gain one additional Mortal Beauty talent. If you do not meet its prerequisites, you gain it when you do. ### Terrible Beauty Scripture Your Beauty is frightening, alien, predatory, corpse-like, demonic, or too perfect. Drawback: When you fail a Charisma check with a nonhostile creature by 5 or more, the creature becomes uneasy, frightened, offended, or suspicious at the GM's discretion. Benefit: When a hostile creature fails a saving throw against your Catch the Eye, you may choose for it to be Frightened of you until the end of your next turn instead of Captivated. Once a creature is affected this way, it is immune to this benefit for 24 hours. ### Fading Lotus Scripture Your Beauty burns through vitality, youth, memory, or emotional warmth. Drawback: Whenever you spend 3 or more CP on Beauty talents in a single scene, you gain one Fading mark. Each Fading mark gives you a -1 penalty to the next Charisma check you make outside combat. All Fading marks clear when you finish a long rest or complete a meaningful restoration scene. Benefit: Once per long rest, when a creature succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Beauty talents, you may force it to reroll. You must use the new result. ### Unpainted Truth Scripture Your Beauty fails when you lie about who you are. Drawback: You cannot benefit from Beauty talents while actively maintaining a false identity, false vow, or false emotional presentation, unless the falsehood is openly part of a performance everyone understands as performance. Benefit: Once per long rest, when you use Beauty to tell a painful truth, confess, reveal your identity, or expose hypocrisy, choose one: add 1d4 to one related social check, or before one target rolls a saving throw against the Beauty talent involved in that truthful revelation, increase your Cultivation Save DC against that saving throw by 2.

- The target gains Advantage on the next Charisma (Performance), Charisma (Persuasion), Dexterity (Acrobatics), or Wisdom (Insight) check made before the effect ends, if the check depends on grace, poise, first impressions, etiquette, dance, beauty, or emotional presentation. A creature can benefit from this option only once per scene.
- The target becomes visually memorable. Creatures that see it during the duration have Advantage on checks to remember or identify it later.
- The target's aura becomes soft, graceful, haunting, radiant, refined, tragic, elegant, or terrible. This has no direct combat effect, but it may make certain social approaches possible.
A creature can benefit from only one use of Adorn the Moment at a time.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Berserker Qi Expression: Primary — Battle Qi; Supporting — Blood Qi, Yang Qi, Thunder Qi. Sphere Type: Martial / Body-Commitment Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening only through explicit Path synergy, inheritance, or GM-approved scripture Resource: Martial Focus, Stamina for Body Refining expressions, and CP only when a talent or Path expression says so Core Chassis: Adrenaline, Batter, Battered state, Exertion talents Berserker cultivates committed force. Its basic loop is to accept risk through Adrenaline, land a Batter attack, and exploit the target’s physically disrupted Battered state with one Exertion talent. ### Rules Baseline This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Concentration, Cover, difficult terrain, Hide, Invisible, Bloodied, Exhaustion, and Damage Threshold unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### Barriers, Domains, and Formation Anchors A Barrier is a temporary supernatural barrier, including a Protection-sphere Barrier or another effect that explicitly identifies itself as a Barrier. A Domain is a high-rank cultivation effect that says it is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove a Domain unless the technique explicitly says otherwise. A Formation Anchor is an anchor point explicitly created by a Formation or identified by the GM as part of a Formation project. These spheres do not create Formation Anchors automatically. ### Core Berserker Rules #### Special Attacks When a talent says it is a Special Attack, replace one attack when you take the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different Action Type. #### Multiple Listed Costs When a talent lists multiple possible costs, pay exactly one legal cost unless the talent explicitly says otherwise. Spend CP when using Qi or Resonance to fuel the technique. Spend Stamina only when a Body Refining feature permits that expression. Expend Martial Focus only when the talent lists that option. #### Martial Focus Berserker uses Martial Focus. Unless a broader martial-sphere rule later replaces this wording: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is absent. #### Adrenaline At the start of your turn, choose whether to enter Adrenaline until the start of your next turn. While Adrenaline is active: take a -2 AC penalty; gain the benefit of one Adrenaline talent you know. You may choose a different Adrenaline talent each time you activate Adrenaline. Unless a talent says otherwise, activate only one Adrenaline talent at a time. #### Batter A Batter is a Special Attack made with: a melee weapon; an unarmed strike; a natural weapon; a thrown weapon. On a hit that deals damage, the target becomes Battered until the end of your next turn. A Battered creature has no automatic penalty by itself. Exertion talents exploit the opening created by Batter. #### Exertion Some talents have the Exertion tag. When making a Batter attack, apply one Exertion talent you know. Unless a talent says otherwise: choose the Exertion before rolling the attack; apply the Exertion only if the Batter deals damage; apply only one Exertion to one Batter attack; Exertion effects with a one-round duration end at the start of your next turn. ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Adrenaline When you learn Berserker, gain Adrenaline and choose one Mortal Realm Adrenaline talent for which you meet the prerequisites. #### Batter When you learn Berserker, gain Batter. ### Berserker Talent Tags #### Adrenaline Talents An Adrenaline talent modifies the benefit gained while accepting the Adrenaline AC penalty. #### Exertion Talents An Exertion talent modifies one Batter attack. #### Focus Talents A Focus talent recovers, spends, or modifies Martial Focus. #### Ruin Talents A Ruin talent damages terrain, structures, barriers, or ongoing cultivation effects. #### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents martial commitment beyond ordinary physical limits. #### Unique Berserker Talents A Unique Berserker Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another category. ### MORTAL REALM BERSERKER TALENTS #### Berserk - Adrenaline While active, reduce all damage you take by: Proficiency Bonus Apply this reduction before Resistance. #### Dreadnought - Adrenaline While active, gain Advantage on checks and saving throws made to resist or end: Grappled; Paralyzed; Petrified; Prone; Restrained; Stunned. #### Juggernaut - Adrenaline While active: ignore difficult terrain; your Speed cannot be reduced below its normal value by ordinary effects; effects that reduce Speed to 0 still function if they explicitly immobilize, Grapple, Restrain, or seal movement. #### Marauder - Adrenaline While active, increase land Speed: | Cultivation Level | Speed Increase | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | +5 feet | | 5-10 | +10 feet | | 11-16 | +15 feet | | 17-20 | +20 feet | #### Bell-Ringer - Exertion When Batter deals damage, the target has Disadvantage until the start of your next turn on: Intelligence saving throws; Intelligence checks; Concentration saving throws, including one caused by the Batter attack. #### Bone-Breaker - Exertion When Batter deals damage, subtract: 1d4 from attack rolls made by the target until the start of your next turn. #### Leg-Smasher - Exertion When Batter deals damage, reduce the target’s Speeds by half, minimum 5 feet, until the start of your next turn. If the target was already Battered before the attack, it makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Fall Prone. Successful Save: Remain standing. #### Shatter Earth - Exertion, Ruin Instead of attacking a creature, Batter the ground and expend Martial Focus. The ground must be stone or softer material. Choose one area: spaces within 5 feet; 10-foot cone; 15-foot line. The area becomes difficult terrain. Creatures standing inside make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which. Failed Save: Fall Prone. Successful Save: Remain standing. Clear one 5-foot square as an Action or through an appropriate repair effect. #### Brutal Strike When making Batter, take: -5 to the attack roll. Hit: Deal: +10 damage #### Deathless Gain: Advantage on death saving throws; when determining death from massive damage, treat maximum HP as three times its actual value; if Stable at 0 HP, regain 1 HP after 1d4 minutes instead of 1d4 hours. #### Great Destroyer - Ruin While holding Martial Focus: deal double damage with melee weapon attacks against objects; gain Advantage on checks made to break objects. #### Savage - Focus When you reduce an eligible creature to 0 HP with a melee or thrown weapon attack, use a Bonus Action to regain Martial Focus. The creature must have CR at least half your CL, rounded down, minimum CR 1/2. #### Sanguine Invigoration When you reduce an eligible creature to 0 HP with a melee or thrown weapon attack, gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn equal to: Cultivation Level The creature must have CR at least half your CL, rounded down, minimum CR 1/2. ### FOUNDATION REALM BERSERKER TALENTS #### Executioner - Adrenaline, Focus Prerequisite: CL 5+ While Adrenaline is active, expend Martial Focus to reroll one missed weapon attack. Use the new result. #### Heavy Swing - Exertion Prerequisite: CL 5+ When Batter deals damage, the target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: cannot take Bonus Actions; cannot take Reactions; until the start of your next turn. If the target was already Battered before the attack, it is also Stunned until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No additional effect. #### Reaper’s Momentum - Exertion Prerequisite: CL 5+ Take: -5 to the Batter attack roll. Hit: Make another weapon attack with -5 against a different creature within reach. Continue making attacks while: each previous attack hits; each target is different; each target is within reach; you have not already attacked that creature during this Reaper’s Momentum chain. Only the original Batter attack applies its Exertion. #### Advancing Carnage Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you score a critical hit with a melee weapon or reduce a creature to 0 HP with a melee weapon, make one melee attack as a Bonus Action. #### Bloody Counter Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature targets you with a melee attack before rolling Allow the attack to hit automatically. The attack is still rolled to determine whether it critically hits. After damage is determined, make one melee attack against the creature. You may apply one Exertion talent to this counterattack. If the attacker was already Battered, resolve your counterattack before the triggering attack. #### Extended Exertion - Focus Prerequisite: CL 5+ Apply two Exertion talents to one Batter attack by: spending a Bonus Action; or expending Martial Focus. #### Beat Down Prerequisite: CL 5+ Battered lasts until the end of your second turn after Batter lands. Your Exertion effects that normally last until the start of your next turn instead last until the start of your second turn after the attack. #### Ruinous Tread - Ruin Prerequisite: Shatter Earth, CL 5+ When leaving a space through ordinary movement, choose to break that ground. The space becomes difficult terrain until cleared as an Action or repaired appropriately. Ruinous Tread normally affects: stone; packed earth; wood; softer surfaces. It does not automatically destroy: metal floors; Formation cores; artifacts; Realm-defining terrain. #### Cultivation Sunder - Exertion, Ruin Prerequisite: CL 5+ When Batter deals damage, attempt to break one ongoing supernatural effect affecting: the target; an area you struck; a Barrier you struck. Choose one effect you can perceive. If you cannot identify an effect, target the weakest eligible effect. Compare Batter damage to: 10 + effect rank For ordinary fifth-edition spells, use spell level as effect rank. For an effect without a listed rank, the GM assigns a rank from 0 to 9 using the closest spell-level equivalent. Damage Meets DC: Suppress the effect for rounds equal to your Proficiency Bonus.Damage Exceeds DC by 5+: Dispel the effect. Cultivation Sunder does not automatically dispel: Domains; Secret Inheritances; artifacts; Formation cores; Realm-defining transformations. Those require a contested Cultivation Check or a specific rule. #### Atavism - Adrenaline, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 7+ While active, when a supernatural effect cares about creature type, choose to count as: your normal creature type; or Beast. Use whichever is more favorable. Atavism does not grant: beast anatomy; Beast-sphere talents; transformation; senses; natural weapons; Beast Nature. #### Alter Terrain - Ruin Prerequisite: Shatter Earth, CL 7+ When using Shatter Earth: create a hole 5 feet deep in affected ground squares; optionally raise ground adjacent to the affected area by 5 feet. Alter Terrain reshapes ordinary ground through force. It does not create controlled Earth-sphere structures. ### CORE FORMATION REALM BERSERKER TALENTS #### Meridian-Rending Blow Prerequisite: CL 10+ Trigger: You score a critical hit with a melee weapon Cost: Expend Martial Focus Choose one recognizable limb, wing, tail, or similar anatomical structure. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The chosen structure becomes disabled until the target completes a short or long rest or receives sufficient restorative healing. Examples: | Targeted Structure | Effect | | --- | --- | | Arm | Disadvantage on attacks made with that arm; cannot effectively use two-handed weapons | | Leg | Speed reduced by 10 feet; Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws | | Wing | Lose ordinary flight dependent on that wing | | Tail or similar appendage | Lose attacks or movement features primarily dependent on it | Creatures without recognizable anatomy are immune. ##### Optional Severe Injury Module At tables using lasting-injury rules, the GM may allow Meridian-Rending Blow to sever or permanently destroy the chosen structure on a failed save. Literal dismemberment is not the default player-facing rule. #### Rift Strike - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Gain 1 level of the Exhaustion condition Roar and strike with enough force to tear open a temporary rift. This Action provokes opportunity attacks. Transport: yourself; carried equipment; willing creatures in contact with you; one willing Medium-or-smaller creature per 3 CL. Large creatures count as two Medium creatures, Huge creatures count as two Large creatures, and so on. Maximum distance: 100 miles x Cultivation Level You need a clear idea of the destination’s location and layout. If you have not visited the destination, arrive: 1d20 miles from the intended point. If your current Exhaustion exceeds 1, roll a d2. 1: Rift Strike fails, but Exhaustion still increases.2: Rift Strike succeeds. Rift Strike is supernatural martial rupture. It does not grant general Space-sphere control. #### Heaven-Shaking Batter - Exertion, Ruin Prerequisite: CL 10+ When Batter deals damage, choose one: push the target 15 feet; knock the target Prone; deal additional Force damage equal to 2d8; damage one unattended object or Barrier adjacent to the target for the same Batter damage; create a 10-foot-radius patch of difficult terrain centered on the target. If the target was already Battered, choose two different effects instead of one. #### Unyielding Advance - Adrenaline Prerequisite: CL 10+ While active: cannot be moved unwillingly unless the source succeeds on a Strength check against your Berserker Save DC; when a hostile creature enters your reach, move 5 feet toward it without provoking opportunity attacks; when you take damage, gain Advantage on your next Strength (Athletics) check before the start of your next turn. #### Court of the Unbroken Warpath - Martial Domain “The battlefield did not become smaller. The warrior simply stopped recognizing obstacles as reasons to stop.” Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest For the duration: activate one Adrenaline talent without taking the normal -2 AC penalty; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain; gain Resistance to forced movement; deal double damage to unattended objects and temporary Barriers; after reducing a creature to 0 HP or critically hitting, move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks; once per turn when Batter hits a Battered target, regain Martial Focus. Court of the Unbroken Warpath ends early if you become Incapacitated. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM BERSERKER TALENTS #### War-God Incarnation Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign engine of battle. For the duration: gain Resistance to all damage except Psychic; activate two Adrenaline talents at once; ignore the AC penalty from one active Adrenaline talent; increase reach by 5 feet; Batter damage gains +2d10; when Batter hits, the target counts as already Battered for that attack’s Exertion; once per turn after taking damage, move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks; when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, regain Martial Focus. #### World-Breaking Rampage Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 60-foot line, 15 feet wide Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Charge through the area. Creatures inside make Strength or Dexterity saving throws, choosing which. Failed Save: Take: 10d10 Bludgeoning, Slashing, or Force damage and fall Prone. Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing. You move to any legal unoccupied space at the far end of the line. Ordinary terrain in the line becomes difficult terrain. Unattended objects and temporary Barriers take double damage. World-Breaking Rampage does not automatically destroy: artifacts; Formation cores; Domains; Realm-defining structures. #### Heaven-Crushing Exertion Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Make one Batter attack. Before rolling, choose three Exertion talents you know. Apply all three on a hit. If the target was already Battered, add: 6d10 Force damage Heaven-Crushing Exertion cannot be combined with Extended Exertion. ### SECRET BERSERKER INHERITANCE #### The Blow Heaven Refused to Receive “The cultivator did not strike harder than Heaven. The cultivator struck after Heaven understood that it could not step aside.” Classification: Secret Berserker Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Heaven-Crushing Exertion, hidden war-god scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Reach or thrown-weapon range Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Make one Batter attack. Before rolling: gain Advantage; ignore Disadvantage; choose up to four Exertion talents you know; treat the target as already Battered; ignore Resistance to the attack’s damage; ignore ordinary object Damage Thresholds. Hit: Add: 12d10 Force damage The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It is Stunned until the end of your next turn and pushed up to 30 feet. Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. If the attack strikes an object, structure, or temporary Barrier, deal double total damage. The Blow Heaven Refused to Receive does not automatically destroy: artifacts; Formation cores; Domains; Secret Inheritances; Realm-defining structures. Those may still be meaningfully damaged or contested according to the GM. ### OPTIONAL BERSERKER VARIANTS A Berserker variant changes what the practitioner believes commitment requires. These variants are mutually exclusive unless a talent says otherwise. #### Calmness “The hand is not weaker because the heart is quiet.” You do not gain Adrenaline. You do not gain the initial bonus Adrenaline talent. ##### Benefit Gain Extended Exertion as a bonus talent, ignoring its Realm prerequisite. Calmness creates a disciplined crusher who specializes in layered Batter effects rather than exposed aggression. #### Unbattered “I do not need to weaken the enemy twice.” You cannot use Batter. You cannot learn Exertion talents. ##### Benefit Gain Sanguine Invigoration as a bonus talent. When you reduce an eligible creature to 0 HP with a melee or thrown weapon attack, also regain Martial Focus. Unbattered creates a momentum fighter focused on finishing blows rather than staged disruption. #### Pain-Forged Body “Pain is not proof of failure. Pain is information delivered without courtesy.” You cannot activate Adrenaline unless you have taken damage since the end of your last turn or are below half maximum HP. ##### Benefits gain Berserk or Dreadnought as a bonus Adrenaline talent; when activating Adrenaline while Bloodied, reduce its AC penalty to -1; once per round when you take damage while Adrenaline is active, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Body Refining - Unbreakable Frame Use Constitution as your Berserker key ability. When Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0: regain Martial Focus if absent; gain Advantage on your next Batter attack before the end of your next turn. While Adrenaline is active, reduce forced movement affecting you by: 5 feet At CL 10+, reduce it by: 10 feet #### Qi Cultivation - Impact-Meridian Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Berserker key ability. Once per turn when Batter deals damage: move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks; or reduce the CP cost of one Berserker Forged Technique before the end of your next turn by 1, minimum 1. When using Cultivation Sunder, add your Proficiency Bonus to Batter damage only for determining whether the effect is suppressed or dispelled. #### Spirit Awakening - Battle-Intent Resonance Use Wisdom as your Berserker key ability. When one creature within 30 feet becomes Battered, learn one: whether it intends to retreat; whether it intends to attack you; whether it is frightened; whether it is protecting another creature. This reads immediate battle intent, not private thoughts. Once per round when a Battered creature fails a saving throw against one of your Exertion talents, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Tempered Rage Prerequisite: Berserker sphere, CL 4+ When activating Adrenaline, choose one: reduce the AC penalty to -1 until the start of your next turn; increase the Save DC of one Exertion talent by +1 until the start of your next turn. Use Tempered Rage once per short rest. #### Earthbreaker Adept Prerequisite: Berserker sphere, Shatter Earth, CL 6+ When using Shatter Earth: increase one area dimension by 5 feet; ignore ordinary difficult terrain created by your own Ruin talents; add your Proficiency Bonus to checks made to destroy doors, walls, and mundane structures. #### Bloody Counter Adept Prerequisite: Berserker sphere, Bloody Counter, CL 8+ When using Bloody Counter: reduce triggering damage by your Proficiency Bonus; your counterattack has Advantage if the attacker was already Battered; after resolving the counterattack, move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature. #### Sunder-Script Adept Prerequisite: Berserker sphere, Cultivation Sunder, CL 8+ Gain Advantage on checks made to recognize: temporary Barriers; ongoing supernatural effects; Formation anchors; weak points in constructed defenses. Once per short rest, when Cultivation Sunder suppresses an effect, treat the result as though Batter damage exceeded the DC by 5. #### Warpath-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Berserker sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation or martial training project, use one Adrenaline, Exertion, or Ruin principle you know as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. Normal project requirements still apply.

### Set the Workpiece
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch or reach
Target: One legal workpiece
Duration: 1 minute or current crafting scene
Cost: None
Choose one legal workpiece as your current workpiece.
Until the effect ends:
you can place Forge Marks on that workpiece;
you can spend Forge Marks from that workpiece;
you have Advantage on checks made to repair, adjust, fit, or identify that workpiece;
you cannot have more than one current workpiece unless a talent says otherwise.
If you choose a new current workpiece, the old one stops being current but keeps any Forge Marks already on it until those marks expire.
