spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Daemonic Cultivation Qi Expression: Primary — Devouring Qi; Supporting — Corrupt Qi, Blood Qi, Death Qi, Stolen-Origin Qi. Sphere Type: Forbidden Secret Restricted Power Sphere Primary Path: Any Path may be tempted, but no Path treats it as ordinary open cultivation Resource: CP of the user's Path; some techniques may also spend Hit Dice, Stamina, Temporary HP, captured essence, sacrificed treasure, accepted Corruption, or other explicit costs Core Chassis: Devouring, stolen growth, corruption hooks, mutation pressure, temptation power, forbidden domains Design Note: This sphere is intentionally stronger and more dangerous than ordinary spheres. Preserve its narrative costs, stigma, and consequences. “Every path asks what you are willing to refine. The daemonic path asks what you are willing to become after the refining is done.” Sphere Type: Forbidden Secret Restricted Power Sphere Power Tier: Apex Temptation Sphere. This sphere is intentionally stronger and more flexible than an ordinary sphere, but it stains the cultivator’s foundation, attracts sect suppression, and gives the GM durable narrative hooks. Primary Path: Any Path may be tempted by Daemonic Cultivation, but each expresses it differently. Common Entry: A forbidden scripture, demon seed, blood altar, heart-devil bargain, sealed fiend inheritance, abyssal relic, devoured monster core, ruined heavenly tribulation, or desperate breakthrough. Resources: CP of the user’s Path. Some techniques may also spend Hit Dice, Stamina, Temporary HP, captured essence, sacrificed treasure, or accepted Corruption. Common Effects: Massive power amplification, devouring, stolen talent, mutation, terror, possession pressure, corruption, forbidden regeneration, technique twisting, demonic domains, predatory pressure, and temporary breach of ordinary limits. ### Core Warning Daemonic Cultivation is not a normal combat style. It is the most tempting sphere because it offers what cultivators always want: power now; recovery when empty; talent without years of discipline; breakthrough pressure; survival after lethal mistakes; the ability to eat enemies, inherit fragments, and force one more step when Heaven says the body is finished. It is forbidden because the price is not merely social reputation. The scripture changes appetite, destiny, meridians, vows, and the shape of the soul. This sphere should feel strong enough that a desperate cultivator understands why sect elders hide it, why villains seek it, and why righteous prodigies are tempted by it. ### Daemonic Dao Daemonic Cultivation is the cultivation of hunger that learns doctrine. A beast hungers without principle. A cultivator refines desire into method. A daemonic cultivator takes the step after that: they make hunger itself the furnace. The daemonic path teaches that all things may be consumed: blood; fear; resentment; vows; pain; spiritual pressure; monster cores; failed techniques; stolen inheritances; karmic debt; even the cultivator’s own future. A proper daemonic cultivator does not merely rage or kill. They refine the world into advantage. They make every wound a contract, every enemy a pill furnace, every fear a banner, every sin a stepping stone. The central question of Daemonic Cultivation is: What will you feed the demon, and when it grows, who will be holding the leash? ### The Daemonic Difference Daemonic Cultivation is distinct from ordinary evil, ordinary monsters, and ordinary forbidden blood arts. Blood consumes life-fluid. Death commands ghosts, corpses, and endings. Fate alters the ledger of consequence. Puppetry controls bodies through strings, seals, or souls. Beastmastery bonds and commands living beasts. Berserker accepts opening and fury. Void rejects existence and form. Daemonic Cultivation does something more dangerous: It refines an inner predator into a second cultivation engine. A daemonic cultivator can appear as: a righteous hero with a sealed heart-devil; a sect criminal whose dantian contains a demon seed; a monster who learned scripture; an immortal heir carrying an abyssal inheritance; a desperate Body Refiner who turned wounds into furnace-mouths; a Qi cultivator whose techniques bite back; a Spirit cultivator whose soul contains a throne, prison, and hungry court. ### Sphere Boundaries Daemonic Cultivation may amplify, twist, steal, or corrupt many methods, but it does not replace every sphere. It does not replace Blood. Blood governs blood control, blood vitality, bloodline pressure, and crimson bodies. Daemonic Cultivation may drink blood as fuel, but blood technique precision belongs to Blood. It does not replace Death. Death governs ghosts, corpses, necromancy, and endings. Daemonic Cultivation may devour ghosts or bind a demon shadow, but commanding the dead belongs to Death. It does not replace Fate. Fate governs destiny, ledger, names, vows, and Heaven’s written consequence. Daemonic Cultivation may cheat fate through hunger, but true ledger correction belongs to Fate. It does not replace Puppetry. Puppetry governs control strings, puppet bodies, soul-puppet arrangements, and remote control. Daemonic Cultivation may dominate a weakened enemy for a moment, but precise puppet doctrine belongs to Puppetry. It does not replace Alchemy. Alchemy refines pills, elixirs, formulae, cauldrons, and medicine. Daemonic Cultivation devours, mutates, and forces refining through the self. It does not replace Beastmastery. Beastmastery bonds with beasts. Daemonic Cultivation may tame or absorb demonic beasts, but stable companion doctrine belongs to Beastmastery. It does not replace Berserker. Berserker channels reckless momentum. Daemonic Cultivation is predatory appetite, corruption, and forbidden second-engine power. It does not replace Void. Void unmakes, negates, and rejects. Daemonic Cultivation consumes and transforms. ### Why This Sphere Is Forbidden Daemonic Cultivation is forbidden for four reasons. First, it creates rapid power growth from morally and spiritually dangerous sources. Second, it gives cultivators ways to recover or exceed ordinary limits by feeding on enemies, fear, pain, vows, or corruption. Third, it invites possession, mutation, inner demon growth, sect contamination, and tribulation distortion. Fourth, it can parasitize other spheres. A daemonic cultivator may twist a sword strike, seal, fire art, thread line, pill, or spear thrust into a hungry technique without fully respecting that sphere’s Dao. A GM should let the sphere be powerful. The cost is not that the techniques are weak. The cost is that every use matters. ### Core Daemonic Rules #### Daemonic Key Ability Use the key ability of your Path unless a Path synergy or variant says otherwise. Body Refining usually uses Constitution. Qi Cultivation usually uses Intelligence or Charisma. Spirit Awakening usually uses Wisdom. #### Daemonic Save DC Daemonic Save DC equals: 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Daemonic key ability modifier. #### Daemonic Attack Modifier Daemonic Cultivation Attack equals: Proficiency Bonus + Daemonic key ability modifier. #### Daemonic Techniques Are Supernatural Daemonic techniques are supernatural cultivation effects. Unless a talent says otherwise, they count as magical for overcoming ordinary Resistance and for interactions with anti-magic, suppression, consecrated wards, exorcism, heavenly seals, and similar effects. #### Cultivation Expression Many Daemonic talents describe possible manifestations such as claws, smoke, blood mist, black thread, corpse incense, furnace breath, needles, shadow marks, beast pupils, horn-shadow, or demonic script. These are cultivation expressions unless a feature says otherwise. Cultivation expression does not change the rules of a talent. It does not change damage type, Action Type, range, target, area, saving throw, duration, condition, cost, prerequisites, or sphere interaction unless the talent explicitly says it does. When a talent says it works through a visible daemonic thread, claw, needle, smoke, mark, or similar vector, that vector is the visible channel of the technique. It must be perceptible enough to provide counterplay and must still obey the talent’s range, line of effect, and cover limits. A player may describe the vector in the style of their scripture, but expression alone cannot bypass Total Cover, concealment, wards, sealed barriers, or anti-daemonic protection. The rule is simple: expression is flexible; mechanics are fixed. #### Demon Seed, Demon Core, and True Demon Transformation A Demon Seed is not a Demon Core. It does not make the cultivator a demon, change the cultivator’s creature type, or automatically replace their cultivation base. A Demon Seed is the first forbidden method-root: a knot of hunger, resentment, survival instinct, stolen law, demonic qi, heart-devil pressure, or abyssal inheritance planted inside the body, dantian, meridians, or soul. It lets the cultivator use Daemonic talents, gain and spend Devoured Essence, Overdraw, and accumulate Corruption. A Demon Core is a later threshold. It may form through severe cultivation deviation, a deliberate dark ritual, possession, devouring a demonic core, surviving core-shattering, accepting a heart-devil bargain, or forcing a breakthrough when the orthodox foundation should have collapsed. A Demon Core is not gained merely by learning this sphere unless a talent, variant, Secret Inheritance, or GM event says so. True demon transformation is a still greater state. It belongs to Nascent Soul, Secret, Immortal, catastrophic deviation, or campaign-defining choices. Daemonic Cultivation tempts the cultivator toward that state; it does not force it at the first step. #### Corruption Corruption is the sphere’s main pressure mechanic. You gain Corruption when a Daemonic talent says so, when you fail certain backlash checks, or when you willingly overdraw power. Track Corruption as a number from 0 to 10. Corruption is not ordinary exhaustion, poison, disease, or madness. It is contamination of appetite, meridians, soul, and karmic scent. #### Corruption Thresholds At Corruption 0 to 2, the demon is hungry but mostly obedient. At Corruption 3 to 5, the demon leaves visible signs. Examples include black veins, horn-shadow, predatory aura, smoke breath, voice echo, beast-pupil eyes, claw-like nails, or cold spiritual pressure. You suffer Disadvantage on checks to conceal daemonic cultivation from trained observers unless you use a specific concealment feature. At Corruption 6 to 8, the demon bargains. After each Long Rest, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. On a failure, choose one: lose 1 Hit Die until your next Long Rest, gain no benefit from the first non-daemonic healing effect you receive that day, or allow the GM to introduce a minor demonic impulse, omen, or social complication. At Corruption 9 to 10, the demon strains the leash. When combat begins, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. On a failure, until the end of your first turn, you cannot choose the Dodge, Disengage, or Help action unless doing so directly enables you to feed, strike, corrupt, or protect a claimed possession. Corruption should pressure play. It should not remove the character from the player as a routine punishment. #### Reducing Corruption Reduce Corruption through cultivation discipline, confession, sealing, exorcism, purifying pills, heavenly tribulation, sect punishment, or rejecting daemonic opportunities. Default options: After a Long Rest spent in safe meditation, reduce Corruption by 1 if you did not use any Daemonic talents since your last Long Rest. During a full cultivation session, you may attempt a Wisdom or Constitution check against DC 15 + current Corruption. On success, reduce Corruption by 1. A major purification ritual, sect elder intervention, heavenly lightning trial, or rare pill may reduce more at GM discretion. #### Overdraw Some Daemonic talents allow Overdraw. When you Overdraw, gain 1 Corruption to reduce the CP or Stamina cost of one Daemonic talent by an amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus, minimum cost 0. After Overdrawing, you cannot Overdraw again until the start of your next turn. Overdraw is why the sphere is tempting. A cultivator who should be empty may still act. #### Devoured Essence Some talents create Devoured Essence. Devoured Essence represents swallowed vitality, fear, resentment, technique-fragments, monster core heat, soul pressure, or demonic qi. Unless a talent says otherwise: you may hold Devoured Essence up to your Proficiency Bonus; Devoured Essence lasts until the end of your next Short Rest or Long Rest; you may spend Devoured Essence only on Daemonic talents; you lose all Devoured Essence if reduced to 0 HP. #### Daemonic Detection A creature trained in Spirit, Fate, Protection, Life, or Daemonic Cultivation may sense daemonic pressure with a successful Wisdom (Insight), Intelligence (Arcana), or relevant Cultivation Check against your Daemonic Save DC. You may conceal obvious signs with mundane disguise, sealed clothing, talismans, incense, meditation, or a concealment talent. Consecrated sites, heavenly arrays, and sect gates may impose Disadvantage on concealment. #### Daemonic Cultivation and Alignment This sphere does not require a moral alignment label. A character may use it for survival, vengeance, antiheroic burden, sect duty, or villainy. However, the technique itself is predatory and corruptive. Good intentions do not erase Corruption. ### Base Sphere Abilities When you learn Daemonic Cultivation, gain Demon Seed, Devour Essence, and Daemonic Augment. #### Demon Seed Classification: Forbidden Daemonic Root Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina Plant or awaken a Demon Seed in your body, dantian, meridians, or soul. The Seed is a forbidden method-root, not a Demon Core. It does not make you a demon; it opens the second furnace through which the daemonic scripture can breathe. While Demon Seed is active: your Daemonic talents may be used; you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Daemonic key ability modifier; once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack, add 1d4 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage; you have Advantage on saving throws against Frightened; you have Disadvantage on checks made to appear spiritually pure unless you suppress all visible signs. At CL 5, the extra damage becomes 1d6. At CL 11, the extra damage becomes 1d8. At CL 17, the extra damage becomes 1d10. When Demon Seed ends, if you used Overdraw during its duration, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. On a failure, gain 1 additional Corruption. #### Devour Essence Classification: Forbidden Daemonic Technique Action Type: Multi-Mode Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode Factory Combat Bucket: split_required Split Candidate Buckets: bonus_action, reaction Timing Detail: Bonus Action or Reaction Factory Routing: split_modes_before_character_action_programming Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets Recommended Factory Realization: modes=BONUS_ACTION_DEVOUR->bonus_action, REACTION_DEVOUR->reaction Range: 30 feet Cost: None Use Devour Essence when one of the following happens within range: a hostile creature is reduced to 0 HP; a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Daemonic talents; you score a Critical Hit; a creature bearing your demonic mark takes damage; an ongoing summoned, possessed, spirit, fiendish, undead, or demonic effect ends. Gain 1 Devoured Essence. You can use Devour Essence once per round. If the triggering creature is at least your Realm or has a CR/level equal to at least half your CL, you may instead gain 2 Devoured Essence, but you also gain 1 Corruption. #### Daemonic Augment Classification: Forbidden Amplification Action Type: Special Trigger Canonical Action Type: Special Trigger Factory Combat Bucket: passive Timing Detail: No Action, once per turn Factory Routing: triggered_passive_modifier_row Cost: 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or 1 Devoured Essence Trigger: You use a sphere talent, weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack that deals damage, imposes a condition, moves a creature, creates a zone, or forces a saving throw. Twist the technique with daemonic hunger. Choose one: add Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll; impose Disadvantage on one Concentration saving throw caused by the triggering effect; if the triggering effect moves a creature, increase the movement by 5 feet; if the triggering effect creates Difficult Terrain, one creature that fails a save also cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; if the triggering effect deals Necrotic, Psychic, Fire, Poison, Acid, Force, or weapon damage, ignore ordinary Resistance to one of those damage types for that instance; mark one damaged creature until the start of your next turn. The first time you damage the marked creature before the mark ends, gain 1 Devoured Essence. Daemonic Augment may modify non-Daemonic sphere talents, but only once per turn. This is one of the main reasons the sphere is forbidden. ### Daemonic Talent Tags #### Hunger Talents Hunger talents devour, heal, recover, or steal power. #### Seed Talents Seed talents modify Demon Seed, Corruption, mutation, or Overdraw. #### Tyrant Talents Tyrant talents impose fear, command, pressure, domination, or anti-retreat effects. #### Mutant Talents Mutant talents transform the body, limbs, senses, blood, bones, or aura. #### Parasite Talents Parasite talents steal, copy, twist, feed on, or interrupt other techniques. #### Domain Talents Domain talents create demonic fields, courts, thrones, or hellscapes. #### Secret Talents Secret talents are campaign-defining demonic inheritances. ### Mortal Realm Daemonic Talents #### Black-Claw Manifestation - Mutant Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: While Demon Seed is active Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina Manifest claws, fangs, horn-shadow, bone spurs, black nails, predatory hair, or another daemonic weapon. Your Unarmed Strikes may deal Slashing, Piercing, Necrotic, or Force damage. Once per turn when you hit with an Unarmed Strike or natural weapon, choose one: gain Temporary HP equal to Proficiency Bonus; move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target; reduce the target’s Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn; apply your demonic mark until the start of your next turn. #### Demon-Skin Reinforcement - Mutant, Seed Reaction Trigger: You take damage while Demon Seed is active. Cost: 1 CP, 1 Stamina, or 1 Devoured Essence Reduce the damage by 1d10 + your Daemonic key ability modifier. If you reduce the damage to 0, gain 1 Devoured Essence. You may hold only one borrowed trait at Mortal Realm. ### Foundation Realm Daemonic Talents #### Second Furnace Demon Heart - Seed Prerequisite: CL 5+ Your demon seed becomes a second furnace. While Demon Seed is active: increase your maximum Devoured Essence by Proficiency Bonus; once per turn when you spend Devoured Essence, gain Temporary HP equal to Proficiency Bonus; when you Overdraw, reduce the additional Corruption Save DC by 2; if you start your turn with 0 CP or 0 Stamina, you may gain 1 Corruption to gain 1 Devoured Essence. #### Heaven-Spiting Recovery - Hunger Prerequisite: CL 5+ Reaction Trigger: You would be reduced to 0 HP while Demon Seed is active. Gain Resistance to that damage type until the start of your next turn. At CL 11, the Resistance lasts until the end of your next turn. At CL 17, when you gain this Resistance, your next damage roll with a Daemonic talent deals additional damage of that type equal to Proficiency Bonus. #### Consume Fear, Refine Command - Tyrant Prerequisite: Dread Appetite, CL 5+ When a creature fails a saving throw against your Dread Appetite, gain 1 Devoured Essence. After the roll, gain 1 Corruption. If the check fails despite this bonus, gain 1 additional Corruption. This talent is one of the sphere’s greatest temptations. It does not create CXP by itself; it helps force a door open. #### Demon Court Retainer - Tyrant, Parasite Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP with a Daemonic talent, you may spend 2 Devoured Essence. Instead of killing it, you brand its shadow, fear, or resentment. For 1 minute, a minor demonic echo appears in an unoccupied space within 10 feet of the creature. The echo is not a full companion. Once before it vanishes, the echo may use your Bonus Action to do one: Help one attack against a creature bearing your Demon Mark; impose Disadvantage on one enemy’s Opportunity Attack; deal Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to one Frightened creature within 30 feet; carry a whispered message of up to ten words to a creature within 60 feet. Enemies you choose make a Wisdom saving throw the first time each turn they enter the aura or start their turn there. Failed Save: Choose one: Frightened until the start of their next turn; Speed reduced by 15 feet until the start of their next turn; cannot take Reactions until the start of their next turn; take Psychic or Necrotic damage equal to 2d8 + Proficiency Bonus; gain your Demon Mark until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Their Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of their next turn. When Demon Sovereign Aura ends, gain 1 Corruption if any creature was reduced to 0 HP inside the aura. #### Devour the Scripture Fragment - Parasite Prerequisite: Demonic Technique Theft, CL 10+ When you succeed with Demonic Technique Theft, you may spend 3 additional Devoured Essence and gain 1 Corruption. Choose one visible non-Secret, non-Domain, non-Inheritance talent effect used by the triggering creature. Until the end of your next turn, you may reproduce a corrupted echo of that effect once, using your Daemonic key ability and Daemonic Save DC. The echo must obey these limits: it cannot last longer than 1 round unless the GM approves; it cannot restore more HP than 2 x your CL; it cannot create permanent objects; it cannot summon permanent companions; it cannot copy Secret Inheritances, Domains, Realm transformations, or artifacts; if the effect would normally require a sphere-specific object, symbol, weapon, or medium, your daemonic aura provides a crude substitute. After using the echo, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. Failed Save: Gain 1 Corruption. #### Thousand-Mouth Devouring Art - Hunger Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: Up to Proficiency Bonus creatures you can see Cost: 7 CP or 7 Devoured Essence Black mouths, shadow wounds, hungry sutras, fang-shaped qi, or ghostly demon faces bite at selected enemies. Each target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take 6d8 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage, and you gain 1 Devoured Essence. Successful Save: Take half damage. If a target is Frightened, below half HP, or bearing your Demon Mark, it has Disadvantage on the save. Gain 1 Corruption if this talent reduces two or more creatures to 0 HP. #### Demon Bone Regeneration - Mutant, Hunger Prerequisite: CL 10+ While Demon Seed is active, at the start of your turn, you may spend 1 Devoured Essence. Regain HP equal to 1d8 + your Daemonic key ability modifier. If you are missing an eye, finger, tooth, horn, claw, or cosmetic body part, it regrows during a Short Rest or Long Rest. At CL 15, once per Long Rest, you may regrow a lost limb during a Long Rest by gaining 2 Corruption. This is daemonic regeneration, not clean Life restoration. The regrown part may carry visible demonic signs. #### Inner Demon Incarnation - Seed, Mutant Prerequisite: Second Furnace Demon Heart, CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 8 CP or 8 Devoured Essence Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Let the demon seed partially incarnate. For the duration: Demon Seed is active and does not require its normal cost; gain Fly Speed equal to walking Speed, but no Hover; gain Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic damage; your Daemonic Augment may be used twice per turn, but not on the same roll or effect; when you gain Devoured Essence, gain one additional Devoured Essence, once per round; your weapon attacks, Unarmed Strikes, and Cultivation Attacks count as magical; you emit obvious daemonic signs. When the incarnation ends, gain 1 Corruption. If you ended the incarnation with 0 Devoured Essence, gain 1 additional Corruption. #### Corrupt the Righteous Law - Parasite, Tyrant Prerequisite: CL 10+ Reaction Trigger: A creature within 60 feet regains HP, gains Temporary HP, receives a saving throw bonus, ends a condition, or becomes protected by a Barrier, ward, or defensive aura. Cost: 5 CP or 5 Devoured Essence The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: reduce healing by 2d8 + Proficiency Bonus; reduce Temporary HP gained by 2d8 + Proficiency Bonus; prevent one condition from ending until the start of your next turn; suppress one ordinary defensive bonus until the start of your next turn; mark the target with your Demon Mark until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The protective effect works normally, but you learn its general source. This talent cannot suppress Secret Inheritances, artifact protections, Domains, or Realm-defining defenses unless the GM allows a contested Cultivation Check. #### Black Sun Over the Dantian - Seed, Tyrant Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Cost: 8 CP or 8 Devoured Essence Choose one creature you can see. It makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: A black sun appears over its spiritual center until the end of your next turn. While affected: it cannot regain CP, Stamina, or other cultivation resources; it cannot benefit from temporary CP; the first time it spends CP or Stamina, it takes 4d8 Psychic or Necrotic damage; if it is concentrating, it has Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws. Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the first time it spends CP or Stamina, it takes Psychic or Necrotic damage equal to Proficiency Bonus. Black Sun Over the Dantian does not delete a cultivation base. It pressures resource flow for a short time. ### Nascent Soul Realm Daemonic Talents #### Demon Emperor Incarnation Prerequisite: Inner Demon Incarnation, CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 15 CP or 15 Devoured Essence Use Limit: Once per Long Rest You become the visible sovereign of your inner demon court. For the duration: gain Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover; gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Necrotic, Psychic, and Poison damage; gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened, Charmed, Poisoned, Grappled, Restrained, and Stunned; Daemonic Augment costs no resource once per turn; your first Daemonic talent each turn costs 2 fewer CP or Devoured Essence, minimum 0; once per turn when you reduce a creature to 0 HP, regain 3 CP or 3 Stamina; Demon Sovereign Aura is active without Concentration, using a 60-foot radius; ordinary creatures of lower Realm that start their turn inside the aura must make a Wisdom saving throw or become Frightened until the start of their next turn. When the incarnation ends, gain 2 Corruption. If Corruption would exceed 10, the excess becomes Demonic Debt. The GM may spend Demonic Debt later to introduce tribulation distortion, inner demon trials, sect investigation, possession pressure, or enemies drawn by your scent. #### World-Devouring Maw Prerequisite: Thousand-Mouth Devouring Art, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 40-foot-radius sphere Cost: 12 CP or 12 Devoured Essence Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Open a vast daemonic mouth in the world. Creatures you choose inside make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take 12d10 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage, are pulled 30 feet toward the center, and gain your Demon Mark for 1 minute. Successful Save: Take half damage and are pulled 10 feet. Objects, unattended materials, minor summoned creatures, and ordinary terrain inside may be shredded, swallowed, or ruined at GM discretion. For each creature reduced to 0 HP by World-Devouring Maw, gain 2 Devoured Essence and regain HP equal to your CL. After using this talent, gain 1 Corruption. #### Steal the Enemy’s Heaven Prerequisite: Devour the Scripture Fragment, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within 120 feet uses a non-Secret, non-artifact, non-Domain technique with a visible effect. Cost: 12 CP or 12 Devoured Essence Make a contested Cultivation Check. Success: The triggering technique still occurs, but you steal its heavenly momentum. Choose two: gain Resistance to all damage dealt by the triggering effect; one target of the triggering effect gains Advantage on its saving throw; your next Daemonic talent before the end of your next turn has Advantage on its attack roll or imposes Disadvantage on one saving throw; regain CP or Stamina equal to Proficiency Bonus; reproduce a corrupted echo of one minor part of the technique before the end of your next turn. Success by 5 or more: Choose three instead. Failure: The technique resolves normally and you gain 2 Corruption. #### Hell Opens Beneath the Sect Gate - Domain Prerequisite: Demon Sovereign Aura, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 120-foot-radius sphere centered on a point within 120 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 15 CP or 15 Devoured Essence Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Open a temporary demonic territory: black banners, bone pillars, hungry rivers, furnace pits, red moons, screaming sutras, or upside-down palaces. The area becomes Difficult Terrain for enemies. Enemies that start their turn inside make Wisdom saving throws. Failed Save: Choose one: take 8d8 Psychic, Necrotic, Fire, or Force damage; become Frightened until the start of the next turn; cannot regain HP until the start of the next turn; cannot take Reactions until the start of the next turn; lose Resistance to one damage type of your choice until the start of the next turn; gain your Demon Mark for 1 minute. Successful Save: Take damage equal to Proficiency Bonus and treat the area as Difficult Terrain until the start of the next turn. Allies you choose inside gain Temporary HP equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns and may spend 1 Hit Die when they reduce a hostile creature to 0 HP. After the Domain ends, the site remains spiritually stained unless purified. #### Ten-Thousand Demon Sutra Prerequisite: CL 15+ During a Long Rest or full cultivation session, you may study, bind, devour, or bargain with a captured technique fragment, monster core, spirit remnant, bloodline echo, or demon scripture. Choose one non-Secret talent from a sphere you have seen used or studied for at least one scene. Until your next Long Rest, you may use a corrupted imitation of that talent once. Limits: the talent cannot be a Secret Inheritance; it cannot create permanent infrastructure; it cannot create a full companion; it cannot be a Domain unless the GM explicitly permits; it uses your Daemonic key ability and Save DC; using it costs its normal cost + 2 CP or +2 Devoured Essence; after using it, gain 1 Corruption. If you learn the same talent through its proper sphere later, this imitation ends. ### Secret Daemonic Inheritance #### The Demon That Ate Its Own Name “The first demon was chained by name. The last demon escaped by devouring the word that could command it.” Classification: Secret Daemonic Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Demon Emperor Incarnation, Ten-Thousand Demon Sutra, a hidden nameless demon scripture, and a personal catastrophe caused by hunger Action Type: Special Trigger Canonical Action Type: Special Trigger Factory Combat Bucket: passive Timing Detail: No Action when you would die, be sealed, have your soul destroyed, lose your cultivation base, or fail a decisive saving throw Factory Routing: triggered_passive_modifier_row Cost: All remaining CP, all Devoured Essence, and 3 Corruption Use Limit: Once per campaign arc, or once ever unless the GM permits the demon’s return Erase one immediate defeat by feeding it to the nameless demon. Choose one: instead of dying, remain at 1 HP and immediately activate Demon Emperor Incarnation; instead of being sealed, break one ordinary seal and teleport to a visible space within 120 feet; instead of losing your cultivation base, suppress the base-scattering effect until the end of the scene; instead of failing a decisive saving throw, succeed and unleash World-Devouring Maw centered on yourself without harming chosen allies; instead of having your soul destroyed, split off a daemonic remnant that can be recovered through a future quest. Afterward: Corruption becomes 10; gain 3 Demonic Debt; every trained Fate, Spirit, Protection, Heavenly Punishment, or Daemonic cultivator of equal or higher Realm within a vast narrative distance may sense that something forbidden survived; the GM creates a permanent consequence tied to your name, shadow, reflection, or future tribulation. This inheritance should save a character in a legendary moment, not become a weekly panic button. ### Optional Daemonic Variant Scriptures A character normally chooses at most one Daemonic variant when first learning the sphere or during a major corruption event. Variants may grant power, but they also define how the demon feeds. #### Inner Demon Scripture Your demon is not an external inheritance. It is your own heart-devil refined into a weapon. Benefits: use Wisdom as your Daemonic key ability if higher; gain Advantage on checks to detect emotional weakness, shame, fear, envy, or obsession; when a creature fails a saving throw against Dread Appetite, regain HP equal to Proficiency Bonus. Restriction: when you fail a Wisdom saving throw, gain 1 Corruption unless the effect was harmless; purification cannot reduce your Corruption below 1 unless you confront the heart-devil in a major scene. #### Blood Demon Scripture Your demon feeds through blood, wounds, and crimson vitality. Benefits: when you deal damage to a Bloodied creature, gain Temporary HP equal to Proficiency Bonus once per turn; Bloodless Devouring heals +1d8 additional HP; Black-Claw Manifestation may deal Necrotic or Slashing damage. Restriction: healing that restores HP to you while no creature has been damaged by you since your last turn is reduced by Proficiency Bonus; trained Blood cultivators can recognize your corruption more easily. #### Corpse Demon Scripture Your demon feeds on death qi, corpses, ghost remnants, and burial resentment. Benefits: gain Resistance to Necrotic damage while Demon Seed is active; when a creature dies within 30 feet, you may use Devour Essence without spending your Reaction or Bonus Action, once per round; your Demon Court Retainer echo lasts 10 minutes outside combat. Restriction: consecrated ground, funeral rites, ancestor halls, and heavenly burial arrays impose Disadvantage on your Daemonic Cultivation Attacks unless you first spend 1 Devoured Essence; Life and Protection cultivators can sense your corpse qi with normal detection methods. #### Beast Demon Scripture Your demon seed is bound to a monstrous appetite. Benefits: Borrow the Monster’s Shape may hold two borrowed traits at once; gain Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) checks to track wounded creatures; when you reduce a beast, monstrosity, fiend, demon, or demonic beast to 0 HP, gain one extra Devoured Essence. Restriction: while Corruption is 6 or higher, you have Disadvantage on checks to resist obvious bait made from blood, wounded prey, or monster cores unless you spend 1 CP or 1 Stamina; social concealment becomes harder when hungry. #### Heavenly Demon Scripture You cultivate the paradox of a demon wearing Heaven’s crown. Benefits: your Daemonic talents may deal Radiant or Psychic damage instead of Necrotic when appropriate; Demon Sovereign Aura may appear as golden tyranny, false halos, burning edicts, or heavenly command; when a creature fails a save against Corrupt the Righteous Law, it also cannot benefit from Advantage on the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn. Restriction: Fate, Heavenly Punishment, and orthodox sect wards treat you as especially offensive; whenever you use Overdraw inside a consecrated or heavenly site, gain 1 additional Corruption. #### Quiet Demon Scripture Your demon survives by hiding. Benefits: visible signs of Corruption do not appear until Corruption 6; gain Advantage on one check per Short Rest to conceal daemonic signs; Demon-Shadow Step may be used from dim light, darkness, smoke, crowd cover, or behind a larger creature even if the target is not marked, frightened, or wounded. Restriction: your overt Domain talents cost 1 additional CP or Devoured Essence; if your daemonic nature is publicly revealed, gain 1 Corruption. ### Path Synergies #### Body Refining - Demon Body Furnace Use Constitution as your Daemonic key ability. You may spend Stamina for Daemonic talents. When Demon Seed is active: gain Resistance to Poison damage; your Unarmed Strikes and natural weapons count as approved Daemonic weapons; when Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, gain 1 Devoured Essence, once per round; when you Overdraw, you may take damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus instead of gaining Corruption, once per Short Rest. At Corruption 6 or higher, your body shows permanent signs unless purified. #### Qi Cultivation - Devil-Qi Engine Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Daemonic key ability. When Demon Seed is active: reduce the CP cost of your first Daemonic talent each turn by 1, minimum 1; add 10 feet to the range of ranged Daemonic talents; when you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Daemonic talent, regain 1 CP, once per round. If you end combat with more Devoured Essence than CP, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. On failure, gain 1 Corruption. #### Spirit Awakening - Soul Demon Throne Use Wisdom as your Daemonic key ability. Your Daemonic talents affect incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, ghosts, spirits, and soul-bound creatures normally when dealing Psychic, Necrotic, or Force damage. When Demon Seed is active: gain Advantage on saving throws against possession; when a creature fails a saving throw against Dread Appetite or Demon Sovereign Aura, learn whether it is afraid, bound by a vow, possessed, or spiritually wounded; you may spend 1 Devoured Essence to suppress one minor possession influence affecting yourself until the end of your next turn. If Corruption reaches 10, your inner demon may become a recurring Spirit trial. ### Cultivation Insights #### Sealed Demon Seed Prerequisite: Daemonic Cultivation, CL 1+ You bind the demon seed with chains, sutras, needles, talismans, or vows. Gain: maximum Corruption increases to 12; visible signs of Corruption appear two points later; once per Long Rest, when you would gain Corruption, reduce the amount by 1. Drawback: if the seal is broken by a major story event, immediately gain 2 Corruption. #### Devil-Qi Circulation Prerequisite: Daemonic Cultivation, CL 4+ When Demon Seed is active, choose one damage type from Necrotic, Psychic, Poison, Fire, Acid, or Force. Your Daemonic talents may use that damage type until the end of the scene. Once per Short Rest, when a creature fails a save against a Daemonic talent of that type, gain 1 Devoured Essence. #### Heart-Devil Negotiator Prerequisite: Daemonic Cultivation, Spirit Awakening or Wisdom 14+, CL 5+ When you would gain Corruption, you may bargain with the inner demon. Make a Wisdom (Insight) check against DC 12 + current Corruption. Success: Delay the Corruption until the end of the scene. Failure: Gain the Corruption immediately and the GM may create a minor temptation. You can use this Insight once per Short Rest. #### Demon-Slaying Demon Prerequisite: Daemonic Cultivation, CL 8+ You refine demons by hunting demons. When you damage a fiend, demon, possessed creature, demonic beast, inner demon manifestation, or creature using Daemonic Cultivation: add Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll, once per turn; if the creature drops to 0 HP, reduce your Corruption by 1 or gain 2 Devoured Essence. #### Orthodox Mask of the Black Scripture Prerequisite: Daemonic Cultivation, CL 8+ You have learned to hide forbidden power beneath ordinary cultivation signs. Gain Advantage on checks to conceal Daemonic Cultivation from casual observers. When entering a sect gate, consecrated site, or heavenly ward, you may spend 1 CP or 1 Devoured Essence to avoid automatic detection by ordinary wards. Powerful wards may still call for a contested check. #### Feed the Breakthrough Furnace Prerequisite: Profane Breakthrough Pressure, CL 10+ When you use Profane Breakthrough Pressure and the check succeeds, choose one: gain Temporary HP equal to your CL after the cultivation session; regain all missing CP up to half your maximum CP; reduce Corruption by 1 if the breakthrough involved defeating or purifying an inner demon; gain Advantage on your next saving throw against tribulation backlash. If the check fails, gain 2 Corruption instead of 1. #### Name-Sealing Demon Chain Prerequisite: Demon Mark, Fate or Ink sphere, CL 10+ When a creature fails its saving throw against Demon Mark, you may write, speak, brand, or stitch a partial name-chain. Until the mark ends: the creature has Disadvantage on checks to magically disguise itself from you; if it teleports within 60 feet, you know the direction of its destination but not exact distance; the first time it damages you, it takes Psychic damage equal to Proficiency Bonus. This is not full Fate name control. #### Demon Emperor’s Price Prerequisite: Demon Emperor Incarnation, CL 15+ When Demon Emperor Incarnation ends, you may reduce Corruption gained by 1. If you do, choose one price: lose one Hit Die until your next Long Rest; suffer Disadvantage on the next social check against an orthodox cultivator; the GM gains one Demonic Debt; one visible demonic sign remains until purified.

Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action

your Daemonic talents may be used;
you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Daemonic key ability modifier;
once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack, add 1d4 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage;

#### Demon Seed
Classification: Forbidden Daemonic Root
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina
Plant or awaken a Demon Seed in your body, dantian, meridians, or soul. The Seed is a forbidden method-root, not a Demon Core. It does not make you a demon; it opens the second furnace through which the daemonic scripture can breathe.
While Demon Seed is active:
your Daemonic talents may be used;
you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Daemonic key ability modifier;
once per turn when you hit with a weapon attack, Unarmed Strike, or Cultivation Attack, add 1d4 Necrotic, Psychic, or Force damage;
you have Advantage on saving throws against Frightened;
you have Disadvantage on checks made to appear spiritually pure unless you suppress all visible signs.
At CL 5, the extra damage becomes 1d6.
At CL 11, the extra damage becomes 1d8.
At CL 17, the extra damage becomes 1d10.
When Demon Seed ends, if you used Overdraw during its duration, make a Wisdom saving throw against your Daemonic Save DC. On a failure, gain 1 additional Corruption.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### Darkness
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Area: 15-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Create a sphere of supernatural Darkness centered anywhere within range.
The darkness radiates from a central point, spreads around corners, and cannot extend through walls.
A creature with Darkvision can see through this Darkness. Nonmagical light cannot illuminate it.
#### Contesting Light
If a Light-sphere effect is created inside your Darkness, the creator of the Light effect makes a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
Successful Check: Your Darkness is countered and the Light effect functions normally.Failed Check: The Light effect functions only as an ordinary light source and cannot illuminate your Darkness.
#### Persistent Darkness
Augment - 2 CP: Your Darkness persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the Darkness on your turn without spending an action.

### Meld
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour
Cost: None

An unwilling creature may make a Wisdom saving throw to resist receiving the Meld.
A creature may benefit from only one Meld talent granted by the same cultivator unless another ability explicitly says otherwise.
#### Rapid Meld
Augment - 1 CP: Reduce the activation time to 1 Action.
#### Persistent Meld
Augment - 2 CP: The Meld persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after granting the Meld on your turn without spending an action.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Dark Qi Expression: Primary — Hidden Yin Qi; Supporting — Shadow Qi, Water-Depth Qi, Fear Qi. “The night does not lie. It simply refuses to answer every question at once.” Sphere Type: Power Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Rare Variant: Body Refining through Night-Bound Body Resource: CP Common Effects: Supernatural darkness, obscured terrain, hidden travel, sensory deprivation, concealment, fear of the unseen, shadow-border movement ## Dark Dao Dark is the cultivation of hidden truth. A Dark cultivator does not need to create an illusion. They remove certainty from the battlefield. They decide what cannot be clearly perceived, safely crossed, confidently targeted, or easily understood. Darkness may express secrecy, sanctuary, patience, rest, isolation, ambush, intimidation, concealment, or predation. It is not automatically evil. ### Core Lighting Rule Dark follows ordinary 2024 fifth-edition lighting and Darkvision rules unless a Dark-sphere talent explicitly overrides them. Basic supernatural Darkness cannot be illuminated by nonmagical light, but ordinary Darkvision can still see through it. Talents such as Pure Darkness explicitly change that rule. ## Base Sphere Abilities ### Darkness Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: None Create a sphere of supernatural Darkness centered anywhere within range. The darkness radiates from a central point, spreads around corners, and cannot extend through walls. A creature with Darkvision can see through this Darkness. Nonmagical light cannot illuminate it. #### Contesting Light If a Light-sphere effect is created inside your Darkness, the creator of the Light effect makes a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC. Successful Check: Your Darkness is countered and the Light effect functions normally.Failed Check: The Light effect functions only as an ordinary light source and cannot illuminate your Darkness. #### Persistent Darkness Augment - 2 CP: Your Darkness persists for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment after creating the Darkness on your turn without spending an action. ### Meld Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: 10 minutes Range: Touch Target: One creature Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour Cost: None Grant the target one Meld talent you know. An unwilling creature may make a Wisdom saving throw to resist receiving the Meld. A creature may benefit from only one Meld talent granted by the same cultivator unless another ability explicitly says otherwise. #### Rapid Meld Augment - 1 CP: Reduce the activation time to 1 Action. #### Persistent Meld Augment - 2 CP: The Meld persists for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment after granting the Meld on your turn without spending an action. ### Darkvision - Meld When you learn the Dark sphere, you learn this Meld talent automatically. Grant the target Darkvision out to 60 feet. If the target already possesses Darkvision, increase its Darkvision range by 30 feet instead. Augment - 2 CP: Increase the granted Darkvision range to 120 feet. If the target already possesses Darkvision, increase its range by 60 feet instead. ## Dark Talent Tags ### Darkness Talents A talent with the Darkness tag modifies an area of Darkness you create. Only one Darkness talent may normally modify a single instance of Darkness. Areas modified by different talents may overlap, but identical effects do not stack with themselves. ### Meld Talents A talent with the Meld tag provides an alternative effect that may be granted through the Meld base ability. ### Augment Talents An Augment modifies another Dark-sphere effect when its additional CP cost is paid. ## MORTAL REALM DARK TALENTS ### Black Lung - Darkness Your Darkness becomes foul and miasmic. A breathing creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Poisoned until it leaves the Darkness. A creature Poisoned by Black Lung that attempts to activate an ability requiring clear speech must make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, the activation fails and the action and any CP spent are lost. Creatures that do not breathe are unaffected. Augment - 1 CP: When creating Black Lung, consume one dose of contact or inhalation poison held in your hand. A creature that fails against Black Lung also makes a saving throw against the poison’s DC. A creature immune to Black Lung is also immune to the imbued poison. ### Fearful Darkness - Darkness Your Darkness plays upon fears that remain unnamed. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Frightened until it ends its turn outside the Darkness. A creature that succeeds but remains inside may repeat the saving throw at the start of each subsequent turn, ending the Frightened condition on itself on a success. ### Hungry Darkness - Darkness Your Darkness saps vitality. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take Necrotic damage equal to your Cultivation Level. A creature may take this damage only once per round, regardless of how often it enters or leaves the Darkness. ### Looming Darkness - Darkness Creatures inside your Darkness have Disadvantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma ability checks and saving throws. ### Numbing Darkness - Darkness Creatures inside your Darkness have Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution ability checks and saving throws. ### Shadow Slick - Darkness Your Darkness becomes nearly frictionless. A creature that attempts to move more than half its Speed through the area makes a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Check: Fall Prone. Creatures inside the area have Advantage on Dexterity checks made to escape the Grappled condition. ### Shadow Tag - Darkness, Meld A creature passing through your Darkness picks up a trace of your cultivation in its shadow. For 8 hours, you know the creature’s approximate direction and whether it is alive, unconscious, or dead. As a Meld talent, apply the same effect directly to one creature. You may track a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you exceed this limit, choose one older tag to end. The effect ends immediately if the creature moves more than 1 mile away from you. ### Snagging Darkness - Darkness Your Darkness fills with grasping tendrils. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Restrained until the start of its next turn. A Restrained creature may use a Bonus Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success. ### Tenebrous Legerdemain - Darkness Manipulate objects inside your Darkness. As a Bonus Action, attempt to steal one worn or held object from a creature inside the area. Make either a ranged Cultivation Attack or a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the creature’s Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. Success: Pull the object away and move it to another space inside the same Darkness. You have Disadvantage if the object is firmly secured or held in two hands. Unattended objects may be moved without a check. You may move objects weighing up to 5 x CL pounds. ### Thick Darkness - Darkness Your Darkness becomes difficult terrain. Creatures inside move at half Speed and cannot take the Dash or Disengage actions. ### Blindfold - Meld Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Saving Throw: Wisdom negates Concentrate the target’s shadow into a band of supernatural Darkness across its senses. Failed Save: The target is Blinded and the range of all other senses is reduced by half. The creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Darkvision does not overcome Blindfold. A creature that can see through supernatural Darkness is immune. ### Clearsight - Meld The target is immune to negative effects created by your Darkness talents. Clearsight does not automatically grant sight through Darkness. A creature with Darkvision may see through your Pure Darkness while Clearsight is active. An allied cultivator may choose to let your Clearsight apply to Darkness effects they create. ### Dark Slaughter - Meld While the target stands inside an area of your Darkness, it deals additional damage whenever it attacks with Advantage or attacks a creature unable to perceive it. | CL | Additional Damage | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 1d6 | | 5-10 | 1d8 | | 11-16 | 1d10 | | 17-20 | 1d12 | This damage is multiplied on a critical hit and may stack with Sneak Attack or a comparable precision-damage feature. ### Feed on Darkness - Meld Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes At the start of each of the target’s turns while it remains inside your Darkness, it gains Temporary HP equal to your key ability modifier. These Temporary HP last for 1 round after leaving your Darkness. ### Hide in Darkness - Meld While the target stands inside an area of your Darkness, it may take the Hide action even while clearly visible. This specifically overrides the ordinary Hide action’s line-of-sight requirement while the target remains inside your Darkness. ### Shadowed Mien - Meld Cloak the target in menacing shadow that conceals appearance, subtle movements, and intentions. The target gains Advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Wisdom (Insight) checks made to discern the target’s intentions have Disadvantage. The target sees outward normally. Darkvision does not penetrate the effect. Clearsight and abilities that explicitly allow sight through supernatural Darkness reveal the target clearly and suppress these social benefits for that observer. Augment - 1 CP: Grant the target Temporary HP equal to your Cultivation Level for the duration. Losing those Temporary HP does not end the remaining benefits. ### Step Through Darkness - Meld While the target stands in Dim Light or Darkness, it may use a Bonus Action to teleport up to half its Speed to one visible unoccupied space also located in Dim Light or Darkness. The target may carry equipment up to its ordinary carrying capacity. Augment - 1 CP: Increase the teleport distance to the target’s full Speed. ### Clinging Darkness - Augment Augment - 0 CP: Center an area of Darkness on one creature or object rather than a stationary point. If targeting a creature or its worn or held object, that creature may make a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The Darkness is anchored to the creature or object and moves with it. An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. ### Directional Darkness - Augment Augment - 1 CP: Your Darkness blocks vision from only one chosen vantage. For a wall-shaped effect, choose which side is obscured. For a sphere, choose one: Creatures inside see outward clearly. Creatures outside see inward clearly. The boundaries remain obvious to creatures that can see through the effect. ### Extinguish - Augment Augment - 0 CP: When your Darkness is created, extinguish all nonmagical light sources inside it rather than merely suppressing them. This includes flame, incandescence, and alchemical light. Coals cool, glowing metal dims, and luminous chemicals become inert. You may also attempt to counter or dispel one magical flame effect inside the area. Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s save DC. Extinguish does not damage creatures composed of flame or luminous energy. ### Greater Darkness - Augment Augment - 1 CP: Increase the radius of your Darkness to 30 feet. If combined with Wall of Darkness, double the number of 10-foot cubes. ### Obfuscation - Augment Augment - 1 CP: Creatures and objects inside your Darkness, or affected by one of your Meld talents, cannot be located through ordinary scrying or divination. A sufficiently specialized penetrating divination may attempt a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC to bypass Obfuscation. Obfuscation does not interfere with your own divinations. ### Obscure Passage Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: One visible surface Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 1 CP Place a black circle on a surface and create a temporary passage. The passage has a diameter in feet equal to your Proficiency Bonus. | Realm | Maximum Depth | | --- | --- | | Mortal Realm | 5 feet | | Foundation Realm | 10 feet | | Core Formation Realm | 15 feet | | Nascent Soul Realm | 20 feet | Obscure Passage cannot penetrate a surface of exceptional hardness, such as adamantine. If the surface is too thick or hard, the talent fails and the CP is lost. When the effect ends, the surface returns whole and unmarred. Light does not pass through the passage. Ordinary low-light vision and Darkvision cannot see through it. Clearsight and abilities that explicitly allow sight through supernatural Darkness may do so. A creature standing over the passage when it opens may make a Dexterity saving throw, moving to the nearest safe space on a success. ### Rolling Blackout - Augment Augment - 0 CP: Move one area of Darkness you created up to 30 feet as an Action or Bonus Action, remaining within the effect’s maximum range. A creature leaving the area immediately stops suffering ongoing effects that depend upon remaining inside it. ### Shadow Stash Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Target: One object Duration: Instantaneous Cost: None Store one nonliving object inside your cast shadow. The object appears as part of your silhouette and has no weight while stored. Stored objects cannot be used, activated, or provide passive bonuses. You may store up to 5 x CL pounds. Retrieve one stored item as a Bonus Action. A stored object cannot be stolen or targeted unless the creature attempting to do so also knows Shadow Stash. If your shadow is removed, animated, or suppressed, you cannot access the stash until your shadow returns. If you die, stored objects appear in the nearest unoccupied space. Augment - 1 CP: Retrieve an item without spending an action during your turn, or retrieve one as a Reaction. ### Wall of Darkness - Augment Augment - 0 CP: Arrange your Darkness as a number of contiguous 10-foot cubes equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus instead of a sphere. You must be able to perceive every space the effect will occupy. ## FOUNDATION REALM DARK TALENTS ### Creeping Lethargy - Darkness Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, CL 5+Augment - 1 CP Your Darkness fogs the mind and draws creatures toward sleep. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Until it starts a turn outside the Darkness, the creature may take an Action or a Bonus Action on its turn, not both. If a creature suffering this penalty starts its turn inside the Darkness, it repeats the Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Fall Unconscious for 1 minute or until the creature starts a turn outside the Darkness, whichever occurs first. A sleeping creature repeats the saving throw at the start of each of its turns, waking on a success. It also wakes if it takes damage or another creature uses an Action to wake it. ### Disorienting Darkness - Darkness Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, CL 5+ Your Darkness makes routes unreliable. The first time on a turn that a creature attempts to enter, leave, or move through the area, it makes an Intelligence saving throw. Failed Save: Roll 1d8 to determine the creature’s direction of travel. 1 is the intended direction; 2-8 rotate clockwise around the creature. The creature moves as though the rolled direction were its intended route. The creature does not realize it moved off course until its next turn or until it leaves the Darkness. #### Second Purchase - Core Formation Upgrade If you purchase Disorienting Darkness a second time, gain both augments below. Augment - 0 CP: When a creature fails its save and attempts to move, you may spend your Reaction to choose its direction instead of rolling randomly. Augment - 1 CP: When a creature that failed its save makes an attack or uses an ability with a specified target before the end of that turn, randomly redirect the attack or ability to another legal target within range. If no other legal target exists, the action is unaffected. If the ability targets multiple creatures, randomly choose each legal target. ### Pure Darkness - Darkness Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, CL 5+ Darkvision is reduced to 5 feet inside your Darkness. All other senses, including Blindsight and Scent, have their range reduced by half. You may also dim sound traveling into, out of, or through the Darkness. Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing have Disadvantage. ### Pitch Black - Augment Prerequisite: Pure Darkness, Foundation Realm, CL 5+Augment - 1 CP Apply Pure Darkness in addition to one other Darkness talent modifying the same area. Pay the normal CP cost of every applied talent. ### Lightless Penumbra - Meld Prerequisite: Shadowed Mien, Foundation Realm, CL 5+Augment - 1 CP Render Shadowed Mien entirely opaque. The target gains protection from ordinary and magical daylight, Advantage on saving throws against Light and sight-based effects, and is treated as averting its gaze against gaze attacks without suffering the normal penalties. ## CORE FORMATION REALM DARK TALENTS ### Eternal Darkness - Augment Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, CL 10+Augment - 2 CP Your Darkness becomes permanent until dispelled. Permanent Darkness is stationary. It cannot be centered on a creature or object through Clinging Darkness and cannot be moved by Rolling Blackout. ### One With The Night Prerequisite: Step Through Darkness, Core Formation Realm, CL 12+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Target: Self Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes Cost: 2 CP Become an area of your own Darkness. You become Incorporeal, gain a Fly Speed of 30 feet, and Hover. You may move through creatures and objects as though they were difficult terrain. If you end your turn inside an object, take 1d10 Force damage. You cannot make attacks, manipulate objects, or use your items. You may still activate sphere effects that do not require a physical action, focus, tool, weapon, or other component your incorporeal form cannot provide. You gain Resistance to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. As a Bonus Action, change your radius from 5 feet up to the maximum radius of one area of Darkness you control. When you activate this talent, you may imbue yourself with one Darkness talent by paying its normal CP cost. As an Action, replace the active Darkness talent by paying the normal CP cost of the new talent. End One With The Night early as a Bonus Action and rematerialize in one unoccupied space inside your personal Darkness area. ### Shadow Walker - Meld Prerequisite: Step Through Darkness, Core Formation Realm, CL 14+Augment - 1 CP The target must stand in Dim Light or Darkness when this Meld is granted. The target temporarily steps out of the Material Plane and enters the shadowed border where the Material Plane touches the realm beyond ordinary light. While traveling there: Travel at up to 50 miles per hour. Perceive an approximate relationship to the Material Plane. See terrain only as blurred and unreliable outlines. Gain no precise scouting, spying, mapping, or surveillance benefit. The target may return to the Material Plane at any time. When returning, roll 1d10 x 100 feet. The target appears that distance away from the desired endpoint in a random horizontal direction. If this would place the target inside a solid object, roll 1d10 x 1,000 feet and shunt the target that distance in the same direction. If this would still place the target inside a solid object, place it in the nearest unoccupied space and give it 1 level of Exhaustion. Shadow Walker cannot cross a Dimensional Lock or comparable sealed boundary. ## NASCENT SOUL REALM DARK TALENTS ### Midnight - Augment Prerequisite: Greater Darkness, Nascent Soul Realm, CL 15+Augment - 2 CP Increase the radius of your Darkness to 2 miles. A Darkness effect augmented by Midnight cannot also carry a Darkness talent. ## SECRET DARK INHERITANCE ### Night That Swallows the Lantern “Some nights are not the absence of day. They are older than the first sunrise.” Classification: Secret Dark Talent Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, CL 17+, One With The Night, hidden primordial-night inheritance Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You would be reduced to 0 HP, fail a saving throw, or become unable to act while standing inside Dim Light or Darkness Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Choose one: Drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP. Succeed on the triggering saving throw. End one ordinary Grappled, Restrained, Blinded, or Stunned condition affecting you. Move up to 60 feet into one unoccupied space located in Dim Light or Darkness. Immediately activate One With The Night without paying its CP cost. Until the end of your next turn: You may see through ordinary and supernatural Darkness. You gain Resistance to all damage except Radiant, Force, and Void effects. Ordinary nonmagical light sources within 30 feet of you are extinguished. You cannot make attacks unless you rematerialize first. ## OPTIONAL DARK CULTIVATION VARIANTS A Dark cultivation variant changes how a cultivator understands hidden truth. These variants are mutually exclusive. They do not automatically grant bonus talents. ### Meld Into Dark “I do not command the darkness. I recognize that it was already here.” You do not create supernatural Darkness. #### Benefits You may use Dark Meld talents only on yourself. You may activate Meld talents while standing in any Dim Light or Darkness, not only an area you created. When a Meld talent requires your Darkness, one existing area of Dim Light or Darkness may count as your personal Darkness only for activating and sustaining that Meld. #### Limitations You cannot use Darkness or talents whose primary purpose is to create a new area of Darkness. You cannot control, move, reshape, or modify an existing area’s darkness unless another effect gives you that ability. You cannot choose Shadow Dependence. ### Shadow Dependence “Every darkness I create is stretched from the part of me the light could not hold.” You draw supernatural Darkness from your own cast shadow. #### Benefits When you create Darkness, stretch and reshape your own shadow into the effect. Your Darkness is visibly personal and suited to scripture-specific refinements involving cast shadows. #### Limitations You must possess a visible cast shadow to create Darkness. You may maintain only one Darkness effect at a time. While your Darkness remains active, you do not cast a shadow. While shadowless, you cannot use or be targeted by talents that require a cast shadow. You cannot choose Meld Into Dark. ## PATH SYNERGIES ### Qi Cultivation - Veiled Night Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Dark key ability. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Dark augment by 1, minimum 1. Increase the range of Darkness by 30 feet. ### Spirit Awakening - Night-Soul Resonance Use Wisdom as your Dark key ability. Your Darkness talents affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and astral projections normally. Your Darkvision Meld may be granted to a spirit or bonded companion even if it lacks ordinary eyes. ### Body Refining - Night-Bound Body Requires the Night-Bound Body Cultivation Insight. Use Constitution and Stamina for Dark talents. While standing inside Dim Light or your Darkness: Gain +1 AC. Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. Gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened. ## CULTIVATION INSIGHTS ### Night-Bound Body Prerequisite: Body Refining, Dark sphere, CL 4+ Learn Dark as a Body Refining discipline. Use Constitution and Stamina for Dark talents. Gain the Night-Bound Body synergy. ### Darkened Eye Prerequisite: Dark sphere, Darkvision Meld, CL 4+ When you grant Darkvision through Meld, the target may also see through your own basic supernatural Darkness. This does not grant sight through Pure Darkness unless the target also benefits from Clearsight. ### Keeper of the Black Lamp Prerequisite: Dark sphere, CL 8+ Increase the maximum number of persistent Darkness effects you may maintain by 1. This does not bypass Concentration unless the effect was made persistent through its normal augment. ### Hidden-Road Disciple Prerequisite: Step Through Darkness, CL 8+ Increase the teleport distance of Step Through Darkness by 10 feet. Once per short rest, apply its distance augment without paying the additional CP cost.

Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action

Range: Touch
Target: One creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Rouse Lesser Dead
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One Common corpse or suitable set of remains
Duration: 8 hours, or until the servant is destroyed or dismissed
Cost: 1 CP
Control Load: 1
Requirement: You must have enough unused Death Control Limit to maintain the servant, and the target must be a legal corpse under the Corpse Availability rules.
You animate the target with grave Qi as one Lesser Corpse Servant. It appears in the corpse's space with full Hit Points and uses the Lesser Corpse Servant stat block below.
The servant is one undead asset. It counts against your Death Control Limit, acts immediately after your turn, and is commanded according to Commanding Death Servants. If it is not commanded, it takes the Dodge action and moves only as permitted by those rules.
A Lesser Corpse Servant does not contain the original soul unless another talent says so. It can follow simple commands, perform labor, carry objects, open doors, keep watch, pull carts, dig, clean, guard a threshold, or fight if commanded.
You may maintain only one Lesser Corpse Servant created by this base ability at a time. You may dismiss that servant without taking an action on your turn. If you complete this ritual while one of your Lesser Corpse Servants from this ability still exists, the earlier servant must be dismissed before the new one is created.
If the corpse is protected, sacred, claimed, preserved, or socially taboo, animating it may be impossible without a rite, permission, or a successful opposed Cultivation Check.
