spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Disease Qi Expression: Primary — Pestilence Qi; Supporting — Poison Qi, Damp Qi, Corruption Qi, Weakness Qi. “Poison is a weapon. Disease is an ecosystem that has decided to occupy you.” Common Name: Disease Sphere Sphere Type: Restricted Biological / Spiritual Affliction Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Rare Variant: Body Refining through Plague-Bearing Body, quarantine-fist methods, parasite-marrows, and self-contained fever scriptures Resource: CP, or Stamina for approved Body Refining accessCore Chassis: Contagion Tokens, Infection Effects, Sickened, Fever Seeds, and Quarantine VeilsCore Abilities: Diagnose the Sickness, Sow the Fever Seed, Raise the Quarantine Veil Common Effects: infection, symptoms, debuffs, anti-healing pressure, quarantine, treatment, immunity, controlled outbreaks, parasites, spiritual sickness, and socially dangerous plague cultivation ### Disease Dao Disease is the cultivation of hostile continuity. A Disease cultivator does not merely poison blood or rot flesh. They introduce a pattern that wants to persist, adapt, spread, hide, starve, and return. A fever is not only heat. It is a message that the body has begun fighting on terms chosen by something else. A righteous Disease cultivator learns quarantine, diagnosis, plague-eating, monster hunting, and epidemic control. A cruel Disease cultivator learns hidden carriers, battlefield outbreaks, parasite seeds, and plagues that punish healing. A forbidden master teaches sickness to recognize a name. Disease asks: What has entered the body, what does it want to become, and who else will it reach before it is stopped? ### What Disease Does Disease cultivators read hostile patterns, plant Fever Seeds, build quarantine boundaries, and decide whether an infection should be purged, contained, hidden, or allowed to bloom. Disease talents commonly do one or more of the following: identify disease, infection, carriers, symptoms, contamination, or quarantine needs; place, spend, move, hide, or intensify Contagion Tokens; deal Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage through cultivated sickness; impose symptoms such as fever, coughing, malaise, weakness, rot, tremors, or spiritual sickness; create quarantine fields that protect allies or punish enemies; suppress healing, weaken concentration, or slow enemy movement; create parasite seeds, plague bodies, hidden carriers, or epidemic surges; treat disease when the cultivator follows a quarantine or physician method. Disease is powerful, but dangerous. It does not automatically create real-world pathogens, spread beyond a scene, infect settlements, or become a mass plague unless the GM makes that a story event, ritual, downtime project, or consequence of reckless cultivation. ### The Disease Loop The recurring loop is: Read the Sign -> Plant the Seed -> Cultivate the Symptom -> Control the Spread -> Decide Whether to Purge or Let It Bloom. A Disease user should feel different depending on their role. A physician reads symptoms and builds quarantine. A monster hunter marks infected prey and prevents the outbreak from reaching civilians. A battlefield controller creates zones of fever, weakness, coughing, and exhaustion. A forbidden plague adept hides symptoms until the decisive moment. ### Realm Progression Mortal. Diagnose infection, seed fever, create small quarantine veils, impose short symptoms, remove tokens, and protect allies from ordinary disease. Foundation. Develop controlled outbreak patterns, spreading symptoms, anti-healing pressure, parasite seeds, stronger quarantine, hidden carriers, and plague-bearing body methods. Core Formation. Command epidemic cascades, living plague constructs, disease domains, multi-target token detonations, spiritual sickness, and serious quarantine rites. Nascent Soul. Become a plague-sovereign, create battlefield-scale pestilence worlds, unleash perfected symptom plagues, found quarantine citadels, and infect cultivation patterns rather than only bodies. ### Sphere Boundaries Disease overlaps with many spheres but does not replace them. Poison. Poison is dose, toxin, venom, alchemical harm, corrosion, and immediate contamination. Disease is an adaptive hostile pattern that persists, spreads, and evolves. Poison asks whether the body can survive one dose. Disease asks whether the body can stop that dose from becoming an ecosystem. Life. Life restores, purifies, heals, regenerates, and calls back living continuity. Disease diagnoses, contains, weaponizes, or purges infection. Disease may treat sickness, but it does not broadly heal wounds or restore missing life. Flesh. Flesh reshapes tissue, grows grafts, modifies organs, and regenerates bodies. Disease can inflame, weaken, parasitize, or corrupt tissue, but it does not redesign bodies as a general art. Blood. Blood governs blood flow, sacrifice, lineage, bleeding, internal channels, and inherited vitality. Disease can travel through blood or taint circulation, but it does not command blood as an element or lineage force. Death. Death governs corpses, grave qi, undead, funerary memory, mortality, and endings. Disease spreads among the living. Death remains after the living are gone. Disease can create corpse fever as a technique, but it does not automatically raise undead or command the dead. Ash / Decay. Ash and Decay govern aftermath, residue, erosion, rot, ruin, smothering, and what remains after burning or breakdown. Disease may include rot as a symptom, but its identity is hostile living or spiritual pattern, not simple decomposition. Flowers / Verdant Growth. Flowers and Verdant Growth provide pollen, spores, fragrances, medicinal blooms, plant life, and parasitic blossoms. Disease defines the infection pattern. Flowers may deliver or express that pattern. Alchemy. Alchemy prepares durable medicines, pills, toxins, antidotes, reagents, incubation chambers, and treatment protocols. Disease is active cultivation of infection and quarantine. Alchemy can support Disease, but Disease does not automatically create pills or laboratory materials. Demonic Cultivation. Disease is tempting for demonic cultivators because fear, crowds, carriers, and indirect harm make shortcuts attractive. The Disease sphere itself is not automatically demonic. Weaponizing plague against civilians, creating uncontrolled epidemics, or cultivating through mass suffering usually is. ### Rules Baseline Use the campaign’s normal 2024 fifth-edition baseline unless a talent says otherwise. Disease does not automatically: spread outside combat; infect crowds, towns, armies, or nations; create real-world pathogens; bypass immunity to disease, poison, or a condition; affect constructs, undead, elementals, spirits, or creatures without meaningful biology; reduce ability scores permanently; inflict permanent exhaustion; suppress all healing; block CP recovery; remove diseases from allies; heal Hit Points; create medicine, antidotes, or vaccines; create undead; create permanent zones of contamination; force enemies to attack allies; replace Poison, Life, Flesh, Death, Alchemy, or Demonic Cultivation. A talent must state any exception directly. ### Key Ability, Save DC, and Damage Disease usually uses the Path’s key ability. Qi Cultivation: normal Qi key ability.Spirit Awakening: Wisdom when the disease is spiritual, psychic, dreamborne, soulborne, or memory-borne.Body Refining: Constitution when using approved Body Refining Disease access. Cultivation Save DC: 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. Cultivation Attack Modifier: your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. When Disease talents deal damage, the usual damage types are Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic. Choose the damage type when the talent is used unless the talent says otherwise. Poison damage represents toxins, venom, fungal secretions, septic humors, or corrupt fluids. Necrotic damage represents rot, organ failure, wasting, fever-burn, grave contamination, or cellular collapse. Psychic damage represents spiritual sickness, soul fever, nightmare infection, or memory plague. ### Martial, Power, and Body Access Disease is a restricted biological and spiritual sphere. Martial characters may use Disease through infected weapons, plague needles, pressure-point fever techniques, quarantine seals, corpse-hunter training, medicinal smoke, or monster-hunter practices. Qi Cultivators externalize infected qi, medicinal qi, miasma, spirit spores, or quarantine diagrams. Spirit Awakeners infect perception, memory, fear, aura, soul pressure, ghostly breath, and the spirit’s command over the body. Body Refiners do not usually project disease qi outside the body. A Body Refiner who learns Disease normally does so through Plague-Bearing Body methods: carrying controlled sickness in the flesh, sweating fever into close-range combat, resisting contagion, taking disease into the marrow, or passing symptoms through touch, blood, breath, grappling, or pressure-point contact. ### Core Disease Rules #### Infection Effects An Infection Effect is a condition, penalty, ongoing harm, or symptom created by a Disease talent. Unless a talent says otherwise: the same Infection Effect from the same source does not stack; different Infection Effects may coexist; a creature repeats its saving throw at the end of each of its turns if the effect lasts longer than 1 round; a creature that ends an Infection Effect cannot be affected by that same talent again until the start of the creator’s next turn; constructs and creatures without meaningful biology may be immune to ordinary biological Disease; spiritual Disease may affect unusual creatures through a talent, Path synergy, or Forged Technique; Disease does not spread beyond the scene unless a talent, ritual, downtime project, or GM ruling explicitly allows it. #### Sickened Some Disease talents apply Sickened. A Sickened creature suffers the following effects: Disadvantage on Constitution checks. Disadvantage on concentration saving throws. When it regains Hit Points, the amount restored is halved. Sickened normally lasts until the start of your next turn unless a talent says otherwise. Sickened is distinct from Poisoned. A creature can suffer both. #### Contagion Tokens Some Disease talents place Contagion Tokens. A creature may hold a number of Contagion Tokens from you equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Unless a talent says otherwise: a creature can gain at most one Contagion Token from you each turn; Contagion Tokens last for 1 minute; Contagion Tokens do not harm the creature by themselves; certain Disease talents spend tokens to intensify symptoms; a successful treatment may remove tokens; Contagion Tokens are not contagious outside combat unless a ritual, downtime project, or GM scene says so; your allies are not affected by your Contagion Tokens unless a talent says otherwise or you choose them as targets. #### Carrier and Outbreak Language A carrier is a creature, object, corpse, or area bearing a Disease effect, Contagion Token, or infection clue. An outbreak is an area or chain of effects that applies Disease pressure to more than one creature. Outbreaks in this sphere are fantasy cultivation effects. They are not instructions for real disease transmission, sanitation, or pathogen design. ### Disease Initiation When you first learn the Disease sphere, you gain the following three core abilities. #### Diagnose the Sickness Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch, or 30 feet if you can clearly perceive the target Target: One creature, corpse, object, patch of terrain, sample, wound, room, or obvious contamination source Duration: Instantaneous Cost: None You read the signs of disease and hostile biological or spiritual patterns. You learn whether Disease is present and one of the following facts: whether the infection is ordinary, magical, spiritual, alchemical, demonic, or unknown; whether the target carries any of your Contagion Tokens; whether the target is Sickened; whether the infection appears contagious in the current scene; whether the condition is worsening; whether ordinary medicine might help; whether quarantine is recommended; whether the target is an active carrier, passive carrier, or merely contaminated. If you spend 1 CP when using Diagnose the Sickness, learn three facts instead of one. Diagnose the Sickness does not automatically reveal the exact creator, exact cure, hidden Secret techniques, full disease history, every carrier nearby, or the safest treatment plan. #### Sow the Fever Seed Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature Duration: Instantaneous Cost: None You release infected qi, spores, diseased fluid, spiritual fever, coughing shadow, or parasitic essence. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack roll. On a hit, the target takes Disease damage and gains one Contagion Token. Mortal: 1d8Foundation: 2d8Core Formation: 3d8Nascent Soul: 4d8 Choose Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage when you use this ability. A creature can gain only one Contagion Token from your Sow the Fever Seed each turn. #### Raise the Quarantine Veil Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 10-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP You raise a visible or invisible veil of quarantine marks, medicinal smoke, spirit fever, miasma threads, salt circles, bone needles, paper seals, humming insects, or coughing ghosts. When you create the veil, choose one mode: Containment or Outbreak. ##### Containment Mode Choose any number of creatures in the area. Chosen creatures gain Advantage on saving throws against Disease while they remain inside the veil. Whenever a chosen creature starts its turn inside the veil, it may remove one Contagion Token from itself. Disease effects created by you cannot spread from inside the veil to creatures outside the veil unless you allow it. ##### Outbreak Mode When an enemy enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 1d6 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not Sickened. The damage increases by Realm. Mortal: 1d6Foundation: 2d6Core Formation: 3d6Nascent Soul: 4d6 A creature can take this damage only once per turn. ### Talent Tags Disease talents use the following tags as play reminders. [Diagnose] modifies Diagnose the Sickness.[Seed] modifies Sow the Fever Seed.[Veil] modifies Raise the Quarantine Veil.[Symptom] adds a symptom to an Infection Effect.[Purge] treats, removes, suppresses, or contains Disease.[Carrier] hides, moves, stores, or redirects tokens and infection patterns.[Forbidden] is socially dangerous or morally restricted in most orthodox settings. ## Mortal Talents Mortal Disease talents define basic symptoms, first quarantine methods, plague diagnosis, and token interaction. #### Fever Symptom Tags: [Seed], [Symptom] Cost: 1 CP When you hit a creature with Sow the Fever Seed, you may spend 1 CP to force the target to make a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The target’s next healing before the start of your next turn is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus. At Core Formation, a failed save also deals additional Disease damage equal to your key ability modifier. #### Malaise Symptom Tags: [Seed], [Symptom] Cost: 1 CP When you hit a creature with Sow the Fever Seed, you may impose weakness rather than raw fever. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet, it cannot take Reactions, and it has Disadvantage on Strength checks. Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the start of your next turn. #### Coughing Breath Tags: [Seed], [Symptom] Cost: 1 CP When you hit a creature with Sow the Fever Seed, you may spend 1 CP to disturb its breath. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on concentration saving throws. Successful Save: The target has Disadvantage on the next concentration saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn. #### Contaminated Wound Tags: [Seed], [Carrier] Trigger: You damage a creature with Sow the Fever Seed or a weapon attack. Cost: 1 CP Use Limit: Once per turn The attack deals additional 1d6 Necrotic or Poison damage. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target gains one Contagion Token, and healing it receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Healing it receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn. The additional damage increases to 2d6 at Core Formation and 3d6 at Nascent Soul. #### Physician of Bad Signs Tags: [Diagnose] When you use Diagnose the Sickness, you may ask one additional practical question. Examples include: What kind of creature is most vulnerable to this infection? Is the infection being sustained by a creature, item, terrain feature, corpse, or spiritual anchor? Would Life, Alchemy, Disease, Radiance, Flesh, or Spirit Awakening be the most obvious treatment route? Is the infection being hidden? Has the target been recently treated? The GM answers truthfully, but may answer in cultivation-world language rather than mechanical labels. #### Purging Breath Tags: [Diagnose], [Purge] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Target: One willing creature Cost: 1 CP Choose one: grant the target an immediate repeat saving throw against one Infection Effect; remove one Contagion Token; suppress Sickened until the start of your next turn; grant Advantage on the target’s next saving throw against Disease before the next short rest; identify one ordinary infection affecting the target. Purging Breath does not restore Hit Points. #### Clean Carrier Method Tags: [Carrier], [Purge] You can carry minor infections without spreading them accidentally. You have Advantage on saving throws against ordinary disease. When you succeed on a saving throw against a Disease effect, you may choose to gain one harmless Contagion Token instead of suffering no visible effect. This token cannot be spent by enemies and fades after 1 minute. Once per round, when you voluntarily remove one of your own harmless Contagion Tokens, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Body Refiners often learn this talent before Plague-Bearing Body. #### Narrow Quarantine Tags: [Veil] When you Raise the Quarantine Veil in Containment Mode, you may reduce the radius to 5 feet. If you do, the veil no longer requires Concentration, but it lasts only until the end of your next turn. This is often used to isolate a patient, seal a corpse, protect a doorway, or stop one infected creature from spreading tokens for a round. #### Plague Needle Tags: [Seed], [Carrier] You can deliver Disease through a precise martial strike. When you hit with a weapon attack using a needle, dart, dagger, claw, fang, unarmed strike, or other small piercing method, you may spend 1 CP to use Sow the Fever Seed through that hit instead of making a ranged Cultivation Attack. Use the weapon attack’s hit result. The Disease damage is added to the weapon’s damage. Body Refiners may use this talent through unarmed strikes, pressure points, biting, claws, blood contact, or palm needles. ## Foundation Talents Foundation Disease talents make the sphere more tactical: stronger quarantine fields, spreading infection, parasite seeds, hidden carriers, and controlled battlefield outbreaks. #### Enlarged Quarantine Veil Tags: [Veil] Your Quarantine Veil radius increases to 15 feet. At Core Formation, it increases to 20 feet. At Nascent Soul, it increases to 30 feet. #### Plague Cloud Tags: [Veil], [Seed] When you Raise the Quarantine Veil in Outbreak Mode, you may spend 2 additional CP. The veil becomes a drifting cloud of spores, infected mist, spiritual fever, crawling parasites, or coughing smoke. The area becomes lightly obscured, and enemies that fail their saving throw against the veil also gain one Contagion Token. At Core Formation, enemies that fail also become unable to regain more than half the normal Hit Points from healing until the start of your next turn. #### Quarantine Ward Tags: [Veil], [Purge] When you Raise the Quarantine Veil in Containment Mode, you may spend 2 additional CP. The veil becomes a proper ward. Choose any number of creatures inside the veil. They gain Resistance to Poison and Necrotic damage caused by Disease talents while they remain inside the veil. In addition, Contagion Tokens cannot spread out of the area unless you allow it. If a creature inside the ward attempts to teleport out while bearing one or more Contagion Tokens, it must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or the teleport fails. The ward does not physically trap creatures. #### Spreading Infection Tags: [Seed], [Carrier] Trigger: A creature bearing one or more of your Contagion Tokens starts its turn within 10 feet of another creature. Cost: 2 CP Use Limit: Once per round Choose one nearby creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target gains one Contagion Token. Successful Save: The target cannot gain Contagion Tokens from this talent until the start of its next turn. You choose whether this talent can affect your allies. This talent does not spread infection outside combat unless a ritual, downtime project, or GM scene allows it. #### Weakening Sickness Tags: [Seed], [Symptom] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Choose one creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one symptom from the list below. The symptom lasts for the duration. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the symptom on itself on a success. Successful Save: Choose one symptom. It lasts until the start of your next turn. Symptoms: Disadvantage on Strength saving throws. Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws. Speed reduced by 20 feet. Healing received reduced by your Proficiency Bonus. Cannot take Reactions. Disadvantage on concentration saving throws. Gain one Contagion Token at the start of each turn. #### Parasite Seed Tags: [Seed], [Carrier] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Choose one creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: A biological, fungal, spiritual, or dream parasite clings to the target. At the start of each of the target’s turns, it takes 2d6 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and gains one Contagion Token. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Successful Save: The target takes 2d6 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage once and does not gain the parasite. The damage increases to 3d6 at Core Formation and 4d6 at Nascent Soul. #### Hidden Carrier Tags: [Diagnose], [Carrier], [Forbidden] Your disease signs become difficult to identify. When another creature uses a divination, Medicine check, Diagnose-like effect, or Disease talent to identify your Contagion Tokens or Infection Effects, it must make a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC. On a failure, it knows that something is wrong but not that you caused it. You may suppress visible symptoms caused by your Disease talents until the start of your next turn. Suppressed symptoms still function mechanically. #### Plague-Bearing Body Tags: [Carrier], [Purge] Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Cultivated disease circulates harmlessly inside your body. For the duration, you gain: Resistance to Poison and Necrotic damage; Advantage on saving throws against Disease; immunity to ordinary disease; immunity to Sickened; the ability to hold your own Contagion Tokens harmlessly inside your body. A creature Grappling you or touching your blood, sweat, bite, claws, breath, or open wound gains one Contagion Token at the start of its turn unless you suppress the effect. Body Refiners treat this as a central access talent. #### Merciful Quarantine Physician Tags: [Diagnose], [Purge], [Veil] When you use Purging Breath on a creature inside your Quarantine Veil in Containment Mode, you may choose two Purging Breath benefits instead of one. In addition, if Purging Breath allows an immediate repeat saving throw against an Infection Effect, the target has Advantage on that saving throw. ## Core Formation Talents Core Formation Disease talents create true epidemic engines: cascading symptoms, living plague bodies, stronger domains, and multi-target token detonations. #### Symptom Cascade Tags: [Seed], [Symptom] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Choose one creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose two symptoms. The symptoms last for the duration. At the end of each of the target’s turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending both symptoms on itself on a success. Successful Save: Choose one symptom. It lasts until the start of your next turn. Symptoms: Fever: Take 2d8 Necrotic damage at the start of each turn. Tremors: Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. Weakness: Disadvantage on Strength saving throws. Coughing: Cannot take Reactions. Fatigue: Speed reduced by 20 feet. Rot: Healing received reduced by your Proficiency Bonus. Confusion: Disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws. Pain: Disadvantage on concentration saving throws. Parasite: Gain one Contagion Token at the start of each turn. #### Epidemic Surge Tags: [Seed], [Carrier] Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Cost: 4 CP Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus creatures bearing your Contagion Tokens. Spend one Contagion Token from each chosen creature. Each target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target takes 3d8 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The target takes half damage and is not Sickened. Epidemic Surge can damage each creature only once per use. At Nascent Soul, this damage becomes 4d8. #### Plague Eruption Tags: [Veil], [Seed] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 6 CP You create a violent outbreak zone. This functions as Raise the Quarantine Veil in Outbreak Mode, but the area is 20 feet and the damage is 5d6. When a creature with one or more of your Contagion Tokens fails its saving throw against this area, you may spend one of those tokens to deal an additional 2d6 damage. At Nascent Soul, the base damage becomes 7d6 and the token damage becomes 3d6. #### Living Plague Tags: [Seed], [Carrier], [Forbidden] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 6 CP You create one crawling plague construct, parasite swarm, fever ghost, infected corpse-shell, or spiritual sickness body. Only one Living Plague created by you may exist at a time. Living Plague AC: 13 + your Proficiency Bonus. Hit Points: 5 x your Cultivation Level. Speed: 30 feet, Climb 30 feet. It acts immediately after your turn. As a Bonus Action, command it to Attack, Dash, Dodge, Help, Hide, Climb, or interact with a contaminated object. Without a command, it Dodges. Infected Strike: Use your Cultivation Attack Modifier. On a hit, the target takes 2d8 + your key ability modifier Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and gains one Contagion Token. Contagious Body: When the Living Plague is destroyed, creatures of your choice within 5 feet make Constitution saving throws. On a failed save, a creature gains one Contagion Token. #### Court of the Crawling Fever Tags: [Veil], [Seed], [Purge] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP The battlefield fills with cultivated infection and disciplined quarantine authority. You and allies you choose gain: Advantage on saving throws against Disease; Resistance to Poison and Necrotic damage caused by Disease talents; immunity to your Quarantine Veil and Plague Cloud damage; the ability to remove one of your Contagion Tokens from themselves at the start of each of their turns. Enemies in the aura cannot regain more than half the normal Hit Points from healing. When an enemy starts its turn in the aura, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: the enemy takes 2d8 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage; the enemy becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn; the enemy gains one Contagion Token; the enemy cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; the enemy’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Healing the enemy receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn. A creature is affected only once per turn. #### Soul Plague Method Tags: [Diagnose], [Seed], [Symptom] Your Disease can infect spiritual command rather than flesh. Your Disease talents can affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and soul-bound constructs if they have an animating spirit or spiritual identity. Against such targets, your Disease talents may deal Psychic or Necrotic damage instead of Poison. When you use Diagnose the Sickness on such a target, you may learn whether the sickness is tied to memory, possession, soul injury, curse, Heart Demon influence, or external spiritual contamination. ## Nascent Soul Talents Nascent Soul Disease talents express sovereign plague authority, large-scale quarantine, perfected outbreak control, and infection that reaches cultivation itself. #### Plague-Sovereign Incarnation Tags: [Seed], [Carrier], [Veil] Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest You become a perfected plague incarnation. Disease no longer merely moves through you; it answers to your name. For the duration, you gain: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover; immunity to Poison damage; immunity to ordinary disease; immunity to Sickened; Resistance to Necrotic and Psychic damage; your Sow the Fever Seed deals 6d10 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage instead of its normal damage; creatures damaged by your Disease talents gain one Contagion Token once per turn. Virulent Presence: When an enemy starts its turn within 20 feet of you, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: the enemy takes 4d8 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage; the enemy becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn; the enemy gains one Contagion Token; the enemy cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; healing the enemy receives is halved until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Healing the enemy receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn. A creature is affected by Virulent Presence only once per turn. #### World of Pestilence Tags: [Veil], [Seed], [Purge] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest You create a battlefield-scale epidemic zone. Allies you choose inside the area gain: Resistance to Poison and Necrotic damage; Advantage on saving throws against Disease; immunity to your Contagion Tokens; immunity to your Disease terrain effects. Enemies inside the area suffer the following effects: they cannot regain more than half the normal Hit Points from healing; they have Disadvantage on concentration saving throws; they gain one Contagion Token when they enter for the first time on a turn; when they enter for the first time on a turn or start their turn inside, they make a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 8d8 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and becomes Sickened until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not Sickened. A creature takes this damage only once per turn. #### Thousand-Symptom Plague Tags: [Seed], [Symptom] Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 30-foot-radius sphere Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest You release a perfected outbreak of many symptoms at once. Creatures of your choice inside the area make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: A creature takes 10d10 Necrotic, Poison, or Psychic damage and suffers two symptoms until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: A creature takes half damage and suffers one symptom until the start of your next turn. Symptoms: Cannot take Reactions. Speed becomes 0. Healing received is halved. Disadvantage on attack rolls. Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. Disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws. Gain two Contagion Tokens. Become Poisoned. Become Frightened. #### Quarantine Citadel Tags: [Veil], [Purge], [Strategic Project] Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual project Time: 30 days Cost: 15 CP at the culmination, plus 25,000 gp in medicinal herbs, jade, alchemical materials, sealed chambers, talismans, spirit anchors, and quarantine infrastructure You create a permanent quarantine site, plague hospital, containment fortress, disease-research compound, sealed cemetery, monster-hunter infirmary, or epidemic defense hall. Choose three benefits: Disease talents cost 1 fewer CP once per turn nearby, minimum 1. Diagnose the Sickness and Purging Breath checks gain +2. Ordinary disease cannot spread between sealed rooms. Raise the Quarantine Veil can be made permanent in prepared chambers. Life and Alchemy projects gain +2 when treating disease. Residents gain Advantage on saving throws against ordinary disease. Contaminated objects may be stored safely. Intruders carrying Disease trigger visible warning marks. Medicinal herbs worth 500 gp are produced each month. One dangerous infection may be studied with reduced risk. You may maintain a number of Quarantine Citadels equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Infection of the Cultivation Breath Tags: [Seed], [Symptom], [Forbidden] When a creature bearing at least two of your Contagion Tokens spends CP, you may use your Reaction and spend one of those tokens. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the creature cannot reduce CP costs below printed values, cannot regain CP, and has Disadvantage on concentration saving throws. Successful Save: The creature cannot regain CP until the start of its next turn. This talent does not permanently destroy cultivation advancement and cannot scatter a cultivation base by itself. ## Secret Inheritance ### Secret Inheritance: Disease That Infects the Dao “The body fought the fever. The soul fought the rot. The technique failed because the disease had learned how cultivation breathed.” Classification: Secret Disease Talent Prerequisite: Nascent Soul, Plague-Sovereign Incarnation, hidden primordial-plague inheritance Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Choose one creature. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target suffers Dao-infecting sickness. At the start of each of its turns, it takes 4d10 Necrotic damage and 4d10 Psychic damage. While infected, the target: is Sickened; cannot regain Hit Points above half maximum Hit Points; cannot gain Temporary HP; cannot regain CP; cannot reduce CP costs below printed values; has Disadvantage on concentration saving throws; gains one Contagion Token at the start of each turn. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Successful Initial Save: The target takes 4d10 Necrotic damage and 4d10 Psychic damage, and cannot regain CP until the start of its next turn. #### Removing the Infection This effect may also end through one of the following: legendary Life purification; legendary Flesh regeneration; legendary Alchemy treatment; legendary Radiance or Sun purification; a Secret cleansing technique; a successful Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC made as an Action; appropriate divine, imperial, underworld, or sect intervention. Disease That Infects the Dao does not permanently destroy cultivation advancement unless the GM makes it the subject of a major story arc. ## Disease Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures A Disease drawback is an optional sphere-specific limitation that grants a bonus Disease talent or benefit while changing how your Disease cultivation functions. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Disease drawback when first learning Disease or undergoing a major Disease initiation; Disease drawbacks are mutually exclusive; the drawback applies to all Disease talents you use; if a drawback grants a talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, you gain that talent when you meet the prerequisites; if the drawback is retrained or removed, the bonus talent or benefit is lost. These are Tianxia-specific cultivation limits, not imported casting traditions. ### Quarantine Physician Scripture You cannot use Disease talents to deliberately spread Contagion Tokens to unwilling creatures except monsters, demons, undead, plague beasts, or active carriers threatening others. You gain Purging Breath or Merciful Quarantine Physician as a bonus talent. If you knowingly use Disease against civilians, prisoners, or noncombatants, this scripture cracks. Until repaired through atonement, treatment work, or GM-approved story, you lose the bonus talent. ### Hidden Carrier Scripture Your Disease is subtle but slow to bloom. Your Contagion Tokens are not automatically visible. Attempts to detect them require a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC. However, when you first place a Contagion Token on a creature during combat, it does not count for spending talents until the start of your next turn. You gain Hidden Carrier as a bonus talent. ### Plague-Bearing Body Scripture Your Disease cannot easily leave your body. You may only use Disease talents on yourself, creatures you touch, creatures touching you, creatures you hit with an unarmed strike or weapon, creatures Grappling you, or creatures exposed to your blood, breath, sweat, pressure points, or open wounds. You gain Plague-Bearing Body as a bonus talent. This scripture is the most common Body Refining Disease access. ### Severed Epidemic Scripture You cannot create area outbreaks. You cannot use Raise the Quarantine Veil in Outbreak Mode, Plague Cloud, Plague Eruption, Court of the Crawling Fever, World of Pestilence, Thousand-Symptom Plague, or other talents whose main function is area infection. You gain Physician of Bad Signs or Purging Breath as a bonus talent. This scripture is common among orthodox plague doctors allowed to study Disease only for diagnosis and treatment. ### One-Symptom Scripture Your Disease expresses through one recurring symptom. Choose Fever, Malaise, Coughing, Rot, Parasite, or Spiritual Sickness. Whenever a talent would let you choose from multiple symptoms, you must choose your selected symptom if it is available. If it is not available, choose the closest symptom the GM approves. Your chosen symptom is harder to resist. Once per turn, when a creature fails a saving throw against your chosen symptom, you may place one Contagion Token on it. You gain one Mortal Disease talent associated with your chosen symptom. ## Path Synergies ### Qi Cultivation - Refined Plague Circulation Qi Cultivators are the standard Disease users. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Disease talent by 1, minimum 1, when that talent affects a creature bearing at least one of your Contagion Tokens. When you damage a creature with at least one Contagion Token, add your key ability modifier to one Disease damage roll once per turn. Qi Cultivation Disease often appears as infected qi, medicinal miasma, spirit spores, talismanic quarantine diagrams, jade needles, or plague bells. ### Spirit Awakening - Soul Plague You may use Wisdom as your Disease key ability when your Disease talents are spiritual, psychic, dreamborne, memory-borne, ghostly, or soulborne. Your Disease talents can affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and soul-bound constructs through spiritual infection if the talent can reasonably reach their identity or animating pattern. Against such creatures, you may deal Psychic or Necrotic damage instead of Poison damage. Spirit Awakening Disease often appears as nightmare fever, memory rot, coughing ghosts, shame-plague, echo parasites, possession-sickness, or soul chills. ### Body Refining - Plague-Bearing Body Body Refining Disease requires explicit access through Plague-Bearing Body, a variant scripture, a subpath, an Insight, or a forged technique. You use Constitution as your Disease key ability and Stamina as your Disease resource. You gain Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws against Disease. You can hold your own Contagion Tokens harmlessly inside your body. When you succeed on a saving throw against Disease, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per round. Before the end of your next turn, you may add your Constitution modifier to one Disease damage roll. Body Refining Disease should usually remain touch-based, grapple-based, weapon-body-based, breath-based, blood-based, or pressure-point-based. It should not become remote miasma projection unless a specific technique says so. ## Cultivation Insights ### Plague-Bearing Body Insight Prerequisite: Body Refining, CL 4+ You may learn the Disease sphere. You use Stamina and Constitution for Disease talents. You gain the Body Refining - Plague-Bearing Body synergy. ### Plague Physician Prerequisite: Disease, CL 8+ Purging Breath may be used as a Bonus Action. Purging Breath may target a willing creature within 30 feet. When you use Purging Breath, you may remove two Contagion Tokens instead of one. If the target immediately repeats a saving throw against a Disease effect, it has Advantage. You automatically identify ordinary disease when using Diagnose the Sickness. ### Epidemic Master Prerequisite: Disease, CL 8+ The maximum number of your Contagion Tokens a creature can hold increases by 2. Once per turn, when a creature gains one of your Contagion Tokens, reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn. ### Quarantine Adept Prerequisite: Disease, CL 8+ Raise the Quarantine Veil no longer requires Concentration when used in Containment Mode. The veil radius increases by 5 feet. As a Bonus Action, you may move one Quarantine Veil you created up to 10 feet. Your Containment Mode prevents ordinary Disease effects from spreading beyond the ward unless you allow it. ### Hidden Carrier Insight Prerequisite: Disease, CL 8+ Your Disease talents become harder to identify. Diagnose-like effects require a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC to identify you as the source. Your Contagion Tokens may remain visually hidden. Parasite Seed lasts 1 hour outside combat, though it cannot spread beyond the scene without GM permission. You may suppress visible symptoms caused by your talents until they are triggered. ### Clean Quarantine Reputation Prerequisite: Disease sphere You are known as a plague handler rather than a plague criminal. When you openly assist a community, sect, caravan, village, military camp, or clinic with diagnosis or containment, you gain Advantage on one social check made to request cooperation, access to patients, quarantine authority, or emergency supplies. This Insight does not protect you if you are caught weaponizing disease against innocents. ## Forged Technique Examples ### Bone-Rot Plague Spheres: Disease + Bones Your Fever Seed weakens armor, bone plates, skeletal reinforcement, or bone constructs. A target bearing your Contagion Token suffers a penalty to the next AC-boosting bone effect it receives before the start of your next turn. ### Flesh-Eating Bloom Spheres: Disease + Flesh + Flowers You cultivate parasitic blossoms that bloom in living tissue. This technique modifies Parasite Seed. The parasite appears as flowers, roots, spores, or fungal petals. If the target fails two saving throws against the parasite, it also suffers one Flesh-style tissue distortion chosen by the GM until treated. ### Corpse Fever Spheres: Disease + Death A corpse becomes a contagious hazard rather than an undead servant. As an Action, place a sealed fever mark on a corpse. The next enemy that touches, loots, animates, or disturbs the corpse gains one Contagion Token and must save against Sickened. This does not create undead. ### Poison-Plague Miasma Spheres: Disease + Poison + Smoke Your Quarantine Veil becomes a toxic infection cloud. When you use Outbreak Mode, you may choose Poison damage and cause failed saves to also suffer Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw against Poison before the start of your next turn. ### Moon-Pox Curse Spheres: Disease + Moon Symptoms wax and wane with lunar rhythm. A target suffering Symptom Cascade changes symptoms at the start of each of its turns. Under moonlight or dreamlike conditions, you may roll twice and choose the symptom. ### Plague Puppet Core Spheres: Disease + Puppetry A puppet, corpse shell, construct, or parasite host carries a sealed outbreak payload. When the carrier is destroyed or dismissed, it releases a Narrow Quarantine or Outbreak Mode veil centered on itself. ### Sun-Purging Quarantine Spheres: Disease + Radiance / Sun A quarantine ward burns infection rather than hiding it. When you use Containment Mode, creatures you choose inside the veil may immediately repeat a saving throw against Disease. On a success, visible motes of sunlight burn one Contagion Token away. ## Strategic Project Seeds ### Quarantine Station Create a temporary clinic, isolation camp, sealed shrine, plague cart, or frontier disease tent. Possible benefits include safer diagnosis, reduced spread between patients, Advantage on ordinary Medicine checks, secure corpse handling, and early warning against visible symptoms. ### Plague Archive Create a record of symptoms, names, talismans, spirit sketches, corpse notes, medicinal responses, and quarantine outcomes. Possible benefits include bonuses to Diagnose the Sickness against known infections, faster treatment research, and reduced risk when encountering a repeated outbreak. ### Monster-Hunter Infirmary Develop a sect hall that studies the diseases carried by beasts, demons, ghosts, corpse parasites, and infected cultivators. Possible benefits include favored-enemy style diagnosis, improved Purging Breath against monster-borne disease, and safer handling of contaminated trophies. ### Public Sanitation Mandate Use Disease cultivation for righteous civil service. Possible benefits include reduced disease outbreaks in a settlement, improved reputation with commoners, authority to enforce quarantine, and conflict with merchants, nobles, corrupt officials, or demonic cults profiting from sickness. ### Sealed Plague Prison Create a containment site for one dangerous infection, curse-plague, demon fever, spiritual parasite, or sleeping epidemic. Possible benefits include research access, story hooks, periodic containment checks, sect politics, and disaster risk if the prison is damaged.

Area: 10-foot-radius sphere

Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not Sickened.
The damage increases by Realm.
Mortal: 1d6Foundation: 2d6Core Formation: 3d6Nascent Soul: 4d6
A creature can take this damage only once per turn.

automatic_base_abilities.full_description:
#### Restful Dream - Rite Talent
When you learn the Dreams sphere, you learn Restful Dream automatically.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Duration: Until the end of the target’s next short rest
Cost: 1 CP
Guide the target into a restorative dream during its next short rest.
After completing that rest, the target:
gains Temporary HP equal to 2 x Proficiency Bonus;
may repeat one saving throw against Frightened;
may end one ordinary nightmare, minor sleep disturbance, or minor mental-stress effect;
gains Advantage on one check made to recover from ordinary exhaustion, stress, or mental fatigue. A creature may benefit from Restful Dream only once per long rest.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Dreams Qi Expression: Primary — Dream Qi; Supporting — Spirit Qi, Moon Qi, Memory Qi, Illusion Qi. “The sleeping mind is not defenseless. It is simply standing in a different world.” Sphere Type: Restricted Power Sphere Primary Path: Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation Rare Variant: Body Refining through Lucid-Dream Body or the self-restricted Inner Reverie variant Resource: CP Common Effects: Sleep, drowsiness, nightmares, symbolic memory, lucid protection, dream communication, dream travel, mental recovery, dreamscapes The Sphere of Dreams cultivates symbols, sleep, subconscious pressure, and lucid passage. Its practitioners plant Dream Seeds, create Dreamscapes, soothe allies, frighten enemies, and walk roads that exist only while the waking world loosens its grip. Dreams is not direct mind control and does not automatically reveal a creature’s exact location. Each talent states what information or influence it provides. ### CORE DREAMS RULES #### Dream Seed A Dream Seed is a symbolic impression planted in one creature’s subconscious. A Dream Seed is not a visible mark. It does not provide tracking, exact-square knowledge, or automatic detection. Unless a talent says otherwise: a Dream Seed on an awake unwilling creature lasts until the start of your next turn; a Dream Seed on a willing or sleeping creature lasts for 1 hour; a creature may bear only one of your Dream Seeds at a time; a Dream Seed allows you to use Seed talents on that creature; a Dream Seed ends if a talent consumes it. A sleeping creature does not automatically wake when a Dream Seed is planted. #### Drowsy Some Dreams talents apply Drowsy. A Drowsy creature: cannot take Reactions; has Speed reduced by 10 feet; has Disadvantage on its next Wisdom (Perception) check or Concentration saving throw before the condition ends. Drowsy normally lasts until the start of your next turn. #### Dream Sleep Some Dreams talents place a creature into Dream Sleep. A creature in Dream Sleep: is Unconscious; falls Prone if physically able; awakens if it takes damage unless the talent says otherwise; awakens if another creature uses an Action to shake or loudly awaken it; repeats the listed saving throw at the listed time if the effect lasts longer than one round. A creature immune to Unconscious is normally immune to Dream Sleep unless a Nascent Soul Realm talent or Secret Inheritance says otherwise. #### Dreamscape A Dreamscape is a symbolic mental environment overlaying waking space or experienced during sleep. A Dreamscape may resemble: an endless staircase; a moonlit lake; a childhood courtyard; a burning city; a forest of eyes; a palace of mirrors; a battlefield under falling snow; a giant library; floating islands; a star-filled void. A Dreamscape does not automatically reveal literal truth. A creature’s appearance inside may reflect emotion, memory, fear, desire, regret, self-image, spiritual damage, or hidden bonds. ### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES #### Dream Seed Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature Cost: None Plant a symbolic impression in one creature’s subconscious. ##### Willing or Sleeping Creature Apply Dream Seed automatically. The Dream Seed lasts for 1 hour. ##### Awake Unwilling Creature The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Apply Dream Seed until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No effect. #### Drowsy Thought - Seed Talent When you learn the Dreams sphere, you learn Drowsy Thought automatically. When an awake unwilling creature fails its saving throw against your Dream Seed, it also becomes Drowsy until the start of your next turn. #### Dreamscape Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: None Create one symbolic Dreamscape centered within range. The Dreamscape is perceptible as drifting symbolism, altered emotional tone, half-heard music, impossible shadows, falling petals, remembered voices, or similar dreamlike impressions. A Dreamscape does not automatically: create false terrain; block line of sight; make creatures Hidden; impose a condition; reveal private memories; grant literal information. Choose one Dreamscape talent you know and pay its CP cost. ##### Lingering Dreamscape Augment - 2 CP: The Dreamscape persists for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment after creating the Dreamscape on your turn without spending an Action. #### Restful Dream - Rite Talent When you learn the Dreams sphere, you learn Restful Dream automatically. Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 10 minutes Range: Touch Target: One willing creature Duration: Until the end of the target’s next short rest Cost: 1 CP Guide the target into a restorative dream during its next short rest. After completing that rest, the target: gains Temporary HP equal to 2 x Proficiency Bonus; may repeat one saving throw against Frightened; may end one ordinary nightmare, minor sleep disturbance, or minor mental-stress effect; gains Advantage on one check made to recover from ordinary exhaustion, stress, or mental fatigue. A creature may benefit from Restful Dream only once per long rest. ### DREAMS TALENT TAGS #### Seed Talents A Seed talent modifies Dream Seed or provides a new way to affect a creature bearing your Dream Seed. Unless a talent says otherwise, apply only one Seed augment when planting a Dream Seed. #### Dreamscape Talents A Dreamscape talent modifies an area created through Dreamscape. Only one Dreamscape talent normally modifies one Dreamscape. #### Slumber Talents A Slumber talent deepens Drowsy into stronger sleep pressure. #### Nightmare Talents A Nightmare talent weaponizes fear, unfinished memory, or symbolic terror. #### Lucid Talents A Lucid talent protects, awakens, redirects, or stabilizes the mind. #### Rite Talents A Rite talent is a ritual, sleeping practice, memory exercise, or dream-travel method. #### Unique Dreams Talents A Unique Dreams Talent is a distinct technique that does not require Dream Seed or Dreamscape. #### Augments An Augment modifies another Dreams effect when its additional CP cost is paid. #### Dreams Damage Entries If a Dreams talent deals damage, the talent must state a damage die, damage type, and timing. If an older text says only “Psychic damage” or “listed Psychic damage,” use the damage table printed in that talent. Character packages and automation surfaces must copy the explicit dice line rather than leaving the value implied. ### MORTAL REALM DREAMS TALENTS #### Dream Needle - Unique Dreams Talent Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: None Release a sharpened symbolic impression. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal Psychic damage according to your Cultivation Level. | Cultivation Level | Dream Needle Damage | | --- | ---: | | CL 1-4 | 1d8 Psychic | | CL 5-10 | 2d8 Psychic | | CL 11-16 | 3d8 Psychic | | CL 17-20 | 4d8 Psychic | Once per turn on a hit, choose one: the target becomes Drowsy until the start of your next turn; learn the target’s strongest current emotion; plant Dream Seed until the start of your next turn; the target has Disadvantage on its next saving throw against Frightened before the start of your next turn. #### Half-Waking Haze - Dreamscape Talent Cost: 1 CP A hostile creature entering the Dreamscape for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Become Drowsy until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn. #### Dream Whisper - Rite Talent Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 10 minutes Range: Special Duration: 10 minutes Cost: 1 CP Choose one sleeping creature known to you on the same plane. Send one dream-message through: words; symbolic imagery; emotion; a remembered location; a warning; a simple question. The target may reply through a dream impression if willing. Dream Whisper does not compel a response. #### Nightmare Glimpse - Nightmare Talent Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 2 CP Choose one creature bearing your Dream Seed or currently Drowsy. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Take Psychic damage according to your Cultivation Level and become Frightened of you until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half as much Psychic damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. | Cultivation Level | Nightmare Glimpse Damage | | --- | ---: | | CL 1-4 | 2d6 Psychic | | CL 5-10 | 3d6 Psychic | | CL 11-16 | 4d6 Psychic | | CL 17-20 | 5d6 Psychic | #### Dream Ward - Lucid Talent Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet makes a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Dream Sleep, nightmare, memory intrusion, or Psychic damage Cost: 1 CP Add your Proficiency Bonus to the saving throw result. You may use Dream Ward after seeing the roll but before knowing the outcome. #### Gentle Awakening - Lucid Talent Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Cost: 1 CP Choose one willing creature. End one: ordinary Dream Sleep effect; ordinary nightmare; ordinary sleep disturbance; Drowsy condition; minor fear residue; minor dream intrusion. At CL 10, range increases to 30 feet. Gentle Awakening does not automatically end a Domain, Secret Inheritance, curse, or major mental effect. #### Symbolic Shelter - Dreamscape Talent Cost: 1 CP Allies inside the Dreamscape gain: Advantage on saving throws against Frightened; Advantage on saving throws against Dream Sleep; Resistance to Psychic damage from Nightmare talents. ### FOUNDATION REALM DREAMS TALENTS #### Sleep - Slumber Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Choose one creature bearing your Dream Seed or currently Drowsy. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Enter Dream Sleep. Repeat the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. Successful Save: Become Drowsy until the start of its next turn. The creature awakens early if it takes damage or another creature uses an Action to awaken it. #### Shared Dream - Rite Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 10 minutes Duration: Up to 8 hours Cost: 3 CP Choose up to your Proficiency Bonus willing sleeping creatures. Their dreams connect. Participants may: communicate; share stories; discuss plans; practice meditation; experience a chosen symbolic environment; voluntarily explore a memory; rehearse a conversation; train symbolically. Shared Dream does not: replace a long rest; automatically teach a sphere; grant permanent proficiency; reveal private memories without consent; permit physical travel. #### Dream Mirror - Lucid Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within 60 feet targets you with Charmed, Frightened, Psychic damage, Dream Sleep, nightmare, or mental intrusion Cost: 3 CP The attacker makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: the triggering effect fails against you; the attacker takes 3d8 Psychic damage; the attacker becomes Drowsy until the start of its next turn; the attacker has Disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Reduce Psychic damage from the triggering effect by half. #### Nightmare Chain - Nightmare Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Choose one creature bearing your Dream Seed. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: At the start of each of its turns, the target suffers all of the following effects: - takes Psychic damage according to your Cultivation Level; - becomes Drowsy until the start of its next turn; - has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the end of that turn. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. Successful Initial Save: The target takes the Nightmare Chain damage once and suffers no ongoing effect. | Cultivation Level | Nightmare Chain Damage | | --- | ---: | | CL 5-10 | 2d8 Psychic | | CL 11-16 | 3d8 Psychic | | CL 17-20 | 4d8 Psychic | #### Memory Garden - Rite Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 1 hour Range: Touch Target: One willing creature Cost: 4 CP Enter a symbolic dream representation of one memory. You may: experience its emotional tone; observe symbolic figures; notice missing details; identify contradictions; recognize spiritual damage; search for one forgotten clue; help the creature process a traumatic memory voluntarily. Memory Garden does not guarantee literal accuracy. It does not reveal private memories beyond the volunteered memory without consent. #### False Awakening - Slumber Talent Prerequisite: CL 7+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature bearing your Dream Seed succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Dreams talents Cost: 2 CP Use Limit: Once per round The target makes a second Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: It becomes Drowsy until the start of its next turn and cannot take Reactions. Successful Save: No additional effect. False Awakening does not cause the original failed talent to take effect. #### Lucid Veil - Dreamscape Talent Prerequisite: CL 7+ Cost: 3 CP Inside the Dreamscape: ##### Allies gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, and Dream Sleep; may communicate through brief symbolic impressions; gain Advantage on checks made to recognize Illusions and mental influence. ##### Enemies A hostile creature entering for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Become Drowsy until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Has Disadvantage on its next Wisdom (Perception) check before the start of its next turn. ### CORE FORMATION REALM DREAMS TALENTS #### Court of the Half-Waking Moon - Dreams Domain “The enemy remained awake. That was the first illusion.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP The battlefield becomes a shared half-waking dream. ##### You and Allies gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, and Dream Sleep; gain Resistance to Psychic damage; may communicate through brief symbolic impressions; may move through allied spaces; gain Advantage on checks made to recognize Illusions and mental influence. ##### Enemies When an enemy starts its turn inside, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: become Drowsy until the start of its next turn; take 2d8 Psychic damage; have Disadvantage on its next attack roll; have Disadvantage on its next saving throw against a Dreams talent; reduce Speed by 20 feet until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. #### Dream Prison - Slumber Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 6 CP Choose one creature bearing your Dream Seed. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The target becomes trapped in a looping waking dream: Speed becomes 0; cannot take Reactions; cannot willingly target creatures more than 10 feet away; repeats the saving throw at the end of each turn. Successful Save: Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. Whenever the target takes damage, it repeats the saving throw with Advantage. #### Dreamwalk - Rite Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 10 minutes Duration: Concentration, up to 1 hour Cost: 6 CP Enter the dream of one sleeping creature. Meet one requirement: touch the target; possess a meaningful personal connection; possess a significant symbolic object connected to the target; know the target well and remain within 1 mile. Inside the dream, you may: communicate; observe symbolic imagery; search for emotional clues; confront a nightmare; calm the dream; follow a dream intruder; enter a memory-symbol if permitted; recognize whether another presence is intruding. Dreamwalk does not guarantee literal truth. It does not automatically bypass spiritual protection, consent, or a stronger dream technique. #### Dream Beast - Unique Dreams Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Create one dream creature shaped from a chosen symbolic theme. ##### Dream Beast The beast acts immediately after your turn. As a Bonus Action, command it to: Attack; Dash; Disengage; Dodge; Help; Search. Without a command, it Dodges. ##### Nightmare Claw Attack: Your Cultivation Attack Modifier Damage: 2d8 + Path key ability modifier Psychic damage On a hit, the target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. #### Lucid Escape - Lucid Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You fail a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Dream Sleep, Illusion, mental control, nightmare, or Psychic damage Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per short rest Choose one: succeed on the saving throw instead; reduce Psychic damage to 0; end one ordinary Dreams or Illusion effect affecting you; move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks after the triggering effect resolves. #### Waking Dream Passage - Unique Dreams Talent Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 4 CP Step through a moment of unreality. Teleport into one visible unoccupied space inside: one Dreamscape you created; your Dreams Domain; the space of a sleeping willing creature; a prepared dream-road anchor. Waking Dream Passage cannot cross a Dimensional Lock, sealed barrier, or planar boundary. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM DREAMS TALENTS #### Dream-Sovereign Incarnation “The cultivator opened their eyes. Everyone else began dreaming.” Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign lucid presence. Gain: Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover; Immunity to Psychic damage; Immunity to Charmed and Frightened; Immunity to ordinary sleep effects; Dream Needle damage becomes 6d10; know the strongest current emotion of visible creatures within 60 feet; move through creatures as difficult terrain; plant Dream Seed on one visible creature within 60 feet at the start of each of your turns without spending an Action. #### World of Dreams Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Transform the area into an overwhelming Dreamscape. Choose three effects: enemies treat the area as difficult terrain; enemies cannot take Reactions; enemies have Disadvantage on Wisdom saving throws; enemies have Disadvantage on attacks against creatures more than 10 feet away; allies may Hide while Lightly Obscured; allies gain Resistance to Psychic damage; allies communicate through symbolic impressions; enemies entering for the first time on a turn or starting inside take 3d8 Psychic damage on a failed Wisdom save or half on a success; allies may repeat one saving throw against Charmed or Frightened when they start their turn inside; sleeping creatures inside are protected from ordinary possession. The area appears as a chosen Dreamscape. World of Dreams does not create physical barriers unless combined with another sphere. #### Dream Road Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 1 hour Duration: 8 hours Cost: 10 CP Connect two prepared sleeping locations on the same plane within 10 miles. Willing sleeping creatures may travel between them through a shared dream. Travelers: fall asleep at one anchor; arrive physically at the other after 10 minutes; carry worn and carried equipment; awaken safely after arriving. Dream Road cannot cross: a Dimensional Lock; a sealed planar boundary; a ward explicitly preventing dream travel; another plane. A maintained dream-road network belongs to a cultivation project. #### Thousand-Night Repose - Lucid Rite Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 1 hour Range: Touch Target: Up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures Duration: One long rest Cost: 10 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Guide the targets through a profound restorative sleep. After completing the long rest, each target may choose two: end one ordinary mental-stress effect; end one ordinary nightmare; repeat one saving throw against Charmed or Frightened; gain Temporary HP equal to 3 x Proficiency Bonus; reduce one level of ordinary exhaustion caused by lack of sleep, travel, or mental strain; gain Advantage on its first Wisdom saving throw before its next long rest. Thousand-Night Repose does not remove curses, permanent injuries, Realm-level exhaustion, or Secret effects. ### SECRET DREAMS INHERITANCE #### Dream That Swallows the Waking World “The target awoke three times. Each awakening was part of the dream.” Classification: Secret Dreams Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Dream-Sovereign Incarnation, hidden oneiric scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Choose one creature. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. ##### Failed Save For the duration: Speed becomes 0; cannot take Reactions; cannot willingly target creatures more than 10 feet away; has Disadvantage on attack rolls; cannot benefit from ordinary telepathy; takes 4d10 Psychic damage at the start of each turn; repeats the saving throw at the end of each turn. Whenever the target takes damage from another creature, it repeats the saving throw with Advantage. ##### Successful Save Take 4d10 Psychic damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Dream That Swallows the Waking World does not: permanently trap the target; rewrite personality; permanently alter memory; force automatic obedience; bypass effects that explicitly protect against Secret dream techniques. ### OPTIONAL DREAMS CULTIVATION VARIANTS A Dreams cultivation variant changes what the cultivator believes a dream requires. These variants are mutually exclusive. They do not automatically grant bonus talents unless explicitly stated. #### Inner Reverie “I do not enter dreams. I teach my body to remain half-asleep while standing.” You cannot create Dreamscape at a distant point. Your Dreamscape must be centered on yourself and moves with you. You may apply Dream Seed only to: yourself; one creature you touch; one creature you hit with an unarmed strike or melee weapon attack; one creature entering or starting its turn inside your Dreamscape. ##### Body Refining Access A Body Refiner may learn Dreams through Inner Reverie without spending the Lucid-Dream Body Cultivation Insight merely to gain access to the sphere. Use Constitution and Stamina for Dreams talents. Inner Reverie does not grant the Lucid-Dream Body synergy unless you later learn that Insight. ##### Benefit Gain one Seed, Dreamscape, Slumber, Lucid, or Unique Dreams talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. #### Keeper of Quiet Dreams “Some dreams are not weapons. Some dreams are the only room where a wounded soul can set down its burden.” You cannot learn Nightmare talents. ##### Benefits gain one Rite or Lucid talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; Restful Dream grants additional Temporary HP equal to your Path key ability modifier; once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Lucid or Rite talent by 1, minimum 0; Shared Dream may include one additional willing creature. #### Nightmare Eater “Fear is not the enemy. Fear is the door the enemy forgot to lock.” You cannot use Restful Dream or Thousand-Night Repose on another creature. ##### Benefits gain one Nightmare or Slumber talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; once per turn when a hostile creature becomes Drowsy or Frightened from one of your Dreams talents, deal Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus; once per turn when a hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Nightmare talents, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; Nightmare Glimpse range increases by 30 feet. Nightmare Eater is not automatically forbidden, but many sects treat it with caution. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Spirit Awakening - Lucid Soul Use Wisdom as your Dreams key ability. Dream Whisper and Dreamwalk may reach: spirits; ghosts; astral bodies; sleeping possessed creatures; soul-bound companions; spirit beasts; demon beasts normally when they meaningfully dream or carry symbolic consciousness. Once per round when an ally inside one of your Dreamscapes succeeds on a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Dream Sleep, or nightmare, it gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Qi Cultivation - Dream-Meridian Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Dreams key ability. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Dreams talent by 1, minimum 1. Increase Dream Seed, Dream Needle, and Dreamscape range by 30 feet. #### Body Refining - Lucid-Dream Body Requires the Lucid-Dream Body Cultivation Insight unless Dreams was learned through Inner Reverie. Use Constitution and Stamina for Dreams talents. After completing a short rest or while standing inside your Dreamscape: gain +1 AC; gain Advantage on your next saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, or Dream Sleep; once per turn, add your Constitution modifier to one Dream Needle damage roll. Learning Dreams through Inner Reverie grants access but does not grant this synergy unless you also learn Lucid-Dream Body. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Lucid-Dream Body Prerequisite: Body Refining, Dreams sphere, CL 4+ Learn Dreams as a Body Refining discipline if you did not gain access through Inner Reverie. Use Constitution and Stamina for Dreams talents. Gain the Lucid-Dream Body synergy. #### Dream Healer Prerequisite: Dreams sphere, Restful Dream, CL 8+ When a creature benefits from Restful Dream or Thousand-Night Repose: add your Proficiency Bonus to Temporary HP granted; allow the target to repeat one additional saving throw against Frightened or an ordinary nightmare; reduce ordinary recovery time from mental fatigue by 25 percent. #### Nightmare Adept Prerequisite: Dreams sphere, one Nightmare talent, CL 8+ Once per turn when a hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Nightmare talents: add your Proficiency Bonus to one Psychic damage roll; the creature cannot benefit from ordinary invisibility against you until the start of your next turn because its fear remains symbolically obvious. This does not reveal an exact square through Total Cover. #### Memory Gardener Prerequisite: Dreams sphere, Memory Garden, CL 8+ Gain Advantage on Cultivation Checks made to: identify contradictions inside a symbolic memory; recognize dream intrusion; distinguish emotional truth from literal detail; help a willing creature process one traumatic memory; follow a dream-intruder through Dreamwalk. #### Lucid Duelist Prerequisite: Dreams sphere, CL 8+ Once per turn when a hostile creature becomes Drowsy from one of your Dreams talents, choose one: move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; gain Advantage on your next Dream Needle attack against it before the end of your next turn; gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Dream-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Dreams sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation project, use one Dreamscape, Rite, or dream-road talent you know as a seed effect. This does not create the Formation automatically. The project still requires: preparation time; dream anchors; materials; a suitable resting site; a core or power source; maintenance; Formation-specific vulnerabilities.
