When a creature starts its turn inside or enters for the first time on a turn, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take 5d8 Fire damage and become Burning. Successful Save: Take half damage. At the start of each of your turns, choose one Burning creature inside. It makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No additional effect. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM FIRE TALENTS #### Fire-Sovereign Incarnation Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign flame-body. Gain: Fly Speed 80 feet and Hover; Immunity to Fire damage; Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks; Ignite damage becomes 6d12; Burn damage becomes 2d6 + Proficiency Bonus; Overheat self-damage is reduced to 0; once per turn, use Ignite without spending an Action when you reduce a creature to 0 HP or destroy a significant object with Fire damage; ordinary flammable unattended objects ignite when you pass within 5 feet. You cannot benefit from being Hidden while Fire-Sovereign Incarnation is active unless a talent explicitly says otherwise. #### Sun-Devouring Firestorm Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 150 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Create a massive storm of flame. The area becomes Fire Terrain. When the storm appears, creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take 10d10 Fire damage and become Burning. Successful Save: Take half damage. At the start of each of your turns, choose up to three 10-foot-radius zones inside the storm. Creatures in those zones make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take 4d10 Fire damage. Successful Save: Take half damage. Unattended flammable objects ignite. The storm creates smoke and ash after it ends. #### Heaven-Piercing Flame Lance Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300-foot line, 10 feet wide Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Release a line of condensed world-burning flame. Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take 14d10 Fire damage. Successful Save: Take half damage. Choose one creature that failed its save. Until the start of your next turn: it cannot take Reactions; Fire Resistance does not apply to it; it cannot regain HP. Objects and Barriers inside take double damage. Heaven-Piercing Flame Lance does not automatically destroy artifacts, Formation cores, Domains, or Secret Inheritances. ### SECRET FIRE INHERITANCE #### First Spark That Burned the Sky “Before there were lamps, there was hunger. Before there was hunger, there was the first refusal to remain cold.” Classification: Secret Fire Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Fire-Sovereign Incarnation, hidden primordial-flame scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Choose one creature, object, Barrier, or 30-foot-radius area. The First Spark appears. ##### Creature The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take 16d10 Fire damage, become Burning, and lose Fire Resistance until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and become Kindled until the end of your next turn. If this reduces the target to 0 HP, its space becomes Fire Terrain for 1 minute and creates one Ash Remnant if the Ash sphere is involved in a Forged Technique. ##### Object, Barrier, or Structure Deal 20d10 Fire damage. This ignores an ordinary object’s Damage Threshold and deals double damage to objects vulnerable to heat. It must still affect the object’s AC and reduce its HP. ##### Area The area becomes Fire Terrain for 1 minute. At the start of your next turn, the area erupts. Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take 10d10 Fire damage. Successful Save: Take half damage. The First Spark cannot be used subtly. Creatures within 1 mile may see or sense the ignition unless blocked by a major supernatural barrier. ### OPTIONAL FIRE CULTIVATION VARIANTS Fire variants change what the cultivator believes ignition requires. These variants are mutually exclusive. They do not automatically grant bonus talents unless explicitly stated. #### Inner Furnace “The world does not need to burn. I am enough.” You cannot create Conflagration at a distant point. Your Conflagration must be centered on yourself and moves with you. You may apply Ignite only through: touch; unarmed strike; melee weapon attack; a creature entering or starting its turn inside your Conflagration. ##### Body Refining Access A Body Refiner may learn Fire through Inner Furnace without spending the Furnace Body Cultivation Insight merely to gain access to the sphere. Use Constitution and Stamina for Fire talents. Inner Furnace does not grant the Furnace Body synergy unless you later learn that Insight. ##### Benefits Gain one Ignite, Conflagration, Overheat, or Unique Fire talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. You gain Resistance to Fire damage from your own Fire talents. When you Overheat, reduce self-damage by 1, minimum 1. #### Wildfire Heart “A spark is not meant to remain obedient.” You cannot use Lingering Conflagration. Your Conflagration always moves 10 feet in a random direction at the start of your turn unless you spend a Bonus Action to direct it. ##### Benefits Gain one Conflagration or Overheat talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. When a hostile creature fails a saving throw against your Conflagration, create one additional 5-foot square of Fire Terrain adjacent to it until the start of your next turn. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of an Overheat augment by 1, minimum 0. #### Hearth Flame “Not every fire devours. Some fires are kept so others may live.” Your Fire damage dice from Ignite and Unique Fire attack talents are one die size smaller. For example, d10 becomes d8. ##### Benefits Gain one Fire Ward, Burning Weapon, Banked Ember, or Blazing Armor talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. Allies inside your Fire Terrain gain Advantage on saving throws against cold, fear, and exhaustion caused by exposure. Once per short rest, when you would deal Fire damage to an ally, reduce that damage to 0. Hearth Flame is still Fire. It does not become Radiance or Healing. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Qi Cultivation - Refined Flame Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Fire key ability. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Fire talent by 1, minimum 1. When you damage a Kindled creature with Fire, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll. #### Body Refining - Furnace Body Requires the Furnace Body Cultivation Insight unless Fire was learned through Inner Furnace. Use Constitution and Stamina for Fire talents. While you are Burning, inside Fire Terrain, or under Blazing Armor: gain +1 AC; increase Speed by 10 feet; gain Advantage on saving throws against cold and fear. Once per round when Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, apply Burn to one creature within 5 feet. Learning Fire through Inner Furnace grants access but does not grant this synergy unless you also learn Furnace Body. #### Spirit Awakening - Vow-Flame Resonance Use Wisdom as your Fire key ability. When you apply Burn, you may choose for the flame to manifest as visible vow-fire, ancestor flame, wrath-fire, or purifying spirit flame. Your Fire talents affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and soul-bound entities normally. Once per round when a creature violates an oath, attacks a protected guest, or breaks a declared taboo within 60 feet, you may treat it as Kindled until the start of your next turn. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Furnace Body Prerequisite: Body Refining, Fire sphere, CL 4+ Learn Fire as a Body Refining discipline if you did not gain access through Inner Furnace. Use Constitution and Stamina for Fire talents. Gain the Furnace Body synergy. #### Burn-Seal Adept Prerequisite: Fire sphere, Searing Brand, CL 8+ Burn you apply lasts for 1 minute. A Burning creature repeats a Constitution saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the extended Burn on itself on a success. When a creature extinguishes your extended Burn with an Action, it takes Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Overheat Adept Prerequisite: Fire sphere, one Overheat talent, CL 8+ Once per turn when you Overheat: reduce the self-damage by your Proficiency Bonus; if this reduces the self-damage to 0, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn. This does not stack with Fire-Sovereign Incarnation. #### Flame-Weapon Disciple Prerequisite: Fire sphere, Burning Weapon, CL 8+ Burning Weapon no longer requires Concentration when cast on yourself. Once per turn when Burning Weapon applies Burn, add your Proficiency Bonus to the weapon’s Fire damage. #### Forgeflame Custodian Prerequisite: Fire sphere, Formations or Smithing access, CL 8+ When designing a Formation, item, pill furnace, forge, or alchemical chamber, you may use one Fire talent you know as a seed effect. This does not create the project automatically. Normal project requirements still apply.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Flowers Qi Expression: Primary — Blossom Qi; Supporting — Wood Qi, Beauty Qi, Poison/Perfume Qi, Life Qi. Sphere Type: Power / Nature / Fragrance / Influence Sphere Primary Path: Spirit Awakening or Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Body Refining only through body-bound blossom, bloodline, poison-flower, perfume-body, or GM-approved internal practice Resource: CP, Blossoms, Fragrances, pollen or scent markers, medicinal blooms, poison blooms, and Concentration when a talent says so Core Chassis: Blossoms, Bloom timing, Fragrance effects, support/control/poison/concealment branches Flowers cultivates growth, fragrance, medicine, pollen, and delayed bloom. Its basic loop is to plant Blossoms, choose when they bloom, and shape drifting Fragrances into support, control, poison, or concealment. ### Rules Baseline This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Concentration, Cover, difficult terrain, Hide, Invisible, Bloodied, Exhaustion, and Damage Threshold unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### Barriers, Domains, and Formation Anchors A Barrier is a temporary supernatural barrier, including a Protection-sphere Barrier or another effect that explicitly identifies itself as a Barrier. A Domain is a high-rank cultivation effect that says it is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove a Domain unless the technique explicitly says otherwise. A Formation Anchor is an anchor point explicitly created by a Formation or identified by the GM as part of a Formation project. These spheres do not create Formation Anchors automatically. ### Core Flower Rules #### Blossom A Blossom is a spiritual bud cultivated onto a creature, object, or space. Unless a talent says otherwise: a Blossom occupies one creature, object, or 5-foot space; a dormant Blossom lasts for 1 hour; you may maintain a number of dormant Blossoms equal to your Proficiency Bonus; a Blossom is visible as a faint spiritual flower unless a talent says otherwise; a creature may use an Action to remove one visible Blossom attached to itself or an object it carries; when a Blossom blooms, resolve one Blossom talent you know and pay its CP cost; unless a talent says otherwise, the Blossom withers after blooming. #### Fragrance A Fragrance is a drifting spiritual pollen cloud. Unless a talent says otherwise: a Fragrance occupies a 15-foot-radius sphere; a Fragrance uses Concentration; you may maintain only one Fragrance at a time; a Fragrance may be moved up to 10 feet as a Bonus Action; only one Fragrance talent normally modifies a single Fragrance; identical Fragrance effects do not stack with themselves. #### Garden A Garden is a Flower effect that combines multiple blooms into one battlefield expression. A temporary Garden is still an active sphere effect. A permanent or maintained garden is a cultivation project and may require Wood, Alchemy, Formations, materials, caretakers, or a suitable spiritual site. ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Cultivate Blossom Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature, object, or unoccupied 5-foot space Duration: 1 hour or until bloomed Cost: None Create one dormant spiritual Blossom. ##### Willing Creature, Object, or Space The Blossom is applied automatically. ##### Unwilling Creature Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Apply the Blossom. Miss: No effect. ##### Immediate Bloom When you create a Blossom, you may cause it to bloom immediately as part of the same Action. ##### Delayed Bloom As a Bonus Action, cause one of your dormant Blossoms within 60 feet to bloom. Choose one Blossom talent you know and pay its CP cost. #### Medicinal Blossom - Blossom When you learn the Flower sphere, you learn this Blossom talent automatically. Cost: 1 CP When the Blossom blooms, choose one living creature within 5 feet. The creature regains HP: | Cultivation Level | Healing | | --- | --- | | 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier | | 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier | | 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier | A creature may benefit from your Medicinal Blossom only once per short rest. #### Fragrance Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: None Create a drifting spiritual fragrance centered within range. Choose one Fragrance talent you know and apply it. ##### Lingering Fragrance Augment - 2 CP: The Fragrance persists for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment after creating the Fragrance on your turn without spending an Action. #### Fragrant Veil - Fragrance When you learn the Flower sphere, you learn this Fragrance talent automatically. The area fills with petals, mist, and drifting pollen. Inside the area: the space is Lightly Obscured; creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on sight or smell. ### Flower Talent Tags #### Blossom Talents A Blossom talent provides an effect when one of your dormant Blossoms blooms. Unless a talent says otherwise, a Blossom withers after resolving its effect. #### Fragrance Talents A Fragrance talent modifies an area created through the Fragrance base ability. Only one Fragrance talent normally modifies a single Fragrance. #### Garden Talents A Garden talent combines multiple blossoms, fragrances, or floral effects into one battlefield-scale technique. #### Unique Flower Talents A Unique Flower Talent is a distinct technique that does not require Cultivate Blossom or Fragrance. #### Augments An Augment modifies another Flower effect when its additional CP cost is paid. ### MORTAL REALM FLOWER TALENTS #### Petal Dart - Unique Flower Talent Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: None Release sharpened petals or condensed floral Qi. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal Slashing or Poison damage: | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 1d8 | | 5-10 | 2d8 | | 11-16 | 3d8 | | 17-20 | 4d8 | Choose the damage type when attacking. #### Thorned Bloom - Blossom Cost: 2 CP Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute The Blossom opens into a 10-foot-radius field of thorned flowers centered on itself. The area becomes difficult terrain. A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take Piercing damage. Successful Save: Take half damage. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 1-10 | 2d6 | | 11-16 | 4d6 | | 17-20 | 6d6 | A creature takes this damage only once per turn. #### Scented Trace - Blossom Cost: 1 CP Duration: 8 hours Instead of blooming visibly, the Blossom dissolves into a faint spiritual fragrance attached to its subject. While the subject remains on the same plane and within a number of miles equal to: 10 x Proficiency Bonus you know its approximate direction. An unwilling creature makes a Dexterity saving throw when the trace blooms. Successful Save: The trace fails. You may maintain a number of Scented Traces equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Petal Ward - Unique Flower Talent Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage Cost: 1 CP A spiral of petals absorbs part of the blow. Reduce the triggering damage: | Cultivation Level | Damage Reduction | | --- | --- | | 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier | | 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier | | 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier | The protected creature gains Advantage on its next saving throw against Poison before the start of your next turn. #### Lotus Step - Unique Flower Talent Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Duration: Until the end of your turn Cost: 1 CP Blossoms appear beneath your feet. Until the end of your turn: move across liquids; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain; cross fragile surfaces without breaking them; do not provoke opportunity attacks. #### Soporific Pollen - Fragrance Cost: 2 CP A creature that enters the Fragrance for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Become Drowsy until the start of its next turn. While Drowsy: Speed is reduced by 10 feet; cannot take Reactions; has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks. Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. #### Calming Perfume - Fragrance Cost: 1 CP A willing creature that starts its turn inside the Fragrance may immediately repeat one saving throw against the Frightened condition. A hostile creature inside has Disadvantage on Charisma (Intimidation) checks. Calming Perfume does not suppress violence and does not replace Mind-sphere emotion control. ### FOUNDATION REALM FLOWER TALENTS #### Poison Blossom - Fragrance Prerequisite: CL 5+ Cost: 4 CP A cloud of toxic blossoms fills the Fragrance. A creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take Poison damage and become Poisoned until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 5-10 | 3d6 | | 11-16 | 5d6 | | 17-20 | 7d6 | A creature takes this damage only once per turn. #### Beguiling Perfume - Fragrance Prerequisite: CL 5+ Cost: 4 CP A creature that enters the Fragrance for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Charmed by you until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. While Charmed in this way: the creature cannot willingly target you with attacks or harmful abilities; it has Disadvantage on attacks against your allies while you remain visible. Beguiling Perfume does not grant direct commands and does not replace the Mind sphere. #### Exploding Seed - Blossom Prerequisite: CL 5+ Cost: 3 CP Duration: Until the end of your next turn The Blossom hardens into a swelling spiritual seed. At the end of your next turn, it explodes in a 10-foot-radius sphere. Creatures inside make a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take Piercing or Poison damage. Successful Save: Take half damage. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 5-10 | 4d6 | | 11-16 | 6d6 | | 17-20 | 8d6 | A creature carrying an Exploding Seed may use its Action to remove and discard it before detonation. #### Layered Bouquet - Fragrance Augment Prerequisite: CL 7+ Cost: +2 CP Apply two Fragrance talents to one Fragrance instead of one. Pay the normal cost of both talents. The same Fragrance talent cannot be applied twice. #### Traveling Garden - Blossom Augment Prerequisite: CL 7+ Cost: +1 CP When a Blossom blooms into an area, you may anchor that area to a creature or object carrying the Blossom. An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The area moves with the bearer. Successful Save: The area remains centered in its original space. A creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the moving anchor on a success. #### Fragrant Mirage - Unique Flower Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Wrap yourself in petals, perfume, and shifting floral silhouettes. For the duration: gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks while Lightly Obscured; opportunity attacks against you have Disadvantage; the first Petal Dart you make each turn has Advantage while you stand inside one of your Fragrances. Fragrant Mirage does not make you Invisible and does not create false images. ### CORE FORMATION REALM FLOWER TALENTS #### Garden of the Hundred Blossoms - Flower Domain “Every petal carries a lesson. Some lessons are gentle.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP A spiritual garden blooms around you. ##### Allies At the start of each ally’s turn inside, choose one: gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; end Poisoned; increase Speed by 10 feet until the end of the turn. ##### Enemies When an enemy starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: Poisoned until the start of its next turn; Speed reduced by 20 feet until the start of its next turn; cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; take 2d8 Poison damage. Successful Save: Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. A creature is affected only once per turn. #### Thousand-Petal Storm - Unique Flower Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Cost: 6 CP Release a storm of sharpened petals. Creatures inside make a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take Slashing damage and become Blinded until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 10-16 | 6d6 | | 17-20 | 8d6 | #### Spirit Lotus - Blossom Prerequisite: CL 10+ Cost: 6 CP Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute The Blossom opens into a floating lotus spirit. ##### Spirit Lotus | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | 13 + Proficiency Bonus | | HP | 5 x CL | | Speed | Fly 30 feet and Hover | The lotus acts at the end of your turn. Choose one creature within 30 feet of the lotus and one effect: ##### Restoration The target regains HP: 2d8 + Path key ability modifier A creature may benefit from this Restoration only once per short rest. ##### Purifying Pollen The target immediately repeats one saving throw against: Charmed; Frightened; Poisoned; disease; one ongoing Flower effect. ##### Piercing Petals Make a Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal 3d8 Slashing damage. #### Flower of False Death - Blossom Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet would drop to 0 HP Cost: 6 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest per creature Cause one Blossom already attached to the creature to bloom. The creature drops to 1 HP instead of 0 HP. Until the start of its next turn: it becomes Invisible until it attacks or activates a harmful ability; it may move through hostile spaces as difficult terrain. A blossom appears where the creature would have fallen. #### Corpse-Blooming Flower - Forbidden Blossom Talent Classification: Forbidden Flower Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A living creature dies within 60 feet Duration: 1 minute Cost: 4 CP A spiritual flower erupts from the corpse and occupies its space. At the start of your turn, choose one: ##### Funeral Medicine One ally within 15 feet regains: 2d8 + Path key ability modifier HP ##### Grave Pollen One enemy within 15 feet makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take 3d8 Poison or Necrotic damage. Successful Save: Take half damage. Only one Corpse-Blooming Flower may exist at a time. It cannot be created from: Constructs; temporary summons; creatures without a meaningful body. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM FLOWER TALENTS #### Garden of Infinite Blossoms “The battlefield became a garden. The garden remembered who watered it with blood.” Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest The area becomes a vast spiritual garden. Choose three effects: Thorned Bloom covers the ground. Poison Blossom fills selected 15-foot-radius zones. Allies gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns. Enemies cannot take Reactions. Lotus blossoms form stepping stones through the air; allies gain Fly Speed 30 feet. Fragrant mist Heavily Obscures selected zones for enemies. Corpse-Blooming Flowers erupt from the first three valid corpses created inside. Allied healing gains an additional bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. As a Bonus Action, reposition one 15-foot-radius zone within the garden. #### Immortal Lotus Seed - Blossom Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: Ritual Time: 8 hours Range: Touch Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per Realm per creature Plant a spiritual lotus seed inside one willing living creature. The seed lasts until used. When the creature would die, it may activate the seed. The creature: drops to 1 HP instead; gains 4d10 Temporary HP; ends Poisoned; ends one ordinary disease; teleports into an unoccupied space within 30 feet; emits harmless petals. The seed then withers. A creature may carry only one Immortal Lotus Seed at a time. #### Ten-Thousand Bloom Scripture - Garden Talent Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 10 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest For the duration: your maximum dormant Blossoms becomes twice your Proficiency Bonus; Cultivate Blossom may create two Blossoms instead of one; once per turn, cause one dormant Blossom to bloom without spending a Bonus Action; the first Blossom talent you activate each turn costs 1 fewer CP, minimum 1; when a Blossom withers, you may move its residue into an unoccupied space within 15 feet and create a dormant Blossom there. Ten-Thousand Bloom Scripture does not allow the same creature to benefit from Medicinal Blossom or Spirit Lotus Restoration more often than normal. ### SECRET FLOWER INHERITANCE #### Blossom of the Final Breath “The flower blooms only once. So does the death it carries.” Classification: Secret Flower Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Garden of Infinite Blossoms, hidden floral scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Choose one creature. A single blossom appears on its body. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. ##### Failed Initial Save The flower blooms for 1 minute. At the start of each of the target’s turns: take 4d10 Poison or Necrotic damage; cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on itself on a success. ##### Successful Initial Save Take 4d10 Poison or Necrotic damage. Healing received is halved until the start of its next turn. ##### Removing the Blossom The blossom may also be removed by: a Nascent Soul Realm purification technique; a successful Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC made as an Action; a Secret technique; destroying the physical blossom. ##### Physical Blossom | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | 15 | | HP | 2 x CL | | Immunities | Poison and Psychic damage | ### OPTIONAL FLOWER CULTIVATION VARIANTS A Flower cultivation variant changes what the cultivator believes a blossom requires. These variants are mutually exclusive. They do not automatically grant bonus talents unless explicitly stated. #### Inner Garden “The body is soil. The meridians are roots. Every wound is an invitation to bloom.” You cannot place Blossoms onto other creatures, objects, or spaces. Your Blossoms may target only yourself. Your Fragrances must be centered on yourself and move with you. ##### Body Refining Access A Body Refiner may learn Flowers through Inner Garden without spending the Blooming Body Cultivation Insight merely to gain access to the sphere. Use Constitution and Stamina for Flower talents. Inner Garden does not grant the Blooming Body synergy unless you later learn that Insight. ##### Benefit Gain one Blossom or Fragrance talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. #### Rooted Garden “I do not summon flowers. I remind the garden what it was already preparing to become.” You cannot create a Blossom or Fragrance unless one of the following exists within its area or attached to its target: natural plant life; a carried seed; a prepared floral reagent; one of your existing Blossoms. ##### Benefits Gain one Blossom or Fragrance talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Blossom or Fragrance talent by 1, minimum 0. A dormant Blossom created from natural plant life lasts 8 hours instead of 1 hour. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Spirit Awakening - Soul Blossom Use Wisdom as your Flower key ability. When using Medicinal Blossom or Spirit Lotus: add your Wisdom modifier to one healing roll once per turn; healing may affect spirits and soul-bound creatures where appropriate; Purifying Pollen may target one ordinary spiritual affliction when appropriate. #### Qi Cultivation - Living Fragrance Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Flower key ability. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Flower talent by 1, minimum 1. Increase the range of Cultivate Blossom and Fragrance by 30 feet. #### Body Refining - Blooming Body Requires the Blooming Body Cultivation Insight unless Flowers was learned through Inner Garden. Use Constitution and Stamina for Flower talents. At the start of your turn while below half maximum HP, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once you gain these Temporary HP, you cannot gain them again until completing a short rest. Learning Flowers through Inner Garden grants access but does not grant this synergy unless you also learn Blooming Body. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Blooming Body Prerequisite: Body Refining, Flowers sphere, CL 4+ Learn Flowers as a Body Refining discipline if you did not gain access through Inner Garden. Use Constitution and Stamina for Flower talents. Gain the Blooming Body synergy. #### Poison Garden Adept Prerequisite: Flowers sphere, CL 8+ Gain: Resistance to Poison damage; Advantage on saving throws against Poisoned; immunity to ordinary plant-based toxins; once per turn, add your Proficiency Bonus to one Poison damage roll. #### Lotus Physician Prerequisite: Flowers sphere, CL 8+ When using Medicinal Blossom or Spirit Lotus: remove one ordinary bleeding effect; stabilize a creature at 0 HP; add your Proficiency Bonus to one healing roll. #### Fragrant Mirage Adept Prerequisite: Flowers sphere, Fragrant Mirage, CL 8+ While inside one of your Fragrances: you may take the Hide action while Lightly Obscured, provided you are still out of every enemy’s line of sight; the first opportunity attack made against you each round has Disadvantage; your first Petal Dart each turn has Advantage. #### Seed-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Flowers sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation project, use one Flower Blossom, Fragrance, or Garden talent you know as a seed effect. This does not create the Formation automatically. The project still requires: preparation time; materials; anchors; a suitable spiritual site; maintenance; Formation-specific vulnerabilities.

Factory Combat Bucket: reaction

You may use Flowing Response when one of the following triggers occurs:
a creature you can see makes a melee attack roll against you;
a creature within your reach attempts to Grapple or Shove you;
a creature within your reach forces you to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw to avoid being moved, knocked Prone, Grappled, or Restrained.
Choose the matching response.
##### Yield Against an Attack
Increase your AC against the triggering melee attack by your Proficiency Bonus.
If the attack misses, the response succeeds. After the attack resolves, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature, then apply one Response talent you know.
##### Yield Against Control
Gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw against the Grapple, Shove, forced movement, Prone effect, or Restrained effect.
If you succeed on the saving throw, the response succeeds. After the effect resolves, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature, then apply one Response talent you know.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Flowing River Qi Expression: Primary — Flow Qi; Supporting — Water Qi, Breath Qi, Redirection Qi. “The river does not defeat the stone by hating its weight. It teaches the stone where weight must go.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Paths: Body Refining and Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Yielding defense, redirection, defensive footwork, attack turning, forced movement, balance disruption, escaping pressure, momentum borrowing, flowing counters Flowing River is the cultivation of yielded force. A novice thinks yielding means retreating. An adept learns that yielding is a decision about where force is allowed to continue. The hand does not stop the spear; it changes the line of the spear. The foot does not oppose the charge; it removes the ground the charge expected to find. The body does not become absent; it becomes the curve the enemy must follow. The Sphere of Flowing River teaches practitioners to receive pressure without becoming its destination. They slip, draw, turn, redirect, and return momentum at the instant an enemy commits. A Flowing River cultivator asks: Where is the force already going? Which part of the enemy’s motion cannot be withdrawn? Is the correct answer a step, a turn, a throw, a capture, or a returned attack? Should Martial Focus be spent to redirect the blow, preserve the stance, or make the enemy overextend? After fighting a Flowing River practitioner for two rounds, an enemy should understand one truth: Every attack that fails to land may become movement the defender owns. ### Rules Baseline This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Attack action, Dodge, Disengage, Opportunity Attack, movement, Speed, Grapple, Shove, Grappled, Prone, Restrained, Incapacitated, Cover, and Difficult Terrain unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### Martial, Not Water Magic Flowing River is a Martial Sphere. Its ordinary techniques are not water spells. They are body angle, timing, breath, stance, leverage, and cultivated sensitivity to motion. A high-Realm practitioner may appear supernatural, but the base sphere does not create water, manipulate rivers, command tides, or replace the Water sphere. #### Barriers, Domains, and Formation Anchors A Barrier is a temporary supernatural barrier, including a Protection-sphere Barrier or another effect that explicitly identifies itself as a Barrier. A Domain is a high-rank cultivation effect that says it is a Domain. Ordinary suppression, dispelling, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove a Domain unless the technique explicitly says otherwise. A Formation Anchor is an anchor point explicitly created by a Formation or identified by the GM as part of a Formation project. Flowing River does not create Formation Anchors automatically. ### Core Flowing River Rules #### Martial Focus Flowing River uses Martial Focus. Until a global Martial Focus rule replaces this reminder: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is absent. Martial Focus represents softness under pressure, breath, posture, and the instant in which an enemy’s committed motion becomes readable. #### Flowing River Save DC When a Flowing River talent calls for a saving throw, use your Cultivation Save DC. Unless a Path synergy or feature says otherwise, choose Strength or Dexterity as your Flowing River key ability when you learn the sphere. #### Flowing Response Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: When a creature you can see makes a melee attack roll against you; when a creature within your reach attempts to Grapple or Shove you; or when a creature within your reach forces you to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw to avoid being moved, knocked Prone, Grappled, or Restrained. Cost: None Use Limit: Once per round You receive an incoming force and decide where it continues. You may use Flowing Response when one of the following triggers occurs: a creature you can see makes a melee attack roll against you; a creature within your reach attempts to Grapple or Shove you; a creature within your reach forces you to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw to avoid being moved, knocked Prone, Grappled, or Restrained. Choose the matching response. ##### Yield Against an Attack Increase your AC against the triggering melee attack by your Proficiency Bonus. If the attack misses, the response succeeds. After the attack resolves, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature, then apply one Response talent you know. ##### Yield Against Control Gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw against the Grapple, Shove, forced movement, Prone effect, or Restrained effect. If you succeed on the saving throw, the response succeeds. After the effect resolves, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature, then apply one Response talent you know. #### Response Talents A Response talent modifies one successful Flowing Response. Unless a talent says otherwise: apply only one Response talent to one successful Flowing Response; choose the Response talent after the trigger fails to hit, move, restrain, grapple, or knock you Prone; the triggering creature must be within your natural reach when the Response talent resolves; if a Response talent moves a creature, the creature must be no more than one size larger than you; a Response talent does not make a Counterstrike, Opportunity Attack, or Readied attack unless it explicitly says so. #### Gather the Current Whenever you take the Dodge or Disengage Action as your Action, regain Martial Focus. This does not trigger when you Dodge or Disengage as a Bonus Action unless a talent says otherwise. #### Flowing Movement When Flowing River lets you move without provoking Opportunity Attacks, the protection applies only against the creature or creatures named by the feature. You still need a legal path. Flowing River movement is not teleportation. ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Flowing River Training When you learn Flowing River, gain proficiency in one of the following: Strength (Athletics); Dexterity (Acrobatics); Wisdom (Insight). If you are already proficient in all three, choose one Mortal Realm Flowing River talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. You also learn Flowing Response and Gather the Current. ### Flowing River Talent Tags #### Response Talents A Response talent modifies one successful Flowing Response. #### Footwork Talents A Footwork talent improves movement, positioning, escape, stance changes, or Dodge and Disengage actions. #### Redirection Talents A Redirection talent changes where a failed attack, failed grapple, missed shove, or overcommitted movement goes next. #### Focus Talents A Focus talent recovers, expends, or modifies Martial Focus. #### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents yielding technique that has become unmistakably wuxia or supernatural in expression while remaining rooted in martial timing. #### Unique Flowing River Talents A Unique Flowing River Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another tag. ## Mortal Realm Flowing River Talents ### Draw Past - Response, Redirection When your Flowing Response succeeds, the triggering creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Move the creature 5 feet into one legal space adjacent to you. Successful Save: No movement. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Draw Past cannot move a creature through a wall, Barrier, occupied space, or other illegal space. ### Empty Step - Response, Footwork When your Flowing Response succeeds, increase the movement granted by Flowing Response from 5 feet to 10 feet. If you took the Dodge Action on your last turn, this movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from any creature that attacked you and missed before the start of your next turn. ### Hand on the Wrist - Response When your Flowing Response succeeds, the triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. ### Soft Capture - Response When your Flowing Response succeeds against a creature within reach, the triggering creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The creature gains the Grappled condition until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No effect. You must have a free hand or another eligible grappling body part. This grapple follows the ordinary 2024 rules for ending a grapple unless another feature changes them. ### Turn the Foot - Response When your Flowing Response succeeds, the triggering creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: the creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn; the creature has Disadvantage on the next Opportunity Attack it makes before the start of its next turn; the creature falls Prone if it moved at least 10 feet immediately before triggering Flowing Response. Successful Save: No effect. ### Water Wears Stone - Response When your Flowing Response succeeds, deal Bludgeoning damage to the triggering creature equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This damage represents a joint tap, elbow turn, shoulder check, foot sweep, or other small use of the enemy’s own pressure. It is not a separate attack. ### Turning Guard - Footwork When you take the Dodge Action, choose one creature you can see. Until the start of your next turn, when that creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it. This movement is not Flowing Response and does not apply a Response talent. ### Reed in Storm - Focus When a creature misses you with a melee attack while you are benefiting from the Dodge Action, regain Martial Focus. You regain Martial Focus only if it is currently absent. ### Current Between Steps - Footwork When you take the Disengage Action, choose one creature whose reach you leave during that movement. The next melee attack roll that creature makes against you before the start of your next turn has Disadvantage. If the creature misses you with that attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it. ### Low River Stance - Footwork You may drop Prone at any time, including outside your turn. Standing from Prone costs you only 5 feet of movement. While Prone, you may use Flowing Response against melee attacks made by creatures within your reach. You do not gain this benefit against ranged attacks merely because they are made within reach. ### Patient Water - Focus When you take the Dodge Action and no hostile creature makes an attack roll against you before the start of your next turn, regain Martial Focus at the start of that turn. You regain Martial Focus only if it is currently absent. ## Foundation Realm Flowing River Talents ### Bend the Blade - Response, Redirection Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a melee attack misses you because of Flowing Response, expend Martial Focus. Choose one creature other than you within the triggering attacker’s reach and within the attack’s original range. Resolve the same attack roll against the chosen creature’s AC. Hit: The chosen creature suffers the attack’s ordinary hit effects. Miss: No effect. Bend the Blade does not force the attacker to spend another Action or resource. It redirects the committed attack already made. ### Circular Throw - Response, Redirection Prerequisite: CL 5+ When your Flowing Response succeeds against a creature within reach, the triggering creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Move the creature up to 10 feet to one legal space you can see. If the movement ends adjacent to a wall, Barrier, large object, or another creature, the target also falls Prone. Successful Save: Move the creature 5 feet to one legal space adjacent to you. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. ### Wave Breaker - Response Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may use Flowing Response when a creature you can see makes a ranged weapon attack against you. When used this way, Yield Against an Attack increases your AC against the triggering ranged weapon attack by your Proficiency Bonus. If the attack misses, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature of your choice, but you may apply only the following Response talents: Empty Step; Hand on the Wrist, if the attacker is within your reach; Water Wears Stone, if the attacker is within your reach. ### River Takes the Spear - Response Prerequisite: CL 5+ When your Flowing Response succeeds against a melee attack made with a weapon, the attacker makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Until the start of its next turn, the attacker cannot make Opportunity Attacks with that weapon, and the next attack roll it makes with that weapon has Disadvantage. Successful Save: The attacker cannot make Opportunity Attacks with that weapon until the start of its next turn. River Takes the Spear does not disarm the weapon. ### Current Carries the Ally - Footwork Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you use Flowing Response and move at least 5 feet, choose one willing ally within 5 feet of your starting space. That ally may use its Reaction to move 5 feet into one legal space you vacated or passed through. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature. ### Soft Body, Hard Floor - Response Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a creature within reach fails a saving throw against one of your Response talents, choose one: the creature cannot stand from Prone until the start of its next turn; the creature’s Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn; the creature cannot take the Dash Action until the start of its next turn. ### River Crossing Step - Footwork Prerequisite: CL 7+ When Flowing Response lets you move, you may move through one hostile creature’s space during that movement. Treat that creature’s space as Difficult Terrain. You may not end movement in an occupied space. ### Return the Grip - Response Prerequisite: CL 7+ When your Flowing Response succeeds against a Grapple or Shove attempt, the triggering creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which. Failed Save: Choose one: the creature is pushed 10 feet away from you; the creature falls Prone; the creature gains the Grappled condition until the start of your next turn, if you have a free hand or another eligible grappling body part. Successful Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. ### Two Currents Meet - Focus Prerequisite: CL 7+ When Flowing Response succeeds, expend Martial Focus to apply two different Response talents you know to the same successful response. Both talents must be legal for the same triggering creature. ## Core Formation Realm Flowing River Talents ### Court of Returning Water - Flowing River Domain “Within this court, every hard line learns it has already bent.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest You establish a 30-foot-radius Domain centered on yourself. It moves with you. While the Domain lasts: You may use Flowing Response twice per round, but no more than once during the same turn; regain Martial Focus once per round when a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack; may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker whenever a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack. Allies Allies of your choice inside the Domain gain Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone or moved against their will. Once per round, when a hostile creature misses one of those allies with a melee attack, that ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker. Enemies Once per turn when a hostile creature inside the Domain misses with a melee attack or fails to Grapple, Shove, move, or knock a creature Prone, you may force it to make a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Move it 10 feet to one legal space inside the Domain, or give it the Prone condition. Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. The Domain ends early if you become Incapacitated. ### Ten Thousand Edges Find No Center - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you take the Dodge Action, the first melee attack each round that would hit you before the start of your next turn misses instead. After this attack misses, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker. This movement is not Flowing Response and does not apply a Response talent. ### River Breaks the Charge - Response Prerequisite: CL 10+ You may use Flowing Response when a creature you can see willingly moves at least 20 feet in a straight or mostly direct line toward you and enters a space within your reach. When you do, the creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: the creature falls Prone; its movement ends immediately; you move the creature 10 feet to one legal space adjacent to you; you move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature. Successful Save: The creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn. ### Empty Bank Evasion - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you make a Dexterity saving throw against an effect you can see, expend Martial Focus. If the saving throw succeeds, you take no damage from the effect and may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures whose effects you avoided. If the saving throw fails, you take half damage from the effect if it deals damage. Empty Bank Evasion applies only to the damage of the triggering effect. It does not automatically prevent conditions, forced movement, or other non-damage effects unless the effect says a successful save would do so. ### Borrowed Momentum - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 10+ Once per turn when a creature is moved by one of your Flowing River talents, choose one: move yourself 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature; grant one ally within 30 feet a 5-foot movement that does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature; add your Proficiency Bonus to the next damage roll you make against that creature before the end of your next turn; reduce the creature’s Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. ## Nascent Soul Realm Flowing River Talents ### No Center Under Heaven - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Your body becomes a moving answer with no fixed center. For the duration: melee attack rolls against you have Disadvantage unless you are Incapacitated; you may use Flowing Response without spending your Reaction once per round; when Flowing Response succeeds, move up to half your Speed instead of 5 feet; this movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from any creature whose attack, Grapple, Shove, or forced movement you avoided this round; when you move through a hostile creature’s space using River Crossing Step, that creature must make a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone. ### Return the Mountain to the Mountain - Redirection Prerequisite: Bend the Blade, CL 15+ When a melee attack misses you because of Flowing Response, expend Martial Focus. Choose one legal target within 30 feet of you that the triggering attack could physically reach along a clear path if redirected by weapon angle, body turn, rebound, or momentum. Resolve the same attack roll against the chosen target’s AC. Hit: The chosen target suffers the attack’s ordinary hit effects. Miss: The chosen target takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Return the Mountain to the Mountain cannot pass through Total Cover, a sealed Barrier, or a space the original attack could not plausibly be redirected through. ### River That Carries Armies - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+ When you move without provoking Opportunity Attacks through a Flowing River talent, choose a number of willing allies up to your Proficiency Bonus who are within 30 feet and can see or hear you. Each chosen ally may use its Reaction to move up to 10 feet. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures that missed you, failed to control you, or were moved by your Flowing River talent this round. ### Drown the Killing Intent - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 17+ When a creature misses you with a melee attack while you are benefiting from Dodge, you may force that creature to make a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Until the start of its next turn, the creature cannot willingly make another attack against you unless you are the only creature it can perceive as a legal target. Successful Save: The creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes against you before the start of its next turn. A creature immune to the Frightened condition has Advantage on this saving throw, but the effect is not the Frightened condition. ## Secret Inheritance ### The River That Returns the Blade Before It Is Drawn Prerequisites: Flowing River sphere, No Center Under Heaven, CL 17+ “The master did not dodge the sword. The river had already persuaded the sword to regret its path.” Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you can perceive hits you with a melee attack, Grapples you, Shoves you, knocks you Prone, Restrains you, or moves you against your will Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Declare that the attack or controlling force has already entered the river. Cancel the triggering hit, Grapple, Shove, Prone effect, Restrained effect, or forced movement against you. Then choose up to three of the following effects: move yourself up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks; move the triggering creature up to 15 feet to one legal space you can see; give the triggering creature the Prone condition; force the triggering attack to resolve against one other legal target within the attacker’s reach; end one Grappled or Restrained condition currently affecting you; regain Martial Focus at the start of your next turn. If you choose to redirect the attack against another target, use the original attack roll. This inheritance does not cancel area effects, ranged attacks, teleportation, possession, mental influence, or effects that do not physically express force through the body unless the GM rules the scene’s metaphysics make the force directly receivable. ## Optional Cultivation Variants ### Open Palm Current You cultivate Flowing River through empty hands, soft contact, and body angle rather than weapons. You may use Flowing Response only while at least one hand is free and you are not wielding a shield. Gain one Mortal Realm Response talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. Whenever your Flowing Response succeeds while you are unarmed or wielding only Light weapons, you may deal Bludgeoning damage equal to your key ability modifier, minimum 1, to the triggering creature. This damage is not a separate attack. ### Still Water Sentinel You cultivate a rooted current rather than a wandering one. When you take the Dodge Action, you may choose to root yourself until the start of your next turn. While rooted: your Speed becomes 0; you have Advantage on saving throws and checks against forced movement, Prone, Grappled, and Restrained; Flowing Response may protect one willing ally within your natural reach when that ally is the target of a melee attack; if the protected attack misses, the ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker. You cannot use Empty Step while rooted. ## Path Synergies ### Body Refining - Iron Reed Body Use Constitution as your Flowing River key ability. When your Flowing Response succeeds, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You gain these Temporary HP only once per round. If you are using the Open Palm Current variant, you may use Constitution instead of Strength or Dexterity for Unarmed Strikes made as part of Flowing River talents. ### Qi Cultivation - Silken Current Scripture Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Flowing River key ability, chosen when you gain this synergy. You may spend 1 CP when using Flowing Response to treat your natural reach as 10 feet for that response and any Response talent applied to it. The response must be expressed through visible qi, cloth, sleeve motion, weapon line, ribbon, flexible tool, or another plausible path. This does not allow Flowing Response through Total Cover or sealed Barriers. ### Spirit Awakening - Intention-Before-Motion Current Use Wisdom as your Flowing River key ability. You may use Flowing Response against a melee attack made by a creature you cannot see if you can hear the creature, sense its hostile intent, or perceive a spiritual tell it gives off. When Flowing Response succeeds against a creature this way, you may learn one of the following: whether the creature intended to kill, capture, test, or drive you away; whether the triggering attack carried a curse, possession attempt, or spiritual rider visible to your soul; whether the creature is afraid of your response. This does not reveal the creature’s exact location through Total Cover and does not defeat a stronger concealment technique by itself. ## Cultivation Insights ### Student of the Returning Current Prerequisite: Flowing River sphere Gain one Flowing River talent for which you meet the prerequisites. You also gain proficiency in Dexterity (Acrobatics) or Wisdom (Insight). If already proficient in the chosen skill, gain Expertise instead. ### Double Current Method Prerequisite: Flowing River sphere, CL 5+ Once per short rest, when Flowing Response succeeds, apply two different Response talents you know without expending Martial Focus. Both talents must be legal for the same trigger. ### Body Like Water Prerequisite: Flowing River sphere When you are Grappled or Restrained, you may use a Bonus Action to attempt to escape. If you escape a Grapple or Restraint this way, regain Martial Focus. You regain Martial Focus only if it is currently absent. ### River Without Edges Prerequisite: Flowing River sphere, CL 10+ When Flowing Response lets you move, you may move across liquid surfaces, loose rubble, narrow branches, collapsing terrain, or a hostile creature’s occupied space as though those spaces were Difficult Terrain rather than impossible terrain, if the GM agrees the movement has a visible path. You must end this movement in a legal space that can support you. This is not flight, teleportation, or water walking outside the movement granted by Flowing Response.

Gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw against the Grapple, Shove, forced movement, Prone effect, or Restrained effect.

### Counterpressure
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: You, a creature, or an object within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet takes damage, would be pushed or pulled, or would be knocked Prone
Cost: 1 CP
Release opposing pressure.
Choose one:
#### Cushion the Blow
Reduce the triggering damage.
| Cultivation Level | Damage Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier |
| 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier |
#### Refuse the Movement
Reduce the triggering forced movement by the listed distance.
| Cultivation Level | Forced-Movement Reduction |
| --- | --- |
| 1-4 | 10 feet |
| 5-10 | 15 feet |
| 11-16 | 20 feet |
| 17-20 | 30 feet |
If the triggering effect would knock the target Prone, the target also gains Advantage on one saving throw or contested check made to resist that Prone condition.
If no saving throw or contested check would normally occur, Counterpressure does not invent one. It reduces forced movement normally but does not prevent the Prone condition unless another talent says so.
