spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Force Qi Expression: Primary — Pressure Qi; Supporting — Qian/Heaven Qi, Motion Qi, Invisible-Impact Qi. “Power is not the hand that reaches across the room. Power is the answer waiting at the point of impact.” Sphere Type: Power Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Rare Variant: Body Refining through Inner Pressure Body Resource: CP Common Effects: Pressure anchors, transmitted impact, bracing, shockwaves, collision, recoil, short-lived barriers, compressed fields, battlefield resistance ### Force Dao Force is the cultivation of the answering world. Motion alone is not Force. A fist becomes Force when it meets a body. A falling stone becomes Force when it meets the ground. A door becomes a defense when its frame refuses to yield. A cultivator becomes dangerous when they understand that pressure can be stored, transmitted, redirected, and released at the exact point where resistance matters. A novice strikes harder. An adept chooses where the strike is answered. A master teaches the battlefield to answer on their behalf. The floor rejects a charging enemy. A wall returns the impact of a siege blow. An ally survives because the pressure meant to break their body is caught and carried elsewhere. One palm strike travels through a gate and erupts from the stone behind it. Force is not ordinary telekinesis. The sphere does not begin by lifting distant objects, puppeteering bodies, or flying through the sky. Its primary practices are: setting points where pressure may gather; releasing impact from those points; bracing against incoming force; transmitting pressure through bodies, weapons, surfaces, and temporary barriers; deciding whether resistance should hold, yield, rebound, or break. Force rewards preparation and timing. A Force cultivator should continually ask: Where should the battlefield resist? Which impact is worth catching? Should pressure be released now or stored for the answering blow? Is the correct answer a strike, a brace, a rebound, or a wall? Which surface should become an ally before the enemy notices its importance? After fighting a Force cultivator for two rounds, an opponent should understand one truth: Every impact may receive an answer. ## CORE FORCE RULES ### Pressure Anchor A Pressure Anchor is a cultivated point where resistance has been taught to gather. You always count as one of your own Pressure Anchors. Unless a talent says otherwise: an external Pressure Anchor occupies one creature, one unattended object, or one 5-foot square of solid surface; an external Pressure Anchor lasts for 1 hour; you may maintain a number of external Pressure Anchors equal to your Proficiency Bonus; creating another external Pressure Anchor beyond this limit ends one older anchor of your choice; an anchor placed on a creature or object moves with that creature or object; an anchor placed on a surface remains where it was created; an anchor is a cultivation effect, not a physical object; an anchor does not provide tracking, exact-square knowledge, or automatic detection; an anchor ends if its surface or object is destroyed; you may dismiss one of your anchors without spending an Action. A Pressure Anchor may appear as: a shallow ripple in the air; a palm-sized seal; a spiderweb of hairline distortions; a faint indentation in dust; a low hum felt through the bones; a scripture-specific mark visible only when struck. A creature examining a Pressure Anchor may notice it with a successful Wisdom (Perception), Intelligence (Investigation), or Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC. A Force talent originating from an anchor does not automatically bypass Total Cover, a sealed barrier, or an effect that blocks the legal route between origin and target. ### Set Anchor Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: One willing creature, one unattended object, or one 5-foot square of solid surface Duration: 1 hour Cost: None Choose a visible target within range and create one external Pressure Anchor on it. The anchor obeys all rules under Pressure Anchor, including your external-anchor limit, movement with an anchored creature or object, remaining fixed when placed on a surface, detection, dismissal, destruction, and legal-route restrictions. If the target creature already bears one of your external Pressure Anchors, the existing anchor ends immediately before the new one is created. If creating the anchor would exceed your external Pressure Anchor limit, choose one of your older external anchors to end as part of this Action. An unwilling creature is not a legal target for Set Anchor. ### Force Limit Some Force talents push, launch, pin, or otherwise impose physical pressure on a creature. Unless a talent says otherwise, your Force talents can meaningfully move or restrain creatures up to the maximum size listed for your Cultivation Level. | Cultivation Level | Maximum Creature Size | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | Large | | 5-9 | Huge | | 10-14 | Gargantuan | | 15+ | Any ordinary creature size | A talent does not automatically move or restrain a narrative-scale entity such as a mountain-sized beast, living fortress, divine manifestation, or similar scene-defining creature merely because that entity uses a standard size category. The GM may require a dedicated technique, Forged Technique, project, contest, or narrative scene. ### Forced Movement Unless a talent says otherwise: a push moves a target directly away from the effect’s origin; forced movement requires a legal route; forced movement does not allow a creature to pass through solid objects; forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks; forced movement may carry a creature into a hazardous space if the effect can legally place it there; a creature moved vertically falls normally unless another effect supports it; an unattended object may be affected when the talent says so; a secured, worn, or held object is not automatically moved merely because an unattended object would be. ### Barrier A Barrier is shaped resistance created by a Force talent. Unless a talent says otherwise, a Barrier: is visibly perceptible as distorted air, a translucent plane, a pressure ripple, or a scripture-specific effect; blocks movement through its physical boundary, including Incorporeal Movement through that boundary; cannot be crossed merely because a creature can move through ordinary creatures or objects; blocks attacks, projectiles, breath weapons, line effects, and similar effects that must physically cross that boundary; does not automatically block teleportation, planar travel, Ethereal travel, possession, or spiritual techniques that do not physically cross its boundary; does not automatically block gaze attacks, mind-affecting effects, curses, or effects that originate on the protected side; has Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage; vanishes when reduced to 0 HP or when its duration ends. If a Barrier is created through a creature’s space, that creature chooses which side of the Barrier it occupies and moves into the nearest legal space on that side. If an attack or physically traveling effect deals more damage than a Barrier’s remaining HP, subtract the Barrier’s remaining HP. The remaining damage or effect continues through the Barrier if physically appropriate. ## BASE SPHERE ABILITIES ### Set Anchor Set Anchor follows the rules above. ### Impact Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Special Cost: None Choose yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet as the origin. Choose one visible creature or object within 30 feet of that origin. The target must not have Total Cover from the origin. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. If the target is within your natural reach, you may make a melee Cultivation Attack instead. Hit: Deal Force or Bludgeoning damage. Choose the damage type when attacking. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 1d8 | | 5-10 | 2d8 | | 11-16 | 3d8 | | 17-20 | 4d8 | On a hit, you may push the target 5 feet directly away from the origin if it does not exceed your Force Limit. Impact is cultivated pressure becoming consequence at one chosen point. ### Counterpressure Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You, a creature, or an object within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet takes damage, would be pushed or pulled, or would be knocked Prone Cost: 1 CP Release opposing pressure. Choose one: #### Cushion the Blow Reduce the triggering damage. | Cultivation Level | Damage Reduction | | --- | --- | | 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier | | 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier | | 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier | #### Refuse the Movement Reduce the triggering forced movement by the listed distance. | Cultivation Level | Forced-Movement Reduction | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 10 feet | | 5-10 | 15 feet | | 11-16 | 20 feet | | 17-20 | 30 feet | If the triggering effect would knock the target Prone, the target also gains Advantage on one saving throw or contested check made to resist that Prone condition. If no saving throw or contested check would normally occur, Counterpressure does not invent one. It reduces forced movement normally but does not prevent the Prone condition unless another talent says so. ## FORCE TALENT TAGS ### Anchor Talents An Anchor talent modifies Set Anchor or adds a new way to use Pressure Anchors. ### Impact Talents An Impact talent modifies Impact or provides a new pressure release. Unless a talent says otherwise, apply only one Impact augment to one Impact attack. ### Counter Talents A Counter talent modifies Counterpressure or creates a new immediate answer to incoming force. ### Field Talents A Field talent creates an area of sustained pressure centered on yourself or one Pressure Anchor. Unless a talent says otherwise, a Field uses Concentration and you may maintain only one Force Field at a time. ### Barrier Talents A Barrier talent creates or modifies a temporary Barrier. Unless a talent says otherwise, a Barrier uses Concentration and you may maintain only one Force Barrier at a time. ### Unique Force Talents A Unique Force Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another category. ### Augments An Augment modifies another Force effect when its additional CP cost is paid. ## MORTAL REALM FORCE TALENTS ### Hammerfall - Impact Augment Cost: +1 CP When Impact hits, increase its forced movement by 5 feet. If the target collides with a solid surface before completing that movement, it takes additional Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If the target does not exceed your Force Limit, it also makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Fall Prone. Successful Save: Remain standing. A creature suffers Hammerfall’s additional damage only once per turn. ### Sundering Pressure - Impact Augment Cost: +1 CP When Impact damages one object, structure, Barrier, or Construct, deal one additional Impact damage die. Sundering Pressure does not automatically ignore damage thresholds, Resistance, Immunity, or the special rules of a major structure. ### Body-Conducted Impact - Impact Talent Trigger: You hit with one melee weapon attack, unarmed strike, or natural weapon attack Cost: 1 CP Use Limit: Once per turn Conduct pressure through the successful attack. Choose one: push the target 5 feet directly away from you if it does not exceed your Force Limit; deal additional Force or Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus; deal double damage from the triggering attack to one unattended object or ordinary Barrier. Body-Conducted Impact does not count as activating Impact and does not replace the triggering attack’s ordinary damage. ### Shockwave - Impact Talent Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet Area: 10-foot-radius sphere centered on the origin Cost: 2 CP Release pressure in every direction. Creatures of your choice inside the area make Strength saving throws. Failed Save: Take Force or Bludgeoning damage and, if the creature does not exceed your Force Limit, push it 10 feet directly away from the origin. Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no forced movement. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 1-10 | 2d6 | | 11-16 | 3d6 | | 17-20 | 4d6 | Choose the damage type when activating the talent. Unattended objects weighing no more than 20 pounds x CL are pushed 10 feet automatically if a legal route exists. ### Clinging Anchor - Anchor Augment Cost: +1 CP Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute When Impact hits a creature that does not exceed your Force Limit, place one external Pressure Anchor on that creature. The creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: The anchor remains for the duration. Successful Save: The anchor lasts until the start of your next turn. At the end of each of its turns, the creature repeats the saving throw, ending the anchor on a success. The anchor counts against your normal maximum number of external Pressure Anchors. ### Immovable Anchor - Anchor Talent A willing creature within 5 feet of yourself or one of your Pressure Anchors gains: Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to resist forced movement; Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to avoid falling Prone; Advantage on checks made to resist a Shove or Overrun attempt. A creature benefits from only one of your Immovable Anchors at a time. ### Momentary Rampart - Barrier, Counter Talent Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: An attack, projectile, breath weapon, line effect, or similar physically traveling hostile effect would pass within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: 1 CP Create one 5-foot-by-5-foot Barrier adjacent to the chosen origin. Choose its orientation when creating it. The Barrier has: | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | Your Cultivation Save DC | | HP | CL + Proficiency Bonus | | Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic | The triggering attack or effect resolves against the Barrier first if the Barrier physically interrupts its path. Momentary Rampart is an immediate answer, not a persistent wall. ### Recoil Ward - Counter Talent When Counterpressure reduces damage dealt by a creature within 30 feet of the protected target, you may pay 1 additional CP. The creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Push the creature 5 feet directly away from the protected target if it does not exceed your Force Limit. Successful Save: No movement. Recoil Ward does not affect damage caused by terrain, environmental hazards, or effects with no identifiable creature as their source. ### Pressure Step - Unique Force Talent Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Cost: 1 CP Release pressure beneath or behind your body. Move up to 10 feet through a legal route. This movement: does not provoke opportunity attacks; may move horizontally or vertically; ignores nonmagical difficult terrain; cannot pass through solid objects; is not teleportation. If you end this movement without support, you fall normally. ### Pressure Sense - Anchor Talent You know when one of your Pressure Anchors: is struck; is moved; is destroyed; is crossed by a creature of Small size or larger; becomes separated from you by a planar boundary. Pressure Sense does not reveal an exact square, a creature’s identity, or hidden information beyond the event that disturbed the anchor. ### Single-Breath Foothold - Barrier Talent Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or one willing creature within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet begins falling Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: 1 CP Create one horizontal 5-foot-by-5-foot Barrier immediately beneath the target. The target lands on the Barrier if space permits. The Barrier supports up to 100 pounds x CL. The Barrier has: | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | Your Cultivation Save DC | | HP | CL + Proficiency Bonus | | Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic | Single-Breath Foothold is a momentary catch, not a floating platform or permanent bridge. ## FOUNDATION REALM FORCE TALENTS ### Force Wall - Barrier Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Create a Barrier beginning in one unoccupied space adjacent to the origin. The wall is composed of contiguous 5-foot-by-5-foot panels. Maximum wall dimensions: 30 feet long; 10 feet high; 1 foot thick. Each panel has: | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | 15 + Proficiency Bonus | | HP | 3 x CL | | Resistances | Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing | | Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic | A panel may be damaged and destroyed independently. Force Wall blocks only effects that physically cross its boundary. ### Compression Field - Field Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere centered on the origin Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Compress the area with sustained resistance. The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures. When a hostile creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. If it already suffers this reduction from Compression Field, it also falls Prone. Successful Save: No additional effect. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn. Compression Field does not alter weight and does not automatically prevent flight. ### Pressure Pin - Field Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet Range: 10 feet from the origin Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Choose one creature that does not exceed your Force Limit. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Become Restrained by concentrated pressure. Successful Save: Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. A Restrained creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Pressure Pin does not move the target and does not command its actions. ### Anchored Passage - Anchor Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Increase Set Anchor range to 60 feet. When you use Set Anchor, create up to two external Pressure Anchors instead of one. Each anchor must have a separate legal target within range. ### Rising Step - Unique Force Talent Prerequisite: Pressure Step, CL 5+ When using Pressure Step, move up to 30 feet instead of 10 feet. You may carry one willing creature of your size or smaller. The creature must begin adjacent to you and arrive in one legal unoccupied space adjacent to your destination. If either creature ends the movement without support, that creature falls normally. ### Returning Impact - Counter Talent Prerequisite: Recoil Ward, CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: Counterpressure reduces damage from a melee attack, ranged weapon attack, thrown weapon attack, collision, or other physical impact caused by a creature Cost: 2 CP After resolving Counterpressure, return the caught pressure toward the source. The source creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Take Force damage equal to the amount of damage reduced by Counterpressure, to a maximum of 3 x CL, and push 10 feet directly away from the protected target if it does not exceed your Force Limit. Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no forced movement. Returning Impact does not reflect poison, Psychic damage, ongoing damage, or a supernatural effect with no meaningful physical impact. ### Cascading Collision - Impact Augment Prerequisite: Hammerfall, CL 7+ Cost: +2 CP When Impact pushes a creature into another creature, both creatures make Strength saving throws. Failed Save: Take Bludgeoning damage equal to 2d8 + Path key ability modifier and fall Prone. Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing. A creature can take Cascading Collision damage only once per turn. ### Force Mantle - Unique Force Talent Prerequisite: CL 7+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Wrap your body in answering pressure. Gain: +2 AC; Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to resist forced movement; Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to avoid falling Prone; once per turn, add your Proficiency Bonus to one Force or Bludgeoning damage roll caused by one of your Force talents. Force Mantle does not create a Barrier and does not automatically protect another creature. ### Ground-Answering Palm - Impact Talent Prerequisite: CL 7+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor placed on a solid surface that you can perceive within 60 feet Area: 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line along a connected solid surface Cost: 3 CP Transmit impact through the connected surface. Creatures standing on the affected surface make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take Force or Bludgeoning damage and fall Prone. Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 7-10 | 4d6 | | 11-16 | 5d6 | | 17-20 | 7d6 | Choose the damage type when activating the talent. Use Impact from one legal origin inside the Domain without needing a prepared external anchor. Use Counterpressure when its protected target is within 5 feet of any solid surface inside the Domain. Use Pressure Step once per turn without spending CP. #### Allies Gain Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to resist forced movement and falling Prone. Reduce falling and collision damage by your Proficiency Bonus. After a hostile creature misses an ally with a melee attack, that ally may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. #### Enemies Treat the Domain as difficult terrain while moving across a solid surface. Have Disadvantage on Strength checks made to break one of your Barriers. When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain while touching a solid surface, it makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: push it 10 feet along the surface; knock it Prone; reduce its Speed to 0 until the start of its next turn; deal 2d8 Force or Bludgeoning damage. Successful Save: Reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of its next turn. A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn. Court of the Answering World does not grant telekinesis, flight, or control over creatures that are not touching a meaningful surface. ### Invisible Mountain - Field Talent Prerequisite: Compression Field, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 90 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere centered on the origin Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP Create a field of overwhelming compressed resistance. The area is difficult terrain for hostile creatures. A hostile creature entering the area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Take Force damage and become Restrained until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 10-16 | 4d8 | | 17-20 | 6d8 | A creature makes this saving throw and takes this damage only once per turn. Invisible Mountain does not change a creature’s weight. It compresses the route through which the creature attempts to move. ### Rampart of Still Air - Barrier Talent Prerequisite: Force Wall, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP Create one hemispherical dome or sealed sphere centered on the origin. Choose a radius up to 15 feet. The Rampart has: | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | 16 + Proficiency Bonus | | HP | 8 x CL | | Resistances | All damage except Force and Void effects | | Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic | The Rampart blocks effects that physically cross its boundary. It does not automatically block teleportation, gaze attacks, mind-affecting effects, or effects originating inside the Rampart. ### Kinetic Reservoir - Counter Talent Prerequisite: Returning Impact, CL 10+ When Counterpressure reduces damage, you may store some of the caught pressure. Track stored pressure equal to the damage reduced, to a maximum of: 5 x CL Stored pressure lasts until the end of your next turn. Once before the stored pressure ends, when you deal damage with Impact, Shockwave, Ground-Answering Palm, or Returning Impact, expend any amount of stored pressure and add that amount as Force damage to one target damaged by the technique. You cannot store damage prevented by Resistance, Immunity, Temporary HP, or another creature’s defensive feature unless Counterpressure itself reduced that damage. You may maintain only one Kinetic Reservoir at a time. ### Meridian of Impact - Impact Talent Prerequisite: Ground-Answering Palm, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor placed on a solid surface that you can perceive within 120 feet Area: 60-foot-long, 10-foot-wide line along connected solid surfaces Cost: 6 CP Send a disciplined rupture through stone, wood, metal, or another connected solid surface. Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing. Choose the damage type when activating the talent. Objects, structures, and Barriers along the route take one additional damage die. Meridian of Impact cannot jump across an unsupported gap or bypass Total Cover through a disconnected surface. ### Rebounding Passage - Unique Force Talent Prerequisite: Rising Step, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: 5 CP Choose yourself and a number of willing creatures within 10 feet equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This movement: does not provoke opportunity attacks; may travel horizontally or vertically; cannot pass through solid objects; is not teleportation. A creature that ends the movement without support falls normally. ### Unbroken Brace - Counter Talent Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or one willing creature within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 90 feet fails a Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution saving throw against forced movement, falling Prone, a collision, or a physically traveling area effect Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per short rest The target succeeds on the saving throw instead. The cultivator reminded the mountain how to stand.” Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign answer to physical pressure. Gain: +3 AC; Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Force damage; Advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws against forced movement, falling Prone, collision, and physically traveling area effects; use Counterpressure once per round without spending CP; use Pressure Step once per turn without spending CP; increase Impact damage to 6d10 Force or Bludgeoning damage; increase the push caused by Impact by 10 feet; increase the HP of Barriers you create by 5 x Proficiency Bonus. World-Bracing Incarnation does not grant flight, teleportation, or immunity to nonphysical effects. ### Heaven-Crushing Palm - Impact Talent Prerequisite: Hammerfall, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Origin: Yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 120 feet Area: 30-foot-radius sphere centered on the origin Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Release a catastrophic pressure strike. Creatures and objects inside make Strength saving throws. Failed Save: Take 12d10 Force or Bludgeoning damage, push 20 feet directly away from the origin if the creature does not exceed your Force Limit, and fall Prone. Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no forced movement. Choose the damage type when activating the talent. Objects, structures, and Barriers take double damage. Heaven-Crushing Palm does not automatically destroy a major structure, artifact barrier, city wall, or narrative-scale defense. Apply appropriate object rules, damage thresholds, and project-scale adjudication. ### Unanswerable Rampart - Barrier, Counter Talent Prerequisite: Rampart of Still Air, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A visible attack, projectile, breath weapon, line effect, cone, or similar physically traveling hostile effect would pass through one point within 120 feet Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: 10 CP Use Limit: Once per short rest Create a sovereign Barrier up to 60 feet long and 30 feet high. It has: | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | 20 | | HP | 20 x CL | | Resistances | All damage except Force and Void effects | | Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic | If the triggering effect destroys the Barrier, remaining damage or area effect may continue through it when physically appropriate. Unanswerable Rampart does not automatically stop teleportation, gaze attacks, mind-affecting effects, or effects originating beyond the Barrier without crossing it. ### Ten Thousand Rebounds - Counter Talent Prerequisite: Kinetic Reservoir, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You activate Counterpressure Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: 8 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Until the start of your next turn, the first time each hostile creature deals physical damage to you or an ally within 30 feet, it makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Take 4d8 Force damage and push 10 feet directly away from the damaged creature if it does not exceed your Force Limit. Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no forced movement. A creature is affected by Ten Thousand Rebounds only once during the duration. Ten Thousand Rebounds does not respond to poison, Psychic damage, ongoing damage, or effects with no meaningful physical impact. ## SECRET FORCE INHERITANCE ### One Finger Holds Back Heaven “The avalanche descended. The elder raised one finger. For one breath, the world remembered that falling was not the same as arriving.” Classification: Secret Force Talent Prerequisite: CL 17+, World-Bracing Incarnation, hidden Force scripture Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: One visible physically traveling attack, collapsing structure, avalanche, siege release, breath weapon, line effect, cone, or comparable disaster would cross one point within 300 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Create one sovereign Barrier centered on the chosen point. Choose one shape: a wall up to 120 feet long and 60 feet high; a hemispherical dome with a radius up to 60 feet; a sealed sphere with a radius up to 30 feet. The Barrier has: | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | 22 | | HP | 30 x CL | | Resistances | All damage except Force and Void effects | | Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic | When the Barrier appears, it stops the triggering effect at its boundary if that effect must physically cross the Barrier. If the Barrier is destroyed, remaining damage or physical consequence continues through it when appropriate. One Finger Holds Back Heaven may temporarily contest a narrative-scale physical disaster, but it does not automatically erase that disaster. A collapsing mountain, divine weapon, city-destroying array, or similar threat may continue to exert pressure each round or require a dedicated scene to resolve. The inheritance does not automatically stop: teleportation; planar travel; gaze attacks; mind-affecting effects; curses; effects originating inside the protected boundary; a threat that does not physically cross the Barrier. ## OPTIONAL FORCE CULTIVATION VARIANTS Force variants are mutually exclusive unless the GM explicitly permits a rare blended scripture. A variant changes how the cultivator understands the answering world. It does not automatically grant bonus talents. ### Inner Pressure Body “The wall is my skin. The anchor is my stance. The answering world begins at the edge of my breath.” You cultivate Force entirely inside your own body. This is a restrictive Body Refining access variant. A Body Refiner may learn Force through this variant without spending a Cultivation Insight merely to gain access. Use Constitution as your Force key ability and Stamina instead of CP. You cannot create external Pressure Anchors. The range of your Force talents becomes Self or your natural reach. If a Force talent creates an area, Barrier, or line, it must originate from you. Learning Force this way grants access but does not automatically grant the Force-Tempered Body Path synergy. Learn the corresponding Cultivation Insight to gain that synergy later. Inner Pressure Body does not need a separate compatibility list. Its restriction changes the legal origins and ranges of the same Force talents. ### Still-Air Architect “A blow is temporary. A boundary changes every decision made after it appears.” You cultivate resistance more readily than violent impact. #### Benefits Increase Set Anchor range by 30 feet. Maintain one additional Force Barrier at a time. Increase the HP of Barriers you create by your Proficiency Bonus. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Barrier talent by 1, minimum 1. #### Limitations Impact deals no damage. Impact may still push a target normally. You cannot learn Sundering Pressure, Cascading Collision, Heaven-Crushing Palm, or another talent whose defining purpose is destructive impact unless a Forged Technique explicitly changes your scripture. ### Returning-Wave Scripture “The strongest answer is not refusal. It is consequence returned to its source.” You cultivate recoil and counterpressure rather than fixed resistance. #### Benefits Increase Counterpressure range by 30 feet. Once per turn when Counterpressure reduces damage, store additional pressure equal to your Proficiency Bonus for Kinetic Reservoir if you know that talent. Once per short rest, activate Counterpressure without spending CP. #### Limitations You cannot learn Force Wall, Rampart of Still Air, Unanswerable Rampart, or another talent whose defining purpose is a persistent Barrier. ## PATH SYNERGIES ### Qi Cultivation - Refined Pressure Circuit Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Force key ability. Increase Set Anchor range by 30 feet. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Force Augment by 1, minimum 1. When one of your external Pressure Anchors ends, you may move one other external Pressure Anchor you created up to 10 feet along the same connected surface without spending an Action. ### Spirit Awakening - Resonant Boundary Scripture Use Wisdom as your Force key ability. Your Pressure Anchors carry spiritual resonance. While you can perceive one of your Pressure Anchors within 60 feet, you know when a spirit, ghost, Incorporeal creature, astral projection, possessing entity manifesting outside a host, or similar spiritual body: enters a space within 5 feet of that anchor; leaves a space within 5 feet of that anchor; attempts to cross one of your Barriers. This awareness identifies the relevant anchor and the creature’s approximate direction from that anchor. It does not automatically reveal an exact square, identity, invisible creature, possessing entity inside a host, or creature behind Total Cover. #### Soul-Bracing Counterpressure Counterpressure gains an additional trigger: Trigger: A creature within 5 feet of yourself or one Pressure Anchor you can perceive within 60 feet makes a saving throw against possession or an effect that would forcibly displace, bind, or suppress its soul. When Counterpressure is triggered this way, choose Refuse the Intrusion instead of Cushion the Blow or Refuse the Movement. Refuse the Intrusion: Add your Proficiency Bonus to the triggering saving throw. You may use this Reaction after seeing the roll but before knowing the outcome. #### Soulward Barrier Augment - 1 CP: When you create a Barrier, extend it into the Ethereal Plane and the corresponding spiritual layer of the setting, if one exists. A Soulward Barrier blocks Ethereal travel and spiritual movement that physically cross its boundary. A Soulward Barrier does not automatically: reveal an invisible spirit; stop teleportation or planar travel that does not physically cross its boundary; eject a creature already inside the protected area; imprison a possessing entity inside a host; suppress a specialized spiritual technique that explicitly bypasses ordinary barriers. ### Body Refining - Force-Tempered Body Requirement: Learn the Force-Tempered Body Cultivation Insight. Use Constitution as your Force key ability and Stamina instead of CP. While you are touching a Pressure Anchor or affected by Force Mantle: gain +1 AC; gain Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to resist forced movement and falling Prone; once per turn when Body-Conducted Impact deals damage or pushes a creature, choose one: increase the forced movement by 5 feet; add your Constitution modifier to one damage roll; immediately stand from Prone without spending movement. Inner Pressure Body grants Body Refining access but does not grant this stronger synergy automatically. ## CULTIVATION INSIGHTS ### Force-Tempered Body Prerequisite: Body Refining, Force sphere, CL 4+ Learn Force as a Body Refining discipline if you did not gain access through Inner Pressure Body. Use Constitution and Stamina for Force talents. Gain the Force-Tempered Body Path synergy. ### Barrier Adept Prerequisite: Force sphere, Momentary Rampart or Force Wall, CL 8+ Your Force Barriers gain: +2 AC; additional HP equal to 5 x Proficiency Bonus. ### Pressure-Point Master Prerequisite: Force sphere, CL 8+ Increase the maximum number of external Pressure Anchors you may maintain by your Proficiency Bonus. When using Set Anchor, create one additional external Pressure Anchor with a separate legal target within range. ### Recoil Disciple Prerequisite: Force sphere, Counterpressure, CL 8+ Increase Counterpressure range by 30 feet. Once per short rest, activate Counterpressure without spending CP. ### Impact Scripture Prerequisite: Force sphere, Hammerfall or Sundering Pressure, CL 8+ Once per turn when one of your Force talents deals Force or Bludgeoning damage, choose one: add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll; push one damaged target 5 feet directly away from the effect’s origin if it does not exceed your Force Limit; deal one additional damage die to one unattended object, structure, or ordinary Barrier damaged by the technique. ### Battlefield Bracing Prerequisite: Force sphere, Immovable Anchor, CL 8+ A willing creature benefiting from Immovable Anchor also gains Half Cover against ranged attacks and physically traveling supernatural effects while it remains within 5 feet of the anchor.

Activation: Choose Combat Array or Prepared Array; resolve the selected mode using its own Action Type and procedure.
Range: See chosen mode
Area: See chosen mode
Duration: See chosen mode
Cost: See chosen mode
Required Components: Formation kit, improvised markers, or a talent that replaces physical markers
You create a Formation Array. When you set an array, choose one Formation mode: Combat Array or Prepared Array.
##### COMBAT ARRAY
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Area: 10-foot-radius circle centered on a point you can see within range
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You cast a flag, plate, talisman, line of Qi, or quick diagram into place and create a temporary battlefield array.
Choose one Basic Pattern you know. The array gains that pattern’s Passive effect and Pulse effect.
The Combat Array has one visible or spiritually visible Array Eye at its center. It collapses if the Eye is destroyed, if you lose Concentration, or if you create another active array beyond your Formation Load.
##### PREPARED ARRAY
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Area: 20-foot-radius circle, one room, one courtyard, one gatehouse, one bridge, or a comparable bounded site
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 3 CP
You install Nodes and an Array Eye into a location. Choose one Basic Pattern you know. The array gains that pattern’s Passive effect and Pulse effect.
A Prepared Array does not require Concentration once completed. It is fixed in place. It uses three Nodes and one Eye by default.
If two of its three Nodes are destroyed, or if its Eye is destroyed, removed, or suppressed, the array collapses.

Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Target: One active Formation Array you control within range
Cost: None
Choose one Pattern Layer currently installed in the target array. Resolve that Pattern Layer's complete Pulse effect as part of this Bonus Action.
The selected Pulse determines its own eligible targets, saving throws, damage, movement, duration, states, and other results. Unless that Pattern says otherwise, the Pulse originates from the Formation Array and can affect only creatures, objects, or spaces that are legal targets for that Pattern inside or at the boundary of the array.
Pulsing one Pattern Layer does not activate the array's other Pattern Layers. If the selected Pulse requires a choice of target or mode, make that choice when you use this Bonus Action.
Unless a feature says otherwise, a creature may be affected by the same named Pattern Pulse only once per round.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Formations Qi Expression: Primary — Pattern Qi; Supporting — Earth-Anchor Qi, Geometry Qi, Law Qi, Directional Qi. “A single flag calls the wind. Nine flags call the mountain. Ten thousand flags convince the heavens that the battlefield was always a diagram.” Common Name: Formations Sphere Sphere Type: Restricted Power Sphere / Strategic Infrastructure Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit AwakeningRare Variant / Insight Gate: Body Refining through Array Eye Body (self-anchored only)Primary Resource: CP Common Effects: Formation arrays, nodes, flags, array eyes, formation gates, flow lines, prepared sites, battlefield terrain control, detection arrays, concealment arrays, killing arrays, sealing arrays, restoration arrays, teleport gates, sect defenses, grand formations, world-shaping diagrams. ### FORMATION DAO Formations are the cultivation of place made obedient. A Sword cultivator condenses intent into one edge. A Fire cultivator ignites a condition. A Qiweaver reads the pattern beneath a technique. A Formation master writes the pattern into the world and makes everyone fight inside the answer. The Dao at the heart of this sphere is not “make a circle with an effect.” It is alignment: Heaven above, Earth below, people within, and Qi made to circulate through a chosen diagram. A formation is a promise imposed on space. It says: this door is now a Gate; this flag is now a Node; this jade plate is now an Eye; this line is where force must travel; this courtyard is no longer a courtyard, but a killing array; this mountain is no longer terrain, but a sect’s outer skin. The strongest formations in cultivation stories are not merely traps. They are infrastructure, doctrine, battlefield law, spiritual engineering, and sect power. They defend mountains. They refine pills. They hide forbidden valleys. They suppress demons. They gather spiritual veins. They turn an ordinary arena into a killing field. They allow weaker cultivators to resist stronger invaders because the place itself has been taught to cultivate. ### REALM PROGRESSION Mortal Realm: You learn to set a small combat or prepared array, choose a basic pattern, place nodes, protect or break formation eyes, and pulse the array for modest tactical effects. Foundation Realm: Your arrays awaken. Nodes may be thrown into place with Qi, patterns may be layered, gates may move, anchors may draw on the ground’s spiritual flow, and prepared sites become true defenses. Core Formation Realm: You no longer merely set an array; you preside over one. You may create a temporary Domain-like battlefield formation, nest arrays, connect prepared sites, and perform sect-scale formation engineering. Nascent Soul Realm: Your soul becomes an Array Eye. The battlefield aligns around your intent, grand formations become possible, and your prepared works may shape armies, cities, mountains, and spiritual veins. Secret Inheritance: You unfold the World-Array Scripture and briefly make Heaven, Earth, and the battlefield behave as if they were always one diagram. ### RULES BASELINE Formation uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline unless a rule in this sphere says otherwise. Action Types. Formation techniques state whether they use an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Ritual, or no action. A Ritual in this sphere is a Tianxia setup procedure, not the core spellcasting ritual tag. Areas. A Formation Array has a defined area. If an effect says it applies “inside the array,” it applies to creatures or objects within that area. If an effect says it applies when a creature crosses the boundary, it triggers only when the creature enters or leaves through the formation’s edge. Difficult Terrain. Difficult Terrain follows the normal rule: movement costs extra. Multiple sources of Difficult Terrain do not stack unless a feature says the movement cost increases further. Cover and Obscurement. A formation does not grant Cover, concealment, Lightly Obscured, Heavily Obscured, Invisible, or Hidden unless the pattern or talent says so. Concealment patterns do not automatically make creatures Hidden. Teleportation and Planar Travel. Formations do not automatically block teleportation, planar travel, Ethereal travel, possession, summoning, or spiritual projection. Only Gate, Sealing, or specific higher-Realm talents do so. Objects. Nodes, Eyes, flags, jade plates, talismans, pillars, inscribed stones, and anchors are objects unless a feature says they are purely spiritual. They can be attacked, damaged, stolen, moved, hidden, repaired, or dispelled as appropriate. Concentration. Combat Arrays require Concentration unless a talent says otherwise. Prepared Arrays usually do not require Concentration after the setup is complete, but they are fixed in place and vulnerable through their Nodes and Eye. Saving Throws and Checks. Formation save effects use your Cultivation Save DC. Formation attack effects use your Cultivation Attack Modifier. Formation design, repair, analysis, and disruption use Formation Checks. Forced Movement. Formation effects that push, pull, drag, redirect, or teleport creatures do not provoke Opportunity Attacks unless a feature says otherwise. Conditions. This sphere uses normal conditions such as Grappled, Restrained, Prone, Blinded, Deafened, Incapacitated, Unconscious, and Poisoned when named. Custom states such as Marked by the Eye, Flow-Locked, or Gate-Sealed are defined in this sphere. Prepared Sites. A Prepared Array is not a portable permanent spell. It is an installed site. The GM may require suitable ground, adequate time, visible or hidden components, access to the space, and maintenance when the array is large or strategic. ### CORE FORMATION TERMS #### FORMATION ARRAY A Formation Array is an active spatial technique shaped by Nodes, an Array Eye, and one or more Pattern Layers. An array may be a visible circle of runes, a square of flags, a hexagram of jade pegs, a line of talismans, a room of carved inscriptions, a ring of stones, a battlefield of banners, or an invisible spiritual circuit revealed only by Qi sight. #### ARRAY EYE The Array Eye is the regulating point of the formation. It may be: a jade plate; a banner; a talisman bundle; an inscribed stone; a spiritual compass; the Formation master; a prepared altar; a Formation Core in a large project. A Formation Array collapses if its Eye is destroyed, removed, suppressed, or taken outside its legal position, unless a talent says otherwise. #### NODE Nodes define and stabilize the array’s space. A Node may be a flag, peg, rune, talisman, carved mark, rod, candle, inscribed shell, spirit stone, or similar object. A basic reusable formation kit costs 50 gp and contains enough ordinary markers to set ordinary Combat and Prepared Arrays. Some talents and projects require more expensive materials. #### FLOW LINE A Flow Line is an imagined or visible path along which the formation circulates Qi. Talents may create effects along Flow Lines, allow teleportation between Nodes, transmit a pulse, or make a creature crossing a line trigger the array. #### GATE A Gate is a controlled opening, boundary, threshold, or permitted route through an array. Formation masters do not simply make walls. They decide which paths are real, which are false, and who is allowed to cross them. #### PATTERN LAYER A Pattern Layer is a functional instruction installed into an array: detection, locking, concealment, killing, restoration, suppression, amplification, reflection, and so on. An ordinary array has one Pattern Layer. Higher talents allow multiple Pattern Layers. #### ARRAY PULSE Many patterns have a Pulse. A Pulse is the active command that sends Qi through the array. Unless a feature says otherwise, you may use a Bonus Action on your turn to Pulse one Formation Array you control within 120 feet. You must be conscious, not Incapacitated, and able to perceive or spiritually sense the Array Eye. #### FORMATION LOAD You may normally maintain only one active Formation Array at a time. Dormant arrays count only while active. Prepared arrays that are installed but dormant do not count against this limit until triggered. If you create a new active array beyond your limit, choose one previous active array you control to collapse harmlessly. #### FORMATION CHECK When a feature calls for a Formation Check, roll: d20 + Proficiency Bonus + your Formation key ability modifier Your key ability is normally the key ability of your Path. Qi Cultivation commonly uses Intelligence or Wisdom. Spirit Awakening commonly uses Wisdom. Body Refining does not normally manipulate external Qi circuits; a Body Refining cultivator uses Constitution only when a feature, rare variant, or Insight lets their body serve as the Array Eye. A Formation Check may be used to: identify a formation; find hidden Nodes; repair a damaged Node; disable an enemy array; stabilize a collapsing array; redirect a Gate; contest another Formation master’s control. #### FORMATION SAVE DC Your Formation Save DC is your normal Cultivation Save DC unless a feature says otherwise. #### FORMATION ATTACK MODIFIER Your Formation Attack Modifier is your normal Cultivation Attack Modifier unless a feature says otherwise. #### FORMATION BREAKING A formation should be powerful, but it should not be untouchable. A hostile creature may break or disrupt a formation by: destroying the Array Eye; destroying enough Nodes; moving a required Node out of position; severing a Flow Line with an appropriate talent; using Qiweaving or a dispelling technique against the array; succeeding on a Formation Check against the controlling cultivator; exploiting a specific weakness built into the formation. Unless a talent says otherwise, destroying the Eye collapses the array. Destroying half the Nodes of a Prepared Array collapses it. Combat Arrays without physical Nodes collapse if their Eye is destroyed or if you lose Concentration. ### FORMATION OBJECT STATISTICS Use these default statistics unless a talent or project says otherwise. Combat Array Eye: AC 13, Hit Points equal to 5 + your CL, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Prepared Array Node: AC 15, Hit Points equal to 3 × your CL, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Prepared Array Eye: AC 15, Hit Points equal to 5 × your CL, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. Grand Formation Anchor: AC 17, Hit Points equal to 10 × your CL, Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. A Node or Eye may be hidden. If hidden, a creature must first find it before targeting it precisely. Broad damage to its space may still harm it at the GM’s discretion. ### BODY REFINING AND FORMATIONS Body Refining is not a normal external array-control Path. A Body Refining cultivator does not automatically project Qi into distant Nodes, floating diagrams, invisible Flow Lines, or detached Array Eyes. When Body Refining interacts with Formations, use one of the following models unless a specific talent, item, sect ritual, Forged Technique, or Insight says otherwise: Living Eye: the cultivator’s body is the Array Eye. The diagram turns around stance, breath, bones, scars, tattoos, armor, weapon posture, blood rhythm, or meridian gates. Physical Tools: the cultivator places flags, plates, chains, stones, rods, talismans, carved marks, footprints, weapons, shield rims, blood marks, or terrain features as actual Nodes. Prepared Sites: the cultivator can help build, maintain, defend, identify, or break a prepared formation by physical work, endurance, body-as-anchor techniques, and formation knowledge. Insight-Gated Externalization: stronger detached or partially external array use requires a Cultivation Insight, Forged Technique, sect scripture, artifact, or other explicit permission. Body Refining formations are therefore close, embodied, object-marked, and interruptible. They can be powerful, but their power comes from becoming the hinge of the diagram rather than commanding a free-floating external Qi circuit. ### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES #### FORMATION TRAINING When you gain the Formations sphere, gain proficiency with one of the following if you do not already have it: Arcana; Investigation; Religion; Survival; Calligrapher’s Supplies; Cartographer’s Tools; Mason’s Tools; Tinker’s Tools. Breaking Talents disable, analyze, steal, suppress, or collapse enemy arrays. Domain Talents create short-lived Core Formation battlefield arrays. Once per round when a hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Formation effects, regain 1 CP. A Grand Formation may defend a city district, mountain gate, battlefield, lake, canyon, fortress, valley, or sect territory. A typical Grand Formation requires: 1 year of work; at least 50,000 gp of materials; one major Formation Core; at least nine Anchors; one spiritual vein, sacred site, furnace, ancestral tomb, celestial timing, or equivalent power source; trained assistants or an organization capable of maintaining it; a visible or discoverable vulnerability; GM approval for its laws and limits. Grand Formations are campaign-scale structures. They should matter politically, militarily, economically, and spiritually. #### SOVEREIGN OF THE WORLD-DIAGRAM - DOMAIN Prerequisite: Court of the Ninefold Array, CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 60-foot-radius Emanation Duration: 1 minute Cost: 10 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest You become the moving Eye of a sovereign formation. Spiritual diagrams unfold under your feet, behind your eyes, and in the air around you. For the duration: the area is your Sovereign Array; choose three Pattern Layers you know; the array gains all three; once during each of your turns, you may Pulse one Pattern Layer without using an action; you may spend 2 CP to Pulse a second Pattern Layer during the same turn; keyed allies inside may use Formation Step as a Bonus Action; hostile creatures inside cannot benefit from teleportation unless they first succeed on a Charisma saving throw; Nodes created by this feature cannot be permanently destroyed, but each destroyed Node prevents one Pulse before reforming at the end of your next turn. You are the Array Eye. If you become Incapacitated, the Sovereign Array collapses. #### NINE PALACES KILLING ARRAY - PATTERN Prerequisite: Killing Line Pattern, CL 15+ When you create an array with the Killing Line Pattern, you may designate up to nine Nodes as killing palaces. When you Pulse the Killing Line Pattern, choose up to three hostile creatures inside the array. Make one Formation Attack roll and compare it to each target’s AC. Hit: A target takes 4d8 + your Formation key ability modifier damage. If at least two targets are hit, one Flow Line between two Nodes becomes a killing line until the start of your next turn. A hostile creature that crosses that line takes damage equal to your CL. #### MOUNTAIN-SEALING GREAT ARRAY - GATE Prerequisite: Sealing Gate Pattern, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 30-foot-radius circle Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 9 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Create a heavy sealing array with four visible Anchors. Inside the array: teleportation and planar travel fail unless the creature succeeds on a Charisma saving throw; hostile creatures cannot willingly leave by ordinary movement unless they succeed on a Strength or Charisma saving throw, their choice; ongoing non-Secret movement-enhancing effects are suppressed while their source remains inside; summoning into or out of the array fails unless the summoner succeeds on a Formation Check against your Formation Save DC. Destroying two Anchors collapses the array. You are also affected by the sealing rules unless you are keyed to the array. #### FORMATION SPIRIT - PREPARED Prerequisite: Self-Sustaining Circuit, CL 15+ You may awaken a minor spirit inside one Prepared Array or project you control. The Formation Spirit is not a full companion. It is a semi-aware steward of the array. It may: Pulse one Pattern Layer according to instructions you set; alert you within 10 miles when the array is attacked or triggered; attempt one Formation Check per round to resist disruption; speak in simple impressions to keyed creatures inside; maintain a list of keyed creatures; recognize obvious damage to Nodes, Anchors, or the Eye. If the array collapses, the Formation Spirit becomes dormant until the array is repaired or rebuilt. #### TURN THE BATTLEFIELD INSIDE OUT - GATE Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: One Formation Array you control Cost: 7 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Choose any number of keyed allies inside the array and up to the same number of hostile creatures inside it. Each hostile creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. For each failed save, you may exchange that hostile creature’s position with one chosen keyed ally, provided both spaces are legal. A creature that succeeds is not moved, but it cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. This is teleportation and fails against effects that block teleportation. #### ARRAY THAT SWALLOWS THE ATTACK - BREAKING Prerequisite: Formation Devours Technique, CL 15+ When you use Formation Devours Technique and succeed, you may spend 3 additional CP to store the caught force inside the array. Before the end of your next turn, when you Pulse the array, you may release the stored force against one target inside or crossing the array. Make a Formation Attack roll. Hit: The target takes damage equal to the amount prevented or reduced, maximum 10d8. If not released before the end of your next turn, the stored force dissipates harmlessly. #### STAR-VEIN ASTROLABE - PREPARED Prerequisite: Heavenly Grand Formation, CL 15+ When you build a Prepared, Sect, or Grand Formation under an auspicious timing, celestial event, spiritual tide, geomantic alignment, or matching terrain, choose one Astrolabe benefit: increase duration by one category, such as 8 hours to 24 hours or 24 hours to 7 days; reduce material cost by 25 percent; conceal the Eye and Anchors from ordinary sight; increase the Formation Save DC by 1; allow the formation to store a number of CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus for its own automatic Pulses. The GM determines what timing or alignment is sufficient. For important formations, finding or creating the right timing may be a story objective. ### SECRET FORMATION INHERITANCE #### HEAVEN AND EARTH BECOME THE DIAGRAM Secret Formation Inheritance Prerequisites: Sovereign of the World-Diagram, Heavenly Grand Formation, CL 17+, lost scripture, celestial revelation, sect-defining inheritance, or world-array transmission Action Type: Multi-Mode Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Action, or 1 minute if used as a prepared ritual Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_prepared_ritual_variant Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=ONE_MINUTE_PREPARED_RITUAL Range: Self Area: 300-foot-radius sphere centered on you, or one prepared site up to a comparable scale Duration: 10 minutes Cost: 20 CP Use Limit: Once per week. If used to overwrite a major existing Grand Formation, once per month. You unfold the World-Array Scripture. For a short time, the surrounding world is treated as if it had always been built from your Nodes, Gates, and Flow Lines. Choose five World Laws from the list below. The area becomes a World Array with those laws. Law of the Eye: You always know the location of creatures inside the area unless hidden by a Secret technique or stronger effect. You do not learn their thoughts, statistics, or secrets. Law of the Gate: Keyed allies may teleport up to 60 feet inside the area as a Bonus Action. Hostile creatures attempting to teleport inside, out of, or through the area must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or the teleport fails. Law of the Locked Road: Hostile creatures treat the entire area as Difficult Terrain. Once per round when a hostile creature moves more than 10 feet, you may force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, its movement ends. Law of the Hidden Road: Keyed allies have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and may Hide while Lightly Obscured inside the area. Hostile creatures have Disadvantage on checks made to find your Nodes, Eyes, hidden Gates, or concealed keyed allies. Law of the Killing Line: Once during each of your turns, choose a line up to 120 feet long inside the area. Hostile creatures on that line make Dexterity saving throws. A creature takes 8d8 Force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. Law of the Returning Breath: Once per round when a keyed ally inside the area is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, it instead drops to 1 Hit Point and is moved up to 30 feet to a legal space inside the area. A creature can benefit from this law only once per use of the inheritance. Law of the Suppressed Current: The first time each round a hostile creature spends CP inside the area, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the CP is spent and the effect fails. On a success, the effect works, but the creature cannot benefit from this law again until the start of its next turn. Law of the Shattered Formation: Choose one non-Secret Formation, Barrier, Domain, or prepared magical battlefield effect inside the area. Make a Formation Check against its creator’s save DC. On a success, suppress it while this inheritance lasts. On a failure, suppress one of its minor benefits until the end of your next turn. Law of the Nine Palaces: Divide the area into up to nine visible or invisible palaces. Once per turn, when a hostile creature crosses from one palace into another, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, choose whether it becomes lost, slowed, or exposed until the start of your next turn. A lost creature cannot willingly move closer to a chosen objective. A slowed creature’s Speed is halved. An exposed creature cannot benefit from Invisible or Half Cover. Law of the World Anchor: Create nine Anchors. Each Anchor has AC 19, Hit Points equal to 15 × your Proficiency Bonus, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The World Array does not require Concentration while at least five Anchors remain. If fewer than five remain, you must Concentrate to maintain it. If fewer than three remain, it collapses. While this inheritance lasts, you may Pulse one Pattern Layer or World Law once during each of your turns without using an action. Limits: This inheritance does not permanently create territory, erase a kingdom, make you omnipotent, automatically kill creatures, rewrite the past, or suppress a stronger Secret Inheritance without a contested scene. It does, however, allow a Formation master to fight like a sect defending its ancestral mountain. ### FORMATION DRAWBACKS AND VARIANT SCRIPTURES These drawbacks are optional sphere-specific variants. A character normally chooses no more than one when first learning Formations or during a major Formation initiation. If a drawback grants a bonus talent, the talent is lost if the drawback is later removed. #### DIAGRAM-BOUND SCRIPTURE You cannot set Combat Arrays as an Action. Your arrays require visible diagrams, flags, inscriptions, or prepared spatial marks. Gain Rapid Array or Hidden Nodes as a bonus talent. #### FLAG-BOUND LINEAGE Your arrays require physical formation flags, rods, talismans, plates, or similar markers. You cannot create purely spiritual Nodes with Awakened Array Scripture. Gain Reinforced Nodes as a bonus talent. #### SINGLE-PATTERN ORTHODOXY Choose one Basic Pattern. Whenever you set an array, it must include that Pattern as one of its Pattern Layers. Gain Layered Pattern as a bonus talent when you meet its prerequisite. Until then, gain Additional Pattern. #### IMMOVABLE EYE Your Array Eye cannot move once placed, and you cannot move Nodes with Awakened Array Scripture. Gain Expanded Geometry as a bonus talent. #### OBVIOUS GEOMETRY Your Nodes, Gates, and Flow Lines are always visibly marked by runes, light, mist, flags, chalk, blood, or spiritual pressure. Creatures have Advantage on checks made to notice your active arrays. Gain Formation Compass or Disrupt Node as a bonus talent. #### SECT ARCHITECT SCRIPTURE You cannot use Combat Arrays in initiative unless you spend 1 minute setting them up first. Your power lies in prepared sites, sect defenses, and long-term construction. Gain Triggered Array and Borrowed Geometry as bonus talents. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### QI CULTIVATION - CLASSICAL ARRAY MASTER You may use Intelligence as your Formation key ability. When you set an array on a spiritual vein, ley crossing, alchemical furnace, pill hall, forge, shrine, water source, grave site, or other power-rich location, reduce its CP cost by 1, minimum 1. Once per short rest, when you fail a Formation Check to identify, repair, or stabilize an array, you may reroll the check. #### SPIRIT AWAKENING - SOUL-DIAGRAM PERCEPTION You may use Wisdom as your Formation key ability. You can perceive spiritual Nodes, ghostly Gates, possession anchors, soul-bound Arrays, and formations built from memory or intent when they are not hidden by a stronger technique. When a spirit, ghost, possessing creature, or incorporeal creature crosses one of your Formation Gates, you may use your Reaction to force it to make a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: It cannot become Invisible, Ethereal, or Incorporeal until the start of its next turn. #### BODY REFINING - ARRAY EYE BODY This is a rare variant, not the normal way Body Refining uses Formations. A Body Refining formation practitioner does not freely manipulate external Qi. They make the body, stance, scars, armor, weapon, breath rhythm, or physical array tools carry the diagram. You may use Constitution as your Formation key ability and Stamina in place of CP for Formation talents, but only for arrays that follow the limits below. When you use Formations through Body Refining, you may treat yourself as the Array Eye of one Combat Array you create or maintain. While you are the Array Eye: the array must be centered on you or on a physical object you are touching; its Nodes must be physical markers, terrain features, weapons, flags, stones, plates, blood marks, footprints, scars, armor seams, shield rims, or similar tangible objects; you cannot create floating, invisible, or purely external Qi Nodes unless another talent, Insight, item, or Forged Technique explicitly allows it; you cannot maintain a Combat Array whose Eye is detached from your body unless another feature externalizes the Eye; if you are moved against your will, knocked Prone, Incapacitated, Restrained by a stronger effect, or removed from the array’s area, the array becomes Unstable until the start of your next turn; while Unstable, the array’s Passive effect remains, but you cannot trigger its Pulse. When you take the Attack action, Dash, Dodge, or use a Body Refining feature while inside an array you personally anchor, you may also trigger one available Pulse from that Formation if the Pulse is otherwise legal. You may do this no more than once per turn. A Body Refining cultivator using this synergy is not commanding a detached diagram from afar. Their body is the hinge on which the formation turns. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### FORMATION APPRENTICE Prerequisite: Formations sphere, CL 4+ Learn one additional Basic Pattern. When you set a Prepared Array, reduce the setup time by half. #### HIDDEN NODE ADEPT Prerequisite: Hidden Nodes, CL 6+ Creatures have Disadvantage on the first check they make each day to find one of your hidden Nodes or Eyes. When a hostile creature fails to find one of your Nodes, you may move one Node in the same array up to 5 feet without using an action. #### FORMATION BREAKER Prerequisite: Formation Compass or Disrupt Node, CL 8+ When you succeed on a Formation Check to identify or disrupt an enemy array, gain Advantage on your next attack roll, saving throw, or Formation Check against that array before the end of your next turn. Once per short rest, when you would fail a Formation Check against an array by 2 or less, you may choose to succeed instead. #### MOVING ARRAY FOOTWORK Prerequisite: Awakened Array Scripture, CL 8+ When you Pulse a Combat Array, you may move yourself 5 feet along one of its Flow Lines without provoking Opportunity Attacks. If you end this movement adjacent to a Node or the Eye, gain Half Cover until the start of your next turn. #### SECT ARCHITECT Prerequisite: Sect Formation Design, CL 12+ Reduce the time required to design and build Sect Formations by 25 percent. When you create a Sect Formation, you may define one hidden maintenance chamber, false Node, or decoy Eye as part of the project without increasing cost. #### GRAND ARRAY HEIR Prerequisite: Heavenly Grand Formation, CL 16+ When defending a formation you created, add your Proficiency Bonus to the first Formation Check you make each round. Once per long rest, when a Grand Formation Anchor you control would be destroyed, it instead remains at 1 Hit Point and becomes dormant until repaired.

Range: See chosen mode

##### COMBAT ARRAY
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Area: 10-foot-radius circle centered on a point you can see within range
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You cast a flag, plate, talisman, line of Qi, or quick diagram into place and create a temporary battlefield array.
Choose one Basic Pattern you know. The array gains that pattern’s Passive effect and Pulse effect.
The Combat Array has one visible or spiritually visible Array Eye at its center. It collapses if the Eye is destroyed, if you lose Concentration, or if you create another active array beyond your Formation Load.
##### PREPARED ARRAY
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Area: 20-foot-radius circle, one room, one courtyard, one gatehouse, one bridge, or a comparable bounded site
Duration: 8 hours
Cost: 3 CP
You install Nodes and an Array Eye into a location. Choose one Basic Pattern you know. The array gains that pattern’s Passive effect and Pulse effect.
A Prepared Array does not require Concentration once completed. It is fixed in place. It uses three Nodes and one Eye by default.
If two of its three Nodes are destroyed, or if its Eye is destroyed, removed, or suppressed, the array collapses.

resolved_automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### PULSE ARRAY
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Target: One active Formation Array you control within range
Cost: None
Choose one Pattern Layer currently installed in the target array. Resolve that Pattern Layer's complete Pulse effect as part of this Bonus Action.
The selected Pulse determines its own eligible targets, saving throws, damage, movement, duration, states, and other results. Unless that Pattern says otherwise, the Pulse originates from the Formation Array and can affect only creatures, objects, or spaces that are legal targets for that Pattern inside or at the boundary of the array.
Pulsing one Pattern Layer does not activate the array's other Pattern Layers. If the selected Pulse requires a choice of target or mode, make that choice when you use this Bonus Action.
Unless a feature says otherwise, a creature may be affected by the same named Pattern Pulse only once per round.

Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self, touch, or a held object
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 0 CP
Choose one legal Glass Surface: your body, worn armor, held weapon, held shield, held object, or a solid surface you are touching.
Until the effect ends, the chosen surface becomes tempered by Glass cultivation. It may become transparent, crystalline, mirror-bright, veined with clear faultlines, or visibly glass-boned, as appropriate to the surface.
A tempered surface is the anchor for your Faultline Marks and Refraction Responses.
You may maintain one tempered Glass Surface at a time. This increases to two at CL 5, three at CL 11, and four at CL 17.
If you temper your own body, this does not make you fragile by itself. Specific talents may create brittle benefits or risks.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Refraction Responses
When a creature, object, attack line, or Glass Surface with a Faultline Mark is involved in a triggering event, you may spend the mark to use one Refraction Response you know.
Unless a talent says otherwise, you may use only one Refraction Response per triggering event.
You know the following Refraction Responses when you learn Glass.
##### Turn the Angle
Trigger: A marked creature hits you or an ally within 5 feet of one of your tempered Glass Surfaces.
Reduce the triggering damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
At CL 5, reduce it by 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 11, reduce it by 3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 17, reduce it by 4d8 + your Proficiency Bonus.
If this reduces the damage to 0, the attacker cannot make Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn.
##### Visible Crack
Trigger: A marked creature attempts to Hide, become Invisible, benefit from Cover, or conceal the origin of an attack or technique.
Until the start of your next turn, you and allies who can see one of your Glass Surfaces know the marked creature’s space, even if the creature is Invisible or hidden.
This does not reveal a creature through Total Cover unless the Glass Surface also has line of sight to the creature.
##### Bitter Edge
Trigger: A marked creature willingly moves 5 feet or more.
The creature takes Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
At CL 11+, you may also make the first square of movement through your adjacent space or your Glass Surface count as difficult terrain.
##### Shatter Warning
Trigger: A marked creature makes an attack roll through or against one of your Glass Surfaces.
Impose a -2 penalty on the triggering attack roll.
If the attack misses, the marked creature takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
##### Refracted Step
Trigger: You spend a Faultline Mark on a creature within 5 feet of you or your tempered Glass Surface.
Move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the marked creature.
At CL 5, move 10 feet. At CL 11, move 15 feet. At CL 17, move 20 feet.
##### Break the Line
Trigger: A marked object, barrier, weapon, shield, door, or Glass Surface takes damage.
Add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage dealt to that object or surface.
If the object is reduced to 0 HP, choose one creature within 5 feet of it. That creature takes Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
