spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Iron Fist Qi Expression: Primary — Hardened-Body Qi; Supporting — Metal Qi, Bone Qi, Yang Qi, Impact Qi. “The hand is empty only to those who cannot hear the bones remembering war.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus; some Path synergies and Forged Techniques may also spend CP or Stamina when explicitly stated Common Effects: Unarmed strikes, palm blows, elbows, knees, kicks, stance chains, Shoves, Grapples, pressure-point attacks, breath timing, close-range counters, body conditioning, iron-body forms, projected fist intent, meridian disruption Iron Fist cultivates the body as a complete weapon: fists, palms, elbows, knees, kicks, stance chains, pressure, counters, and disciplined striking anatomy. ### Player-Facing Rules #### Iron Fist Dao Iron Fist is the cultivation of the body as a complete weapon. A Brute asks how much weight can be moved. An Iron Fist practitioner asks where the body is already weak, where the breath breaks, where the foot cannot recover, and which joint has already lost the argument. The fist is only the first lesson. The Dao includes: straight punches that follow the centerline; palm strikes that transmit force through armor and flesh; elbows and knees used where weapons cannot turn; kicks that break stance, distance, and rhythm; shoulder checks and body turns that change an opponent’s structure; breath timing that makes one strike arrive with the whole body behind it; pressure-point disruption; iron conditioning; disciplined forms that turn ordinary movement into attack. A novice learns where to place the fist. An adept learns that the fist begins in the foot, waist, breath, and intent. A master learns to strike a body through the place where it is least prepared to remain whole. A sovereign learns that Heaven itself has a meridian. The Iron Fist loop is: Set the body. Choose a stance, angle, or breath. Open the gate. Land an Unarmed Strike, Shove, Grapple, or body-check that creates an Opening. Follow the form. Apply one Form talent to damage, reposition, disrupt, or seal. Chain the rhythm. Use movement, repeated strikes, counters, and Focus recovery to stay inside the enemy’s guard. Strike the principle. At higher Realms, the attack reaches meridians, spiritual structure, and the opponent’s cultivated self-image. After fighting an Iron Fist cultivator for two rounds, an opponent should understand one truth: The body has more doors than armor can guard. #### Rules Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. ##### Unarmed Strike Under the 2024 rules, an Unarmed Strike is a melee attack made with the body. It may be used to: deal damage; Grapple; Shove. The Damage option uses an attack roll. The Grapple and Shove options use a saving throw against a DC based on Strength and Proficiency Bonus unless another rule changes the ability used. Iron Fist modifies those options rather than replacing the entire Unarmed Strike rule. ##### Grapple and Shove The ordinary 2024 Grapple and Shove options remain available. Iron Fist talents state when they: modify the Save DC; use Dexterity or another ability; add a rider after a successful Shove or Grapple; allow a non-hand body part to maintain a limited clinch; exceed ordinary size limits. ##### Special Attacks When an Iron Fist talent says it is a Special Attack, replace one attack when you take the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different Action Type. ##### No Weapon Mastery by Default Unarmed Strikes are not weapons. Iron Fist does not automatically grant Weapon Mastery properties. A Forged Technique, Insight, class feature, or special training may create a weapon-mastery-like effect, but that effect is local to the feature that grants it. ##### Opportunity Attacks An Opportunity Attack may use an Unarmed Strike. Iron Fist talents state when they modify Opportunity Attacks or allow a counter. ##### Multiple Listed Costs When a talent lists multiple possible costs, pay exactly one legal cost unless the talent explicitly says otherwise. Spend CP when using Qi or Resonance to fuel the technique. Spend Stamina only when a Body Refining feature permits that expression. Expend Martial Focus only when the talent lists that option. #### Core Iron Fist Rules ##### Martial Focus Iron Fist uses Martial Focus. Unless a broader martial-sphere rule later replaces this wording: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is currently absent. Martial Focus represents breath, posture, structure, timing, and the brief instant in which the whole body is one weapon. ##### Iron Fist Ability When you learn Iron Fist, choose Strength or Dexterity as your Iron Fist ability. Use your Iron Fist ability for: attack rolls made with Unarmed Strikes through this sphere; damage rolls made with Unarmed Strikes through this sphere; the Save DC of your Iron Fist talents; the Save DC of your Unarmed Strike’s Grapple and Shove options when you apply an Iron Fist talent to that Grapple or Shove. Your Iron Fist Save DC equals: 8 + your Iron Fist ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus Path synergies may allow Constitution, Intelligence, Charisma, or Wisdom to become your Iron Fist ability. ##### Iron Fist Die Your Unarmed Strike damage die becomes the value shown on the Iron Fist Die table when the Unarmed Strike is made through this sphere. Cultivation Level: 1-4; One hand occupied or using armor normally: 1d6; Both hands free and not wielding a Shield: 1d8 Cultivation Level: 5-10; One hand occupied or using armor normally: 1d8; Both hands free and not wielding a Shield: 1d10 Cultivation Level: 11-16; One hand occupied or using armor normally: 1d10; Both hands free and not wielding a Shield: 1d12 Cultivation Level: 17-20; One hand occupied or using armor normally: 1d12; Both hands free and not wielding a Shield: 2d6 If another feature gives your Unarmed Strike a larger damage die, use the larger die. Do not add both dice together unless a feature explicitly says it adds damage. ##### Opening An Opening is a moment when a creature’s stance, guard, breath, balance, or meridian rhythm is exposed. Unless a talent says otherwise: an Opening lasts until the end of your next turn; a creature may bear only one of your Openings at a time; Opening is not a condition; Opening does not reveal location; Opening does not provide exact-square knowledge; Opening does not bypass concealment or Total Cover; Opening ends early if you become Incapacitated. A creature becomes Opened by you when either of the following occurs: you hit it with an Unarmed Strike that deals damage; it fails a saving throw against a Grapple or Shove option of your Unarmed Strike. Some talents have stronger effects against a creature that was already Opened before the triggering strike or maneuver resolved. ##### Open the Gate Once per turn when you Open a creature, choose one of the following immediate effects. ###### Centerline Impact If the triggering Unarmed Strike dealt damage, add your Proficiency Bonus to that damage. ###### Hooking Step Move yourself 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the Opened creature, or move the Opened creature 5 feet into a legal space if it is no more than one size larger than you. This movement is not a Brute collision effect. ###### Breath-Checking Strike The Opened creature cannot take Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. ##### Form Talents Some Iron Fist talents have the Form tag. A Form talent modifies one Unarmed Strike or one Open the Gate effect. Unless a talent says otherwise: apply no more than one Form talent to a single Unarmed Strike; choose the Form talent before rolling the attack or before the target rolls its saving throw; a Form talent applies only if the Unarmed Strike hits or the target fails its saving throw; a Form talent that refers to an Opened creature means a creature already Opened before the triggering strike or maneuver resolved; a Form talent does not add damage unless it says it does. ##### Sequence Talents Some Iron Fist talents have the Sequence tag. A Sequence talent rewards chaining strikes, movement, Grapples, Shoves, and stance changes during the same turn. Unless a talent says otherwise: apply one Sequence talent per turn; the Sequence must include at least one Unarmed Strike; a missed attack or successful saving throw does not break the Sequence, but it may prevent a talent’s rider from applying. ##### Guard Talents Some Iron Fist talents have the Guard tag. A Guard talent modifies defense, counters, body conditioning, or reactions. Iron Fist Guard talents represent stance, forearms, shoulders, breath, and conditioned flesh. They do not count as Shields, Protection Aegises, or Guardian Interposes unless a talent explicitly says otherwise. ##### Meridian Talents Some Iron Fist talents have the Meridian tag. A Meridian talent disrupts breath, nerve, circulation, spiritual rhythm, or cultivated structure. A creature without ordinary anatomy may still have an analogous structure, such as joints, seams, animating essence, spirit channels, or pressure patterns. The GM determines whether a specific Meridian talent can affect unusual creatures. ##### Body Weapon Iron Fist treats the following as expressions of Unarmed Strike: punch; palm strike; elbow; knee; kick; headbutt; shoulder check; hip check; body slam; stance sweep. Unless a talent says otherwise, a creature still needs a free hand to maintain an ordinary Grapple. Some Iron Fist talents allow temporary clinches using legs, shoulders, elbows, or body pressure. #### Base Sphere Abilities ##### Iron Fist Training When you learn Iron Fist: gain proficiency in Strength (Athletics), Dexterity (Acrobatics), or Wisdom (Medicine); if already proficient in all three, choose one Iron Fist talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; choose Strength or Dexterity as your Iron Fist ability; gain the Iron Fist Die; choose one Mortal Realm Form talent for which you meet the prerequisites. ##### Open the Gate You gain the Opening and Open the Gate rules described above. ##### Centered Breath When you take the Dodge action while unarmed or using only Unarmed Strikes, regain Martial Focus if it is absent. Once per turn when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike while holding Martial Focus, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature. #### Iron Fist Talent Tags ##### Form Talents A Form talent modifies one Unarmed Strike or Open the Gate effect. ##### Sequence Talents A Sequence talent rewards chaining strikes, Shoves, Grapples, movement, or repeated contact. ##### Guard Talents A Guard talent improves defensive stance, counters, and body conditioning. ##### Meridian Talents A Meridian talent disrupts bodily or spiritual structure. ##### Focus Talents A Focus talent recovers, expends, or modifies Martial Focus. ##### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents martial art beyond ordinary physical training. ##### Unique Iron Fist Talents A Unique Iron Fist talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another tag. #### Mortal Realm Talents ##### Breaking Knuckle - Form When your Unarmed Strike deals damage, add Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If the target was already Opened, it has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the end of your next turn. ##### Sweeping Kick - Form When a creature fails the saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Shove option and you choose to give it the Prone condition, it also takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Iron Fist ability modifier, minimum 1. If the creature was already Opened, standing from Prone costs it an additional 10 feet of movement before the end of its next turn. ##### Driving Heel - Form When a creature fails the saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Shove option and you push it, increase the push distance by 5 feet. If the creature was already Opened, increase the push distance by 10 feet instead, and you may move 5 feet toward the creature without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it. This movement is not an Impact Collision and does not trigger Brute Collision talents. ##### Wrist-Trapping Hand - Form When a creature fails the saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Grapple option, choose one object it is holding. Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls made with that object against creatures other than you. If the target was already Opened, it also cannot use that object to make Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn. ##### Rising Knee - Form When your Unarmed Strike deals damage to a creature you are Grappling, or to a creature Grappling you, deal additional Bludgeoning damage equal to 1d6. If the target was already Opened, also reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. ##### Palm Feint - Form, Focus Before making an Unarmed Strike, expend Martial Focus. Gain Advantage on the attack roll, or impose Disadvantage on the target’s saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Grapple or Shove option. If the target was already Opened, regain Martial Focus after the strike resolves. ##### Elbow in the Door - Form When your Unarmed Strike deals damage to a creature within 5 feet, choose one space adjacent to both you and the target. Until the start of your next turn, the target treats that space as difficult terrain. If the target was already Opened, you may also prevent it from willingly moving through that space until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw against your Iron Fist Save DC. ##### Hammer-and-Anvil Rhythm - Sequence Once per turn, when you hit the same creature with two or more Unarmed Strikes during your turn, choose one: apply Open the Gate again to that creature; extend the creature’s Opening until the end of your next turn; regain Martial Focus if it is absent. ##### Crane-Step Combination - Sequence After you hit with an Unarmed Strike, move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target. If your next Unarmed Strike before the end of the turn targets a different creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to its damage on a hit. ##### Rooting Stance - Guard, Focus Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: None Root your breath and lower body. Until the duration ends: gain Advantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws against effects that would move you or knock you Prone; reduce forced movement affecting you by 5 feet; if a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature. If you expend Martial Focus when entering Rooting Stance, reduce forced movement by 10 feet instead. ##### Iron Forearm Guard - Guard Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you can see hits you with a melee attack Cost: None Reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus + your Iron Fist ability modifier. If this reduces the damage to 0, the attacker becomes Opened by you until the end of your next turn. ##### Counter Palm - Guard, Focus Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within reach misses you with a melee attack Cost: Expend Martial Focus Make one Unarmed Strike against the triggering creature. If the attack hits, you may apply one Form talent you know. ##### Body Conditioning - Guard While holding Martial Focus and not wielding a Shield, gain a +1 bonus to AC. When you take Bludgeoning damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus. ##### Focusing Breath - Focus When you use Centered Breath to regain Martial Focus by taking the Dodge action, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once per turn when you Open a creature and then end your turn within 5 feet of it, regain Martial Focus if it is absent. ##### Open-Hand Disarm - Unique Iron Fist Talent When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you may forgo Open the Gate to attempt to disarm one object it is holding. Make an Unarmed Strike attack roll contested by the target’s Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics), target’s choice. Success: The target drops one held object of your choice. Failure: No additional effect. You have Disadvantage on the attack roll if the target holds the object with two or more hands. The target has Advantage if larger than you and Disadvantage if smaller. If you possess the Scoundrel sphere, you may immediately use Steal against the dropped object if it is within your reach. ##### Iron Shirt Practice - Unique Iron Fist Talent After each long rest, choose one damage type: Bludgeoning; Piercing; Slashing. While holding Martial Focus and wearing no Heavy armor, reduce damage of the chosen type by your Proficiency Bonus when it is dealt by a nonmagical weapon, natural weapon, or Unarmed Strike. At CL 10+, you may choose Force as the damage type if the damage comes from a physical impact or martial technique. ##### Merciful Hand - Unique Iron Fist Talent When your Unarmed Strike would reduce a creature to 0 HP, you may leave it at 1 HP and choose one: knock it Prone; Grapple it if you have a free hand and it is a legal target; prevent it from taking Reactions until the end of its next turn; immediately move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from it. When you use Merciful Hand, regain Martial Focus if absent. #### Foundation Realm Talents ##### Iron Meridian Body - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Your Iron Fist techniques become openly supernatural. Gain the following benefits: your Unarmed Strikes count as magical cultivation attacks for overcoming Resistance and Immunity; your Unarmed Strikes may deal Bludgeoning or Force damage, chosen when you hit; you may strike incorporeal creatures normally with Unarmed Strikes; when you use an Unarmed Strike to damage an unattended object, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage. Iron Meridian Body does not allow you to strike through Total Cover or attack creatures on another plane. ##### Breath-Extended Strike - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ While holding Martial Focus, your Unarmed Strike reach increases by 5 feet. When you expend Martial Focus before making an Unarmed Strike, your reach for that strike becomes 30 feet. A Breath-Extended Strike may appear as: compressed fist Qi; a palm imprint crossing the air; a whip-crack kick of force; a dragon-shaped exhalation; a visible ripple from your stance through the ground. This is still an Unarmed Strike. It does not allow general telekinesis, object manipulation, grappling through walls, or sustained remote force. ##### Meridian-Sealing Palm - Meridian, Form Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you hit an Opened creature with an Unarmed Strike that deals damage, expend Martial Focus. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one seal until the end of its next turn. Arm Seal: The target has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes with one arm or comparable limb. Leg Seal: The target’s Speed is reduced by 15 feet. Breath Seal: The target cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw it makes. Voice Seal: The target cannot speak above a whisper or activate an ability requiring clear speech. Successful Save: The target cannot take Opportunity Attacks until the start of your next turn. A creature without recognizable anatomy may still be affected if it has comparable movement, attack, breath, voice, or spiritual channels. ##### Flowing Combination - Sequence Prerequisite: CL 5+ Once per turn after you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, you may immediately use the Grapple or Shove option of Unarmed Strike against that same creature without spending an additional attack. If the creature was already Opened, it makes the saving throw against this Grapple or Shove with Disadvantage. ##### Iron Fist Flurry - Sequence, Focus Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you take the Attack action and make at least one Unarmed Strike, expend Martial Focus to make one additional Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action. If another feature already allows you to make an Unarmed Strike as a Bonus Action, you may instead add your Iron Fist ability modifier to the damage of one Unarmed Strike you hit with before the end of your turn. ##### Falling Leaf Sweep - Form Prerequisite: Sweeping Kick, CL 5+ When a creature fails its saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Shove option and you give it the Prone condition, choose one other creature within 5 feet of the target. That second creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: It falls Prone. Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the original target was already Opened, choose two creatures within 5 feet instead of one. ##### Dragon-Step Clinch - Form Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a creature fails the saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Grapple option, you may maintain the grapple with a leg hook, shoulder pressure, elbow clamp, or body clinch instead of a free hand. A body clinch follows these rules: you may maintain only one body clinch at a time; you cannot maintain a body clinch while Restrained, Prone, or Incapacitated; your Speed is reduced by 10 feet while maintaining it; the target has Advantage on checks made to escape unless it was Opened when the grapple began; you may end the clinch at any time without spending an Action. Dragon-Step Clinch supports knees, elbows, and close-body forms without replacing the Wrestling sphere. ##### Axe-Kick Descent - Form Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you fall at least 10 feet, jump down, or descend from a higher space and hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike before the end of the turn, add 2d6 Bludgeoning or Force damage. If the target was already Opened, it makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Fall Prone. Successful Save: No additional effect. Reduce any falling damage you take during this descent by 5 × your Proficiency Bonus. ##### Bell-Ringing Body Shot - Meridian Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you hit an Opened creature with an Unarmed Strike, choose one: the target has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks until the start of your next turn; the target cannot take the Dash action until the end of its next turn; the target’s next attack roll before the end of its next turn deals reduced damage equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus. ##### Empty Palm Stops the Blade - Guard Prerequisite: Iron Forearm Guard, CL 5+ When Iron Forearm Guard reduces damage from a melee weapon attack, you may expend Martial Focus. Make an Unarmed Strike attack roll against the attacker’s AC. Hit: Choose one: disarm the triggering weapon into a legal adjacent space; reduce the triggering damage by an additional 2d8; make the attacker Opened by you until the end of your next turn. ##### Wall-Rebound Kick - Sequence Prerequisite: CL 5+ If you move at least 10 feet and pass adjacent to a wall, pillar, larger creature, tree, or other solid surface, your next Unarmed Strike before the end of the turn gains one benefit: add 1d8 damage; increase its reach by 5 feet; after it resolves, move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target. This talent does not allow general wall-running. For sustained traversal, use Athletics. ##### Medicine of the Closed Gate - Meridian Prerequisite: Proficiency in Wisdom (Medicine), CL 5+ When you spend 1 minute treating a willing creature, make a Wisdom (Medicine) check against DC 15. Success: End one ordinary muscle cramp, joint strain, breath disruption, or similar nonmagical penalty caused by a martial technique. During combat, you may use an Action and expend Martial Focus to apply this treatment to yourself or a willing creature within reach. On a successful check, the target may immediately repeat one saving throw against a Meridian talent, Grappled condition, Prone-related martial hindrance, or similar bodily disruption. #### Core Formation Realm Talents ##### Court of One Hundred Forms - Martial Domain “The enemy saw one body. The mistake was counting only two hands.” Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest Create a 30-foot Emanation of disciplined martial pressure. Within the Court, every step, turn, breath, and stance change becomes part of a larger form. For the duration: your Unarmed Strike reach increases by 5 feet; once per turn when you Open a creature, apply one Form talent you know without counting against your normal one-Form limit; once per turn when you hit an Opened creature with an Unarmed Strike, regain Martial Focus if absent; when you take the Dodge action, make one Unarmed Strike before the end of that action; hostile creatures you have Opened treat spaces adjacent to you as difficult terrain; when a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature. Court of One Hundred Forms ends early if you become Incapacitated. This Domain does not create independent duplicates, command allies, or turn the entire battlefield into difficult terrain. It represents your body controlling the nearby exchange. ##### One-Inch Heavenquake - Meridian, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Cost: Expend Martial Focus Make one Unarmed Strike against a creature or object within reach. On a hit, add 4d8 Force damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It is Stunned until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. If the target was already Opened, the attack ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning and Force damage. One-Inch Heavenquake can damage unattended objects and temporary Barriers. It does not automatically destroy artifacts, Domains, Formation cores, or Realm-defining structures. ##### Hundred-Form Combination - Sequence Prerequisite: Flowing Combination, CL 10+ When you take the Attack action and make at least two Unarmed Strikes, choose two different Form talents you know. Until the end of your turn, each chosen Form may be applied once without counting against your normal one-Form limit. You cannot apply the same Form twice to one strike. ##### Meridian Lock - Meridian Prerequisite: Meridian-Sealing Palm, CL 10+ When a creature fails its saving throw against Meridian-Sealing Palm, choose two seals instead of one. If the creature was already Opened, you may instead choose one seal and impose the following additional effect: Body-Locked: The target’s Speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn, and it has Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws. ##### Sky-Shattering Axe Kick - Form Prerequisite: Axe-Kick Descent, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Leap, descend, or drive a vertical kick through the target’s guard. Choose one creature within your movement reach. Move up to half your Speed to a legal space adjacent to it. This movement may include a vertical leap up to 15 feet and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the target. Make one Unarmed Strike. Hit: Add 4d6 Bludgeoning or Force damage. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Fall Prone and become Opened until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 15 feet until the start of your next turn. ##### Iron Fist Breaks the Weapon - Guard, Meridian Prerequisite: Empty Palm Stops the Blade, CL 10+ When a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack, expend Martial Focus. Make an Unarmed Strike against the attacker or against the weapon used for the triggering attack. If you target the attacker and hit, apply one Form talent. If you target the weapon and hit, the weapon takes the attack’s damage. If the weapon is nonmagical and the damage equals or exceeds its Damage Threshold or GM-set durability, it breaks. A magical weapon, artifact, or soul-bound weapon may resist with a Cultivation Check against your Iron Fist Save DC. ##### Internal Hammer - Meridian Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you hit an Opened creature with an Unarmed Strike, expend Martial Focus. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one ongoing physical or martial effect affecting the target, such as a stance, guard, body enhancement, rage-like state, mobility technique, or temporary damage reduction. Suppress that effect until the end of the target’s next turn. Successful Save: The effect is not suppressed, but the target cannot benefit from Advantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. Internal Hammer does not suppress Domains, Secret Inheritances, permanent transformations, artifacts, or effects that do not depend on the target’s bodily or spiritual structure. ##### Tiger-Crane Alternation - Sequence Prerequisite: CL 10+ Once per turn when you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, choose Tiger or Crane. Tiger: Add your Iron Fist ability modifier to the next Shove or Grapple Save DC you impose before the end of the turn. Crane: Move up to 15 feet before your next Unarmed Strike this turn without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the creature you hit. If the target was already Opened, gain both benefits. ##### Bell-Tower Body - Guard, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Body Conditioning, CL 10+ While holding Martial Focus and not wearing Heavy armor: reduce Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage from nonmagical attacks by your Proficiency Bonus; gain Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone; when a creature hits you with an Unarmed Strike, natural weapon, or nonmagical melee weapon, it takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ##### Eight-Gate Diagnosis - Meridian Prerequisite: Medicine of the Closed Gate, CL 10+ As an Action, study one creature within 30 feet that you can perceive. Make a Wisdom (Medicine), Intelligence (Investigation), or Cultivation Check against the creature’s Cultivation Save DC. Success: Learn two of the following: whether it is Bloodied; whether it has Resistance to Bludgeoning, Force, or nonmagical physical damage; whether it has immunity to Prone, Grappled, Stunned, or forced movement; whether it is maintaining an ongoing bodily or martial enhancement; which saving throw among Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution appears weakest. Until the end of your next turn, your first Unarmed Strike against that creature has Advantage. ##### Fists Ring Like Bells - Unique Iron Fist Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 15-foot cone Cost: Expend Martial Focus Release a series of compressed palm strikes. Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take 4d8 Thunder or Force damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no additional effect. Creatures already Opened by you have Disadvantage on the saving throw. #### Nascent Soul Realm Talents ##### Sovereign Iron-Body Incarnation “The master did not raise a hand. Every bone in the room remembered how to be struck.” Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign incarnation of cultivated martial form. For the duration: gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, and Force damage; your Unarmed Strike reach increases by 10 feet; your Breath-Extended Strike range becomes 60 feet when you expend Martial Focus; your Unarmed Strikes ignore Resistance to Bludgeoning and Force damage; once per turn when you hit with an Unarmed Strike, apply one additional Form talent you know; once per round when a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, make one Unarmed Strike against it without spending your Reaction; when you Open a creature, learn whether Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution is its weakest saving throw; regain Martial Focus when you reduce a creature to 0 HP or cause a creature to fail a saving throw against one of your Iron Fist talents. Sovereign Iron-Body Incarnation ends early if you become Incapacitated. ##### Thousand-Hand War Body Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot Emanation Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Your afterimages, breath, and striking intent fill the area with a storm of blows. Choose any number of creatures in the area. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take 8d8 Bludgeoning or Force damage, become Opened until the end of your next turn, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and become Opened until the start of your next turn. After resolving the technique, move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. ##### Nine-Bell Meridian Palm Prerequisite: Meridian Lock, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Make one Unarmed Strike. Hit: Add 6d10 Thunder or Force damage. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose three seals from Meridian-Sealing Palm. The seals last for 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending one seal of its choice on a success. Successful Save: Choose one seal from Meridian-Sealing Palm until the end of the target’s next turn. If the target was already Opened, it has Disadvantage on the first saving throw. ##### Heaven-Seizing Clinch Prerequisite: Dragon-Step Clinch, CL 15+ You may use Dragon-Step Clinch against creatures up to two sizes larger than you. When you maintain a body clinch, you are no longer slowed by that clinch. Once per turn when you hit a creature you are Grappling or body-clinching with an Unarmed Strike, choose one: move the creature 10 feet with you into legal spaces; force it to make a Constitution saving throw or become unable to take Reactions until the start of your next turn; add 2d8 Force damage. Heaven-Seizing Clinch does not allow you to carry a mountain-sized monster, living fortress, divine manifestation, or scene-defining creature merely because it uses a standard size category. ##### Quivering Gate Strike - Meridian Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per creature per long rest Make one Unarmed Strike. Hit: The target takes normal damage and gains a hidden quivering mark for 1 minute. While the mark lasts, you may use an Action to release it if the target is within 120 feet and on the same plane. When released, the target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take 10d10 Force damage and become Stunned until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. The mark ends after release. A creature can bear only one of your Quivering Gate Strike marks at a time. ##### Palm That Moves the Empty Bell Prerequisite: Breath-Extended Strike, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Strike one visible creature, object, or temporary Barrier with a palm force that travels through air, water, or a continuous solid surface. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack using your Iron Fist ability. Hit: Deal 8d8 Force damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Move it 20 feet in one legal direction and knock it Prone. Successful Save: Move it 5 feet in one legal direction. This is not general Force control. The attack must travel along a clear route or continuous surface from you to the target. ##### Empty-Hand Breaks the Formation Door Prerequisite: One-Inch Heavenquake, CL 15+ When One-Inch Heavenquake hits a temporary Barrier, Formation Anchor, sealed door, artifact shell, or other defensive structure, add 6d8 Force damage. If the target is not an artifact, Domain, Secret Inheritance, or Realm-defining structure, you may also force a Cultivation Check against your Iron Fist Save DC. Failed Check: Suppress one defensive property of the target until the end of your next turn. Successful Check: No suppression. A permanent Formation, artifact, sect gate, or comparable structure may require a dedicated scene or project to fully destroy. ##### World-Tempering Body Prerequisite: Bell-Tower Body, CL 15+ While holding Martial Focus: you cannot be knocked Prone unless the source succeeds on a Strength check or Cultivation Check against your Iron Fist Save DC; reduce forced movement affecting you by 15 feet; when you take damage from a melee attack, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus after the damage resolves; your Unarmed Strikes can damage objects as though made with adamantine for the purpose of ignoring ordinary object Damage Thresholds. #### Secret Iron Fist Inheritance ##### The Fist That Taught Heaven to Flinch “Heaven did not fall. It only stepped back. For one breath, that was enough.” Classification: Secret Iron Fist Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Sovereign Iron-Body Incarnation, hidden iron-body scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Reach, or 60 feet through Breath-Extended Strike Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Make one Unarmed Strike against one creature, object, temporary Barrier, or supernatural defensive effect. Before rolling: gain Advantage; ignore Disadvantage; treat the target as Opened; your attack ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning, Thunder, and Force damage; if the attack targets an object or temporary Barrier, ignore ordinary object Damage Thresholds. Hit: Add 12d10 Force or Thunder damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose three consequences. The target is Stunned until the end of your next turn. The target falls Prone and cannot stand until the start of your next turn. The target cannot take Reactions for 1 minute. The target’s Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn. Suppress one non-Secret bodily, martial, or movement technique affecting the target for 1 minute. Apply three seals from Meridian-Sealing Palm for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending one seal on a success. Move the target up to 30 feet in one legal direction without triggering Brute Collision talents. You immediately move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Successful Save: Choose one consequence other than Stunned. If the target is an object, temporary Barrier, Formation Anchor, or defensive effect, deal double total damage and make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s rank or DC. Successful Check: Breach, suppress, or shatter one defensive layer until the end of your next turn. Failed Check: The target is damaged but not breached. The Fist That Taught Heaven to Flinch does not automatically destroy: artifacts; permanent Formations; Domains; Secret Inheritances; Realm-defining structures; cosmic offices; living worlds; Heaven itself. Those may still be meaningfully damaged, humiliated, interrupted, or turned into the subject of a campaign. #### Iron Fist Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures An Iron Fist variant changes what the practitioner believes the body is for. These variants are mutually exclusive unless a talent says otherwise. ##### Soft Palm Scripture “The gentle hand does not spare the enemy. It only chooses the door that opens inward.” You cannot choose Breaking Knuckle as your starting Form talent. ###### Benefit Gain Meridian-Sealing Palm as a bonus talent when you reach CL 5. Until then, gain Palm Feint as a bonus talent. When a creature fails a saving throw against your Unarmed Strike’s Grapple or Shove option, you may Open it without dealing damage. Soft Palm practitioners specialize in Openings, control, and meridian disruption over raw damage. ##### Leg-Iron Path “A fist travels from the shoulder. A kick begins at the earth.” You must describe most Iron Fist attacks as kicks, knees, sweeps, or lower-body techniques. You cannot use Dragon-Step Clinch unless you learn it normally. ###### Benefit Gain Sweeping Kick or Driving Heel as a bonus talent. When both hands are occupied but you are not Restrained or Prone, you still use the “both hands free” Iron Fist Die column for Unarmed Strikes that are explicitly kicks or knees. Once per turn after you move at least 10 feet and hit with a kick, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target. ##### Closed-Fist Body “No projected hand. No borrowed wind. Bone, tendon, breath, and contact.” You cannot learn Breath-Extended Strike, Palm That Moves the Empty Bell, or Iron Fist Forged Techniques that attack at range unless another feature explicitly overrides this restriction. ###### Benefit Gain Body Conditioning as a bonus talent. When you hit a creature within 5 feet with an Unarmed Strike, add your Proficiency Bonus to damage once per turn. At CL 10+, while within 5 feet of a creature you have Opened, gain Advantage on saving throws against forced movement and Prone effects from that creature. ##### Clinch Door Style “The long road of the fist ends where the enemy can no longer make space.” You focus on close-body pressure. You cannot use Breath-Extended Strike beyond 10 feet. ###### Benefit Gain Dragon-Step Clinch as a bonus talent at CL 5. Until then, gain Wrist-Trapping Hand as a bonus talent. When you hit a creature you are Grappling with an Unarmed Strike, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage once per turn. When a creature escapes your Grapple, you may use your Reaction to make one Unarmed Strike against it. #### Path Synergies ##### Body Refining - Iron Body Scripture Use Constitution as your Iron Fist ability if you wish. When Stamina Guard reduces damage from a melee attack to 0, choose one: regain Martial Focus if absent; make one Unarmed Strike against the attacker if it is within reach; move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker. At CL 10+, when you use One-Inch Heavenquake, you may spend Stamina instead of expending Martial Focus if a Body Refining feature permits that expression. ##### Qi Cultivation - Breath-Meridian Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Iron Fist ability if you wish. Once per turn when you Open a creature with an Unarmed Strike, store one breath charge until the end of your next turn. Before the stored charge expires, choose one: reduce the CP cost of one Iron Fist Forged Technique by 1, minimum 1; increase Breath-Extended Strike range by 10 feet for one strike; add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll made by an Iron Fist technique. ##### Spirit Awakening - Form-Intent Resonance Use Wisdom as your Iron Fist ability if you wish. When you Open a creature, learn one of the following: whether it intends to attack you before the end of its next turn; whether it intends to flee; whether it is protecting another creature; whether it is concentrating or maintaining a technique through bodily discipline; whether Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution appears most vulnerable. This reads immediate martial intent and bodily rhythm, not private thoughts. Once per round when an Opened creature fails a saving throw against one of your Iron Fist talents, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Cultivation Insights ##### Tempered Knuckles Prerequisite: Iron Fist sphere, CL 4+ When your Unarmed Strike deals damage to an object, temporary Barrier, or creature wearing manufactured armor, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage once per turn. When you take damage from striking a hard surface or armored creature, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus. ##### Flowing Combination Adept Prerequisite: Iron Fist sphere, Flowing Combination, CL 6+ When Flowing Combination grants a free Grapple or Shove attempt: increase that technique's Save DC by 1; on a failed save, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target; if the target was already Opened, regain Martial Focus if absent. Use this Insight once per turn. ##### Meridian Student Prerequisite: Iron Fist sphere, Meridian-Sealing Palm, CL 8+ When a creature succeeds on its saving throw against Meridian-Sealing Palm, choose one: it still cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn; learn whether Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution is its weakest saving throw. Once per short rest, when a creature fails against Meridian-Sealing Palm, extend one chosen seal until the end of your next turn. ##### Iron Shirt Adept Prerequisite: Iron Fist sphere, Body Conditioning or Iron Shirt Practice, CL 8+ While holding Martial Focus and wearing no Heavy armor: reduce falling damage by 5 × your Proficiency Bonus; gain Advantage on one Constitution saving throw against a physical shock, poison, or bodily disruption once per short rest; when a hostile creature damages you with an Unarmed Strike or natural weapon, it takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ##### Clinch-Gate Adept Prerequisite: Iron Fist sphere, Dragon-Step Clinch, CL 8+ When you maintain a body clinch: the target no longer has Advantage on checks to escape solely because the clinch is maintained without a hand; you may use Rising Knee once per turn without requiring the target to already be Grappled by hand; when the target misses you with a melee attack, reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of its next turn. ##### Form-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Iron Fist sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation or martial training project, use one Iron Fist Form, Opening, Meridian, or Guard principle you know as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. Normal project requirements still apply. ##### Empty-Hand Weapon Master Prerequisite: Iron Fist sphere, Open-Hand Disarm, CL 8+ When you successfully disarm a creature with Open-Hand Disarm, choose one: catch the item if you have a free hand; kick the item up to 15 feet into a legal space; immediately use one Unarmed Strike against the disarmed creature; if you possess Scoundrel, immediately plant a Tiny object on the target without spending an Action. Use this Insight once per round.

### Set the Scene
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature that can see or hear you
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Choose one creature as your Foil and one Proposition.
You may have only one Foil at a time.
The creature knows that you are inviting a response, but it does not automatically know which Punchline talent you intend to use.
Choose one Proposition:
#### Come Closer
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil willingly moves at least 5 feet toward you or willingly enters your reach.
#### Strike the Fool
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil makes an attack roll against you.
#### Ignore the Fool
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil targets another creature with an attack roll or harmful effect while it can see or hear you.
#### Show Your Hand
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil takes the Magic action or activates an explicitly supernatural technique.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
forced movement does not fulfill a Proposition;
teleportation does not fulfill Come Closer;
a Proposition is fulfilled after the Foil commits to the triggering action but before the triggering attack roll or saving throws are resolved;
if a Punchline changes movement, resolve it after the triggering movement enters the relevant space but before movement continues;
one fulfilled Proposition allows one Punchline;
after you deliver a Punchline, Set the Scene ends.
