spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Jester Qi Expression: Primary — Reversal Qi; Supporting — Joy Qi, Chaos Qi, Mockery Qi, Fate-Tilt Qi. “A minister who speaks directly may lose their head. A fool who agrees too enthusiastically may save an empire.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Rules Baseline: 2024 fifth-edition rules (5.5e) Primary Path: Spirit Awakening Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Body Refining Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Public baiting, feigned incompetence, acrobatic exits, indirect remonstrance, mock praise, tactical prediction, improvised weapons, mimicry, social pressure, unorthodox battlefield control ### Jester Dao Jester is the cultivation of the crooked answer. A novice believes a joke is an ornament added after the truth. An adept understands that a joke may be the only shape in which the truth can pass through a guarded door. A direct accusation creates resistance. A perfect imitation creates recognition. A threat invites defiance. An absurd compliment allows pride to expose itself. The Sphere of Jester governs: feigned openings; public baiting; tactical prediction; mock praise; pratfalls; improvised performance; acrobatic exits; borrowed roles; embarrassing reversals; ridicule directed at arrogance rather than identity; speaking truth through indirection. The Jester is not a clown because they are harmless. The Jester appears harmless because enemies reveal more when they believe the fool is beneath consideration. ### Sphere Boundaries Jester governs public bait, indirect pressure, feigned incompetence, performance, mimicry, absurd agreement, and tactical reversals. Scoundrel governs theft, dirty tricks, practical deceit, and opportunistic crime. Mind governs direct emotional, cognitive, or telepathic influence. Illusion governs false sensory information imposed on perception. Athletics governs practiced movement doctrine; Jester uses movement as part of a performance. Shadow governs absence, silhouette, hidden routes, and second meanings expressed through light and darkness. Warleader governs direct morale and command; Jester influences the battlefield through ridicule, rhythm, and public contradiction. Formations may turn performance principles into courts, stages, debate halls, or maintained arrays, but Jester does not create permanent infrastructure automatically. ### Jester and Mind | Sphere | Primary Theme | | --- | --- | | Jester | The enemy recognizes a public invitation and chooses whether to commit | | Mind | The target’s thoughts or emotions are influenced directly | | Jester + Mind | Hypnotic comedy, irresistible suggestion, compulsive role assignment | A Jester technique is not automatically a Charm effect. Creatures immune to Charmed may still understand that the Jester is baiting them. If a technique imposes Charmed, Frightened, or another condition, it says so explicitly. ### Jester and Illusion | Sphere | Primary Theme | | --- | --- | | Jester | Feigned incompetence, physical performance, mimicry, public misdirection | | Illusion | False sights, sounds, creatures, terrain, and sensory information | | Jester + Illusion | False stages, phantom audiences, impossible costume changes, painted exits | A Jester may pretend to trip without creating a false image. A Jester may imitate a general without becoming visually indistinguishable from that general. Those stronger deceptions require Illusion, disguise, or an explicit talent. ### Core Jester Rules ### 2024 Fifth-Edition Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline, sometimes called 5.5e. Jester talents supplement the normal rules for: Action; Bonus Action; Reaction; Influence; Help; Hide; Dodge; Disengage; Opportunity Attacks; Cover; Invisible; Charmed; Frightened; Prone. A Jester talent replaces a normal rule only when it explicitly says so. ### Martial Focus Jester uses Martial Focus. Until a global Martial Focus rule replaces this reminder: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is absent. ### Jester Save DC Your Jester Save DC is: 8 + Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus A Path synergy, Insight, or other feature may explicitly replace Charisma for Jester talents. ### Influence and Performance The 2024 Influence action allows Charisma (Performance) when attempting to amuse a creature. Jester talents may provide additional combat uses for performance, but they do not force a creature to comply with an Influence request unless they explicitly say so. ### Set the Scene Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature that can see or hear you Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: None Choose one creature as your Foil and one Proposition. You may have only one Foil at a time. The creature knows that you are inviting a response, but it does not automatically know which Punchline talent you intend to use. Choose one Proposition: #### Come Closer The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil willingly moves at least 5 feet toward you or willingly enters your reach. #### Strike the Fool The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil makes an attack roll against you. #### Ignore the Fool The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil targets another creature with an attack roll or harmful effect while it can see or hear you. #### Show Your Hand The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil takes the Magic action or activates an explicitly supernatural technique. Unless a talent says otherwise: forced movement does not fulfill a Proposition; teleportation does not fulfill Come Closer; a Proposition is fulfilled after the Foil commits to the triggering action but before the triggering attack roll or saving throws are resolved; if a Punchline changes movement, resolve it after the triggering movement enters the relevant space but before movement continues; one fulfilled Proposition allows one Punchline; after you deliver a Punchline, Set the Scene ends. ### Deliver the Punchline Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: Your Foil fulfills your chosen Proposition Use one Punchline talent you know whose trigger is compatible with the fulfilled Proposition. If the Punchline calls for a saving throw, use your Jester Save DC. ### No-Offense Performance Set the Scene and Deliver the Punchline are not automatically magical, Charmed, Frightened, or mind-affecting effects. They represent visible or audible bait, timing, rhythm, and tactical understanding. A creature does not need to respect you, like you, or believe you are funny for Set the Scene to work. The creature merely needs to perceive the invitation and decide how to respond. ### Flustered Some Jester talents make a creature Flustered. Until the start of your next turn, a Flustered creature: cannot take Reactions; has Disadvantage on the next attack roll or ability check it makes. After that roll, the Disadvantage portion ends, but the creature still cannot take Reactions until the condition ends. Flustered is a Jester-specific state, not a standard 2024 condition. ### Base Sphere Ability ### Jester Training When you learn Jester: gain proficiency in Charisma (Performance), Charisma (Deception), or Dexterity (Acrobatics); if already proficient in all three, choose one Jester talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; choose one Mortal Realm Punchline talent for which you meet the prerequisites. ### Set the Scene and Deliver the Punchline When you learn Jester, gain Set the Scene and Deliver the Punchline. ### Jester Talent Tags ### Punchline Talents A Punchline talent is used as a Reaction when your Foil fulfills a compatible Proposition. ### Setup Talents A Setup talent changes Set the Scene, adds Propositions, or allows additional Foils. ### Pratfall Talents A Pratfall talent weaponizes apparent clumsiness, misdirection, movement, or a false opening. ### Mock-Praise Talents A Mock-Praise talent turns excessive confidence, overcommitment, or conspicuous technique into a tactical weakness. ### Borrowed-Role Talents A Borrowed-Role talent imitates a visible posture, social position, movement rhythm, or combat choice. ### Focus Talents A Focus talent recovers, expends, or modifies Martial Focus. ### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents performance and indirection beyond ordinary mortal technique. ### Mortal Realm Jester Talents ### A Fine Display - Punchline Compatible Proposition: Strike the Fool Resolve after the attack roll. If the triggering attack misses: move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil; the Foil becomes Flustered. If the triggering attack hits, reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus. ### After You, Honored Guest - Punchline, Pratfall Compatible Proposition: Come Closer Move up to 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil. Then the Foil makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Fall Prone. Successful Save: No additional effect. Your movement must end in a legal unoccupied space. ### Applaud the Master - Punchline Compatible Proposition: Ignore the Fool Choose the creature targeted by the triggering attack roll or harmful effect. That creature gains: +2 AC against the triggering attack roll, or: +2 to one saving throw against the triggering effect. Apply the bonus only to the triggering roll. If the attack misses or the saving throw succeeds, the Foil becomes Flustered. ### Excellent Idea - Punchline, Mock-Praise Compatible Proposition: Show Your Hand The Foil makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: It becomes Flustered and has Disadvantage on the first Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the start of your next turn. Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Excellent Idea does not cancel the triggering technique. ### Pratfall Exit - Pratfall When you fall Prone or deliberately drop Prone, move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks. Use Pratfall Exit once per round. Standing from Prone still costs movement normally. ### Ridiculous Weapon Gain proficiency with improvised weapons. When you attack with an improvised weapon, use Charisma instead of Strength or Dexterity for the attack roll and damage roll if higher. A harmless prop, folding fan, bowl, ladle, painted sign, bench, fruit, slipper, or similar object normally deals: 1d4 Bludgeoning damage unless the GM determines that it closely resembles another weapon. Once per turn when you hit with an improvised weapon, choose one: apply Set the Scene to the target without spending a Bonus Action, choosing Strike the Fool; move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target; the target has Disadvantage on its next Opportunity Attack before the start of your next turn. ### False Opening - Pratfall, Focus At the start of your turn, choose to take: -2 AC until the start of your next turn. The first time a creature misses you with an attack roll before the penalty ends: regain Martial Focus if absent; move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature. ### Grand Entrance - Setup When Initiative is rolled, use Set the Scene without spending a Bonus Action. If you are Surprised, use Grand Entrance after your first turn begins instead. ### Words Without Offense Gain Expertise in Charisma (Performance). When you take the Influence action to amuse, criticize indirectly, or deliver unwelcome advice through humor, treat a d20 roll of 9 or lower as 10. Words Without Offense does not allow a repugnant request to succeed automatically. ### Borrowed Expression - Borrowed-Role After observing one creature for at least 1 minute, gain Advantage on Charisma (Deception) or Charisma (Performance) checks made to imitate its: posture; mannerisms; speech rhythm; public habits; obvious emotional presentation. Borrowed Expression does not change your appearance or voice automatically. ### Dancing Fool - Pratfall When you Disengage, move through allied spaces without treating them as difficult terrain until the end of the turn. Once during that movement, pass through one hostile creature’s space if it is no more than one size larger than you. Treat that hostile space as difficult terrain and do not end movement there. ### Focused Applause - Focus When your Punchline causes an attack to miss, causes a saving throw to succeed, or makes a creature fall Prone, regain Martial Focus if absent. ### Foundation Realm Jester Talents ### Mock-Praise Scripture - Setup, Mock-Praise Prerequisite: CL 5+ When using Set the Scene, choose two different Propositions. The first one fulfilled permits one compatible Punchline and ends Set the Scene normally. ### Borrowed Gesture - Punchline, Borrowed-Role Prerequisite: CL 5+Compatible Proposition: Show Your Hand or Ignore the Fool After the triggering Action resolves, choose one: take the Dodge action as part of this Reaction; take the Disengage action as part of this Reaction and move up to 10 feet; take the Help action as part of this Reaction to assist one ally within 30 feet that can see or hear you; if the Foil moved willingly before triggering this Punchline, move up to half that distance without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil. Borrowed Gesture does not copy spells, sphere talents, or class features. ### You Meng’s Borrowed Robes - Borrowed-Role Prerequisite: Borrowed Expression, CL 5+ After observing one creature for at least 10 minutes, create a studied role. While performing that role: gain Advantage on Charisma (Deception) and Charisma (Performance) checks made to imitate the creature’s mannerisms; gain Advantage on one Influence check made against a creature familiar with the imitated person; once per short rest, when a creature familiar with the imitated person targets you with an attack or harmful effect, impose Disadvantage on one attack roll or gain Advantage on one saving throw against that effect. This talent does not change your physical appearance, clothing, voice, memories, authority, or legal identity automatically. A disguise, Illusion, or forged documents may improve the performance. ### Absurd Agreement - Punchline, Mock-Praise Prerequisite: CL 5+Compatible Proposition: Show Your Hand After the triggering technique resolves, the Foil makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn; it cannot take Bonus Actions until the start of its next turn; it becomes Flustered; one ally who saw the technique gains Advantage on its next attack roll against the Foil before the start of your next turn. Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. ### Banquet Escape - Punchline, Pratfall Prerequisite: CL 5+Compatible Proposition: Strike the Fool Resolve after the triggering attack roll. Move up to half your Speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil. If this movement places you outside the triggering attack’s reach or range, the attack misses. If the attack still hits, reduce its damage by: 2d6 + Charisma modifier ### Thrown Slipper Rebuke - Punchline Prerequisite: Ridiculous Weapon, CL 5+Compatible Proposition: Ignore the Fool or Show Your Hand Make one improvised-weapon ranged attack against the Foil with a normal range of 30 feet and a long range of 60 feet. Hit: Deal normal improvised-weapon damage and choose one: the Foil becomes Flustered; reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn; one ally targeted by the triggering effect moves 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil. The thrown prop returns to your hand, lands in a legal space nearby, or is replaced with another appropriate prop as the fiction allows. ### Fool’s Diplomacy Prerequisite: Words Without Offense, CL 5+ When taking the Influence action outside combat, use Charisma (Performance) in place of Deception, Intimidation, or Persuasion when delivering the request through: humor; satire; allegory; mock praise; self-deprecation; a short performance. The normal Influence rules still determine whether the request is willing, hesitant, or repugnant. ### Too Proud to Stop - Setup, Mock-Praise Prerequisite: CL 7+ When your Foil fulfills a Proposition and you do not deliver a Punchline, preserve Set the Scene until the start of your next turn. If the Foil fulfills one of your Propositions again before Set the Scene ends, use one compatible Punchline without spending your Reaction. Use Too Proud to Stop once per round. ### Painted Exit - Pratfall Prerequisite: CL 7+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Move up to half your Speed. During this movement: do not provoke opportunity attacks; pass through hostile spaces as difficult terrain if the creature is no more than one size larger than you; do not end movement in an occupied space; fall Prone at the end of the movement unless you choose to remain standing. ### Core Formation Realm Jester Talents ### Court of Words Without Offense - Martial Domain “Everyone heard the joke. Nobody agreed on who the fool had been.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest For the duration: creatures inside can hear you clearly unless Deafened or prevented by a stronger effect; use Set the Scene once at the start of each of your turns without spending a Bonus Action; when one ally inside is missed by an attack roll, it moves 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the attacker; when one Foil inside becomes Flustered, choose one ally inside to gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; once per round, deliver one Punchline without spending your Reaction. You may still use your Reaction for a different Punchline when legal. Court of Words Without Offense does not force creatures to laugh, understand your language, or become Charmed. ### Reductio ad Absurdum - Punchline, Mock-Praise Prerequisite: CL 10+Compatible Proposition: Show Your Hand Before the Foil resolves the triggering supernatural technique, present the contradiction in its overcommitment. The Foil chooses one: abandon the triggering technique before paying its cost or expending its use; resolve the technique normally, then become Flustered and take 4d8 Psychic damage. A creature immune to Psychic damage may still choose either option and may still become Flustered. Reductio ad Absurdum does not affect Domains, Secret Inheritances, or techniques whose activation cannot reasonably be abandoned once begun. ### Painted Wall, No Shade - Punchline, Mock-Praise Prerequisite: CL 10+Compatible Proposition: Come Closer or Show Your Hand Choose one visible temporary Barrier, conjured wall, created area of Cover, or terrain-altering supernatural effect involved in the triggering movement or technique. Make a Jester Cultivation Check: d20 + Charisma modifier + Proficiency Bonus against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC, named sphere Save DC, or spell save DC. Successful Check: Suppress one 10-foot section or one 5-foot square until the start of your next turn.Failed Check: No effect. Painted Wall, No Shade does not suppress Domains, Formation cores, artifacts, or Realm-defining structures. ### Thousand Faces, One Mistake - Setup, Borrowed-Role Prerequisite: You Meng’s Borrowed Robes, CL 10+ When you use Set the Scene, create one visible role: cringing coward; arrogant noble; loyal servant; wounded traveler; drunken performer; officious inspector; familiar rival; another role approved by the GM. Until Set the Scene ends: gain Advantage on one Charisma (Deception) or Charisma (Performance) check consistent with the role; if the Foil fulfills your Proposition, choose to become Invisible to the Foil until the end of the current turn after your Punchline resolves. Invisible from this talent ends early if you make an attack roll or deal damage. The role does not automatically deceive creatures that cannot perceive the performance. ### The Audience Chooses the Hero - Punchline Prerequisite: CL 10+Compatible Proposition: Ignore the Fool Choose the ally targeted by the triggering attack or harmful effect. Until the start of your next turn, the ally gains: +2 AC; Advantage on Dexterity saving throws; Temporary HP equal to 2 x Proficiency Bonus. If the triggering effect misses or fails against the ally, the Foil becomes Flustered. ### Dongfang Shuo’s Court-Hermit Step - Pratfall, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature misses you with an attack, you succeed on a saving throw against a harmful effect, or one of your Punchlines resolves Cost: Expend Martial Focus Move up to your Speed. During this movement: do not provoke opportunity attacks; pass through hostile spaces as difficult terrain if the creature is no more than one size larger than you; do not end movement in an occupied space; Hide as part of this Reaction if you end Heavily Obscured or behind Total Cover and otherwise meet the 2024 Hide requirements. ### Borrowed Action, Honest Consequence - Punchline, Borrowed-Role Prerequisite: CL 12+Compatible Proposition: Ignore the Fool or Show Your Hand After the triggering Action resolves, choose one ordinary Action: Dash; Disengage; Dodge; Help; Hide, if you meet its normal requirements; Search; Study; Utilize with one object already in hand or within reach. Take that Action as part of this Reaction. Borrowed Action, Honest Consequence does not copy Magic actions, sphere talents, spells, or class features. ### Nascent Soul Realm Jester Talents ### Recluse-at-Court Incarnation “The fool remained in the center of the court and somehow stood outside every rule that expected dignity.” Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest For the duration: use Set the Scene at the start of each of your turns without spending a Bonus Action; maintain up to three Foils at once, choosing one Proposition for each; deliver one Punchline per round without spending your Reaction; move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks after delivering a Punchline; gain Resistance to Psychic damage; gain Immunity to Charmed and Frightened; when a Foil becomes Flustered, regain Martial Focus if absent. ### Ten-Thousand Masks Procession Prerequisite: Thousand Faces, One Mistake, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 60-foot Emanation originating from you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest A procession of roles, gestures, jokes, and impossible changes of posture fills the area. #### Allies gain +10 feet Speed; gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened; take the Help action as a Bonus Action once during the duration; move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks when a hostile creature inside becomes Flustered, once per round. #### Enemies When one enemy enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: become Flustered; reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn; suffer Disadvantage on its next saving throw before the start of its next turn; cannot take Bonus Actions until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Ten-Thousand Masks Procession is a visible supernatural performance. It does not automatically create convincing visual Illusions outside its explicit effects. ### The Whole Court Laughs Prerequisite: Court of Words Without Offense, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: Your Foil rolls a natural 1 on a d20 Test, misses an attack by 5 or more, or fails a saving throw against one of your Jester talents by 5 or more Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest The Foil makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn: become Flustered; Speed becomes 0; cannot take Bonus Actions; attack rolls against it have Advantage. Successful Save: Become Flustered. This technique targets self-possession and battle rhythm, not social identity. ### Mocking Heaven’s Decree Prerequisite: Reductio ad Absurdum, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: One creature you can see within 60 feet activates a Domain, Realm Evolution, or ordinary supernatural technique costing at least 5 CP or an equivalent resource Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest The creature chooses one: abandon the triggering technique before paying its cost or expending its use; resolve the technique normally and become Flustered until the end of your next turn; resolve the technique normally and allow one ally you can see to move up to its Speed, take the Dodge action, or take the Help action immediately. Mocking Heaven’s Decree does not cancel Secret Inheritances. ### Secret Jester Inheritance ### The Words Heaven Could Not Punish “The fool bowed. Heaven realized too late that striking the fool would complete the joke.” Classification: Secret Jester Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Words Without Offense, hidden fool-sage scripture Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: One creature you can see or hear within 120 feet declares an attack, harmful effect, Domain, Realm Evolution, or Secret Inheritance Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Before the triggering effect resolves, state one absurd but accurate consequence of the creature’s declared action. The creature chooses one: #### Refuse the Role Abandon the triggering action before paying its cost or expending its use. #### Complete the Joke Resolve the triggering effect normally. After it resolves: the creature takes 10d10 Psychic damage; it becomes Flustered until the end of your next turn; it cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn; choose up to three allies who can see or hear you; each moves up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks from the creature; if the triggering effect was a Domain, Realm Evolution, or Secret Inheritance, reduce its remaining duration by 1 round, minimum 1 round. The Words Heaven Could Not Punish does not force a creature to abandon its action. It makes continuing expensive enough that the choice becomes meaningful. ### Jester Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures Jester variants are optional cultivation scriptures that change what the cultivator believes a fool is allowed to become. They are Tianxia-specific variant scriptures, not imported casting-tradition rules. A Jester variant grants a benefit only because it also imposes a real limitation. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Jester variant when you first learn the Sphere of Jester or undergo a major Jester initiation; Jester variants are mutually exclusive unless the GM permits a special lineage; the drawback applies to all Jester talents you use; if a drawback grants a bonus talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, you gain that talent when you meet the prerequisites; if the drawback is retrained or removed, you lose the bonus talent or benefit it granted. ### Mock-Praise Remonstrant “I agree completely. That is why everyone can now see the disaster so clearly.” You cultivate Jester as indirect remonstrance, absurd agreement, and public contradiction. Drawback: No Sudden Entrance. You cannot learn Grand Entrance or Thousand Faces, One Mistake. Your comedy works by letting pride reveal itself in public; it does not favor sudden arrivals, vanished identities, or mask-processions. Benefits: gain Excellent Idea as a bonus Punchline talent; when using Excellent Idea or Absurd Agreement, add Proficiency Bonus to one Psychic damage roll or grant one ally Temporary HP equal to Proficiency Bonus; take the Influence action through Charisma (Performance) as a Bonus Action once per short rest outside combat; gain Advantage on checks made to criticize indirectly, expose hypocrisy, or offer dangerous advice through humor. ### Actor of Borrowed Robes “The mask does not conceal the truth. The mask lets the truth speak with a familiar voice.” You cultivate Jester as studied role, imitation, and borrowed authority. Drawback: No Prop-Weapon Fool. You cannot learn Ridiculous Weapon or Thrown Slipper Rebuke. Your scripture depends on posture, role, and public recognition, not weaponized props or slapstick violence. Benefits: gain Borrowed Expression as a bonus talent; reduce the observation time for You Meng’s Borrowed Robes from 10 minutes to 1 minute; after delivering a Punchline, gain Advantage on your next Deception or Performance check before the end of your next turn; when using Borrowed Gesture, choose two different ordinary Actions and take one of them. ### Dancing Acrobat “The audience laughs because the fall was impossible. The enemy falls because the step was deliberate.” You cultivate Jester as visible movement, pratfall, timing, and impossible escapes. Drawback: Seen or Wasted. You cannot use Punchlines that require the Foil to hear you. A creature must see your physical performance for Set the Scene to affect it. Blind creatures, creatures behind Total Cover, and creatures otherwise unable to perceive your movement cannot be made your Foil through this variant unless another feature lets them perceive the performance. Benefits: gain Pratfall Exit as a bonus talent; increase your Speed by 10 feet while holding Martial Focus; when Pratfall Exit moves you, stand from Prone immediately after the movement without spending movement; when After You, Honored Guest makes a creature fall Prone, regain Martial Focus if absent. ### Path Synergies ### Spirit Awakening - Mirror of Pride Use Wisdom as your Jester key ability if higher than Charisma. When one Foil within 60 feet fulfills a Proposition, learn one immediate battle truth: whether it intends to continue attacking you; whether it intends to retreat; whether it is protecting another creature; whether it fears public humiliation more than injury. This reads immediate emotional pressure, not private thoughts. Once per round when a Foil becomes Flustered, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Qi Cultivation - Laughing-Meridian Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Jester key ability. Once per turn when you deliver a Punchline: move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the Foil; or reduce the CP cost of one Jester Forged Technique before the end of your next turn by 1, minimum 1. At CL 10+, increase the free movement to 10 feet. ### Body Refining - Acrobat of the Crooked Step Use Constitution as your Jester key ability for Pratfall talents and improvised-weapon attacks if higher. While holding Martial Focus: reduce falling damage by 5 x Proficiency Bonus; stand from Prone by spending 5 feet of movement; when False Opening causes one attack to miss, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Cultivation Insights ### Three-Inch-Tongue Adept Prerequisite: Jester sphere, Words Without Offense, CL 4+ Gain Advantage on one Influence check per short rest when using humor, allegory, or mock praise. When a creature becomes Flustered from one of your Jester talents, add Proficiency Bonus to your next Performance check before the end of your next turn. ### Improvised-Prop Adept Prerequisite: Jester sphere, Ridiculous Weapon, CL 6+ Once per turn: draw, pick up, or stow one improvised prop without spending an Action; increase improvised-weapon damage from 1d4 to 1d6 unless the object already uses a larger die; after hitting with an improvised weapon, move the prop into your hand, an adjacent legal space, or one ally’s free hand within 10 feet. ### Pratfall Adept Prerequisite: Jester sphere, one Pratfall talent, CL 8+ Once per round when you fall Prone, stand from Prone, or move through one hostile space: gain +2 AC against one attack before the start of your next turn; or move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from one creature. ### Borrowed-Role Adept Prerequisite: Jester sphere, Borrowed Expression, CL 8+ When using a studied role: recognize one obvious contradiction in a creature’s public behavior after observing it for 1 minute; gain Advantage on one Study or Influence check made to expose that contradiction; use You Meng’s Borrowed Robes against a group familiar with the imitated person rather than only one creature. Borrowed-Role Adept reveals observable inconsistency, not private secrets. ### Fool-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Jester sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation, court, stage, debate hall, or long-term performance project, use one Jester Setup, Pratfall, Mock-Praise, or Borrowed-Role principle as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. The project still requires: preparation time; performers or custodians; suitable social context; props; anchors where appropriate; maintenance; Formation-specific vulnerabilities.

The creature knows that you are inviting a response, but it does not automatically know which Punchline talent you intend to use.
Choose one Proposition:
#### Come Closer
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil willingly moves at least 5 feet toward you or willingly enters your reach.
#### Strike the Fool
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil makes an attack roll against you.
#### Ignore the Fool
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil targets another creature with an attack roll or harmful effect while it can see or hear you.
#### Show Your Hand
The Proposition is fulfilled when the Foil takes the Magic action or activates an explicitly supernatural technique.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
forced movement does not fulfill a Proposition;
teleportation does not fulfill Come Closer;
a Proposition is fulfilled after the Foil commits to the triggering action but before the triggering attack roll or saving throws are resolved;
if a Punchline changes movement, resolve it after the triggering movement enters the relevant space but before movement continues;
one fulfilled Proposition allows one Punchline;
after you deliver a Punchline, Set the Scene ends.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Karma Qi Expression: Primary — Consequence Qi; Supporting — Debt Qi, Oath Qi, Fate Qi, Judgment Qi. “Every action leaves a thread. Every debt waits to be paid.” Common Name: Karma Sphere Sphere Type: Secret Power Sphere / Consequence and Oath Sphere Primary Path: Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation Rare Variant: Body Refining through Karmic Body, scars of consequence, impact-witnessing, and oath-bearing flesh Resource: Cultivation Points, Karmic Imprints, Karmic Burdens, and oath consequences Common Effects: Consequences, debt, grace, oaths, vows, red threads, backlash, reflected harm, delayed judgment, consequence-sensing, oath-binding, debt collection, merit protection, heavenly mandate, and severing karmic connections. ### Karma Dao Karma is the cultivation of consequence. Fate concerns the uncertain road before the step. Divination reads signs of what may come. Time decides when a moment arrives. Karma remembers why the moment is owed. A Karma cultivator studies red threads of debt, gold threads of grace, black knots of grievance, broken vow-scars, inherited burdens, sect merits, heavenly punishments, and the hidden ledgers written by repeated deeds. To cultivate Karma is to understand that no act ends when the hand withdraws. The Dao question of Karma is: What has been earned, and who must answer for it? ### Secret-Sphere Access Karma cannot normally be learned through ordinary sphere selection. Unlocking it requires one or more of the following: a hidden heavenly scripture; a karmic trial; a vow witnessed by Heaven; a master who can open the Ledger Eye; a red-thread inheritance; a debt to a celestial court, ancestor, ghost, sect, or divine mandate; survival of a calamity caused by broken oaths or accumulated grievance; GM approval. A character normally knows no more than one Secret sphere unless the campaign grants an exceptional narrative reward. Karma should be rare because it changes how the table thinks about actions. The sphere asks the GM and players to notice promises, betrayal, mercy, cruelty, sacrifice, repayment, and consequence. ### Realm Progression Mortal Realm. The cultivator can perceive fresh threads, record a limited number of Debt and Grace Imprints, punish immediate harm, reward protection, track a touched thread, and bind minor willing oaths. Foundation Realm. The cultivator opens a stable Ledger Seal. Imprints last longer, oaths become more severe, protection and punishment can be exchanged between linked creatures, and repeated wrongdoing becomes mechanically dangerous. Core Formation Realm. The cultivator establishes a Court of Cause and Effect. Within the Court, actions produce visible threads, debts punish themselves, grace shelters the deserving, and major oaths become campaign-defining obligations. Nascent Soul Realm. The cultivator embodies the Heavenly Ledger. Debts may answer across distance, harm may return to source, vows may bind a hall or sect, and borrowed futures demand payment. Secret Inheritance. The cultivator severs a named karmic thread for one impossible breath, releasing a creature from one oath, curse, possession, debt, bond, resurrection anchor, or supernatural obligation - but never from all consequence. ### Sphere Boundaries Fate shifts probability and the uncertain space between possible outcomes. Karma does not improve odds because fortune smiles. Karma acts when a cause has created a debt or grace. Divination reads omens, likely futures, hidden facts, and signs. Karma reads debts, vows, grievances, obligations, and consequence threads. Divination asks what might happen. Karma asks what is owed. Time changes timing, delay, acceleration, and brief rewinding. Karma can defer consequence or make a debt arrive later, but it does not freely manipulate time. Death governs endings, grave Qi, corpses, ghosts, anti-healing, and the law of death. Karma can punish murder, track a death-debt, or bind a ghost by oath, but it does not command corpses or grave Qi by default. Radiance burns impurity, reveals the unclean, and purifies spiritual contamination. Karma judges deeds and vows. Radiance asks whether something is corrupt. Karma asks what was done. Sect Stewardship tracks institutional obligation, merit, roles, petitions, and sect ledgers. Karma is cosmic and personal consequence. The two overlap when sect merit becomes spiritually binding. Talismans store commands in prepared script. A talisman may carry an oath, punishment, or karmic receipt, but Talismans governs the medium and activation procedure. Formations command places through Arrays, Eyes, Nodes, and Gates. A Karma Formation may punish trespass or broken law, but Formations governs the site structure. Thread and Chains create explicit physical or spiritual links. Karma’s red threads are obligations and consequences, not automatically tethers, restraints, or pull-lines. Curses and Demonic Cultivation can impose harm without deserving cause. Karma is strongest when the target has created a consequence. Using Karma to fabricate guilt is a corruption risk and may become a story drawback. ### Key Ability, Save DC, and Costs Use your Path key ability for Karma save DCs unless a Path synergy changes it. Cultivation Save DC: 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. Cultivation Attack Modifier: Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. Karma Check: d20 + your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. Use this to contest oaths, sever threads, read concealed karmic effects, or overcome another cultivator’s Ledger when a talent calls for it. CP Costs: If a feature lists a CP cost, spend CP from your Path’s cultivation pool. ### Core Karma Rules #### Karmic Thread A Karmic Thread is a supernatural connection created by a deed, vow, injury, mercy, betrayal, promise, favor, sacrifice, theft, murder, rescue, oath, curse, or consequence-bearing event. Threads may appear as red cords, gold filaments, black knots, ash-gray stains, ink characters, scars in the aura, debt coins, heavenly tally marks, court records, prayer slips, or silent pressure around the soul. Most creatures cannot perceive Karmic Threads without Karma, Divination, Spirit Awakening, or a relevant feature. #### Cause A Cause is an action meaningful enough for Karma to record. A Cause can include: dealing damage; preventing damage; healing another creature; inflicting or removing a harmful condition; betraying a willing ally; protecting another creature at personal risk; breaking a clear oath; fulfilling a difficult oath; stealing something of real value; sparing an enemy at real cost; killing a creature; rescuing a helpless creature; violating a sworn law; paying a meaningful debt; accepting a meaningful burden. Not every action creates Karma. Petty inconvenience, accidental bumps, routine combat exchanges, empty promises, or purely mechanical exploitation should not automatically create a Cause unless the table agrees the scene gives it weight. #### Witness To record Karma, you normally must Witness the Cause. You Witness a Cause if one of the following is true: you directly see or hear the act; you perceive the act through Spirit Awakening, Divination, a bonded companion, or a valid technique; the act occurs against you; the act occurs against a creature bound to you by a Karma talent; the act violates an oath you created; the act occurs inside your Karma Domain; a talent says you may record it. A hidden action may still create Karma in the world, but you cannot automatically use your Ledger unless you Witness it or later discover it through a valid feature. #### Karmic Imprints Karma talents use Karmic Imprints. An Imprint is a temporary recorded consequence held in your Ledger. There are two main Imprint types: Debt Imprint. Represents harm, betrayal, oath-breaking, theft, cruelty, aggression, murder, violated hospitality, or consequence-bearing wrongdoing. Grace Imprint. Represents protection, healing, sacrifice, loyalty, oath-keeping, mercy, rescue, repayment, or consequence-bearing virtue. A creature may hold a combined number of your Debt and Grace Imprints equal to your Proficiency Bonus unless a talent says otherwise. A single Cause normally creates only one Imprint. Unused Imprints fade when you finish a long rest unless a talent, oath, Domain, or Secret effect makes them persistent. #### Matching Imprints Some talents require a matching Imprint. Use Debt Imprints to punish harm, suppress aggression, expose guilt, return injury, or worsen a consequence. Use Grace Imprints to protect, aid, stabilize, share burden, fulfill promises, or reward sacrifice. A talent cannot use a Grace Imprint to punish a target unless the talent explicitly allows judgment through betrayed grace. A talent cannot use a Debt Imprint to bless a target unless the talent explicitly allows debt repayment. #### Karmic Load A cultivator may maintain a number of active oath, red-thread, or persistent Karma effects equal to their Proficiency Bonus unless a talent states a separate limit. These effects make up the cultivator’s Karmic Load. A temporary Imprint does not count against Karmic Load unless it is made persistent. If you exceed your Karmic Load, choose one existing active Karma effect to end immediately. #### Settling the Account Many talents expend Imprints. When an Imprint is expended, the account is partially settled. Unless a talent says otherwise, the same Cause cannot be used again to create the same Imprint after it has been spent. Example: If an enemy strikes your ally and you record a Debt Imprint, then spend that Imprint to use Return the Sting, the same strike cannot later create another Debt Imprint. A later harmful act can. #### False Karma A Karma cultivator can be wrong about facts, but the Ledger resists fabricated consequence. You cannot create a Debt Imprint merely by accusing a creature. You cannot create a Grace Imprint merely by praising a creature. There must be a deed, oath, sacrifice, harm, favor, or consequence-bearing act. A forbidden Karma scripture may allow false accounting, but doing so should create corruption, backlash, heavenly attention, or story debt. #### Oath Clarity An oath must be clear enough for the table to adjudicate. Good oaths have: named participants; a clear duty or prohibition; a duration or completion condition; a known consequence for breaking it; willing consent unless the technique is explicitly coercive or forbidden. Avoid oaths that require mind-reading, impossible precision, or rules-lawyer traps. #### Karma and Monsters Creatures without ordinary morality can still create Karma if they act with meaningful agency. Mindless undead, beasts, constructs, swarms, summoned creatures, and instincts may be weaker vessels for Karma unless controlled by a responsible will. When a minion acts under direct command, the GM may place the Imprint on the commander instead of the minion. #### Karma and Player Agency Karma should create consequences, not remove character agency. Oaths and debts are most interesting when the player chooses the burden, accepts the risk, and then has to live with it. ### Base Karma Abilities #### Ledger Eye Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: None Target: One creature, object, oath, corpse, location, or visible supernatural bond you can perceive You open the Ledger Eye and read visible consequence around the target. The protected creature gains one Karmic Burden owed to Heaven. Before its next long rest, it must choose one consequence: lose all remaining CP; gain one level of Exhaustion; take 6d10 Psychic damage; accept a meaningful narrative obligation approved by the GM; immediately create a Grace Cause of comparable significance. Borrowed Tomorrow postpones consequence. It does not erase it. #### No Lie Before the Ledger Tags: Ledger, Oath, Judgment Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 60-foot-radius aura centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes Cost: 8 CP For the duration, creatures of your choice inside the aura feel the pressure of witnessed truth. When an affected creature knowingly speaks a direct lie, breaks a promise made during the aura, or conceals a required answer after agreeing to speak, it makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 4d8 Psychic damage and gains one Debt Imprint. Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and does not gain an Imprint. This talent does not force a creature to speak. It punishes falsehood after the creature chooses to speak under the Ledger. #### Ten Thousand Debts Return to Source Tags: Debt, Reflection, Judgment Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300 feet Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Choose one creature you can perceive that has created at least one major Debt Cause in the last 24 hours and carries at least one of your Debt Imprints. The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, the first time the target damages another creature, inflicts a harmful condition, or commands another creature to do so, the consequence returns to it. It takes Psychic damage equal to the damage it caused, or 8d10 Psychic damage if the Cause did not deal damage. Successful Save: The target takes 4d10 Psychic damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Ten Thousand Debts Return to Source cannot trigger from damage it deals to the target. ### Secret Karma Inheritance #### Sever the Karmic Thread “No debt. No blessing. No fate. For one breath, the heavens lose their claim.” Classification: Secret Karma Talent Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Cause and Effect, hidden heavenly inheritance, GM approval Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Choose one creature, oath, curse, bond, possession, debt, grace, contract, summoning link, resurrection anchor, divination link, or supernatural obligation you can perceive. If the target is unwilling or protected by another power, it makes a Charisma saving throw or contests your Karma Check with its own relevant check. Failed Save or Successful Contest by You: Choose one narrow karmic connection. Examples include: one oath; one curse; one possession bond; one divination link; one summoning contract; one resurrection anchor; one master-servant binding; one named Karma talent affecting the target; one debt owed to a specific creature, sect, ghost, ancestor, or divine office; one Grace or Debt Imprint chain created by a specific event. The chosen connection is severed for 1 hour. Successful Save or Failed Contest by You: The connection is suppressed until the start of your next turn. Sever the Karmic Thread cannot: remove an entire Path; erase a character’s whole past; remove every curse at once; negate all consequences of a campaign event; permanently cancel a Secret sphere; grant immunity to future actions; make a guilty creature innocent; make a promise never have been spoken. When the severance ends, the thread may return changed. The GM decides whether the suspended connection resumes, weakens, twists, or creates a new story debt. ### Karma Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures A Karma drawback is an optional sphere-specific limitation that grants a bonus talent or benefit while changing how Karma cultivation functions. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Karma drawback when first learning Karma or undergoing a major karmic initiation; Karma drawbacks are mutually exclusive unless the GM permits a special inheritance; if a drawback grants a talent whose prerequisites are not yet met, you gain that talent when you meet the prerequisites; if the drawback is retrained, removed, or broken, the bonus talent or benefit is lost. #### Retribution Ledger You may create and spend Debt Imprints normally, but you cannot create Grace Imprints except on yourself through story events the GM approves. You gain one Debt talent as a bonus talent. This scripture is common among executioners, vengeance seekers, demon hunters, and sect punishers. It is powerful but spiritually dangerous. A Retribution Ledger cultivator who punishes without cause may attract false-karma backlash. #### Grace Ledger You may create and spend Grace Imprints normally, but you cannot create Debt Imprints except against creatures that directly harm you or a creature bound to you by Red Thread of Fellowship. You gain one Grace or Mercy talent as a bonus talent. This scripture is common among oath-healers, protectors, bodhisattva-like cultivators, and sect mediators. #### Witness-Bound Ledger You can use Record the Deed only for Causes you directly see or hear with your own senses. Remote senses, ally reports, delayed evidence, and symbolic impressions do not count unless a talent explicitly overrides this drawback. You gain Karmic Sight as a bonus talent. If you already have it, gain another Ledger talent. #### Oath-Bound Karma Your Karma is strongest through spoken vows. You cannot place an Imprint from ordinary combat damage unless the act violates an oath, sworn duty, declared challenge, hospitality, sect law, or personal promise. You gain Minor Oath as a bonus talent. At CL 10, you also reduce the CP cost of Great Oath by 1, minimum 1. #### Blood-Price Ledger Whenever you use a Karma talent that expends two or more Imprints, you take Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This damage cannot be reduced or redirected. Your maximum Karmic Imprints per creature increases by 1. #### Visible Threads Scripture Your Karma effects create visible red, gold, black, or white threads that supernatural observers can notice. Creatures have Advantage on checks to identify that your Karma is affecting them or the scene. You gain Advantage on Ledger Eye checks and Karma Checks made to identify, follow, or contest visible oaths, debts, and consequence threads. #### Personal Ledger You can normally place Debt Imprints only on creatures that harm you, betray you, break an oath to you, or damage a creature bound to you by a Karma talent. You can place Grace Imprints only on yourself or willing creatures bound to you. You gain Karmic Body or Red Thread of Fellowship as a bonus talent. If you do not meet the prerequisites for Karmic Body, you gain it when you do. ### Path Synergies #### Spirit Awakening - Soul Ledger Spirit Awakening is the primary Path for Karma because Karma listens to souls, vows, intent, guilt, merit, grievance, and obligation. When using Ledger Eye or Karmic Sight, you may also sense one of the following when relevant: possession; soul damage; whether the creature’s soul is bound; whether a spirit, ghost, ancestor, or oath-witness is attached to it; whether a vow has scarred the target’s soul rather than only its aura. Once per long rest, when you would place a Debt or Grace Imprint on a creature you can perceive spiritually, you may place that Imprint without using your Reaction. #### Qi Cultivation - Heavenly Calculation Qi Cultivators approach Karma through celestial arithmetic, cause-and-effect diagrams, heavenly stems, karmic numerology, and the calculation of consequence. You may use Intelligence or Charisma instead of Wisdom as your Karma key ability. Once per turn, when you spend CP on a Karma talent, reduce its cost by 1, minimum 1, if the target carries one of your Karmic Imprints or is bound by one of your Oath talents. #### Body Refining - Karmic Body Body Refiners do not normally cast distant spiritual ledgers. A Body Refining Karma cultivator must carry Karma in scars, bones, breath, bruises, blood-price, impact memory, oath tattoos, or a vow engraved into flesh. You need the Karmic Body Cultivation Insight or an equivalent story initiation to use this synergy. When a creature damages you with a melee attack, unarmed strike, natural weapon, or physically delivered weapon attack, you may place one Debt Imprint on it without using your Reaction. This can occur only once per round. When you willingly take damage for an ally or fulfill a physical oath at personal cost, you may place one Grace Imprint on yourself without using your Reaction. This can occur only once per long rest unless a talent says otherwise. Body Refining Karma talents usually require self, touch, melee range, worn gear, oath scars, blood marks, or a creature that has directly harmed the Body Refiner. Detached remote judgment requires an explicit Insight, item, Formation, Talisman, Spirit Awakening feature, or story permission. #### Karma and Fate When combined with Fate, Karma can decide which roll deserves alteration. Fate shifts probability; Karma supplies cause. A Karma/Fate cultivator may use a Debt or Grace Imprint as the story condition for a Fate talent, if the GM approves. #### Karma and Talismans Karma talismans function as receipts, oath papers, grievance slips, merit charms, or delayed punishments. Talismans handles the script, trigger, storage, and prepared medium. Karma supplies the consequence. #### Karma and Formations A Karma Formation may punish trespass, reward loyal service, expose oath-breaking, or mark repeated violence inside a hall. Formations handles the Array Eye, Nodes, Gates, and site procedure. Karma handles the debt or grace being recorded. #### Karma and Sect Stewardship Sect Stewardship records social merit, duties, offices, petitions, and institutional recognition. Karma can make those records spiritually heavy. A sect ledger blessed by Karma may treat merit as Grace and betrayal as Debt. #### Karma and Death Karma can track murder, unfinished grievance, ghost debts, ancestral punishment, and revenge vows. Death commands grave Qi, corpses, ghosts, and death law. The combination is dangerous and often forbidden. #### Karma and Radiance Radiance reveals and burns corruption. Karma reveals and punishes consequence. Together they form heavenly judgment, especially against oath-breakers, possessing spirits, demonic cultivators, and hidden murderers. ### Cultivation Insights #### Karmic Body Prerequisite: Body Refining Path, CL 4+, secret karmic initiation You may learn Karma despite using Body Refining as your Path. You use Stamina instead of CP for Karma talents. You gain the Body Refining - Karmic Body Path synergy. Your Karma effects are visibly embodied as scars, bruises, breath marks, bone inscriptions, blood-red veins, impact echoes, or oath tattoos. A creature can identify this with a successful Wisdom or Intelligence check against your Cultivation Save DC. #### Oathkeeper Prerequisite: Karma sphere, CL 8+ When you knowingly fulfill a difficult promise despite personal cost, gain one Grace Imprint on yourself. Maximum: one Grace Imprint per long rest. You have Advantage on checks made to recognize magically binding promises, coerced oaths, and oath loopholes. #### Debt Collector Prerequisite: Karma sphere, CL 8+ When a creature with at least three of your Debt Imprints drops to 0 Hit Points within 60 feet of you, regain CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once you use this Insight, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest. #### Heaven’s Witness Prerequisite: Karma sphere, CL 8+ When you use Record the Deed on a creature that breaks an oath, betrays a willing ally, murders a helpless creature, or violates hospitality, you may spend 1 CP to make the Imprint persistent. A persistent Imprint lasts for 7 days or until spent. You may maintain only one persistent Imprint through this Insight at a time. #### Grace-Bearing Soul Prerequisite: Karma sphere, Spirit Awakening Path, CL 8+ When you spend a Grace Imprint to reduce damage, grant Temporary HP, or improve a saving throw, the target may also end Charmed or Frightened on itself if the effect’s source has lower CL than you. Once you use this additional benefit, you cannot use it again until you finish a long rest. #### Merciless Accountant Prerequisite: Karma sphere, CL 10+ When a creature carrying one of your Debt Imprints creates another Debt Cause, you may move one Debt Imprint from another creature within 60 feet onto it. The receiving creature cannot exceed your normal Imprint maximum. Once you use this Insight, you cannot use it again until the start of your next turn. #### Borrowed Merit Prerequisite: Karma sphere, CL 10+ When a willing creature carrying one of your Grace Imprints would fail an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw, another willing creature within 30 feet carrying one of your Grace Imprints may expend its Imprint to add 1d4 to the roll. This can occur once per round. #### Ledger-Safe Tongue Prerequisite: Karma sphere, CL 4+ You have Advantage on Charisma checks made to word clear oaths, negotiate fair terms, identify hidden traps in bargains, and persuade creatures that a consequence is just. When you create Minor Oath, you may include one simple exception clause without making the oath unclear.

Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Target: One creature, object, oath, corpse, location, or visible supernatural bond you can perceive
You open the Ledger Eye and read visible consequence around the target.
Choose one question:
Does the target carry one of your Karmic Imprints?
Is the target bound by an oath, curse, contract, possession bond, summoning bond, or supernatural obligation?
Has the target recently caused a death, betrayal, rescue, or oath-breaking within the last 24 hours?
Is the target concealing strong guilt, resentment, obligation, gratitude, or grievance?
Is a Fate, Divination, Karma, Curse, or Oath effect altering the target’s road?
Is this location unusually burdened by death, betrayal, worship, grievance, or fulfilled vows?
The GM answers truthfully, but the answer may be symbolic rather than exact. Ledger Eye does not automatically identify names, motives, or hidden details.
At CL 5, you may ask two questions. At CL 11, you may ask three questions.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Read the Pulse
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 0 CP
You read the target’s living pattern.
You learn whether the target is living, dead, dying, poisoned, diseased, Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. You also learn whether the target currently has 0 Hit Points.
You may place a Pulse Seal on the target.
If you use Read the Pulse as an Action instead of a Bonus Action, you also learn the general nature of one disease, poison, injury, or condition affecting the target. The GM may describe this in practical terms rather than revealing hidden stat-block names.
You may use Read the Pulse on a corpse that has been dead no longer than 1 day. If you do, you learn the most obvious cause of death.
You may use Read the Pulse on a creature bearing your Pulse Seal regardless of distance or line of effect, provided the creature is on the same plane of existence. When you do, you know the creature’s direction and distance from you.
Body Refiners cannot use this remote reading unless a talent, forged technique, or GM permission allows their Pulse Seal to remain physically meaningful at that distance.

#### Borrowed Breath
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 0 CP
You lend temporary vitality to an injured creature.
The target gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the target has 0 Hit Points and is living, the target becomes stable before receiving these Temporary HP. These Temporary HP do not restore the target to consciousness unless another feature says otherwise.
Borrowed Breath can only be used on an injured target. It cannot raise the target’s current Hit Points plus Temporary HP above the target’s Hit Point maximum unless a talent says otherwise.
Augment - Lasting Breath, 1 CP: The Temporary HP last until depleted or until you finish a long rest. You may apply this augment after creating Borrowed Breath on your turn without spending an action.

#### Purify the Pulse
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 1 CP
You remove one disease or one of the following conditions from the target:
Blinded;
Deafened;
Paralyzed;
Poisoned.
If the condition is caused by an ongoing effect, Purify the Pulse suppresses that effect for a number of rounds equal to your key ability modifier, minimum 1 round. This does not end the source effect unless a talent says otherwise.
Purify the Pulse cannot remove curses, instantaneous effects, missing limbs, Exhaustion, ability score reductions, Hit Point maximum reductions, or spiritual bindings unless a talent says otherwise.
