spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Life Qi Expression: Primary — Life Qi; Supporting — Wood Qi, Blood Qi, Healing Qi, Breath Qi. “Life is not the refusal of death. Life is the remembered pattern that teaches the body how to continue.” Common Name: Life Sphere Sphere Type: Vital Restoration Sphere Primary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Rare Variant: Body Refining through self-contained healing bodies, marrow sutras, pressure-point medicine, physician-fist methods, and blood-breath scriptures Resource: CP, or Stamina when a Body Refining feature permits Life useCore Chassis: Pulse Seals Common Effects: diagnosis, healing, stabilization, temporary vitality, poison and disease treatment, condition removal, delayed healing, restorative surges, sympathetic transfer, regeneration, resuscitation, resurrection, soul-return rites, and battlefield infirmary fields ### Life Dao Life is the cultivation of remembered continuity. A Life cultivator does not merely pour vitality into wounds. They read the living pattern beneath the wound, discover where breath, blood, flesh, meridian, and spirit have forgotten their proper rhythm, and set a Pulse Seal that teaches the body how to continue. Life is not automatically gentle. A battlefield physician may close a wound with ruthless speed. A sect healer may take poison into their own meridians. A forbidden plague-doctor may strip an affliction from an ally and cast it into an enemy. A Nascent Soul master may call a soul back before the yellow springs forget its name. The recurring loop is: Read the pulse. Identify the living pattern, its injuries, and whether the target still remembers how to continue. Set the seal. Place a Pulse Seal that gives your cultivation a stable point of treatment. Mend, lend, or purify. Restore Hit Points, lend temporary vitality, or remove a harmful state. Deepen the continuity. Use talents to delay healing, spread treatment, take harm into yourself, regenerate damaged bodies, or hold the soul at the threshold. Respect the price. Life can defy death, but every return should leave exhaustion, debt, penalty, karmic notice, rare-material cost, sect attention, or story consequence when the scale becomes large. Life is the Dao of the question: What part of the living pattern still remembers how to return? ### What Life Does Life cultivators read the living pattern, set a Pulse Seal, and teach flesh, breath, and spirit to remember how to continue. Life talents commonly do one or more of the following: read a creature’s living pattern; place, preserve, deepen, or spread a Pulse Seal; restore Hit Points; grant temporary vitality; stabilize the dying; remove disease, poison, wounds, or conditions; delay healing until the correct moment; take another creature’s affliction into yourself; repair a broken body; preserve or return a willing soul. Life is powerful, but not casual. Large-scale healing, regeneration, and resurrection may still require Realm, body integrity, soul consent, rare materials, sect infrastructure, downtime, or story consequences when the scene calls for them. ### Realm Progression Mortal Realm. A Life cultivator reads injuries, stabilizes the dying, heals by touch, grants limited temporary vitality, removes common diseases and bodily conditions, and learns basic battlefield medicine. Foundation Realm. The cultivator can perform stronger treatment, suppress curse-like effects, restore movement and mind, affect sealed allies at short range, treat several patients at once, and perform one-breath resuscitation if death has only just occurred. Core Formation Realm. The cultivator repairs deep injuries, removes multiple afflictions, reattaches limbs, regrows lesser body parts, treats body-soul disagreement, creates infirmary fields, and can return the dead within a minute when the body remains mostly intact. Nascent Soul Realm. The cultivator performs true resurrection rites, restores missing body parts during resurrection, creates domains of remembered breath, preserves a soul-lamp at the instant of death, and treats battlefield-scale catastrophe. Secret Inheritance. The cultivator proves that life is not stored in blood, breath, marrow, or soul alone, but in the agreement between them. ### Sphere Boundaries Life overlaps many spheres. These boundaries keep it from becoming the general solution to every harm. #### Life and Yang Yang kindles unfinished force and helps something complete or overcomplete. Yang may keep a creature fighting for one more breath, stir vitality, break restraint through rising force, or burn out a hostile exertion. Life performs dedicated healing, diagnosis, restoration, regeneration, and resurrection. #### Life and Blood Blood governs living blood, bleeding, lineage, sacrifice, internal flow, blood authority, and blood-price techniques. Life may close wounds or cleanse a blood-borne poison, but it does not command blood as an element, enforce lineage law, or turn bleeding into a weapon unless a specific talent says so. #### Life and Wood or Verdant Growth Wood and Verdant Growth govern plants, roots, seasonal growth, living terrain, groves, seeds, and plant bodies. Life restores creatures and living patterns. Life does not grow forests, command roots, generate spiritual herbs, or replace plant cultivation. #### Life and Protection Protection prevents harm through aegises, wards, barriers, sacrificial defense, and safe boundaries. Life repairs harm after it happens or preserves the living pattern as it fails. A Life cultivator can keep an ally alive, but does not automatically create shields, barriers, or damage interception. #### Life and Radiance Radiance reveals, purifies, judges, blesses, and burns away corruption through light. Life may cleanse disease or poison, but it does so by restoring the living pattern, not by holy brilliance. Radiance can expose what is wrong. Life teaches the body how to recover from it. #### Life and Death Life restores. Death prevents return, preserves remains, commands corpses, governs grave qi, and negotiates endings. Life may return a willing soul to a viable body. It does not command corpses, enslave ghosts, harvest death as power, or make the dead answer as servants. #### Life and Alchemy Alchemy prepares medicines, pills, elixirs, reagents, volatile formulae, antidotes, and long-term treatment materials. Life is immediate cultivation healing. Alchemy may support Life through prepared medicine, rare ingredients, or clinical projects, but Life does not automatically create pills, cauldrons, reagents, or material remedies. #### Life and Qiweaving Qiweaving interferes with active qi patterns, temporary effects, dispelling, disruption, and pattern rank. Life can suppress an ongoing harmful effect through restoration talents, but it is not a general counterspell or universal dispelling sphere. #### Life and Spirit Awakening Spirit Awakening is a Path. Life is a sphere. Spirit Awakening provides the soul-facing perspective that makes Life’s soul-return, trauma treatment, and body-spirit repair more natural. Life does not automatically read minds, command souls, rewrite identity, enter dreams, or force an unwilling soul to return. ### Rules Baseline Use the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline unless this sphere explicitly changes it. #### Hit Points and Healing Life talents that restore Hit Points follow ordinary healing rules. They cannot raise a target above its Hit Point maximum unless a talent says otherwise. Life healing does not restore Temporary HP, CP, Stamina, spell slots, class resources, item charges, or limited-use features unless a talent says so. #### Temporary HP Temporary HP from Borrowed Breath follow ordinary Temporary Hit Point rules unless a talent says otherwise. Temporary HP do not stack. If a creature already has Temporary HP and receives more, it chooses which source to keep. Borrowed Breath has a local limit: by default it can only be used on an injured target and cannot raise current Hit Points plus Temporary HP above the target’s Hit Point maximum. Greater Invigorate removes this local limit. #### Dying, Stability, and 0 Hit Points A living creature at 0 Hit Points follows the normal dying rules. Borrowed Breath can stabilize such a creature, but Temporary HP alone do not restore consciousness. Mend the Pulse can restore consciousness if it raises the target above 0 Hit Points. Life talents do not prevent instant death from massive damage, decapitation, disintegration, old age, soul destruction, or effects that state death occurs without a dying interval unless a talent specifically says otherwise. #### Conditions Life talents may reference ordinary conditions such as Blinded, Charmed, Deafened, Frightened, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, and Unconscious. Use the 2024 meanings unless this sphere defines a local state. Purify the Pulse can remove only the conditions listed in its text or in a talent modifying it. #### Disease and Poison Disease and poison may be mundane, alchemical, spiritual, demonic, curse-like, environmental, or cultivation-based. A basic Life ability can treat ordinary disease or poison. Stronger or story-scale afflictions may require a talent, a Cultivation Check, rare medicine, downtime, Alchemy support, sect infrastructure, or a quest. #### Curses and Ongoing Effects Life does not automatically remove curses or ongoing magical effects. Break Enchantment allows a Life cultivator to attempt suppression or removal of an ongoing effect through restoration, but it does not make Life a universal dispelling sphere. #### Undead, Constructs, and Artificial Bodies Life normally affects living creatures. It does not affect undead, constructs, animated objects, or purely spiritual entities unless a talent says otherwise. Esoteric Vitality lets Life recognize unnatural animating patterns. This still does not make those targets living for every rule. #### Corpses and Resurrection A corpse is an object unless a rule treats it otherwise. Resuscitation and resurrection require a mostly intact body unless the talent says it can restore missing parts. A soul must be willing and at liberty to return. Life cannot return a creature that died of old age, cannot compel an unwilling soul, and cannot overcome soul destruction, reincarnation beyond reach, divine prohibition, stronger underworld law, or campaign-scale cosmology without GM permission. #### Concentration If a Life talent requires Concentration, use the normal concentration rules. Sustained Revitalizing Thread and similar talents say when a Life effect can persist without Concentration. ### Key Ability, Save DC, and Costs Use your Path key ability for Life talents unless a Life feature says otherwise. Qi Cultivation uses the key ability chosen for that Path. Spirit Awakening uses Wisdom. Body Refining Life uses Constitution when a Body Refining feature, Insight, variant scripture, or forged technique permits Life use through the body. When a Life talent calls for a saving throw, use your Cultivation Save DC. Cultivation Save DC: 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. When a Life talent calls for a Cultivation Check, roll: d20 + Proficiency Bonus + your Life key ability modifier. When a Life talent lists a CP cost, spend CP from the pool granted by your Path. If you are using a permitted Body Refining Life method, spend Stamina instead. Unless a talent says otherwise, a cost cannot be reduced below 0. ### Martial, Power, and Body Access Life is a Power Sphere by default because most expressions manipulate living essence, medicinal qi, spiritual continuity, or soul-return authority. Qi Cultivation is the cleanest default access. A Qi cultivator externalizes medicinal qi through palms, needles, breath, talismans, hand seals, scripture recitation, or sect infirmary methods. Spirit Awakening can practice Life by reading the soul’s memory of embodiment, diagnosing trauma in the aura, cooling terror, calling a drifting soul back, and repairing the link between body and spirit. Body Refining does not normally project healing qi outside the body. A Body Refiner can learn Life only through a feature, Insight, subpath, variant scripture, forged technique, or GM-approved initiation that explains how the body itself becomes medicine. Unless a Life talent specifically says otherwise, a Body Refiner using Life: must target themself, a creature they touch, a creature touching them, or a creature connected through blood, breath, pressure-point contact, carried medicine, or physical treatment; cannot use remote Pulse Seal targeting through open air; cannot create a free-floating medicinal qi field away from the body; can express Life through marrow strength, self-regeneration, palm treatment, breath sharing, body heat, medicinal sweat, bone-setting, and taking another creature’s affliction into the body. ### Core Life Rules #### Pulse Seals The Life sphere uses Pulse Seals. A Pulse Seal is a cultivation mark placed upon the living pattern of a creature. It is not a condition. Immunity to a condition does not grant immunity to Pulse Seals unless a feature says otherwise. A Pulse Seal represents a healer’s recognition of how a creature’s life should continue. #### Pulse Seal Limit You can maintain a number of Pulse Seals equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature can bear only one Pulse Seal from you at a time unless a talent says otherwise. A Pulse Seal lasts for 1 hour, until you dismiss it, until the creature dies, until you finish a long rest, or until the creature is no longer on the same plane of existence as you. A willing creature may end your Pulse Seal on itself at any time, no action required. #### Placing a Pulse Seal When you use a Life sphere ability on a willing living creature, you may place a Pulse Seal on that creature. You may also place a Pulse Seal with Read the Pulse. #### Sealed Allies A creature bearing your Pulse Seal is a sealed ally. Some talents can read, heal, or protect sealed allies at range. Body Refiners do not gain remote sealed-ally functions unless a talent, forged technique, subpath, or GM permission explains the physical or embodied connection that makes the seal legal. #### Pulse Seals and Hostile Creatures Life is not primarily a hostile marking sphere. You can place a Pulse Seal on an unwilling creature only if a talent says so. A hostile creature that somehow bears your Pulse Seal still remains unwilling for healing or restoration unless the GM decides the creature accepts treatment. #### Life Talent Tags Pulse Talents place, read, spend, expand, or protect Pulse Seals. Mend Talents improve healing. Breath Talents improve Borrowed Breath and temporary vitality. Purification Talents improve condition, disease, poison, curse, or effect removal. Diagnosis Talents improve Read the Pulse and medical understanding. Sympathetic Talents move afflictions into the healer. Plague Talents transfer or weaponize disease, poison, or removed conditions. These are often Forbidden. Regeneration Talents restore damaged or missing body parts. Soul-Return Talents return the recently dead or call a willing soul back. Field Talents affect groups, auras, infirmary areas, or battlefield aftermath. Variant Scriptures change how Life cultivation functions in exchange for a bonus talent or benefit. ### Base Sphere Abilities When you learn the Life sphere, you gain Life Initiation, Read the Pulse, Mend the Pulse, Borrowed Breath, and Purify the Pulse. #### Life Initiation You gain training in the basic language of living patterns. You can recognize obvious signs of bleeding, suffocation, poisoning, disease, dying, shock, spiritual drift, and broken meridian flow. This does not replace a Medicine check, Alchemy diagnosis, or Spirit Awakening perception when the cause is hidden. You may use your Life key ability instead of Wisdom for Medicine checks made to stabilize a living creature or identify a wound, poison, disease, or condition that your Life talents could treat. #### Read the Pulse Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Target: One living creature Duration: Instantaneous Cost: 0 CP You read the target’s living pattern. You learn whether the target is living, dead, dying, poisoned, diseased, Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. You also learn whether the target currently has 0 Hit Points. You may place a Pulse Seal on the target. If you use Read the Pulse as an Action instead of a Bonus Action, you also learn the general nature of one disease, poison, injury, or condition affecting the target. The GM may describe this in practical terms rather than revealing hidden stat-block names. You may use Read the Pulse on a corpse that has been dead no longer than 1 day. If you do, you learn the most obvious cause of death. You may use Read the Pulse on a creature bearing your Pulse Seal regardless of distance or line of effect, provided the creature is on the same plane of existence. When you do, you know the creature’s direction and distance from you. Body Refiners cannot use this remote reading unless a talent, forged technique, or GM permission allows their Pulse Seal to remain physically meaningful at that distance. #### Mend the Pulse Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Target: One living creature Duration: Instantaneous Cost: 1 CP You restore the target’s living pattern. The target regains Hit Points based on your Realm. Mortal: 1d8 + your key ability modifier.Foundation: 2d8 + your key ability modifier.Core Formation: 3d8 + your key ability modifier.Nascent Soul: 4d8 + your key ability modifier. Mend the Pulse has no effect on undead or constructs unless a talent says otherwise. #### Borrowed Breath Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Target: One living creature Duration: 1 hour Cost: 0 CP You lend temporary vitality to an injured creature. The target gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If the target has 0 Hit Points and is living, the target becomes stable before receiving these Temporary HP. These Temporary HP do not restore the target to consciousness unless another feature says otherwise. Borrowed Breath can only be used on an injured target. It cannot raise the target’s current Hit Points plus Temporary HP above the target’s Hit Point maximum unless a talent says otherwise. Augment - Lasting Breath, 1 CP: The Temporary HP last until depleted or until you finish a long rest. You may apply this augment after creating Borrowed Breath on your turn without spending an action. #### Purify the Pulse Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Target: One living creature Duration: Instantaneous Cost: 1 CP You remove one disease or one of the following conditions from the target: Blinded; Deafened; Paralyzed; Poisoned. If the condition is caused by an ongoing effect, Purify the Pulse suppresses that effect for a number of rounds equal to your key ability modifier, minimum 1 round. This does not end the source effect unless a talent says otherwise. Purify the Pulse cannot remove curses, instantaneous effects, missing limbs, Exhaustion, ability score reductions, Hit Point maximum reductions, or spiritual bindings unless a talent says otherwise. ### Mortal Realm Talents - CL 1+ Mortal Life talents focus on battlefield medicine, diagnosis, emergency healing, stabilizing the dying, delayed recovery, and ordinary condition treatment. #### Adrenaline Surge - Breath, Response When you use a Life sphere ability on an ally other than yourself, you may spend 1 CP to shock their living pattern into motion. You may apply this augment after creating the effect on your turn without spending an action. #### Shared Infirmary Hand - Field When you use Read the Pulse, Mend the Pulse, Borrowed Breath, or Purify the Pulse, you may spend 1 additional CP to affect one additional willing creature you can touch. In addition, the target does not fall Prone from being unconscious if the GM judges that your touch reaches it before it collapses fully, such as during a readied action, reaction-based forged technique, or cinematic immediate treatment. This talent is usually treated as a sect-scale miracle, battlefield aftermath art, plague-response rite, or immortal physician inheritance rather than casual combat healing. #### Yellow-Spring Refusal Seal - Soul-Return, Pulse You place a seal that forbids the threshold from closing too quickly. Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Target: One willing living creature bearing your Pulse Seal Duration: Until the target finishes a long rest Cost: 4 CP The first time during the duration that the target would die and leave a mostly intact body, the seal triggers. The target remains dead, but its soul does not fully depart for 1 minute. During that minute, any Life soul-return talent used on the target treats the death as having occurred in the last round. Once the seal triggers, it ends. A creature can benefit from only one Yellow-Spring Refusal Seal at a time. This seal cannot hold a soul destroyed, consumed, imprisoned, reincarnated beyond reach, claimed by stronger underworld authority, or forbidden from returning by the campaign’s cosmology. ### Secret Inheritance #### Secret Inheritance: The Unbroken Spring Sutra This inheritance teaches that life is not stored in blood, breath, marrow, or soul alone. Life is the agreement between them. When you gain this Secret Inheritance, you gain the following benefits: You can maintain one additional Pulse Seal. When you use Mend the Pulse on a creature bearing your Pulse Seal, roll one additional healing die. When you use Purify the Pulse on a creature bearing your Pulse Seal, you may suppress an ongoing effect for 1 additional round. Once per long rest, when a creature bearing your Pulse Seal within 60 feet would die, you may use your Reaction to spend 3 CP and force the creature to remain alive until the end of its next turn. During that time, the creature is at 0 Hit Points, stable, and cannot regain consciousness unless healed. If the creature is healed before the end of its next turn, it survives. If it is not healed, it dies when the delay ends. This inheritance cannot delay death from old age, soul destruction, complete bodily annihilation, or a cosmological death decree stronger than your cultivation. ### Life Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures A Life drawback is an optional sphere-specific limitation that grants a bonus Life talent or benefit while changing how your Life cultivation functions. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Life drawback when first learning Life or undergoing a major Life initiation; Life drawbacks are mutually exclusive; the drawback applies to all Life talents you use; if a drawback grants a talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, you gain that talent when you meet the prerequisites; if the drawback is retrained or removed, the bonus talent or benefit is lost. These are Tianxia-specific cultivation limits, not imported casting traditions. #### Limited Restoration Scripture Choose one limitation. Closed Wound Scripture: You cannot use Purify the Pulse or take talents that only modify Purify the Pulse. Cold Physician Scripture: You cannot use Mend the Pulse or Borrowed Breath, and you cannot take talents that only modify those abilities. You gain one bonus Life talent for which you meet the prerequisites. #### Self-Returning Body Scripture Your Life cultivation only recognizes your own body as a proper field of treatment. You can only target yourself with Life sphere abilities. You gain Revitalizing Thread or Fount of Life as a bonus talent. At Foundation Realm, you may also learn One-Breath Resuscitation as a Body Refining forged exception, but it can only affect you unless the GM says otherwise. This scripture is common among Body Refiners. #### Sympathetic Physician Scripture You can only purify others by accepting their suffering into yourself. You gain Empathic Transfer as a bonus talent. Whenever you use Purify the Pulse, you must use Empathic Transfer if the affliction can be transferred into you. You cannot combine this scripture with any drawback that removes Purify the Pulse. Orthodox sects respect this scripture, but warn that many sympathetic physicians die young. #### Severed Mercy Scripture Your Life cultivation can heal wounds but cannot call back the dead. You cannot learn One-Breath Resuscitation, Minute-Gate Resuscitation, Resurrection, Greater Resurrection, Soul-Lamp Continuity, Yellow-Spring Refusal Seal, or any talent whose main function is returning the dead to life. You gain one bonus Mortal or Foundation Life talent for which you meet the prerequisites. Many orthodox medical halls require this scripture for healers who are not permitted to interfere with reincarnation or the underworld bureaucracy. #### Rooted Infirmary Scripture Your Life cultivation depends on a prepared place of treatment. Choose a bonded infirmary, shrine, clinic, cave, spring, ancestral hall, battlefield medical tent, or other fixed healing site. While within 1 mile per Cultivation Level of that site, your Life talents function normally. Outside that range, whenever you spend CP on a Life talent, make a Cultivation Check against DC 10 + twice the CP spent. Success: The talent functions normally. Failure: The action and CP are spent, but the talent has no effect. You can bond to a new site with an 8-hour rite. You gain Clear Physician’s Eye or Fount of Life as a bonus talent. #### Bound Medicine Scripture Your Life cultivation requires a visible treatment focus, such as a jade needle case, physician’s bell, bone-setting rod, medicine gourd, scripture scroll, pulse-thread bracelet, or ancestral infirmary token. If you do not have the focus in hand or worn openly, whenever you spend CP on a Life talent, make a Cultivation Check against DC 10 + twice the CP spent. Success: The talent functions normally. Failure: The action and CP are spent, but the talent has no effect. If your focus is lost or destroyed, you can consecrate a replacement during a short or long rest. You gain one Diagnosis, Mend, or Purification talent for which you meet the prerequisites. #### Quiet Clinic Scripture Your Life cultivation cannot function while your emotions are violently disturbed. You cannot use Life talents while Charmed, Frightened, Stunned, Incapacitated, or under a supernatural rage, panic, ecstasy, despair, or compulsion effect that prevents calm treatment. You may use an Action to steady your breath and make a Wisdom saving throw against DC 10 + your Proficiency Bonus. On a success, you can use Life talents until the end of your next turn despite the emotional disturbance. You gain Clear Physician’s Eye or Mind-Cooling Pulse as a bonus talent. If you do not meet the prerequisite for Mind-Cooling Pulse, you gain it when you do. ### Path Synergies #### Body Refining Body Refining Life is strongest when the cultivator becomes the medicine. Good Body Refining expressions include: healing through palm pressure; sealing wounds with heated blood; breathing into another creature’s lungs; bone-setting with iron fingers; taking poison into your own marrow; regenerating by condensing flesh around the injury; storing Fount of Life in the dantian, bones, heart, or blood. Body Refining Life should usually remain self-only or touch-based unless the cultivator deliberately forges a technique to extend it. A Body Refiner who wants more standard party healing should usually take a forged technique, variant scripture, physician subpath, medicine treasure, or sect training that explains how their body maintains the treatment connection. #### Qi Cultivation Qi Cultivation Life is the standard physician’s path. Good Qi Cultivation expressions include: medicinal qi threads; jade needles; meridian diagrams; spirit-herb breath; golden healing light that is not automatically Radiance; sect infirmary methods; battlefield triage formations; Pulse Seals written in qi. Qi Cultivators are the most likely Life users to learn Life-Seal Reach, Pulse Array Treatment, Vital Court Field, and World-Womb Restoration. #### Spirit Awakening Spirit Awakening Life treats the living body as a promise remembered by the soul. Good Spirit Awakening expressions include: hearing the target’s fading breath as a voice; seeing the shape of pain in the aura; waking the part of the soul that still wants to live; restoring Frightened, Charmed, Stunned, or Unconscious conditions; guiding a willing soul back during resurrection; distinguishing a body that is dead from a soul that is gone. Spirit Awakening Life is the most natural route to Resurrection, Soul-Lamp Continuity, Soul-in-the-Body Treatment, and Life Domain: Hall of Returning Breath. ### Cultivation Insights #### Battlefield Physician Prerequisite: Life sphere. When you use Read the Pulse in combat, you may move up to 10 feet before or after using it without provoking opportunity attacks from the target of your treatment. In addition, when you stabilize a creature, that creature gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Clean-Handed Healer Prerequisite: Life sphere. When you use Purify the Pulse to remove disease or poison, you have Advantage on any Cultivation Check required to identify or suppress the same disease or poison for the next 24 hours. If you successfully treat three or more creatures suffering from the same disease or poison during a single scene, the GM may allow you to understand its mundane treatment requirements. #### Iron Mercy Prerequisite: Life sphere and Body Refining Path. When you use Empathic Transfer, you gain Temporary HP equal to your Constitution modifier + your Proficiency Bonus. These Temporary HP can only absorb damage or harm caused by the affliction you accepted. #### Pulse-Thread Memory Prerequisite: Life sphere. You can maintain one additional Pulse Seal. When you use Read the Pulse on a creature bearing your Pulse Seal, you may learn whether the creature has taken damage since the start of your last turn. #### Sect Infirmary Disciple Prerequisite: Life sphere. During a short rest, you may treat a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each treated creature that spends one or more Hit Dice regains additional Hit Points equal to your key ability modifier. If your campaign uses cultivation injuries, the GM may allow this Insight to reduce the time required for ordinary nonmagical recovery. #### Soul-Return Witness Prerequisite: Life sphere and Spirit Awakening Path. When you use Read the Pulse on a corpse that has been dead no longer than 1 day, you also learn whether the soul appears willing, unwilling, absent, trapped, consumed, or blocked from ordinary return, to the extent that the answer is visible to your cultivation. This does not reveal who trapped the soul or how to defeat the obstacle unless the GM says your result is strong enough. ### Forged Technique Examples #### Palm That Remembers Warmth Suggested Realm: Foundation. Sphere: Life. Path Fit: Body Refining or Qi Cultivation. You strike or touch a creature and leave a Pulse Seal in the same motion. When you hit a creature with an unarmed strike or touch a willing creature as part of movement, you may spend 1 CP to place a Pulse Seal on that creature. If the creature is willing, it also gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Body Refiners often use this technique to keep Life touch-based while still functioning in combat. #### Needle Bridge Across the Battlefield Suggested Realm: Foundation or Core Formation. Sphere: Life. Path Fit: Qi Cultivation. You anchor fine medicinal qi threads in jade needles. When you place a Pulse Seal on a willing creature, you may also place a visible or invisible needle-thread anchor. While the creature is within 60 feet, your Life-Seal Reach treats it as though it were 30 feet closer. If the thread is severed by an enemy, the Pulse Seal remains but the range benefit ends. #### Dream of the Body Before the Wound Suggested Realm: Core Formation. Sphere: Life. Path Fit: Spirit Awakening. You show the target’s soul a memory of its unwounded body. When you use Mend the Pulse on a creature bearing your Pulse Seal, you may spend 2 CP to also allow the target to make a new saving throw against one Charmed, Frightened, Stunned, or Unconscious effect currently affecting it. On a success, the effect ends. #### The Last Breath Waits at the Door Suggested Realm: Nascent Soul. Sphere: Life. Path Fit: Spirit Awakening or Qi Cultivation. You set a soul-return seal that waits for disaster. When you use Latent Healing on a creature, you may spend 3 additional CP to create a Last Breath Seal. If the creature dies while the Latent Healing remains, the Latent Healing triggers immediately before death is finalized. If the healing raises the creature above 0 Hit Points, it survives and gains 1 level of Exhaustion. A creature can benefit from only one Last Breath Seal per long rest. ### Downtime and Sect Project Examples #### Sect Infirmary Ledger A Life cultivator can maintain a ledger of Pulse Seal treatments in a sect infirmary. Over downtime, this may justify improved recovery for disciples, reduced plague spread, safer breakthrough care, and better diagnosis of unusual poisons. #### Plague-Ward Clinic A Life cultivator with Clear Physician’s Eye, Greater Purification, or World-Womb Restoration can lead a plague-response project. Alchemy, Harvesting and Gathering, Radiance, Protection, and Sect Stewardship may all contribute. #### Battlefield Mercy Hall A sect may build doctrine around Life cultivators recovering wounded allies after combat. This should affect social authority, mission rewards, obligations to the wounded, and enemy attempts to target healers. #### Soul-Return Petition A Resurrection attempt may require permission from underworld clerks, ancestral tablets, sect elders, death-cultivator wardens, or the dead person’s own Dao. Treat this as story support for the soul-at-liberty requirement.

resolved_automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Read the Pulse
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 0 CP
You read the target’s living pattern.
You learn whether the target is living, dead, dying, poisoned, diseased, Blinded, Deafened, Paralyzed, or Poisoned. You also learn whether the target currently has 0 Hit Points.
You may place a Pulse Seal on the target.
If you use Read the Pulse as an Action instead of a Bonus Action, you also learn the general nature of one disease, poison, injury, or condition affecting the target. The GM may describe this in practical terms rather than revealing hidden stat-block names.
You may use Read the Pulse on a corpse that has been dead no longer than 1 day. If you do, you learn the most obvious cause of death.
You may use Read the Pulse on a creature bearing your Pulse Seal regardless of distance or line of effect, provided the creature is on the same plane of existence. When you do, you know the creature’s direction and distance from you.
Body Refiners cannot use this remote reading unless a talent, forged technique, or GM permission allows their Pulse Seal to remain physically meaningful at that distance.

#### Borrowed Breath
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Target: One living creature
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 0 CP
You lend temporary vitality to an injured creature.
The target gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If the target has 0 Hit Points and is living, the target becomes stable before receiving these Temporary HP. These Temporary HP do not restore the target to consciousness unless another feature says otherwise.
Borrowed Breath can only be used on an injured target. It cannot raise the target’s current Hit Points plus Temporary HP above the target’s Hit Point maximum unless a talent says otherwise.
Augment - Lasting Breath, 1 CP: The Temporary HP last until depleted or until you finish a long rest. You may apply this augment after creating Borrowed Breath on your turn without spending an action.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### First Circuit Method
Action Type: Passive
Canonical Action Type: Passive
Factory Combat Bucket: passive
Timing Detail: Passive / Charge Rider
Factory Routing: passive_or_modifier_row
Range: Self
Cost: None
When you first gain the Lightning sphere, your meridians learn to hold a brief seed of unstable potential. This is called a First Circuit.
A First Circuit is not a full Charge and does not make you vulnerable to hostile Lightning talents unless a feature specifically says so. It is the internal spark that lets Lightning cultivation move through the body before it escapes into the world.
Once on each of your turns, when you use Gather Charge on yourself, a held weapon, a worn item, or a Lightning focus you are touching, choose one Circuit expression. The chosen expression lasts until the Charge ends.
**Body Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you deal lightning damage or consume a Charge, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature damaged by your Lightning sphere this turn.
**Edge Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, the next time you hit with an unarmed strike, weapon attack, Lightning Lash, or Lightning talent delivered through a held implement, you deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
**Nerve Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you would have your Speed reduced, be knocked Prone, or be denied Reactions by a non-Secret effect, you may discharge the Circuit to gain Advantage on the saving throw against that effect. If no saving throw is allowed, reduce the penalty by one step: ignore a Speed reduction of 10 feet or less, stand from Prone by spending 5 fewer feet of movement, or regain your Reaction at the start of your next turn.
**Conduction Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you apply Charge to a creature, object, formation node, talisman, weapon, armor, or 5-foot space, you may make yourself Conductive until the start of your next turn. While Conductive this way, your next Lightning talent that requires a Conductive Path may treat yourself, your held weapon, or your worn armor as the starting point of that path.
You may discharge only one First Circuit per round.

### Gather Charge
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Target: Yourself, one object you can see, one weapon you are holding, one willing creature you can see, one formation node you can see, or one unoccupied 5-foot space you can see
Cost: None
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
You gather unstable Lightning Qi and place a Charge on the target.
If you Charge a weapon you are holding, the next time you hit with that weapon before the Charge ends, you may consume the Charge to deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you Charge yourself, you gain Advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw you make before the Charge ends against lightning, thunder, paralysis, forced movement, or being knocked Prone.
If you Charge a 5-foot space, the space becomes Conductive. The first time a creature enters that space before the Charge ends, you may end the Charge to deal lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to that creature. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
At Foundation Realm, the range becomes 60 feet. At Core Formation, you may create two Charges with one use of Gather Charge, provided they are within range and do not exceed your Charge limit.

Lightning Lash is a Cultivation Attack, not a weapon attack, unless a talent says otherwise.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Lightning Qi Expression: Primary — Lightning Qi; Supporting — Thunder Qi, Storm Qi, Yang Qi, Metal-Conductive Qi, Wind Qi, Fire-Spark Qi, Nerve Qi, Meridian-Shock Qi, Heaven-Pressure Qi. “Thunder arrives after the flash. The fool fears the sound. The cultivator fears the instant before it.” Common Name: Lightning Sphere Sphere Type: Power Sphere; Elemental Sphere; Shock, Arc, Interruption, and Conductive-Force Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Paths: Body Refining and Spirit Awakening Key Themes: sudden connection, charge, arcs, shock, thunder, interruption, reaction denial, concentration disruption, conductive weapons, electric fists, pressure-point lightning, flash-step movement, lightning body transformation, anti-formation overload, talisman burnout, qi-construct disruption, storm-born strikes, heavenly judgment. Primary Resource Hooks: CP, Charge, Conductive paths, Concentration, weapons or body contact for embodied expressions, Weather support only when a talent or forged technique explicitly uses it. ## Lightning Dao Lightning is the cultivation of sudden connection. Fire asks what can be transformed by burning. Air asks how pressure, breath, and movement touch the world. Weather asks what condition Heaven has placed over the battlefield. Sound asks how vibration, speech, and resonance move through bodies and space. Lightning asks what happens when potential finds its path before defense finishes forming. A novice Lightning cultivator sparks a fist, stings a meridian, flashes across a short gap, or sends a bolt down a wet blade. A Foundation cultivator chains charge between enemies, burns talismans, shocks formations, and refines lightning through nerves and breath. A Core Formation master turns the battlefield into a circuit of prepared consequences. A Nascent Soul lightning sovereign makes armies discover that every raised weapon, shouted command, wet stone, and active ward has become part of the same judgment. Lightning is not merely damage. It is arrival, interruption, conductive fate, and the terrible clarity of the shortest path. ## Neighboring Sphere Boundaries Lightning overlaps several spheres but should not replace them. Weather governs battlefield condition: reading the sky, Sky Mantles, Cloud Shrouds, Gather Weather, severity, signs, shelter, exposure, and Realm-gated weather mandates. Lightning governs direct lightning strikes, charge, arcs, shock, conductive paths, thunderbursts, nerve disruption, flash movement, and electrical judgment. A Lightning talent may create sparks, thunderbursts, static fields, charged air, brief storm signs, or a localized thunderhead image. It does not normally create sustained weather, change climate categories, impose Weather severity, maintain Sky Mantles, hang Cloud Shrouds, or use Gather Weather. A forged technique may combine Lightning and Weather to do those things. Air governs currents, breath, flight, projectile denial, and wind as direct pressure. Fire governs flame, ignition, burning, heat, and transformation through combustion. Sound governs vibration, speech, echo, silence, and resonance; Lightning uses thunder as pressure and shock, not as broad sound mastery. Yang governs active vitality, heat, assertion, and life-force surge; Lightning may use Yang as a supporting qi but is not the full Yang sphere. Metal governs weapons, refinement, armor, cutting, and conductive material; Lightning may travel through metal but does not replace Metal. ## Realm Progression Mortal Realm: Lightning is body-spark, charged weapon, brief bolt, electric fist, pressure-point jolt, small arc, flash reveal, static guard, and thunderclap shock. Foundation Realm: Lightning becomes externalized and tactical. The cultivator chains targets, flash-steps, enters lightning body methods, overloads minor wards, charges arrows, burns talismans, shocks meridians, and creates short-lived conductive fields. Core Formation Realm: Lightning becomes circuit logic. The cultivator prepares charged paths, suppresses formation nodes, creates lightning prisons, rides return strokes, uses lightning-god transformations, and turns enemy coordination into a liability. Nascent Soul Realm: Lightning becomes heavenly interruption. The cultivator moves along storm paths, links armies through one circuit, interrupts weaker techniques at domain scale, challenges formations, and manifests as a sovereign lightning body. Secret Inheritance: The lightning cultivator commands the instant when potential becomes judgment. Everything charged in the field briefly belongs to one heavenly circuit. ## 2024 Fifth-Edition Rules Baseline This sphere assumes the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline used by Tianxia. Lightning and thunder damage use ordinary resistance and immunity rules unless a talent says otherwise. Attack rolls, saving throws, Cover, Total Cover, Concentration, conditions, object rules, visibility, suffocation, forced movement, falling, and environmental hazards follow ordinary rules unless this sphere explicitly changes them. Lightning does not automatically ignore Cover. A talent must say when a bolt arcs around Cover, follows a Conductive path, or originates from a Charged target. Lightning does not automatically make wet, armored, or metallic creatures vulnerable. Conductive status enables certain talents and riders; it is not vulnerability by default. Lightning does not automatically stun. Most Lightning interruption uses Reaction denial, Concentration pressure, Speed reduction, command disruption, disadvantage, or temporary suppression. True Stunned effects are rare, costly, high-Realm, or Secret. Lightning does not automatically disable formations, talismans, constructs, summons, wards, or magic items. Overload talents define exactly what can be suppressed, for how long, and what contest or saving throw applies. ## Core Lightning Rules ### Lightning Key Ability When you learn Lightning, use your Path key ability as your Lightning key ability unless a Path synergy, scripture, Insight, or talent assigns another ability. Cultivation Save DC = 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Lightning key ability modifier. Lightning Attack Modifier = Proficiency Bonus + Lightning key ability modifier. When a Lightning talent calls for a Lightning Check, roll: d20 + Proficiency Bonus + Lightning key ability modifier. ### Charge A Charge is a temporary unstable lightning mark placed on a creature, object, weapon, piece of armor, formation node, talisman, spirit thread, or 5-foot space. Unless a talent says otherwise: - A Charge lasts until the start of your next turn. - A creature, object, or space can have only one Charge from you at a time. - You can maintain a number of Charges at one time equal to your Proficiency Bonus. - If you would exceed your Charge limit, choose one of your existing Charges to end. - A Charge is visible as sparks, raised hair, ozone scent, flickering talisman ink, trembling metal, glowing meridian lines, or subtle spiritual pressure unless a talent conceals it. - A Charge has no effect by itself. It exists to be consumed, detected, arced from, stabilized, or overloaded by talents. ### Conductive A creature, object, space, or effect is Conductive if at least one of the following is true: - it is currently Charged; - it is wet or submerged; - it is made mostly of exposed metal; - it is wearing or carrying a large exposed metal object; - it is connected to a visible chain, wire, needle, weapon, armor plate, metallic formation rod, wet line, or lightning-marked thread; - it is part of an active formation, talisman, ward, qi construct, summoned asset, or comparable circuit-like technique; - a Lightning talent says it is Conductive. Conductive status does not create vulnerability, disadvantage, or automatic damage. It only satisfies prerequisites and permits talents to use special riders. A creature protected by insulation, Earth grounding, Void separation, a stronger ward, or a specific anti-lightning technique may stop counting as Conductive for a particular talent if the GM rules the protection meaningfully breaks the path. ### Arc Arc is lightning jumping from one target to another. Unless a talent says otherwise: - A Lightning technique can Arc only if the talent allows it. - An Arc target must be within 10 feet of the previous target at Mortal Realm, 15 feet at Foundation Realm, 20 feet at Core Formation Realm, and 30 feet at Nascent Soul Realm. - An Arc cannot pass through Total Cover unless a Conductive path bypasses that Cover and the talent permits it. - A creature can be damaged by the same Arc sequence only once. - Secondary Arc damage is reduced unless the talent says otherwise. ### Overload Overload is Lightning’s disruption of active qi structures, nervous systems, commands, wards, and circuits. Overload talents may affect: - Concentration; - Reactions; - prepared counters; - command techniques; - qi constructs; - formation nodes; - talismans; - summoned assets; - weapon or armor enchantments; - meridian recovery; - active technique states; - spirit projections or possession channels at higher Realm. Low-Realm Overload does not erase major effects. It reveals, stresses, delays, imposes disadvantage, or suppresses briefly. Core Formation or higher talents may disable weaker temporary effects or contest formation nodes. Nascent Soul and Secret talents may challenge major structures, but stronger authorities may require opposed checks or be immune. ### Thunder Thunder is the sound, pressure, and delayed consequence of Lightning. Thunder talents may push, deafen, frighten briefly, interrupt speech, break commands, shatter fragile objects, expose hidden spaces, or impose morale shock. Thunder is not full Sound-sphere mastery. It does not grant broad echo control, music cultivation, silence arts, speech shaping, or resonance techniques unless a talent or forged technique says so. ### Lightning and the Body Lightning often moves through nerves, muscles, blood, skin, breath, meridians, and pressure points. A Lightning talent that targets meridians or nerves usually requires one of the following: - melee attack; - unarmed strike; - pressure-point touch; - needle; - conductive weapon; - target is already Charged; - target is Conductive; - talent explicitly permits ranged meridian shock. Creatures without nerves, meridians, muscles, or comparable animating channels may be immune to nerve-specific riders, but they can still take lightning or thunder damage unless their traits say otherwise. ## Base Sphere Abilities When you first gain the Lightning sphere, gain proficiency in one of the following skills or tools: Acrobatics, Arcana, Athletics, Insight, Intimidation, Investigation, Medicine, Perception, smith’s tools, calligrapher’s supplies, or a musical instrument. If you already have proficiency in the chosen option, choose one Mortal Realm Lightning talent instead. You also learn First Circuit Method, Gather Charge, and Lightning Lash. ### First Circuit Method Action Type: Passive Canonical Action Type: Passive Factory Combat Bucket: passive Timing Detail: Passive / Charge Rider Factory Routing: passive_or_modifier_row Range: Self Cost: None When you first gain the Lightning sphere, your meridians learn to hold a brief seed of unstable potential. This is called a First Circuit. A First Circuit is not a full Charge and does not make you vulnerable to hostile Lightning talents unless a feature specifically says so. It is the internal spark that lets Lightning cultivation move through the body before it escapes into the world. Once on each of your turns, when you use Gather Charge on yourself, a held weapon, a worn item, or a Lightning focus you are touching, choose one Circuit expression. The chosen expression lasts until the Charge ends. **Body Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you deal lightning damage or consume a Charge, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature damaged by your Lightning sphere this turn. **Edge Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, the next time you hit with an unarmed strike, weapon attack, Lightning Lash, or Lightning talent delivered through a held implement, you deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. **Nerve Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you would have your Speed reduced, be knocked Prone, or be denied Reactions by a non-Secret effect, you may discharge the Circuit to gain Advantage on the saving throw against that effect. If no saving throw is allowed, reduce the penalty by one step: ignore a Speed reduction of 10 feet or less, stand from Prone by spending 5 fewer feet of movement, or regain your Reaction at the start of your next turn. **Conduction Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you apply Charge to a creature, object, formation node, talisman, weapon, armor, or 5-foot space, you may make yourself Conductive until the start of your next turn. While Conductive this way, your next Lightning talent that requires a Conductive Path may treat yourself, your held weapon, or your worn armor as the starting point of that path. You may discharge only one First Circuit per round. ### Gather Charge Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: Yourself, one object you can see, one weapon you are holding, one willing creature you can see, one formation node you can see, or one unoccupied 5-foot space you can see Cost: None Duration: Until the start of your next turn You gather unstable Lightning Qi and place a Charge on the target. If you Charge a weapon you are holding, the next time you hit with that weapon before the Charge ends, you may consume the Charge to deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you Charge yourself, you gain Advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw you make before the Charge ends against lightning, thunder, paralysis, forced movement, or being knocked Prone. If you Charge a 5-foot space, the space becomes Conductive. The first time a creature enters that space before the Charge ends, you may end the Charge to deal lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to that creature. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. At Foundation Realm, the range becomes 60 feet. At Core Formation, you may create two Charges with one use of Gather Charge, provided they are within range and do not exceed your Charge limit. ### Lightning Lash Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature or unattended object you can see Cost: None Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: The target takes lightning damage equal to 1d8 + your Lightning key ability modifier. The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17. When Lightning Lash hits, choose one basic rider: Charge: The target gains a Charge until the start of your next turn. Jolt: The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn. Flash: Sparks reveal the target’s outline. Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot benefit from being unseen against you unless it has Total Cover or a stronger concealment effect. Arc: If another creature or object within 5 feet of the target is Conductive or Charged, it takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This Arc cannot trigger additional Arcs unless a talent says otherwise. Lightning Lash is a Cultivation Attack, not a weapon attack, unless a talent says otherwise. ## Lightning Talent Tags Charge talents create, extend, move, hide, consume, or modify Charges. Arc talents jump lightning between targets. Shock talents deal direct lightning damage, interfere with nerves, or deny reactions. Thunder talents create pressure, sound, morale shock, push effects, Deafen, or command disruption. Imbuement talents channel Lightning through weapons, arrows, needles, chains, armor, instruments, fists, or tools. Movement talents convert Lightning Qi into speed, reflex, flash-step motion, or escape. Overload talents interfere with Concentration, wards, talismans, formations, constructs, summons, and active technique states. Lightning Body talents refine Lightning through the cultivator’s nerves, blood, muscles, meridians, and personal aura. Circuit talents create battlefield logic based on charged paths, conductive links, and prepared nodes. Realm Evolutions change how the entire sphere functions at a new Realm. ## Mortal Realm Talents ### Conductive Strike - Imbuement, Shock When you make a melee weapon attack, unarmed strike, or thrown weapon attack, you may use Lightning as part of the attack if the weapon, limb, or projectile is Charged, metallic, wet, or otherwise Conductive.
