Once per turn when you consume a Charge to empower a Lightning talent, choose one: - gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; - move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; - add +1 to the next Lightning Check you make before the end of your next turn; - impose Disadvantage on the next Opportunity Attack made against you before the start of your next turn. If you are in Lightning-God Body or True Lightning-God Mantle, choose two benefits instead of one. ### Spirit-Circuit Shock - Spirit, Overload Prerequisite: CL 10+, Spirit Awakening Path or GM permission Your Lightning can jolt spirit channels, possession threads, dream projections, and soul-static. When you hit a spirit, ghost, possessed creature, spiritual projection, dream-body, or summoned spirit asset with Lightning Lash, you may spend 1 CP to force a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The target cannot benefit from being Invisible, spiritually hidden, or possession-masked against you until the end of your next turn. If it is possessing another body, the host may immediately repeat one save or contest allowed by the possession effect. Successful Save: The target becomes Charged until the start of your next turn. This talent does not exorcise by itself unless a separate feature says so. ### Thunderhead Lattice - Circuit, Utility Prerequisite: CL 10+, Spark Lattice Preservation You can stabilize charged lattices at larger scale. During 10 minutes of work, you may create a charged lattice around a chest, ritual circle, corpse, small altar, medicine cabinet, crystal vessel, or formation component no larger than a 10-foot cube. For 24 hours, the lattice preserves the contents against mundane spoilage, dampness, minor spiritual leakage, ordinary insects, and casual handling. The lattice also counts as a visible ward for Ozone Reading and for Lightning talents that require a visible Conductive ward or circuit. If a creature opens, disturbs, or breaks the lattice without your permission, it takes lightning damage equal to your Cultivation Level and the lattice ends. A creature can disarm the lattice with a successful Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Intelligence (Arcana), or Lightning Check against your Cultivation Save DC. ### Thousand-Spark Volley - Imbuement, Arc Prerequisite: CL 10+, Thunder Arrow Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Weapon range or 120 feet, whichever is lower Cost: 2 CP Make one ranged weapon attack or ranged Cultivation Attack against a target in range. Hit: The target takes the attack’s normal damage plus 3d8 lightning damage and becomes Charged. Then choose a number of secondary targets up to your Proficiency Bonus within 20 feet of the first target. Each secondary target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: A secondary target takes 2d8 lightning damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: A secondary target takes half damage and suffers no reaction denial. Miss: Choose one secondary target within 20 feet of the original target. It takes lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Sky-Fire Nerve Net - Shock, Circuit Prerequisite: CL 10+, Meridian-Stopping Spark When a creature fails a saving throw against Meridian-Stopping Spark, you may choose one additional Charged creature within 20 feet of it. The additional creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn and has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain Concentration before the end of its next turn. Successful Save: It loses its Charge. This talent can affect only one additional creature each turn. ## Nascent Soul Realm Talents ### Lightning Sovereign Incarnation - Realm Evolution, Lightning Body Prerequisite: CL 15+, Court of Charged Paths Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Duration: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest You become a sovereign center of lightning, nerves, thunder, and charged consequence. For the duration: - You gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can Hover. - You have Resistance to lightning and thunder damage. - Your Lightning Lash range becomes 300 feet. - Your Charge limit doubles. - Once on each of your turns, you may use Lightning Lash or Gather Charge without an action. - The first time each round you deal lightning damage to a creature, that creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. - You may use Static Guard without spending your Reaction once per round. - You may treat visible non-Secret formation nodes, talisman circuits, qi constructs, and summoned asset anchors within 120 feet as Conductive. The incarnation ends early if you are Incapacitated. This incarnation does not create regional weather. If used inside a Weather storm created by another effect, the GM may describe the signs as stormlike, but the mechanics remain Lightning unless a talent says otherwise. ### One Circuit Under Heaven - Circuit, Arc Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300 feet Cost: 3 CP Choose any number of Charged creatures, objects, spaces, formation nodes, or qi constructs you can see within range, up to twice your Proficiency Bonus. Each hostile creature chosen this way makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 6d8 lightning damage, cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, and loses one Charge. Successful Save: The creature takes half damage, can take Reactions normally, and loses one Charge. Chosen objects, constructs, and nodes take lightning damage equal to your Cultivation Level x 2 unless immune. After resolving the damage, you may move one remaining Charge from any chosen target to any other visible target within range. ### Thunder That Answers First - Thunder, Reaction Prerequisite: CL 15+, Thunder Breaks Command Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A hostile creature you can see within 300 feet begins a technique, command, domain activation, formation order, Secret preparation, or battlefield-wide instruction Cost: 3 CP The triggering creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Thunder arrives before the command completes. The triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn, has Disadvantage on the triggering technique’s attack roll or save DC contest if any, and allied creatures relying on that command do not gain Advantage from it. Successful Save: The triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. If the triggering effect is Secret, artifact-backed, or higher Realm, this talent does not cancel it by itself. It imposes the listed penalties unless the opposing authority defeats your Lightning Check. ### Formation-Extinguishing Edict - Overload Prerequisite: CL 15+, Formation-Splitting Bolt Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300 feet Target: One visible formation node, domain anchor, ward engine, talisman array, qi construct, or summoned asset anchor Cost: 3 CP Make a Lightning Check against the effect’s DC, the creator’s Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC. Success: Suppress the target until the end of your next turn if it is non-Secret and your Realm or lower. If it is stronger, reduce one major numerical benefit by your Cultivation Level and impose Disadvantage on the next check made to maintain, command, or repair it before the end of your next turn. Success by 5 or More: Arcs lash through the connected structure. Choose up to three connected creatures, nodes, or constructs within 60 feet. Each takes lightning damage equal to 4d8 + your Lightning key ability modifier. Failure: The structure resists. You still learn one hidden rule of the structure’s conductivity, grounding, or node hierarchy. This talent cannot casually erase ancient city arrays, immortal formations, sect grand protections, or world-scale wards. ### Lightning Wings of the Heavenly Body - Movement, Lightning Body Prerequisite: CL 15+, Lightning Wings Burst While Lightning-God Body, True Lightning-God Mantle, or Lightning Sovereign Incarnation is active, you gain a Fly Speed equal to your walking Speed and can Hover. Once per turn when you move at least 30 feet before hitting a target with a Lightning attack or Conductive Strike, add 2d8 lightning damage to the hit. If you end your turn in the air without Lightning-God Body, True Lightning-God Mantle, Lightning Sovereign Incarnation, Weather support, flight equipment, or another feature keeping you aloft, you fall normally. ### World-Nerve Judgment - Shock, Overload Prerequisite: CL 15+, Sky-Fire Nerve Net Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Target: One creature you can see that is Charged, Conductive, concentrating, possessing another creature, or maintaining an active technique-state Cost: 3 CP The target makes a Constitution saving throw. A spirit, ghost, possession entity, or dream-body may instead make a Wisdom saving throw if that is more appropriate. Failed Save: The target takes 8d8 lightning damage, cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn, and immediately makes one Concentration save or maintenance check for each active effect it is sustaining, with Disadvantage. Successful Save: The target takes half damage, cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, and makes one Concentration save or maintenance check of your choice without Disadvantage. This talent does not automatically end effects that do not require maintenance, Concentration, command, or active qi flow. ### Return Stroke Through the Void - Movement, Arc Prerequisite: CL 15+, Ride the Return Stroke When a creature you can see within 300 feet takes lightning damage or loses a Charge from one of your Lightning talents, you may spend 2 CP to move to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of that creature. This movement follows a visible or spiritual lightning path and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. It can pass through openings, around corners, along Conductive paths, or through active lightning arcs. It cannot pass through sealed anti-space barriers, superior Void separation, or a closed space with no symbolic or conductive path unless you win an opposed Lightning Check against the obstacle. After you arrive, you may make one Lightning Lash against the triggering creature without using an action. You cannot use Return Stroke Through the Void again until the start of your next turn. ## Secret Lightning Inheritance ### When Potential Becomes Judgment Secret Lightning Inheritance Prerequisites: CL 17+, Lightning Sovereign Incarnation, Formation-Splitting Bolt, True Lightning-God Mantle, and access to a true lightning scripture, tribulation scar, heavenly thunder inheritance, or equivalent revelation Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on you Duration: Instantaneous, with aftermath until the end of your next turn Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per week You command the instant when potential becomes judgment. Choose up to three decrees: The Circuit Was Always One. Choose any number of Charged creatures, objects, formation nodes, talismans, qi constructs, or spaces you can perceive in the area, up to three times your Proficiency Bonus. Each hostile creature chosen this way makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 8d8 lightning damage and cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. The Ward Forgets Its Shape. Choose one non-Secret ward, barrier, talisman array, qi construct, or formation segment in the area. Make a Lightning Check against the effect’s DC. On a success, suppress it until the end of your next turn. On a failure, reduce one of its major numerical effects by your Cultivation Level until the end of your next turn. The Body Becomes Thunder. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a Fly Speed of 120 feet, Hover, Resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and Advantage on Dexterity saving throws. The first time you hit each turn with a Lightning attack, it deals additional lightning damage equal to 4d8. The Command Arrives Too Late. Hostile creatures of your choice in the area that are issuing commands, maintaining Concentration, controlling formations, directing summons, or sustaining technique-states make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they cannot take Reactions, issue audible commands, or grant allies Advantage until the end of their next turn. On a success, they cannot take Reactions until the start of their next turn. The Sky Writes the Shortest Path. You may move up to 1 mile to a location you can see, a Charged target you can perceive, or a Conductive path you have marked within the last minute. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. It cannot enter sealed spaces protected by superior authority without an opposed check. The Thunder Speaks After. After all other decrees resolve, creatures of your choice within 120 feet of any target damaged by this inheritance make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is Deafened and Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is Deafened until the start of its next turn. Limits: When Potential Becomes Judgment does not permanently change weather, erase mountains, shut down ancient city arrays by default, kill breathless creatures automatically, bypass immunity, or defeat stronger domain-scale authority without an opposed Cultivation Check. ## Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures Lightning drawbacks are optional sphere-specific limitations. A drawback grants the listed bonus talent or benefit but changes how your Lightning cultivation works. Unless a drawback says otherwise, choose at most one Lightning drawback when first learning the sphere or during a major Lightning initiation. Removing the drawback removes the bonus talent or benefit. ### Inner Lightning-God Scripture Your Lightning cultivation is primarily internal. You cannot use Lightning Lash beyond 30 feet, Chain Bolt, Conductive Field, Court of Charged Paths, or other detached external Lightning effects unless a forged technique, item, Insight, or GM permission allows it. You may use Constitution as your Lightning key ability. You gain Lightning-God Body as a bonus talent at CL 5. Before CL 5, you gain Electric Fist Method as a bonus talent instead. ### Grounded Conductor Method Your Lightning requires contact with a conductor: your body, a weapon, armor, metal, water, stone marked with iron, a formation rod, a talisman strip, or a visible Conductive path. If no conductor is present, Lightning Lash has half range and cannot Arc. You gain Grounding Breath as a bonus talent. ### Thunder Without Storm Doctrine Your lineage rejects broad storm cultivation and focuses on instantaneous shock. You cannot learn Lightning talents with the Circuit tag unless they also have the Shock or Thunder tag, and you cannot use Weather synergy benefits from Lightning Insights. You gain Thunderclap Palm as a bonus talent. ### Oath of the Safe Hand Your Lightning is trained to disable before killing. When one of your Lightning talents would reduce a creature to 0 HP, you may leave it stable at 1 HP and Incapacitated until the start of its next turn. However, your Lightning damage rolls against creatures you have not attempted to disable in the current encounter are reduced by 1 per die, minimum 1 damage per die. You gain Electric Fist Method as a bonus talent. ### Storm-Dependent Scripture Your Lightning is strongest when the sky already carries charge. When natural storm weather, a Weather talent, a storm formation, or another scene feature creates rain, thunderclouds, strong wind, or storm pressure, your Lightning Lash range increases by 30 feet and your Arc range increases by 5 feet. In sealed underground areas, dry tombs, airless chambers, or places deliberately insulated against lightning, your Lightning Checks and Lightning attack rolls have Disadvantage unless you first create or identify a Conductive path. You gain Ozone Reading as a bonus talent. ## Path Synergies ### Body Refining - Nerve Thunder Body Body Refining Lightning begins inside the body. You may use Constitution as your Lightning key ability for Lightning save DCs, Lightning attack rolls, and Lightning Checks. When you use Lightning through Body Refining: - your Lightning techniques must originate from your breath, nerves, muscles, skin, blood, heartbeat, meridians, unarmed strikes, weapons, armor, held tools, or a surface you physically touch; - detached ranged Lightning Lash range is reduced by 20 feet unless the target is Conductive, Charged, or connected by a weapon, chain, wire, needle, or other physical conductor; - you cannot create long-duration external Lightning fields at range unless a talent, Insight, item, forged technique, or GM permission allows it; - when you take the Attack action or Dash action, you may use Gather Charge as part of the same action once per turn. While you are Charged, you have Advantage on saving throws against paralysis, being knocked Prone by thunder, and effects that reduce Speed. ### Qi Cultivation - Outer Thunder Circulation Qi Cultivation is the most natural path for external Lightning manipulation. You may use Intelligence or Charisma as your Lightning key ability. When you spend CP on a Lightning talent, choose one: - increase one Lightning range by 30 feet; - increase one Arc range by 5 feet; - place one additional Charge on a valid target within 30 feet of the original target; - treat one wet, metallic, or formation-linked object in range as Conductive until the end of your turn; - add your Proficiency Bonus to one Lightning Check made to Overload a non-Secret temporary effect. You may choose only one benefit per Lightning talent unless another feature says otherwise. ### Spirit Awakening - Thunder-Omen Shock Spirit Awakening Lightning begins as omen, terror, sudden perception, and soul-startle. You may use Wisdom as your Lightning key ability. You may apply Shock, Thunder, and Overload talents to spirits, ghosts, possessed bodies, spiritual projections, dream-bodies, and soul constructs if they have visible or perceivable spirit-static, soul-thread, possession pressure, ghost-lightning, dream charge, or a comparable animating circuit. Once per round when a creature within 60 feet becomes Charged, fails a save against one of your Thunder talents, or loses a Charge, you may learn one: - whether it is concentrating; - whether it is possessed or spiritually projected; - whether it is protected against lightning, thunder, fear, or possession disruption; - whether an active effect on it is maintained by a visible circuit, oath, command, formation, or spirit thread; - whether it is more vulnerable to Shock, Thunder, or Overload methods. This does not reveal complete thoughts, exact Path, full Realm, or secret techniques. ## Cultivation Insights ### Electric Fist Adept Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Electric Fist Method, CL 4+ When you use Electric Fist Method, you may deal lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to the target on a failed save. Once per short or long rest, when a creature fails its save against Electric Fist Method, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. ### Lightning-God Disciple Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Lightning-God Body, CL 6+ When you activate Lightning-God Body, choose Speed, Reflex, or Shock. Speed: Your Speed increases by an additional 5 feet. Reflex: Once during the duration, when you fail a Dexterity saving throw, you may reroll it. Shock: The first time each turn you deal Lightning-God Body bonus damage, increase that bonus by 1d8. ### Thunder Archer Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Crackling Arrow or Thunder Arrow, CL 6+ When you hit a Charged target with a ranged weapon attack, you may move the Charge to another creature within 10 feet of the target instead of consuming it. Once per short or long rest, when your Thunder Arrow misses, you may still trigger its thunder report centered on the target’s space. ### Formation Breaker Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Overload Ward, CL 8+ You have Advantage on Study checks to identify Conductive formation nodes, talisman circuits, ward anchors, qi construct cores, and prepared counter arrays. Once per short or long rest, when you fail a Lightning Check made to Overload a non-Secret effect, you may reroll the check. You must use the new result. ### Storm Instrumentalist Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Spark-Instrument Method, Music or Sound sphere, CL 6+ When you use Spark-Instrument Method, you may choose one ally who can hear the sound within 30 feet. That ally gains Advantage on the next saving throw it makes against being Frightened, Deafened, or unable to take Reactions before the start of your next turn. This Insight requires Music or Sound to use the ally benefit. Without those spheres, Spark-Instrument Method remains a personal focus only. ### Grounded Rod Body Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Body Refining Path or Grounded Conductor Method, CL 6+ When you are standing on earth, stone, metal, wet ground, or another meaningful conductor, you have Resistance to lightning damage from non-Secret effects. Once per short or long rest, when you would take lightning damage, you may reduce that damage by your Cultivation Level and place a Charge on a visible object or space within 10 feet. ### Flash-Step Duelist Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Flash Step, CL 8+ After you use Flash Step, your next melee attack before the end of your turn has Advantage if the target is Charged or Conductive. If that attack hits, you may choose not to deal bonus lightning damage and instead prevent the target from taking Opportunity Attacks until the start of its next turn. ### Conductive Preservation Artist Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Spark Lattice Preservation, CL 8+ Your preservation lattices can safely hold unstable lightning-aspected, storm-aspected, talismanic, or formation materials. When you use Spark Lattice Preservation, you may also preserve one volatile alchemical reagent, charged crystal, storm herb, lightning beast scale, or damaged talisman component. The item remains stable for 7 days. Once per long rest, you may open such a lattice as a Bonus Action and gain one temporary Charge on yourself or a held object. ### Storm Partner Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Weather sphere or an allied Weather cultivator, CL 8+ When you are inside natural storm weather, a Weather-created Gather Weather field, or a scene with active thundercloud pressure, you may treat one target damaged by your Lightning talent each turn as Conductive until the start of your next turn. This Insight does not grant Weather talents, Sky Mantles, Cloud Shrouds, Weather severity, or storm creation. ### Meridian Lightning Physician Prerequisite: Lightning sphere, Medicine proficiency, Life sphere or Pressure Points sphere, CL 8+ You can use carefully measured Lightning Qi to restart, test, or interrupt bodily channels. During a short rest, you may treat one willing creature. The creature may immediately repeat one saving throw against paralysis, Speed reduction, or a meridian-blocking effect that allows repeated saves. Once per long rest, when a willing creature within 5 feet fails a death saving throw, you may use your Reaction to apply a harmless shock. The creature rerolls the death saving throw and must use the new result. This Insight does not restore HP unless another feature says so.

### First Circuit Method
Action Type: Passive
Canonical Action Type: Passive
Factory Combat Bucket: passive
Timing Detail: Passive / Charge Rider
Factory Routing: passive_or_modifier_row
Range: Self
Cost: None
When you first gain the Lightning sphere, your meridians learn to hold a brief seed of unstable potential. This is called a First Circuit.
A First Circuit is not a full Charge and does not make you vulnerable to hostile Lightning talents unless a feature specifically says so. It is the internal spark that lets Lightning cultivation move through the body before it escapes into the world.
Once on each of your turns, when you use Gather Charge on yourself, a held weapon, a worn item, or a Lightning focus you are touching, choose one Circuit expression. The chosen expression lasts until the Charge ends.
**Body Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you deal lightning damage or consume a Charge, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature damaged by your Lightning sphere this turn.
**Edge Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, the next time you hit with an unarmed strike, weapon attack, Lightning Lash, or Lightning talent delivered through a held implement, you deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
**Nerve Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you would have your Speed reduced, be knocked Prone, or be denied Reactions by a non-Secret effect, you may discharge the Circuit to gain Advantage on the saving throw against that effect. If no saving throw is allowed, reduce the penalty by one step: ignore a Speed reduction of 10 feet or less, stand from Prone by spending 5 fewer feet of movement, or regain your Reaction at the start of your next turn.
**Conduction Circuit.** Before the Charge ends, when you apply Charge to a creature, object, formation node, talisman, weapon, armor, or 5-foot space, you may make yourself Conductive until the start of your next turn. While Conductive this way, your next Lightning talent that requires a Conductive Path may treat yourself, your held weapon, or your worn armor as the starting point of that path.
You may discharge only one First Circuit per round.

### Gather Charge
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Target: Yourself, one object you can see, one weapon you are holding, one willing creature you can see, one formation node you can see, or one unoccupied 5-foot space you can see
Cost: None
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
You gather unstable Lightning Qi and place a Charge on the target.
If you Charge a weapon you are holding, the next time you hit with that weapon before the Charge ends, you may consume the Charge to deal additional lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
If you Charge yourself, you gain Advantage on the next Dexterity saving throw you make before the Charge ends against lightning, thunder, paralysis, forced movement, or being knocked Prone.
If you Charge a 5-foot space, the space becomes Conductive. The first time a creature enters that space before the Charge ends, you may end the Charge to deal lightning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to that creature. A creature can take this damage only once per turn.
At Foundation Realm, the range becomes 60 feet. At Core Formation, you may create two Charges with one use of Gather Charge, provided they are within range and do not exceed your Charge limit.

Classification: Magma Utility
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Choose one patch of Molten Terrain or Obsidian Terrain you created within range.
Choose one:
• cool one 5-foot patch of your Molten Terrain into Obsidian Terrain for 1 minute;
• crack one 5-foot patch of your Obsidian Terrain, ending it and dealing Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus to one creature standing in it, Dexterity save negates;
• move one 5-foot patch of your Molten Terrain up to 5 feet across a continuous surface;
• shape one patch into a low ridge that grants Half Cover until the start of your next turn;
• open a safe stepping line through one patch for one ally until the start of your next turn.
Shape the Crust cannot move terrain through walls, across open air, or into a creature’s space unless a talent says otherwise.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Magma Qi Expression: Primary — Magma Qi; Supporting — Fire Qi, Earth Qi, Pressure Qi, Forge Qi. “Stone remembers patience. Fire remembers hunger. Magma remembers both.” Sphere Type: Restricted Power Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Body Refining through Volcanic Body scripture Rare Path: Spirit Awakening through Furnace-Soul Awakening Default Resource: CP Common Effects: molten terrain, lava flows, volcanic pressure, heavy elemental damage, siege destruction, obsidian hazards, volcanic smoke, magma armor, pressure prisons, eruptions, forge-scale infrastructure, and battlefield denial. ### Magma Dao Magma is the cultivation of molten pressure. Fire devours. Earth endures. Magma advances. A Fire cultivator burns the enemy where they stand. An Earth cultivator controls where the enemy may stand. A Magma cultivator makes standing itself dangerous. Magma does not reward speed for its own sake. It rewards commitment, territorial pressure, siege patience, and the willingness to turn a battlefield into a furnace that punishes every step. A novice throws molten stone. An adept makes the ground remember the volcano. A master turns walls, gates, armor, and formations into things that can melt. A sovereign does not cast lava. They open a wound in the world. ### What Magma Cultivates Magma governs: • molten stone; • lava and slag; • volcanic heat; • pressure under earth; • persistent hazard zones; • siege damage; • obsidian and black glass; • ash-choked volcanic smoke; • eruptions; • forge-like destruction; • battlefield denial; • dangerous territorial control. Magma does not usually create gentle campfire heat, portable ordinary flame, clean stone walls, precise metal forging, soft smoke illusion, or long-term civic infrastructure by itself. ### Sphere Boundaries Magma and Fire Fire governs ignition, flame, burning, smoke, quick heat, and explosive combustion. Magma governs molten stone, heat under pressure, battlefield hazards, lava flows, siege damage, volcanic armor, and terrain transformation. Fire is faster. Magma is heavier. Magma and Earth Earth governs stone, soil, walls, fortification, burrowing, terrain shaping, and structural endurance. Magma governs stone made fluid, earth made dangerous, structures under heat stress, and terrain that punishes occupation. Earth holds. Magma advances. Magma and Ash Ash governs remains, smothering residue, burned history, choking aftermath, ruin, and attrition. Magma may create ash and volcanic smoke, but Ash owns the settled aftermath. Magma and Metal Metal governs ore, armor, blades, refining, conductivity, and forged structure. Magma may melt metal, power a forge, or ruin armor, but Metal governs the shaped result. Magma and Alchemy Alchemy refines substances into pills, elixirs, medicines, and field formulae. Magma may supply furnace heat, volcanic essence, disposal pits, or dangerous reagents, but it does not replace pill forging. Magma and Formations Magma can create temporary volcanic courts, eruption lines, and dangerous terrain. Formations turn those principles into maintained volcano arrays, siege furnaces, sect gates, fortress channels, and city-scale lava control. ### Restricted Access Magma is not normally learned casually. A cultivator usually needs at least one of the following: • instruction from a volcanic sect, furnace clan, or forbidden fire-earth lineage; • survival of a volcanic tribulation; • a magma scripture recovered from a forge tomb, lava lake, disaster zone, or underground palace; • a Body Refining transformation that can survive furnace heat; • a Qi Cultivation furnace method combining Earth and Fire principles; • a Spirit Awakening furnace-soul initiation; • a rare treasure such as a volcanic heartstone, living obsidian seed, or sealed lava core. The GM may require story access before Magma can be selected. ### Magma Key Ability Use your Path’s normal key ability unless a feature says otherwise. Qi Cultivation commonly uses Intelligence or Charisma. Body Refining variants use Constitution. Spirit Awakening variants use Wisdom. Your Magma Save DC equals: 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Magma key ability modifier. Your Magma Cultivation Attack Modifier equals: Proficiency Bonus + your Magma key ability modifier. ### Core Magma Rules #### Molten Terrain Some Magma talents create Molten Terrain. Unless a talent says otherwise: • Molten Terrain is difficult terrain. • A creature entering Molten Terrain for the first time on a turn or starting its turn inside makes a Dexterity saving throw. • On a failed save, the creature takes the damage listed by the talent. • On a successful save, the creature takes half damage unless the talent says otherwise. • A creature takes damage from the same patch or area of Molten Terrain only once per turn. • Being moved through Molten Terrain can trigger the terrain if the movement causes the creature to enter it. • Allies you designate may ignore damage from your Molten Terrain only when the talent says so. • Even protected allies usually still treat Molten Terrain as difficult terrain unless a talent says otherwise. Molten Terrain represents hot stone, molten ground, burning slag, furnace cracks, lava channels, or volcanic pressure rising through the surface. #### Obsidian Terrain Some Magma talents cool into Obsidian Terrain. Obsidian Terrain is: • difficult terrain for hostile creatures; • sharp and unstable; • capable of creating jagged Half Cover when a talent says so; • vulnerable to Thunder, Force, and heavy Bludgeoning effects at the GM’s discretion. When a hostile creature moves more than 10 feet through your Obsidian Terrain during one turn, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: It takes Slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus and its Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the end of the turn. Successful Save: It avoids the damage. A creature makes this save only once per turn from the same Obsidian Terrain. #### Burning Some Magma talents cause Burning. Unless a campaign uses a different Fire rule, Burning from Magma means: • the creature takes the listed Fire damage at the start of each of its turns; • the creature or an adjacent creature may use an Action to extinguish the effect; • suitable water, Cold, Earth, or smothering effects may end the Burning if the GM agrees; • Burning ends automatically when the listed duration ends. Magma Burning is often mixed with clinging slag and may be harder to ignore than ordinary flame. #### Heat Pressure Some Magma talents apply Heat Pressure. A creature under Heat Pressure is not necessarily on fire. The air around it distorts, armor heats, footing softens, and breath becomes difficult. Unless a talent says otherwise, Heat Pressure lasts until the start of your next turn and may impose one of the following effects: • Speed reduced by 10 feet; • cannot take Reactions; • Disadvantage on the next Strength or Dexterity check before the start of your next turn; • must choose between moving willingly or taking an Action on its next turn, not both. A creature may suffer only one Heat Pressure effect from you at a time unless a higher-Realm talent says otherwise. #### Water and Cold Interaction Ordinary water may cool a small exposed patch of Molten Terrain into steam and brittle stone, at the GM’s discretion. Strong Water or Cold talents may suppress, cool, or remove Molten Terrain. When Molten Terrain is rapidly cooled, it may become Obsidian Terrain. Cooling magma should create tactical consequences such as steam, brittle glass, difficult terrain, jagged ridges, cracked armor, or blocked footing. Do not automatically multiply damage merely because hot and cold effects overlap unless a Forged Technique or specific rule says so. #### Structures, Objects, and Siege Damage Magma is one of the strongest spheres for damaging structures. Unless a talent says otherwise, Magma talents may damage: • unattended objects; • ordinary walls; • doors; • vehicles; • siege engines; • temporary Barriers; • exposed Formation Anchors. However, Magma does not automatically destroy: • artifacts; • Domain anchors; • Secret Inheritance structures; • Realm-defining geography; • protected sect gates; • major city walls; • world-scale terrain. Those require project rules, contested Cultivation Checks, dedicated siege scenes, or specific GM permission. #### Collateral Risk Magma is not subtle. Magma talents may ignite flammable objects, ruin floors, weaken structures, create smoke, injure bystanders, make roads impassable, or leave visible volcanic scars. A Magma cultivator who uses the sphere inside a city, library, ship, forest, mine, bridge, market, or sect hall should expect consequences. ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Magma Initiation When you learn Magma, choose the form your magma takes most often: • red-gold lava; • black slag; • white-hot furnace stone; • volcanic glass; • subterranean pressure cracks; • ash-veiled lava; • spiritual molten ore; • another appropriate expression. Changes: • use Constitution as your Magma key ability; • spend Stamina instead of CP for Magma talents you are permitted to learn; • you may learn Armor, Terrain, and Eruption talents that originate from your body or spaces you touch; • projected ranged Magma talents beyond 30 feet require a specific Insight, inheritance, item, or Forged Technique; • you gain Resistance to Fire damage while using Obsidian Skin or Magma Armor; • when Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, you may create one 5-foot patch of Obsidian Terrain adjacent to you. Restriction: Your Magma is bodily and contact-centered. Without a feature, you cannot casually flood distant terrain with Stamina alone. #### Refined Magma Meridian Scripture Qi Cultivation access. You refine Earth and Fire Qi into a slow-moving furnace meridian. Benefits: • once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Magma talent by 1, minimum 1; • when damaging a creature standing in your Molten Terrain, add your key ability modifier to one damage roll once per turn; • your Magma talents are harder to disperse with ordinary water or wind; • you have Advantage on checks to stabilize volcanic hazards, forges, furnace arrays, and controlled lava channels. #### Furnace-Soul Awakening Spirit Awakening access. Your soul manifests as a volcano, furnace, lava sea, or pressure chamber. Benefits: • use Wisdom as your Magma key ability; • spend Resonance for Magma talents when appropriate; • your Magma talents can affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and soul-bound creatures through spiritual volcanic pressure; • when damaging a spirit or possessing entity, you may deal Radiant or Psychic damage instead of Fire if appropriate; • once per short rest when a spirit fails a saving throw against one of your Magma talents, it also suffers Heat Pressure. Restriction: Furnace-Soul Magma is obvious to spiritual senses. Spirit courts, ghost sects, and karmic entities may recognize the pressure of your soul-furnace. #### Obsidian Glass Scripture You emphasize cooling, cutting, mirrors, black glass, and battlefield shaping over flowing lava. Benefits: • gain Cinderglass Shards as a bonus talent; • when one of your Magma talents would create Molten Terrain, you may create Obsidian Terrain instead; • creatures damaged by your Obsidian Terrain cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible until the start of their next turn if blood, dust, ash, or heat residue marks them; • Blackglass Rampart costs 1 fewer CP, minimum 1; • your Obsidian Terrain grants you Advantage on checks to track creatures that crossed it within the last hour. Restriction: Your Fire damage from Magma talents is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus, minimum 1, unless the target is standing in Molten Terrain. #### Siege-Magma Scripture You cultivate Magma as a fortress-breaking and project-scale art. Benefits: • gain Siege-Magma Adept as a bonus Insight if you meet its prerequisites; • when damaging an object, structure, vehicle, Barrier, or Formation Anchor with a Magma talent, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll; • Volcanic Forge requires 20 percent fewer materials; • Mantle Breach costs 1 fewer CP, minimum 1. Restriction: Your Magma is less agile. Furnace Step costs 1 additional CP, and you cannot use it without touching earth, stone, metal, or a structure. ### Path Synergies #### Qi Cultivation - Refined Magma Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Magma key ability. Once per turn: • reduce the CP cost of one Magma talent by 1, minimum 1; or • increase one Magma talent’s range by 30 feet if it creates terrain or targets a structure. When damaging a creature standing in your Molten Terrain, add your key ability modifier to one damage roll once per turn. #### Body Refining - Volcanic Body Use Constitution as your Magma key ability. While Obsidian Skin, Furnace Mantle, or Magma Armor is active: • gain +1 additional AC; • add Constitution modifier to checks made to resist Grapple, Shove, Prone, and forced movement; • deal Fire damage equal to Proficiency Bonus to a creature Grappling you, once per turn; • spend Stamina instead of CP for Magma talents that your Body Refining access permits. Projected ranged Magma talents still require a specific feature, Insight, inheritance, or Forged Technique. #### Spirit Awakening - Furnace-Soul Use Wisdom as your Magma key ability. Your Magma talents may affect: • spirits; • ghosts; • incorporeal creatures; • possessing entities; • soul-bound creatures; • spiritual parasites. Once per round when a spirit, ghost, or possessing entity takes damage from your Magma talent, choose one: • it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; • it cannot willingly enter a creature’s body until the start of its next turn; • it becomes visible as a heat shimmer until the start of its next turn; • it suffers Heat Pressure. ### Cultivation Insights #### Furnace-Soul Awakening Prerequisite: Spirit Awakening, CL 4+ You may learn Magma despite its ordinary path restrictions. Gain: • use Wisdom as your Magma key ability; • spend Resonance for Magma talents when appropriate; • gain the Furnace-Soul path synergy; • your Magma effects appear as spiritual furnace pressure rather than ordinary lava unless you choose otherwise. #### Lava-Walking Immortal Prerequisite: Magma, CL 8+ Gain: • immunity to damage from your own Molten Terrain; • Resistance to Fire damage; • ability to cross ordinary lava without sinking or taking ordinary lava damage for up to 1 minute at a time; • immunity to ordinary extreme heat; • ability to leave temporary obsidian footholds behind you while crossing lava, lasting until the start of your next turn. This does not protect against legendary volcanoes, immortal lava seas, divine fire, or Secret Inheritance magma unless the GM agrees. #### Siege-Magma Adept Prerequisite: Magma, CL 8+ Once per turn when damaging an object, structure, vehicle, Barrier, or Formation Anchor through a Magma talent, choose one: • add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll; • deal double damage to an unattended ordinary object or mundane structure; • ignore ordinary hardness; • reveal a visible crack, weak point, pressure seam, or load-bearing failure. This does not automatically destroy artifacts, permanent Formations, Domains, or Realm-defining structures. #### Obsidian Sculptor Prerequisite: Magma, CL 8+ When one of your Magma talents ends, choose one affected 10-foot area. Transform it into one: • obsidian barrier; • jagged difficult terrain; • short staircase; • defensive ridge; • Half Cover position; • simple obsidian platform; • sealed volcanic cap over a pit, vent, or fissure. The structure lasts 1 hour unless destroyed. #### Furnace-Heart Discipline Prerequisite: Magma, CL 4+ You have learned not to be consumed by your own heat. Gain: • Advantage on saving throws against Burning; • Advantage on checks to maintain Concentration caused by Fire, Cold, smoke, or environmental heat; • once per short rest when you fail a Constitution saving throw caused by heat, smoke, poison gas, or volcanic pressure, reroll the save and use the new result. #### Volcanic Collateral Control Prerequisite: Magma, CL 6+ You can restrain your most destructive terrain. When creating Molten Terrain, choose a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus. Those creatures ignore the first damage roll from that terrain before the start of your next turn. In addition, when a Magma talent would ignite ordinary unattended objects, you may exclude one 10-foot area from incidental ignition. #### Blackglass Executioner Prerequisite: Obsidian Glass Scripture or Cinderglass Shards, CL 10+ Once per turn when a hostile creature takes Slashing damage from your Obsidian Terrain or Cinderglass Shards, choose one: • reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn; • prevent Reactions until the start of your next turn; • mark it with black-glass residue, preventing ordinary Invisible from benefiting it until the start of your next turn; • add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Metal Qi Types: metal qi, sharp qi, hard qi, mineral qi, magnetic qi, ringing qi, armament qi, ore-root qi, iron-bone qi, killing-edge qi, White Tiger qi; related methods may add sword qi, saber qi, spear qi, lightning-conduction qi, earth-ore qi, blood-iron qi, or blacksmith qi only when another sphere, scripture, item, or feature explicitly contributes it. "The nail is small. Heaven still moves around the point." Common Name: Metal Sphere Sphere Type: Elemental Power Sphere; Five-Phase Metal Sphere; Metal-Qi Combat Sphere; Mineral, Magnetism, Hardening, Edge, Needle, and Resonance Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Paths: Body Refining and Spirit Awakening Key Themes: sharpness, hardness, contraction, piercing, armor-splitting, mineral pressure, magnetic command, iron body, metal needles, ringing structure, meridian nails, weaponized filings, White Tiger killing intent, ore-rooted terrain, and the difference between forging a tool and becoming the edge Primary Resource Hooks: CP, Metal key ability, qualifying Metal Qi medium, metal objects, worn or held metal, mineral ground, Tiny metal objects, metal projectiles, temporary metal-qi projections, and optional scripture restrictions Core Chassis: Metal Qi Awakening, Sharpen, Weight, Magnet Hand, Metal Appraisal Common Effects: direct extra slashing or piercing damage, short push or pull, object manipulation, armor and shield pressure, metal needles, iron filings, mineralized terrain, anti-weapon reactions, temporary hardening, meridian-pinning, conductive setup, and resonance-based flaw reading ## Metal Dao Metal is the Dao of form made hard enough to divide the world. Earth hides ore. Fire makes it answer. Water cools its temper. Wood is cut by it. Blood remembers iron. A cultivator of Metal does not merely own a sword or repair armor. They learn the principle by which a point becomes a wound, a bell reveals a flaw, a nail fixes a dragon vein in place, and a mountain teaches the bones to refuse. The Sphere of Metal begins from three questions: What is the hardest thing here? Where is the line that should split? What object, body, or oath is already carrying metal and does not yet know it belongs to me? Blacksmiths make tools. Weapon masters perfect forms. A Metal cultivator commands the qi of hardness, edge, mineral weight, ringing structure, and magnetic obedience. The recurring verbs of Metal are: Sharpen. Make an edge, needle, claw, coin, fang, fingernail, breath, or ray of qi divide what it touches. Harden. Turn body, armor, bones, tools, or momentary qi into a refusal. Draw. Pull, push, suspend, pin, or twist metal-bearing matter through loadstone command. Ring. Listen for structure, flaw, oath, resonance, weakness, and hidden metal. Nail. Fix a body, meridian, weapon, gate, or formation point with a single cruel point. Metal is functional. It does not need a complex mark engine to matter. It cuts, weighs, rings, binds, and pierces. ## Sphere Boundary Metal governs: - hard metal qi, sharp metal qi, magnetic metal qi, ringing metal qi, mineral qi, and White Tiger cutting intent; - direct sharpening, piercing, hardening, metal pressure, and metal-bearing telekinesis; - temporary metal needles, filings, coins, rings, chains, nails, shards, and iron sand made from qi or available metal; - attacks and techniques that use metal as a medium or create short-lived metal-qi projections; - reading flaws in armor, weapons, locks, restraints, bells, gates, ore veins, and metal-bearing formations; - bending, dragging, pinning, scattering, or hardening metal in a temporary combat or exploration scene; - internal iron-body cultivation, metal bones, iron skin, iron breath, and marrow hardening; - ringing resonance and structural weakness; - battlefield use of ore, metal-bearing stone, mineral dust, and buried metal. Metal does not govern: - permanent crafting, repair, reforging, item improvement, workshop production, smithing economies, or artifact manufacture; - general weapon mastery without metal qi; - sword intent as its own Dao; - saber/dao cutting style as a martial tradition; - spear, chain, shield, axe, or bow mastery as their own spheres; - earthmoving, stone shaping, mud, sand, or crystal as broad terrain control; - lightning as elemental damage except where a Metal talent explicitly creates conductive setup; - blood control, bloodline theft, or general hemomancy; - soul prisons, corpse puppetry, undead bodies, or permanent spirit-binding unless a Forbidden Metal rule says so; - permanent item enchantment. If a rule is mainly about making or improving equipment, use Blacksmith. If it is mainly about a weapon style, use the appropriate weapon sphere. If it is mainly about ore in the ground, use Earth unless the effect specifically depends on metal or mineral qi. If it is mainly about electricity, use Lightning. If it is mainly about blood as a substance, use Blood. ## Metal Access Metal is a normal elemental sphere in most orthodox territories, but its more lethal branches are closely watched. Needle sects, White Tiger halls, imperial armor-breaker offices, mine wardens, and weapon-command lineages all teach different forms of Metal. Qi Cultivation is the cleanest route for projected metal qi: flying needles, iron sand, magnetic command, ringing diagnosis, and blade-light. Body Refining expresses Metal through skin, bones, teeth, nails, marrow, breath, muscles, worn armor, held weapons, and direct contact. Spirit Awakening expresses Metal through resonance, weapon memory, oath-edge, ancestral bells, White Tiger killing intent, and the spiritual meaning of severance. Secret Metal talents require a teacher, scripture, mine-heart inheritance, White Tiger hall, needle canon, ancestral weapon, bell monastery, or sect law office. Forbidden Metal talents require forbidden instruction and usually involve living meridians, unwilling bodies, soul-cages, corpse iron, or dantian sealing. ## Realm Progression Mortal Realm: Metal is direct edge, momentary hardening, small magnetic pulls, tiny object command, needle flicks, flaw-sense, and contact-based mineral pressure. A Mortal Metal cultivator should feel functional immediately: sharpen a blow, drag an enemy a few feet, read a lock or weapon, harden skin for a heartbeat, or send a nail through a gap. Foundation Realm: Metal becomes an external fighting method. Needles scatter through robe seams and armor joints, iron filings cloud space, magnetism begins to shape movement, armor-splitting cuts appear, and Body Refiners may deepen iron-bone methods while Qi Cultivators project temporary metal qi without always needing mundane metal. Core Formation Realm: Metal becomes battlefield structure. The cultivator creates iron-sand rivers, cages movement with loadstone force, rings flaws in barriers and constructs, turns hidden metal against its owner, and makes White Tiger severance a reliable anti-recovery and anti-defense pressure. Nascent Soul Realm: Metal becomes sovereign command over edge, mineral weight, weapon memory, bell resonance, and killing authority. The cultivator can manifest blade domains, impose mountain-ore dictates, split high defenses, harden the body into an adamant state, and nail even spiritual momentum long enough to decide a battle. Secret Inheritance: Secret Metal is not a minor refinement. It is the moment a temple, mine-heart, execution lineage, ancestral bell, immortal armory, or White Tiger mandate teaches the cultivator that metal is not a tool but an authority. Secret Metal should be scene-defining, story-gated, and dangerous enough that sects remember who was taught it. Forbidden Metal: Forbidden Metal uses nails, bells, soul-cages, corpse iron, and dantian seals against unwilling living circulation. It is precise, tempting, and criminal. It should feel narrower than Daemonic Cultivation or Death, but more surgically horrifying than ordinary Metal. ## 2024 Fifth-Edition Rules Baseline Metal uses the 2024 Fifth Edition action economy unless a talent says otherwise. Action Type: Rules Reference Canonical Action Type: Rules Reference Timing Detail: A Metal option states whether it uses an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Search action, Study action, object interaction, 10-minute ritual, 1-hour ritual, short-rest activity, or long-rest activity Factory Routing: rules_reference_not_character_action Split Review Decision: rules_reference_not_character_action Recommended Factory Realization: no_character_action_row Attacks and Saves: Metal attacks and Metal Save DCs use the Metal key ability. When a talent calls for a saving throw, the target rolls against your Metal Save DC. Cover and Line of Effect: Metal does not bypass Total Cover, sealed doors, closed formation shells, hidden objects, or sealed storage treasures unless a talent explicitly says so. Magnetic pressure still needs line of effect unless a talent says otherwise. Concentration: Metal talents do not require Concentration unless a talent says so. Magical/Supernatural: Metal talents are supernatural cultivation effects. They count as magical for overcoming ordinary Resistance and for interactions with anti-magic, suppression fields, warding talismans, consecrated barriers, heavenly seals, anti-cultivation formations, and similar effects. Expression Is Flexible; Mechanics Are Fixed: A player may describe Metal as iron bones, white-gold blade light, flying needles, blood-iron nails, ore veins, bronze bells, weapon memory, tiger claw pressure, magnetic palms, or silver filings. This expression does not change action type, range, target, damage type, duration, cost, cover, saving throw, or prerequisites unless a talent says so. ## Core Metal Rules ### Metal Key Ability When you learn Metal, use your Path key ability for Metal Checks, Metal attacks, and your Metal Save DC. A Qi Cultivator normally uses Intelligence or Charisma. A Body Refiner normally uses Constitution. A Spirit Awakener normally uses Wisdom. If a character has a special tradition, scripture, background, or GM-approved rule, the GM may permit a different Metal key ability. Once chosen, the Metal key ability should remain stable unless the character rebuilds their method. ### Metal Check When a Metal talent calls for a Metal Check, roll: **d20 + Proficiency Bonus + Metal key ability modifier** You may spend CP before the roll to steady the structure. Spend up to your Proficiency Bonus CP. Each CP spent adds +1 to the Metal Check. ### Metal Save DC Your Metal Save DC equals: **8 + Proficiency Bonus + Metal key ability modifier** ### Metal Cultivation Attack Your Metal Cultivation Attack Modifier equals: **Proficiency Bonus + Metal key ability modifier** ### Qualifying Metal Qi Medium A Metal talent must be expressed through at least one qualifying medium unless the talent says otherwise: - your body, bones, teeth, nails, blood-iron, marrow, or hardened skin; - a held, worn, carried, or touched metal object; - a metal weapon, shield, armor, tool, needle, coin, ring, bell, chain, nail, wire, or projectile; - metal-bearing stone, ore, filings, mineral dust, iron sand, or metal-rich ground; - a temporary metal-qi projection created by a Metal talent; - a spiritual weapon, ancestral weapon, or metal-bearing artifact that the GM agrees can carry Metal Qi. A purely wooden, stone, cloth, water, fire, dream, poison, blood, or shadow expression is not a qualifying Metal Qi medium unless another sphere or feature explicitly turns it into metal-bearing qi. ### Temporary Metal Qi Some Metal talents create needles, filings, hard plates, nails, or blade-light from qi. These are temporary Metal Qi expressions. They are not permanent objects, cannot be sold, cannot be stockpiled, and vanish when the talent ends. ### Metal and Equipment Metal can bend, ring, harden, sharpen, or command metal in a scene. It does not permanently repair or improve equipment. A weapon sharpened by Metal loses that supernatural edge when the talent ends. A dent repaired for a moment by Metal is still damaged afterward unless a Blacksmith, item, repair, or downtime rule fixes it. ### Metal and Blood-Iron Blood contains iron, but Metal does not gain general control over blood. Blood-Iron talents affect your own blood, bone, teeth, nails, marrow, or a wound or blood trace only when the talent explicitly says so. Broad blood manipulation belongs to Blood. ## Metal Methods A Metal cultivator may express the sphere through one or more Methods. These are not separate subclasses. They are cultivation idioms used to describe talent choices, teachers, sect styles, and variant scriptures. ### Iron-Body Method Metal is internalized into skin, bones, teeth, nails, armor, and stance. This Method favors Body Refiners, defensive reactions, contact techniques, and self-hardening. ### Killing Needle Method Metal becomes points: needles, coins, nails, pins, wires, filings, and iron sand. This Method favors ranged harassment, anti-caster pressure, and meridian-pinning. ### Loadstone Command Method Metal becomes obedience to attraction and repulsion. This Method favors push, pull, disarm pressure, forced movement, battlefield repositioning, and object command. ### Bell-Metal Resonance Method Metal becomes ringing structure. This Method favors flaw-reading, anti-armor pressure, counter-reactions, detection, formation diagnosis, and vibration attacks. ### White Tiger Edge Method Metal becomes killing clarity. This Method favors decisive strikes, severance, fear pressure, anti-regeneration, and finishing Bloodied foes. ### Ore-Root Method Metal remains half earth: veins, mineral ground, mine gates, buried iron, and ore-bearing stone. This Method favors area control and fortification without becoming broad Earth. ### Blood-Iron Method Metal is expressed through the body's own iron: blood, bone marrow, teeth, fingernails, wound heat, and metallic breath. This Method is legal when self-directed. It becomes Forbidden when it nails, cages, steals, or refines another creature's living meridians without consent. ## Path Expression ### Body Refining - Iron Marrow Body Body Refining Metal is strongest when the medium is the cultivator's own body, armor, held weapon, shield, blood-iron, teeth, nails, bones, or direct contact. Use Constitution as your Metal key ability if Metal is learned or expressed through Body Refining. When you use a Metal talent that originates from your body, worn armor, a held metal object, an unarmed strike, a weapon you are holding, a creature you are touching, or a creature you hit, grapple, or shove, it is an Iron Marrow expression. When you use Iron Marrow expressions, apply the following rules: - Once per turn, when you apply Sharpen through a melee weapon, unarmed strike, natural weapon, tooth, nail, armor spike, shield bash, or direct body contact, you may choose to make the extra damage the same type as the triggering attack or Piercing. - When a Metal talent that targets only you, your worn equipment, your held equipment, or a creature you physically touch costs CP, you may spend Stamina instead of CP if you are a Body Refiner and the talent does not create a detached projectile, remote area, or free-floating construct. - Once per short rest, when you use a Metal reaction to reduce damage or resist forced movement, add your Constitution modifier to the reduction or saving throw. - Remote Metal talents, flying needle clouds, distant magnetic command, field-wide ringing, and metal domains require the talent to support that range or a scripture such as Open the Outer Ore. This synergy does not delete talents. It defines which Metal expressions are cleanly embodied before outward Metal projection is opened. ### Qi Cultivation - Ten Thousand Needles Qi Qi Cultivation is the classic projected route of Metal: blade-light, flying needles, filings, iron sand, magnetic lines, dantian-forged shards, ring patterns, and White Tiger killing radiance. Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Metal key ability. When you use a Metal talent that creates a temporary metal-qi projectile, needle, shard, blade-light, filing cloud, bell-ring, or magnetic line, it is a Ten Thousand Needles expression. When you use Ten Thousand Needles expressions, apply the following rules: - Once on each of your turns, when you use a non-domain Metal talent with a range of 30 feet or more, increase its range by 10 feet. - When you use Magnet Hand, you may move the unattended Tiny metal object 20 feet instead of 10 feet. - Once per short rest, when a Metal talent creates multiple projectiles or affects multiple targets, choose one target that failed its save or was hit. That target takes extra Piercing or Slashing damage equal to your Metal key ability modifier. - You may express Metal even when no mundane metal is present by creating temporary Metal Qi needles or filings, but these vanish immediately after the talent resolves unless the talent gives them a duration. ### Spirit Awakening - Bell and White Tiger Spirit Spirit Awakening Metal hears structure before it strikes. The spirit tastes flaw, oath, weapon memory, ancestral iron, execution bells, and White Tiger killing intent. Use Wisdom as your Metal key ability. When you use a Metal talent through resonance, oath-edge, weapon memory, ancestral bells, tiger-sign, or spiritual severance, it is a Bell and White Tiger expression. When you use Bell and White Tiger expressions, apply the following rules: - When you use Metal Appraisal on a creature, weapon, armor, formation node, restraint, bell, gate, or metal-bearing object, you may also learn whether it is spiritually loyal, cursed, oath-bound, ancestral, corpse-touched, forbidden, or carrying a recent killing intent. - Once per turn, when you damage a creature with a Metal talent after using a Study action, Search action, or Metal Appraisal on that creature or its equipment since the start of your previous turn, the target cannot benefit from being Invisible against you until the start of your next turn if it remains within 30 feet. - Once per short rest, when a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Bell-Metal, White Tiger, or Meridian Nail talents, you may learn one symbolic flaw: pride, fear, oath, wound, brittle armor, borrowed weapon, unstable meridian, or hidden hesitation. - Forbidden Metal involving soul-cages, corpse bells, unwilling meridian nails, or dantian sealing is especially visible to Spirit Awakening senses. ## Base Sphere Abilities When you acquire the Sphere of Metal, you gain the following base abilities. Most Metal talents modify or build from Sharpen, Weight, Magnet Hand, Metal Appraisal, or the qualifying Metal Qi medium. ### Metal Qi Awakening You awaken the ability to express Metal Qi through qualifying mediums. You can use Metal talents through your body, a held or worn metal object, a touched metal object, a metal projectile, mineral dust, ore-bearing ground, or a temporary metal-qi projection created by a Metal talent. Metal Qi Awakening does not grant weapon proficiency, armor proficiency, Blacksmith tools, permanent item crafting, or broad control over all metal in sight. ### Sharpen Action Type: No Action Canonical Action Type: No Action Factory Combat Bucket: passive Factory Routing: passive_or_triggered_modifier_row Trigger: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a qualifying Metal Qi attack or technique Range: The range of the triggering attack or technique Target: One target hit by the triggering attack or technique Cost: None You sharpen the impact with Metal Qi. The target takes extra Slashing or Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This extra damage counts as magical and Metal Qi damage for overcoming ordinary Resistance and for Tianxia interactions. If a Metal talent later improves Sharpen, apply only one improvement to a given triggering hit unless the talent says otherwise. ### Weight Action Type: No Action Canonical Action Type: No Action Factory Combat Bucket: passive Factory Routing: passive_or_triggered_modifier_row Trigger: Once on each of your turns when you hit with a qualifying Metal Qi attack or technique and choose not to use Sharpen on that hit Range: The range of the triggering attack or technique Target: One Large or smaller creature hit by the triggering attack or technique Cost: None You add sudden mineral weight or magnetic drag. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw against your Metal Save DC or be pushed 5 feet or pulled 5 feet, chosen by you. This movement cannot move a target through Total Cover, sealed barriers, walls, or occupied spaces.
