Choose up to three decrees: **All Weapons Bow.** Hostile creatures of your choice in the region that are holding metal weapons, wearing metal armor, carrying metal tools, made partly of metal, standing in ore-rich ground, or directly connected to battlefield metal make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature is pulled 30 feet, pushed 30 feet, knocked Prone, or forced to drop one non-artifact metal object, your choice. On a success, it is moved 5 feet or keeps its grip, your choice. **The Edge Finds the Gap.** Choose up to twice your Proficiency Bonus metal-bearing creatures, armored creatures, weapon-bearing creatures, constructs, or creatures carrying your Metal Qi that you can perceive in the region. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes **8d8 slashing or piercing damage** and cannot regain HP until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and can regain HP normally. **The Bell Names the Flaw.** Choose one visible or spiritually perceived non-Secret ward, barrier, armor technique, formation node, talisman frame, construct, gate, chain, seal, armory defense, or metal-bearing technique in the region. Make a Metal Check against its DC. On a success, suppress it until the end of your next turn. On a failure, reduce one of its major numerical benefits by your Cultivation Level until the end of your next turn and learn one of its protection rules. **The Ore Remembers the Mountain.** Choose a point on metal-bearing ground, stone with ore, a mine, a forge floor, a battlefield covered with weapons, an armory, a city gate, or comparable terrain. Until the end of your next turn, the ground in a 60-foot radius becomes difficult terrain for hostile creatures, and the first time each hostile creature moves more than 10 feet through it, it takes piercing damage equal to your Cultivation Level. **The Tiger Passes Judgment.** Hostile creatures of your choice in the region that are Bloodied, Frightened, carrying your Metal Qi, holding a weapon, wearing armor, standing among battlefield metal, or maintaining a violent technique make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature cannot take Reactions, cannot benefit from Invisibility against you, and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. On a success, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. **The Body Becomes a Bell of Iron.** Until the end of your next turn, you gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Lightning, and Thunder damage; cannot be forcibly moved unless the enemy wins an opposed check against your Metal Check; and your first Metal talent hit each turn deals additional damage equal to **4d8**. Limits: Ten-Thousand-Metal Sovereign Edict does not permanently steal weapons, destroy artifacts, erase mountains, shut down ancient city arrays by default, bypass immunity, command nonmetal creatures without a metal-bearing condition, or defeat stronger domain-scale authority without an opposed Cultivation Check. ## Forbidden Metal Forbidden Metal is not the same as Secret Metal. Secret Metal is rare knowledge. Forbidden Metal is the use of Metal Qi to nail, cage, seal, refine, or weaponize unwilling living meridians, soul-bearing metal, corpse iron, dantian points, and spiritual prisons. Orthodox Metal cuts enemies in battle, hardens the body, commands weapons, reads ore, and breaks armor. Forbidden Metal treats living circulation as a lock, the soul as a bell, and the dantian as a nail-hole. Forbidden Metal is tempting because it is precise. It is not broad Death, Blood, Puppetry, or Daemonic Cultivation. It does not raise corpses, steal whole bloodlines, create full demons, or grant permanent control over souls. Instead, it creates narrow, immediate, terrifying effects: dantian pinning, meridian interruption, corpse-iron tracking, soul-bell alarms, and spiritual imprisonment. ### Iron Stain Whenever you use a Forbidden Metal talent, gain 1 Iron Stain unless that talent lists a different Iron Stain amount. Iron Stain is spiritually visible to appropriate detection, especially Protection, Karma, Hidden Eye, Death, Life, Spirit Awakening, Blacksmith, Metal, ancestral courts, execution offices, corpse registries, oath bells, and sect law mirrors. When your Iron Stain equals or exceeds your Proficiency Bonus, you suffer the following: - You have Disadvantage on Charisma checks against orthodox cultivators who can sense or prove the stain, except Intimidation. - Bells, weapons, graves, execution grounds, and ancestral tablets may ring or chill near you at the GM's discretion. - When you see a helpless restrained cultivator, the GM may call for a Wisdom saving throw against your Metal Save DC. On a failure, you do not lose control, but you have Disadvantage on the next ability check or saving throw made to refuse a forbidden sealing shortcut before the end of the scene. Iron Stain can be reduced only by serious purification, public atonement, releasing prisoners, repairing a damaged meridian, sect punishment, Protection rites, Life rites, Karma judgment, ancestral pardon, or story consequences. A normal long rest does not remove it. ### Living Meridian Nail - Forbidden, Needle Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, forbidden needle scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch or 30 feet Target: One Bloodied, Restrained, Grappled, Incapacitated, or willing creature Cost: 3 CP Iron Stain: gain 1 Make a Metal Cultivation Attack. Hit: the target takes **3d8 Piercing damage** and must make a Constitution saving throw. Failure: until the end of your next turn, the target cannot regain CP, cannot teleport, and has Disadvantage on its next Cultivation Check or technique-maintenance save. Success: the target cannot regain CP until the start of your next turn. Using this on a helpless or unwilling cultivator outside battle is a major crime in orthodox society. ### Dantian Iron Seal - Forbidden, Bell, Needle Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Living Meridian Nail Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: 10-minute forbidden ritual Range: Touch Target: One helpless, bound, unconscious, willing, or ritually restrained cultivator Cost: 5 CP Iron Stain: gain 2 Make a Metal Check against DC 18 or the target's Cultivation Save DC, whichever is higher. Success: the target's CP maximum is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the target completes a long rest and receives cleansing, Life, Protection, or equivalent meridian care. Success by 5 or More: the reduction also applies to the target's next breakthrough-related Cultivation Check as a penalty equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Failure: gain 1 Iron Stain and suffer Psychic damage equal to twice your level or cultivation level from backlash. Dantian Iron Seal cannot reduce a target below half maximum CP and cannot permanently destroy a cultivation base without a major story consequence and GM permission. ### Soul-Cage Bell - Forbidden, Bell Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, forbidden bell, soul-cage scripture, or execution-office inheritance Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One spirit, ghost, soul trace, possessed creature, or creature carrying visible soul residue Cost: 8 CP Iron Stain: gain 2 The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failure: it is Restrained by ringing metal qi until the end of your next turn. While Restrained this way, it cannot become Invisible, cannot teleport, and cannot pass through objects or creatures. Success: it cannot become Invisible until the start of your next turn. This does not grant permanent soul ownership, necromancy, corpse control, or memory theft. ### Corpse-Iron Tracking Nail - Forbidden, Ore-Root, Bell Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, corpse court, grave-iron teacher, or forbidden battlefield manual Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: 1-minute forbidden ritual Range: Touch Target: One corpse, severed weapon, armor plate, bloodied nail, battlefield scrap, grave bell, or execution iron connected to a meaningful creature Cost: 2 CP Iron Stain: gain 1 if the target is a corpse, grave good, or spiritually protected relic For 24 hours, you can sense the direction, but not distance, to one creature who killed, carried, wore, buried, or was killed by the target, chosen when you perform the ritual. This sense fails across planes, sealed formations, oath-protected burials, or deliberate corpse-purification rites. ## Metal Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures Metal variants are optional cultivation scriptures that change how the sphere manifests. A variant grants a benefit only if it also imposes a real limitation. Unless the GM says otherwise: - choose at most one Metal variant when first learning Metal or undergoing a major Metal initiation; - Metal variants are mutually exclusive; - the variant applies to all Metal talents you use; - if a variant grants a talent whose prerequisites are not yet met, you gain that talent when you meet those prerequisites; - if the variant is retrained, removed, or ritually broken, lose the bonus talent or benefit unless another feature preserves it; - talents sealed by a variant are Known - Restricted Use, not deleted, unless the variant says they are replaced. ### Iron Body Only Scripture Prerequisite: Body Refining Path Your Metal begins in bones, teeth, nails, skin, armor, shield, held weapon, and breath. Use Constitution as your Metal key ability while practicing this scripture. Benefit: Your maximum HP increases by your Proficiency Bonus while you know this scripture. When you use Iron Skin Moment, add your Constitution modifier to the damage reduction. Drawback: Your Metal talents cannot create detached projectiles, remote areas, flying needles, ranged magnetic command, or domain effects unless you physically touch the target, strike the target with a held weapon or body, or later open external Metal through Open the Outer Ore. ### Needle Ascetic Scripture Your Metal refuses broad armor, heavy weapons, and large metal displays. It becomes small, hidden, and cruelly exact. Benefit: When you use Needle Flick, Meridian Nail, Hundred Needles Fan, or Thousand-Edge Rain, increase one damage roll by your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. Drawback: You cannot use Metal talents that require heavy armor, large metal structures, ore-rich ground, shields, or Huge metal objects unless you abandon this scripture during a long rest. ### Loadstone Vow Scripture Your Metal obeys attraction and repulsion more than edge. Benefit: Once per turn, when you push or pull a creature with Weight or a Loadstone talent, increase that movement by 5 feet. Drawback: Your Sharpen extra damage is reduced by 1, minimum 1, unless the target is wearing, holding, standing on, or carrying meaningful metal. ### White Tiger Slaughter Scripture Your Metal is killing intent before it is mineral. Benefit: When you damage a Bloodied creature with a White Tiger or Edge talent, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll once per turn. Drawback: After you reduce a meaningful creature to 0 HP with a Metal talent, you have Disadvantage on Charisma checks other than Intimidation until you complete a short rest or perform a restraint rite. Orthodox witnesses may treat your aura as execution-office or war-crime pressure. ### Ore-Root Mine Scripture Your Metal refuses empty air. It wants ore, stone, ground, iron doors, mine walls, weapon piles, and buried metal. Benefit: When you use a Metal talent while standing on metal-rich, stone, mineral, worked-metal, or ore-bearing ground, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. Drawback: When you are flying, swimming in open water, airborne, on pure wood, on clouds, or in a place the GM rules has no usable mineral or metal, your Metal talent ranges are halved unless the talent uses a held, worn, or internal medium. ### Open the Outer Ore Prerequisite: Body Refining Path, Foundation Realm, Iron Body Only Scripture, Constitution 16+ You have learned to let Metal leave the body without ceasing to be Body Refining. Your breath carries iron dust, your heartbeat rings like a hammer on ore, and the nails of your fingers teach qi to travel. You remove the external projection restriction from Iron Body Only Scripture. You may use Metal talents at their listed ranges if you otherwise meet their prerequisites. First Projection Risk: Once per short rest, when you use an external Metal effect that costs CP and affects a creature other than you, increase one damage roll, damage reduction, forced movement distance, or Metal Check by your Proficiency Bonus. After the effect resolves, take Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus as iron pressure vents through your skin. This damage ignores Resistance. Opening the outer ore does not grant Qi Cultivation, does not grant Blacksmith crafting, and does not make external Metal subtle. ## Path Synergies ### Body Refining - Iron Marrow Body Body Refining Metal is strongest through embodied metal: bones, teeth, nails, armor, shields, weapons, marrow heat, and contact. Use Constitution as your Metal key ability if Metal is learned or expressed through Body Refining. When a Metal talent originates from your body, armor, shield, held weapon, tooth, nail, blood-iron, or direct touch, apply the following rules: - You may spend Stamina instead of CP on Metal talents that target only you, your worn equipment, your held equipment, or a creature you physically touch. - Once per turn, after you hit, grapple, shove, or physically touch a creature, you may use Metal Appraisal on that creature's armor, weapon, restraint, or metal-bearing body without spending an action. This free appraisal can ask only whether the target is brittle, conductive, armored, weapon-bearing, or suitable for a Metal talent you know. - Once per short rest, when you use a Metal reaction to reduce damage, resist forced movement, or harden your body, add your Proficiency Bonus to the effect. - External Metal still requires the talent to have a range or an opening source. ### Qi Cultivation - Ten Thousand Needles Qi Qi Cultivation Metal is strongest when Metal Qi is projected as blade-light, flying needles, filings, iron sand, magnetic lines, and dantian-forged shards. Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Metal key ability. When you use projected Metal Qi: - You may create temporary metal-qi needles or filings even if no mundane metal is present. - Once on each of your turns, increase the range of one non-domain Metal talent by 10 feet. - Once per short rest, when you use a Metal talent that affects multiple targets, choose one damaged target. It takes additional Piercing or Slashing damage equal to your Metal key ability modifier. - When you use Metal Appraisal through visible metal qi or ringing resonance, its range becomes 60 feet. ### Spirit Awakening - Bell and White Tiger Spirit Spirit Awakening Metal is strongest when Metal means resonance, oath-edge, weapon memory, ancestral bells, execution intent, and the spiritual truth of severance. Use Wisdom as your Metal key ability. When you use spiritual Metal: - When you use Metal Appraisal, you may also learn whether the target is oath-bound, cursed, ancestral, corpse-touched, loyal, resentful, forbidden, or recently used to kill. - Once per turn, when you damage a creature after studying its structure, weapon, armor, or aura since the start of your previous turn, the creature cannot benefit from being Invisible against you until the start of your next turn while within 30 feet. - Once per short rest, when a creature fails a saving throw against a Bell, White Tiger, or Meridian Nail talent, learn one symbolic flaw: pride, fear, oath, wound, brittle armor, borrowed weapon, unstable meridian, hidden hesitation, or false confidence. - Forbidden Metal involving souls, corpse bells, unwilling meridians, or dantian seals is especially obvious to your senses. ## Cultivation Insights ### Alloy-Sense Disciple Prerequisite: Metal sphere When you use Metal Appraisal on a mundane metal object, armor, weapon, gate, lock, chain, bell, coin, or tool, you may also learn whether it is iron, steel, bronze, silver, gold, copper, tin, lead, meteor metal, spirit metal, alloyed, plated, or false. ### Proper Weight of the Tool Prerequisite: Metal sphere You gain proficiency with Smith's Tools, Jeweler's Tools, Tinker's Tools, or one weapon with a meaningful metal component. If you already have the chosen proficiency, gain Advantage on the next ability check involving that proficiency before your next long rest. This Insight does not grant Blacksmith sphere crafting. ### Hard-Meridian Breathing Prerequisite: Metal sphere Once per short rest, when you fail a Strength or Constitution saving throw against forced movement, Prone, Grappled, or Restrained, you may spend 1 CP to reroll the save. You must use the new result. ### Clean Edge Discipline Prerequisite: Metal sphere When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Metal talent, you may choose to make the wound clean and controlled. If you do, you have Advantage on the next Medicine check or social check made to prove that you did not use Forbidden Metal, poison, Blood, Death, or Daemonic Cultivation. ### Conductor's Eye Prerequisite: Metal sphere You can tell whether a visible object or creature is obviously wet, metallic, grounded, insulated, lightning-charged, or conductive without spending an action, unless the condition is deliberately concealed. ### White Tiger Restraint Prerequisite: Metal sphere You have trained not to let killing intent rule the hand. You gain Advantage on saving throws or ability checks made to resist White Tiger frenzy, execution pressure, forbidden sealing temptation, killing-intent backlash, or comparable Metal-related spiritual violence. If you willingly use a Forbidden Metal talent on a helpless unwilling creature, replace this Insight with another Metal Insight chosen with GM approval. ### Mine-Warden's Ear Prerequisite: Metal sphere, Foundation Realm When you are underground, in a mine, near a forge district, inside a weapon hall, or standing on obvious mineral ground, you gain Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to notice buried metal, hidden weapon caches, unstable supports, hollow walls, or ore-bearing stone. ### Open the Outer Ore Insight Prerequisite: Metal sphere, Body Refining Path, Foundation Realm, Iron Body Only Scripture You qualify for Open the Outer Ore even if your Constitution is 14 instead of 16. When you take Open the Outer Ore, the self-damage from First Projection Risk is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus, minimum 1. ## Automation Notes The base acquisition actions for this sphere are Sharpen, Weight, Magnet Hand, and Metal Appraisal. Most Metal talents should modify one of those base expressions, create a Metal attack, create a Metal reaction, create a Metal area, or define a scripture/variant. no damage, disarm, trap manipulation, lock picking, or attack by itself Name: Metal Appraisal Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Study action or Search action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: None Range: 30 feet Target: One visible metal or metal-bearing target Roll: Metal Check only if target is concealed, protected, artifact-level, or contested Duration: Instantaneous Output: one permitted structural answer AI Use Notes: - Do not invent permanent crafting from Metal talents. - Do not grant Blacksmith repairs unless a Blacksmith rule is present. - Do not let Magnet Hand attack, disarm, pick locks, steal worn objects, or solve complex mechanisms by itself. - Do not allow Blood-Iron to become broad blood control. - Do not allow temporary Metal Qi objects to be sold, stockpiled, or used as permanent equipment. - When Body Refining uses Stamina for Metal, confirm the talent is self, held, worn, touched, or contact-based. - When Qi Cultivation projects Metal without mundane metal, treat projectiles as temporary qi expressions. - When Spirit Awakening uses Metal, prefer resonance, oath-edge, weapon memory, bells, and White Tiger intent. - Forbidden Metal should create Iron Stain and social/legal/karmic consequences.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Monkey Style Qi Expression: Primary — Trick-Motion Qi; Supporting — Body Qi, Joy Qi, Wind Qi, Reversal Qi. “The ape climbs the wall, steals the peach, laughs at the guard, and reaches enlightenment before breakfast.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening through training, Cultivation Insight, Path synergy, or Variant ScripturePrimary Resource: StaminaDao: Monkey Style cultivates stolen advantage through capering motion. The monkey does not meet force where it is strongest; it climbs around it, steals the exposed thing, laughs at the failed answer, and escapes before punishment lands.Core Engine: Start the caper, create a Monkey Link, spend the link on a finish, then scatter before punishment lands. Common Effects: capering movement, climbing, staff play, improvised weapons, theft, feints, disarms, evasive reactions, afterimages, playful disruption, monkey-body transformation. Monkey Style is the cultivation of stolen advantage. A Monkey Style cultivator treats the battlefield as a forest of handholds, sleeves, ledges, rafters, staffs, fruit bowls, roof-beams, exposed belts, moving shoulders, and unguarded assumptions. Where a disciplined swordsman seeks the cleanest line, the monkey cultivator asks what can be climbed, stolen, thrown, mocked, swung from, or escaped through. Monkey Style is playful, but it is not weak. The laughter is bait. The foolishness is a hook. The capering body steals angles, reactions, objects, footing, dignity, and eventually destiny itself. ### WHAT MONKEY STYLE DOES Monkey Style is for players who want a mobile trickster martial art built around movement chains. Monkey Style specializes in: climbing, swinging, vaulting, and changing elevation; moving through strange spaces and forcing bad angles; using staffs, poles, props, and improvised weapons; stealing exposed objects and enemy timing; denying reactions, escaping punishment, and leaving afterimages; turning battlefield clutter into part of the technique. Monkey Style overlaps with other spheres but does not replace them. Athletics is cleaner physical traversal and raw bodily skill. Reeling Immortal is falling, rolling, Prone combat, and unstable recovery. Scoundrel is broader dirty tricks, sabotage, and unfair timing. Jester is public bait, social contradiction, and visible tactical propositions. Brute is shoves, collisions, and direct physical leverage. Wrestling is grapples, holds, pins, and closed-distance body control. Transformation is lasting alternate bodies and physical adaptation. Monkey Style climbs above the enemy, steals the enemy’s certainty, and escapes through the smallest gap the battlefield forgot to close. ### RULES BASELINE This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Attack action, Opportunity Attack, Advantage, Disadvantage, Cover, Hide, Invisible, Influence, Search, Study, Utilize, Concentration, and conditions unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. ### CORE MONKEY STYLE RULES #### Key Ability and Costs Your Monkey Style key ability is Strength or Dexterity, chosen when you learn the sphere. If you are a Body Refiner, you may use Constitution as your Monkey Style key ability when a feature such as Iron Ape Frame, Monkey-Body Adept, or a Variant Scripture permits it. Monkey Save DC = 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Monkey Style key ability modifier Monkey Attack Modifier = Proficiency Bonus + Monkey Style key ability modifier Unless a talent says otherwise, Monkey Style talents cost Stamina. Qi Cultivators, Spirit Awakeners, and other non-Body paths may use CP instead of Stamina only through explicit training, Cultivation Insight, Path synergy, or Variant Scripture. When a Monkey Style talent lists more than one possible cost, pay exactly one legal cost. You never pay multiple listed costs unless the talent says otherwise. #### Special Attacks When a talent says it is a Special Attack, replace one attack when you take the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different Action Type. #### Capering Movement and Occupied Spaces When a Monkey Style talent lets you move through another creature’s space, that movement still follows these rules unless the talent says otherwise: you cannot willingly end your movement in an occupied space; a hostile creature’s space is difficult terrain unless the talent says otherwise; Total Cover, sealed barriers, and physical walls still block movement; teleportation is not movement and does not satisfy movement-distance requirements unless a talent says otherwise. #### Climbing, Hanging, and Swinging A talent that grants a Climb Speed allows you to climb using that Speed. A Monkey Style talent may allow you to hang from branches, rafters, beams, ledges, poles, ropes, hooks, tail-like Qi, hooked equipment, or your staff. This does not give you extra hands unless a talent says so. If you are hanging, climbing, or balancing in a way that would normally require a check, the GM may still call for a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check when the surface is especially smooth, fragile, hostile, or moving. #### Improvised Weapons and Props The 2024 rules treat an improvised weapon as an object used as a weapon. It normally deals 1d4 damage, or uses a similar weapon’s statistics if the GM agrees the object resembles that weapon. Monkey Style talents may raise the damage die, grant proficiency, or add movement after an improvised-weapon hit. Unless a talent says otherwise, an improvised weapon used with Monkey Style: is not automatically a magic item; counts as magical only when the talent says so; uses Strength for melee attacks and Dexterity for thrown attacks unless the object resembles a weapon with another rule; has a normal thrown range of 20/60 feet if thrown and no better range is provided. #### Staff and Long-Weapon Techniques When a Monkey Style talent refers to a staff, it includes a quarterstaff, long staff, monk staff, walking staff, or similar blunt pole. A spear, pike, polearm, ladder, oar, banner pole, or other long object qualifies only when the talent says it does or when the GM agrees the object is being used as a Monkey Style long weapon rather than as another sphere’s primary weapon discipline. Weapon Mastery properties function only if another feature grants you the relevant Weapon Mastery. #### Borrowed Objects and Theft Some talents let you steal, draw, stow, snatch, kick, throw, or redirect objects. Unless a talent says otherwise, an accessible object is visible, reachable, and not fully secured inside armor, clothing, a locked container, a sealed pouch, a creature’s body, a Formation core, or a soul-bound artifact. Monkey Style cannot steal a creature’s Path, sphere, Secret Inheritance, bonded soul-item, Realm-defining treasure, or cultivation base unless a specific feature says otherwise. #### Disarm Effects A Disarm effect is any effect that forces a creature to drop a held item or lose control of it. The 2024 core rules do not provide one universal Disarm action, so Monkey Style Disarm effects use the save or check listed in the talent. #### Afterimages and Decoys A Monkey Style afterimage is not a creature unless a talent says otherwise. Afterimages: do not provide flanking; do not make attacks; do not block movement; do not create Total Cover; vanish when the talent says they vanish. ### THE MONKEY CHAIN The Monkey Chain is the heart of this version of Monkey Style. A Monkey Style exchange has four parts: Start the Caper. Activate Capering Footwork or another Opener. Create a Monkey Link. Do something monkey-like during the caper: climb, change elevation, slip through space, steal, feint, swing, kick a prop, or strike from an odd angle. Spend the Link. Use a Finish: trip, steal, deny reactions, scatter, strike, redirect, or create an afterimage. Escape Punishment. Use a Reversal if the enemy tries to punish the caper. #### CHAIN TERMS Opener: A talent that starts or alters Capering Footwork. Link: A moment of stolen advantage created during the caper. Finish: A talent or base option that spends a Monkey Link for a stronger effect. Reversal: A reaction talent used when an enemy attacks, misses, grabs, restrains, or tries to punish you. Chain Talent: A Monkey Style talent that says which part of the Monkey Chain it modifies. #### CREATING A MONKEY LINK While Capering Footwork or another Monkey Style Opener is active, you may create one Monkey Link per turn when you do one of the following: move at least 10 feet before making an attack or forcing a save; change elevation by at least 5 feet; climb, hang, swing, or balance on terrain; move through a hostile creature’s space or the space of a larger creature; interact with a prop, unattended object, staff, rope, ladder, curtain, roof tile, branch, sleeve, belt, or similar battlefield feature; cause a creature to miss you with an opportunity attack; succeed on a Monkey Style check, save contest, or Trick effect. You can hold only one Monkey Link at a time unless a talent says otherwise. A Monkey Link lasts until the end of your current turn. #### SPENDING A MONKEY LINK Once per turn, when you hit with a Monkey Style attack, force a creature to fail a Monkey Style saving throw, or complete a Monkey Style movement sequence, you may spend your Monkey Link on one of the following base finishes. ##### SLIP FINISH Move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from one creature you affected or moved past this turn. ##### LAUGH FINISH One creature you affected or moved past this turn cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. ##### SNATCH FINISH Pick up, draw, stow, kick, toss, or steal one accessible unattended object within 5 feet of you. You cannot use Quiet Gap, invisibility, or silence-based techniques to hide the obvious performance of your Monkey Style Trick talents unless a feature explicitly says otherwise. ##### BENEFIT gain Mischievous Feint as a bonus talent; once per short rest, when a creature succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Monkey Style Trick talents, force it to reroll and use the new result; Monkey Style Trick talents can affect spirits, ghosts, and possessing entities that can perceive your performance spiritually. #### Beast-Brother Ape Scripture - Drawback Variant “Do not imitate the ape. Admit the ape is kin.” ##### DRAWBACK: Beast-Bound Body Your Monkey Style leans toward animal embodiment and loses some human tool discipline. You cannot use Borrowed Treasure, Hundred-Handed Trickster, or other fine theft talents while transformed unless your form has suitable hands or the GM permits it. While using a Beast Taming, Transformation, or Seventy-Two Earthly Transformations form, you cannot wield manufactured weapons unless the form can reasonably hold them. After a transformation ends, you cannot use Staff talents until the start of your next turn unless you are already holding a suitable weapon. Social disguise suffers: creatures inspecting you closely may notice bestial posture, gaze, scent, or movement. ##### BENEFIT gain Monkey-Body Adept or Impossible Climber as a bonus talent when you meet its prerequisites; while transformed into a climbing, swift, Tiny, or Powerful beast template, Capering Footwork costs 0 once per turn; once per turn after creating a Monkey Link through beast movement, your next Unarmed Strike before the end of the turn deals extra damage equal to Proficiency Bonus. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Body Refining - Iron Ape Frame While using Capering Footwork: gain +1 AC; add Constitution modifier to checks made to climb, jump, escape Grappled, or resist being knocked Prone; Vaulting Strike deals 1d10 extra damage instead of 1d8; you may use Constitution as your Monkey Style key ability; once per turn, when you spend a Monkey Link on Tap Finish or a melee Finish, add Constitution modifier to the damage if it is not already included. #### Qi Cultivation - Cloud-Skipping Qi You may learn Monkey Style as a Martial Sphere using CP instead of Stamina. Once per turn, reduce the resource cost of one Monkey Style talent by 1, minimum 1. When you create a Monkey Link through Capering Footwork, it may appear as cloud-prints, ripples of light, wind-pads, or lotus-like footprints. #### Spirit Awakening - Laughing Soul You may learn Monkey Style using Resonance or the current Spirit Awakening CP equivalent. Mischievous Feint, Laughing Theft of Timing, and Monkey Style Trick talents may affect: spirits; ghosts; possessing entities; creatures that cannot see you but can perceive your spirit or intent. Once per long rest, reroll one failed Wisdom saving throw. When a spirit or possessing entity fails a saving throw against your Monkey Style Trick talent, you create a Monkey Link that can be spent only against that entity or its vessel before the end of your next turn. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Monkey-Body Adept Prerequisite: Body Refining, Monkey Style, CL 4+ Your Monkey Grip improves. Your Climb Speed equals your walking Speed. Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks involving climbing, swinging, vaulting, or balancing. You may use Capering Footwork while climbing without needing a free hand. Once per turn after creating a Monkey Link through changing elevation, your next Unarmed Strike before the end of the turn deals additional damage equal to Proficiency Bonus. #### Iron Ape Frame Prerequisite: Body Refining, Monkey Style, CL 4+ Gain the Iron Ape Frame synergy. Gain proficiency in Acrobatics or Athletics. If already proficient, gain a flat +2 bonus to checks with the chosen skill. #### Staff Sage Prerequisite: Monkey Style, Staff of the Laughing Sage, CL 8+ While wielding a staff, spear, polearm, or suitable long object: gain +1 to attack rolls with that weapon; reduce Golden Hoop Staff’s cost by 1, minimum 1; use Dexterity or Constitution for attack rolls with that weapon if your Path or feature permits it; once per turn when you create a Monkey Link through Staff-Swing Step, extend your reach by 5 feet until the end of that turn. #### Heavenly Mischief Prerequisite: Monkey Style, CL 8+ Once per short rest, when a creature succeeds on a saving throw against Mischievous Feint or a Monkey Style Trick talent, force it to reroll. It must use the new result. If the reroll fails, you create a Monkey Link. #### Impossible Climber Prerequisite: Monkey Style, Monkey Grip, CL 8+ You may climb ceilings, smooth stone, ice, fragile surfaces, and Large or larger creatures without requiring free hands, provided some supernatural or physical explanation exists. While climbing, move at full Speed. Once per turn when you climb a creature or impossible surface during Capering Footwork, create a Monkey Link. #### Peach-Thief Adept Prerequisite: Monkey Style, Borrowed Treasure, CL 8+ Borrowed Treasure may target an object held in one hand if the object is not strapped, locked, soul-bound, fused to the target, or Realm-defining. The target has Advantage on the contested check if it is actively using that item. On a success, you may immediately stow the object or throw it up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. If you throw the object into a dangerous, elevated, hidden, or awkward space, create a Monkey Link that lasts until the end of your next turn.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Music Qi Expression: Primary — Harmony Qi; Supporting — Sound Qi, Spirit Qi, Rhythm Qi, Emotion Qi. “A sword cuts the body. A song enters before the blade is drawn.” Common Name: Music Sphere Sphere Type: Hybrid Martial / Power Sphere of Resonance, Rhythm, Heart-Sound, and Coordinated Performance Primary Paths: Spirit Awakening and Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Body Refining through Battle Cadence, breath rhythm, weapon impacts, steps, chants, and body-as-drum methods Resource: CP for Resonant Art and Soul-Sound techniques; Stamina or Martial Focus for Body Refining and martial cadence techniques when permitted Common Effects: Performances, rhythm, morale, fear, heart-sound, emotional tuning, coordinated movement, ally support, dissonance, concentration disruption, sonic/psychic damage, echo performers, spirit communication through melody, martial cadence, and battlefield tempo. ### Music Dao Music is the cultivation of ordered resonance. Sound happens when the world is struck. Music happens when the strike is remembered in measure. A novice learns how to make a tone. An adept learns how to keep rhythm while blades move. A master learns how one note can command breath, courage, grief, fear, and memory. A sovereign learns that Heaven, Earth, body, spirit, army, river, bell, and battlefield all contain a hidden tempo. The Dao question of Music is: What answers when the heart is given a measure? Music cultivators do not merely entertain. They tune the battlefield. They give allies a shared breath. They make enemies stumble because their killing intent has lost the beat. They call ghosts by melody, calm maddened beasts, shatter concentration with one wrong note, and carry a sect’s discipline through drum, bell, chant, flute, zither, throat, footstep, or weapon-impact. ### Realm Progression Mortal Realm. The cultivator learns to maintain a Measure, release Resonant Notes, support allies with simple Phrases, disrupt enemy rhythm, guard through cadence, and move through a battlefield without losing tempo. Foundation Realm. The cultivator opens stable harmonic meridians. Performances can carry qi, affect spirits, create Echo Performers, bind instruments, coordinate allies at greater range, break lesser silence effects, and impose stronger emotional measures. Core Formation Realm. The cultivator forms a resonant court. Within the Domain, allied actions follow a shared tempo, enemies lose reactions or concentration, spirits hear hidden tones, and the battlefield itself becomes an instrument. Nascent Soul Realm. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Attack action, Opportunity Attack, Advantage, Disadvantage, Concentration, Cover, Invisible, Hide, Charmed, Frightened, Deafened, Incapacitated, Stunned, Prone, Grappled, Restrained, Exhaustion, Long Rest, Short Rest, Temporary HP, and object interaction unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands them. #### Hearing, Silence, and Spiritual Sound Unless a talent says otherwise, a Music effect affects only creatures that can hear the performance or perceive the rhythm through a legal substitute such as Spirit Awakening, body vibration, linked instrument, or prepared Formation. A Deafened creature is normally unaffected by hostile or beneficial Music effects that require hearing. A Silence effect suppresses ordinary audible Music performances inside it. If you are inside Silence, you cannot begin or maintain an audible performance unless a feature says otherwise. A Music effect with the Soul-Sound tag may affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, or spiritually linked creatures even when ordinary ears are irrelevant. Soul-Sound does not automatically bypass Silence unless the talent says so. #### Performance and Concentration Some Music talents require an ongoing performance. Unless a talent states otherwise: starting a performance uses a Bonus Action; a performance lasts for 1 minute; you may end it at any time; you may maintain only one performance at a time; you must be able to produce audible sound, rhythm, vibration, or a permitted spiritual equivalent; you cannot maintain a performance while Incapacitated; a performance requiring Concentration ends if Concentration is lost; a creature must perceive the performance to benefit or suffer its effects. #### Key Ability, Save DC, and Costs Your Music key ability depends on Path expression. Body Refining: Constitution when using Battle Cadence, breath, steps, weapon impacts, chants, or another approved embodied performance. Qi Cultivation: Intelligence or Charisma. Spirit Awakening: Wisdom. Music Save DC: 8 + Proficiency Bonus + your Music key ability modifier. Music Attack Modifier: Proficiency Bonus + your Music key ability modifier. Music Check: d20 + Proficiency Bonus + your Music key ability modifier. Use this to identify supernatural songs, maintain rhythm under pressure, break silence effects, analyze resonance, contest another musical technique, or stabilize a failing performance when a talent calls for it. Costs: Spend CP for Qi or Spirit Music talents. Spend Stamina or Martial Focus only when a Body Refining feature, variant, or talent permits that expression. ### Core Music Rules #### Tone A Tone is the emotional and spiritual color of a Music technique. Common tones include courage, grief, calm, fury, vigilance, longing, solemnity, mockery, mourning, triumph, and clarity. A Tone is not mind control by itself. It gives the performance a direction that talents can use. #### Measure A Measure is an ongoing rhythm, chant, instrumental line, breathing cadence, footwork pattern, or heart-sound structure maintained by the cultivator. When you Keep the Measure, choose one method: voice; drum; bell; flute; zither, qin, pipa, or other stringed instrument; clapping; footwork; weapon impacts; breath rhythm; bone, armor, or body resonance; spiritual sound permitted by a feature. A Measure is the base state that lets many Music talents function. #### Phrase A Phrase is a short use of a Measure. Unless a talent says otherwise: you may use only one Phrase per round; a Phrase affects one legal target or the listed area; a Phrase ends immediately after it resolves; a Phrase cannot be used if your Measure is suppressed. #### Chord A Chord is a stronger multi-layer effect, usually a sustained performance that benefits allies, hinders enemies, or establishes a temporary battlefield order. A Chord usually requires Concentration unless the talent says otherwise. #### Dissonance A Dissonance talent disrupts another creature’s rhythm, breath, concentration, spiritual technique, emotion, or timing. Dissonance does not automatically dispel other effects. It creates penalties, interruptions, or opposed checks when specified. #### Echo Performer An Echo Performer is a temporary sound-image, resonant duplicate, instrument-spirit, bell-shadow, voice afterimage, or rhythm projection. Unless a talent states otherwise, an Echo Performer: is not a creature; cannot attack by itself; cannot create a second performance; can serve as the visible or audible origin point of one Music effect you create; disappears if damaged or if your performance ends. #### Musical Instruments and Focuses A Music cultivator may perform without a manufactured instrument if their method is voice, breath, chant, body rhythm, footwork, clapping, or weapon impact. A physical instrument may be: ordinary; crafted as a spiritual focus; bonded through an Insight; integrated into armor, weapon, bell, drum, fan, sleeve, flute, qin, pipa, gong, chime, or sect standard; used as a Formation node, Talisman medium, or Imbuement vessel when a separate feature permits. Destroying or removing an instrument can interrupt instrument-bound techniques, but it does not silence a cultivator who has another legal performance method. #### Music and Combat Noise Combat noise does not automatically prevent Music. A cultivator trained in this sphere can keep rhythm through battle. However, the GM may call for a Music Check when: thunderous noise overwhelms the performance; the performer is gagged or winded; the instrument is damaged; a hostile Sound or Music technique contests the performance; the cultivator attempts delicate music inside a storm, battlefield, collapse, or crowd. ### Base Sphere Abilities When you first learn Music, gain Keep the Measure, Opening Phrase, and Resonant Note. #### Keep the Measure Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: None Tags: Performance, Measure Begin a Music performance using one legal method. You cannot use Music talents to create Fury effects or cheerful festival effects unless the GM rules the scene transforms them into funeral rites. When a creature fails a saving throw against your Dissonance or Soul-Sound talent, you may learn whether it is Bloodied, possessed, undead, dying, or bound to one visible oath mark. Gain Immortal Funeral Bell when you meet its prerequisite. #### Soloist Scripture “A chorus dilutes the truth of one note.” You cannot affect more than one ally with the same Music talent unless the talent is a Domain, Nascent Soul talent, or Secret Inheritance. When a Music talent targets only you or one creature, increase one healing, damage, or Temporary HP value by your Proficiency Bonus. Gain Unshaken Rhythm as a bonus Insight when you meet its prerequisite. #### Voice-Sealed Scripture “My mouth is closed. The bones remember.” You cannot perform through ordinary speech, song, or verbal music. Your Music must be produced through instrument, breath, footwork, percussion, weapon impacts, armor chimes, or body resonance. You have Advantage on saving throws against effects that silence speech only, but not against full Silence effects. Gain Perfect Pitch as a bonus Insight when you meet its prerequisite. ### Path Synergies #### Body Refining - Battle Cadence Body Use Constitution as your Music key ability for Cadence, Phrase, and Battle Cadence talents you are permitted to learn. A Body Refining Music cultivator normally performs through: breath; heartbeat; footwork; weapon impacts; clapping; bells or drums strapped to the body; armor chimes; shouted chants; stance rhythm. When using Body Refining with Music: spend Stamina instead of CP only for talents that list Stamina or are explicitly permitted by a Body Refining feature; your Music range is reduced by half unless the talent is centered on you or uses a clear physical rhythm; you cannot create distant Echo Performers or Soul-Sound effects without an Insight, instrument, item, or explicit feature; while Keeping the Measure through Battle Cadence, add your Constitution modifier to Initiative; once per turn after moving at least 10 feet, add your Proficiency Bonus to one melee weapon, unarmed strike, or natural weapon damage roll. Body Refining Music is powerful when close, embodied, and audible. It is not remote spellcasting by another name. #### Qi Cultivation - Harmonic Meridian Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Music key ability. Once per turn, when you use a Music talent: reduce its CP cost by 1, minimum 1; or increase its range by 30 feet; or change one Thunder damage instance to Psychic or one Psychic damage instance to Thunder. When Resonant Note hits, you may move one ongoing Measure’s audible origin 10 feet along a visible line of sound, wind, bell vibration, instrument string, or qi resonance. #### Spirit Awakening - Soul-Resonance Art Use Wisdom as your Music key ability. Your Music talents affect the following normally when using Psychic damage, Soul-Sound, or a talent that explicitly targets them: spirits; ghosts; possessing entities; incorporeal creatures; soul-bound creatures. Once per long rest, when an ally affected by your Music talent fails a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, allow it to reroll. It must use the new result. When you use Ledger Eye, Spirit Sense, or another spiritual perception feature while Keeping the Measure, the GM may provide one emotional tone attached to a visible spirit or possession effect. ### Cultivation Insights #### Battle Musician Prerequisite: Body Refining, Music sphere, CL 4+ Your body can keep a battle measure without a delicate instrument. Gain the following benefits: use Constitution as your Music key ability for Cadence talents; use Stamina for Battle Cadence, Rhythmic Guard, Echoing Step, March of the Immortal Host, and other Music talents the GM approves as embodied cadence; maintain performances through movement, weapon impacts, breathing, or chants; when you take the Attack action while Keeping the Measure, you may use Opening Phrase once that turn without spending a Bonus Action. #### Perfect Pitch Prerequisite: Music sphere, CL 8+ Gain Advantage on checks made to: identify a voice; detect imitation; recognize supernatural sound; notice concealed listeners; break silence effects; analyze musical techniques; recognize whether a Music effect is mortal, spiritual, Formation-supported, or artifact-supported. #### Spirit Instrument Prerequisite: Music sphere, CL 8+ Choose one meaningful instrument, bell, drum, voice method, weapon-instrument, or body-rhythm focus. It becomes spiritually bound to you. You may summon it to your hand or ready it from within 1 mile as a Bonus Action, unless it is sealed by a stronger effect. It cannot be damaged by ordinary means while you are conscious. Once per short rest, add +1 to one Music Attack roll or increase your Music Save DC by +1 for one talent before the roll is made. #### Unshaken Rhythm Prerequisite: Music sphere, CL 8+ Once per long rest, when you fail a Concentration saving throw for a Music talent, succeed instead. When you use this benefit, you may also immediately use Opening Phrase on yourself without spending an action. #### Ensemble Leader Prerequisite: Music sphere, Shared Measure, CL 8+ When you use Shared Measure, choose one additional willing creature. Once per round while Shared Measure is active, when an affected creature misses with an attack, another affected creature may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. #### Resonance Breaker Prerequisite: Music sphere, Disruptive Harmony or Silence-Breaking Note, CL 10+ When you succeed on a Music Check to suppress, disrupt, or identify a Sound, Music, War, Formation, or Spirit effect, gain one benefit: regain 1 CP; regain Martial Focus; grant one ally within 30 feet Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; impose Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw made by the disrupted creature before the start of your next turn. Use Resonance Breaker once per short rest. #### Heartstring Physician Prerequisite: Music sphere, Healing Hymn, CL 10+ When a creature receives healing from your Healing Hymn, choose one: it ends one nonmagical Frightened effect; it gains Advantage on the next death saving throw before the end of its next turn; it reduces its Exhaustion penalty for one roll before the end of its next turn, but does not remove Exhaustion; it gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature can benefit from Heartstring Physician only once per short rest. #### Bell-and-Formation Custodian Prerequisite: Music sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation, ritual hall, bell tower, drum terrace, concert court, funeral rite, or morale project, use one Music principle you know as a seed concept. Appropriate principles include: Measure; Tone; Chord; Dissonance; Echo Performer; Battle Cadence; Soul-Sound; Silence-Breaking Note. This does not create the project automatically. The project still requires time, materials, site access, appropriate spiritual power, and maintenance. #### Song-Soul Oathbearer Prerequisite: Spirit Awakening, Music sphere, CL 10+ When you use a Music talent with the Soul-Sound tag on a willing ally, that ally may choose to reveal one oath, fear, grief, vow, or emotional burden to you through symbolic sound. If it does, choose one: it gains Advantage on one saving throw against Frightened before the end of its next turn; it gains Temporary HP equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus; you gain Advantage on your next Wisdom check to understand or negotiate with that ally before the end of the scene. This does not force confession and cannot read hidden thoughts from unwilling creatures.
