spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of The Piercing Needle Qi Expression: Primary — Needle Qi; Supporting — Metal Qi, Precision Qi, Meridian Qi, Poison Qi. Sphere Type: Martial / Precision / Duelist Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, or Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus for fencing and precision techniques; CP or Stamina only when a talent, Path expression, or meridian-point technique says so Core Chassis: Feints, precision attacks, tactical openings, footwork, disarming, binds, parries, ripostes, meridian-point strikes “A sword may win a battle through strength. A needle wins the duel by finding the place where strength cannot answer.” Common Name: Fencing Sphere Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Feints, precision attacks, tactical openings, footwork, disarming, weapon binds, parries, ripostes, draw cuts, and meridian-point strikes The Sphere of the Piercing Needle teaches fencing as the art of creating and exploiting openings. A practitioner wins through measure, footwork, feints, and precise attacks rather than brute force. Some schools use narrow blades. Others use sabers, spears, unarmed strikes, or spell attacks. The defining principle is the same: draw out the enemy’s answer, then strike the place their answer exposed. #### USING THE PIERCING NEEDLE WITH 5.5E RULES The Piercing Needle adds to the ordinary 5.5e rules. Except where a feature below explicitly says otherwise, use the normal rules for Actions, Bonus Actions, Reactions, Opportunity Attacks, attack rolls, Advantage, Disadvantage, the Help action, movement, Grapples, conditions, weapons, Unarmed Strikes, spell attacks, and equipping or unequipping weapons. The Piercing Needle does not automatically grant: proficiency with a weapon; a Weapon Mastery property; a Fighting Style feat; an additional Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction; Sneak Attack or any other class feature; the ability to ignore a creature’s Resistance or Immunity; permission to apply a talent to an attack that does not satisfy that talent’s requirements. ##### Help: Assist an Attack Roll Under the ordinary 5.5e Help action, you may momentarily distract an enemy within 5 feet of you. The next attack roll made by one of your allies against that enemy has Advantage. This benefit expires at the start of your next turn. The Feint ability below expands this use of Help. #### MARTIAL FOCUS The Piercing Needle uses Martial Focus. You may hold one Martial Focus at a time. Some talents expend Martial Focus. Expending Martial Focus is not an Action. You cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it. If a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is currently absent. Martial Focus is a state of physical readiness, breath, posture, and intent. It is not CP. #### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES ##### Fatal Thrust When you make a melee attack roll with Advantage, including a melee spell attack, you may reroll one of the two d20s once. You must use the new roll. Fatal Thrust does not stack with another feature that allows you to roll or reroll an additional d20 as part of resolving Advantage on the same attack roll. ##### Feint When you take the Help action to use Assist an Attack Roll against an enemy within 5 feet of you, you may aid yourself instead of an ally. If you aid yourself, the next attack roll you make against that enemy has Advantage. This benefit expires at the end of your next turn. Whenever you use Help to grant Advantage on an attack roll against an enemy, whether you aid yourself or an ally, you perform a Feint against that enemy. A Feint does not require a weapon unless a talent explicitly says otherwise. ##### Exploits Some Piercing Needle talents have the Exploit tag. An Exploit changes the effect of a precise attack. Once per round, when you hit a creature with a melee attack, you may apply one Exploit talent you know if either of the following is true: the attack roll had Advantage; or the attack roll did not have Disadvantage, and at least one of your allies is within 5 feet of the target and does not have the Incapacitated condition. Unless a talent explicitly says otherwise: choose the Exploit after the attack hits; apply no more than one Exploit to that attack; apply no more than one Exploit during the same round; an Exploit does not increase the attack’s damage unless its text says it does; an Exploit does not make an otherwise illegal target valid; a creature is immune to an anatomical Exploit if it lacks the required anatomy. ##### Disarming Technique When you would make a melee weapon attack with a weapon or an Unarmed Strike, you may replace that attack with a Disarm attempt against one object held by the target. Make an attack roll using the weapon or Unarmed Strike. The target contests that roll with a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, choosing which check to use. You have Disadvantage on the attack roll if the target holds the object with two or more hands. The target has Advantage on its check if it is larger than you. The target has Disadvantage on its check if it is smaller than you. If your attack roll exceeds the target’s check, the target drops the object in its space. The attempt deals no damage and applies no other effect unless a talent explicitly says otherwise. A Disarm attempt is not a Grapple or Shove. It does not automatically let you catch, move, break, or use the dropped object. ## Core Piercing Needle Rules This v1.10.5 section is a parsing map, not an additional feature grant. It names the rules below that should be treated as the sphere's base package during character creation, dashboard import, Roll20 export, and combat simulation. - Use the Piercing Needle with 5.5e Rules is the sphere's main rules baseline. - Martial Focus is the default resource for ordinary fencing and precision methods. - Base Sphere Abilities are the legal base package for character sheets. - Piercing Needle talents create openings through measure, feints, exact strikes, binds, parries, ripostes, and meridian-point pressure. - Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening expressions must still pay CP and obey targeting when a talent becomes supernatural. #### PIERCING NEEDLE TALENT TAGS ##### Exploit Talents An Exploit talent modifies one precise attack that satisfies the Exploit rules. ##### Feint Talents A Feint talent improves the Help action, your ability to create openings, or the benefits of attacking a creature you have Feinted. ##### Footwork Talents A Footwork talent improves movement, positioning, reach, or your ability to avoid retaliation. ##### Guard Talents A Guard talent improves parries, ripostes, disarming, or weapon binds. ##### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents fencing technique beyond ordinary martial training. #### MORTAL REALM PIERCING NEEDLE TALENTS ##### Ankle Strike - Exploit The target must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The target has the Prone condition. Successful Save: No effect. A creature that cannot be knocked Prone is immune to Ankle Strike. ##### Arm Strike - Exploit Choose one arm, forelimb, tentacle, or comparable limb used by the target to attack, hold an object, or manipulate its surroundings. For a number of rounds equal to your Proficiency Bonus, the target takes a -2 penalty to: attack rolls made with a weapon, natural weapon, or object held or controlled primarily by that limb; and Strength and Dexterity ability checks that rely primarily on that limb. If the affected limb is required to wield a Two-Handed weapon, the penalty applies to attacks made with that weapon. Multiple uses of Arm Strike do not stack against the same limb. A creature without a suitable limb is immune to this Exploit. ##### Chest Strike - Exploit The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The target has the Poisoned condition until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No effect. A creature without a vulnerable chest, core, or comparable center of breath is immune to Chest Strike. ##### Distracting Blades - Exploit Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot make Opportunity Attacks. ##### Face Strike - Exploit Cost: Expend Martial Focus. The target must make a Dexterity saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The target has the Blinded condition for 1 minute. Successful Save: No effect. The target or a creature within its reach may take the Utilize action to wipe away blood, dust, or another obstruction and end the effect early. A creature that does not rely on a vulnerable face, eyes, or comparable organs to see is immune to Face Strike. ##### Leg Slash - Exploit Until the start of your next turn, each of the target’s Speeds is halved. A creature without a vulnerable limb, joint, or comparable means of movement is immune to Leg Slash. ##### Repositioning Strike - Exploit If the target is no more than one size larger than you, move it up to 5 feet to an unoccupied space within your reach. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. ##### To the Hilt - Exploit Cost: Expend Martial Focus. For a number of rounds equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded up, the target loses Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. To the Hilt does not suppress Immunity. ##### Wide Open - Exploit Choose one ally other than yourself. The next attack roll that ally makes against the target has Advantage. This benefit expires at the start of your next turn. ##### Bind Weapon - Guard When you win a Disarm attempt, you may bind the target’s object to your weapon instead of causing the target to drop it. You may also bind a hand, natural weapon, or comparable attacking limb as though it were a held object. While the bind lasts: the target has the Grappled condition; the bound object or limb cannot be used to make attacks; you must remain within the reach of the weapon or Unarmed Strike used to establish the bind; you cannot use the weapon or limb maintaining the bind to make attacks; the bind ends if you become Incapacitated, release it at any time with no Action required, or move beyond the permitted reach. If an object is bound, the target may release that object at any time with no Action required, ending the bind. Otherwise, the target may use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the bind on a success. Bind Weapon is a special form of Grapple. It does not require a free hand unless the weapon or Unarmed Strike used to establish the bind requires one. ##### Expert Feint - Feint You may perform a Feint as a Bonus Action instead of taking the Help action. ##### Fatal Opening - Feint When you make an attack roll with Advantage granted by your own Feint, your attack scores a Critical Hit on a roll of 19 or 20. ##### Fencing Focus - Feint After you perform a Feint against a valid enemy or win a Disarm attempt, you may use a Bonus Action to regain Martial Focus. ##### Footwork - Footwork Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Move up to 10 feet. This movement: requires no Action or Reaction; may occur even when it is not your turn; does not provoke Opportunity Attacks; must end in a legal unoccupied space you can reach. You may use Footwork after an attack is declared against you but before its attack roll is made. If you do, the triggering attack roll has Disadvantage. If your movement makes you an illegal target for the triggering attack, the attack misses instead. You may also use Footwork after an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw includes you as a target but before you make the saving throw. If your movement does not remove you from the effect, you have Advantage on the Dexterity saving throw. ##### Greater Feint - Feint When you perform a Feint against an enemy, you may expend Martial Focus. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The first attack roll made by each creature against the target has Advantage. This benefit expires at the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Your Feint functions normally. ##### Group Cover - Footwork When a hostile creature makes an attack roll against you, each other hostile creature adjacent to the attacker has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you until the start of your next turn. ##### Lunge - Footwork While holding Martial Focus, you may increase your reach for melee attacks by 5 feet until the end of the current turn. If you use Lunge, take a -2 penalty to attack rolls against targets within 5 feet of you until the start of your next turn. Lunge does not increase your reach for Opportunity Attacks unless another feature explicitly says otherwise. ##### Parry and Riposte - Guard Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature hits you with a melee attack Cost: Expend Martial Focus Choose one melee weapon you wield or your Unarmed Strike. Roll the normal damage of that attack form and reduce the triggering attack’s damage by the amount rolled. For this damage roll, include: the normal weapon or Unarmed Strike damage dice; the ability modifier you would normally add to the attack’s damage; and a magic weapon’s ordinary bonus to damage, if applicable. Do not include extra damage dice or effects that require a hit, a Critical Hit, a resource expenditure, or a separate trigger. If you use an Unarmed Strike that has no damage die, reduce the triggering damage by 1 + the ability modifier you would normally add to the Unarmed Strike instead of rolling. The reduction cannot be less than 0. If you reduce the triggering attack’s damage to 0, immediately make one melee attack against the attacker if it is within your reach. You may apply one Exploit talent to this attack if the attack roll does not have Disadvantage, even if the attack would not otherwise satisfy the normal Exploit requirements. ##### Read Foe Gain proficiency in Insight. If you already have proficiency in Insight, gain Expertise in Insight instead. You may take this talent twice. If you already have Expertise in Insight, you cannot take this talent again. ##### Skewer - Exploit When you apply an Exploit to an attack, you may expend Martial Focus to apply two different Exploits you know to that attack instead of one. Both Exploits must legally affect the target. ##### Traitorous Blade - Guard When you win a Disarm attempt, you may immediately catch the disarmed object if: you have at least one free hand; the object can be held in that hand; and the object is not physically attached to the target. After catching the object, you may use a Bonus Action to make one attack with it if you can legally do so. #### FOUNDATION REALM PIERCING NEEDLE TALENTS - CL 5+ ##### Parry Anything - Guard Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Parry and Riposte, CL 5+ You may use Parry and Riposte when a ranged weapon attack or ranged spell attack hits you. You may make the retaliatory attack only if the attacker is within the legal reach or range of the attack form you use for the riposte. Parry Anything does not reduce damage from an effect that does not hit you with an attack roll. ##### Vacuum Cut - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 5+ When you take the Attack action and make a melee weapon attack during the same turn that you draw or otherwise equip the weapon used for that attack, you may expend Martial Focus to extend that attack’s reach to 30 feet. Vacuum Cut: changes the reach of that single melee weapon attack; does not turn the attack into a ranged attack; does not allow the attack to pass through Total Cover; does not automatically allow the attack to target a creature you cannot perceive; may receive an Exploit if it otherwise satisfies the Exploit rules. ##### Crane-Wing Advance - Footwork Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Footwork, CL 5+ When you use Footwork, move up to 15 feet instead of 10 feet. If you end this movement within 5 feet of a creature, your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature for the rest of the current turn. ##### Returning Point - Footwork Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 5+ Once per turn, after you apply an Exploit to a creature, move up to 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can reach. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature. ##### Needle-Catching Reversal - Guard Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Parry and Riposte, CL 5+ When Parry and Riposte reduces the triggering attack’s damage to 0, regain Martial Focus after resolving the retaliatory attack. ##### Three-Step Feint - Feint Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Expert Feint, CL 5+ When you perform a Feint as a Bonus Action, choose up to two enemies within 5 feet of you instead of one. Resolve the Feint separately against each chosen enemy. If another talent requires a saving throw, each chosen enemy makes its own saving throw. #### CORE FORMATION REALM PIERCING NEEDLE TALENTS - CL 10+ ##### Court of Measured Openings - Martial Domain “Within the court, every raised guard casts a shadow. Every shadow is a road for the needle.” Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Short Rest For the duration, gain the following benefits: you may perform one Feint during each of your turns with no Action required; when a hostile creature within your melee reach misses you with an attack, you may perform a Feint against that creature with no Action required; when you apply an Exploit, you may apply two different Exploits you know instead of one without expending Martial Focus; once per round when you use Footwork, regain Martial Focus after completing the movement. Court of Measured Openings ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition. A no-Action Feint still follows the normal Feint rules. It does not grant an additional attack by itself. ##### Shadow Strike - Exploit Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 10+ Your attack cuts through the target’s vitality and casts a wound into its essence. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The target gains 1 temporary Exhaustion level for a number of rounds equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Successful Save: No effect. A temporary Exhaustion level from Shadow Strike: uses the ordinary effects of Exhaustion; ends automatically when its duration expires; stacks with ordinary Exhaustion; does not stack with another temporary Exhaustion level from Shadow Strike. A later failed save refreshes the duration instead. Shadow Strike is a magical effect. ##### Soul Strike - Exploit Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 10+ Cost: Expend Martial Focus Your attack targets the enemy’s psyche and spiritual rhythm. The target must make a Wisdom saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The target takes a -2 penalty to saving throws for a number of rounds equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Successful Save: No effect. Multiple uses of Soul Strike do not stack. A later failed save refreshes the duration. Soul Strike is a magical effect. ##### Vacuum Slice - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Vacuum Cut, CL 11+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row When you use Vacuum Cut, you may use a Bonus Action to replace the single-target attack with a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line originating from you. Make one attack roll and compare the result to the Armor Class of each creature in the line. Each creature hit takes the normal damage of the melee weapon attack. Vacuum Slice: deals damage only once to each creature in the line; deals only the attack’s normal damage; does not apply Exploits, Weapon Mastery properties, or other on-hit riders; does not pass through Total Cover. ##### Bleed Air - Exploit Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 11+ Cost: Expend Martial Focus If the target is below its Hit Point maximum, twist your strike through a lung or comparable organ of breath. The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: Roll 1d4. After that many rounds, the target begins choking. While choking, it follows the ordinary 5.5e Suffocation hazard. Successful Save: No effect. The effect ends before choking begins if the target is restored to its Hit Point maximum. After choking begins, the effect ends if any of the following occurs: the target is restored to its Hit Point maximum; the target gains an effect that allows it to breathe without the injured organ; a creature within reach of the target takes the Utilize action and succeeds on a Wisdom (Medicine) check against your Cultivation Save DC. A creature that does not need to breathe or lacks a comparable vulnerable organ is immune to Bleed Air. ##### Meridian-Sealing Bind - Guard Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Bind Weapon, CL 10+ When a creature fails to escape your Bind Weapon, choose one of the following effects until the bind ends: the creature cannot take Reactions; the creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than you; each foot of the creature’s movement costs 1 extra foot. Choose a new effect each time the creature fails an escape attempt. #### NASCENT SOUL REALM PIERCING NEEDLE TALENTS - CL 15+ ##### Sovereign Needle Incarnation - Sovereign Form “The body no longer follows the blade. The blade no longer follows the thought. All three arrive at the opening together.” Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Long Rest For the duration, gain the following benefits: attacks you make count as magical for the purpose of overcoming Resistance or Immunity to nonmagical attacks and damage; when you use Fatal Thrust, you may reroll either or both of the two d20s once, and you must use the new rolls; you may apply an Exploit up to twice per round instead of once per round, but no more than once to the same attack unless another rule permits it; once per round, you may use Footwork without expending Martial Focus; when you win a Disarm attempt or reduce an attack’s damage to 0 with Parry and Riposte, regain Martial Focus. Sovereign Needle Incarnation ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition. ##### Needle Through Ten Thousand Guards - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Move up to your Speed. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. During this movement, choose a number of hostile creatures no greater than your Proficiency Bonus. Each chosen creature must come within your melee reach at some point during the movement. Make one melee attack against each chosen creature. Each attack has Advantage. You may apply one different Exploit you know to each successful attack without counting those Exploits against your normal once-per-round limit. You cannot apply more than one Exploit to the same attack through this talent. Needle Through Ten Thousand Guards does not allow you to move through occupied spaces or end your movement in an illegal destination. ##### Heart-Stopping Reversal - Guard Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Parry and Riposte, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: Damage from a creature you can perceive would reduce you to 0 Hit Points Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Drop to 1 Hit Point instead. If the triggering creature is within the legal reach or range of an attack you can make, immediately make one attack against it. On a hit, apply one Exploit you know without counting that Exploit against your normal once-per-round limit. The Exploit must legally affect the target. Heart-Stopping Reversal prevents only the reduction to 0 Hit Points. It does not automatically prevent a condition, forced movement, damage to another creature, or another consequence of the triggering effect. ##### No Space Between Thought and Steel - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Vacuum Cut, CL 15+ When you use Vacuum Cut, increase its reach from 30 feet to 60 feet. Once per turn, when you use Vacuum Cut, you may draw or otherwise equip the required weapon as part of making the attack even if you already equipped or unequipped a weapon during the same Attack action. This talent does not allow Vacuum Cut to pass through Total Cover or strike a target you cannot otherwise perceive. ##### Empty Hand, Open Meridian - Exploit Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 15+ Cost: Expend Martial Focus The target must make a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, the target cannot regain Hit Points, and it cannot regain CP or another cultivation resource. Successful Save: The target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. Empty Hand, Open Meridian is a magical effect. It does not remove Temporary HP or resources the target already possesses. #### SECRET PIERCING NEEDLE INHERITANCE ##### The One Opening Beneath Heaven “Every defense protects something. Therefore every defense abandons something else.” Classification: Secret Piercing Needle Inheritance Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Sovereign Needle Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden needle scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. End this movement with one creature, object, Barrier, or structure section within the reach of a melee attack you can make. Make one melee attack against the target with Advantage. Fatal Thrust may apply normally. This attack does not receive a Weapon Mastery property. If it hits, resolve its normal damage and then apply the appropriate effect below. If the attack form has no normal damage die, treat its normal damage die as d1 when calculating this inheritance’s additional damage. ##### Creature The target takes additional damage equal to twelve rolls of the attack’s normal damage die. This additional damage uses one damage type normally dealt by the attack, chosen when you use the inheritance. Then choose three consequences: the target cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn; each of the target’s Speeds becomes 0 until the end of your next turn; the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the end of your next turn; the target loses Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage until the end of your next turn; end one Stance, Guard, Domain, or comparable temporary martial effect affecting the target, subject to GM approval; apply one Exploit talent you know that can legally affect the target without expending Martial Focus or counting against your Exploit limit; move the target up to 20 feet along the ground if it is Huge or smaller. A creature cannot be affected by the same consequence more than once from a single use of this inheritance. ##### Object, Barrier, or Structure The target takes additional damage equal to eighteen rolls of the attack’s normal damage die. This additional damage ignores ordinary damage thresholds and ordinary Resistance to the chosen damage type. The One Opening Beneath Heaven does not automatically destroy: artifacts; Formation cores; Realm-defining Barriers; Domains; Secret Inheritances; major structures protected by a superior narrative or cultivation-scale effect. ##### Miss If the attack misses, you complete the movement but deal no damage and apply no consequences. #### OPTIONAL PIERCING NEEDLE VARIANT ##### Imprecise Blade Some practitioners learn to create openings through adaptability rather than perfect thrust geometry. When you learn this variant: you do not gain Fatal Thrust; and gain one Mortal-realm Exploit talent of your choice as a bonus talent. Impure or unconventional weapon schools often use Imprecise Blade, but the variant does not change which attacks can receive Exploits. #### PATH SYNERGIES ##### Body Refining - Tendon-Reading Footwork Use Constitution for Piercing Needle Cultivation Save DCs. Once per turn, when you use Footwork or Returning Point, gain a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. ##### Qi Cultivation - Needle-Qi Extension Use Intelligence or Charisma for Piercing Needle Cultivation Save DCs, chosen according to your Qi Cultivation key ability. Once per turn, when you expend Martial Focus on a Piercing Needle talent, choose one melee attack you make before the end of the current turn. That attack may deal Force damage instead of its normal damage type. This does not change whether the attack is melee or ranged, alter its reach, or grant an additional effect. ##### Spirit Awakening - Read the Unspoken Guard Use Wisdom for Piercing Needle Cultivation Save DCs. Once per turn, when a creature you Feinted makes an attack roll before the start of your next turn, you may move up to 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can reach. This movement requires no Action or Reaction and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature. #### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS ##### Empty-Hand Needle Form Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, an approved unarmed or natural-weapon discipline, CL 4+ Choose one Unarmed Strike, natural weapon, or explicitly approved body weapon. For Piercing Needle sphere requirements, treat that attack form as a melee weapon you wield. Empty-Hand Needle Form does not: grant a natural weapon if you do not already possess one; change the attack’s ordinary damage or damage type; make the attack a held object; create a free hand; grant proficiency with an unrelated weapon. ##### Breath Before Steel Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 8+ Once per Short Rest, when you would expend Martial Focus on a Piercing Needle talent, retain Martial Focus instead. ##### Needle-School Instructor Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, CL 6+ When training allies during downtime, you may use one Piercing Needle talent you know as the seed concept for a fencing drill, dueling scripture, school exercise, or Formation-assisted training project. This does not automatically grant a talent to another creature or create a permanent project. The final result still requires appropriate time, instruction, materials, and GM approval. ##### Stillness Before the Draw Prerequisite: Piercing Needle sphere, Vacuum Cut, CL 10+ When Initiative is rolled and you are not Surprised, you may draw or otherwise equip one melee weapon and regain Martial Focus. If you already hold Martial Focus, you retain it normally. You cannot hold more than one Martial Focus.

#### Deliver the Dose
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet, or weapon range if delivered through a weapon
Target: One creature or object
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: None
You deliver venom, toxic qi, corrosive fluid, a poisoned needle, mineral dust, spirit spores, toxic breath, or a coated strike.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. If you deliver the dose through a weapon attack, make the weapon attack normally instead.
On a hit, the target takes Poison or Acid damage, chosen when you attack.
Mortal: 1d8Foundation: 2d8Core Formation: 3d8Nascent Soul: 4d8
Once per turn when you hit a creature with Deliver the Dose, the target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The target gains 1 Dose Mark and has Disadvantage on its next ability check before the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: The target does not gain a Dose Mark.
Deliver the Dose cannot place Dose Marks on creatures immune to the delivery method, damage type, or Poison sphere effect used.

#### Ingrain the Toxin
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action

Cost: 2 CP
You spend 2 Dose Marks on the target and attempt to lodge a minor lingering toxin into the body, meridian flow, breath, or spirit.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one Minor Ingrained Toxin effect:
Bitter Breath. The target has Disadvantage on its next Constitution saving throw before its next long rest.
Numb Channels. The target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until its next long rest.
Sour Blood. The next healing the target receives before its next long rest is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
Clouded Senses. The target has Disadvantage on its next Wisdom (Perception) check before its next long rest.
Heavy Pulse. The target cannot benefit from the Dash action on its next turn, and has Disadvantage on its next Dexterity saving throw before its next long rest.
Successful Save: The Dose Marks are spent, but no Ingrained Toxin takes hold.
A Minor Ingrained Toxin is intentionally limited. Serious long-term poison requires Foundation, Core Formation, or Nascent Soul talents.
A creature can identify or treat a Minor Ingrained Toxin with appropriate Medicine, Alchemy, Life, Poison, or purification methods. The treatment DC equals your Cultivation Save DC.
