spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Puppetry Qi Expression: Primary — Puppet Qi; Supporting — Thread Qi, Spirit Qi, Wood/Mechanism Qi, Control Qi. “The fool thinks the puppet is false because wood has no will. The puppeteer knows the body was never the only thing that could obey a motion.” Sphere Type: Cultivation Sphere Rules Baseline: 2024 fifth-edition rules (5.5e) Primary Paths: Spirit Awakening and Qi Cultivation Secondary Paths: Body Refining, Blacksmith, Metal, Verdant Growth, Illusion, Shadow Resource: Cultivation Points, unless a talent says otherwise Common Effects: puppet vessels, control threads, joint-catching, object animation, substitute bodies, remote handling, thread traps, decoy bodies, ritual puppet theaters, corpse-puppet taboos, soul-thread warnings ## Puppetry Dao Puppetry is the cultivation of borrowed motion. A novice believes a puppet is a false body. An adept understands that every body is a set of joints, weights, impulses, and permissions. A puppet is simply the body that admits this openly. The Puppetry cultivator does not merely summon a servant. They create an arrangement of obedience. A vessel is chosen. A thread is set. Motion is loaned. The resulting movement leaves tension behind, and that tension becomes the cultivator’s real weapon. Puppetry governs: animated vessels; control threads; joint-catching and limb-binding; substitute bodies; remote handling; hidden hands; battlefield stagecraft; puppet screens and decoy bodies; mechanical, wooden, cloth, bone, jade, paper, shadow, or spirit-thread puppets; the forbidden question of whether a corpse, soul, or living body can be treated as a vessel. Puppetry is not the art of making people love you, think what you want, or become loyal servants. Puppetry is the art of making a motion pass through a chosen body. ### Sphere Sentence Puppetry cultivators claim a vessel, set a control thread, place tension where motion catches, and spend that tension to move, guard, bind, misdirect, or act through the vessel. ## Sphere Boundaries ### Puppetry and Conjuration | Sphere | Primary Theme | | --- | --- | | Puppetry | Uses a vessel, thread, and direction to borrow motion through a body or object | | Conjuration | Calls or manifests an independent companion, spirit, creature, or summoned entity | | Puppetry + Conjuration | Spirit-puppets, summoned puppet actors, contract-bound marionettes | A puppet vessel is not automatically an independent creature. It does not take turns or make decisions unless a talent says it can. ### Puppetry and Mind | Sphere | Primary Theme | | --- | --- | | Puppetry | Catches joints, posture, bodies, tools, and visible action through threads | | Mind | Directly influences thought, emotion, memory, choice, or perception | | Puppetry + Mind | Compulsion strings, role obedience, hypnotic marionettes | Puppetry does not automatically override a creature’s will. If a talent forces movement, restricts a limb, or makes a creature act, it states the saving throw and limits explicitly. ### Puppetry and Blacksmith | Sphere | Primary Theme | | --- | --- | | Puppetry | Animates, directs, sacrifices, and controls vessels during play | | Blacksmith | Repairs, forges, tempers, awakens, and permanently improves items or workpieces | | Puppetry + Blacksmith | Masterwork puppets, artifact marionettes, weaponized puppet bodies | Puppetry can use a puppet body. Blacksmith makes the body better. ### Puppetry and Spirit Awakening Spirit Awakening can see intent, soul pressure, and spiritual residue. Puppetry can set control lines and substitute bodies. A Spirit-puppeteer may eventually bind echoes, ancestral gestures, or soul-thread imprints, but Puppetry does not automatically enslave souls. ### Puppetry and Body Refining Body Refining Puppetry begins with the cultivator’s own body, armor, held objects, physical cords, touch, and self-marionette methods. A Body Refiner does not automatically project invisible control threads at range unless a talent, Insight, forged technique, Realm evolution, or GM-granted breakthrough explicitly allows it. This mirrors the Tianxia assumption that Body Refiners do not freely use external Qi projection by default. ## Core Puppetry Rules ### 2024 Fifth-Edition Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline. Puppetry talents supplement the normal rules for: Action; Bonus Action; Reaction; Opportunity Attacks; Cover; Objects; Grappled; Restrained; Prone; Concentration; the Magic action; the Utilize action; the Help action; mounted and carried objects where relevant. A Puppetry talent replaces a normal rule only when it explicitly says so. ### Puppetry Key Ability Use your Path key ability for Puppetry unless a Path synergy, Insight, or feature says otherwise. If a Puppetry rule calls for a saving throw, use your Cultivation Save DC. If a Puppetry rule calls for an attack roll, use your Cultivation Attack Modifier. ### Puppet Vessels A Puppet Vessel is an object, prepared doll, articulated frame, puppet limb, paper figure, wooden body, jade automaton shell, corpse-puppet vessel, shadow effigy, armor-rig, or other suitable medium that a Puppetry technique can move. A vessel is not automatically a creature. Unless a talent says otherwise: a puppet vessel is an object; it does not breathe, think, speak, concentrate, attune, or take independent turns; it cannot take Actions except when you direct it; it cannot use class features, sphere talents, spells, magic items, or Cultivation Insights; it cannot provide flanking or count as an ally unless a talent says it does; it can occupy a space, but creatures can move through its space as difficult terrain unless it is at least their size and a talent lets it block movement; it cannot grapple, shove, disarm, or restrain unless a talent says it can; it is visibly or spiritually connected to your technique unless a talent says the threads are hidden. #### Vessel Size A basic puppet vessel may be Tiny, Small, or Medium. A Tiny vessel can fit in one hand or perch on your body. A Small or Medium vessel occupies its own space. A puppet vessel larger than Medium requires a talent, forged technique, special construction, Formation, or GM permission. #### Vessel Statistics Unless a specific vessel has better object statistics, use the following default statistics for an active puppet vessel: | CL | AC | Hit Points | Speed | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 13 | 10 + twice your CL | 25 feet | | 5-10 | 14 | 15 + three times your CL | 30 feet | | 11-16 | 15 | 20 + four times your CL | 30 feet | | 17+ | 16 | 25 + five times your CL | 35 feet | The vessel uses your saving throw bonus for Dexterity and Strength saves when directly controlled by you. If reduced to 0 Hit Points, the vessel is broken and the active effect on that vessel ends. Repairing a broken vessel normally requires tools, materials, time, a Blacksmith talent, Mending, or a similar feature. ### Control Threads A Control Thread is the visible, invisible, spiritual, Qi, physical, shadow, blood, wire, silk, hair, or intent-line that carries your command. Unless a talent says otherwise: your control range is 60 feet; you must have line of effect to a puppet vessel you control; a control thread ends if the vessel is outside your control range at the end of your turn; you may control one active puppet vessel at a time; you know the direction of your active vessel while the thread remains; a creature that can see spiritual effects, Qi flows, magic, invisible objects, or the relevant material thread may identify the vessel as controlled. #### Body Refining Limitation A Body Refining Puppetry cultivator may use physical cords, armor rigs, held puppets, body-thread methods, and touch-based control normally. Remote control threads that are not physically connected, visible through the body, or maintained by touch are Projected Puppetry. A Body Refiner does not gain Projected Puppetry by default. ### Tension Marks A Tension Mark is a Puppetry-specific mark showing that a thread has caught a joint, weapon, sleeve, stance, command rhythm, or vulnerable point of motion. A creature, object, or puppet vessel can have only one Tension Mark from you at a time unless a talent says otherwise. A Tension Mark lasts until the end of your next turn. You may spend a Tension Mark only if the marked target is within your control range and you have an active control thread. A Tension Mark is not a condition. ### Tension Responses A Tension Response spends a Tension Mark to create a defined result. Unless a talent says otherwise: use only one Tension Response per turn; a Tension Response does not require an Action, unless it says it does; forced movement from Puppetry does not provoke Opportunity Attacks; a creature cannot be moved into obviously lethal terrain unless a talent explicitly allows it and the GM permits the positioning; a target at least two sizes larger than your puppet vessel has Advantage on saving throws against being moved or knocked Prone by Puppetry. #### Basic Tension Responses When you spend a Tension Mark, choose one response you know. You know the following basic responses when you learn Puppetry. ##### Tug the Joint Move the marked creature 5 feet to an unoccupied space you can see. The movement must be horizontal and cannot move the creature into the air. A creature may resist with a Strength saving throw. On a success, it is not moved. ##### Cross the Limb The marked creature has Disadvantage on the next weapon attack roll, unarmed strike, or Dexterity ability check it makes before the end of its next turn. After that roll, the mark is spent. ##### Guarding Vessel Choose one creature within 5 feet of your puppet vessel. That creature gains +2 AC against the next attack roll made against it before the start of your next turn. ##### False Hand Your puppet vessel takes the Help action to assist one creature within 5 feet of it. ##### Snap the Thread The marked target takes 1d6 Force damage or the damage type dealt by the puppet vessel’s last Puppetry attack. This damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17. ## Base Sphere Abilities ### Puppet Initiation When you learn Puppetry: gain proficiency with Woodcarver’s Tools, Weaver’s Tools, Smith’s Tools, Tinker’s Tools, Calligrapher’s Supplies, or Sleight of Hand; if already proficient with your chosen option, choose one Puppetry talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; create or designate one basic puppet vessel during a long rest; learn Raise the Vessel, Puppet Strike, and the basic Tension Responses. ### Raise the Vessel Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet, or touch for Body Refining unless using Projected Puppetry Duration: 1 minute Cost: 1 CP Target: One suitable puppet vessel You claim one puppet vessel and set a control thread to it. The vessel becomes active for the duration. When you activate the vessel, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you may move it up to its Speed. This movement may include climbing, crawling, hopping, rolling, skittering, or walking as appropriate for its form. The vessel cannot fly, swim, burrow, squeeze through impossible spaces, or climb smooth surfaces unless a talent, construction, or feature allows it. You may dismiss the vessel on your turn without an Action. If you raise a second vessel, the first vessel becomes inactive unless a talent allows you to control more than one. ### Puppet Strike Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Your control range Target: One creature within 5 feet of your active puppet vessel Cost: 0 CP Make a Puppetry attack roll from the puppet vessel’s space. On a hit, the target takes: 1d8 + your Puppetry key ability modifier Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, chosen when you designate the vessel’s form. The damage increases to 2d8 at CL 5, 3d8 at CL 11, and 4d8 at CL 17. On a hit, the target gains a Tension Mark. Puppet Strike is not a weapon attack unless a talent explicitly makes it one. ### Thread the Object Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet, or touch for Body Refining unless using Projected Puppetry Duration: Instantaneous or until the end of your next turn Cost: 0 CP You manipulate one unattended object no heavier than 10 pounds within range. You may open or close a simple door, pull a lever, pick up an object, move an object up to 10 feet, knock over a Tiny object, tug a sleeve, ring a bell, or perform a similar simple manipulation. Thread the Object cannot attack, activate magic items, make tool checks, pick locks, disarm traps, or perform complex craft unless a talent says otherwise. ## Puppetry Talent Tags ### Vessel Talents A Vessel talent improves what puppet vessels can be, survive, carry, or do. ### Thread Talents A Thread talent changes range, concealment, object control, or how control lines behave. ### Tension Talents A Tension talent adds new ways to apply or spend Tension Marks. ### Substitute Talents A Substitute talent lets a puppet absorb danger, act in your place, or mislead targeting. ### Forbidden Talents A Forbidden talent interacts with corpses, living bodies, souls, or coercive control. Forbidden talents require GM permission. ### Projected Talents A Projected talent allows remote external control that is not based on touch, carried vessels, physical cords, or Body Refining contact logic. Body Refiners need explicit permission to use Projected talents. ## Mortal Realm Puppetry Talents ### Ironwood Practice Body - Vessel Your basic puppet vessel gains one of the following constructions when you designate it after a long rest: Guard Body: +2 AC. Running Body: +10 feet Speed. Needle Body: Puppet Strike may deal Piercing damage and its range from the vessel increases to 10 feet. Heavy Body: advantage on saving throws against forced movement, but Speed decreases by 5 feet. Tool Body: the vessel can hold and use one mundane tool as part of Thread the Object. You may choose a different construction after a long rest. ### Hidden Thread - Thread Your control threads are difficult to notice. A creature must succeed on an Intelligence (Investigation), Wisdom (Perception), or appropriate cultivation check against your Cultivation Save DC to identify the thread without special senses. A creature that can see invisible objects, spiritual residue, Qi currents, or the thread’s physical material still gains Advantage on the check. ### Long Silk Thread - Thread, Projected Increase your control range by 30 feet. At CL 5, increase it by 60 feet instead. At CL 11, increase it by 120 feet instead. A Body Refiner may learn this talent only if they have Projected Puppetry permission. ### Joint-Catching Needle - Tension When you hit with Puppet Strike, choose one of the target’s obvious modes of movement: walking, climbing, flying, swimming, or burrowing. Until the end of your next turn, the first time the target uses that movement mode, you may spend the Tension Mark to reduce that movement by 10 feet. At CL 5+, reduce it by 20 feet instead. ### Sleeve-Pulling Rebuke - Tension Trigger: A creature with your Tension Mark makes an Opportunity Attack. Spend the mark. The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The Opportunity Attack misses. Successful Save: The attack roll has Disadvantage. ### Puppet Screen - Substitute When a creature within 5 feet of your active puppet vessel is targeted by a ranged attack, use your Reaction to move the puppet vessel into the line of attack. The target gains Half Cover against the triggering attack. If the attack misses because of the cover bonus, the puppet vessel takes damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### False Body on the Stage - Substitute When you take the Dodge action, your active puppet vessel also gains the benefits of Dodge until the start of your next turn. If an enemy misses the puppet vessel with an attack during that time, apply a Tension Mark to that enemy. ### Little Servant’s Errand - Thread Your Thread the Object can manipulate unattended objects weighing up to 10 x your Proficiency Bonus pounds. You may also perform simple tool-adjacent tasks such as sweeping dust, carrying a message scroll, pulling a curtain, pouring tea, moving a tray, turning a crank, or retrieving a visible object. This talent does not replace a tool proficiency check when skill matters. ### Puppet-Hand Feint - Tension When your puppet vessel takes the Help action using False Hand, the helped ally may choose to apply the help to its next attack roll or Dexterity ability check before the start of your next turn. If the helped roll succeeds, the target of the roll gains a Tension Mark if legal. ### Sever the Sleeve, Not the Arm - Tension When you spend a Tension Mark with Cross the Limb, choose one held nonmagical object the marked creature is holding. The creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: It drops the object in its space. Successful Save: It keeps the object, but has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes with that object before the end of its next turn. This talent cannot disarm shields that are strapped on, cursed items, natural weapons, or body parts. ### Self-Marionette Method - Vessel, Body Refining You may treat your own body, armor, clothing, or a held object as your active puppet vessel for Puppetry features. When you do, Raise the Vessel does not create a separate object. Instead, until the effect ends: your movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from one creature you have marked with Tension during the current turn; once per turn, after you spend a Tension Mark, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the marked creature; you may use Puppet Strike through an unarmed strike, armor cord, sleeve, weapon tassel, or held object. Self-Marionette Method does not grant extra limbs or extra Actions. ## Foundation Realm Puppetry Talents ### Two-Body Control - Vessel Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may maintain two active puppet vessels at once. When you use a Bonus Action to move one vessel, you may move both vessels, but the total movement between them cannot exceed the highest Speed among them. You may use Puppet Strike from either vessel, not both, unless another talent says otherwise. ### Needle Rain Marionette - Vessel, Tension Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you use Puppet Strike, choose to make the vessel release needles, splinters, paper blades, wire hooks, or bone pins. The attack can target one creature within 30 feet of the puppet vessel. On a hit, the damage type is Piercing, and the target gains a Tension Mark. ### Thread the Weapon - Thread, Tension Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a creature with your Tension Mark makes a melee weapon attack, spend the mark as a Reaction. The creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: reduce the attack roll by your Proficiency Bonus; the attack’s target gains +2 AC against the attack; if the attack misses, move the attacker 5 feet to a legal space. Successful Save: The attack roll is reduced by 1. ### Substitute Harm Body - Substitute Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you take damage from an attack or effect while your active puppet vessel is within 30 feet, use your Reaction and spend 1 CP. Reduce the damage by: 2d8 + your Puppetry key ability modifier Your puppet vessel takes the same amount of damage that was reduced. At CL 11+, increase the reduction to 3d8 + your ability modifier. At CL 17+, increase it to 4d8 + your ability modifier. ### Threaded Step Formation - Thread Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you move your active puppet vessel, choose one willing ally within 5 feet of it. That ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature that has your Tension Mark. Use Threaded Step Formation once per turn. ### Grasping Marionette - Vessel, Tension Prerequisite: CL 5+ Your puppet vessel can attempt to Grapple. As an Action, choose one creature within 5 feet of the vessel. The creature makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, its choice. Failed Save: The creature is Grappled by the puppet vessel until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: The creature is not Grappled, but gains a Tension Mark. The Grapple ends early if the puppet vessel is moved more than 5 feet away from the target, is reduced to 0 Hit Points, or leaves your control range. ### Paper Soldier Battalion - Vessel Prerequisite: CL 7+ You may designate a swarm of Tiny paper, straw, cloth, wooden, or bone puppets as one puppet vessel. It occupies a 10-foot square and can move through openings at least 1 inch wide. It cannot carry objects heavier than 5 pounds. Puppet Strike from the battalion may target one creature in its space or within 5 feet of its space. When a creature starts its turn inside the battalion’s space, apply a Tension Mark to that creature if it does not already have one from you. ### Voice Through the Doll - Thread Prerequisite: CL 7+ Speak through your active puppet vessel. Your voice may sound like your own, like the puppet’s carved voice, or like a simple theatrical mask. This does not imitate a specific person convincingly unless you have the appropriate disguise, Illusion, Jester, or Deception support. When you use the Influence action through the puppet, you may use your Puppetry key ability in place of Charisma if the request is delivered through performance, warning, messenger-work, or ritual theater. ### Knot the Knee - Tension Prerequisite: CL 7+ When a creature with your Tension Mark willingly moves at least 10 feet, spend the mark as a Reaction. The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: It falls Prone after moving 5 feet. Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn. ## Core Formation Realm Puppetry Talents ### Puppet Theater Domain - Court of Hanging Threads “The battlefield became a stage. Every sleeve, weapon, corpse, doll, and shadow waited for the hand that knew its cue.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you Duration: 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per short rest You establish a Puppet Theater Domain. For the duration: your control range applies anywhere inside the Domain; you may maintain up to three active puppet vessels inside the Domain; when a hostile creature starts its turn within 5 feet of one of your active puppet vessels, it gains a Tension Mark if it does not already have one from you; once on each of your turns, use a basic Tension Response without spending your normal once-per-turn Tension Response limit; your puppet vessels gain Temporary HP equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus when the Domain appears; when one of your puppet vessels is reduced to 0 Hit Points, choose one hostile creature within 5 feet of it to make a Dexterity saving throw or become Restrained until the end of its next turn by snapping threads and collapsing limbs. The Domain does not create permanent puppets or raw materials. ### Ten Thousand Fingers Scripture - Thread Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you use Thread the Object, affect a number of unattended objects up to your Proficiency Bonus within a 20-foot cube. Each object must be no heavier than 10 pounds unless another talent increases the limit. You may arrange tools, pull pins, move props, open latches, scatter caltrops, throw curtains, or perform a similar coordinated manipulation. This talent cannot make attacks unless another talent explicitly allows it. ### Marionette Substitution Body - Substitute Prerequisite: Substitute Harm Body, CL 10+ When a creature you can see targets you with an attack or harmful effect, use your Reaction and spend 3 CP to switch positions with one active puppet vessel within 60 feet. You teleport or are pulled along the thread to the vessel’s space, and the vessel moves to your former space. Resolve the triggering attack or effect against the new legal target if the target remains legal. If the puppet vessel is not a legal target, you gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw or the attack roll against you has Disadvantage. This movement is supernatural. ### Enemy String Hook - Tension, Projected Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you hit a creature with Puppet Strike or Needle Rain Marionette, spend 2 CP to deepen the Tension Mark into a String Hook. Until the end of your next turn, the marked creature cannot willingly move farther from your active puppet vessel unless it succeeds on a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, its movement stops. A creature can use its Action to tear out the hook, ending the mark. A Body Refiner may learn this talent only with Projected Puppetry permission unless the puppet vessel is physically attached to the target. ### Iron-Coffin Puppet Shell - Vessel Prerequisite: CL 10+ Your active puppet vessel can carry one willing Medium or smaller creature. While carried this way, the creature has Three-Quarters Cover, but is Restrained by the cramped shell unless the shell is built specifically for them during a long rest. As a Bonus Action, you may open or close the shell if the vessel is within control range. If the vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points while carrying a creature, the carried creature falls Prone in the vessel’s space and takes Bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Puppet Drinks the Blow - Substitute Prerequisite: CL 10+ When a creature within 5 feet of your puppet vessel takes damage, spend a Tension Mark from the attacker or from the damaged creature. Reduce the damage by: 3d8 + your Puppetry key ability modifier The puppet vessel takes damage equal to half the amount reduced. ### Red Thread Command Seat - Vessel, Thread Prerequisite: CL 12+ You may sit, stand, or meditate inside a specially prepared command rig, puppet chair, palanquin, coffin-cart, or suspended thread frame. While using the command seat: you cannot move except by directing the seat or being carried; your control range increases by 120 feet; you may maintain one additional active puppet vessel; if an enemy damages the command seat, you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw against DC 10 or half the damage taken, whichever is higher, or lose Concentration on one Puppetry effect. The command seat is an object with AC 15 and Hit Points equal to 10 + five times your CL unless built better by Blacksmith, Metal, or crafting. ### Borrowed Body Performance - Thread, Substitute Prerequisite: Voice Through the Doll, CL 12+ As an Action, choose one active puppet vessel. Until the start of your next turn, perceive through the vessel’s hearing and sight if it has appropriate carved senses, gemstone eyes, spirit mirrors, or similar features. During that time: you are Blinded and Deafened to your own body’s surroundings; you may speak through the vessel; you may take the Help, Search, Study, or Utilize action through the vessel; you may make one Puppet Strike through the vessel as a Bonus Action if you have not already used Puppet Strike this turn. ## Nascent Soul Realm Puppetry Talents ### Thousand-Puppet Incarnation “The master lifted one finger. Every discarded doll in the hall remembered it had once been shaped like a body.” Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 8 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest For the duration: maintain up to five active puppet vessels; when you use your Bonus Action to move puppet vessels, move any number of your active vessels up to their Speed; once on each of your turns, make one Puppet Strike without spending your Action; use two Tension Responses per turn instead of one; when a puppet vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, it explodes into thread, splinters, silk, bone, paper, or metal shards; each hostile creature within 5 feet makes a Dexterity saving throw or gains a Tension Mark and takes 3d8 Piercing or Force damage. This incarnation does not create permanent puppet vessels. You must have sufficient suitable objects, prepared dolls, debris, or material in the scene, or the GM may limit the number of vessels. ### Soul-Thread Warning - Thread, Spirit Prerequisite: Spirit Awakening or GM permission, CL 15+ When a creature within your control range is about to take an Action that would directly harm you or one of your active puppet vessels, you sense the thread of intent. Use your Reaction to move one active puppet vessel up to half its Speed before the triggering Action resolves. If this movement places the vessel adjacent to the acting creature, the creature gains a Tension Mark before the Action resolves. Soul-Thread Warning reads immediate hostile intent, not private thoughts. ### Heaven’s Spare Body - Substitute Prerequisite: Marionette Substitution Body, CL 15+ When you would be reduced to 0 Hit Points while you have an active puppet vessel within control range, spend 8 CP and destroy that vessel. You are reduced to 1 Hit Point instead. Then move to the destroyed vessel’s space or move the destroyed vessel’s remains to your space. Use Heaven’s Spare Body once per long rest. This talent cannot prevent death from effects that kill without reducing Hit Points unless the GM allows a specific interaction. ### Forbidden Corpse-Puppet Method - Forbidden, Vessel Prerequisite: GM permission, CL 15+ You may use a humanoid corpse or similar corpse as a puppet vessel. The corpse is not undead unless another feature makes it undead. It does not regain life, memory, class features, or spellcasting. When you raise a corpse-puppet vessel, choose one body memory from the following list: Soldier’s Arm: Puppet Strike damage die increases by one step. Runner’s Feet: +15 feet vessel Speed. Guard’s Spine: the vessel can provide Half Cover to one adjacent creature. Laborer’s Grip: the vessel has Advantage on saves made to maintain a Grapple created by Grasping Marionette. Speaker’s Jaw: you may use Voice Through the Doll through it with Advantage on Performance checks meant to unsettle or warn. Using this talent is spiritually taboo in most orthodox sects. It may attract Karma, ghost resentment, family vengeance, sect discipline, corpse-law investigation, or burial rite consequences. ### Red Thread World-Puppet Array - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Puppet Theater Domain, CL 15+ When you create Puppet Theater Domain, you may anchor it to visible threads, hanging banners, stage ropes, chains, roots, wires, or Formation lines in the area. For the duration: the Domain area increases to a 60-foot Emanation; hostile creatures treat the area within 5 feet of your puppet vessels as Difficult Terrain; once per round, when a hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Puppetry talents, move one puppet vessel up to its Speed without spending an Action; allied creatures inside gain Advantage on saving throws against being Grappled or Restrained. If all anchors are destroyed or severed, the Domain ends. ## Secret Puppetry Inheritance ### The Body That Heaven Forgot Was Mine “Cut the hands. Burn the doll. Break the stage. The thread was never between the puppet and the master. It was between motion and the world.” Classification: Secret Puppetry Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Thousand-Puppet Incarnation, hidden marionette scripture, GM approval Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or one active puppet vessel within 120 feet is targeted by an attack, harmful effect, Domain, Realm Evolution, or Secret Inheritance Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per week Before the triggering effect resolves, designate one of the following as the True Body until the end of the current turn: yourself; one active puppet vessel; one prepared puppet vessel within 120 feet; one valid vessel destroyed since the end of your last turn. The triggering effect treats the True Body as the primary target if it is a legal target. If it is not a legal target, choose one: the triggering attack has Disadvantage, or you gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw; reduce the triggering damage by 10d10; move yourself and up to three active puppet vessels to legal spaces within 30 feet of their current positions; apply Tension Marks to up to five hostile creatures you can see within 120 feet. After the triggering effect resolves, every active puppet vessel you control may immediately move up to its Speed and make one Puppet Strike, dividing attacks among legal targets as you choose. Then all Tension Marks you control end. If the GM determines the inheritance was used to deny a karmic, oathbound, or tribulation consequence without paying any substitute price, the inheritance may create a new debt instead of erasing the old one. ## Puppetry Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures Puppetry variants are optional cultivation scriptures that change how the sphere manifests. They are Tianxia-specific design tools inspired by drawback design, not imported casting-tradition rules. A Puppetry variant grants a benefit only when it also imposes a real limitation. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Puppetry variant when first learning the sphere or undergoing a major Puppetry initiation; Puppetry variants are mutually exclusive; the drawback applies to all Puppetry talents you use; if a variant grants a talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, gain that talent when you meet its prerequisites; if the variant is removed, lose the granted bonus talent or benefit. ### Body-as-Puppet Scripture You cultivate the self-marionette method rather than independent vessels. You gain Self-Marionette Method as a bonus talent. When you use Self-Marionette Method, increase the movement it grants by 5 feet. #### Drawback: No Spare Body You cannot maintain an independent active puppet vessel that is not your body, armor, clothing, held object, or an object physically attached to you by a cord, chain, sleeve, armor-rig, or similar link. You cannot learn Two-Body Control, Paper Soldier Battalion, or Thousand-Puppet Incarnation unless the GM approves a breakthrough that changes this drawback. ### Mechanist Puppet Scripture You cultivate articulated mechanical, jade, metal, or wooden puppets. You gain Ironwood Practice Body as a bonus talent. When you designate a puppet vessel after a long rest, choose two constructions instead of one. #### Drawback: Built Body Required You cannot use random debris, corpses, shadows, clothing, or unprepared objects as puppet vessels. Your active puppet vessels must be prepared constructs, dolls, frames, armor rigs, or articulated bodies maintained with appropriate tools. If you lose access to your prepared vessels, you can still use Thread the Object and Self-Marionette Method, but you cannot Raise the Vessel on an independent puppet until you craft, repair, buy, or recover one. ### Hidden Thread Scripture You cultivate subtle control, secret cords, hair threads, silk lines, and nearly invisible handwork. You gain Hidden Thread as a bonus talent. When a creature fails to notice one of your threads, your first Puppet Strike against that creature before the end of your next turn has Advantage. #### Drawback: No Loud Theater You cannot use Puppet Theater Domain, Red Thread World-Puppet Array, or any Puppetry talent that requires obvious public stagecraft unless you choose to reveal all active threads until the end of the scene. When you reveal your threads this way, creatures gain Advantage on checks to identify, attack, or sever them until the scene ends. ### Corpse-Puppet Scripture You cultivate taboo vessel methods using corpses, funerary dolls, burial bindings, or ancestral body remnants. You gain Forbidden Corpse-Puppet Method as a bonus talent when you meet its prerequisites. Before CL 15, you may use a corpse as a basic puppet vessel, but it gains no body memory. #### Drawback: Burial Debt Every corpse-puppet vessel creates a visible spiritual debt. After each scene in which you use a corpse-puppet vessel, the GM may introduce one appropriate consequence: family grievance; ghost resentment; sect discipline; funeral-law investigation; Karmic Thread complication; Yin, Death, Karma, or Spirit Awakening backlash; refusal of orthodox aid until rites are paid. This drawback is not a license for free undead armies. The corpse remains an object unless another rule makes it undead. ### Stage-Master Scripture You cultivate battlefield puppet theaters rather than personal duels. You gain Threaded Step Formation as a bonus talent. When you create Puppet Theater Domain, one willing ally inside may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. #### Drawback: Needs a Stage You cannot create Puppet Theater Domain or Red Thread World-Puppet Array unless the area contains enough anchors for threadwork: ropes, banners, pillars, trees, stakes, walls, chains, rafters, furniture, tall grass, corpses, puppet debris, or prepared markers. In a featureless empty area, your control range is reduced by half until you create or place suitable anchors. ## Path Synergies ### Spirit Awakening - Soul-Thread Discernment Use Wisdom as your Puppetry key ability if higher. When a creature gains a Tension Mark from you, learn one immediate motion truth: whether it intends to move before the start of your next turn; whether it intends to attack your body or your puppet; whether its current movement is voluntary or compelled; whether it is being controlled, possessed, dominated, or commanded by another influence. This reads immediate motion pressure, not private memories. At CL 10+, once per round when you spend a Tension Mark, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Qi Cultivation - Projected Red Thread Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Puppetry key ability. You gain Projected Puppetry permission for Puppetry talents. Increase your control range by 30 feet. At CL 10+, increase it by 60 feet instead. Once per turn when you spend CP on a Puppetry talent, move one active puppet vessel 10 feet without spending an Action. ### Body Refining - Muscle-Thread Body Use Constitution as your Puppetry key ability for Self-Marionette Method and Substitute talents if higher. While using Self-Marionette Method: gain Advantage on saving throws against being moved against your will; when you spend a Tension Mark, reduce the next Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage you take before the start of your next turn by your Proficiency Bonus; once per short rest, when you fail a Dexterity saving throw, move your own body 5 feet and reroll the saving throw. You must use the new result. This synergy does not grant general remote puppet projection. ### Blacksmith - Built to Obey When you repair or prepare a puppet vessel during a long rest using Blacksmith tools or a Blacksmith talent, choose one: increase the vessel’s Hit Points by your CL; increase its AC by 1; give it one additional Ironwood Practice Body construction until your next long rest; allow the vessel to carry one integrated mundane tool or concealed compartment. At CL 10+, choose two benefits. ### Metal - Bell-Wire Resonance If your puppet vessel contains metal wire, rings, needles, bells, chains, blades, or armor plates, your Puppetry attacks may deal Slashing, Piercing, Thunder, or Lightning damage if a talent or forged technique permits the change. Once per turn when a Metal talent places or spends a Temper Mark on a creature adjacent to your puppet vessel, move that vessel 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. ### Verdant Growth - Root-Puppet Method A puppet vessel made from living wood, vines, roots, gourds, bamboo, paper talismans, or plant fiber can be treated as a Living Medium for Verdant Growth features if the GM approves the construction. Once per turn when a Growth Mark and a Tension Mark are on the same target, spend either mark to move the target 5 feet or reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the end of the current turn. ## Sphere Synergies | Sphere | Synergy Concept | | --- | --- | | Blacksmith | Artifact puppets, repair, integrated weapons, tool bodies, command seats | | Metal | Wire, bells, needles, armor puppets, conductive strings | | Verdant Growth | Vine puppets, bamboo soldiers, root theaters, living wood vessels | | Illusion | False puppets, stage doubles, hidden master, impossible puppet crowds | | Jester | Theater misdirection, absurd puppet roles, mock court performances | | Shadow | Shadow puppets, silhouette bodies, second-hand movement | | Karma | Debt strings, oath-bound puppets, consequence threads | | Spirit Awakening | soul-thread warnings, possession defenses, ancestral gestures | | Force | impact puppets, pressure strings, collision redirection | | Yin | preservation dolls, corpse taboos, stillness strings | | Yang | overdriven puppet bodies, blazing command, animated vigor | ## Cultivation Insights ### External Thread Breakthrough Prerequisite: Body Refining Path, Puppetry sphere, CL 5+ You gain limited Projected Puppetry permission. Your Projected Puppetry range is 30 feet and applies only to puppet vessels you prepared during a long rest or objects physically marked with your blood, hair, tendon-fiber, or body-refining seal. At CL 10+, increase the range to 60 feet. This Insight does not grant general Qi projection outside Puppetry. ### Puppet Artisan Prerequisite: Puppetry sphere, proficiency with one appropriate tool, CL 4+ During a long rest, prepare one additional basic puppet vessel. When you repair a broken puppet vessel, reduce the time and material cost by half. Once per long rest, when one of your puppet vessels is reduced to 0 Hit Points, leave it at 1 Hit Point instead. ### Nine-Finger Director Prerequisite: Puppetry sphere, Two-Body Control, CL 8+ When you maintain more than one active puppet vessel, choose one vessel at the start of each turn as your leading hand. The leading hand gains one of the following benefits until the start of your next turn: +10 feet Speed; +2 AC; Advantage on the next Strength or Dexterity save it makes; the next Puppet Strike made through it deals extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Severed Thread Recovery Prerequisite: Puppetry sphere, CL 8+ When a control thread ends because a vessel leaves range, a line is severed, or the vessel is reduced to 0 Hit Points, regain 1 CP. Use Severed Thread Recovery once per short rest. At CL 15+, use it twice per short rest. ### Stage of Ten Thousand Hands Prerequisite: Puppetry sphere, Puppet Theater Domain, CL 12+ When you create Puppet Theater Domain, choose one type of stage anchor present in the area: ropes, rafters, trees, banners, pillars, chains, furniture, corpses, puppet debris, roots, or Formation lines. While at least one chosen anchor remains, your puppet vessels inside the Domain gain +10 feet Speed. If all chosen anchors are destroyed, moved, burned, severed, or removed, this Insight stops functioning until you create the Domain again.

### Raise the Vessel
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet, or touch for Body Refining unless using Projected Puppetry
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Target: One suitable puppet vessel
You claim one puppet vessel and set a control thread to it.
The vessel becomes active for the duration.
When you activate the vessel, and as a Bonus Action on later turns, you may move it up to its Speed.
This movement may include climbing, crawling, hopping, rolling, skittering, or walking as appropriate for its form.
The vessel cannot fly, swim, burrow, squeeze through impossible spaces, or climb smooth surfaces unless a talent, construction, or feature allows it.
You may dismiss the vessel on your turn without an Action.
If you raise a second vessel, the first vessel becomes inactive unless a talent allows you to control more than one.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
##### Qi Bond
Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature, object, or Active Qi Pattern
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Attempt to form a thread between your circulation and the target’s Qi pattern.
A willing creature, an unattended object, or an Active Qi Pattern you created is bonded automatically.
Against an unwilling creature, attended object, or hostile Active Qi Pattern, make a ranged Cultivation Attack. If the target is an Active Qi Pattern, treat its AC as equal to its creator’s Cultivation Save DC. If the creator is unknown, use 10 + Pattern Rank.
Hit: Create a Qi Bond.
Miss: No bond forms.
While the bond lasts, you may use your Action on each of your turns to apply one Bond talent you know to the target.
Unless a Bond talent says otherwise, the Qi Bond ends if:
the target is ever outside your Qi Bond range;
the target has Total Cover from you;
you use your Action for anything other than applying or maintaining a Bond talent;
you lose Concentration.
###### Persistent Qi Bond
Augment - 2 CP: The Qi Bond persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the bond on your turn without spending an Action.

##### Turbulent Field
Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 5-foot-radius Emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
You emit a field of unstable Qi.
If the campaign uses wild magic or Qi-deviation rules, increase the instability chance of creatures inside the area by 50 percent.
If the campaign does not use a separate instability system, use the following fallback.
The first time on a turn that a creature inside the area activates a technique that costs CP or casts a spell using a spell slot, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The technique is Turbulent until it resolves. A Turbulent technique suffers one complication chosen by the GM or rolled from a campaign-appropriate table, such as visible backlash, noisy activation, reduced range, accidental self-exposure, or minor damage to an unattended nearby object.
The fallback complication should be inconvenient but should not normally waste the technique unless another Turbulence talent says so.
The area radius increases by Realm:
Cultivation Level: 1-4 - Radius: 5 feet
Cultivation Level: 5-10 - Radius: 10 feet
Cultivation Level: 11-16 - Radius: 15 feet
Cultivation Level: 17-20 - Radius: 20 feet
###### Lingering Turbulence
Augment - 2 CP: The Turbulent Field persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the field on your turn without spending an Action.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
##### Unweave Pattern
Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature, object, location, or Active Qi Pattern
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: None
Attempt to end one Active Qi Pattern on the target.
If the pattern’s Pattern Rank is equal to or lower than half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, it ends automatically.
Otherwise, make a Qiweaving Check against the pattern.
Successful Check: The pattern ends.
Failed Check: The pattern remains.
Unweave Pattern cannot end a Domain, Secret Inheritance, Formation project, artifact-level effect, or campaign-scale working unless a talent, project, or GM ruling explicitly permits it.
###### Rapid Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: Reduce the Action Type to Action.
If you Ready this Action to disrupt a technique as it is activated, resolve Unweave Pattern when the triggering technique is being created. On a successful check, the technique fails and any Action, CP, spell slot, or limited use spent on it is lost.
###### Broad Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: Attempt to unweave a number of additional Active Qi Patterns on the same target equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down.
Make a separate Qiweaving Check for each pattern that is not ended automatically.
###### Certain Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: The automatic-ending threshold becomes your Proficiency Bonus instead of half your Proficiency Bonus.
