spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Qiweaving Qi Expression: Primary — Raw Weave Qi; Supporting — Pattern Qi, Meridian Qi, Ambient Qi, Thread Qi. “A flame burns because Fire taught it hunger. A sword cuts because Sword taught it decision. A Qiweaver asks a simpler question: what pattern is making the technique believe it can continue?” Tianxia Name: Sphere of Qiweaving Sphere Type: Utility Power Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Rare Variant: Body Refining through Inner Circuit Body, Meridian-Tool Body, or sect-specific talisman-martial training Resource: CP Common Effects: Disrupting active techniques, counterweaving, Qi bonds, CP transfer, technique retuning, multi-sphere harmonics, stabilizing or destabilizing Qi patterns, controlled wild Qi ### Qiweaving Dao Qiweaving is the cultivation of the pattern beneath technique. Most spheres cultivate a specific answer. Fire ignites. Blood remembers. Protection preserves. Sword decides. Shadow travels through the second silhouette. Qiweaving does not begin by asking what the technique expresses. It asks how the expression is being held together. A novice Qiweaver learns to feel the knot in another cultivator’s working. An adept learns where to pull. A master can retune the current before the enemy understands that their own Qi has changed direction. A sovereign looks across a battlefield and sees not flames, blades, wards, curses, and talismans, but braided currents waiting to be named, severed, steadied, or joined. The sphere’s recurring loop is: Read the current. Identify an active Qi pattern, a creature’s surface circulation, or the structure of a sphere technique. Choose the intervention. Unweave, bind, modulate, splice, stabilize, or destabilize. Pay the cost of precision. Qiweaving is utilitarian, but it is rarely free when used quickly. Respect the source Dao. Qiweaving modifies patterns; it does not replace the sphere that created them. ### Rules Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the ordinary 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Concentration, Cover, Total Cover, attack rolls, saving throws, spells, magical effects, and D20 Tests unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### Dispel and Countering Are Local Rules Here Qiweaving defines its own local Unweave Pattern and Counterweave rules for ending or disrupting active techniques. #### Total Cover Matters Qiweaving does not ignore Total Cover. A talent may read or affect a pattern only when the target, pattern, origin, or route is legal under that talent’s text. #### Concentration Remains Valuable Qiweaving interacts with Concentration but does not erase its importance. A talent that lets you take over, reinforce, or disrupt Concentration states exactly how it does so. #### Pattern Rank Measures Active Effects Pattern Rank lets Qiweaving interact consistently with spells, CP techniques, Realm talents, Domains, Barriers, Aegises, marks, and other active effects. ### Core Qiweaving Rules ##### Active Qi Pattern An Active Qi Pattern is an ongoing magical, spiritual, or cultivation effect that currently exists in the scene. Examples include: a spell with ongoing duration; an Aegis; a Ward; a Barrier; a Domain; a sphere mark such as a Blood Thread, Shadow Mark, Dream Seed, or Ashen Brand; an active talisman effect; a summoned or shaped construct of Qi; a maintained aura; a Concentration technique; an active curse, possession trace, or corruption mark when the GM rules it has a manipulable Qi pattern. An Active Qi Pattern is not automatically: a creature’s entire Path; a creature’s Realm; a class feature with no active manifestation; a permanent magic item; a whole Formation project; a Secret Inheritance; an already-resolved instantaneous effect; a creature’s soul; a bloodline; a destiny. A talent must explicitly say when it can interact with any of those higher-order targets. ##### Pattern Rank When a Qiweaving talent needs to measure an Active Qi Pattern, determine its Pattern Rank. Use the first applicable entry: Effect Source: Spell - Pattern Rank: Spell level Effect Source: Sphere or cultivation effect with CP cost - Pattern Rank: CP spent to activate or maintain it, minimum 1 Effect Source: Mortal or basic talent with no CP cost - Pattern Rank: 1 Effect Source: Foundation Realm talent with no CP cost - Pattern Rank: 3 Effect Source: Core Formation Realm talent or Domain with no listed rank - Pattern Rank: 5 Effect Source: Nascent Soul Realm talent with no listed rank - Pattern Rank: 7 Effect Source: Secret Inheritance or campaign-scale effect - Pattern Rank: 9 or higher, and usually cannot be affected unless the talent says so Effect Source: Unclear source - Pattern Rank: GM sets Pattern Rank using the closest entry above If an effect has both a spell level and CP cost, use the higher value. ##### Qiweaving Check Some Qiweaving talents call for a Qiweaving Check. Make: d20 + your Key Ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus The DC is usually: 10 + the target effect's Pattern Rank If the effect’s creator has a higher Cultivation Save DC, the GM may use that DC instead. A Qiweaving Check is a Cultivation Check for rules that refer to Cultivation Checks. ##### Martial Focus and Qiweaving Qiweaving is a Power Sphere and normally uses CP. Some talents allow Martial Focus to support quick counter-timing. Unless a talent says otherwise: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is currently absent. ##### Technique Categories Qiweaving talents use the following tags. ###### Unweaving Talents An Unweaving talent ends, counters, suppresses, damages, or steals the structure of an Active Qi Pattern. ###### Bond Talents A Bond talent requires your Qi Bond to a creature, object, or Active Qi Pattern. ###### Modulation Talents A Modulation talent alters one sphere technique you activate. Unless a talent says otherwise: apply only one Modulation talent to one technique; choose the Modulation when you activate the technique; pay any additional CP cost immediately; the Modulation cannot make an illegal target legal; the Modulation cannot remove an effect’s basic limitations unless it says so. ###### Harmonic Talents A Harmonic talent requires two or more spheres. These are the Tianxia version of dual-sphere talents. ###### Turbulence Talents A Turbulence talent interacts with unstable Qi, wild Qi, Qi deviation, or uncontrolled technique behavior. ### Base Sphere Ability ##### Qiweaving Training When you learn the Qiweaving sphere, choose one Qiweaving Package: Unweaving Package; Qi Bond Package; Modulation Package; Harmonic Package; Turbulence Package. You gain the base ability of that package. If the package grants a bonus talent, choose one talent from that package for which you meet the prerequisites. You may learn additional packages through Additional Qiweaving Package. ### Qiweaving Packages #### Unweaving Package The Unweaving Package is about ending, countering, and disrupting active techniques. ##### Unweave Pattern Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: 10 minutes Range: 30 feet Target: One creature, object, location, or Active Qi Pattern Duration: Instantaneous Cost: None Attempt to end one Active Qi Pattern on the target. If the pattern’s Pattern Rank is equal to or lower than half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, it ends automatically. Otherwise, make a Qiweaving Check against the pattern. Successful Check: The pattern ends. Failed Check: The pattern remains. Unweave Pattern cannot end a Domain, Secret Inheritance, Formation project, artifact-level effect, or campaign-scale working unless a talent, project, or GM ruling explicitly permits it. ###### Rapid Unweave Augment - 1 CP: Reduce the Action Type to Action. If you Ready this Action to disrupt a technique as it is activated, resolve Unweave Pattern when the triggering technique is being created. On a successful check, the technique fails and any Action, CP, spell slot, or limited use spent on it is lost. ###### Broad Unweave Augment - 1 CP: Attempt to unweave a number of additional Active Qi Patterns on the same target equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down. Make a separate Qiweaving Check for each pattern that is not ended automatically. ###### Certain Unweave Augment - 1 CP: The automatic-ending threshold becomes your Proficiency Bonus instead of half your Proficiency Bonus. #### Qi Bond Package The Qi Bond Package is about attaching your perception and control to another current. When you gain this package, you learn Qi Bond and one Bond talent for which you meet the prerequisites. ##### Qi Bond Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: One creature, object, or Active Qi Pattern Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: None Attempt to form a thread between your circulation and the target’s Qi pattern. A willing creature, an unattended object, or an Active Qi Pattern you created is bonded automatically. Against an unwilling creature, attended object, or hostile Active Qi Pattern, make a ranged Cultivation Attack. If the target is an Active Qi Pattern, treat its AC as equal to its creator’s Cultivation Save DC. If the creator is unknown, use 10 + Pattern Rank. Hit: Create a Qi Bond. Miss: No bond forms. While the bond lasts, you may use your Action on each of your turns to apply one Bond talent you know to the target. Unless a Bond talent says otherwise, the Qi Bond ends if: the target is ever outside your Qi Bond range; the target has Total Cover from you; you use your Action for anything other than applying or maintaining a Bond talent; you lose Concentration. ###### Persistent Qi Bond Augment - 2 CP: The Qi Bond persists for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment after creating the bond on your turn without spending an Action. #### Modulation Package The Modulation Package is about retuning techniques you already know. When you gain this package, you learn Minor Qi Arts and one Modulation talent for which you meet the prerequisites. ##### Minor Qi Arts You learn to perform harmless adjustments to ambient Qi. As an Action, you may create one minor effect within 30 feet: color, warm, chill, flavor, clean, or soil a Tiny object; cause a faint harmless sound, scent, breeze, spark, ripple, or glow; make a small symbol, seal, footprint, or line of script appear for 1 minute; open or close an unlocked Tiny mundane object such as a pouch clasp or paper fan; predict ordinary weather signs for the next hour when outdoors; cause a candle, incense stick, lamp wick, or similar tiny flame to brighten, dim, or extinguish. Minor Qi Arts cannot deal damage, impose a condition, create Cover, duplicate another sphere talent, activate a magic item, or deceive a careful observer by itself. If your table uses spell cantrips directly, the GM may allow Minor Qi Arts to count as druidcraft, prestidigitation, and thaumaturgy for prerequisite and harmless utility purposes. Use your Key Ability as the spellcasting ability for such cantrips. ##### Apply Modulation Once per turn, when you activate a sphere technique you know, you may apply one Modulation talent you know to that technique and pay the listed cost. #### Harmonic Package The Harmonic Package is about creating techniques that deliberately join two or more sphere principles. Requirement: You must know at least two non-Qiweaving spheres to select this package. When you gain this package, choose one Harmonic talent for which you meet the prerequisites. You benefit from a Harmonic talent only while you possess that talent, possess its required base spheres, and meet its other prerequisites. While you possess the Harmonic Package, if a sphere grants you a bonus talent, you may instead choose a Harmonic talent that has that sphere as a prerequisite. Bonus talents granted by sphere variants cannot be exchanged this way unless the variant explicitly permits it. #### Turbulence Package The Turbulence Package is optional. It supports campaigns that use wild Qi, Qi deviation, unstable spellcasting, or uncontrolled technique backlash. When you gain this package, you learn Turbulent Field and one Turbulence talent for which you meet the prerequisites. ##### Turbulent Field Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 5-foot-radius Emanation Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: None You emit a field of unstable Qi. If the campaign uses wild magic or Qi-deviation rules, increase the instability chance of creatures inside the area by 50 percent. If the campaign does not use a separate instability system, use the following fallback. The first time on a turn that a creature inside the area activates a technique that costs CP or casts a spell using a spell slot, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The technique is Turbulent until it resolves. A Turbulent technique suffers one complication chosen by the GM or rolled from a campaign-appropriate table, such as visible backlash, noisy activation, reduced range, accidental self-exposure, or minor damage to an unattended nearby object. The fallback complication should be inconvenient but should not normally waste the technique unless another Turbulence talent says so. The area radius increases by Realm: Cultivation Level: 1-4 - Radius: 5 feet Cultivation Level: 5-10 - Radius: 10 feet Cultivation Level: 11-16 - Radius: 15 feet Cultivation Level: 17-20 - Radius: 20 feet ###### Lingering Turbulence Augment - 2 CP: The Turbulent Field persists for its remaining duration without Concentration. You may apply this augment after creating the field on your turn without spending an Action. ### Mortal Realm Qiweaving Talents #### Additional Qiweaving Package Classification: Unique Qiweaving Talent Choose one Qiweaving Package you do not already possess. You gain that package’s base ability and may select talents from that package. You may learn this talent more than once. Each time, choose a different package. #### Dazing Unweave - Unweaving Prerequisite: Unweaving Package Cost: +1 CP When you successfully counter a technique with Unweave Pattern, the creature whose technique you countered makes an Intelligence saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the creature has Disadvantage on attack rolls made as part of magical or cultivation techniques, and creatures have Advantage on saving throws against its magical or cultivation techniques. Successful Save: No additional effect. #### False Completion - Unweaving Prerequisite: Unweaving Package Cost: +1 CP When you successfully counter a technique with Unweave Pattern, the creature whose technique you countered makes an Intelligence saving throw. Failed Save: The creature believes the technique had its intended outward effect until the end of its next turn or until obvious evidence proves otherwise. This is an illusion-like misreading of the broken Qi pattern. It does not create a full illusion, harm the target, or force other creatures to believe the result. #### Vicious Unweave - Unweaving Prerequisite: Unweaving Package Cost: +1 CP When you successfully end or counter an Active Qi Pattern with Unweave Pattern, choose one creature bearing, maintaining, or creating that pattern. That creature takes Force damage. Cultivation Level: 1-4 - Damage: 1d10 Cultivation Level: 5-10 - Damage: 2d10 Cultivation Level: 11-16 - Damage: 3d10 Cultivation Level: 17-20 - Damage: 4d10 A creature can take this damage from you only once per turn. #### Read Current - Bond Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package When you apply this Bond talent, learn two of the following facts about the bonded target: whether it currently has CP remaining; whether it is maintaining Concentration; the number of Active Qi Patterns currently affecting it, rounded up to a simple category: none, one, several, or many; the strongest visible sphere resonance affecting it, such as Fire, Blood, Shadow, Protection, Sword, or another known sphere; whether its circulation is stable, strained, disrupted, corrupted, or turbulent; whether one visible Active Qi Pattern on it has a Pattern Rank no higher than your Proficiency Bonus. Read Current does not reveal exact statistics, hidden thoughts, spell names, complete talents, or private memories. #### Feed Current - Bond Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package When you apply this Bond talent to a willing bonded creature, spend 1 or more CP, up to your Proficiency Bonus. The target gains the same amount as Temporary CP. Temporary CP granted by this talent: lasts for 1 minute; may be spent only on sphere techniques or Path features; cannot be converted into healing or CXP; cannot be transferred again; does not stack with itself. Use the higher amount. A creature can benefit from your Feed Current once per short rest. #### Draw Current - Bond Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package When you apply this Bond talent to an unwilling bonded creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target loses 1 CP, and you gain 1 Temporary CP. Successful Save: No CP is lost. Temporary CP gained this way lasts until the end of your next turn. A creature cannot lose more CP to your Draw Current than your Proficiency Bonus per long rest. If the target has no CP, this talent has no effect unless a feature explicitly treats another resource as CP. #### Throttle Current - Bond Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package When you apply this Bond talent to a bonded creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The next technique the target activates before the start of your next turn that costs CP costs 1 additional CP. If the target cannot or will not pay the additional CP, the technique fails and any Action spent on it is lost. The original CP is not spent. Successful Save: No effect. A creature can suffer this added cost from you only once per round. #### Gentle Modulation - Modulation Prerequisite: Modulation Package Cost: +1 CP When you activate a sphere technique that affects an area, choose a number of creatures in the area up to your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1. The chosen creatures automatically succeed on their saving throws against that activation, and they take no damage if they would normally take half damage on a successful save. Gentle Modulation cannot protect a creature from an effect that does not allow a saving throw. #### Distant Modulation - Modulation Prerequisite: Modulation Package Cost: +1 CP When you activate a sphere technique with a range of at least 10 feet, increase its range by 30 feet. At CL 11, increase the range by 60 feet instead. Distant Modulation does not change the size of an area and cannot make a touch-range technique ranged unless a talent explicitly permits it. #### Quiet Modulation - Modulation Prerequisite: Modulation Package Cost: +1 CP When you activate a sphere technique, suppress obvious sound, spoken formula, visible hand-sign flare, or unnecessary spectacle from the activation. The technique’s normal effects remain visible once they appear. Quiet Modulation does not make an attack Hidden, conceal a projectile, hide obvious damage, remove material components, or allow a technique to bypass a feature that specifically detects magic or cultivation. #### Stable Modulation - Modulation Prerequisite: Modulation Package Cost: +1 CP When you activate a sphere technique that requires Concentration, gain Advantage on the first Concentration saving throw you make for that technique before the start of your next turn. At CL 11, this benefit lasts until the end of your next turn. #### Paired Resonance - Harmonic Prerequisite: Harmonic Package, two non-Qiweaving spheres Choose two spheres you know when you learn this talent. Once per turn, when you apply a mark, thread, seed, anchor, brand, or similar sphere-specific tag from one chosen sphere to a creature, you may cause that creature to count as visibly touched by the other chosen sphere until the start of your next turn. This does not apply the other sphere’s actual mark, thread, seed, anchor, or brand unless a talent says so. It merely satisfies talents that require the target to be affected by or recently touched by that sphere, subject to GM approval. #### Shared Cost Scripture - Harmonic Prerequisite: Harmonic Package, two non-Qiweaving spheres When you activate a Harmonic talent requiring two spheres, reduce its CP cost by 1, minimum 1. You may use this reduction a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest. #### Quiet the Flaw - Turbulence Prerequisite: Turbulence Package When a willing creature inside your Turbulent Field would suffer a wild Qi or Qi-deviation complication, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP. Reduce the severity of the complication by one step, or allow the creature to reroll the instability result and use the new result. If the campaign does not use an instability table, the creature gains Advantage on the saving throw against your Turbulent Field instead. #### Friend in the Storm - Turbulence Prerequisite: Turbulence Package Choose a number of creatures up to your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1, when you create Turbulent Field. Chosen creatures are not affected by your Turbulent Field unless they choose to be. As a Bonus Action, you may change one chosen creature while the field lasts. ### Foundation Realm Qiweaving Talents #### Meridian Grammar - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ You learn to read the grammar of active Qi. Gain the following benefits: increase the range of Unweave Pattern and Qi Bond to 60 feet; when you see a creature activate a sphere technique, you may identify the sphere involved if you know that sphere or have seen the technique before; when you target an Active Qi Pattern with Unweave Pattern, you learn its approximate Pattern Rank before deciding whether to spend CP on augments; you have Advantage on Qiweaving Checks made to identify, study, or trace an Active Qi Pattern during exploration or downtime. Meridian Grammar does not reveal a creature’s full list of talents or Path features. #### Counterweave Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you can perceive within Unweave Pattern range activates a spell, sphere technique, or other Active Qi Pattern Cost: 1 CP and expend Martial Focus Use Unweave Pattern against the triggering technique as it is being activated. On a success, the technique fails. Any Action, CP, spell slot, or limited use spent to activate it is lost. On a failure, the technique resolves normally. Counterweave cannot counter a Secret Inheritance unless the inheritance specifically permits it. #### Borrowed Modulation Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A willing creature within 30 feet activates a sphere technique Cost: 1 CP plus the Modulation’s cost Apply one Modulation talent you know to the triggering creature’s technique. The triggering creature must be willing, must be able to perceive your assistance, and must pay any costs required by the original technique. You pay the Modulation cost. #### Open Circuit Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 5+ Your Qi Bond may target an Active Qi Pattern directly even when you cannot target the creature bearing it, provided you can perceive the pattern and it is not behind Total Cover. While bonded to an Active Qi Pattern, you may apply Bond talents to the pattern rather than to a creature. Examples: Read Current identifies the pattern’s sphere resonance and Pattern Rank category. Throttle Current increases the CP cost of the next attempt to sustain or extend the pattern. Draw Current can drain 1 CP from a maintained pattern if it has stored CP or a sustaining creator. The GM determines which Bond talents make sense for a non-creature pattern. #### Conductive Touch Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package or Pressure Points sphere, CL 5+ When you hit a creature with an Unarmed Strike, natural weapon, or light melee weapon, you may spend 1 CP to create a Qi Bond to that creature without using a Bonus Action. If the target is unwilling, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The Qi Bond forms. Successful Save: No bond forms. #### Retune Current Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 5+ Cost: +1 CP When you activate a sphere technique that deals Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Psychic, Radiant, or Thunder damage, choose one damage type from that list that another sphere you know could plausibly produce. Change one damage roll of the technique to the chosen damage type. Retune Current cannot create a damage type that none of your known spheres can justify. #### Stabilizing Circuit Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 5+ When you apply Stable Modulation, you may also add your Proficiency Bonus to the first Concentration saving throw made for that technique before the start of your next turn. If another effect already adds your Proficiency Bonus to that save, do not add it twice. #### Sever Link Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 5+ Cost: +1 CP When you use Unweave Pattern against a mark, thread, seed, anchor, brand, or similar connection between two creatures, objects, or spaces, you may sever the connection without ending the entire parent technique. Examples include cutting a tracking mark, ending one creature’s Blood Thread, removing one Shadow Mark, disconnecting one pressure anchor, or breaking one talisman link. The GM determines whether a connection is separable. #### Regulated Breathing Prerequisite: Turbulence Package or Qi Bond Package, CL 5+ As an Action, choose one willing creature within 30 feet whose circulation is unstable, turbulent, poisoned by Qi deviation, or suffering from a temporary backlash effect. The target may immediately repeat one saving throw against that instability or backlash, adding your Key Ability modifier to the roll. A creature can benefit from your Regulated Breathing once per short rest. ### Core Formation Realm Qiweaving Talents #### Court of Ten Thousand Currents - Domain Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 30-foot Emanation Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Use Limit: Once per short rest You establish a Domain in which active Qi patterns become visible as braided currents. While the Domain lasts: you know the location of Active Qi Patterns inside the Domain that are not behind Total Cover; you have Advantage on Qiweaving Checks made against patterns inside the Domain; your Unweave Pattern and Qi Bond range extends to any valid target inside the Domain; once during each of your turns, you may apply one Modulation talent you know to a technique you activate without paying that Modulation’s additional CP cost, unless the talent’s cost is 3 CP or higher; when a willing creature inside the Domain activates a sphere technique, you may use your Reaction to grant it a +1 bonus to its Cultivation Save DC for that activation; when a hostile creature inside the Domain activates a sphere technique that costs CP, you may use your Reaction to force it to pay 1 additional CP or make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the technique is visibly distorted, and creatures have Advantage on the first saving throw they make against it before the end of the turn. A creature can be affected by only one cost increase from this Domain per turn. Court of Ten Thousand Currents is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove it unless the technique explicitly affects Domains. #### Grand Unweaving Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Cost: 3 CP Choose any number of Active Qi Patterns inside the area that you can perceive. Make one Qiweaving Check and compare the result to each chosen pattern’s DC separately. Success Against a Pattern: That pattern ends. Failure Against a Pattern: That pattern remains. Grand Unweaving cannot affect Domains, Secret Inheritances, Formation projects, artifacts, or campaign-scale workings unless a feature explicitly permits it. #### Seize Pattern Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 10+ Cost: +2 CP When you successfully counter a technique that targets one or more creatures or objects, you may reassign the technique’s targets instead of ending it. Choose new legal targets within the original range and targeting limits. If the technique requires Concentration, you take over Concentration for the original creator. The original creator cannot end the effect voluntarily while you concentrate on it. Seize Pattern cannot make an illegal target legal, change an area into a single target, or seize a Secret Inheritance. #### Shared Reservoir Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 10+ When you maintain Qi Bond on a willing creature, you and the bonded creature may transfer CP between yourselves as an Action. The creature giving CP chooses how much to give, up to your Proficiency Bonus. Transferred CP cannot exceed the recipient’s normal maximum CP. A creature can receive CP through your Shared Reservoir once per long rest. #### Circuit Lock Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 10+ Cost: 2 CP When you apply Throttle Current, you may intensify it into a Circuit Lock. The bonded target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, the target cannot spend more CP on a single technique than your Proficiency Bonus. Successful Save: Throttle Current applies normally. Circuit Lock does not prevent a creature from using a Secret Inheritance, but the inheritance’s visible Qi pattern may become strained or narratively exposed at the GM’s discretion. #### Twin-Sphere Modulation Prerequisite: Harmonic Package, CL 10+ When you activate a Harmonic talent requiring two spheres, you may apply one Modulation talent you know to that activation even if you already applied another Modulation this turn. You must still pay the Modulation’s cost. #### Reversible Pattern Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 10+ Cost: +2 CP When you activate a sphere technique with a duration of at least 1 minute, inscribe a reversible pattern into it. Once before the technique ends, you may use a Bonus Action to reverse one non-damaging directional choice made when the technique was created. Examples include: reverse the direction a rotating field moves; change which side of a line-shaped effect is safe; swap the inward or outward pressure of an area; reverse a permitted push into a pull if the original technique could plausibly support it. Reversible Pattern cannot change targets, change damage into healing, alter a saving throw type, or rewrite a technique’s basic identity. #### Turbulent Backlash Prerequisite: Turbulence Package, CL 10+ When a hostile creature fails its saving throw against your Turbulent Field, you may spend 1 CP. The creature takes Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus plus your Key Ability modifier, and it has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw it makes before the start of its next turn. ### Nascent Soul Realm Qiweaving Talents #### Sovereign Qiweaver Incarnation Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest You manifest the living embodiment of the woven current. Your eyes may become rings of script, your meridians may shine through the skin, or ten thousand invisible threads may hum through the battlefield. For the duration: you perceive Active Qi Patterns within 120 feet that are not behind Total Cover; your Unweave Pattern and Qi Bond range becomes 120 feet; once during each of your turns, you may use Unweave Pattern as a Bonus Action against a pattern with Pattern Rank no higher than your Proficiency Bonus; once per round, you may use Counterweave without expending Martial Focus; when you apply a Modulation talent to your own technique, reduce that Modulation’s CP cost by 1, minimum 0; when you successfully end an Active Qi Pattern, regain 1 CP. You may regain CP this way a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus during the incarnation; hostile creatures of your choice inside 30 feet have Disadvantage on checks made to conceal, disguise, or stabilize Active Qi Patterns. Sovereign Qiweaver Incarnation does not automatically affect Domains, Secret Inheritances, artifacts, or Formation projects. #### World-Circuit Severance Prerequisite: Unweaving Package, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Choose up to a number of Active Qi Patterns you can perceive within range equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Make one Qiweaving Check with Advantage. Compare the result to each chosen pattern’s DC. Success Against a Pattern: The pattern ends. Failure Against a Pattern: The pattern is suppressed until the start of your next turn instead. World-Circuit Severance may suppress a Domain until the start of your next turn on a successful check, but it does not end the Domain unless the Domain’s text permits it. #### Rewrite the Returning Breath Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A willing creature within 60 feet would spend CP Cost: 3 CP The triggering creature spends 1 less CP, minimum 0. Then choose one: the creature gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus plus your Key Ability modifier; the creature may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; the creature gains Advantage on the first Concentration saving throw it makes before the start of its next turn; the creature’s technique ignores one instance of Disadvantage on its first attack roll before the end of the turn. A creature can benefit from your Rewrite the Returning Breath once per long rest. #### Heaven-Tuned Modulation Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 15+ When you apply a Modulation talent to a technique you activate, choose one additional minor tuning: increase the technique’s range by 30 feet; increase one area dimension by 5 feet; extend a duration of 1 minute or longer by 1 round; add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll; impose Disadvantage on the first ability check made to identify or counter the technique before the end of your next turn. You may use Heaven-Tuned Modulation a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest. #### Calm the Wild Meridian Prerequisite: Turbulence Package, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 4 CP Choose one creature, object, Active Qi Pattern, or 20-foot-radius area suffering from wild Qi, Qi deviation, uncontrolled backlash, or unstable magical turbulence. Make a Qiweaving Check against the instability’s DC or 10 + its Pattern Rank. Successful Check: Suppress the instability for 1 minute. If it was caused by an ongoing effect with Pattern Rank no higher than your Proficiency Bonus, you may end it instead. Failed Check: The instability remains, but creatures of your choice inside the affected area have Advantage on saving throws against it until the start of your next turn. ### Secret Inheritance #### Return the Ten Thousand Currents to One Breath Classification: Secret Qiweaving Inheritance Prerequisite: Sovereign Qiweaver Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden Qiweaving scripture or equivalent sect transmission Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere Cost: 8 CP Use Limit: Once per week You name the first current beneath the battlefield. For one breath, every active technique inside the area remembers that it is only borrowed Qi. Choose any number of Active Qi Patterns inside the area that you can perceive. Make one Qiweaving Check with Advantage. Compare the result to each chosen pattern’s DC. ##### Success Against a Mortal, Foundation, or Core Pattern The pattern ends. ##### Success Against a Nascent Soul Pattern or Domain The pattern is suppressed until the end of your next turn. If the pattern’s text allows it to be ended by superior unweaving, it ends instead. ##### Success Against a Secret Inheritance, artifact, Formation project, or campaign-scale working The pattern is not ended. Choose one: suppress one non-central function until the start of your next turn; reveal one structural weakness, anchor, cost, or condition required to challenge it; prevent it from expanding, moving, or being reinforced until the start of your next turn; shield a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus from one immediate expression of it. ##### Failure Against a Pattern The pattern is exposed until the start of your next turn. Attacks and Qiweaving Checks against exposed patterns have Advantage, and creatures have Advantage on saving throws against exposed hostile patterns. ##### Aftermath After resolving the inheritance, choose a number of willing creatures inside the area up to your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1. Each chosen creature regains 1 CP or gains 1 Temporary CP if it is already at maximum CP. Then you lose access to Sovereign Qiweaver Incarnation until you finish a long rest. Return the Ten Thousand Currents to One Breath cannot permanently remove a Path, Realm, bloodline, soul, artifact, sect Formation, or destiny. It can reveal how such things are being sustained and create a moment in which they may be challenged. ### Optional Variants #### Pure Unweaver You cannot learn the Turbulence Package. Gain the Unweaving Package as your starting package and choose one Unweaving talent as a bonus talent. #### Gentle Circuit Keeper You cannot learn Draw Current, Turbulent Backlash, or any talent whose primary function is draining CP from an unwilling creature. Gain Feed Current as a bonus talent. #### Unstable Meridian Savant You must choose the Turbulence Package as your starting package. Whenever you create Turbulent Field, you may increase its radius by 5 feet. However, the first time each combat you activate a Qiweaving talent that costs CP, roll the campaign’s wild Qi or Qi-deviation check for yourself. #### Martial Meridian Tool You do not gain Minor Qi Arts from the Modulation Package. Gain Conductive Touch as a bonus talent when you first gain the Qi Bond Package or Modulation Package. You may use Unarmed Strikes, needles, light weapons, talisman brushes, or similar tools as the visible focus of your Qiweaving talents. ### Path Synergies #### Qi Cultivation Qi Cultivators are the natural masters of Qiweaving. They often express this sphere as: visible meridian diagrams; threadlike Qi extending from the fingers; floating script around active techniques; breath cycles that retune sphere effects; talisman seals that briefly label another cultivator’s working. Possible synergies: A Qi Cultivator may learn a Forged Technique that reduces the CP cost of one Qiweaving package ability once per short rest. A Qi Cultivator who knows three or more Power Spheres may treat Harmonic Package prerequisites as one CL lower for narrative training access, though normal mechanical CL prerequisites still apply. A Qi Cultivator’s sect may use Qiweaving as the foundation of formation inspection, technique repair, and scripture editing. #### Spirit Awakening Spirit Awakening expresses Qiweaving as resonance, intention, and spiritual pressure. A Spirit Awakener may not understand every mathematical current, but they can feel when a technique is lying about what sustains it. Possible synergies: A Spirit Awakener may use Wisdom for Qiweaving Checks when reading curses, possession, spiritual corruption, or soul-adjacent Active Qi Patterns. Qi Bond may appear as a harmonic tone, eye contact, ringing mantra, or thread of intent rather than literal Qi filament. Spirit Awakening plus Qiweaving is especially appropriate for exorcists, oath-breaker investigators, and judges of polluted technique lineages. #### Body Refining Body Refiners rarely become broad Qiweaving scholars unless trained by a specialized sect. When they do, they express the sphere through the body as instrument: striking a technique’s rhythm with a palm; grounding hostile Qi through the soles; catching a spell’s current in hardened meridians; disrupting a curse by breathing through the body’s inner furnace. Possible synergies: A Body Refiner may learn Martial Meridian Tool as an appropriate variant. A Body Refiner may create Forged Techniques that let Unarmed Strikes deliver Qi Bond, Sever Link, or Counterweave against nearby techniques. Body Refining plus Qiweaving should remain narrower than Qi Cultivation plus Qiweaving unless the character’s build invests heavily in this sphere. ### Cultivation Insights #### Circuit Scholar Prerequisite: Qiweaving sphere When you make an Intelligence check to identify a spell, sphere technique, talisman effect, or Active Qi Pattern, add your Proficiency Bonus if you are not already proficient. If you are proficient, add double your Proficiency Bonus. #### Calm Hands, Clear Current Prerequisite: Qiweaving sphere When you fail a Concentration saving throw for a Qiweaving talent or a technique modified by a Modulation talent, you may reroll the save. Use the new result. Once you use this Insight, you cannot use it again until you finish a short or long rest. #### Shared Breath Method Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package When you grant Temporary CP to a willing creature with Feed Current, that creature also gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Counter-Script Reflex Prerequisite: Counterweave, CL 5+ When you roll Initiative, you may regain Martial Focus if you know at least one hostile creature in the encounter can use magical or cultivation techniques. #### Stable Wild Meridian Prerequisite: Turbulence Package You have Advantage on saving throws against your own Turbulent Field and against wild Qi or Qi-deviation effects you created. #### Harmonic Memory Prerequisite: Harmonic Package, CL 10+ Choose one Harmonic talent you know. Once per long rest, when you activate that talent, reduce its CP cost by 1, minimum 0.

##### Qi Bond
Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature, object, or Active Qi Pattern
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
Attempt to form a thread between your circulation and the target’s Qi pattern.
A willing creature, an unattended object, or an Active Qi Pattern you created is bonded automatically.
Against an unwilling creature, attended object, or hostile Active Qi Pattern, make a ranged Cultivation Attack. If the target is an Active Qi Pattern, treat its AC as equal to its creator’s Cultivation Save DC. If the creator is unknown, use 10 + Pattern Rank.
Hit: Create a Qi Bond.
Miss: No bond forms.
While the bond lasts, you may use your Action on each of your turns to apply one Bond talent you know to the target.
Unless a Bond talent says otherwise, the Qi Bond ends if:
the target is ever outside your Qi Bond range;
the target has Total Cover from you;
you use your Action for anything other than applying or maintaining a Bond talent;
you lose Concentration.
###### Persistent Qi Bond
Augment - 2 CP: The Qi Bond persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the bond on your turn without spending an Action.

##### Turbulent Field
Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 5-foot-radius Emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: None
You emit a field of unstable Qi.
If the campaign uses wild magic or Qi-deviation rules, increase the instability chance of creatures inside the area by 50 percent.
If the campaign does not use a separate instability system, use the following fallback.
The first time on a turn that a creature inside the area activates a technique that costs CP or casts a spell using a spell slot, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: The technique is Turbulent until it resolves. A Turbulent technique suffers one complication chosen by the GM or rolled from a campaign-appropriate table, such as visible backlash, noisy activation, reduced range, accidental self-exposure, or minor damage to an unattended nearby object.
The fallback complication should be inconvenient but should not normally waste the technique unless another Turbulence talent says so.
The area radius increases by Realm:
Cultivation Level: 1-4 - Radius: 5 feet
Cultivation Level: 5-10 - Radius: 10 feet
Cultivation Level: 11-16 - Radius: 15 feet
Cultivation Level: 17-20 - Radius: 20 feet
###### Lingering Turbulence
Augment - 2 CP: The Turbulent Field persists for its remaining duration without Concentration.
You may apply this augment after creating the field on your turn without spending an Action.

##### Unweave Pattern
Classification: Base Qiweaving Ability
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature, object, location, or Active Qi Pattern
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: None
Attempt to end one Active Qi Pattern on the target.
If the pattern’s Pattern Rank is equal to or lower than half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, it ends automatically.
Otherwise, make a Qiweaving Check against the pattern.
Successful Check: The pattern ends.
Failed Check: The pattern remains.
Unweave Pattern cannot end a Domain, Secret Inheritance, Formation project, artifact-level effect, or campaign-scale working unless a talent, project, or GM ruling explicitly permits it.
###### Rapid Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: Reduce the Action Type to Action.
If you Ready this Action to disrupt a technique as it is activated, resolve Unweave Pattern when the triggering technique is being created. On a successful check, the technique fails and any Action, CP, spell slot, or limited use spent on it is lost.
###### Broad Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: Attempt to unweave a number of additional Active Qi Patterns on the same target equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down.
Make a separate Qiweaving Check for each pattern that is not ended automatically.
###### Certain Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: The automatic-ending threshold becomes your Proficiency Bonus instead of half your Proficiency Bonus.

Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: 30 feet
Target: One creature, object, location, or Active Qi Pattern
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: None
Attempt to end one Active Qi Pattern on the target.
If the pattern’s Pattern Rank is equal to or lower than half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down, it ends automatically.
Otherwise, make a Qiweaving Check against the pattern.
Successful Check: The pattern ends.
Failed Check: The pattern remains.
Unweave Pattern cannot end a Domain, Secret Inheritance, Formation project, artifact-level effect, or campaign-scale working unless a talent, project, or GM ruling explicitly permits it.
###### Rapid Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: Reduce the Action Type to Action.
If you Ready this Action to disrupt a technique as it is activated, resolve Unweave Pattern when the triggering technique is being created. On a successful check, the technique fails and any Action, CP, spell slot, or limited use spent on it is lost.
###### Broad Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: Attempt to unweave a number of additional Active Qi Patterns on the same target equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down.
Make a separate Qiweaving Check for each pattern that is not ended automatically.
###### Certain Unweave
Augment - 1 CP: The automatic-ending threshold becomes your Proficiency Bonus instead of half your Proficiency Bonus.
