spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Radiance Qi Expression: Primary — Radiant Qi; Supporting — Light Qi, Fire Qi, Purification Qi, Yang Qi. “Light shows the road. Radiance asks whether the road can bear the truth of morning.” Sphere Type: Power Sphere Primary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Body Refining through Diamond Light Body Resource: CP; rare Body Refining expressions may spend Stamina when an explicit feature permits it Common Effects: spiritual brilliance, revelation, purification, blindness, dawn marks, anti-corruption pressure, radiant wards, consecrated auras, possession disruption, solar judgment, truth-bearing light Radiance cultivates spiritual brilliance: revealing falsehood, marking corruption, blinding through overwhelming truth, warding allies with dawnlight, and purifying unclean Qi. ### Player-Facing Rules #### Radiance Dao Radiance is the cultivation of brilliance that judges what it reveals. Light makes a thing visible. Radiance makes a thing answer for what it has become. A lantern can show a hidden door. A mirror can bend a beam. A prism can scatter color. Those are the arts of Light. Radiance begins when brightness becomes spiritual pressure: the dawn that exposes corruption, the halo that steadies a frightened heart, the sun-bright palm that burns possession out of a body, the unbearable crown of truth before which falsehood, rot, undeath, and spiritual pollution cannot pretend to be whole. A novice learns to shine. An adept learns to reveal. A master learns to purify without destroying what can still be saved. A sovereign learns that some darkness is not absence of light, but a lie waiting for judgment. The Radiance loop is: Kindle dawn. Strike, glow, or consecrate a space with visible spiritual brilliance. Dawnmark the unclean or concealed. Make the target’s false state harder to maintain. Reveal or purify. Choose whether the moment requires sight, cleansing, protection, or judgment. Press the truth. Use Blinding, Ward, Purification, or Revelation talents to force a response. Become the dawn. At higher Realms, the cultivator no longer merely creates radiance; their presence becomes the light by which corruption is measured. After fighting a Radiance cultivator for two rounds, an enemy should understand one truth: The body can hide in darkness. The soul cannot hide from dawn. #### Rules Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. ##### Invisible and Hidden Under the 2024 rules, a creature can gain the Invisible condition from the Hide action while it remains hidden, and the state can end when the creature makes noise, attacks, casts certain spells, or is found. Radiance often says a creature “cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible” or “cannot hide through ordinary visual concealment.” This means the listed technique prevents the relevant concealment benefit while the creature is within the radiance or bears the relevant mark. It does not automatically reveal exact position through Total Cover unless the talent explicitly says so. ##### Blinded Radiance uses the ordinary Blinded condition. A creature without sight normally has no eyes to blind, but Radiance may still affect it with non-visual spiritual pressure when a talent says so. Many Radiance effects allow sightless creatures to avoid the Blinded condition while still suffering the non-visual portion, such as losing Reactions or taking radiant damage. ##### Concentration Radiance auras, courts, and zones use Concentration unless they say otherwise. Persistent, Domain, Nascent Soul, and Secret techniques state their own Concentration requirements. ##### Magical Darkness and Supernatural Concealment Ordinary light removes ordinary darkness. Supernatural Darkness, Shadow concealment, Void concealment, Smoke, Illusion, and specialized stealth techniques may require explicit Radiance talents to contest. When a talent says it suppresses a darkness or concealment effect of lower Realm or non-Legendary rank, equal or superior effects may require an opposed Cultivation Check or remain unaffected at the GM’s discretion. ##### Radiant Damage Radiant damage represents spiritual brilliance, solar judgment, holy light, cleansing force, or truth-bearing pressure. A creature may be described as charred by light, burned from within, outlined by dawnfire, or struck by a beam of white-gold Qi. ##### Healing and Purification Radiance may remove conditions, suppress curses, cleanse spiritual contamination, reduce damage, and improve saving throws. It does not automatically restore lost HP unless a talent explicitly heals. #### Core Radiance Rules ##### CP Radiance is normally a CP sphere. When a Radiance talent lists a CP cost, pay that cost from your Path’s cultivation pool unless a Path synergy, Insight, or rare variant explicitly permits Stamina or another resource. ##### Dawnmark A Dawnmark is a visible or spiritually perceptible brand of radiance placed on a creature, object, or 5-foot space. Unless a talent says otherwise: a Dawnmark lasts until the start of your next turn; a creature may bear only one Dawnmark you created at a time; a Dawnmark sheds Dim Light in its space; a Dawnmark is not a tracking mark; it does not reveal exact position through Total Cover; it does not automatically pierce sealed barriers, planar separation, or specialized concealment; a Dawnmark allows you to apply Mark talents to the target. A Dawnmark represents spiritual exposure. A marked creature’s falsehood, corruption, fear, possession, or concealment has been touched by dawn, even if the full judgment has not yet arrived. ##### Unclean Targets Some Radiance talents become stronger against Unclean targets. A creature or effect may count as Unclean if it is: undead; a demon, fiend, corrupted spirit, or possession entity; a creature currently possessing another creature; a creature currently possessed; a creature bearing obvious spiritual corruption; a creature benefiting from a corruption-derived temporary feature; a curse, disease, poison, or spiritual contamination when a talent can legally target that effect; another target the GM identifies as spiritually impure, profane, or dawn-opposed in the campaign setting. Unclean is a Radiance classification, not a universal creature type. It should be applied by fiction, stat block, active effect, or GM ruling. ##### Purification Limits Radiance can cleanse many things, but it does not automatically erase story-scale curses or major cultivation consequences. A Radiance talent may require a Cultivation Check, special materials, a higher-Realm technique, a Forged Technique, or a narrative scene when targeting: a curse created by a stronger cultivator; a bloodline curse; a sect inheritance seal; a divine punishment; a possession supported by an artifact or Formation; an oath, debt, karma, or legal-spiritual contract; a corruption that has become part of the target’s cultivation base. ##### Radiant Light Radiance may create Bright Light or Dim Light. Unless a talent says otherwise, this light is visible, spiritual, and recognizable as a cultivation effect. Radiant light can be beautiful, painful, golden, white, red-gold, dawn-pink, blue-white, halo-like, or scripture-specific. Radiant light does not automatically create hard-light objects, bridges, mirrors, lasers, optical camouflage, or refraction effects. Those belong primarily to Light unless a Radiance talent explicitly creates a consecrated surface. ##### Mark Talents A talent with the Mark tag modifies Dawnmark or provides a new way to exploit a Dawnmarked target. Unless a talent says otherwise: apply only one Mark talent when placing a Dawnmark; a Mark talent does not create a Dawnmark by itself unless it says so; a Mark talent does not make an invalid target valid; a Dawnmark must still be present when the Mark effect resolves. ##### Purification Talents A talent with the Purification tag removes, suppresses, or contests harmful conditions, curses, diseases, poisons, spiritual contamination, possession, corruption, or related effects. ##### Aura Talents A talent with the Aura tag creates a zone of radiance centered on you or a point. Auras usually use Concentration and provide benefits or pressure while creatures remain inside. ##### Ward Talents A talent with the Ward tag protects a creature from damage, fear, charm, possession, necrotic pressure, or corruption. ##### Revelation Talents A talent with the Revelation tag exposes falsehood, disguise, concealment, possession signs, hidden writing, spiritual residue, or corruption. ##### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents Radiance cultivation beyond ordinary magical light. #### Base Sphere Abilities ##### Radiance Training When you learn Radiance, choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as your Radiance ability. Use your Radiance ability for Radiance attack rolls, Radiance saving throw DCs, and Radiance checks unless your Path or a talent says otherwise. Your Radiance Save DC equals: 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Radiance ability modifier Your Radiance Attack Modifier equals: your Proficiency Bonus + your Radiance ability modifier ##### Radiance Strike Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: None Release a focused stroke of spiritual brilliance. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal Radiant damage and apply your Dawnmark until the start of your next turn. Cultivation Level: 1-4; Damage: 1d8 Cultivation Level: 5-10; Damage: 2d8 Cultivation Level: 11-16; Damage: 3d8 Cultivation Level: 17-20; Damage: 4d8 Once per turn, if Radiance Strike damages an Unclean target, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll. ##### Glow Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Target: Yourself, one willing creature, or one unattended object Duration: 1 hour or until dismissed Cost: None Cause the target to shed Bright Light in a 10-foot radius and Dim Light for an additional 10 feet. You may dismiss a Glow you created without spending an Action. A creature or object bearing your Glow is not hidden by ordinary darkness, but Glow does not automatically reveal hidden creatures, defeat Invisible, or pierce magical concealment. #### Mortal Realm Talents ##### Blinding Flash - Aura Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 15-foot cone or 10-foot-radius Emanation originating from you Cost: 2 CP Release a sudden burst of overwhelming brilliance. Creatures of your choice inside the area make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Blinded until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. A creature without sight automatically succeeds against the Blinded portion but still cannot take Reactions on a successful save result. ##### Solar Flare - Aura Prerequisite: Blinding Flash When you use Blinding Flash, pay +2 CP. The flash also deals Radiant damage. Cultivation Level: 1-10; Damage: 2d6 Cultivation Level: 11-16; Damage: 4d6 Cultivation Level: 17-20; Damage: 6d6 A creature that succeeds on its saving throw takes half damage and is not Blinded. ##### Revealing Light - Revelation, Aura Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 20-foot-radius Emanation originating from you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP You surround yourself with searching dawnlight. Inside the aura: ordinary darkness is suppressed; ordinary Invisible provides no benefit against creatures that can see the target; creatures have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks relying on visual concealment; ordinary disguises, false faces, and obvious illusions become visibly strained; hidden writing, concealed doors, fresh blood, lingering spiritual residue, and signs of corruption are easier to detect; a creature bearing your Dawnmark cannot benefit from ordinary visual concealment. Revealing Light does not automatically answer questions, reveal exact squares through Total Cover, or defeat Legendary or Secret concealment. ##### Dawn Ward - Ward Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or one ally within 30 feet takes damage Cost: 1 CP A flash of dawnlight catches the harm before it settles. Reduce the triggering damage by the amount shown below. Cultivation Level: 1-10; Damage Reduction: 1d8 + Radiance ability modifier Cultivation Level: 11-16; Damage Reduction: 2d8 + Radiance ability modifier Cultivation Level: 17-20; Damage Reduction: 3d8 + Radiance ability modifier If the triggering damage is Necrotic, Radiant, Psychic from fear or possession, or damage dealt by an Unclean creature, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction. ##### Gentle Dawn - Purification, Ward Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Target: One willing creature Cost: 1 CP You place a soft dawn glow over the target’s brow, heart, or meridians. Choose one: the target may immediately repeat a saving throw against Charmed or Frightened; the target may immediately repeat a saving throw against Poisoned; suppress one ordinary fear, despair, nausea, or spiritual chill effect on the target until the start of your next turn; grant Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Radiance ability modifier. A creature may gain Temporary HP from your Gentle Dawn only once per short rest. ##### Expose False Form - Mark, Revelation When you apply Dawnmark to a creature, you may pay 1 CP. Until the Dawnmark ends: the target cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible; the target has Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks relying on visual concealment; ordinary disguises and illusions covering the target visibly shimmer; attacks against the target ignore ordinary visual concealment if the attacker can see the Dawnmark. Expose False Form does not reveal exact position through Total Cover or automatically defeat superior illusion or transformation techniques. ##### Mercy of Morning - Ward Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: One creature bearing your Glow or Dawnmark Cost: 1 CP Choose one: end one ordinary frightened response that is not a full condition; grant the target Advantage on its next saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, or possession before the end of your next turn; allow the target to stand from Prone without spending movement; allow the target to move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Mercy of Morning is a stabilizing blessing, not a major healing effect. ##### Dawnlit Rebuke - Mark When a creature bearing your Dawnmark damages one of your allies within 60 feet, you may use your Reaction and pay 1 CP. The creature takes Radiant damage equal to: 1d8 + your Radiance ability modifier At CL 11, increase the damage to 2d8 + your Radiance ability modifier. At CL 17, increase the damage to 3d8 + your Radiance ability modifier. If the creature is Unclean, it cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn. ##### Consecrated Lantern - Revelation When you create Glow, you may make it a Consecrated Lantern. A Consecrated Lantern lasts 8 hours instead of 1 hour. While a creature carries or wears it, the creature gains Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to notice: fresh spiritual residue; signs of possession; hidden writing; concealed bloodstains; undead traces; corruption marks; an object or creature already bearing your Dawnmark. You may maintain a number of Consecrated Lanterns equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ##### Searing Halo - Aura Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP A sharp halo forms behind your head, weapon, palm, or back. For the duration: you shed Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for another 20 feet; once per turn when Radiance Strike hits, deal +1d8 Radiant damage; a creature that hits you with a melee attack while within 5 feet takes Radiant damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus; you gain Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened by Unclean creatures. #### Foundation Realm Talents ##### Dawnmark Scripture - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Your Dawnmark becomes a stable spiritual brand rather than a momentary gleam. Gain the following benefits: your Dawnmark lasts until the end of your next turn; your Dawnmark sheds Bright Light in its space and Dim Light for 5 feet; when a creature bearing your Dawnmark starts its turn, you may choose to make the mark flare; if you do, the creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; once per turn when you damage an Unclean creature bearing your Dawnmark, add 1d8 Radiant damage; you may use Mark talents on a Dawnmarked target within 60 feet even if you cannot currently see the target, provided you know its direction and there is a legal route for the technique. Dawnmark Scripture does not reveal exact position through Total Cover or bypass sealed barriers. ##### Purifying Radiance - Purification Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Cost: 3 CP Touch one willing creature and choose one: end Poisoned; remove one ordinary disease; end Charmed or Frightened; suppress one curse for 1 hour; cleanse ordinary spiritual contamination; allow the target to immediately repeat a saving throw against possession or corruption with Advantage. A stronger curse, disease, possession, or spiritual contamination may require a Cultivation Check against the creator’s Save DC or an appropriate DC set by the GM. ###### Burning Purification Instead of cleansing a willing creature, make a melee Cultivation Attack against one Unclean creature within reach. Hit: Deal 4d8 Radiant damage. The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn. At CL 11, increase the damage to 6d8. At CL 17, increase the damage to 8d8. ##### Daybreak Seal - Mark, Purification Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you damage a creature bearing your Dawnmark, you may pay 2 CP. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot regain HP and cannot gain Temporary HP. Successful Save: The target cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn. If the target is Unclean, it has Disadvantage on the saving throw. ##### Radiant Exorcism Palm - Purification Prerequisite: Purifying Radiance, CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Cost: 4 CP Touch one creature affected by possession, spiritual contamination, curse pressure, or an attached unclean entity. Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s Save DC or a DC set by the GM. Success: Suppress one visible possession, corruption, or curse-derived temporary benefit until the end of your next turn. If the effect is ordinary for the target’s Realm, also grant the host Advantage on its next saving throw to resist or end that effect. Failure: The target becomes Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn, but the effect is not suppressed. Radiant Exorcism Palm does not automatically end a major possession, remove a bloodline curse, or destroy a bound spirit. ##### Dawn Step - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Cost: 1 CP Step through a line of dawnlight to an unoccupied space you can see. The origin or destination must be in Bright Light, bear your Glow, or be adjacent to a creature or object bearing your Dawnmark. This movement: does not provoke Opportunity Attacks; does not pass through solid objects; cannot cross a sealed Barrier or Dimensional Lock; leaves a visible streak of radiance until the start of your next turn. Dawn Step is short spiritual movement, not the high-speed optical movement of the Light sphere. ##### Judgment Ray - Strike Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120-foot line, 5 feet wide Cost: 3 CP Release a straight beam of dawn judgment. Creatures in the line make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take Radiant damage and become Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and become Dawnmarked until the start of your next turn. Cultivation Level: 5-10; Damage: 4d6 Cultivation Level: 11-16; Damage: 6d6 Cultivation Level: 17-20; Damage: 8d6 Judgment Ray ignores Half Cover and ordinary visual concealment. It does not ignore Total Cover. ##### Radiant Aegis of the Heart - Ward Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: One willing creature Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Wrap the target’s heart, soul, or core in gentle radiance. For the duration, the target gains: Resistance to Necrotic damage; Advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened; Advantage on saving throws against possession attempts; when the target succeeds on a save against Charmed, Frightened, or possession, it may move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. A creature may benefit from only one Radiant Aegis of the Heart you created at a time. ##### Mirror of Clean Dawn - Revelation, Ward Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within 60 feet makes a saving throw against an illusion, disguise, possession, fear, charm, or corruption effect Cost: 2 CP A dawn mirror appears behind the target, showing the true outline of the threat. The target gains a bonus to the triggering saving throw equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If the saving throw succeeds, the creature that created the triggering effect becomes Dawnmarked until the start of your next turn if it is within 60 feet and not behind Total Cover. ##### Consecrated Boundary - Aura, Purification Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Create an area of quiet dawnlight. Inside the area: allies gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and corruption; Unclean creatures treat the area as difficult terrain; an Unclean creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Wisdom saving throw; ordinary spiritual contamination is suppressed. Failed Save: The Unclean creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn and takes Radiant damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your Radiance ability modifier. Successful Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Consecrated Boundary is not a physical Barrier and does not block movement by ordinary creatures. ##### Unhidden Stain Sight - Revelation Prerequisite: CL 5+ While you are in Bright Light, your Glow, a Consecrated Boundary, or your Revealing Light, you may use a Bonus Action to inspect one creature or object you can see within 60 feet. Make a Wisdom (Insight), Intelligence (Investigation), or Cultivation Check against the target’s passive Deception, passive Stealth, or an appropriate DC set by the GM. Success: Learn whether the target bears one of the following obvious spiritual conditions: possession; undeath; active corruption; a curse currently affecting behavior; a disguise or illusion covering its true form; a recent contact with an Unclean force. This does not identify the exact source, full stat block, future intention, or hidden name of the effect. #### Core Formation Realm Talents ##### Court of Unshadowed Dawn - Domain “Every shadow in the court understood that it was only waiting for permission to confess.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot-radius Emanation originating from you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP Use Limit: Once per short rest Create a Domain of judgment-bearing dawn. Inside the Domain, you and allies you designate gain the following benefits: Resistance to Necrotic damage; Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and corruption; ordinary Darkness and Dim Light do not impose penalties on sight; ordinary Blinded effects caused by light or darkness are suppressed at the start of the ally’s turn; once per round when an ally succeeds on a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, possession, or corruption, that ally gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Enemies inside the Domain suffer the following effects: ordinary Invisible provides no benefit; ordinary visual concealment cannot be used to Hide from creatures inside the Domain; disguises and illusions visibly strain; Unclean creatures cannot regain HP while inside the Domain; when a hostile creature starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution or Wisdom saving throw, your choice when you create the Domain. Failed Save: Choose one: the creature is Blinded until the start of its next turn; the creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; the creature takes 2d8 Radiant damage; the creature cannot regain HP or gain Temporary HP until the start of its next turn; suppress one ordinary corruption-derived temporary benefit on the creature until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. A sightless creature automatically succeeds against the Blinded option but remains subject to the non-visual effects. ##### Solar Radiance Form - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 8 CP Manifest a perfected halo, dawn mantle, or solar crown of Radiance. For the duration: you shed Bright Light in a 30-foot radius and Dim Light for another 30 feet; you gain Resistance to Radiant and Necrotic damage; Radiance Strike deals +1d8 Radiant damage; a creature that hits you with a melee attack while within 10 feet takes 2d6 Radiant damage; once per turn when Radiance Strike hits a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Blinded until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Unclean creatures have Disadvantage on the saving throw. ##### Dawn-Cleansing Wave - Purification, Aura Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot cone Cost: 6 CP Release a wave of purifying brilliance. Allies in the area may immediately repeat one saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned, possession, or corruption. Hostile creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take 6d8 Radiant damage, become Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn, and cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and become Dawnmarked until the start of your next turn. If an Unclean creature fails the saving throw, suppress one ordinary corruption-derived temporary benefit on it until the end of your next turn. ##### Halo of the Merciful Sovereign - Ward Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One willing creature Duration: 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Place a stable halo over the target. For the duration: the target sheds Bright Light in a 10-foot radius; the target has Resistance to Necrotic damage; the target has Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and corruption; when the target takes damage from an Unclean creature, reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus; when the target succeeds on a save against Charmed, Frightened, possession, or corruption, one hostile creature within 10 feet of the target becomes Dawnmarked until the start of your next turn. This Halo does not require Concentration, but you may maintain only one Halo of the Merciful Sovereign at a time. ##### Scour the Unclean - Mark, Purification Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you damage an Unclean creature bearing your Dawnmark, you may pay 3 CP. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Suppress one visible corruption-derived temporary benefit until the end of your next turn. The target also cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Suppress one visible corruption-derived temporary benefit until the start of your next turn. Examples of corruption-derived benefits include temporary regeneration from undeath, possession-granted resistance, demonic concealment, an unclean aura, a corruption-created natural weapon, or a temporary curse boon. Scour the Unclean does not suppress class features, Path features, ordinary biology, or a Secret Inheritance unless the GM rules the feature is explicitly corruption-derived and vulnerable to Radiance. ##### Dawn Gate Ward - Aura, Ward Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 6 CP Create a gate of vertical dawnlight. Choose one creature type, force, or condition when creating the Ward, such as undead, demons, possession entities, creatures bearing a specific corruption, or creatures currently maintaining magical Darkness. A creature matching the chosen category that attempts to enter or leave the area must make a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Its movement fails for that attempt, and it becomes Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: It may move normally, but it cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible or visual concealment until the start of your next turn. Dawn Gate Ward is not a complete prison. It does not block teleportation, planar travel, ethereal movement, or superior movement techniques unless a Forged Technique or higher-Realm feature says otherwise. ##### Heaven-Reading Dawnbeam - Revelation Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: 5 CP Choose one creature, object, corpse, doorway, seal, or obvious magical effect you can see. A pillar of radiance falls across the target. Make a Cultivation Check against the target’s Save DC, the creator’s Save DC, or a DC set by the GM. Success: Learn up to two of the following: whether it is Unclean; whether it is possessed or serving as a possession anchor; whether it bears a curse or spiritual contamination; whether it is disguised or under an illusion; whether it recently harmed a creature through necrotic, radiant, fear, charm, or possession pressure; whether it is maintaining a concealment effect; whether one obvious corruption-derived benefit is active. Failure: Learn one obvious surface truth and apply Dawnmark until the start of your next turn if the target is a creature. This talent does not reveal a target’s full statistics, future actions, secret name, or complete history. ##### Sun-White Judgment Spear - Strike Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 180 feet Cost: 6 CP Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal 6d8 Radiant damage and apply Dawnmark until the end of your next turn. The attack ignores Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover, ordinary Darkness, ordinary visual concealment, and ordinary disguises. If the target is Unclean, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It is Blinded and cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. ##### Consecrated Recovery Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you use a Radiance talent to end, suppress, or grant a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Poisoned, possession, corruption, disease, or curse, choose one affected willing creature. That creature gains Temporary HP equal to: 2 × your Proficiency Bonus A creature can gain this Temporary HP from you only once per short rest. #### Nascent Soul Realm Talents ##### Heavenly Radiance - The Undying Dawn “The night did not end. It was simply made too honest to continue.” Prerequisite: CL 15+, Solar Radiance Form Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Concentration: Not required Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Transform into an incarnation of sovereign dawn. For the duration: gain Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover; gain Immunity to Radiant damage; gain Resistance to Necrotic, Fire, and Psychic damage; shed Bright Light in a 120-foot radius and Dim Light for another 120 feet; suppress non-Legendary magical Darkness, ordinary illusion concealment, ordinary invisibility, and ordinary fear auras inside your Bright Light; Radiance Strike deals 8d10 Radiant damage instead of its normal damage; once per turn when Radiance Strike hits an Unclean target, suppress one visible corruption-derived temporary benefit until the start of your next turn. ###### Solar Aura When a hostile creature starts its turn within 20 feet of you, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take 4d10 Radiant damage and become Blinded until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. A creature is affected by Solar Aura only once per turn. ###### Dawn Wave While Heavenly Radiance is active, when you use Radiance Strike, you may instead release one of the following: a single-target beam with a range of 120 feet; a 60-foot line, 10 feet wide; a 30-foot cone. The line and cone require Dexterity saving throws for half damage instead of attack rolls. Creatures that fail are Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn. When the transformation ends, gain 1 level of Exhaustion unless you ended the encounter with at least half your maximum CP remaining. ##### World of Revealed Morning Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Fill the area with overwhelming revealed morning. Inside the area, allies you designate gain: Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage; Advantage on checks made to detect hidden creatures, possession, curses, and spiritual contamination; Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and corruption; immunity to ordinary Blinded effects caused by light or darkness; the ability to ignore ordinary Darkness and ordinary visual concealment. Hostile creatures inside suffer: ordinary Invisible fails; ordinary illusions and disguises visibly shimmer; ordinary Darkness disappears; corruption marks, undead residue, possession anchors, and fresh spiritual stains become visible; Unclean creatures cannot regain HP and cannot gain Temporary HP. When a hostile creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take 4d8 Radiant damage and become Blinded until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. A creature takes this damage only once per turn. ##### Sever the Possessing Shadow - Purification Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 10 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Choose one creature you can see that is possessed, spiritually contaminated, or serving as an anchor for an Unclean force. Make a Cultivation Check against the possessing or corrupting effect’s Save DC. If the effect has no Save DC, use the responsible creature’s Save DC or a DC set by the GM. Success: Suppress the possession or corruption until the end of your next turn. During that time, the host may immediately repeat one saving throw or contested check to end or weaken the effect with Advantage. If the effect is ordinary for its Realm, it ends instead. Failure: The effect is not suppressed, but the host gains Advantage on its next saving throw against it before the end of your next turn. If the possessing or corrupting entity is present within 60 feet, it becomes Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn and takes 6d8 Radiant damage. Sever the Possessing Shadow does not automatically destroy a soul, kill a host, erase a campaign-defining curse, or override a Secret Inheritance. ##### Heaven-Opening Judgment Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300-foot line, 10 feet wide Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Release a colossal beam of pure Radiance. Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take 12d10 Radiant damage, become Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn, and cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and become Dawnmarked until the start of your next turn. The beam ignores: Half Cover; Three-Quarters Cover; ordinary concealment; ordinary Darkness; non-Legendary magical Darkness; one ordinary Radiant Resistance; up to 5 feet of ordinary wood, packed earth, or unworked stone. Structures and unattended objects take double damage. Heaven-Opening Judgment does not ignore Total Cover created by Legendary, Secret, artifact, Formation, or Realm-defining defenses unless a separate contest permits it. ##### Crown of the Unblinking Sun Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 10 CP A crown of unwavering dawn appears above you. For the duration: you cannot be Blinded; you gain Truesight out to 30 feet, but only for perceiving illusions, disguises, possession signs, magical darkness, and spiritual corruption; your Radiance talents affect incorporeal Unclean creatures normally; when an Unclean creature fails a save against your Radiance talent, it also cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; once per turn, when you apply Dawnmark, you may extend it to one additional hostile creature within 10 feet of the original target. The Truesight granted by this talent does not reveal every secret door, ethereal creature, or planar boundary unrelated to Radiance’s purifying scope. ##### Resurrection of the Morning Breath - Ward, Purification Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A willing creature within 60 feet would drop to 0 HP due to damage from an Unclean creature, Necrotic damage, a curse, possession, or corruption Cost: 8 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest A dawn breath catches the creature at the edge of collapse. The creature drops to 1 HP instead of 0 HP. Then choose one: end Frightened or Charmed on the creature; suppress one possession or corruption effect on the creature until the start of your next turn; move the creature up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see without provoking Opportunity Attacks; deal 4d8 Radiant damage to the triggering creature if it is within 60 feet and not behind Total Cover. Resurrection of the Morning Breath is not full resurrection and cannot restore a dead creature. #### Secret Radiance Inheritance ##### First Dawn Before Falsehood “Before the first mask, before the first grave refused rest, before the first shadow learned to lie, there was morning.” Classification: Secret Radiance Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Heavenly Radiance, hidden primordial-dawn inheritance Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 90-foot-radius Emanation originating from you Duration: 1 minute Concentration: Required Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week You manifest the memory of the world’s first dawn. Inside the area, the following effects are suppressed unless created by a Legendary or Secret technique, artifact, major Formation, divine source, or Realm-defining phenomenon: ordinary Invisible; ordinary illusions and disguises; ordinary Darkness and non-Legendary magical Darkness; ordinary fear auras; ordinary charm-based glamour; possession concealment; visible corruption-derived temporary benefits; hidden writing and concealed spiritual residue; shadow travel that relies on ordinary or non-Legendary shadows. A Legendary or Secret concealment, corruption, possession, or darkness effect may resist with an opposed Cultivation Check. When you create the Emanation, hostile creatures of your choice inside make Wisdom saving throws. Unclean creatures have Disadvantage. Failed Save: Choose three different consequences for that creature: take 8d10 Radiant damage; become Blinded until the end of your next turn; cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn; cannot regain HP or gain Temporary HP until the end of your next turn; suppress one corruption-derived temporary benefit until the end of your next turn; end one ordinary invisibility, disguise, or illusion covering it; force a possessing entity to reveal itself and lose the benefit of concealment until the end of your next turn; apply Dawnmark for the full duration of the inheritance. Successful Save: Choose one consequence other than the full-duration Dawnmark. Allies of your choice inside the Emanation immediately gain the following benefits: may repeat one saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, possession, corruption, Poisoned, or a curse; gain Temporary HP equal to 3 × your Proficiency Bonus; may see ordinary Invisible and ordinary illusion-covered creatures revealed by the inheritance; cannot be Blinded by ordinary light or darkness while inside the Emanation. First Dawn Before Falsehood cannot automatically: destroy a god; erase an entire bloodline curse; break a campaign-defining oath; reveal every secret in a city; identify every spy without evidence; override a Secret Inheritance without a contest; purify a willing villain who has made corruption part of their Dao; turn Radiance into unrestricted Divination. When the inheritance ends, choose one Dawnmark created by it. That Dawnmark lasts until the end of your next turn. #### Radiance Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures ##### Gentle Dawn Variant You do not gain the damage bonus against Unclean targets from Radiance Strike. Gain Gentle Dawn as a bonus talent. You may choose to make any Radiance damage you deal nonlethal when the target is a living creature not currently possessed by an Unclean entity. ##### Blinding Mercy Variant Your Blinding Flash cannot impose the Blinded condition. When a creature would be Blinded by your Radiance talent, it instead cannot take Reactions and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of your next turn. Gain one Ward or Purification talent as a bonus talent. ##### Diamond Light Body Variant You may learn Radiance as a Body Refiner only if you possess the Diamond Light Body Cultivation Insight, an appropriate inheritance, or a feature that explicitly grants access. When using this variant, your radiance is expressed through refined skin, bone, eyes, breath, and meridians rather than external Qi alone. ##### Hidden Lamp Variant You cannot use Glow to create obvious Bright Light unless you spend 1 CP. Gain Consecrated Lantern as a bonus talent. Your Consecrated Lantern may be visible only to creatures you designate. This variant suits spies, exorcists, and wandering physicians who conceal their dawnlight until the moment of judgment. #### Path Synergies ##### Qi Cultivation - Refined Dawn Circulation A Qi cultivator treats Radiance as the refinement of clean, bright Qi that moves through the meridians like morning through mist. Once per turn, when you spend CP on a Radiance talent that deals damage, reduces damage, grants Temporary HP, or removes a condition, add your Radiance ability modifier to one damage, reduction, or Temporary HP roll. When you use Purifying Radiance, reduce its CP cost by 1, minimum 1. ##### Spirit Awakening - Illumination of the Soul A Spirit Awakening cultivator may use Wisdom as their Radiance ability. Your Radiance talents may affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal Unclean creatures, possession entities, and soul-based corruption normally when the talent’s fiction permits it. When you use a Purification talent on a creature, that creature gains Advantage on its next saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, possession, or corruption before the end of your next turn. When you apply Dawnmark to an Unclean spirit or possession entity, you know whether the mark is attached to the host, the possessing entity, or both. ##### Body Refining - Diamond Light Body A Body Refiner may learn Radiance through the Diamond Light Body Insight or an appropriate inheritance. When using Diamond Light Body: use Constitution as your Radiance ability; you may spend Stamina instead of CP on Radiance talents that target yourself, originate from your body, or protect a creature within 10 feet; you may describe Radiance Strike as a palm flash, eye beam, bone-glow, forehead lamp, or radiant breath; once per short rest, when a ranged Cultivation Attack hits you, use your Reaction to reduce the damage by 2d8 + Constitution modifier; if this reduces the damage to 0, the attacker takes Radiant damage equal to your Constitution modifier + Proficiency Bonus. ##### Cross-Sphere Notes Radiance + Life creates healing light, recovery from spiritual contamination, and dawn medicine. Radiance + Fire creates burning judgment, white flame, and purifying conflagrations. Radiance + Sun creates full solar exorcism, divine noon courts, and overwhelming solar revelation. Radiance + Light creates hard-beam revelation, beacon arrays, and anti-concealment optics. Radiance + Spirit creates exorcism palms, soul illumination, and possession-breaking scripture. Radiance + Protection creates dawn wards, sanctuary barriers, and defensive consecrations. Radiance + Sword creates sunlit severing, demon-cutting sword intent, and oath-revealing cuts. #### Cultivation Insights ##### Radiance’s Blessing Prerequisite: Radiance Once per short rest, at the start of your turn, regain CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You may use this Insight only if you are conscious and able to circulate Radiance. The recovery may appear as sunlight entering the meridians, a halo reigniting, a prayer answered by dawn, or inner brilliance refusing to gutter. ##### Diamond Light Body Prerequisite: Body Refining, CL 4+ You may learn Radiance as a Body Refiner. Use Constitution as your Radiance ability and gain access to the Diamond Light Body Path synergy. Your Glow may originate from your skin, bones, eyes, scars, breath, or meridians. ##### Solar Heart Prerequisite: Radiance, CL 8+ Gain Resistance to Radiant damage. When you use a Radiance talent that restores HP, grants Temporary HP, or reduces damage, add your Proficiency Bonus to one healing, Temporary HP, or damage-reduction roll. If the target is currently Charmed, Frightened, possessed, or affected by corruption, it also gains Advantage on its next saving throw against that effect before the end of your next turn. ##### Unhidden Path Prerequisite: Radiance, CL 8+ Your Revealing Light and Consecrated Lantern become better at showing what refuses dawn. Gain the following benefits: you have Advantage on checks made to notice possession signs, spiritual contamination, undead traces, concealed writing, and corruption marks while in your own Bright Light; when you apply Dawnmark to a creature, you may immediately make one Wisdom (Insight), Intelligence (Investigation), or Cultivation Check to determine whether it is Unclean; your Glow can be made visible only to creatures you designate. ##### Dawn Physician Prerequisite: Radiance, CL 8+ When you use Gentle Dawn or Purifying Radiance on a willing creature, you may also grant Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Once per short rest, when you use Purifying Radiance to end Poisoned, Charmed, or Frightened, you may use it as a Bonus Action instead of an Action. ##### Demon-Revealing Eyes Prerequisite: Radiance, CL 8+ You may use Unhidden Stain Sight as part of the same Action when you use Radiance Strike against a creature. If the Radiance Strike hits and the target is Unclean, you learn that it is Unclean even if the check would fail. You do not learn the source unless the check succeeds. ##### Dawn-Ward Adept Prerequisite: Radiance, CL 8+ When you use Dawn Ward, choose one: increase the damage reduction by 1d8; the protected creature gains Advantage on its next saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, possession, or corruption before the end of your next turn; if the damage is reduced to 0, the attacker becomes Dawnmarked until the start of your next turn. ##### Thousand-Lamp Meditation Prerequisite: Radiance, CL 8+ During a cultivation session or long rest, you may maintain a circle of harmless dawn lamps. Choose up to a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each chosen creature gains one of the following benefits until it finishes its next short rest: Advantage on the first saving throw it makes against Frightened; Advantage on the first saving throw it makes against Charmed; Advantage on the first saving throw it makes against possession or spiritual contamination; Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature can benefit from only one Thousand-Lamp Meditation at a time.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### Counterstrike
Action Type: Action
Canonical Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Ready Action; see Extra Attack and Multiattack below
Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: None
Prepare one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike as a Counterstrike.
When you prepare a Counterstrike:
choose one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike you could legally make;
choose one perceivable trigger;
choose one Counter talent you know, if any.
When one of your chosen triggers begins, you may take your Reaction to make the prepared attack against the triggering creature.
A Counterstrike is a specific exception to the ordinary Ready Action:
it resolves before the triggering action, movement, or other activity finishes;
the triggering activity continues normally after your Counterstrike unless your attack, a Counter talent, or another rule prevents it;
you must be able to perceive the trigger;
the triggering creature must be a legal target for the prepared attack when your Counterstrike resolves;
you may ignore a trigger and continue waiting for another chosen trigger before the preparation ends.
Hit: Deal the attack’s ordinary damage and add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of the attack.
After a Counterstrike hits, you regain your Reaction if it is currently expended.
This restored Reaction is a specific exception to the ordinary Reaction limit. It may be spent normally, but it does not allow you to make a second Counterstrike during the same round.
You may make only one Counterstrike per round, regardless of how many triggers you chose or how many Reactions you can take.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Retribution Qi Expression: Primary — Punishment Qi; Supporting — Karma Qi, Metal-Judgment Qi, Fire-Wrath Qi. “The impatient warrior attacks the opening they can see. The patient warrior decides which opening the enemy will reveal.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Paths: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Readied melee attacks, counterattacks, interruption, defensive reprisals, dueling pressure, pursuit, spell disruption, body blows, prepared answers ## RETRIBUTION DAO Retribution is the cultivation of the prepared answer. A novice believes that speed means acting first. A Retribution cultivator learns a more difficult lesson: the decisive strike often belongs to the warrior who understands what the enemy is about to attempt, accepts the risk of waiting, and answers at the moment when commitment becomes vulnerability. Retribution is not passive defense. Its practitioners cultivate: patience under pressure; recognition of tells, habits, and hostile intent; the discipline to hold a strike until the enemy commits; body positioning that turns defense into retaliation; attacks aimed at disrupting movement, speech, concentration, balance, and confidence; the ability to punish a repeated mistake more severely than the first. A Retribution cultivator asks: Which action is the enemy most likely to attempt? Is the correct answer a blow, a grapple, a pursuit step, or an interception? Is Martial Focus better spent on certainty, control, or a stronger punishment? Is the enemy testing the line, or have they finally committed to crossing it? After fighting a Retribution cultivator for two rounds, an enemy should understand one truth: Every committed action may already have an answer waiting for it. ## CORE RETRIBUTION RULES ### Martial Focus Retribution uses Martial Focus. you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is currently absent. Martial Focus represents breath, posture, attention, and the moment in which observation becomes certainty. ### Counterstrike Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Ready Action; see Extra Attack and Multiattack below Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: None Prepare one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike as a Counterstrike. When you prepare a Counterstrike: choose one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike you could legally make; choose one perceivable trigger; choose one Counter talent you know, if any. When one of your chosen triggers begins, you may take your Reaction to make the prepared attack against the triggering creature. A Counterstrike is a specific exception to the ordinary Ready Action: it resolves before the triggering action, movement, or other activity finishes; the triggering activity continues normally after your Counterstrike unless your attack, a Counter talent, or another rule prevents it; you must be able to perceive the trigger; the triggering creature must be a legal target for the prepared attack when your Counterstrike resolves; you may ignore a trigger and continue waiting for another chosen trigger before the preparation ends. Hit: Deal the attack’s ordinary damage and add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of the attack. After a Counterstrike hits, you regain your Reaction if it is currently expended. This restored Reaction is a specific exception to the ordinary Reaction limit. It may be spent normally, but it does not allow you to make a second Counterstrike during the same round. You may make only one Counterstrike per round, regardless of how many triggers you chose or how many Reactions you can take. ### Common Counterstrike Triggers When preparing a Counterstrike, choose one perceivable trigger. The following triggers are normally valid: a hostile creature begins making an attack roll; a hostile creature begins an opposed ability check or another contested check permitted by a rule; a hostile creature willingly begins moving out of its current space using its Speed or another form of willing movement; a hostile creature begins casting a spell, activating a sphere talent, or using another perceivable supernatural effect; a hostile creature begins drawing, equipping, or readying a weapon; a hostile creature begins speaking audibly; another specific perceivable trigger approved by the GM. A trigger must describe something your character could perceive in time to answer. Forced movement does not trigger Counterstrike unless a talent explicitly says otherwise. ### Additional Triggers As your cultivation deepens, you may prepare for more than one possible mistake. | Cultivation Level | Triggers Chosen When Preparing Counterstrike | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 1 | | 5-10 | 2 | | 11-16 | 3 | | 17-20 | 4 | Additional triggers widen your preparation. They do not increase the number of Counterstrikes you may make in one round. ### Extra Attack and Multiattack If you can make more than one attack when you take the Attack Action or use Multiattack, you may replace one of those attacks with preparing a Counterstrike. Make any remaining attacks normally. This is a special attack replacement. It is not the Ready Action, but it creates the same prepared Counterstrike and follows the same rules. ### Counter Talents A Counter talent modifies one Counterstrike. Unless a talent says otherwise: choose the Counter talent when preparing the Counterstrike; apply only one Counter talent to one Counterstrike; a Counter talent applies only if the Counterstrike hits; a Counterstrike still deals its normal damage unless the talent says otherwise. ## RETRIBUTION TALENT TAGS ### Counter Talents A Counter talent changes the effect of a successful Counterstrike. ### Focus Talents A Focus talent recovers, expends, or modifies Martial Focus. ### Guard Talents A Guard talent improves defense, interception, or a prepared stance. ### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents counterattacking skill that has become unmistakably wuxia or supernatural. ### Unique Retribution Talents A Unique Retribution Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another tag. ## MORTAL REALM RETRIBUTION TALENTS ### Clinch - Counter After your Counterstrike hits, you may spend the Reaction restored by Counterstrike to attempt to Grapple the same target through an Unarmed Strike. You must have a free hand or another body part capable of maintaining the Grapple. The target chooses Strength or Dexterity and makes the corresponding saving throw against your Unarmed Strike Grapple DC. Failed Save: The target has the Grappled condition. Successful Save: No additional effect. Clinch follows the ordinary 2024 rules for Grappling unless another talent changes them. ### Counter Focus - Focus After your Counterstrike deals damage to a meaningful hostile creature, you may spend the Reaction restored by Counterstrike to regain Martial Focus. A meaningful hostile creature normally has a Challenge Rating of at least half your Cultivation Level, rounded down, minimum 1/2. The GM may allow an equivalent threat without a Challenge Rating to qualify. ### Cross Counter - Unique Retribution Talent Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within your reach makes an Opportunity Attack against you Cost: Expend Martial Focus Before the triggering Opportunity Attack resolves, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against that creature. Hit: Deal normal damage. The triggering Opportunity Attack has Disadvantage. Cross Counter is not a Counterstrike unless another talent explicitly says otherwise. ### Dug-In Blow - Counter After your Counterstrike hits, choose one instance of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage dealt by the target before the start of your next turn. You have Resistance to that damage instance. Dug-In Blow applies only once per successful Counterstrike. ### Haymaker - Counter Aim for the target’s mouth, jaw, throat, breath-channel, or another equivalent anatomy. After your Counterstrike hits, the target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The target’s speech and breath channel is damaged until it receives magical healing or completes a short or long rest. While damaged, whenever the creature attempts to: speak audibly; bite; use a breath weapon that requires the damaged anatomy; cast a spell with a Verbal component; activate a sphere talent or another ability requiring clear speech; the creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The attempted speech or activation fails. If the attempt required an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, that action is spent. A limited-use resource is not spent unless it was already committed before the saving throw. A creature without a meaningful mouth, throat, breath channel, or equivalent anatomy is immune. ### Headfake - Guard While you hold Martial Focus, Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage. ### Intercepting Strike - Guard When you prepare Counterstrike, you may choose to intercept one physical attack rather than attack the creature making it. Choose a trigger such as: a melee weapon attack is made within your reach; a physical projectile passes through your reach; a physical projectile targets a creature within your reach. When the trigger begins, take your Reaction and make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against the incoming attack. If your attack roll equals or exceeds the triggering attack roll, negate the triggering attack. Intercepting Strike normally cannot negate: spell attacks; beams; intangible supernatural effects; area effects; massive projectiles such as boulders or ballista bolts unless you wield a weapon or use a technique capable of intercepting them. Reactive Interception: Expend Martial Focus to use Intercepting Strike as a Reaction without preparing Counterstrike first. ### Liver Shot - Counter After your Counterstrike hits, reduce all of the target’s Speeds to 5 feet until the end of its next turn. A creature without meaningful anatomy or locomotion may be immune at the GM’s discretion. ### Powerful Counter - Counter Prerequisite: Extra Attack or Multiattack When you prepare Counterstrike by replacing one attack from your Attack Action or Multiattack, you may forgo one or more of the remaining attacks. For each attack forgone, add 1d8 damage to your Counterstrike on a hit. When you make the Counterstrike attack roll, you may also expend Martial Focus to gain Advantage on that attack roll. ### Raging Bull - Counter When your chosen trigger begins, move up to half your Speed in a straight line before making the Counterstrike. This movement: must end with the triggering creature within your reach; uses your movement for the round; provokes Opportunity Attacks normally; does not allow movement through occupied spaces or sealed barriers unless another rule permits it. If you cannot reach the triggering creature, you may ignore the trigger and continue waiting. ### Set Up - Unique Retribution Talent When you prepare Counterstrike, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against one creature within your reach. Hit: Deal no damage. Until the start of your next turn, whenever the creature willingly moves, it must end that movement in a space adjacent to you. The creature may use a Bonus Action to attempt to break the Set Up. It makes a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check opposed by your Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check. Each creature chooses which skill to use. Successful Check: Set Up ends. Set Up does not prevent forced movement, teleportation, or movement that cannot legally end adjacent to you. ### Sucker Punch - Focus When you make a legal Opportunity Attack, expend Martial Focus to treat that attack as a Counterstrike. Choose one Counter talent you know when making the attack. If you use Sucker Punch, on your next turn you may take only the Dodge or Disengage Action unless another rule explicitly says otherwise. ### Terrifying Hook - Counter After your Counterstrike hits, the target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. The ordinary Frightened rules apply. ### Tight Guard - Guard Whenever you take the Dodge Action or prepare Counterstrike, gain a +1 bonus to AC until the start of your next turn. At CL 11, this bonus increases to +2. Tight Guard counts as the AC bonus from a Shield and does not stack with the AC bonus from using a Shield. ### Violent Pressure - Unique Retribution Talent When you prepare Counterstrike, you may use a Bonus Action to choose one hostile creature within 30 feet that can perceive you. The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The creature has the Frightened condition until the end of its next turn. Successful Save: No effect. After a creature makes this saving throw, it is immune to your Violent Pressure until you complete a long rest. ## FOUNDATION REALM RETRIBUTION TALENTS ### Intense Conditioning - Counter Prerequisite: CL 5+ After your Counterstrike hits, expend Martial Focus. The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: For 1 minute, the target becomes conditioned against the precise trigger that provoked your Counterstrike. Whenever it attempts that same category of action again, it must repeat the Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: The attempted action, movement, or activation fails before it resolves. The creature may choose another legal action if it still has one available. A spell slot, CP cost, item charge, or other limited-use resource is not spent unless the resource was already committed before the saving throw. Successful Save: It may proceed normally. A creature immune to the Frightened condition is immune to Intense Conditioning. Examples of trigger categories include: making an attack roll; willingly leaving a space; casting a spell or activating a sphere talent; drawing or equipping a weapon; speaking audibly. Intense Conditioning does not prohibit every possible activity merely because one narrow trigger applied. ### Launching Uppercut - Counter Prerequisite: CL 5+ After your Counterstrike damages a creature no more than one size larger than you, expend Martial Focus. Launch the creature 10 feet upward. Its current movement ends. It then falls normally. Under the 2024 falling rules, a creature that falls 10 feet normally takes 1d6 Bludgeoning damage and gains the Prone condition when it lands unless it avoids taking any falling damage. #### Ally Launch You may use Launching Uppercut on one willing ally other than yourself without expending Martial Focus. The attack hits automatically and deals no damage. The ally’s current movement does not end. Until that movement ends, it may move horizontally through the air as though it had a Fly Speed equal to its remaining movement. The ally still falls normally when its movement ends. If the ally makes a melee attack against a creature as it lands, the ally takes no falling damage from this launch and does not gain the Prone condition from landing. ### Spell Breaker - Counter Prerequisite: CL 5+ When your Counterstrike damages a creature while it is casting a spell, activating a sphere talent, or using another interruptible supernatural effect, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw. The DC equals 10 or half the damage dealt by your Counterstrike, rounded down, whichever is higher, to a maximum DC of 30. This uses the 2024 Concentration-save formula. Failed Save: The triggering activation fails. The action and any spell slot, CP, item charge, or other resource committed to the activation are lost. Successful Save: The activation continues normally. Spell Breaker is a specific interruption rule. A normal Counterstrike does not automatically interrupt a spell merely because it deals damage before the spell resolves. ### Patient Breath - Focus Prerequisite: CL 5+ If your prepared Counterstrike expires at the start of your turn without being used, regain Martial Focus. ### Read the Tell - Unique Retribution Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you prepare Counterstrike, choose one creature you can see within 60 feet. Until the start of your next turn, gain Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made to recognize that creature’s immediate intent, feints, combat habits, or emotional commitment. The GM may reveal one broad category the creature appears prepared to attempt, such as: attack; move; flee; cast or activate a supernatural effect; defend; speak or issue a command; wait for another creature. Read the Tell does not reveal an exact ability, guarantee that the creature follows through, or bypass deception automatically. ### Unbroken Preparation - Guard Prerequisite: CL 7+ When a chosen trigger begins and you use Counterstrike, a missed Counterstrike does not end your preparation. You may continue waiting for another chosen trigger before the start of your next turn. You still may make only one Counterstrike per round. ## CORE FORMATION REALM RETRIBUTION TALENTS ### Court of the Awaiting Blade - Retribution Domain “Inside this court, every intention casts a shadow before the body moves.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest Manifest a 30-foot-radius aura centered on yourself. For the duration: when you prepare Counterstrike, choose one additional trigger; once per turn when you prepare Counterstrike, you may move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; once per round when your Counterstrike hits, regain Martial Focus; when your Counterstrike hits, the target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; you may apply Read the Tell to every hostile creature you can see inside the Domain rather than only one creature. The Court ends early if you become Incapacitated. ### Chasing Assault - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Launching Uppercut, CL 10+ Whenever you launch a hostile creature through Launching Uppercut, leap into the air beside it. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against the launched creature. Hit: Deal normal damage, drive the target immediately to the ground, and double the falling damage caused by this launch. You descend safely at the end of the target’s turn and take no falling damage from this technique. ### Reflexive Preparation - Focus Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Prepare Counterstrike without taking the Ready Action or replacing an attack. Reflexive Preparation follows all ordinary Counterstrike rules. ### Thousand-Tell Awareness - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Read the Tell, CL 12+ You are difficult to deceive once a creature commits its body to violence. Gain: Advantage on Wisdom (Insight) checks made during combat; Advantage on saving throws against effects that would cause you to attack an ally or misidentify a creature you can currently perceive; the ability to recognize whether a visible creature within 30 feet is deliberately attempting to draw out your Counterstrike through a feint. Thousand-Tell Awareness does not automatically reveal Invisible creatures, thoughts, exact actions, or hidden creatures behind Total Cover. ## NASCENT SOUL REALM RETRIBUTION TALENTS ### Heaven-Reading Stillness - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+ When you prepare Counterstrike, you may choose the following as one trigger: A hostile creature you can perceive within your reach begins any hostile action. A hostile action includes an attack, harmful supernatural effect, deliberate attempt to Grapple or Shove, or another action that would directly harm or restrain you or an ally. Heaven-Reading Stillness does not trigger from: purely defensive actions; movement by itself; speech by itself; concealed activity you cannot perceive; an action whose hostility is not apparent until after it resolves. ### Returning Blade Across Empty Ground - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Raging Bull, CL 15+ When Raging Bull activates, you may move up to your Speed rather than half your Speed. During this movement: you may move across liquids and vertical surfaces without falling until the movement ends; Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage; you may turn once by up to 90 degrees; you must still end with the triggering creature within your reach. Returning Blade Across Empty Ground is cultivated movement, not teleportation. ### Two Answers Within One Breath - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 17+ While Court of the Awaiting Blade is active, you may make up to two Counterstrikes per round rather than one. Each Counterstrike still requires: an available Reaction; a legal chosen trigger; a legal target within reach. A successful Counterstrike may restore the Reaction used to make it as normal. You cannot make more than one Counterstrike during the same creature’s turn. ## SECRET INHERITANCE ### Answer Before the Question Is Spoken “The strike did not interrupt the technique. For one breath, cause and answer simply arrived in the wrong order.” Classification: Secret Retribution Inheritance Prerequisites: Court of the Awaiting Blade, Spell Breaker, CL 17+ Use Limit: Once per long rest When a creature you can perceive within 60 feet begins an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or willing movement, invoke this inheritance before the triggering activity resolves. Move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. This movement may cross liquids and vertical surfaces without falling until the movement ends, but it cannot pass through occupied spaces, Total Cover, sealed barriers, or impossible routes. If you end within reach of the triggering creature, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against it. This attack counts as a Counterstrike and may apply one Counter talent. Hit: Deal normal Counterstrike damage. The target then makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The triggering activity fails before it resolves. Any Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, spell slot, CP cost, item charge, or other committed resource is lost. If the trigger was movement, the movement ends immediately. Successful Save: The triggering activity continues normally after the attack resolves. Answer Before the Question Is Spoken may interrupt an activity that would not ordinarily be a legal Counterstrike trigger. It cannot prevent an effect that has already resolved. ## OPTIONAL CULTIVATION VARIANT ### Pugilist Scripture “The hand is already drawn. The body is already loaded. Why waste the breath required to reach for steel?” You may use Counterstrike only with Unarmed Strikes. When you learn Retribution through Pugilist Scripture, learn one Counter talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. Pugilist Scripture is a restrictive cultivation variant. It does not prevent you from using weapons normally. It prevents weapons from carrying your cultivated Counterstrike technique. ## PATH SYNERGIES ### Body Refining - Rooted Answer Scripture Your body learns to receive commitment without surrendering structure. Whenever your Counterstrike hits, until the start of your next turn gain Advantage on: saving throws made to avoid being Grappled; saving throws made to avoid being Shoved or knocked Prone; checks and saving throws made to resist forced movement. If you practice Pugilist Scripture, your Unarmed Strike Counterstrikes count as magical for overcoming ordinary Resistance. ### Qi Cultivation - Measured Breath Scripture You circulate Qi through the pause between observation and answer. Once per round when you prepare Counterstrike, spend 1 Qi to choose one: choose one additional trigger; retain Martial Focus after expending it on one Retribution talent applied to that Counterstrike; increase Raging Bull movement by 10 feet; add your key ability modifier to one damage roll of the Counterstrike. Measured Breath Scripture cannot reduce a CP or Qi cost below 0 and cannot allow more Counterstrikes per round than normal. ### Spirit Awakening - Intent-Reading Scripture Your soul becomes sensitive to the instant when hostile intent hardens into action. When you prepare Counterstrike, choose one creature you can perceive within 30 feet. Against that creature, you may choose the following as one trigger: The creature begins a hostile action targeting you or an ally within your reach. This spiritual trigger can perceive hostile intent even when the action has no obvious physical tell. Intent-Reading Scripture does not: reveal the exact technique; reveal private thoughts; detect a creature behind Total Cover; reveal a creature you cannot otherwise perceive; identify hostility that does not become apparent until after an effect resolves. ## CULTIVATION INSIGHTS ### Layered Answer Prerequisite: Retribution sphere When preparing Counterstrike, expend Martial Focus to apply two Counter talents rather than one. Resolve both talents on a hit. ### Sentinel’s Reply Prerequisite: Intercepting Strike When using Intercepting Strike to protect another creature, you may move up to 10 feet into one legal unoccupied space before making the interception attack. This movement: does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the creature making the triggering attack; must place the incoming attack within your reach; cannot pass through occupied spaces or sealed barriers. ### Patient Foundation Prerequisite: Retribution sphere When your prepared Counterstrike expires unused, choose one: regain Martial Focus; gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; move up to 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Use Patient Foundation once per round.

Cost: None
Prepare one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike as a Counterstrike.
When you prepare a Counterstrike:
choose one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike you could legally make;
choose one perceivable trigger;
choose one Counter talent you know, if any.
When one of your chosen triggers begins, you may take your Reaction to make the prepared attack against the triggering creature.
A Counterstrike is a specific exception to the ordinary Ready Action:
it resolves before the triggering action, movement, or other activity finishes;
the triggering activity continues normally after your Counterstrike unless your attack, a Counter talent, or another rule prevents it;
you must be able to perceive the trigger;
the triggering creature must be a legal target for the prepared attack when your Counterstrike resolves;
you may ignore a trigger and continue waiting for another chosen trigger before the preparation ends.
Hit: Deal the attack’s ordinary damage and add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll of the attack.
After a Counterstrike hits, you regain your Reaction if it is currently expended.
This restored Reaction is a specific exception to the ordinary Reaction limit. It may be spent normally, but it does not allow you to make a second Counterstrike during the same round.
You may make only one Counterstrike per round, regardless of how many triggers you chose or how many Reactions you can take.
