spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Sabers Qi Types: saber qi, cleaving qi, draw-cut qi, battleline qi, wrapping qi, cruel-edge qi; related methods may add blood-vitality qi, metal qi, weapon qi, horse-soul qi, shield-breaking qi, killing intent, or army qi only when another sphere, Foundation, manual, or feature explicitly contributes it. “The saber does not debate the opening. It makes one.” Common Name: Sabers Sphere Sphere Type: Martial Power Sphere; Curved-Blade, Dao, Chopping, Pursuit, and Offensive Pressure Sphere Primary Paths: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Key Themes: brutal cuts, committed advance, soldierly dao work, shield-breaking pressure, wrapping parries, draw cuts, battlefield arcs, cavalry crescents, execution lines, pursuit, and limited wound pressure Primary Resource Hooks: CP, Stamina for Body Refining self/held-weapon expressions, Resonance for Spirit Awakening saber-spirit expressions, Edge Momentum, Guard Pressured, Saber Wound Core Chassis: Saber-Line Method, Saber-Line Pressure, Edge Momentum Common Effects: saber attacks, damage riders, guard pressure, forced movement, reaction parries, pursuit attacks, short cleaves, line arcs, stance-breaking, limited wounds, and execution pressure ## Sabers Dao Sabers cultivate the brutal line. The jian argues with precision. The saber ends the discussion by crossing the distance, taking the outside gate, and chopping through the hesitation. It is a soldier’s blade, a rider’s blade, an executioner’s blade, and a bandit’s honest answer to doctrine: close, cut, continue. The recurring verbs of Sabers are: Advance. Enter the line before the defender completes their answer. Chop. Put weight through the edge. Wrap. Carry the blade around a guard and return through the opening. Pursue. Do not let a wounded enemy leave the cut. Sabers are vicious, direct, and practical. They are not Blood cultivation. A saber may open a wound, but the sphere does not command blood. It commands the offensive line that made the wound. ## Sphere Boundary Sabers governs: - dao, duan dao, butterfly saber, heavy saber, cavalry saber, and similar curved or chopping blade methods; - committed forward cuts and brutal entries; - wrapping parries and countercuts; - guard-breaking pressure against shields, weapons, stances, and exposed posture; - short battlefield cleaves and crescent arcs; - pursuit of retreating enemies; - capped Saber Wounds caused by slashing pressure; - execution-style pressure against opened, prone, restrained, or Bloodied enemies. Sabers does not govern: - Sword Heart, flying sword doctrine, perfect jian precision, or elegant severance clarity; - broad weapon proficiency across all weapon types; - blood draining, blood shaping, blood healing, blood memory, or blood constructs; - broad Metal Qi command, ore control, magnetic manipulation, or iron-body cultivation; - spear-line reach doctrine, chain binding, shield defense, axe fury, or bow artistry; - cavalry soul-bonding, mount command, or army-scale warleading unless another sphere contributes it. If the effect is mainly perfect precision, use Sword. If it is mainly broad weapon access, use Weapons. If it is mainly metal command, use Metal. If it is mainly blood as a substance, use Blood. If it is mainly mounted warband doctrine, use Horse-Soul, Banner Raid, or Warleader as appropriate. ## Sabers Access Sabers is normally an ordinary martial sphere, but many saber lineages are military, clan, sect-police, executioner, caravan guard, or frontier inheritances. Body Refiners learn Sabers through tendon, shoulder, hip, breath, grip, and pressure of the held weapon. Qi Cultivators learn Sabers as projected crescent qi, external draw-cut lines, and visible blade wind. Spirit Awakeners learn Sabers as ancestral weapon memory, battlefield oath, execution mandate, fear pressure, or named-blade resonance. Secret Saber inheritances require a teacher, battlefield manual, execution platform, cavalry banner, clan blade, frontier army record, or equivalent story source. ## 2024 Fifth-Edition Rules Baseline Sabers uses the 2024 Fifth Edition action economy unless a talent says otherwise. Sabers attacks and Sabers Save DCs use your Sabers key ability. Sabers does not automatically bypass armor, shields, resistance, cover, object hardness, disarming rules, mounted combat rules, or weapon properties. A talent must say when it changes those rules. Sabers does not create Blood-sphere control. Saber Wound is a capped wound rider, not a blood-control engine. Sabers does not grant every weapon proficiency. The base sphere grants one saber-profile weapon and Sabers talent use with qualifying saber-profile weapons. Expression Is Flexible; Mechanics Are Fixed: A player may describe Sabers as infantry dao, short duan dao, butterfly sabers, cavalry saber, heavy execution blade, bandit chopper, sect-police saber, or ancestral curved blade. This expression does not change action type, range, cost, target, damage, duration, or prerequisites unless a talent says so. ## Core Sabers Rules ### Sabers Key Ability When you learn Sabers, use your Path key ability for Sabers attacks, Sabers Checks, and Sabers Save DC unless a scripture, Insight, manual, or GM-approved rule says otherwise. Body Refining normally uses Constitution. Qi Cultivation normally uses Intelligence or Charisma. Spirit Awakening normally uses Wisdom. ### Sabers Save DC Your Sabers Save DC equals: **8 + Proficiency Bonus + Sabers key ability modifier** ### Sabers Cultivation Attack Your Sabers Cultivation Attack Modifier equals: **Proficiency Bonus + Sabers key ability modifier** ### Edge Momentum Edge Momentum is short-lived forward pressure. You can hold Edge Momentum up to your Proficiency Bonus. You lose all unspent Edge Momentum after 1 minute without combat pressure. Unless a talent says otherwise, you may gain Edge Momentum only once on each of your turns. ### Guard Pressured Guard Pressured means a creature has been forced to answer a brutal saber angle. Unless a talent says otherwise, Guard Pressured lasts until the start of your next turn. A Guard Pressured target is not Restrained, Frightened, or Prone by default. It is simply open to specific Sabers riders. ### Saber Wound A Saber Wound is a qi-aggravated slash caused by ugly edge work. A target can have no more than two Saber Wounds from you at a time. A creature can end one Saber Wound by receiving magical healing, succeeding on a Medicine check against your Sabers Save DC as an Action, or spending an Action to bind the wound with appropriate tools if the GM permits it. Saber Wound is not blood control and does not make the target vulnerable by itself. ## Base Sphere Abilities When you acquire the Sphere of Sabers, you gain Saber-Line Method and Saber-Line Pressure. ### Saber-Line Method Action Type: Passive Factory Combat Bucket: passive Factory Routing: passive_or_modifier_row Range: Self Cost: None Choose one qualifying saber-profile weapon, such as dao, duan dao, butterfly saber, cavalry saber, heavy saber, or a similar curved/chopping blade approved by the GM. You gain proficiency with that weapon if you do not already have it. You may use Sabers talents with qualifying saber-profile weapons. If a weapon is ambiguous, the GM decides whether it belongs to Sabers, Sword, Weapons, Axes, or another weapon sphere. ### Saber-Line Pressure Action Type: Passive Canonical Action Type: Passive Factory Combat Bucket: passive Timing Detail: Passive / once-turn rider Factory Routing: passive_or_modifier_row Range: Self Cost: None Once on each of your turns when you hit with a qualifying saber attack after moving toward the target, cutting around a guard, following a Sabers setup, or spending Edge Momentum, choose one: - gain 1 Edge Momentum, up to your Proficiency Bonus; - make the target Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn; - if you practice Cruel Edge Method, apply one Saber Wound. Saber-Line Pressure does not trigger from purely spell attacks, companion attacks, formation attacks, autonomous weapons, or non-saber attacks unless another feature explicitly says so. ## Realm Progression Mortal Realm: Sabers is weapon training, forward cuts, draw cuts, wrapping guards, pursuit, and one-beat counters. Foundation Realm: Saber qi enters the edge. The cultivator can break stance, knock enemies prone, draw ugly wounds, and cleave through short battlefield clusters. Core Formation Realm: Saber arcs become pressure lines. The cultivator creates horse-cutting crescents, mass pursuit, army-line chops, and fearsome anti-guard pressure. Nascent Soul Realm: Saber intent becomes execution authority. The cultivator can cut across a battlefield, force enemies to answer a beheading line, and briefly turn the ground around them into a killing lane. Secret Inheritance: Secret saber manuals are battlefield-changing but not regional sovereign edicts. They are strongest in duels, charges, execution platforms, army lines, and named-blade scenes. ## Saber Methods Choose one Saber Method when you gain the sphere. A Method is a style lane, not a separate sphere. ### Battlefield Dao Method You favor full-sized dao, infantry cuts, shield breaking, and line fighting. Benefit: Once per turn, when you move at least 10 feet before hitting with a saber, add +1 slashing damage and gain 1 Edge Momentum. Restriction: You cannot use this Method’s benefit while restrained, grappled by a creature larger than you, or fighting in a space too cramped to swing a full saber. ### Duan Dao Close-Cut Method You favor short sabers, butterfly sabers, knife-range chops, and ugly close work. Benefit: When you are within 5 feet of a hostile creature and hit it with a Sabers talent, you may move 5 feet around it without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature. Restriction: Your Sabers talents do not gain extra reach from this Method. ### Execution Saber Method You favor heavy chopping blades and decisive finishers. Benefit: Once per turn, when a Sabers talent hits a prone, restrained, stunned, Incapacitated, Guard Pressured, or Bloodied target, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll. Restriction: You have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide the intent of an execution cut while wielding an obvious execution saber. ### Cavalry Crescent Method You favor mounted arcs, long cuts, passing pressure, and rider’s reach. Benefit: If you move at least 20 feet before a saber hit, the target must make a Strength saving throw or be pushed 5 feet. If you are mounted or using a legitimate movement technique, you may instead choose to move 5 feet after the hit without provoking from the target. Restriction: The Method does not grant mount proficiency, Horse-Soul talents, or mounted combat benefits by itself. ### Cruel Edge Method You preserve the wound rider. Benefit: Once per turn when a Sabers talent deals slashing damage, you may apply one Saber Wound. Restriction: A target can have no more than two Saber Wounds from you. This Method does not grant blood control, healing through wounds, blood tracking, or blood constructs. ## Path Expression ### Body Refining - Shoulder-and-Bone Dao Body Refining Sabers begins in waist, shoulder, tendon, stance, grip, heel, and breath. You may use Constitution as your Sabers key ability for Sabers attacks, Sabers Checks, and Sabers Save DCs when using a held saber, worn saber, body-bound saber, or melee saber expression. When you use Body Refining Sabers: - your Sabers effects normally originate from your body, a held saber, a worn saber, a drawn saber, a melee hit, a shove, a grapple, or a physical charge; - you may spend Stamina instead of CP for Sabers talents that are melee, self, held-weapon, movement, or parry effects, if your table allows Body Refiner sphere expenditure through Stamina; - once per short rest, when you hit with a Sabers talent after moving at least 10 feet, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; - detached ranged saber arcs beyond 30 feet require a printed talent, manual, item, forged technique, or GM-approved opening. ### Qi Cultivation - Crescent Edge Qi Qi Cultivation Sabers externalizes the blade into crescent qi, edge wind, draw-cut scripture, and visible battleline pressure. You may use Intelligence or Charisma as your Sabers key ability. When you spend CP on a Sabers talent, choose one: - extend one saber arc, line, or cone by 5 feet; - add your Proficiency Bonus to one Sabers Check made to break a guard, stance, shield, or defensive posture; - make the first 5 feet of movement after the talent not provoke Opportunity Attacks from one creature damaged by the talent; - treat a drawn saber, thrown saber, talisman-saber, or visible crescent edge as the origin point if the talent already permits projected saber qi. Choose only one benefit per Sabers talent unless another feature says otherwise. ### Spirit Awakening - Named Blade Vow Spirit Awakening Sabers begins as blade memory, battlefield oath, ancestral saber pressure, execution mandate, or fear carried by a named weapon. You may use Wisdom as your Sabers key ability. Choose one named saber, ancestral blade, execution tool, vow-blade, or symbolic curved weapon as your saber focus. Once per round, when you hit with a Sabers talent through that focus, you may learn one: - whether the target is Bloodied; - whether the target is afraid, oath-bound, or maintaining morale by command; - whether the target’s defense is armor, shield, stance, formation, spirit, or raw toughness; - whether the target would be more vulnerable to pursuit, execution, fear pressure, or guard breaking. This does not reveal exact HP, complete stat blocks, or secret techniques. ## Sabers Talent Tags Entry talents move you into the cut. Parry talents answer attacks with countercuts. Cleave talents strike multiple targets or wider arcs. Pursuit talents punish retreat. Cruel talents create capped wound pressure. Execution talents finish opened targets. Battleline talents affect space, stance, morale, or multiple enemies. Manual talents are usually secret, lineage-gated, or story-gated. ## Mortal Realm Talents ### Forward Cut - Entry Prerequisite: Sabers sphere Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Weapon reach Cost: None Make one saber attack against one target in reach. Hit: Deal normal weapon damage. If you moved at least 10 feet toward the target this turn, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll. If the target is Guard Pressured, you may also move 5 feet after the hit without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that target. ### Guard-Cutting Parry - Parry Prerequisite: Sabers sphere Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature hits you with a melee weapon attack Cost: None Reduce the incoming weapon damage by 1d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. If this reduces the damage to 0, or if the triggering attack misses because another defense increased your AC before damage, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker. At Foundation Realm, you may spend 1 CP or 1 Stamina to make the attacker Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn. ### Red Trail Pursuit - Pursuit Prerequisite: Sabers sphere Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you hit with a saber attack this round moves away from you Cost: None Move up to half your Speed toward the triggering creature. If you end within saber reach, make one saber attack against it. If the creature has a Saber Wound from you, this movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from that creature. ### Hard Draw Cut - Entry, Cruel Prerequisite: Sabers sphere Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You draw a saber or begin your turn with a sheathed saber Cost: None Until the end of your turn, the next saber hit you make deals additional slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you practice Cruel Edge Method, you may apply one Saber Wound on that hit. ### Wrap the Head, Return the Edge - Parry Prerequisite: Sabers sphere Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A melee attack misses you, or you reduce melee damage with Guard-Cutting Parry Cost: 1 Edge Momentum Make one saber attack against the triggering creature. Hit: Deal normal damage and make the target Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn. ### Shield-Hacking Rhythm - Entry Prerequisite: Sabers sphere When you hit a creature carrying a shield, using a guard stance, or benefiting from a temporary AC bonus, you may spend 1 Edge Momentum. If you do, the target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: The target loses the next shield, parry, guard, or temporary AC bonus it would apply before the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No extra effect. This does not destroy shields or permanent armor. ### Short Saber Infighting - Entry Prerequisite: Sabers sphere When you hit a creature within 5 feet with a duan dao, butterfly saber, short saber, or similar close saber, you may make a shove attempt against that creature as part of the same Action. If the shove succeeds, the creature is Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn. ### Saber Scare - Execution Prerequisite: Sabers sphere When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Sabers talent or score a critical hit with a saber, choose one hostile creature within 30 feet that can see you. That creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: No effect. ## Foundation Realm Talents ### Hewing Entry - Entry Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Weapon reach Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina if delivered as Body Refining melee saber expression Make one saber attack. Hit: Deal normal damage and force a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: The target is knocked Prone or Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn, your choice. Successful Save: The target is Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn. ### Cruel Draw Cut - Cruel Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You hit with a saber attack Cost: 1 CP Deal extra slashing damage equal to one roll of your saber weapon die. If you practice Cruel Edge Method, apply one Saber Wound. If the target already has two Saber Wounds from you, instead add your Proficiency Bonus to the extra damage. ### Circle-Cleaving Saber - Cleave Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Weapon reach Cost: 2 CP Make saber attacks against up to a number of creatures within reach equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You cannot attack the same creature more than once with this talent. After resolving all attacks, choose one creature you hit. It becomes Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn. ### Battleline Shove-Cut - Battleline Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere When you hit a Large or smaller creature with a Sabers talent after moving at least 10 feet, you may spend 1 CP. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Push it 10 feet or knock it Prone. Successful Save: Push it 5 feet. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. ### Bloodless Butcher’s Lesson - Cruel Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere You know where cuts matter without cultivating blood. When you apply a Saber Wound, choose one: - the target’s Speed is reduced by 5 feet until the wound ends; - the target has Disadvantage on the next Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check it makes before the wound ends; - if the target receives magical healing before the wound ends, reduce that healing by your Proficiency Bonus once. This talent does not stack with itself on the same wound. ### Banner-Cleaving Advance - Battleline Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: 1 CP Until the end of your turn, moving through nonmagical difficult terrain caused by crowds, rubble, brush, mud, shallow water, loose weapons, or ordinary battlefield debris costs you no extra movement. If you hit with a saber after using this talent, gain 1 Edge Momentum. ### Counter-Slope Dao - Parry Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere When a creature misses you with a melee attack, you may spend 1 CP to step into the slope of its guard. Move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature. If you end adjacent to it, it becomes Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn. ### Rider’s Passing Cut - Pursuit Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere When you move at least 20 feet on your turn and hit with a saber, you may spend 1 CP to continue your movement up to 10 feet after the hit without provoking from the target. If you are mounted, this follow-through movement can be taken by your mount instead. This does not grant mount control, mount actions, or Horse-Soul benefits. ## Core Formation Realm Talents ### Horse-Cutting Arc - Cleave, Battleline Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot line, 5 feet wide Cost: 4 CP Creatures in the line make a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: A creature takes 5d8 slashing damage and is pushed 5 feet or knocked Prone if Large or smaller, your choice. Successful Save: A creature takes half damage and is not moved. A creature carrying your Saber Wound has Disadvantage on the save. ### Army-Line Chopping Field - Battleline Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 15-foot cone Cost: 4 CP Creatures in the cone make a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: 4d8 slashing damage and Guard Pressured until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Half damage only. Until the start of your next turn, allies who move through the cone’s area do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures that failed the save. ### Beheading Feint - Execution Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere Bonus Action; 2 CP. Choose one creature within saber reach or within 30 feet if using projected saber qi. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: It is Guard Pressured, and your next Sabers attack against it before the end of your turn has Advantage. Successful Save: It is not Guard Pressured, but it cannot take Reactions against your movement until the end of your turn. ### Crescent Through the Shield Wall - Cleave Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere When your Sabers talent damages two or more creatures in one turn, choose one damaged creature carrying a shield, guard state, or temporary AC bonus. That creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: One non-Secret guard, parry, shield bonus, or defensive stance of your choice is suppressed until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No suppression, but the target is Guard Pressured. ### Ten-Step Pursuit Doctrine - Pursuit Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Red Trail Pursuit Your Red Trail Pursuit reaction can trigger when a creature you hit with a saber since the start of your last turn moves away from you, even if the hit was not this round. When you hit with the pursuit attack, you may spend 2 CP to reduce the target’s Speed by 10 feet until the end of its next turn. ### Execution Platform Presence - Execution Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Duration: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP For the duration, once per turn when you hit a Guard Pressured, Prone, Restrained, Stunned, Incapacitated, or Bloodied creature with a saber, add 1d8 slashing damage. When you reduce a creature to 0 HP during the duration, you may end one Frightened effect on yourself or one willing ally within 30 feet. ## Nascent Soul Realm Talents ### Battlefield Beheading Line - Execution, Battleline Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: 8 CP Choose one creature you can see within range. A saber line crosses the battlefield. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: It takes 10d8 slashing damage, becomes Guard Pressured until the end of its next turn, and loses one ordinary guard, stance, or defensive posture until the end of its next turn. Successful Save: It takes half damage and loses no posture. This cannot remove Secret inheritances, domain-scale protections, artifacts, or stronger authority without an opposed check. ### Thousand-Saber Infantry Road - Battleline Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Sabers sphere Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 60-foot line, 10 feet wide Cost: 8 CP Creatures of your choice in the line make a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: 8d8 slashing damage and cannot take Opportunity Attacks until the end of their next turn. Successful Save: Half damage. Allies of your choice can move through the line’s area until the start of your next turn without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures that failed the save. ### Kingfisher Beheads the Retreat - Pursuit, Execution Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Red Trail Pursuit When a creature within 120 feet that you damaged with a Sabers talent since the start of your last turn moves away from you, uses a teleport-like movement, or attempts to leave a battleline, you may spend 4 CP and your Reaction. Make one Sabers Cultivation Attack against that creature. On hit, it takes 6d8 slashing damage and its movement is reduced by 20 feet until the end of the turn. If the movement was teleport-like, this does not prevent the movement unless the target fails a Wisdom saving throw against your Sabers Save DC. ### Domain of the Unanswered Cut - Execution Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Execution Platform Presence Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot emanation Duration: 1 minute Cost: 8 CP Once per long rest, you create a domain of saber pressure. Hostile creatures of your choice that start their turn in the domain while Guard Pressured, Bloodied, or carrying a Saber Wound must make a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn and has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before then. Successful Save: The creature is immune to this talent’s Wisdom save until the start of its next turn. The domain ends early if you are Incapacitated. This is a saber-pressure domain, not a mile-scale sovereign edict. ## Secret Saber Manuals Secret Saber Manuals are rare battlefield lineages, executioner records, cavalry scriptures, frontier army inheritances, bandit-king scars, or named-blade teachings. They are powerful, but Sabers is not intended to have Lightning-style regional sovereignty by default. ### Manual of the Red Gate Charge - Secret, Battleline Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere, battlefield dao inheritance or military teacher Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: 3 CP Move up to your Speed in a straight or gently curving line. During this movement, you may pass through spaces occupied by hostile creatures, but you cannot end there. Choose up to three creatures whose spaces you passed through or moved adjacent to. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: 4d8 slashing damage and knocked Prone if Large or smaller. Successful Save: Half damage and not Prone. Use Limit: Once per short or long rest. At Core Formation Realm, the damage increases to 6d8 and you may affect up to five creatures. ### Execution Platform Sutra - Secret, Execution Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Execution Saber Method or executioner inheritance Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest. For the duration, the first time each turn you hit a Guard Pressured, Restrained, Prone, Stunned, Incapacitated, or Bloodied creature with a Sabers talent, choose one: - add 3d8 slashing damage; - suppress one non-Secret reaction, parry, guard, or defensive stance until the end of the target’s next turn; - force a Constitution saving throw; on failure, the target cannot regain HP or CP until the start of your next turn. This sutra does not kill helpless targets automatically. It makes execution mechanically possible under combat rules. ### Black Banner Cavalry Dao - Secret, Pursuit, Battleline Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Cavalry Crescent Method or cavalry/frontier inheritance Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest. For the duration, when you move at least 20 feet on your turn, your next Sabers hit before the end of that turn deals +2d8 slashing damage and pushes the target 10 feet on a failed Strength save. Once during the duration, when a creature you damaged attempts to move farther away from you, you may use Red Trail Pursuit without spending your Reaction. If you are mounted, your mount also ignores nonmagical difficult terrain created by crowds, mud, grass, shallow water, snow, or loose battlefield debris for the duration. This manual does not grant Horse-Soul, mount intelligence, or warband command. ### Tiger-Butcher Short Saber Manual - Secret, Cruel Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Duan Dao Close-Cut Method or butcher/assassin/sect-police short-saber teacher When you hit a creature within 5 feet with a short saber, duan dao, or butterfly saber, you may spend 2 CP. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It takes 3d8 slashing damage and suffers one Saber Wound. Successful Save: It takes half damage and no Saber Wound. If the target is larger than you, Guard Pressured, or grappled by you or an ally, it has Disadvantage on the save. Use Limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest. ## Sabers Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures Sabers variants are optional martial scriptures. A variant grants a benefit only if it also imposes a real limitation. Unless the GM says otherwise, choose at most one Sabers variant when first learning Sabers or undergoing a major saber initiation. ### Single-Cut Execution Scripture Your saber method believes one committed cut is worth ten lesser motions. Benefit: Once per short rest, when you hit a Guard Pressured or Bloodied creature with a single-target Sabers talent, add 2d8 slashing damage. Drawback: You cannot use Circle-Cleaving Saber, Army-Line Chopping Field, Thousand-Saber Infantry Road, or other multi-target Sabers talents unless a Secret manual, item, or later retraining opens them. ### Short Saber Alley Scripture Your saber belongs to alleys, ships, rooms, and grappling distance. Benefit: You gain Duan Dao Close-Cut Method. If you already have it, gain Short Saber Infighting. Drawback: Sabers talents with lines, cones, or ranges beyond weapon reach have their range or area halved unless you use a forged technique or GM-approved external method. ### Bloodless Soldier Doctrine You reject cruelty and use the saber as disciplined battlefield work. Benefit: When you reduce a creature to 0 HP with a Sabers talent, you may leave it stable at 1 HP and Incapacitated until the start of its next turn. Once per short rest, when you do so, gain 1 Edge Momentum. Drawback: You cannot use Cruel Edge Method, Bloodless Butcher’s Lesson, Tiger-Butcher Short Saber Manual, or any Sabers talent that requires applying Saber Wound. ### Cruel Edge Scripture Your saber method preserves the ugly wound. Benefit: You gain Cruel Edge Method. If you already have it, when a creature with two Saber Wounds from you starts its turn within your saber reach, it takes slashing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Drawback: Your Sabers talents leave obvious wounds. You have Disadvantage on checks to conceal that you used Sabers violence on a body unless you use Medicine, Water, Life, Illusion, or comparable cleanup. ### Body-Only Heavy Dao Scripture Prerequisite: Body Refining Path You cannot project saber qi beyond the reach of your body and held saber unless an opening source permits it. Benefit: You may use Constitution for all melee Sabers talents. When you spend Stamina on a melee Sabers talent, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per turn. Drawback: Projected lines, cones, domains, and ranged saber arcs are Known - Restricted Use until opened by a manual, Insight, item, forged technique, or GM permission. ## Path Synergies ### Body Refining - Heavy Dao Body When you use a Sabers talent through a held saber, body charge, shove, grapple, or melee hit, it is a Heavy Dao Body expression. Once per short rest, when a Heavy Dao Body expression reduces a creature to 0 HP or knocks it Prone, regain Stamina equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Qi Cultivation - Crescent Blade Projection When you spend CP on a projected Sabers talent, you may choose one: - increase a line by 10 feet; - increase a cone by 5 feet; - add +1 to the damage roll for each target beyond the first, maximum your Proficiency Bonus; - create a visible crescent edge that counts as your saber for the talent’s origin. ### Spirit Awakening - Ancestral Execution Name When you name your saber, execution vow, or battlefield oath during a Sabers talent, you may spend 1 Resonance. Choose one creature damaged by the talent. Until the start of your next turn, it has Disadvantage on the next Wisdom save made against fear, morale pressure, intimidation, or execution authority. You can use this synergy once per round. ## Cultivation Insights ### Dao Guard Veteran Prerequisite: Sabers sphere When you use Guard-Cutting Parry, reduce the incoming damage by an additional 2. ### Red Sash Pursuer Prerequisite: Sabers sphere, Red Trail Pursuit When Red Trail Pursuit lets you move, increase that movement by 5 feet. ### Butcher’s Mercy Prerequisite: Sabers sphere You gain proficiency in Medicine or Intimidation. When you bind a Saber Wound, you may end one Saber Wound without a roll if the target is willing or helpless. ### Cavalry Cut Familiarity Prerequisite: Sabers sphere, Cavalry Crescent Method You have Advantage on checks to remain mounted, leap from a saddle, cut while moving on a mount, or identify cavalry saber doctrine. ### Shield-Breaking Eye Prerequisite: Sabers sphere When you Study a creature with a shield, guard stance, or obvious defensive posture, you may learn whether Strength, Dexterity, or Wisdom is most likely to resist your Sabers pressure. ### Execution Restraint Prerequisite: Sabers sphere, Execution Saber Method Once per short rest, when you would add bonus damage against a Bloodied target through Sabers, you may forgo that bonus to impose Disadvantage on the target’s next Opportunity Attack before the start of your next turn. ### Crescent Projection Student Prerequisite: Sabers sphere, Qi Cultivation Path When you use a projected Sabers talent with a range or area, increase its range or area by 5 feet once per short rest. ### Named Blade Listener Prerequisite: Sabers sphere, Spirit Awakening Path When you finish a short rest while holding your named saber focus, ask the GM one symbolic question about a recent battle, execution, oath, fear, or pursuit connected to the blade. The answer is an omen, not a complete fact. ## Automation Notes The acquisition actions for Sabers are Saber-Line Method and Saber-Line Pressure. Most ordinary Sabers talents should reference one of these outputs: Edge Momentum, Guard Pressured, Saber Wound, saber attack, saber arc, movement after hit, or reaction parry. Recommended action registry fields: Name: Saber-Line Pressure Action Type: Passive Canonical Action Type: Passive Factory Combat Bucket: passive Timing Detail: Passive / once-turn rider Factory Routing: passive_or_modifier_row Cost: None Trigger: Hit with qualifying saber attack after movement, setup, guard wrap, or Sabers talent Output: gain Edge Momentum, apply Guard Pressured, or apply Saber Wound if Cruel Edge Method permits AI should not treat Sabers as Blood. Saber Wound is capped and removable and never grants blood control by itself.

Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
