spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Scoundrel Qi Expression: Primary — Exploit Qi; Supporting — Shadow Qi, Wind Qi, Luck Qi, Dui-Exchange Qi. “The heavens keep ledgers because they are afraid someone will notice the locks were decorative.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Dirty tricks, theft, disarming, substitutions, hidden tools, misdirection, stolen footing, stolen voice, stolen identity, stolen skills, stolen techniques, battlefield rigging, impossible escape Scoundrel cultivates the unguarded assumption. Its basic loop is to create an Exploited Opening through Dirty Trick or Steal, take an accessible object or named Reliance, replace the expected answer, and leave before the enemy recovers. At Foundation Realm, the cultivator manifests an Empty-Sleeve Hand: a projected hand of intent that can deliver Dirty Trick and Steal beyond ordinary reach. Each later Realm permits increasingly supernatural forms of theft until the cultivator becomes a living embodiment of the Dao of Scoundrel. ### RULES BASELINE This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Attack action, Opportunity Attack, Advantage, Disadvantage, Cover, Hide, Invisible, Influence, Search, Study, Utilize, Concentration, and conditions unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### DISARM EFFECTS The 2024 core rules do not define a universal Disarm action. Scoundrel provides a local disarm method through Steal. #### OBJECT INTERACTIONS An object stolen, planted, or repositioned through Scoundrel still obeys its normal rules. Stealing a weapon does not automatically grant proficiency or Weapon Mastery with it. Planting a consumable does not automatically activate it. A magic item still requires any normal attunement, command, Utilize action, or other activation. A talisman, poison, alchemical item, or formula still requires an actual item unless a talent explicitly creates one. #### CONCEALMENT Misdirection is not automatically Invisible or Hidden. A Scoundrel may use clutter, allies, terrain, movement, and actual distractions to satisfy ordinary Hide requirements or gain Cover when a talent says so. ### CORE SCOUNDREL RULES #### MARTIAL FOCUS Scoundrel uses Martial Focus. you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is absent. Martial Focus represents readiness, breath, posture, nerve, and the instant in which the practitioner notices what the opponent has stopped guarding. Martial Focus is not CP. #### SCOUNDREL CHECK Several Scoundrel techniques call for a Scoundrel Check. Make: Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) When a creature actively opposes an ordinary physical maneuver, it makes: Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) The creature chooses its skill. The higher result wins. On a tie, the defender wins. When a talent steals an intangible Reliance, the talent normally tells you to compare your Scoundrel Check against the target’s Cultivation Save DC or calls for a saving throw. A creature without a Cultivation Save DC uses: 8 + Proficiency Bonus + highest of Dexterity, Wisdom, or Charisma modifier A supernatural theft may use an opposed Cultivation Check instead when the target is protected by a stronger technique, artifact, Domain, Formation, Secret Inheritance, or scene-defining effect. #### ACCESSIBLE OBJECT An object is accessible when a Scoundrel technique can legally reach and manipulate it. Ordinarily accessible objects include: an item in a creature’s hand; a visible item tucked into a belt, sleeve, pouch, scabbard, bandolier, or similar location; an unattended item within reach; one Tiny object you can plausibly plant on a creature; another object the GM agrees can be physically reached during the maneuver. An object is not ordinarily accessible when it is: fully enclosed inside a sealed container; fused to the target’s body; a natural body part; a complete suit of worn armor; a soul-bound object actively resisting removal; an artifact actively resisting removal; behind Total Cover without a legal route; a spiritual effect with no exposed anchor. Higher-Realm talents explicitly broaden what may be stolen. #### RELIANCE A Reliance is something a creature currently depends upon and that a Scoundrel talent explicitly permits you to steal. A Reliance may be: footing; voice; charm; identity; skill; momentum; equipment; an activated item; one learned talent; one ongoing technique; one successful moment; one sense, Resistance, or other advantage named by a Secret Inheritance. A Reliance is not a universal permission slip. You may steal only the Reliances named by a talent you know. Stealing one Reliance does not automatically steal neighboring concepts. For example, stealing a creature’s voice does not remove all spellcasting, and stealing its momentum does not grant general control over movement. #### TRICK TALENT A talent with the Trick tag modifies one successful Dirty Trick or Steal. Unless a talent says otherwise: apply one Trick talent to one successful Dirty Trick or Steal; choose the Trick after the maneuver succeeds; a Trick talent does not replace the ordinary result unless its text says so; applying a Trick does not create a second Dirty Trick or Steal; the same Trick does not stack with itself. #### EXPLOITED OPENING Some Scoundrel talents create an Exploited Opening. An Exploited Opening lasts until the start of your next turn. While it lasts: the target cannot make Opportunity Attacks against you; choose whether the next attack roll made against the target has Advantage or the next Scoundrel Check made against the target has Advantage; after either benefit is used, the Exploited Opening ends. A creature may suffer only one Exploited Opening from you at a time. ### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES #### SCOUNDREL TRAINING When you learn Scoundrel: gain proficiency in Dexterity (Sleight of Hand); if already proficient, choose one Mortal Realm Scoundrel talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; choose one Mortal Realm Trick talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent. #### DIRTY TRICK Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Natural reach Cost: None Attempt an underhanded maneuver against one creature you can physically hinder. Describe the method: throw grit into its eyes, knot a sleeve, stamp on a foot, box its ears, loosen a belt, hook a leg, slap a talisman across its vision, overturn a stool beneath it, or use another plausible tactic. Make a Scoundrel Check against the target. Success: Choose one appropriate result: Eyes Spoiled. The target has the Blinded condition until the start of your next turn. Ears Ringing. The target has the Deafened condition until the start of your next turn. Tangled Footwork. Halve the target’s Speed until the start of your next turn. Low Sweep. The target has the Prone condition. Jammed Guard. The target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Open the Guard. Apply Exploited Opening. The GM may approve a comparable effect when the description, anatomy, and surroundings support it. A base Dirty Trick should not inflict a stronger condition than those listed above. A creature without the relevant anatomy or vulnerability is immune to an inappropriate effect. If a talent extends a physical Dirty Trick beyond the start of your next turn, the target or an adjacent creature can normally take the Utilize action to end that physical hindrance early. #### STEAL Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Natural reach Cost: None Choose one accessible object. Attempt to take it, reposition it, or plant one Tiny object in an accessible location. ##### Aware Target Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature. ##### Unaware Target Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check against the target’s Passive Perception. ##### Difficult Object Make your check with Disadvantage if the object is securely fastened, worn tightly, held in two hands, or similarly difficult to remove. ##### Success Choose one appropriate result: take the object into a free hand; cause the object to fall into an unoccupied space within your reach; reposition the object to another accessible location on the same target; plant one Tiny object in an accessible location on the target. You may use Steal to remove an object from a creature’s hand as a local Scoundrel disarm rule. Steal does not automatically activate, identify, attune to, or safely handle the object. ### SCOUNDREL TALENT TAGS #### TRICK TALENTS A Trick talent modifies one successful Dirty Trick or Steal. #### FOCUS TALENTS A Focus talent modifies the recovery, retention, or expenditure of Martial Focus. #### EMPTY-SLEEVE TALENTS An Empty-Sleeve talent expands theft, substitutions, hidden-tool use, projected theft, or the kinds of Reliance you may steal. #### ESCAPE TALENTS An Escape talent converts an opening into movement, safety, redirection, or shameless survival. #### DOMAIN TALENTS A Domain talent establishes an area where enemy assumptions become available to the Scoundrel Dao. #### REALM EVOLUTIONS A Realm Evolution represents supernatural Scoundrel cultivation beyond ordinary legerdemain. ### MORTAL REALM SCOUNDREL TALENTS #### CLEANED OUT - TRICK When you succeed on Steal, take or reposition up to two accessible objects instead of one. Resolve both objects through the same successful check. You still need free hands or legal spaces for the objects. #### DOUBLE DIP - TRICK When you succeed on Dirty Trick, expend Martial Focus to choose two different Dirty Trick effects instead of one. If both effects can be ended early through separate physical actions, removing one does not remove the other. Double Dip does not allow a second Trick talent by itself. #### FANCY FOOTWORK - TRICK When you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature no more than one size larger than you, move that creature 5 feet into one legal space. This forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. #### RANGED TRICKERY - TRICK While holding Martial Focus, use Dirty Trick against a creature within 10 feet rather than only within your natural reach. Describe a plausible physical delivery method such as thrown grit, a cord, a hooked tool, a kicked object, or a snapped sleeve-weight. #### SWITCHEROO - TRICK When you succeed on Steal, replace the stolen object with one different Tiny object you hold or plausibly carry. Place the replacement in an empty hand, pocket, pouch, sleeve, or another accessible location on the target. Switcheroo does not create the replacement object. A volatile, alchemical, poisoned, or talismanic item still follows its normal preparation, trigger, activation, and consumption rules. #### TWIST THE KNIFE - TRICK Once per turn when you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature within melee reach, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against it as part of the same Action. This additional attack cannot trigger Twist the Knife again or trigger another additional attack. #### DISTRACTING TRICKERY - TRICK When you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal, the target cannot make Opportunity Attacks against creatures other than you until the start of your next turn. #### FILTHY DISTRACTION - TRICK When you succeed on Dirty Trick against a creature that was unaware of you, it has Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks until the end of your next turn. Its Passive Perception is reduced by 5 for the same duration. #### BOB AND WEAVE - ESCAPE Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Target: Self Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: None Requirement: One willing adjacent ally or one adjacent object must plausibly cover at least half your body. Choose one qualifying ally or object as your cover anchor. You gain Half Cover while you remain adjacent to that anchor and it remains capable of plausibly covering at least half your body. The benefit ends early if you are no longer adjacent to the chosen anchor, the anchor is destroyed or removed, or it can no longer plausibly cover at least half your body. You cannot change the chosen anchor without using Bob and Weave again. The chosen ally spends no action and gains no benefit from this talent. #### CUT AND RUN - ESCAPE While holding Martial Focus, whenever you use your Action to succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal, move up to half your Speed. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the target of the maneuver. #### FOCUSING THIEVERY - FOCUS Whenever you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal, regain Martial Focus as a Bonus Action. #### GRIFTER’S HANDS Gain Expertise in Dexterity (Sleight of Hand). #### MASTER THIEF - EMPTY-SLEEVE When you use Steal, expend Martial Focus to ignore Disadvantage caused by an object being securely fastened, worn tightly, or held in two hands. If you successfully disarm a held object and possess a free hand, catch it instead of causing it to fall. Master Thief does not make a soul-bound object, artifact, body part, or complete suit of worn armor ordinarily accessible. #### HIDDEN TOOL CACHE - EMPTY-SLEEVE Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Target: One object revealed from your concealed preparations Use Limit: Once per Short or Long Rest Cost: None Reveal one plausible Tiny mundane object that you prepared or acquired before the current scene and could reasonably have concealed on your person. You do not need to name the specific object before using this talent, but the object must have been reasonably available to you and must fit your established preparations, clothing, containers, and circumstances. The GM decides whether a proposed object is plausible. Place the object in one of your free hands. If you have no free hand, place it in your space or in one accessible worn container you possess. The revealed object is a real, ordinary object. It remains after being revealed until it is used, lost, destroyed, or discarded. Revealing it does not activate, Utilize, apply, throw, plant, or attack with it; any later use follows the object's normal rules and action economy. The object cannot be magical, alchemical, poisonous, unusually valuable, an item that could not reasonably have been acquired before the scene, or a substitute for another sphere talent. It cannot be a complete tool kit, a costly consumable, or an object whose possession would bypass a meaningful security, scarcity, or story restriction. Examples include chalk, a coin, one ordinary lockpick, a tiny mirror, a nail, a ceramic shard, a fishhook, a key blank, a small folding tool, or a short weighted cord. ### FOUNDATION REALM SCOUNDREL TALENTS At Foundation Realm, the Scoundrel Dao becomes openly supernatural. The cultivator manifests a projected hand of intent that reaches beyond ordinary cloth and skin. #### EMPTY-SLEEVE HAND - REALM EVOLUTION Prerequisite: CL 5+ While holding Martial Focus, you may manifest an Empty-Sleeve Hand whenever you use Dirty Trick or Steal. Your Empty-Sleeve Hand: extends your Dirty Trick and Steal range to 30 feet; travels along one clear legal route to a target you can perceive; may perform the same physical manipulation your own hand could perform through Dirty Trick or Steal; may carry a successfully stolen object back into one of your free hands; may drop, reposition, or plant an object in a legal accessible location; vanishes immediately after the maneuver resolves. Your Empty-Sleeve Hand may appear as: a spectral sleeve; a translucent hand of Qi; an invisible hooked thread; a weighted cord moving too quickly to follow; a flicker of footwork that makes witnesses uncertain whether you ever crossed the distance. The Empty-Sleeve Hand does not: remain on the battlefield after the maneuver; grant general telekinesis; manipulate arbitrary objects without using Dirty Trick or Steal; open a sealed container remotely; pass through Total Cover or a sealed Barrier; automatically remove an artifact, soul-bound object, or complete suit of armor; exert enough force to Shove, Grapple, lift a creature, or replace the Brute, Wrestling, Thread, Force, or Space spheres. #### QUICK THIEVERY - FOCUS Prerequisite: CL 5+ Expend Martial Focus to use Dirty Trick or Steal as a Bonus Action. Use Quick Thievery only once per turn. #### COUNTER THEFT - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 5+, Master Thief Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range attacks you with a handheld weapon Cost: Expend Martial Focus Attempt to Steal the weapon before the attack resolves. Success: Choose one: catch the weapon if you have a free hand; cause the weapon to fall into one legal space within 30 feet of you; plant one Tiny object you hold into the attacker’s now-empty hand. The triggering attack is lost. Failure: The attack resolves normally. Counter Theft does not affect a natural weapon, Unarmed Strike, fused weapon, artifact that resists removal, or weapon protected by a stronger technique without an appropriate opposed Cultivation Check. #### MISDIRECTED ATTACK - ESCAPE Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature makes an Opportunity Attack against you for your movement Attempt Dirty Trick against the attacking creature before the attack resolves. Success: Do not apply a normal Dirty Trick result. Redirect the triggering attack against one other legal target within the attacker’s reach. Use the original attack roll against the new target’s AC. You suffer no damage or additional effect from the triggering attack. Failure: Resolve the Opportunity Attack against you normally. #### STEAL FOOTING - EMPTY-SLEEVE, TRICK Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you succeed on Dirty Trick against a creature no more than one size larger than you, steal its footing. Choose one: move it up to 10 feet along the ground into legal spaces; give it the Prone condition; reduce each of its Speeds to 0 until the start of your next turn; prevent it from taking Reactions until the start of your next turn. If the target is standing on unstable terrain, balancing, climbing, flying through physical wings, or moving rapidly when you apply this Trick, choose two different results instead. #### STEAL VOICE - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to steal the breath, cadence, or spiritual pressure by which its voice enters the world. The target makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn: it cannot speak clearly; it cannot provide Verbal spell components; it cannot activate an ability that explicitly requires intelligible speech; it has Disadvantage on checks requiring speech. Successful Save: It has Disadvantage on its next check requiring speech before the end of its next turn. At CL 10+, on a failed save the effect lasts for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. Steal Voice does not prevent every technique merely because the technique has a name or command phrase in its description. The technique must genuinely require speech. #### STEAL CHARM - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to take a sliver of its social ease rather than an object. For 10 minutes: the target has Disadvantage on Charisma checks and Influence checks; gain Advantage on your next Charisma check before the duration ends. The target does not automatically realize what was stolen. At CL 11+, the duration becomes 1 hour. #### STEAL IDENTITY - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to take its visible mannerisms, posture, vocal rhythm, and surface behavioral tells rather than an object. For 1 hour, gain Advantage on Charisma (Deception) checks made to impersonate that creature. A disguise, transformation, illusion, or Forged Technique may still be needed to reproduce physical appearance. Steal Identity does not grant private memories, passwords, cultivation secrets, or perfect knowledge of relationships. #### STEAL SKILL - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus and name one skill proficiency the target possesses or that you reasonably believe it possesses. For 1 minute: the target loses proficiency in that skill; gain proficiency in that skill; if the target has Expertise in the skill, gain Expertise for the duration. If the guess is incorrect, the effect fails but Martial Focus is still expended. A creature affected by your Steal Skill cannot be affected by it again until you finish a short or long rest. #### IMPOSSIBLE FASTENING - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a physical Dirty Trick you impose would end at the start of your next turn, expend Martial Focus to extend it to 1 minute. The target or an adjacent creature can take the Utilize action to end the hindrance early by undoing the knot, clearing the eyes, loosening the strap, removing the object, or otherwise solving the physical problem. Impossible Fastening cannot extend Prone or Exploited Opening. ### CORE FORMATION REALM SCOUNDREL TALENTS At Core Formation Realm, the surrounding exchange becomes a rigged court. Loose objects, missed attacks, worn equipment, activated talismans, and exposed techniques become possible components of the Scoundrel’s hand. #### COURT OF TEN THOUSAND EMPTY SLEEVES - DOMAIN “The sovereign counted every sword, seal, talisman, and hidden weapon. Counting them had been the mistake.” Prerequisite: Empty-Sleeve Hand, CL 12+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short or long rest Establish a Scoundrel Domain in which the battlefield behaves like a rigged shell game. For the duration: use Dirty Trick and Steal against any valid target inside the Domain; unattended Tiny or Small objects and suitable loose clutter inside the Domain count as accessible when a legal route exists; once during each of your turns, use Dirty Trick or Steal without spending an Action or Bonus Action; apply up to two different Trick talents to one successful Dirty Trick or Steal; once per turn, draw, stow, plant, catch, drop, or reposition one ordinary handheld object inside the Domain without spending an Action; once per round when a hostile creature inside the Domain misses an attack or fails a D20 Test, apply Exploited Opening to it; when you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal inside the Domain, move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Court of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves does not create items, open sealed containers, bypass Total Cover, ignore a sealed Barrier, or automatically steal artifacts. #### GRAND SWITCHEROO - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: Switcheroo, CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range activates one accessible handheld consumable, talisman, mundane tool, magic item, focus, or device Cost: Expend Martial Focus Attempt Steal before the activation resolves. Success: Choose one legal result: steal the triggering object, causing its activation to fail; replace it with one valid substitute you hold, causing the substitute to activate instead when legal; redirect the activation to another legal target; cause the object to activate harmlessly; plant the object onto another creature inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range before it activates, when that creature is a legal recipient. Failure: The original activation resolves normally. Grand Switcheroo does not affect a technique with no accessible anchor or automatically overcome an artifact. #### STEAL HEART - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to take its hostility toward you rather than an object. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: The target has the Charmed condition toward you for 1 minute. Successful Save: No effect. The effect ends early if you or an ally damage the target. Once a creature has been affected by or succeeds against your Steal Heart, it cannot be affected by your Steal Heart again until you finish a long rest. #### STEAL EQUIPMENT - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: Master Thief, CL 10+ Cost: Expend Martial Focus When you use Steal, attempt to remove one worn item, including: a belt; sash; cloak; quiver; scabbard; component pouch; robe; shield; helmet; worn talisman; suit of armor; comparable worn equipment. Make the Steal check with Disadvantage. Master Thief does not remove this Disadvantage. On a success, the object appears in your free hand or one legal unoccupied space inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range. A fused object, soul-bound item, artifact, spiritually protected treasure, or scene-defining object may resist with an opposed Cultivation Check or another appropriate defense. At Core Formation, stealing a complete suit of armor is intentionally possible. The technique is audacious, supernatural, and highly visible. #### STEAL TALENT - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: Steal Skill, CL 10+ Use Limit: Once per long rest per creature When you use Steal Skill, choose one observed sphere talent, martial technique, or comparable learned ability instead of a skill proficiency. You must have observed the ability during the last 10 minutes or otherwise possess reliable knowledge that the target has it. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Save: For 1 minute: the target cannot use the stolen ability; the target cannot use abilities whose prerequisite is the stolen ability; you may use the stolen ability when you meet its prerequisites and can pay its costs. Successful Save: No effect. You may maintain only one stolen talent at a time. Steal Talent cannot steal: a Path; a Realm; an entire sphere portfolio; inherent anatomy; a bloodline; Legendary Actions; Lair Actions; a transformation sustained by the target’s body when you cannot legally assume it; a Secret Inheritance; an ability whose prerequisites you cannot meet. If you steal a base sphere and the target possesses additional talents beyond the base, make the initial Scoundrel Check with Disadvantage. #### STEAL MOMENTUM - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you perceive within 60 feet willingly moves, teleports, charges, or is carried by one of its own techniques Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per round Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature’s Cultivation Save DC. Success: End the triggering movement after the first 5 feet traveled. Then move up to the distance the target lost without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Failure: The target moves normally. Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Steal Momentum does not automatically stop a Secret Inheritance, major calamity, scene-defining movement, or stronger Space technique. Those may require an opposed Cultivation Check. #### RIGGED ESCAPE - ESCAPE Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You gain Grappled, Prone, or Restrained, or become the target of an Opportunity Attack Cost: Expend Martial Focus Choose one: move up to 30 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; stand from Prone without spending movement; immediately repeat one check or saving throw to end Grappled or Restrained with Advantage; exchange spaces with one willing ally within 30 feet if both spaces are legal; use Dirty Trick against one creature inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range. Rigged Escape cannot move through a sealed Barrier or leave an effect that does not permit physical escape without an appropriate check. #### EVERYTHING IN THE WRONG PLACE - REALM EVOLUTION Prerequisite: Empty-Sleeve Hand, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short or long rest Choose a number of hostile creatures inside the area up to your Proficiency Bonus. Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one result for that creature: steal one accessible held item; move the creature up to 15 feet along the ground into legal spaces; give it the Prone condition; prevent it from taking Reactions until the end of your next turn; apply Exploited Opening; cause one ordinary accessible item it carries to fall into one legal space within 30 feet of you. Successful Save: Apply Exploited Opening or move the creature 5 feet along the ground into one legal space. Objects stolen or dropped through this talent appear in legal spaces of your choice inside the area. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM SCOUNDREL TALENTS At Nascent Soul, the Scoundrel becomes a living embodiment of the empty sleeve. The distinction between physical pickpocketing and conceptual robbery begins to collapse, but the Dao remains bounded by explicit Reliances, legal targets, and contestable defenses. #### SOVEREIGN OF TEN THOUSAND EMPTY SLEEVES - REALM EVOLUTION “The cultivator raised both hands. They were empty. Everyone else checked their pockets.” Prerequisite: Court of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves, CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign manifestation of the Scoundrel Dao: a robe of grasping afterimages, spectral sleeves filled with impossible hidden tools, laughing spiritual hands, or another suitable expression. For the duration: gain Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover; increase Empty-Sleeve Hand range to 60 feet; use Dirty Trick or Steal once during each of your turns without spending an Action or Bonus Action; apply up to three different Trick talents to one successful Dirty Trick or Steal; regain Martial Focus whenever you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal; gain one additional Reaction each round, usable only for Scoundrel talents; your supernatural Scoundrel talents may affect incorporeal creatures, spiritual projections, exposed spiritual anchors, and active talismans; when you steal one unattended handheld object within range, draw it into your hand or place it into any legal space you can perceive within range. Sovereign of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves does not grant unrestricted telekinesis, allow arbitrary theft through sealed Barriers, or automatically overcome artifacts and stronger cultivation protections. #### STRIP THE BATTLEFIELD BARE - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 60-foot Emanation originating from you Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Every hostile creature of your choice inside the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Choose two different consequences for that creature: steal one accessible held or worn object; give it the Prone condition; reduce each of its Speeds to 0 until the end of your next turn; prevent it from taking Reactions until the end of your next turn; suppress one ordinary Stance, Guard, or comparable temporary martial effect until the end of your next turn; move it up to 20 feet along the ground if it is Huge or smaller; apply Exploited Opening. Successful Save: Choose one consequence other than stealing worn equipment or suppressing a temporary effect. Stolen objects appear in your hands or legal spaces of your choice within 30 feet of you. An artifact, soul-bound object, or superior spiritually protected object may require an additional opposed Cultivation Check. #### STEAL ONGOING TECHNIQUE - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Empty-Sleeve Hand range Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest per creature Choose one creature benefiting from a non-Secret ongoing magical, martial, or supernatural effect. Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature’s Cultivation Save DC. A stronger protected effect may instead require an opposed Cultivation Check. Success: Transfer one eligible beneficial effect from the target to yourself for up to 1 minute. the target ceases benefiting while the effect is stolen; time spent stolen counts against the effect’s duration; take over Concentration when applicable; if the effect ends while stolen, it does not return; if it remains active when this theft ends, it returns to the original creature for its remaining duration; you must be a legal recipient of the effect. You may maintain only one stolen ongoing technique at a time. Steal Ongoing Technique does not steal curses, harmful effects, a Path, a Realm, an inherent body, artifact attunement, a Legendary transformation, or a Secret Inheritance. #### EMPTY-HANDED THEFT OF HEAVEN - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range activates an accessible handheld item, weapon technique with a physical weapon, consumable, talisman, focus, or device Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Make a Scoundrel Check against the target’s Cultivation Save DC. A stronger protected object or effect may require an opposed Cultivation Check. Success: Choose one: steal the triggering object before its use resolves; redirect the triggering object’s effect to another legal target; cause the object to activate harmlessly; replace one ordinary consumable with one harmless Tiny substitute you possess; remove one ordinary weapon from the target’s grasp before its weapon technique resolves; suppress the triggering object’s activation until the end of your next turn. Failure: The triggering effect resolves normally. Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Empty-Handed Theft of Heaven cannot automatically overcome an artifact, fused object, natural body part, inaccessible anchor, Legendary transformation, or Secret Inheritance. #### STEAL THE DECISIVE MOMENT - EMPTY-SLEEVE Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you perceive within 60 feet succeeds on an attack roll, ability check, or saving throw Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Describe a narrow but audacious expression: a thrown coin, stolen foothold, loosened strap, missing breath, shifted talisman, abruptly absent weapon, interrupted line of sight, or perfectly mistimed step. Turn the triggering success into a failure. Then choose one: move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks; use Dirty Trick against the triggering creature; use Steal against the triggering creature; redirect one handheld object involved in the triggering action to one legal space inside your Empty-Sleeve Hand range. A Legendary, Secret, or equivalent effect may resist with an opposed Cultivation Check. Steal the Decisive Moment interrupts an exposed instant. It does not rewrite a previous turn or broadly manipulate Fate. #### THE DAO OF SHAMELESS SURVIVAL - ESCAPE Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You would drop to 0 HP, fail a saving throw, gain Grappled or Restrained, or become the target of an attack Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Choose one: drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP; turn the failed saving throw into a success; move up to 60 feet into a legal space you can perceive before the triggering attack resolves; redirect one legal single-target attack to another creature within 10 feet of you; end one ordinary Grappled, Restrained, Prone, or disarmed effect affecting you; reveal one previously prepared mundane object that solves the immediate physical problem. A Legendary or Secret effect may resist with an opposed Cultivation Check. The Dao of Shameless Survival cannot rewrite a previous turn, negate an entire area effect automatically, create an artifact, or pass through a sealed Barrier without a legal route. ### SECRET SCOUNDREL INHERITANCE #### HEAVEN’S TREASURY WAS NEVER LOCKED “The sovereign checked their sword. Their sword remained. They checked their cultivation. Their cultivation remained. Only when they tried to act did they discover the thief had stolen the reason any of it mattered.” Classification: Secret Scoundrel Inheritance Prerequisite: Sovereign of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves, CL 17+, hidden heaven-robbery scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Choose one creature you can perceive. Make a Scoundrel Check against its Cultivation Save DC. A superior defense may replace this with an opposed Cultivation Check. #### SUCCESS Steal three different Reliances from the target until the end of your next turn: Steal Reaction. The target cannot take Reactions. Steal Footing. Each of the target’s Speeds becomes 0. Steal Defense. Remove one Resistance from the target. Gain that Resistance for the duration. Steal Awareness. Remove one sense possessed by the target. Gain that sense for the duration. Steal Equipment. Take one held or worn object, including armor, into your hand or place it in a legal space within range. Steal Technique. Suppress one observed non-Secret talent, Stance, Guard, Domain, or ongoing cultivation effect. If it is an ongoing benefit and you are a legal recipient, gain it for the duration. Steal the Next Answer. The next attack roll or saving throw the target makes before the effect ends automatically fails. Steal Position. Exchange spaces with the target if both destinations are legal. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. Steal Momentum. Immediately move up to the target’s Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. Until the effect ends, the target cannot willingly move more than 5 feet during one turn. After choosing the stolen Reliances, move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks and use Dirty Trick or Steal against the target without spending an Action. #### FAILURE Steal one Reliance other than Steal the Next Answer, then move up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. #### LIMITS Heaven’s Treasury Was Never Locked cannot automatically steal: a Path; a Realm; permanent ability scores; an entire character sheet; inherent anatomy; a complete bloodline; Legendary Actions; Lair Actions; an artifact; a Secret Inheritance; permanent karmic authority; a sect, nation, or cosmic office; a destiny protected by a superior narrative-scale effect. Those may still become the subject of a contested scene, Forged Technique, project, campaign objective, or future inheritance. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### BODY REFINING - STREET-HARDENED BODY Use Constitution as your key ability for Scoundrel saving throw DCs. Once per turn when you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature within natural reach, choose one: gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature; gain Advantage on the next check made before the end of your next turn to escape Grappled or Restrained. Street-Hardened Body does not replace Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) for Scoundrel Checks. #### QI CULTIVATION - HIDDEN-TOOL CIRCULATION Use Intelligence or Charisma as your key ability for Scoundrel saving throw DCs. Once per turn when you expend Martial Focus on a Scoundrel talent, choose one: draw or stow one handheld object without spending an Action; move one unattended Tiny object within 10 feet into another legal space within 10 feet through a visible Qi-thread flick; increase Empty-Sleeve Hand range by 10 feet for that technique; reduce the CP cost of one Scoundrel Forged Technique used during the same turn by 1, minimum 1. Hidden-Tool Circulation does not grant general telekinesis or remote fine manipulation. #### SPIRIT AWAKENING - TRICKSTER SOUL Use Wisdom as your key ability for Scoundrel saving throw DCs. Your supernatural Scoundrel talents may affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and spiritual projections when the technique has a suitable spiritual expression. Once per round when you apply Exploited Opening to one creature you perceive within 30 feet, learn one: whether it is concentrating on an effect; whether it carries one perceivable spiritual anchor; whether it is currently possessed; whether one handheld or worn object is spiritually bound strongly enough to resist ordinary Steal; whether it currently benefits from one ongoing effect eligible for Steal Ongoing Technique. Trickster Soul does not reveal private thoughts, complete inventories, or hidden techniques automatically. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### LIGHT FINGERS Prerequisite: Scoundrel sphere, CL 4+ When you roll Initiative while holding Martial Focus, draw or stow up to two ordinary handheld objects. Once per short or long rest, use Steal as a Bonus Action without expending Martial Focus. #### SHAMELESS RETREAT Prerequisite: Scoundrel sphere, Cut and Run, CL 6+ Once per short or long rest when Cut and Run permits movement, move up to your full Speed instead of half your Speed. During that movement, stand from Prone without spending movement. #### HIDDEN-SLEEVE ADEPT Prerequisite: Scoundrel sphere, Hidden Tool Cache, CL 6+ Use Hidden Tool Cache twice per short or long rest. Your Hidden Tool Cache may reveal one ordinary consumable worth no more than a common adventuring consumable, subject to GM approval. It still cannot create a magical item, poison, talisman, or alchemical formula automatically. #### EMPTY-SLEEVE PRODIGY Prerequisite: Scoundrel sphere, Empty-Sleeve Hand, CL 8+ While holding Martial Focus: increase Empty-Sleeve Hand range by 10 feet; use a Tiny unattended object inside that range as a plausible delivery route for Ranged Trickery; gain Advantage on one Scoundrel Check made through Empty-Sleeve Hand once per short or long rest. #### CROOKED-COURT CUSTODIAN Prerequisite: Scoundrel sphere, Court of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves, Formations sphere, CL 12+ When designing a Formation, safehouse, escape route, training hall, vault, or infiltration project, use one Scoundrel technique you know as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. It still requires materials, anchors, maintenance, vulnerabilities, and project design.

resolved_automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### STEAL
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Natural reach
Cost: None
Choose one accessible object. Attempt to take it, reposition it, or plant one Tiny object in an accessible location.
##### Aware Target
Make a Scoundrel Check against the creature.
##### Unaware Target
Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check against the target’s Passive Perception.
##### Difficult Object
Make your check with Disadvantage if the object is securely fastened, worn tightly, held in two hands, or similarly difficult to remove.
##### Success
Choose one appropriate result:
take the object into a free hand;
cause the object to fall into an unoccupied space within your reach;
reposition the object to another accessible location on the same target;
plant one Tiny object in an accessible location on the target.
You may use Steal to remove an object from a creature’s hand as a local Scoundrel disarm rule.
Steal does not automatically activate, identify, attune to, or safely handle the object.

d20 + Proficiency Bonus + Sect Stewardship key ability modifier
You may spend one Merit Die before or after rolling the d20 but before the GM declares the result. Roll the Merit Die and add it to the check.
Unless a talent says otherwise, you cannot add more than one Merit Die to the same d20 roll.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### Standing
Standing measures how an institution currently recognizes you.
Standing is not cultivation Realm, social class, noble rank, or universal reputation. It is local and contextual.
There are five ordinary Standing grades.
No Standing. You are a stranger, guest, prisoner, petitioner, or unknown worker.
Servant Standing. You may perform basic labor, receive food or shelter, and be ordered around.
Outer Standing. You are trusted for ordinary duties, simple missions, shared facilities, and basic records.
Inner Standing. You are trusted with restricted duties, better instruction, inner facilities, low-grade resources, and sensitive errands.
Core Standing. You are trusted with disciples, stores, restricted archives, important missions, hall authority, or a named courtyard.
Some institutions may also recognize Elder Standing, Guest Elder Standing, Lineage Heir Standing, Clan Standing, Official Standing, or other campaign-specific statuses. These are story positions and are not automatically gained from this sphere.
When you learn Sect Stewardship, choose one institution where you have Servant or Outer Standing, subject to GM approval. If the campaign begins before you have joined any group, you instead gain the Petitioner status and can use the sphere to earn your first recognized place.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### Merit Dice
Sect Stewardship uses Merit Dice.
Your Merit Die begins as a d4.
Your maximum number of Merit Dice is equal to your Proficiency Bonus, minimum 1.
You regain all spent Merit Dice when you finish a Long Rest if you are in good standing with at least one institution and spend at least 10 minutes fulfilling a duty, checking a ledger, reporting to a superior, instructing a junior, cleaning a shared space, or otherwise honoring your role.
If you are away from any institution, you regain one spent Merit Die when you finish a Long Rest by maintaining records, writing reports, preserving tokens, planning duties, or honoring the sect’s rules while traveling.
You can spend Merit Dice only on Sect Stewardship features unless another rule says otherwise.
Merit Dice cannot be converted into gold, trade goods, CXP, pills, talents, items, or political office unless a talent explicitly permits a limited exchange.

Outer Standing. You are trusted for ordinary duties, simple missions, shared facilities, and basic records.
Inner Standing. You are trusted with restricted duties, better instruction, inner facilities, low-grade resources, and sensitive errands.
Core Standing. You are trusted with disciples, stores, restricted archives, important missions, hall authority, or a named courtyard.
Some institutions may also recognize Elder Standing, Guest Elder Standing, Lineage Heir Standing, Clan Standing, Official Standing, or other campaign-specific statuses. These are story positions and are not automatically gained from this sphere.
When you learn Sect Stewardship, choose one institution where you have Servant or Outer Standing, subject to GM approval. If the campaign begins before you have joined any group, you instead gain the Petitioner status and can use the sphere to earn your first recognized place.

Sect Stewardship uses Merit Dice.
Your Merit Die begins as a d4.
Your maximum number of Merit Dice is equal to your Proficiency Bonus, minimum 1.
You regain all spent Merit Dice when you finish a Long Rest if you are in good standing with at least one institution and spend at least 10 minutes fulfilling a duty, checking a ledger, reporting to a superior, instructing a junior, cleaning a shared space, or otherwise honoring your role.
If you are away from any institution, you regain one spent Merit Die when you finish a Long Rest by maintaining records, writing reports, preserving tokens, planning duties, or honoring the sect’s rules while traveling.
You can spend Merit Dice only on Sect Stewardship features unless another rule says otherwise.
Merit Dice cannot be converted into gold, trade goods, CXP, pills, talents, items, or political office unless a talent explicitly permits a limited exchange.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Shadow Qi Expression: Primary — Shadow Qi; Supporting — Dark Qi, Light-Contrast Qi, Spirit-Double Qi. “Light reveals the body. Shadow reveals the second shape the body forced the world to remember.” Sphere Type: Power Sphere Primary Path: Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation Rare Variant: Body Refining through Shadow-Bound Body Resource: CP Common Effects: Silhouettes, cast shadows, hidden routes, pursuit, positional concealment, ambush, shadow doubles ## Shadow Dao Shadow is the boundary between presence and absence. A shadow exists because light encountered form and could not occupy every space. It is not merely darkness. It is evidence that something stood between illumination and the world beyond it. Every creature therefore moves through the world twice: once as the visible body; once as the second silhouette created by its passage through light. Shadow cultivators learn to read, preserve, mark, enter, distort, and awaken that second silhouette. ## Core Shadow Rules ### Shadowed Space A Shadowed Space is a space containing at least one of the following: Dim Light; Darkness; a visible Cast Shadow; one of your Shadow Anchors; a shadow created by a Shadow talent; another suitable magical silhouette. A Shadowed Space does not automatically make a creature Hidden. A Shadowed Space does not reveal exact creature positions. A Shadowed Space does not bypass a sealed barrier or a Dimensional Lock. ### Cast Shadow A Cast Shadow is a visible silhouette created when light is obstructed by a creature, object, structure, or terrain feature. A Cast Shadow may exist inside Bright Light. ### Shadow Anchor A Shadow Anchor is a silhouette you have cultivated into a stable route. Unless a talent says otherwise: A Shadow Anchor occupies one 5-foot space. It lasts for 1 hour. You may maintain a number of Shadow Anchors equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A Shadow Anchor may be noticed with a successful Wisdom (Perception), Intelligence (Investigation), or Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC. A suppressed Shadow Anchor is not automatically destroyed. ### Shadow Mark A creature bearing your Shadow Mark carries a readable spiritual silhouette. Unless a talent says otherwise: The Shadow Mark lasts until the start of your next turn. The creature’s silhouette counts as one of your Shadow Anchors. The mark does not automatically reveal an exact square through Total Cover. The mark does not automatically defeat Invisible. The mark does not bypass a sealed barrier, Dimensional Lock, or specialized concealment technique. ## Base Sphere Abilities ### Second Silhouette Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: See text Cost: None Choose one visible creature, object, or 5-foot space containing a Cast Shadow or located inside Dim Light or Darkness. #### Space or Object Create one Shadow Anchor. The anchor lasts for 1 hour. #### Willing Creature Apply your Shadow Mark. The mark lasts for 1 minute. #### Unwilling Creature Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Apply your Shadow Mark until the start of your next turn. A creature may carry only one of your Shadow Marks at a time. ### Shadow Step Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Half your Speed Cost: 1 CP Teleport from a Shadowed Space you occupy into another Shadowed Space you can see. This movement: does not provoke opportunity attacks; ignores nonmagical difficult terrain; cannot pass through a sealed barrier; cannot cross a Dimensional Lock; requires a legal visible destination. ## Shadow Talent Tags ### Imprint Talents A talent with the Imprint tag modifies Second Silhouette or provides a new way to exploit Shadow Mark. Unless a talent says otherwise, apply only one Imprint augment when using Second Silhouette. ### Step Talents A talent with the Step tag modifies Shadow Step. Unless a talent says otherwise, apply only one Step augment each time you activate Shadow Step. ## BASIC SHADOW TALENTS ### Shadow Fang Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: None Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On a hit, deal your choice of Psychic, Necrotic, or Slashing damage: | CL | Damage | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 1d8 | | 5-10 | 2d8 | | 11-16 | 3d8 | | 17-20 | 4d8 | On a hit, you may apply your Shadow Mark until the start of your next turn. Shadow Fang gives a combat-focused cultivator a faster way to establish Second Silhouette pressure without making ranged damage the identity of the entire sphere. ### Grasping Silhouette Classification: Imprint Talent Cost: +1 CP When you apply Shadow Mark to a creature through Second Silhouette, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The creature becomes Restrained until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. ### Lingering Trace Classification: Imprint Talent Cost: +1 CP A Shadow Mark you apply lasts for 8 hours. While the marked creature remains within 1 mile, you know: its approximate direction; whether it is alive; whether it is conscious; whether the mark has been suppressed or removed. You may track a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you exceed this limit, choose one older mark to end. Lingering Trace does not reveal an exact square. ### Clinging Silhouette Classification: Imprint Talent Cost: +1 CP You may create a Shadow Anchor attached to a creature or object. The anchor moves with its bearer. An unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The anchor is applied. Successful Save: No effect. An affected creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the anchor on a success. ### Long Shadow Classification: Step Talent Cost: +1 CP Increase Shadow Step range from half your Speed to your full Speed. ### Shadow Ward Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or an ally within 30 feet takes damage Cost: 1 CP A protective silhouette rises between danger and its target. Reduce the triggering damage: | CL | Damage Reduction | | --- | --- | | 1-10 | 1d8 + Path key ability modifier | | 11-16 | 2d8 + Path key ability modifier | | 17-20 | 3d8 + Path key ability modifier | If the protected creature occupies one of your Shadowed Spaces, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction. ### Silhouette Veil Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP Wrap yourself in overlapping silhouettes. For the duration: Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in Dim Light or Darkness. The first opportunity attack made against you each round has Disadvantage. Creatures more than 30 feet away have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks made to identify your exact position while you are Lightly Obscured. Silhouette Veil does not make you Invisible. ### Shadow Signal Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 1 mile Duration: 10 minutes Cost: 1 CP Project a simple silhouette onto a visible surface. Examples include: a warning symbol; an arrow; a written message; a moving figure; a map-like outline; a concealed mark visible only from one angle. ## FOUNDATION REALM SHADOW TALENTS ### Ambush From Below Classification: Imprint Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature bearing your Shadow Mark moves, attacks, or ends its turn within 60 feet Cost: 2 CP The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes Ambush From Below damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: The creature takes half as much Ambush From Below damage and suffers no Reaction loss. Ambush From Below damage is determined by your Cultivation Level. | CL | Damage | | --- | --- | | 5-10 | 3d8 | | 11-16 | 4d8 | | 17-20 | 5d8 | A creature can trigger Ambush From Below only once per turn. ### Shadow Bind Classification: Imprint Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Choose one creature bearing your Shadow Mark or standing inside one of your Shadowed Spaces. The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The creature is Restrained. Successful Save: The creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. A Restrained creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. ### Step Behind the Body Classification: Step Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Cost: +1 CP When a creature bears your Shadow Mark, its silhouette becomes a legal Shadow Step destination. You may end your Shadow Step in an unoccupied space within 5 feet of that creature. This does not allow you to cross Total Cover, a sealed barrier, or a Dimensional Lock. ### Two Shadows Crossing Classification: Step Talent Prerequisite: CL 7+ Cost: +2 CP Carry one willing creature of your size or smaller through Shadow Step. The creature must begin adjacent to you and arrive in an unoccupied space adjacent to your destination. ### Shadow Exchange Classification: Step Talent Prerequisite: Shadow Ward, CL 7+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet is hit by an attack Cost: 4 CP Teleport the protected creature into one visible, unoccupied Shadowed Space within 20 feet. The destination must not be blocked by a solid obstacle. If this movement carries the creature outside the triggering attack’s reach, line, or area, the attack misses that creature. Shadow Exchange cannot cross a sealed barrier or Dimensional Lock. ### Shadow Lurk Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes Cost: 2 CP Detach the target’s Cast Shadow as a loyal scout. The target does not cast an ordinary shadow while the lurk exists. #### Shadow Lurk AC: 10 + your Proficiency BonusHP: Equal to your CLSpeed: 30 feet The lurk: appears as a shaded imitation of its source; acts immediately after its source; may move, Dodge, Hide, Help, manipulate objects, and use ordinary skill proficiencies possessed by its source; cannot attack; cannot activate Path features, sphere talents, Forged Techniques, limited-use abilities, or items; must remain within 300 feet of its source. Either the target or the lurk may retract it as a Bonus Action. If the lurk is reduced to 0 HP or moves beyond its maximum range, it vanishes and the target becomes Stunned until the end of its next turn. When it returns, the target immediately remembers everything the lurk perceived. ### Animated Shadow Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Prerequisite: Shadow Lurk, CL 7+ Your Shadow Lurk becomes more substantial. Its HP becomes: 2 x CL It uses the Strength score of its original source. It gains nonmagical shadowstuff versions of the source’s ordinary equipment. Once during its turn, it may make one ordinary weapon attack or unarmed strike using the source’s attack modifier. The attack deals half ordinary damage. It still cannot activate: Path features; sphere talents; Forged Techniques; consumable items; supernatural equipment; limited-use abilities. ### Shadow Mantle Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Wrap yourself in layered silhouettes. Gain: +2 AC; Resistance to Psychic and Necrotic damage; Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks; Disadvantage on opportunity attacks made against you; the ability to see normally through ordinary Darkness. Shadow Mantle does not automatically allow sight through supernatural Darkness. ### Borrowed Silhouette Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes Cost: 3 CP Choose one creature you can see. An unwilling creature makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Your silhouette resembles its silhouette. Successful Save: No effect. For the duration, gain Advantage on checks made to: imitate the target’s build at a distance; confuse observers in Dim Light; conceal yourself among similar figures; create uncertainty over which body cast which shadow. Borrowed Silhouette does not copy: voice; memories; equipment; aura; exact facial details. ## CORE FORMATION REALM SHADOW TALENTS ### Court of the Second Silhouette Classification: Shadow Domain Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP Every visible shadow inside the Domain becomes a temporary Shadow Anchor for you. #### You and Allies Gain +1 AC. Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. May move through allied spaces. May move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks after an enemy misses them. #### Enemies Cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible against you. Treat movement away from their own silhouettes as difficult terrain. Have Disadvantage on checks made to Hide. When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: Apply your Shadow Mark. Deal 2d8 Psychic, Necrotic, or Slashing damage. Reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. Prevent Reactions until the start of its next turn. Pull the creature 10 feet toward its own shadow. Successful Save: Apply your Shadow Mark until the start of its next turn. ### Long Road Between Lanterns Classification: Step Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 1 mile Cost: 5 CP Teleport from one of your Shadow Anchors into another Shadow Anchor within range. You may bring a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each creature must begin within 5 feet of the starting anchor and arrive within 5 feet of the destination anchor. Long Road Between Lanterns cannot cross a sealed barrier, Dimensional Lock, or planar boundary. ### Seize the Second Body Classification: Imprint Talent Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 5 CP Choose one creature bearing your Shadow Mark. The creature makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: Pull it up to 20 feet toward its own shadow. Move its shadow up to 20 feet and force its body to follow. Reduce its Speed to 0 until the start of your next turn. Prevent Reactions until the start of your next turn and knock it Prone. Successful Save: Pull the creature 5 feet or reduce its Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. ### Shadow Doppelganger Classification: Unique Shadow Talent Prerequisite: Animated Shadow, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 6 CP Create one combat-ready echo of yourself or one willing creature. The doppelganger acts immediately after your turn. As a Bonus Action, command it to: Attack; Dash; Disengage; Dodge; Help; Hide. Without a command, it Dodges. The doppelganger may make one: ordinary weapon attack; unarmed strike; base Cultivation Attack costing no CP. The copied attack deals half ordinary damage. The doppelganger cannot trigger: additional attacks; CP talents; limited-use features; Domains; Nascent Soul Realm talents; Secret talents; Forged Techniques; summons. ### Shadowless Reversal Classification: Step Talent Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You are hit by an attack Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per round Leave a false silhouette behind and use Shadow Step immediately. If you move outside the attack’s reach, line, or area, the attack misses. Your abandoned silhouette remains until the start of your next turn. The first creature entering its space or starting its turn there makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The creature is Restrained until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: The creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. ## NASCENT SOUL REALM SHADOW TALENTS ### Shadow-Sovereign Incarnation Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign silhouette standing between illumination and absence. Gain: Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover; +3 AC; Resistance to Psychic, Necrotic, and nonmagical weapon damage; Shadow Step range becomes 60 feet; use Shadow Step once per turn without spending CP; maintain one Shadow Lurk or Shadow Doppelganger without Concentration; apply Shadow Mark with Shadow Fang even when the attack misses. ### World of Living Shadows Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Every visible silhouette inside the area becomes part of your battlefield. #### Allies Gain +1 AC. Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. May use one visible shadow inside the area as a Shadow Step destination once per turn. #### Enemies Cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible. Treat the area as difficult terrain. Have Disadvantage on sight-based Wisdom (Perception) checks. When an enemy enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 4d8 Psychic, Necrotic, or Slashing damage and becomes Restrained until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: The creature takes half damage and is not Restrained. A creature takes this damage only once per turn. ### Sever the Second Silhouette Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Choose one creature bearing your Shadow Mark. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The target takes 12d10 Psychic, Necrotic, or Slashing damage. Its Speed becomes 0 and it cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: The target takes half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Until the end of your next turn, the target’s separated shadow remains in its current space as a Shadow Anchor. ## SECRET SHADOW INHERITANCE ### Shadow That Outlives the Body “The enemy destroyed the cultivator. The shadow remained unconvinced.” Classification: Secret Shadow Talent Prerequisite: CL 17+, Shadow-Sovereign Incarnation, hidden primordial-shadow inheritance Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You would drop to 0 HP, fail a saving throw, or be struck by a critical hit Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Choose one: Drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP. Succeed on the triggering saving throw. Turn the triggering critical hit into a miss. Move up to 60 feet into a visible Shadowed Space and leave a shadow corpse behind. End one ordinary restraint, grapple, or physical prison affecting you. Until the end of your next turn: Become Incorporeal. Gain Resistance to all damage except Radiant, Force, and Void effects. May move through occupied spaces and ordinary barriers as difficult terrain. Cannot end your turn inside a barrier. ## OPTIONAL SHADOW CULTIVATION VARIANTS A Shadow cultivation variant changes which half of the Shadow Dao the cultivator understands most clearly. These variants are mutually exclusive. They do not automatically grant bonus talents. ### Cast by Light “The brighter the lantern, the sharper the blade behind the body.” You cultivate precise Cast Shadows. #### Benefits A visible Cast Shadow counts as a Shadowed Space even inside Bright Light. A Shadow Anchor created from a visible Cast Shadow lasts 8 hours. Gain Advantage on Cultivation Checks made to notice, identify, or follow a visible silhouette. #### Limitation Dim Light or Darkness without a visible silhouette does not count as a Shadowed Space for your talents unless: you created the shadow through a Shadow talent; you placed a Shadow Anchor there; the space contains a creature bearing your Shadow Mark. ### Born in Absence “When the lantern dies, the room does not become empty. It becomes mine.” You cultivate Lightless Shadows. #### Benefits Dim Light and Darkness always count as Shadowed Spaces for your talents. Shadow Step may begin or end inside your own supernatural Darkness without requiring a sharply visible Cast Shadow. Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks in Dim Light or Darkness. #### Limitation A creature’s Cast Shadow inside Bright Light does not count as a valid remote target for your talents unless: the creature bears your Shadow Mark; you previously created a Shadow Anchor from its silhouette. ## PATH SYNERGIES ### Spirit Awakening - Second-Silhouette Soul Use Wisdom as your Shadow key ability. Your Shadow talents affect spirits, ghosts, incorporeal creatures, possessing entities, and astral projections normally. A spirit bearing Shadow Mark leaves a readable spiritual silhouette even without a physical body. ### Qi Cultivation - Refined Silhouette Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Shadow key ability. Once per turn, reduce the CP cost of one Shadow talent by 1, minimum 1. Increase Second Silhouette and Shadow Fang range by 30 feet. ### Body Refining - Shadow-Bound Body Requires the Shadow-Bound Body Cultivation Insight. Use Constitution and Stamina for Shadow talents. While Silhouette Veil, Shadow Mantle, or Shadow-Sovereign Incarnation is active: Gain +1 AC. Increase Speed by 10 feet. Gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks. ## CULTIVATION INSIGHTS ### Shadow-Bound Body Prerequisite: Body Refining, Shadow sphere, CL 4+ Learn Shadow as a Body Refining discipline. Use Constitution and Stamina for Shadow talents. Gain the Shadow-Bound Body synergy. ### Second-Silhouette Adept Prerequisite: Shadow sphere, CL 8+ When you apply your Shadow Mark to an unwilling creature with Second Silhouette, Shadow Fang, or another Shadow talent that would normally make the mark last only until the start of your next turn, the mark instead lasts for up to 1 minute. The marked creature repeats a Charisma saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC at the end of each of its turns, ending this extended mark on itself on a success. A willing creature's 1-minute Shadow Mark does not require repeated saving throws. A Shadow Mark extended by Lingering Trace or another talent follows that talent's duration and ending rules instead. ### Lantern-Edge Walker Prerequisite: Shadow sphere, CL 8+ Increase Shadow Step range by 20 feet. Once per short rest, use Two Shadows Crossing without paying its additional CP cost. ### Shadow-Puppet Disciple Prerequisite: Shadow Lurk, CL 8+ Your Shadow Lurk and Shadow Doppelganger gain: additional HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks; the ability to manipulate one unattended object as part of movement. This does not grant additional actions or attacks.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### ACTIVE DEFENSE
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature you are aware of makes an attack roll against you
Requirement: Wielding a Shield
Cost: None
Raise, angle, or turn your Shield against the incoming attack.
Increase your Shield Bonus to AC against the triggering attack by:
+2 AC
This is an additional increase to the AC already granted by the Shield.
You may use Active Defense after the attack roll is made but before damage or another hit effect resolves.
You may expend Martial Focus to use Active Defense without spending a Reaction.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
Active Defense applies only against the triggering attack;
Active Defense does not grant cover;
Active Defense does not block an effect that does not use an attack roll;
Active Defense does not function while you are unaware of the attacker;
Active Defense does not function while you cannot present the Shield toward the incoming attack;
each use of Active Defense may benefit from no more than one Deflect talent.
