spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Shield Qi Expression: Primary — Shield Qi; Supporting — Metal Qi, Earth Qi, Guardian Qi, Oath Qi. “A wall waits for the blow. A shield goes out to meet it.” Sphere Type: Martial Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus; selected projected techniques may also use CP or Stamina when explicitly permitted Common Effects: Active Defense, shield angles, Deflect talents, carried cover, redirection, shield bashes, shield skating, projected Shield Faces, moving ramparts, Shield Intent, Shield Soul, calamity turning Shield cultivates the face turned toward danger. Its practitioners master a wielded shield as a moving defensive surface: raising the correct angle, catching attacks, turning force aside, sheltering allies, and eventually projecting vast Shield Faces capable of meeting battlefield-scale calamities. Shield is distinct from Guardian and Protection. Guardian personally bears danger for others. Protection creates Aegises, Wards, and independent Barriers. Shield turns a wielded defensive face toward the incoming threat and decides whether to block, catch, crush, redirect, or shelter. ### RULES BASELINE This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Attack action, Opportunity Attack, Armor Class, Cover, Dodge, Utilize, Concentration, saving throw, Critical Hit, and conditions unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### BARRIERS, DOMAINS, AND FORMATION ANCHORS A Barrier is a temporary supernatural barrier, including a Protection-sphere Barrier or another effect that explicitly identifies itself as a Barrier. A Domain is a high-rank cultivation effect that says it is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove a Domain unless the technique explicitly says otherwise. A Formation Anchor is an anchor point explicitly created by a Formation or identified by the GM as part of a Formation project. Shield talents do not create Formation Anchors automatically. #### SHIELD TRAINING A standard Shield grants a +2 bonus to Armor Class only when the wielder has Shield training. A creature may wield only one Shield at a time. Donning or doffing a Shield requires the Utilize action. Shield talents may explicitly equip, release, throw, recover, animate, or spiritually project a Shield more quickly. #### COVER Use the ordinary 2024 cover rules unless a Shield talent says otherwise. Half Cover: +2 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. Three-Quarters Cover: +5 bonus to AC and Dexterity saving throws. Total Cover: cannot be targeted directly by an attack or another effect unless the effect can reach the target around the cover. Cover does not stack with itself. Use the highest degree of cover that applies. #### DODGE Use the ordinary 2024 Dodge action unless a Shield talent says otherwise. Until the start of your next turn: attack rolls against you have Disadvantage if you can see the attacker; you make Dexterity saving throws with Advantage. #### LOCAL DISARM RULE The 2024 core rules do not define a universal Disarm action. Shield uses the following local Disarm maneuver because Catch Blade requires it. When you would make a weapon attack, replace that attack with a Disarm attempt against one object held by the target. Make the weapon attack roll contested by the target’s choice of: Strength (Athletics); Dexterity (Acrobatics). Success: The target drops the object. The Disarm deals no damage. Apply the following modifiers: you have Disadvantage if the target holds the object with two or more hands; the target has Advantage if it is larger than you; the target has Disadvantage if it is smaller than you. A Shield talent may explicitly modify this maneuver. #### 2024 SHOVE Under the ordinary 2024 rules, Shove is one option of an Unarmed Strike. The target chooses a Strength or Dexterity saving throw against: 8 + your Strength modifier + your Proficiency Bonus On a failed save, push the target 5 feet away or give it the Prone condition. The target must be no more than one size larger than you unless a talent says otherwise. #### ATTACK ROLLS AND MASSIVE ATTACKS Active Defense applies to attack rolls unless a talent explicitly expands it to another kind of effect. A Shield talent that redirects an attack does not automatically redirect: an area effect; a saving-throw effect; a siege weapon; a mountain-sized projectile; a narrative-scale calamity; an attack that cannot legally reach the new target. Higher-Realm talents may explicitly change these limits. ### CORE SHIELD RULES #### MARTIAL FOCUS Shield uses Martial Focus. you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is currently absent. Martial Focus represents vigilance, breath, posture, grip, and the instant in which the shield-bearer recognizes the angle that matters. #### SHIELD For Shield talents, a Shield is an equipped object that grants a Shield bonus to AC. Unless a talent or variant says otherwise: you must have Shield training to gain the Shield’s AC bonus; you must be wielding the Shield to use Shield talents; you may use only one Shield at a time; a buckler, tower shield, artifact shield, folding shield, bladed shield, or setting-appropriate shield may qualify when the GM approves its ordinary statistics; a Shield talent does not automatically transform the Shield into a weapon; a Shield talent does not automatically grant Shield training to an ally. #### SHIELD BONUS Your Shield Bonus is the AC bonus granted by the Shield you are currently wielding. A standard Shield normally grants: +2 AC If a magic Shield grants an additional enhancement bonus to AC, include that enhancement when a Shield talent refers to the Shield Bonus unless the talent says otherwise. #### ACTIVE DEFENSE Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you are aware of makes an attack roll against you Requirement: Wielding a Shield Cost: None Raise, angle, or turn your Shield against the incoming attack. Increase your Shield Bonus to AC against the triggering attack by: +2 AC This is an additional increase to the AC already granted by the Shield. You may use Active Defense after the attack roll is made but before damage or another hit effect resolves. You may expend Martial Focus to use Active Defense without spending a Reaction. Unless a talent says otherwise: Active Defense applies only against the triggering attack; Active Defense does not grant cover; Active Defense does not block an effect that does not use an attack roll; Active Defense does not function while you are unaware of the attacker; Active Defense does not function while you cannot present the Shield toward the incoming attack; each use of Active Defense may benefit from no more than one Deflect talent. #### DEFLECT TALENT A talent with the Deflect tag adds an effect to one use of Active Defense. Unless a talent says otherwise: choose one Deflect talent after determining whether the triggering attack hits or misses; apply no more than one Deflect talent to one use of Active Defense; a Deflect talent affects only the triggering attack; a Deflect talent does not create an additional Reaction; a Deflect talent does not redirect an attack to an illegal target; an attack retains its original attack roll, damage, damage types, and other effects when redirected. #### SHIELD FACE A Shield Face is a physical or projected defensive surface created by a Shield talent. Unless a talent says otherwise: choose one edge of your space when establishing a Shield Face; the Shield Face protects against routes that cross that edge from the defended side; it remains attached to you and moves with you; it ends at the start of your next turn; it is directional; it does not automatically block movement; it does not automatically provide Total Cover; it is not a Barrier unless the talent explicitly says it is a Barrier; it does not block teleportation, gaze effects, possession, planar travel, Ethereal travel, or effects that do not cross its physical surface. #### BROKEN SHIELD Some Shield talents break a Shield. A broken Shield: no longer grants its Shield Bonus; cannot be used for Shield talents; remains an object that can be carried; may often be repaired during a Long Rest with suitable tools and materials; may require Smithing, artifact refinement, a Cultivation Check, special materials, or a narrative repair scene when magical, spiritual, or unusually valuable. A talent may state that an artifact Shield is suppressed, cracked, or spiritually exhausted rather than physically destroyed. ### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES #### SHIELD TRAINING When you learn Shield: gain Shield training; if you already possess Shield training, choose one Mortal Realm Shield talent for which you meet the prerequisites as a bonus talent; gain Active Defense. #### ACTIVE DEFENSE When you learn Shield, gain Active Defense as described in the Core Shield Rules. ### SHIELD TALENT TAGS #### DEFLECT TALENTS A Deflect talent modifies one use of Active Defense. #### FACE TALENTS A Face talent creates or modifies a Shield Face. #### COUNTER TALENTS A Counter talent turns a successful defense into an attack, Shove, Disarm, movement effect, or another immediate answer. #### MOVEMENT TALENTS A Movement talent changes how the Shield cultivator moves with, rides, throws, or recovers a Shield. #### FOCUS TALENTS A Focus talent modifies Martial Focus expenditure or recovery. #### DOMAIN TALENTS A Domain talent establishes a short-lived Core Formation battlefield court. #### REALM EVOLUTIONS A Realm Evolution represents Shield mastery beyond ordinary martial skill. ### MORTAL REALM SHIELD TALENTS #### CATCH BLADE - DEFLECT, COUNTER When the triggering attack misses and was made with a melee weapon, make a Disarm attempt against that weapon without spending an Action. Add any magic enhancement bonus granted by your Shield to the Disarm attack roll. Catch Blade does not automatically disarm: natural weapons; body parts; integrated weapons; a weapon too large for your Shield to meaningfully catch; a weapon wielded by a narrative-scale creature unless the GM permits the attempt. #### SMASHING COUNTER - DEFLECT, COUNTER When the triggering attack misses and the attacker is adjacent to you, immediately attempt the ordinary 2024 Shove option of an Unarmed Strike against that creature. The Shield may deliver the shove as a rim strike, shoulder check, rising bash, or body-weighted impact. #### REDIRECTING SHIELD - DEFLECT, COUNTER When a weapon attack misses a creature benefiting from your Active Defense, you may expend Martial Focus. Choose one new legal target for the attack. For a melee attack, the new target must be within the attacker’s original reach. For a ranged attack, the new target must be within the attack’s original range from the attacker. Compare the original attack roll to the new target’s AC. The attack retains its original damage and effects. Redirecting Shield does not affect siege weapons, massive weapons, area effects, or attacks that cannot legally reach the new target. #### SACRIFICIAL SHIELD - DEFLECT When the triggering attack hits and is a Critical Hit, break your Shield. The Critical Hit becomes a normal hit. Resolve the attack normally after removing the additional effects caused solely by the Critical Hit. #### BLOCKADE You may use Active Defense when you are subjected to an effect that allows a Dexterity saving throw to take half damage. When used this way: add your Shield Bonus to the Dexterity saving throw instead of increasing your AC; a successful saving throw causes you to take no damage from the effect; choose no Deflect talent unless another talent explicitly allows one. Blockade does not automatically protect against an effect that cannot reasonably be met by presenting the Shield toward its route. #### COVER ALLY You may use Active Defense when an attack targets one ally within your natural reach. You must be aware of the attacker and able to present the Shield between the attack and the ally. The ally gains the Active Defense AC increase against the triggering attack. When a Shield talent refers to a creature benefiting from your Active Defense, an ally protected through Cover Ally qualifies. #### EXTENSIVE DEFENSE - FOCUS Expend Martial Focus without spending an Action, including when it is not your turn. Until the start of your next turn, apply Active Defense against every valid triggering attack without spending a Reaction. If you know Cover Ally, apply this benefit to yourself and allies within your natural reach whenever the attack route permits you to present the Shield. Each triggering attack remains a separate use of Active Defense and may benefit from one Deflect talent. #### FLEXIBLE COVER - FACE Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Until the start of your next turn Choose one edge of your space and establish a physical Shield Face. The Shield Face provides Three-Quarters Cover against attacks and effects whose routes cross the chosen edge toward a protected creature directly behind that face. You may expend Martial Focus to use Flexible Cover as a Bonus Action. As a Reaction, change the selected edge of your space. Flexible Cover does not provide sufficient concealment to allow the Hide action by itself. #### GREATER DEFLECT - FOCUS When using Active Defense, expend Martial Focus to apply two different Deflect talents instead of one. Resolve both talents in the order you choose. #### GUARDED STANCE You may use Active Defense when you are not equipped with a Shield. Choose one weapon you are wielding. Treat that weapon as a Shield for talents that reference your Shield. The chosen weapon has a Shield Bonus of 0 unless another feature grants it a Shield Bonus. Active Defense still grants its additional +2 AC against the triggering attack. A weapon used through Guarded Stance is not a Shield for unrelated rules and does not grant ordinary Shield training. #### INTERPOSING SHIELD A creature benefiting from your Active Defense reduces damage taken from the triggering attack by: your Proficiency Bonus Apply this reduction before Resistance. #### PUNCH BLOCK When you use Active Defense, you may make an attack roll with an Unarmed Strike and use the result in place of your AC for resolving the triggering attack, even if the result is lower. You still count as using Active Defense and may apply one Deflect talent. Punch Block represents catching the attack with the shield rim, gauntlet, forearm, shoulder, or an aggressively timed strike. #### REACTIVE DEFENSE - COUNTER Whenever you take the Dodge action while wielding a Shield, you may make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike as a Reaction against one creature that misses you with an attack before the start of your next turn. You may make this attack only once per use of Dodge. #### SHIELD SKATE - MOVEMENT When moving down an incline or taking the Dash action, you may use a Bonus Action to throw your Shield beneath your feet and skate across the ground. Until the end of the current turn: increase your Speed by 20 feet; ignore nonmagical difficult terrain that your Shield can physically cross; do not benefit from the Shield’s AC bonus during movement made through Shield Skate; recover and re-equip the Shield at the end of your movement without using the Utilize action. The GM determines whether terrain can physically support Shield Skate. ### FOUNDATION REALM SHIELD TALENTS At Foundation Realm, Shield mastery becomes openly supernatural. The physical Shield remains the focus, but its meaning extends beyond its rim. #### PROJECTED SHIELD FACE - REALM EVOLUTION Prerequisite: CL 5+ While wielding a Shield, your Active Defense and Face talents may manifest visible or nearly invisible Shield-Qi. A projected Shield Face may appear as: a translucent shield several times larger than the physical Shield; overlapping scales of compressed Qi; a rotating mirror-bright disc; an ancestral shield emblem; a circular ripple that catches the incoming attack; a scripture-specific spiritual rampart. Gain the following benefits: Active Defense and your Deflect talents may affect magical attack rolls, ghost strikes, incorporeal attacks, and Cultivation Attack rolls normally. When using Cover Ally, increase its range to 15 feet. You still require a clear legal route from your Shield to the ally and must be able to present the projected face toward the incoming attack. When using Flexible Cover, the Shield Face becomes a 15-foot-wide, 10-foot-high plane centered on the chosen edge of your space. A projected Shield Face remains attached to you, moves with you, and protects creatures behind it when an attack or effect physically crosses its surface. Projected Shield Face does not: become a free-standing Barrier; block movement; grant general telekinesis; pass through Total Cover or a sealed Barrier; protect against teleportation, gaze effects, possession, or effects that do not cross its surface; allow a mundane Shield to answer a narrative-scale calamity without an appropriate higher-Realm talent. #### PERFECT REDIRECTION - DEFLECT, COUNTER Prerequisite: Redirecting Shield, CL 7+ You may use Redirecting Shield against spell attacks and Cultivation Attack rolls. You may describe the defense as reflecting a ray, tilting a spell-light trajectory, turning a ghost strike, or catching a projected technique on the Shield’s cultivated face. Perfect Redirection does not redirect saving-throw effects or effects that cannot legally reach the new target. #### RETURNING SHIELD DISC - MOVEMENT, COUNTER Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may throw your Shield as a returning weapon. Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Range: 30/90 feet Requirement: Wielding a Shield Replace one attack when you take the Attack action. Make a ranged weapon attack using Strength or Dexterity. Hit: Deal Bludgeoning damage: 1d8 + the chosen ability modifier After the attack resolves, the Shield returns to your hand and is immediately re-equipped without using the Utilize action. While the Shield is away from your hand, you do not gain its Shield Bonus and cannot use Shield talents unless another talent says otherwise. At CL 11+, the attack deals: 2d8 + the chosen ability modifier At CL 17+, the attack deals: 3d8 + the chosen ability modifier #### MOUNTAIN-ROOTED RIM Prerequisite: CL 5+ Whenever you use Active Defense or Blockade, reduce forced movement affecting the protected creature by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the protected creature would gain the Prone condition from the triggering attack or effect, it has Advantage on the saving throw or contest made to resist that condition. #### MOVING RAMPART - FACE Prerequisite: Flexible Cover, Projected Shield Face, CL 5+ When you establish Flexible Cover: you may use it as a Bonus Action without expending Martial Focus; your movement does not end the Shield Face; change the selected edge once during your turn without spending an Action; allies may move with you behind the projected face, provided they remain within 5 feet of its defended side. The Shield Face still ends at the start of your next turn. #### RAIN-ON-THE-LOTUS DEFLECTION - DEFLECT Prerequisite: Projected Shield Face, CL 5+ When Active Defense causes a ranged weapon attack to miss, choose one: catch one ordinary projectile in a free hand; cause the projectile to fall harmlessly into one legal space within 10 feet; send the projectile back toward the attacker, making a ranged weapon attack with the projectile as part of the same defense. Use Dexterity for the returned attack. The returned attack deals the projectile’s ordinary damage and does not automatically apply the original attacker’s class features, talents, poisons, or expendable effects. #### HEAVEN-WARDING BLOCKADE Prerequisite: Blockade, Projected Shield Face, CL 7+ When using Blockade against an effect whose route physically crosses your projected Shield Face, you may extend Blockade to allies protected behind that face. Each protected ally adds your Shield Bonus to its Dexterity saving throw. Each ally that succeeds takes no damage from the effect. Use Heaven-Warding Blockade only once per round. #### SHIELD-FLIGHT RESCUE - MOVEMENT Prerequisite: Returning Shield Disc, Cover Ally, CL 7+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: An ally you can perceive within 30 feet is targeted by an attack roll Cost: Expend Martial Focus Throw your Shield toward the ally before the attack resolves. The ally benefits from your Active Defense against the triggering attack. After the attack resolves, choose one: the Shield returns to your hand and is immediately re-equipped; the Shield remains equipped by the ally until the start of your next turn, provided the ally has a free hand and is willing. If the Shield remains with the ally, you do not gain its Shield Bonus and cannot use talents requiring you to wield it until it returns. #### UNBROKEN RIM Prerequisite: CL 7+ When your Shield would break, be disarmed, become suppressed, or be destroyed by an ordinary effect, expend Martial Focus. Choose one: the Shield remains intact and equipped; the Shield becomes cracked but functional until the end of your next turn; immediately catch and re-equip the Shield after it is disarmed. Unbroken Rim does not automatically preserve an ordinary Shield against a superior Realm-defining sunder, artifact-destroying technique, or narrative-scale calamity. #### RIDING THE FALLING STAR - MOVEMENT Prerequisite: Shield Skate, Projected Shield Face, CL 7+ When using Shield Skate: you may cross water, snow, loose sand, unstable rubble, and similar surfaces; you may descend vertical surfaces safely; you reduce falling damage by five times your Cultivation Level; if you fall at least 20 feet before reaching the ground, you may move up to your Speed along the ground immediately after landing. Riding the Falling Star is shield-assisted movement. It does not grant flight. ### CORE FORMATION REALM SHIELD TALENTS At Core Formation Realm, the Shield cultivator no longer protects only the space directly behind one physical rim. Their understanding of angle reshapes the nearby battlefield. #### COURT OF TEN THOUSAND TURNING FACES - DOMAIN “The enemy found an opening and struck. The opening turned sideways.” Prerequisite: Projected Shield Face, CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Short Rest Establish a Court of orbiting Shield-Qi surfaces, reflected angles, shield shadows, and ancestral ramparts. For the duration: Projected Shield Face and Cover Ally may protect any ally inside the Court when you can perceive the incoming route. Once per round, use Active Defense inside the Court without spending a Reaction or expending Martial Focus. When you establish Flexible Cover, choose up to three different edges or connected 5-foot segments inside the Court. Each becomes a projected Shield Face until the start of your next turn. When an attack misses because of your Active Defense, move one projected Shield Face up to 10 feet to another legal edge or connected segment inside the Court without spending an Action. Allies of your choice inside the Court gain Half Cover against ranged attacks originating outside the Court. When you use Redirecting Shield, the new target may be any legal target inside the Court that the redirected attack can reach after touching one of your projected Shield Faces. The Court does not automatically: create Total Cover; stop teleportation; block possession or gaze effects; protect against effects originating inside a protected space; become permanent Formation infrastructure; redirect a narrative-scale calamity without a higher-Realm talent. #### ORBITING SHIELD DISC - REALM EVOLUTION Prerequisite: Returning Shield Disc, CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Release your Shield into a controlled orbit around you. For the duration: count as wielding the Shield; retain its Shield Bonus; keep both hands free; may use Shield talents normally; the Shield may originate Returning Shield Disc attacks from any legal space within 10 feet of you; after each Returning Shield Disc attack, place the Shield in any legal space within 10 feet of you before it resumes orbiting; your Shield cannot independently improvise, take Actions, or move beyond its listed control distance. The Shield falls into your hand or into your space when the effect ends. #### HEAVEN-REBUKING BASH - COUNTER Prerequisite: Smashing Counter, Projected Shield Face, CL 10+ When Smashing Counter succeeds, choose one additional effect: push the target an additional 15 feet; deal Bludgeoning damage equal to 2d8 + your Strength modifier; give the target the Prone condition after the push; move up to 15 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks and remain adjacent to the target if possible. At CL 17+, increase the additional push to 30 feet and the damage to: 4d8 + your Strength modifier #### SEAL THE BREACH - FACE Prerequisite: Projected Shield Face, Flexible Cover, CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Manifest one 15-foot-wide, 15-foot-high Shield-Qi Face centered on one edge of your space. Seal the Breach is a temporary Barrier attached to you. The face: moves with you; blocks physical movement through its surface; blocks attacks, projectiles, breath weapons, line effects, and similar effects that must physically cross its surface; blocks Incorporeal Movement through its physical boundary; may be rotated once during your turn without spending an Action; may be rotated as a Reaction when a creature you perceive begins moving. The Barrier does not automatically block: teleportation; planar travel; Ethereal travel; possession; gaze attacks; effects originating behind the face; spiritual effects that do not physically cross its boundary. Seal the Breach ends if you stop wielding your Shield or have the Incapacitated condition. #### THOUSAND-RICOCHET SCRIPTURE - DEFLECT, COUNTER Prerequisite: Redirecting Shield, CL 12+ When you use Redirecting Shield, you may expend Martial Focus to redirect the attack through up to three different legal targets. Resolve the original attack roll against each target’s AC in sequence. The attack stops after the first hit. Each redirection must follow a plausible legal route between Shield Faces, surfaces, weapons, or terrain. A projectile or attack that cannot continue along a legal route ends harmlessly. #### THE MOUNTAIN FITS BEHIND ONE SHIELD - FACE Prerequisite: Moving Rampart, CL 12+ When you establish Flexible Cover or Seal the Breach, increase the projected face to up to: 30 feet wide and 20 feet high You may reduce its size when creating it. When a creature behind the face would be pushed, pulled, or knocked Prone by an effect crossing the face, reduce the forced movement by 20 feet and grant Advantage on one saving throw made to resist Prone. #### CELESTIAL-DISC SWEEP - COUNTER Prerequisite: Returning Shield Disc, CL 12+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot Cone or 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide Cost: Expend Martial Focus Throw the Shield along a sweeping path before it returns to your hand. Each hostile creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take Bludgeoning damage and choose whether the Shield knocks the creature Prone or pushes it 15 feet away from the path. Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no additional effect. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 12-16 | 4d8 | | 17-20 | 6d8 | Unattended ordinary projectiles and fragile objects in the area may be scattered or broken. #### SHIELD OF THE SECOND ANSWER - DEFLECT Prerequisite: Greater Deflect, CL 12+ When Active Defense causes an attack to miss, retain one echoing Shield Face until the start of your next turn. The next valid attack against the same protected creature before the echo ends receives the Active Defense AC increase without spending your Reaction or Martial Focus. The echo may benefit from one Deflect talent. Use Shield of the Second Answer only once per round. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM SHIELD TALENTS At Nascent Soul Realm, the Shield cultivator awakens a sovereign defensive presence. The Shield is no longer merely equipment. It becomes the visible face of a cultivated soul that has learned to answer catastrophe. #### SOVEREIGN SHIELD-SOUL INCARNATION - REALM EVOLUTION “Behind the cultivator stood no fortress. The fortress had learned to walk.” Prerequisite: Projected Shield Face, CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Awaken a Shield Soul and manifest a sovereign rampart around your body. Your incarnation may appear as: a colossal ancestral shield floating behind you; a wheel of interlocking celestial discs; a tortoise-shell mandala; a mirror-bright sun shield; a mountain gate carried in one hand; a spectral fortress marching one step behind you. For the duration: gain a Fly Speed of 40 feet and Hover; increase Projected Shield Face dimensions by 20 feet in width and 10 feet in height; increase Cover Ally range to 60 feet when a clear legal route exists; use Active Defense once per round without spending a Reaction or expending Martial Focus; gain one additional Reaction each round, usable only for Shield talents; when Active Defense applies, reduce damage from the triggering attack by your Proficiency Bonus before Resistance, whether or not you know Interposing Shield; Shield Faces created by your talents count as Barriers against physical crossing unless you choose otherwise when creating them; your Shield talents affect incorporeal creatures, spiritual projections, ghost strikes, and physically traveling spiritual techniques normally; regain Martial Focus whenever a hostile attack misses because of your Active Defense, once per round. The incarnation does not automatically block teleportation, possession, gaze effects, or spiritual techniques that do not physically cross a Shield Face. #### TEN THOUSAND REFLECTIONS - DEFLECT, COUNTER Prerequisite: Court of Ten Thousand Turning Faces or Sovereign Shield-Soul Incarnation, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A hostile creature makes an attack roll against you or an ally you can perceive within 60 feet Cost: Expend Martial Focus Manifest reflected Shield Faces around up to your Proficiency Bonus legal targets within 60 feet. Apply Active Defense against the triggering attack and against the next valid attack targeting each chosen creature before the start of your next turn. Each protected creature may benefit from one Deflect talent against one attack. #### RETURN THE HEAVENSENT BLOW - COUNTER Prerequisite: Blockade, Perfect Redirection, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You perceive a line, cone, breath weapon, projectile storm, or physically traveling cultivation effect whose route crosses one of your Shield Faces Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Make a Cultivation Check against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC or another appropriate DC determined by the GM. Successful Check: Choose one: turn the effect up to 180 degrees and resolve its remaining route in a new legal direction; split the effect around the defended side of your Shield Face, causing protected creatures behind it to take no damage or additional effects; drive the effect into one legal unoccupied area within 60 feet where its remaining route can resolve harmlessly. Failed Check: Creatures behind the Shield Face gain Resistance to the triggering damage and Advantage on saving throws against its additional effects. Return the Heavensent Blow does not automatically redirect: teleportation; possession; gaze effects; internal effects; a Domain; a Secret Inheritance; a narrative-scale calamity beyond the Shield’s current Realm. #### SHIELD WITHOUT DISTANCE - REALM EVOLUTION Prerequisite: Shield-Flight Rescue, CL 15+ Your Shield Soul may appear wherever your intent can still legally reach. Gain the following benefits: increase Shield-Flight Rescue range to 300 feet; when using Cover Ally through Projected Shield Face, increase its range to 120 feet; your Shield may return to your hand from anywhere on the same battlefield at the end of your turn unless sealed, suppressed, carried across a dimensional boundary, or prevented by an equivalent effect; when you use Returning Shield Disc, the Shield may ricochet around corners along a clear sequence of surfaces and Shield Faces, ignoring Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover. Shield Without Distance does not grant remote perception, teleport an ally, or pass through Total Cover, sealed Barriers, or Dimensional Locks. #### WORLD-SHOULDERING FACE - FACE Prerequisite: Seal the Breach, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A structure, siege projectile, massive creature, collapsing terrain feature, or physically traveling calamity would cross one of your Shield Faces Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Until the end of your next turn, one Shield Face you created becomes a World-Shouldering Face. It may hold against: a collapsing gate; a siege projectile; a charging Gargantuan creature; a falling tower section; a flood front; an avalanche edge; a dragon’s breath; another comparable physically arriving threat. The GM may require a Strength saving throw, Constitution saving throw, or Cultivation Check against an appropriate DC. Success: The face holds long enough to protect the defended side and create one meaningful opportunity: escape, counterattack, rescue, repositioning, or reinforcement. Failure: The face still reduces the harm, buys a shorter opportunity, or changes the scene in a meaningful way before breaking. World-Shouldering Face does not permanently hold back a sea, mountain, divine manifestation, or comparable narrative-scale threat without a project, Forged Technique, or Secret Inheritance. #### HEAVEN-CRUSHING SHIELD DESCENT - COUNTER Prerequisite: Celestial-Disc Sweep, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 20-foot-radius, 40-foot-high Cylinder Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per Long Rest Manifest a vast Shield Soul above one point within range and drive it downward. Each hostile creature in the area makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Take Bludgeoning or Force damage, fall Prone, and become Restrained beneath the Shield-Qi face until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and move to the nearest legal space outside the area without falling Prone. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 15-16 | 8d8 | | 17-20 | 10d8 | A creature may use an Action to make a Strength (Athletics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the Restrained condition on itself or one adjacent creature on a success. At the GM’s discretion, the technique may damage fragile terrain, suppress ordinary projectiles, or create a temporary crater. #### SHIELD SOUL NEVER FALLS Prerequisite: Sovereign Shield-Soul Incarnation, CL 15+ When you would drop to 0 HP, lose Concentration on a Shield talent, or have your Shield destroyed, choose one: drop to 1 HP instead of 0 HP; maintain Concentration until the end of your next turn; suppress the Shield’s destruction until the end of your next turn; immediately establish one projected Shield Face without spending an Action. Once you use Shield Soul Never Falls, you cannot use it again until you finish a Long Rest. ### SECRET SHIELD INHERITANCE #### THE WORLD HAS ONLY ONE FRONT “Heaven sent its judgment from every direction. The old shield-bearer raised one hand and taught Heaven where the front was.” Classification: Secret Shield Inheritance Prerequisite: Sovereign Shield-Soul Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden shield scripture or equivalent narrative inheritance Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You perceive an attack, area effect, siege strike, breath weapon, physically traveling cultivation technique, or narrative-scale calamity entering a battlefield within 300 feet Cost: Expend Martial Focus; your wielded Shield becomes spiritually exhausted when the technique ends Use Limit: Once per week Manifest one colossal Shield Face along a visible legal line within range. The face may be up to: 300 feet wide and 150 feet high Choose one defended side. Until the end of your next turn, the Shield Face is a Barrier and the battlefield recognizes it as the single meaningful front of the conflict. Choose Hold or Turn when manifesting the face. ##### HOLD The Shield Face stops the triggering effect at its surface. Creatures and objects on the defended side gain Total Cover against the triggering effect when the effect must cross the face to reach them. The face may hold against: siege fire; a dragon’s breath; a flood front; an avalanche; a collapsing fortress wall; a descending celestial weapon; a massed projectile storm; a physically traveling Nascent Soul technique; another comparable calamity. A superior Secret, Legendary, or narrative-scale effect may force an opposed Cultivation Check. ##### TURN Attempt to turn the triggering effect aside or return it. Make a Cultivation Check against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC or an appropriate narrative-scale DC. Successful Check: Choose one legal new direction, destination, or origin-facing return route. Resolve the remaining physically traveling portion of the effect along that route. Failed Check: The face still holds long enough for creatures on the defended side to move up to their Speed as a Reaction without provoking Opportunity Attacks. The triggering effect then resolves with creatures behind the face gaining Resistance to its damage and Advantage on saving throws against its additional effects. ##### LIMITS The World Has Only One Front does not automatically stop or turn: teleportation; planar travel; Ethereal travel; possession; gaze effects; mind-affecting effects that do not cross the face; effects originating behind the face; a curse already inside a creature; an entire Domain merely because the face intersects it; a cosmic office, destiny, or permanent law of reality; a superior inheritance without an appropriate opposed check or narrative resolution. When the technique ends, your Shield becomes spiritually exhausted. Until repaired through one Long Rest, suitable maintenance, and any additional narrative requirement imposed by the GM: it grants no Shield Bonus; it cannot be used for Shield talents; an artifact Shield may require a specific refining material, oath, trial, or master artisan. ### OPTIONAL SHIELD CULTIVATION VARIANTS A Shield cultivation variant changes what the practitioner believes a shield truly is. These variants are mutually exclusive unless the GM permits a rare scripture to reconcile them. #### FEARLESS You do not cultivate the shield as armor. You cultivate the instant after the enemy believes the shield failed. ##### Limitation Active Defense does not increase AC. ##### Benefit Gain one Deflect talent as a bonus talent. You may still use Active Defense to trigger Deflect talents when the attack misses naturally or another Shield talent permits the response. #### PASSIVE BLOCKER You cultivate the shield as a carried wall rather than a reactive weapon. ##### Limitation You do not gain Active Defense. You cannot learn Deflect talents or talents that require Active Defense. You cannot possess Passive Blocker and either Fearless or Unshielded. ##### Benefit Gain Flexible Cover as a bonus talent. At CL 5+, when you gain Projected Shield Face, increase Flexible Cover width by an additional 5 feet. #### UNSHIELDED You cultivate the defensive principle rather than a literal shield. ##### Limitation You cannot use Active Defense with a Shield. ##### Benefit Gain Guarded Stance as a bonus talent. When Guarded Stance treats one wielded weapon as a Shield, you may use Shield talents through that weapon normally unless the talent specifically requires throwing, breaking, equipping, or physically presenting a Shield. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### BODY REFINING - IRON-RIM BODY Use Constitution for Shield saving throw DCs and Shield Cultivation Checks when higher. When a Shield talent calls for your Strength modifier, you may use Constitution instead. Once per round when a creature benefiting from your Active Defense still takes damage from the triggering attack, reduce that damage by your Constitution modifier, minimum 1, before Resistance. A Body Refiner may spend 1 Stamina instead of expending Martial Focus for one Shield talent that permits Martial Focus expenditure, once per round. #### QI CULTIVATION - REFINED SHIELD-QI CIRCULATION Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Shield key ability. Increase the width of projected Shield Faces by 5 feet. Once per turn, when a Shield talent requires you to expend Martial Focus, you may spend 1 CP instead. When you use Returning Shield Disc, the Shield may deal Force damage instead of Bludgeoning damage. #### SPIRIT AWAKENING - SHIELD-SOUL RESONANCE Use Wisdom as your Shield key ability. Your Shield talents affect: spirits; ghosts; astral projections; incorporeal creatures; physically traveling soul techniques; possession attempts that must cross your Shield Face before entering the target. Once per round when you are aware of a hostile possession attempt, forced soul displacement, or spirit-seizing technique targeting you or an ally protected behind one of your Shield Faces, use Active Defense as though the effect were an attack. Instead of increasing AC, add your Shield Bonus to one saving throw made against that effect. This does not automatically remove a possession or spiritual effect already established inside a creature. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### SHIELD SAGE Prerequisite: Shield sphere, CL 4+ While wielding a Shield: treat the Shield as a magical melee weapon; it deals 1d8 Bludgeoning damage; use Strength for attack and damage rolls; once per turn when you hit with the Shield, push the target 5 feet if it is no more than one size larger than you. A magic Shield’s enhancement bonus to AC does not automatically become an enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls unless its item rules say otherwise. #### MOBILE RAMPART ADEPT Prerequisite: Shield Skate or Moving Rampart, CL 6+ When using Shield Skate or moving while maintaining a Shield Face: allies within 5 feet may follow your movement by moving up to half their Speed as a Reaction; this movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from one creature whose attack route crosses your Shield Face; a creature may benefit from this Insight only once per round. #### TURNING-RIM ADEPT Prerequisite: Redirecting Shield, CL 8+ Once per Short Rest, use Redirecting Shield without expending Martial Focus. When redirecting a ranged weapon attack, ignore Half Cover for the new attack route. #### SOUL-BEARING RIM Prerequisite: Spirit Awakening, Shield sphere, CL 8+ Gain the Shield-Soul Resonance Path synergy. When you succeed on a saving throw improved through Shield-Soul Resonance, regain Martial Focus if absent. #### FORMATION-SHIELD CUSTODIAN Prerequisite: Shield sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation, artifact, gate defense, caravan defense, bodyguard court, siege screen, or training project, use one Shield principle you know as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. The project still requires: preparation time; suitable anchors; physical shields or symbolic shield emblems when appropriate; materials; spiritual power; maintenance; Formation-specific vulnerabilities. #### HEAVEN-BEARING DISCIPLE Prerequisite: World-Shouldering Face, CL 15+ Once per Long Rest, when World-Shouldering Face succeeds, extend its protection until the end of your next turn without requiring Concentration. During that extension, you may move at half Speed while maintaining the face.

#### ACTIVE DEFENSE
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature you are aware of makes an attack roll against you
Requirement: Wielding a Shield
Cost: None
Raise, angle, or turn your Shield against the incoming attack.
Increase your Shield Bonus to AC against the triggering attack by:
+2 AC
This is an additional increase to the AC already granted by the Shield.
You may use Active Defense after the attack roll is made but before damage or another hit effect resolves.
You may expend Martial Focus to use Active Defense without spending a Reaction.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
Active Defense applies only against the triggering attack;
Active Defense does not grant cover;
Active Defense does not block an effect that does not use an attack roll;
Active Defense does not function while you are unaware of the attacker;
Active Defense does not function while you cannot present the Shield toward the incoming attack;
each use of Active Defense may benefit from no more than one Deflect talent.

Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: One 10-foot cube
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 0 CP
You create a veil of real supernatural smoke in an unoccupied space you can see within range.
The area is Lightly Obscured.
A creature entirely on the opposite side of the Smoke Veil from an observer is also lightly obscured from that observer if the line of sight passes through the veil.
As a Bonus Action while the veil persists, move it up to 10 feet to a space within range.
The veil cannot pass through solid barriers unless a talent says otherwise.
At CL 5, the area becomes two connected 10-foot cubes.At CL 11, it becomes three connected 10-foot cubes.At CL 17, it becomes four connected 10-foot cubes.

#### Smoke Responses
You know the following three Smoke Responses.
You may spend one Smoke Trace to use a Smoke Response.
Unless a talent says otherwise, you can use only one Smoke Response per round.
##### Blind the Line
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature with your Smoke Trace makes an attack roll and the attack’s line of sight passes through your Smoke Veil
Spend the Smoke Trace.
The triggering attack has Disadvantage if the attacker relies on sight.
Blind the Line does not affect attacks from creatures that do not rely on sight or that can see clearly through smoke.
##### Follow the Soot
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Target: One creature, object, or space with your Smoke Trace
Spend the Smoke Trace.
Until the start of your next turn, you know the direction to the traced target while it remains within 120 feet of you.
If the target is Invisible, Hidden, or behind smoke, this does not reveal it to your allies, but it prevents it from being hidden from you by smoke alone.
##### Slip the Chimney Path
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Target: One Smoke Trace on a space within your Smoke Veil
Spend the Smoke Trace.
Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures inside your Smoke Veil.
This movement must begin or end in your Smoke Veil.
