spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Smoke Qi Expression: Primary — Smoke Qi; Supporting — Fire-Residue Qi, Wind Qi, Concealment Qi, Breath Qi. “Fire proves that something changed. Smoke asks who noticed the change, who breathed it in, and where the evidence went.” Sphere Type: Power Sphere / Elemental Terrain Sphere Rules Baseline: 2024 fifth-edition rules (5.5e) Primary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Body Refining Resource: CPCommon Expressions: smoke veils, soot trails, incense threads, cinder breath, hidden witnesses, suffocation pressure, battlefield misdirection, fire-smothering, ash marks, escape routes ### Smoke Dao Smoke is the cultivation of the escaping trace. A flame consumes. A body breathes. A secret leaves a room. A messenger passes through a crowd. A killing stroke cuts the air. Smoke remembers that something moved, burned, hid, or transformed. A novice Smoke cultivator hides behind a cloud. An adept Smoke cultivator understands that every cloud is also evidence. The Sphere of Smoke governs: real particulate veils; breath and exhalation; soot, ash, and residue; incense trails; half-seen movement; hidden witnesses; smothering flame; tracing the path of a vanished creature; making direct lines unreliable; revealing what tried to escape notice. Smoke is not darkness, poison, fire, mist, or illusion. Those are neighboring expressions. Smoke is the Dao of the escaping trace. #### Sphere Sentence Smoke cultivators raise a real veil, catch actions in its residue, and use the remaining trace to hide, follow, smother, or expose what passed through it. #### Cultivation Loop Raise a Smoke Veil. Let movement, attacks, breath, speech, flame, or supernatural force pass through the smoke. Mark that passage with a Smoke Trace. Spend the trace on a Smoke Response. The enemy learns that entering smoke does not merely hide them; it lets the smoke remember them. #### What a CL 1 Smoke Cultivator Does Each Round A CL 1 Smoke cultivator usually: creates or moves one Smoke Veil; waits for a creature or effect to act through the smoke; places one Smoke Trace; spends that trace to obscure an attack, follow the passage, or slip through the veil. #### What a CL 10 Smoke Cultivator Does Better At Core Formation, a Smoke cultivator can maintain connected veils, preserve traces longer, and turn a battlefield into a court of breath, soot, and misread lines. #### What Remains Recognizable at CL 15 and CL 20 At higher Realm, Smoke still follows the same loop: raise the veil; catch the trace; spend the trace; make the enemy choose between acting directly and being remembered by smoke. The scale changes from one cloud to an entire battlefield, city street, incense court, funeral procession, or hidden chimney network. ### Sphere Boundaries | Sphere | What It Does | | --- | --- | | Smoke | Real veils, residue, breath, soot traces, smothering, hidden witnesses, indirect paths | | Mist | Moist vapor, fog, dew, rain haze, humidity, cloud-water, aquatic concealment | | Dark | Absence of light, supernatural shadow, light suppression, silhouettes | | Illusion | False sensory premises and misread choices | | Poison | Toxins, venoms, disease-like corruption, alchemical harm | | Fire | Heat, combustion, flame, ignition, burning transformation | | Yin | Waning, receptive diminishment, incomplete consequence, preservation of decline | | Air | Wind, pressure, flight, currents, breath as movement | | Hidden Eye | Scouting, analysis, survey, ambush preparation, battlefield reading | Smoke may obscure vision, carry poison, arise from fire, or conceal a scout. It does not become those spheres unless a talent says so. ### Rules Retained from Fifth Edition This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline. Smoke talents supplement the normal rules for: Concentration; Cover; Lightly Obscured and Heavily Obscured areas; the Hide action; Invisible; Opportunity Attacks; Suffocation; Blinded; Poisoned; Fire damage; area effects; object damage. A Smoke talent changes a base rule only when it explicitly says so. #### Smoke Is Real, Not Illusory Smoke created by this sphere is real supernatural smoke. It can block sight, cling to surfaces, carry scent, leave ash, and be dispersed. Unless a talent says otherwise: Smoke does not create real Cover; Smoke does not create solid objects; Smoke does not fool Truesight as an illusion; Smoke does not automatically poison creatures; Smoke does not automatically extinguish magical fire; Smoke does not pass through airtight barriers; Smoke does not function underwater. #### Dispersing Smoke A strong wind, a strong Air effect, heavy rain, a Water effect that washes the area, or a similar environmental force may disperse ordinary Smoke Veils at the GM’s discretion. A Smoke talent with a CP cost, Domain, Realm prerequisite, or Secret Inheritance can resist dispersion if it says so. ### Core Smoke Rules #### Smoke Save DC Your Smoke Save DC equals: 8 + your key ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus A Path synergy may replace the key ability. #### Smoke Veil Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: One 10-foot cube Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 0 CP You create a veil of real supernatural smoke in an unoccupied space you can see within range. The area is Lightly Obscured. A creature entirely on the opposite side of the Smoke Veil from an observer is also lightly obscured from that observer if the line of sight passes through the veil. As a Bonus Action while the veil persists, move it up to 10 feet to a space within range. The veil cannot pass through solid barriers unless a talent says otherwise. At CL 5, the area becomes two connected 10-foot cubes.At CL 11, it becomes three connected 10-foot cubes.At CL 17, it becomes four connected 10-foot cubes. #### Dense Smoke Some talents make smoke Dense. Dense smoke is Heavily Obscured for creatures that rely on sight. Dense smoke does not automatically deafen creatures, poison creatures, block Tremorsense, or prevent creatures from making attacks into or out of it. It only changes what can be seen unless a talent adds more. #### Smoke Trace A Smoke Trace is the residue left when a creature or effect passes through your smoke. You can have a number of Smoke Traces active at one time equal to your Proficiency Bonus. When you would create a Smoke Trace beyond this limit, choose one existing trace to end. A Smoke Trace lasts until the end of your next turn unless a talent says otherwise. Once per round, you may place a Smoke Trace on a creature, object, or 5-foot space when one of the following happens inside your Smoke Veil or through a line of sight that passes through your Smoke Veil: a creature moves at least 5 feet; a creature makes an attack roll; a creature takes the Magic action, spends CP, uses a spell slot, or activates an explicitly supernatural technique; a creature breathes, speaks, shouts, sings, or uses a breath weapon; Fire damage is dealt; an object burns, breaks, opens, closes, or is carried through the smoke; a creature successfully Hides or becomes Invisible. A creature does not need to know it has a Smoke Trace, but soot, scent, spiritual residue, or a faint smoke-thread may be visible to magical senses or close inspection. #### Smoke Responses You know the following three Smoke Responses. You may spend one Smoke Trace to use a Smoke Response. Unless a talent says otherwise, you can use only one Smoke Response per round. ##### Blind the Line Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature with your Smoke Trace makes an attack roll and the attack’s line of sight passes through your Smoke Veil Spend the Smoke Trace. The triggering attack has Disadvantage if the attacker relies on sight. Blind the Line does not affect attacks from creatures that do not rely on sight or that can see clearly through smoke. ##### Follow the Soot Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Target: One creature, object, or space with your Smoke Trace Spend the Smoke Trace. Until the start of your next turn, you know the direction to the traced target while it remains within 120 feet of you. If the target is Invisible, Hidden, or behind smoke, this does not reveal it to your allies, but it prevents it from being hidden from you by smoke alone. ##### Slip the Chimney Path Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Target: One Smoke Trace on a space within your Smoke Veil Spend the Smoke Trace. Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures inside your Smoke Veil. This movement must begin or end in your Smoke Veil. ### Smoke Talent Tags Veil talents change Smoke Veils. Trace talents create, preserve, move, or spend Smoke Traces. Breath talents add speech, exhalation, choking, incense, and breath-pressure uses. Cinder talents add flame, ash, embers, and burn-evidence uses. Drift talents use smoke as a route for movement or positioning. Witness talents reveal, mark, preserve, or erase traces. Domain talents create large supernatural smoke courts. ## MORTAL REALM SMOKE TALENTS ### Dense Veil - Veil When you create or move your Smoke Veil, it becomes Dense until the start of your next turn. If you maintain the same Smoke Veil without moving it on your next turn, it remains Dense. ### Second Veil - Veil When you create a Smoke Veil, create one additional 5-foot cube of smoke within 30 feet of the original veil. This second veil follows the same duration and concentration. At CL 5, the second veil becomes a 10-foot cube. ### Soot-Scent Trail - Trace, Witness When you use Follow the Soot, the duration becomes 1 minute. The target may attempt a Dexterity (Stealth) check against your Smoke Save DC at the end of each of its turns, ending this extended trace on a success. ### Vanishing Exhalation - Veil, Drift Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You take the Hide action, become Invisible, or move behind Cover Create a 5-foot cube of smoke in the space you left. The smoke lasts until the start of your next turn and may receive Smoke Traces normally. ### Smoke Step - Drift When you use Slip the Chimney Path, increase the movement to 15 feet. At CL 5, increase it to 20 feet. ### Scent-Eating Smoke - Veil, Witness Your Smoke Veil interferes with scent. Creatures inside your Smoke Veil have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to hide from creatures relying primarily on smell. A creature with a Smoke Trace from you loses this benefit against you. ### Cinder Wisp - Cinder, Trace Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature or object you can see Cost: 0 CP Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: The target takes 1d6 Fire damage or 1d6 Poison damage and gains a Smoke Trace. Choose the damage type when you use this talent. The damage represents ember, soot, ash, or lung-sting; it is an expression of Smoke, not the sphere identity. The damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17. ### Smother the Breath - Breath, Trace You gain a new Smoke Response. Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature with your Smoke Trace speaks, casts with a verbal component, uses a breath weapon, or begins a supernatural technique expressed through breath, voice, or exhalation Spend the Smoke Trace. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature coughs, chokes, or loses the clean line of breath. It has Disadvantage on the triggering d20 Test if the trigger includes one. If the trigger does not include a d20 Test, the creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: The creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. Smother the Breath does not prevent ordinary speech after the triggering moment unless a talent says otherwise. ### Soot-Marked Witness - Witness, Trace You gain a new Smoke Response. Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Target: One creature within range bearing your Smoke Trace Cost: Spend the target's Smoke Trace Duration: Until the start of your next turn Spend the Smoke Trace on the target. Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot be Hidden from you solely because it is concealed by smoke, fog, mist, steam, or nonmagical darkness. If it was Hidden from you solely for one or more of those reasons, it immediately ceases to be Hidden from you, and you know its location while it remains within range. This effect does not grant sight through the concealment. Attacks and other effects still suffer any normal penalties for being unable to see the target. It does not defeat Total Cover, unrelated invisibility, concealment from another source, an effect such as Truesight, or a successful Hide supported by circumstances other than the listed concealment. ### Blacken the Flame - Cinder, Trace You gain a new Smoke Response. Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: Fire damage is dealt inside your Smoke Veil or through your Smoke Veil Spend one Smoke Trace on the source, target, or affected space. Reduce the Fire damage dealt to one creature or object by: 1d6 + your key ability modifier The reduction increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17. ### Ash on the Footprints - Witness When a creature leaves your Smoke Veil, you may place a Smoke Trace on the space it left even if you have already placed a Smoke Trace this round. Until the trace ends, creatures have Advantage on Wisdom (Survival) or Wisdom (Perception) checks made to notice that something passed through that space. ### Incense Calm - Breath Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Your Smoke Veil Cost: 1 CP Choose yourself or one ally inside your Smoke Veil. The target gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. The target also has Advantage on the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn against Frightened, Poisoned, or an effect that would prevent speech or breathing. ## FOUNDATION REALM SMOKE TALENTS ### Black-Lung Cloud - Veil, Breath Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you create or move your Smoke Veil, spend 1 CP to make it choking for 1 round. The first time a hostile creature enters the veil on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It is Poisoned until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. A creature that does not breathe has Advantage on the save. ### Smoke Mirror Trail - Trace, Witness Prerequisite: CL 5+ When one creature inside your Smoke Veil becomes Invisible, successfully Hides, teleports, or leaves the veil without using normal movement, you may place a Smoke Trace on it without using your once-per-round Smoke Trace. Until that trace ends, you know the direction to the target while it remains within 120 feet. ### Wall of Smoke - Veil Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you create Smoke Veil, arrange its cubes as a wall. Each cube must share a face with another cube. While the wall is Dense, ranged attacks that pass through at least two of its cubes have Disadvantage if the attacker relies on sight. This wall is not solid and does not provide Cover. ### Emberbank Storage - Cinder Prerequisite: CL 5+ When Fire damage is dealt inside your Smoke Veil, store one emberbank charge until the end of your next turn. You can hold one emberbank charge at a time. When you use Cinder Wisp or Blacken the Flame, spend the charge to add one of the following effects: increase Fire damage by 1d6; reduce Fire damage by an additional 1d6; place a Smoke Trace on one additional creature or object inside the same Smoke Veil. ### Funeral Incense Boundary - Breath, Witness Prerequisite: CL 5+ Your Smoke Veil can preserve the immediate traces of violence. When a creature drops to 0 HP or dies inside your Smoke Veil, you may spend 1 CP as a Reaction. Until the end of your next long rest, the space where it fell retains a visible or spiritual Smoke Trace that records: the direction from which the last harmful effect came; whether the harm was weapon, spell, sphere, poison, disease, or environmental hazard; whether Fire, Poison, Necrotic, Radiant, or Psychic damage was involved. This does not identify the attacker by name unless another feature would. ### Breath-Thread Listening - Breath, Witness Prerequisite: CL 5+ While you are inside your Smoke Veil, you can hear whispers, breathing, coughing, and verbal components inside the same Smoke Veil as if you were within 10 feet of the speaker. A creature with a Smoke Trace cannot hide its breath or speech from this talent unless it is behind total cover or protected by a stronger silence effect. ### Ashen Blindfold - Veil, Trace Prerequisite: CL 7+ When you use Blind the Line, the attacker also makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: It cannot see through your Smoke Veil until the start of its next turn, even if the veil is only Lightly Obscured. Successful Save: No additional effect. This does not affect Blindsight, Tremorsense, or Truesight unless another talent says so. ### Chimney Escape Method - Drift Prerequisite: CL 7+ When you use Slip the Chimney Path, you may move from one space in your Smoke Veil to another space in the same Smoke Veil without crossing the intervening space. The destination must be within 30 feet and must be a space you can see or a space containing one of your Smoke Traces. This is supernatural movement through smoke, not teleportation through solid barriers. ## CORE FORMATION REALM SMOKE TALENTS ### Smoke Domain: Court of Hidden Witnesses Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: Three connected 20-foot cubes within 120 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per short rest You create a court of smoke that remembers every passage. The area is Dense Smoke. For the duration: you may place one additional Smoke Trace each round; your Smoke Traces inside the Domain last until the end of your next turn after they leave the Domain; when a hostile creature starts its turn inside the Domain, you may place a Smoke Trace on it; when you use Follow the Soot inside the Domain, the direction remains known for 1 minute; once per round, you may use Blind the Line, Follow the Soot, or Slip the Chimney Path without spending the Smoke Trace. The Domain does not create solid walls or true Cover. ### Censer Court Method - Domain, Breath Prerequisite: Court of Hidden Witnesses, CL 10+ Allies inside your Smoke Domain gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened and Poisoned. When you use Incense Calm inside the Domain, choose up to two targets instead of one. ### Ashen Court Record - Domain, Witness Prerequisite: Court of Hidden Witnesses, CL 10+ When a creature inside your Smoke Domain makes an attack roll, casts a spell, spends CP, uses a spell slot, uses a supernatural technique, or becomes Invisible, you may place a Smoke Trace on it even if it does not pass through an existing Smoke Veil line of sight. Use Ashen Court Record once per round. ### Black Chimney Route - Domain, Drift Prerequisite: Chimney Escape Method, CL 10+ When you use Slip the Chimney Path inside your Smoke Domain, increase the movement to 30 feet. If you start and end inside the Domain, this movement does not require line of sight, but you must know the destination space is open. ### Smothering Mandate - Breath Prerequisite: Smother the Breath, CL 10+ When a creature fails its saving throw against Smother the Breath, choose one additional effect: it cannot speak above a whisper until the end of its next turn; it has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn; it cannot repeat the same breath, voice, or verbal-component technique until the end of its next turn. This does not prevent speechless techniques. ### Cinder Without Flame - Cinder Prerequisite: Cinder Wisp, CL 10+ When you use Cinder Wisp, choose Fire, Poison, or Necrotic damage. If the target is inside your Smoke Veil, it also makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It cannot regain hit points until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No additional effect. This is soot and lung-sting as a Smoke expression. It does not make Smoke a Disease or Death sphere. ### Evidence in the Ash - Witness Prerequisite: Funeral Incense Boundary, CL 10+ When you use Funeral Incense Boundary, record one additional fact: whether the attacker was within 30 feet, 60 feet, or farther away; whether the attacker was living, undead, construct, spirit, or unknown; whether the attack came from above, below, the same level, or no normal direction; whether the harmful effect carried CP, spell energy, a Formation, or mundane force. ### Soot Eats the Path - Veil, Trace Prerequisite: CL 12+ When a creature with your Smoke Trace willingly moves through your Smoke Veil, you may spend the trace without an action. The creature treats the smoke as difficult terrain until the end of the current turn. If it ends that movement inside your Smoke Veil, it makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: It falls Prone. Successful Save: No additional effect. ## NASCENT SOUL REALM SMOKE TALENTS ### Incense Body of the Vanishing Witness Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 7 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Your breath, shadow, and spiritual residue become smoke-script. For the duration: you are lightly obscured while not in bright wind or heavy rain; when you move at least 10 feet, leave a 5-foot cube of Smoke Veil in one space you left until the start of your next turn; once per round, place a Smoke Trace without using your once-per-round limit; when a hostile creature with your Smoke Trace misses you with an attack, move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature; gain Resistance to Fire and Poison damage. ### Thousand-Chimney Escape Prerequisite: Black Chimney Route, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or one ally inside your Smoke Veil would be hit by an attack or fail a Dexterity saving throw Cost: 5 CP Move the target up to 60 feet to another space inside one of your Smoke Veils or Smoke Domain. If this movement places the target outside the triggering attack’s reach or area, the attack misses or the target takes no damage from the triggering effect. The movement cannot pass through airtight barriers or solid walls. ### The Smoke Knows Who Lied Prerequisite: Soot-Marked Witness, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Target: One creature with your Smoke Trace within 120 feet Cost: 5 CP The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: For 1 minute, whenever the target speaks a deliberate lie while within 120 feet of you, visible soot gathers at its mouth, hand, or shadow. Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, you know whether the target is attempting to conceal hostile intent from you. This talent reveals the presence of deliberate falsehood. It does not force the creature to speak or reveal the truth. ### Ashen Lung Seals the Dragon Cry Prerequisite: Smothering Mandate, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature with your Smoke Trace uses a breath weapon, shout, roar, song, spoken command, verbal-component spell, or breath-based supernatural technique Cost: 5 CP The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The triggering technique fails and its cost or use is spent. Successful Save: The triggering technique resolves, but attack rolls it makes have Disadvantage and targets have Advantage on saving throws against it. This talent does not affect techniques that are not meaningfully expressed through breath, voice, or exhalation. ## SECRET SMOKE INHERITANCE ### The Last Breath Hides the Empire “The palace burned for three days. No one agreed where the emperor went. The smoke remembered, but it did not testify.” Classification: Secret Smoke Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Hidden Witnesses, hidden smoke scripture Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: One creature you can see or hear within 120 feet declares an attack, harmful effect, Domain, Realm Evolution, Secret Inheritance, escape technique, or public accusation Cost: 10 CP Use Limit: Once per week A sovereign smoke court answers the declaration before the world finishes witnessing it. Choose up to three 20-foot cubes within 120 feet. They become Dense Smoke Veils for 1 minute. These veils do not require Concentration. The triggering creature gains a Smoke Trace that lasts for the full duration. Then choose one inheritance effect: #### Hide the Witness Choose up to five willing creatures inside the smoke. Each becomes Invisible until it leaves the smoke, attacks, deals damage, or the inheritance ends. This invisibility is smoke-concealment, not an illusion. #### Carry the Evidence One object, corpse, written message, Formation key, or unattended item inside the smoke is carried to another smoke cube you created with this inheritance. The object must fit inside a 5-foot cube and cannot be worn or carried by an unwilling creature. #### Smother the Declaration The triggering creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The triggering action resolves with Disadvantage on all attack rolls it makes, and targets have Advantage on saving throws against it. If it required speech, breath, command, roar, song, or verbal scripture, it also cannot be repeated until the end of the creature’s next turn. Successful Save: Targets have Advantage on saving throws against the triggering action, or the triggering attack rolls have Disadvantage if it uses attack rolls. #### Reveal the Ashen Path Every creature of your choice inside the smoke learns the direction to the triggering creature, even if it teleports or becomes Invisible before the end of its next turn. The Last Breath Hides the Empire does not erase memory. It controls what can still be seen, carried, followed, or cleanly spoken while the smoke court exists. ## SMOKE DRAWBACKS AND VARIANT SCRIPTURES Smoke variants are optional cultivation scriptures that change how the sphere manifests. They are Tianxia-specific limitations inspired by drawback design, not imported casting-tradition rules. Choose at most one Smoke variant when first learning the sphere or undergoing major Smoke initiation unless the GM says otherwise. If a variant grants a bonus talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, you gain that talent when you meet its prerequisites. If the variant is retrained or removed, lose its bonus talent or benefit. ### Incense Scripture You cultivate smoke as ritual fragrance, prayer, memory, and social atmosphere. Benefit: Gain Incense Calm as a bonus talent. When you use Incense Calm, the target may also end one ordinary fear or panic effect that does not come from a spell, sphere, Domain, or supernatural feature. Drawback: Fragrant Witness. Your Smoke Veils are scented, recognizable, and spiritually polite. You cannot make your Smoke Veils scentless. Creatures have Advantage on checks made to track the source of your smoke, identify your presence after the scene, or recognize that your techniques were used. When you use a Smoke talent to Hide yourself, any Smoke Trace that could lead back to you lasts 1 minute instead of until the end of your next turn. ### Cinder-Breath Scripture You cultivate smoke as the breath of embers and half-dead flame. Benefit: Gain Cinder Wisp as a bonus talent. When Fire damage is dealt inside your Smoke Veil, place a Smoke Trace on one creature damaged by that fire without using your once-per-round Smoke Trace. Drawback: Hungry Ember. Your smoke always leaves visible soot, scorch-signs, or ember scent. You cannot use Smoke talents to erase or disguise evidence of burning, fire, ash, or your own Cinder talents. When you create a Smoke Veil in a space containing unattended flammable material, open flame, oil, dry paper, dry leaves, or obvious ash, the GM may cause the veil to leave clear forensic evidence until the area is cleaned or weathered. ### Ghost-Smoke Scripture You cultivate smoke as funeral trace, ghost-path, and the breath between death and memory. Benefit: Gain Funeral Incense Boundary as a bonus talent. When a creature dies inside your Smoke Veil, place a Smoke Trace on the space without spending CP. Drawback: Death Remembers You. Your smoke answers death better than ordinary motion. In an area with no death, grief, burial, ancestral memory, violence, or spiritual residue, the first Smoke talent you use in an encounter costs 1 additional CP. If the talent normally costs 0 CP, it instead requires 1 CP. This surcharge ends for the encounter once a creature takes damage, drops to 0 HP, dies, or a hostile supernatural effect resolves inside your Smoke Veil. ### Smoke-Lung Body Scripture You cultivate Smoke through breath, lungs, pores, and body heat. Benefit: Gain Smother the Breath as a bonus talent. You can create a 5-foot Smoke Veil centered on yourself without using your hands or voice. Drawback: Breath-Bound Art. You cannot use Smoke talents while you cannot breathe, while suffocating, while in a vacuum, while fully submerged, or while an effect prevents you from exhaling. If an effect would make you unable to speak, it does not stop all Smoke talents, but it prevents Breath talents unless a feature says otherwise. ### Witness-Erasing Scripture You cultivate smoke as disappearance, secrecy, and denial. Benefit: Gain Vanishing Exhalation as a bonus talent. When you create smoke with Vanishing Exhalation, immediately attempt to Hide if you meet the normal Hide requirements. Drawback: No Clean Testimony. Your smoke erases useful evidence as readily as hostile evidence. When you use a Smoke talent to hide, move, or obscure a creature or object, you cannot use Witness talents to preserve, read, or reveal traces from that same creature, object, or space until the end of your next turn. If you erase a Smoke Trace voluntarily, you cannot benefit from Follow the Soot against the erased target until you place a new Smoke Trace on it. ## PATH SYNERGIES ### Qi Cultivation - Furnace-Smoke Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Smoke key ability. Once per turn when you place a Smoke Trace on a creature that spent CP, used a spell slot, or activated a supernatural feature, regain 1 CP if you have no more than half your maximum CP. At CL 10+, when you use Blacken the Flame, reduce the CP cost of your next Smoke talent before the end of your next turn by 1, minimum 0. ### Spirit Awakening - Incense of the Hidden Name Use Wisdom as your Smoke key ability. When you use Follow the Soot, you may learn whether the traced creature is calm, afraid, furious, grieving, or spiritually strained. This reads immediate spiritual residue, not thoughts. Once per round when a hostile creature with your Smoke Trace fails a saving throw against one of your Smoke talents, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Body Refining - Smoke-Lung Body Use Constitution as your Smoke key ability for Breath talents if higher. While holding your breath, you may still use Smoke talents for a number of rounds equal to your Proficiency Bonus. When you succeed on a Constitution saving throw against Poisoned, suffocation, choking, or an inhaled hazard, place a Smoke Trace on one hostile creature or hazardous space inside your Smoke Veil. ## CULTIVATION INSIGHTS ### Iron Lungs of the Furnace Prerequisite: Smoke sphere, CL 4+ Gain Advantage on saving throws against inhaled poison, smoke inhalation, and effects that would prevent you from breathing. Once per short rest, when you would begin suffocating, delay that suffocation for 1 minute. ### Soot-Stained Footwork Prerequisite: Smoke sphere, Smoke Step, CL 6+ When you move through your Smoke Veil, ignore nonmagical difficult terrain inside it. Once per round after you use a Smoke Response, move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature with your Smoke Trace. ### Censer-Bearer’s Discipline Prerequisite: Smoke sphere, Incense Calm, CL 6+ When you use Incense Calm, choose one additional ally inside the same Smoke Veil. The second ally gains half as many Temporary HP and the same saving throw benefit. ### Breath Behind the Mask Prerequisite: Smoke sphere, Vanishing Exhalation, CL 8+ When you create a Smoke Veil in your own space, speak through it without revealing your exact location to creatures relying on hearing. Creatures still know the general direction of your voice unless another feature prevents it. ### Black Censer Meridian Prerequisite: Smoke sphere, CL 10+ When you place a Smoke Trace on a creature that has already had a Smoke Trace this encounter, extend the new trace by 1 round. Once per short rest, use one Smoke Response without spending the trace.

#### Smoke Responses
You know the following three Smoke Responses.
You may spend one Smoke Trace to use a Smoke Response.
Unless a talent says otherwise, you can use only one Smoke Response per round.
##### Blind the Line
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature with your Smoke Trace makes an attack roll and the attack’s line of sight passes through your Smoke Veil
Spend the Smoke Trace.
The triggering attack has Disadvantage if the attacker relies on sight.
Blind the Line does not affect attacks from creatures that do not rely on sight or that can see clearly through smoke.
##### Follow the Soot
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Target: One creature, object, or space with your Smoke Trace
Spend the Smoke Trace.
Until the start of your next turn, you know the direction to the traced target while it remains within 120 feet of you.
If the target is Invisible, Hidden, or behind smoke, this does not reveal it to your allies, but it prevents it from being hidden from you by smoke alone.
##### Slip the Chimney Path
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Target: One Smoke Trace on a space within your Smoke Veil
Spend the Smoke Trace.
Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures inside your Smoke Veil.
This movement must begin or end in your Smoke Veil.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Sniper Qi Expression: Primary — Aim Qi; Supporting — Metal/Projectile Qi, Wind Qi, Perception Qi, Stillness Qi. “The battlefield is loud because most warriors do not understand the value of one correct line.” Cultivation Names: Scripture of the Unerring Line; Thousand-Pace Breath Method; Heaven-Piercing Marksmanship; The Still Eye That Ends Motion Sphere Type: Martial Sphere / Precision Ranged Sphere Primary Paths: Body Refining and Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus Common Effects: Long-range accuracy, careful aim, singular decisive shots, ricochet geometry, pinning, disarming, projectile interception, trap disabling, anti-cover shots, distant marksmanship, line-reading, battlefield execution Sniper cultivates one decisive line: the shot that turns distance, cover, breath, timing, and weak-point knowledge into a single answer. ### Player-Facing Rules ### Sniper Dao Sniper is the cultivation of distance made intimate. A sword cultivator closes the distance. A Barrage cultivator fills the distance. A Sniper cultivator proves the distance was never protection. The Sniper Dao has five faces: Stillness: the body stops wasting motion. Line: the path between cause and wound becomes a scripture. Weak Point: armor, posture, timing, arrogance, and terrain each contain a door. Patience: a missed chance is cheaper than a wasted shot. Arrival: the moment the projectile arrives, every argument about distance ends. A Sniper cultivator at Mortal Realm is a master of careful shots. At Foundation, the line of aim becomes visible to Qi sense and can bend through prepared surfaces. At Core Formation, the Sniper creates a court of fatal angles. At Nascent Soul, the Sniper’s spirit becomes a hunting star that can shoot across impossible ranges. At Secret Inheritance, the Sniper fires a shot that heaven had already failed to dodge. ### Realm Progression Mortal Realm: Deadly Aim, Snipe Shot, long-range discipline, ricochets, pinning, disarming, piercing, pushing, intercepting ranged attacks, disabling traps at range, and careful repositioning. Foundation Realm: Awaken the Qi-Line Sight, allowing supernatural trajectory reading, longer snipe geometry, spirit-weighted projectiles, shots around one protected angle, and more reliable exact-location targeting. Core Formation Realm: Establish the Court of the Unerring Line, a battlefield domain in which sight-lines, ricochets, firing lanes, and marks become spiritual law. Nascent Soul Realm: Manifest the Heaven-Hunting Eye, becoming a living sight-line whose shots ignore mundane distance, ordinary cover, and weak attempts to hide from the shot that has already chosen them. Secret Inheritance: Invoke The Arrow That Arrived Before the Bowstring, an apex shot that finds the decisive line through distance, cover, formation, and timing. ### Rules Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline and the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Attack action, Special Attack, ranged attack, ranged weapon attack, ranged spell attack, thrown weapon, Advantage, Disadvantage, Cover, Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover, Total Cover, Hide, Invisible, Opportunity Attack, Ready, Concentration, Prone, Grappled, Restrained, Incapacitated, Object, and Saving Throw unless this sphere specifically changes them. #### Ranged Attacks A ranged attack may be a ranged weapon attack, a thrown weapon attack, a ranged spell attack, or another attack defined as ranged. Sniper talents specify which kinds of ranged attacks qualify. Unless a talent says otherwise, Snipe Shot applies only to a ranged weapon attack made with a ranged or thrown weapon. #### Range and Long Range Weapons with normal and long range usually impose Disadvantage beyond normal range and cannot attack beyond long range. Sniper talents such as Far Shot, Star-Scraper Line, and high-Realm techniques change these rules only as stated. #### Ranged Attacks in Close Combat The 2024 rules impose Disadvantage on a ranged attack when a hostile creature that can see you and is not Incapacitated is within 5 feet of you. Sniper does not remove that rule unless a talent says so. #### Cover and Total Cover Cover is central to this sphere. A target behind Half Cover or Three-Quarters Cover gains the normal AC and Dexterity saving throw benefits. A target behind Total Cover normally cannot be targeted directly. Sniper talents may ignore, reduce, bounce around, pierce through, or otherwise answer cover. When a talent says it ignores Total Cover, it is a supernatural exception and usually requires exact target location. #### Exact Location Some Sniper talents require you to know a target’s exact location. You know a target’s exact location when you can perceive it directly, when an ally or effect provides precise live information, when a mark or technique identifies the space it occupies, or when the GM agrees the target’s location is certain enough for a shot. A guess is not exact location. Knowing the target is “somewhere in the tower” is not enough. Knowing the target is “standing at the third-floor west window, two steps behind the right pillar” may be enough. #### Unseen Targets and Hidden Creatures If you attack a target you cannot see, normal rules for unseen targets apply unless a talent says otherwise. Sniper can exploit spotters, marks, sound, spirit pressure, dust disturbances, line prediction, or prior wounds, but it should not automatically defeat all hiding. #### Advantage and Disadvantage Deadly Aim improves a ranged attack that already has Advantage. If Advantage and Disadvantage cancel, the attack does not have Advantage and Deadly Aim does not apply. Deadly Aim does not stack with other benefits that allow an additional die selection or repeated reroll from Advantage. #### Ready and Reactions Intercepting Shot and several Counter-Shot talents use the Ready action or a Reaction. If a talent lets you use a Reaction without Ready, it says so. You still only have one Reaction unless a talent grants a special extra Reaction for Sniper talents. #### Objects, Weapons, and Disarming Weapon Shot uses a local disarm rule. It causes a saving throw rather than importing older contested disarm rules. A held object can be shot from the hand only if the GM agrees it can plausibly be struck and moved. Huge objects, fused weapons, soul-bound items, artifacts, and scene-defining items may require an opposed Cultivation Check or be immune unless a higher-Realm talent applies. #### Scoot Shot This sphere preserves the source’s Scoot Shot as a local combat reminder: you can make a ranged attack roll against AC 10 to move an unattended Tiny object 10 feet away from you. Sniper talents may modify this. #### Instant Kill and Graphic Results Some Sniper talents can drop or kill a target at higher Realm. These effects are gated by Realm, target state, saving throw, Martial Focus, or Secret Inheritance, and the table may describe them with more or less graphic detail as appropriate. ### Core Sniper Rules #### Martial Focus Sniper uses Martial Focus. Unless a broader martial-sphere rule later replaces this wording: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, you regain it only if it is currently absent. Sniper regains Martial Focus through stillness, position discipline, exact breath, careful aim, or specific talents such as Shift Position. #### Sniper Technique Save DC When a Sniper talent calls for a saving throw, use your Cultivation Save DC unless the Path, class feature, or technique grants another DC. Cultivation Save DC = 8 + Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier. The default key ability for Sniper is the key ability of the Path through which you learned or use the sphere. Body Refining commonly uses Dexterity or Constitution depending on tradition; Qi Cultivation commonly uses Intelligence or Charisma; Spirit Awakening commonly uses Wisdom. #### Snipe Shot Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Attack Type: One ranged weapon attack made with a ranged or thrown weapon Cost: None Restriction: Apply one Snipe talent unless another feature says otherwise When you take the Attack action, you may replace one attack with a Snipe Shot. Make one ranged weapon attack with a ranged or thrown weapon. Before the attack roll, choose one Snipe talent you know and apply it to that attack. Unless a talent says otherwise: a Snipe Shot is still one attack; a Snipe Shot can benefit from Advantage or suffer Disadvantage normally; only one Snipe talent applies to a Snipe Shot; a missed Snipe Shot usually has no Snipe effect; a Snipe Shot consumes ammunition or the thrown weapon normally; a Snipe Shot cannot be used with an area effect unless a talent says so; if a Snipe talent calls for a saving throw, the target saves after the attack hits and deals damage. #### Deadly Aim When you make a ranged attack, including a ranged spell attack, and that attack has Advantage, you may reroll one of the two d20s once. You must use the new roll. This cannot stack with other benefits from feats, class features, items, sphere talents, or techniques that improve Advantage by adding extra d20s, choosing from more than two d20s, or rerolling one of the Advantage dice. #### Aimed Line Some talents refer to your Aimed Line. You have an Aimed Line against a target when at least one of the following is true: you have Advantage on the ranged attack against that target; you used Perfect Shot for that attack; you did not move more than 5 feet during your current turn and can perceive the target; a Sniper talent, spotter, mark, or Forged Technique establishes an Aimed Line. Aimed Line is not a condition on the target. It is a temporary statement that your posture, breath, and information are sufficient for Sniper techniques. #### Snipe Talent A Snipe talent changes one Snipe Shot. A Snipe talent may: add damage; ignore or change cover; pin or disarm; push or pierce; bounce a shot; intercept a projectile; manipulate an object; target a weak point; extend range; interact with exact location. Unless a talent says otherwise, apply only one Snipe talent to one Snipe Shot. #### Counter-Shot Talent A Counter-Shot talent uses a Reaction or Readied attack to answer another projectile, spell attack, movement line, object, or technique. Counter-Shot talents usually require a ranged weapon ready to fire and a legal projectile or target. #### Line Talent A Line talent modifies range, cover, visibility, exact location, ricochet geometry, or the route traveled by a shot. #### Mark Talent A Mark talent creates information or a temporary weakness that helps future Sniper attacks. A creature can normally bear only one Mark from you at a time unless a talent says otherwise. #### Scoot Shot As a ranged attack, you can shoot an unattended Tiny object. The object has AC 10 for this purpose. On a hit, you move the object 10 feet directly away from you. This talent cannot hit a creature completely enclosed by protective surfaces unless you also use Phasic Shot or a Secret Inheritance. #### Sever the Name from the Distance - Mark Prerequisites: CL 15+ When you hit a creature with a Snipe Shot, you may spend 1 CP to create a Nascent Mark for 1 minute. While the Mark lasts: you always know the direction to the target while it remains on the same plane and within 1 mile; your first ranged attack against it each turn has an Aimed Line; it gains no benefit from being Invisible against your Sniper talents; if it teleports or uses a movement technique, you may use your Reaction to learn its new exact location if it remains within 1 mile. A creature can end the Mark early by succeeding on a Charisma saving throw at the end of its turn, by entering a sealed anti-divination effect, or by using an appropriate cleansing technique. #### Shoot the Returning Blade - Counter-Shot Prerequisites: Intercepting Shot, CL 15+ When a projectile, thrown weapon, flying sword, returning weapon, animated weapon, or weapon-like technique passes within your weapon’s normal range, you may use your Reaction to make a ranged weapon attack against it. On a hit, choose one: knock it to the ground in an unoccupied space within 30 feet; redirect it toward a legal target within 30 feet, comparing your attack roll to the new target’s AC; break its return path, preventing it from returning until the end of its next turn; suppress one non-artifact weapon technique carried by it until the start of your next turn. Artifact weapons, sovereign flying swords, Secret Inheritance weapons, and scene-defining projectiles may require an opposed Cultivation Check. ### Secret Sniper Inheritance #### The Arrow That Arrived Before the Bowstring Secret Sniper Inheritance Prerequisites: Heaven-Hunting Eye, Phasic Shot, CL 17+, a hidden scripture of impossible trajectory Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 1 mile, or farther by story/project/formation at GM discretion Target: One creature, object, formation anchor, vehicle weak point, siege engine, exposed spirit channel, or battlefield command focus whose exact location you know Cost: Expend Martial Focus and spend 3 CP Use Limit: Once per week You lower your breath until the world forgets you are about to act. Then the shot arrives. Make one ranged weapon attack or single-target ranged spell attack. This attack has the following properties: it ignores normal and long range; it has Advantage; Deadly Aim applies; it ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover; it ignores Total Cover unless the target is inside a sealed Barrier, sealed vault, demiplane, divine refuge, artifact enclosure, or equivalent absolute protection; it can pass through one non-absolute obstruction as though using Phasic Shot; it can apply up to three Snipe talents you know; it counts as magical, cultivation-enhanced, and spiritually significant. On a hit, the attack deals normal damage plus 10d10 damage. Then choose three different Decisive Line effects: Line Through the Heart: The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it drops to 0 Hit Points if its remaining Hit Points are equal to or less than half its maximum Hit Points. Line Through the Hand: The target drops one held item, command implement, weapon, talisman, seal, or focus. If the item is protected, win an opposed Cultivation Check. Line Through the Foot: The target’s Speed becomes 0 and it cannot teleport until the end of its next turn. Line Through the Breath: The target cannot speak, chant, roar, provide verbal components, or use breath-keyed techniques until the end of its next turn. Line Through the Eye: The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn, and invisibility or ordinary concealment does not protect it from you for 1 minute. Line Through the Formation: Suppress one exposed formation anchor, ward node, barrier segment, domain focus, siege engine component, or command device until the end of your next turn. Line Through the Technique: End one non-Secret ongoing effect on the target if its Pattern Rank or equivalent is not higher than your Proficiency Bonus; otherwise make an opposed Cultivation Check. Line Through the Command: One order, command aura, battlefield signal, prepared reaction, or commanded servant sequence from the target fails or is delayed until the end of its next turn. Line Through the Escape: If the target would move, teleport, or be carried away before the end of its next turn, you may use your Reaction to force it to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the movement fails. On a miss, the shot still finds a lesser line. Choose one Decisive Line effect other than Line Through the Heart, and apply it if the target fails the relevant saving throw or opposed check. Limits: This inheritance cannot automatically kill a major villain, destroy an artifact, invalidate a whole fortress, erase a divine refuge, or ignore a superior Secret Inheritance. Against such targets, success may instead create the one opening needed for the party, project, sect, army, or next scene to exploit. ### Sniper Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures A Sniper drawback is an optional sphere-specific limitation that grants a bonus Sniper talent or benefit while changing how the Sniper sphere functions. These are Tianxia-specific cultivation limits inspired by drawback design, not imported Pathfinder casting drawbacks. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Sniper drawback when first learning the Sniper sphere or undergoing a major Sniper initiation; Sniper drawbacks are mutually exclusive unless the GM says otherwise; the drawback applies to all Sniper talents you use; if a drawback grants a talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, you gain that talent when you meet its prerequisites; if the drawback is retrained or removed, the bonus talent or benefit is lost. #### Close-Quarters Shooter You may apply Snipe talents only to attacks against targets within 30 feet. You gain Perfect Shot as a bonus talent. This scripture belongs to alley assassins, bodyguard-marksmen, shortbow duelists, thrown-knife snipers, and cultivators who believe distance is measured in heartbeats rather than miles. #### One-Arrow Oath You may make only one Snipe Shot per round, even if a feature would let you apply Sniper effects to more attacks. You gain Head Shot or Deadly Shot as a bonus talent. Whenever your Snipe Shot misses, you may regain Martial Focus at the end of your turn if you did not make any other attacks. #### Open-Sky Lineage Your Sniper talents cannot ignore Total Cover, cannot use Phasic Shot, and cannot attack a target whose route is fully enclosed. You must honor the open sky, open hall, open battlefield, or open line. You gain Far Shot and Rangefinding Breath as bonus talents. If you later gain Phasic Shot, it functions only against wind, missile screens, soft cover, and non-solid interference, not walls or sealed cover. #### Spotter-Dependent Scripture To attack a target you cannot directly perceive with Star-Scraper Line, Thread the Closed Gate, Phasic Shot, or Secret Inheritance, you must have a spotter, mark, formation, spirit, divination, or ally providing exact location information. You gain Signal Shot as a bonus talent. At CL 11, you also gain Star-Scraper Line when you meet its prerequisites. #### Still Breath Defect If you move more than 5 feet during your turn, you cannot use Snipe Shot until the start of your next turn. You gain Perfect Shot as a bonus talent. If you already have Perfect Shot, gain Hundred-Breath Wait when you meet its prerequisites. #### No Ricochet Scripture You cannot use Bouncing Shot, World-Needle Ricochet, or talents that depend on bouncing or turning the shot from a surface. You gain Targeted Assault as a bonus talent. At CL 5, your Targeted Assault also ignores the AC bonus from Half Cover when you attack through an Aimed Line. ### Path Synergies #### Body Refining - Bone-Still Archer Body Refiners cultivate the posture and tendon discipline needed to hold impossible aim under pain, wind, and injury. If Body Refining is your primary Path, you may use Dexterity or Constitution as your key ability for Sniper Technique Save DCs. Once per turn when you make a Snipe Shot and have not moved more than 5 feet this turn, choose one: gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; ignore Disadvantage from being Prone for that attack; reduce forced movement against you by 10 feet until the start of your next turn; add your Constitution modifier, minimum +1, to one Concentration saving throw made before the start of your next turn to maintain a Sniper technique. #### Qi Cultivation - Line-Carving Qi Qi cultivators treat the projectile as the visible portion of a longer energetic equation. If Qi Cultivation is your primary Path, you may use Intelligence or Charisma as your key ability for Sniper Technique Save DCs. Once per turn when you expend Martial Focus on a Sniper talent, you may spend 1 CP to choose one: increase the attack’s range by 60 feet; cause the attack to count as magical or cultivation-enhanced; ignore Half Cover; bend the shot around one Tiny or Small obstacle that does not grant Total Cover; apply a Sniper talent to a single-target ranged spell attack instead of a weapon attack. #### Spirit Awakening - The Eye Behind the Arrow Spirit cultivators shoot the intention exposed by the body, not only the body itself. If Spirit Awakening is your primary Path, you may use Wisdom as your key ability for Sniper Technique Save DCs. Once per round when you create an Aimed Line to a creature you can perceive, learn one of the following: whether the creature is Bloodied; whether it currently benefits from Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover, or Total Cover against you; whether it is concentrating on an effect; whether it carries an exposed spiritual focus, talisman, command implement, or formation token; whether it has a visible or spiritually obvious weak point suitable for Head Shot. This does not reveal a complete stat block, hidden Path, Realm, class features, secret techniques, or private thoughts. ### Cultivation Insights #### Patient Trigger Prerequisite: Sniper sphere, CL 4+ When you Ready a Snipe Shot, you may keep Martial Focus if the triggering event does not occur. Once per short or long rest, when the trigger occurs and your Readied Snipe Shot hits, you may apply Deadly Aim even if the attack did not have Advantage. #### Ricochet Savant Prerequisite: Bouncing Shot, CL 6+ When using Bouncing Shot, you may choose the bounced surface after making the attack roll but before knowing whether the attack hits. Once per short or long rest, if a Bouncing Shot misses, you may make a Scoot Shot against one unattended Tiny object within 10 feet of the missed target. #### Spotter’s Thread Prerequisite: Sniper sphere, CL 6+ As a Bonus Action, choose one willing ally you can see or hear. Until the start of your next turn, if that ally can perceive a target and communicate its exact location to you, you may treat the ally’s perception as sufficient for Rangefinding Breath, Star-Scraper Line, or another Sniper talent that requires exact location, subject to range and line limitations. At CL 11, this communication may be through a linked spirit, formation, token, signal flag, or Forged Technique if the GM approves. #### Quiet After the Shot Prerequisite: Sniper sphere, CL 8+ When you make a Snipe Shot while Hidden or behind cover and the attack misses, you do not reveal your location automatically unless the target or observers can perceive the projectile’s origin, hear the shot, or otherwise trace it. When the attack hits, you may expend Martial Focus to impose Disadvantage on the first Wisdom (Perception) or Intelligence (Investigation) check made before the end of the next round to locate you by the shot. #### Trap-Sniper Method Prerequisite: Trap Technician, CL 8+ You gain proficiency with thieves’ tools. If you already have it, you gain Expertise with thieves’ tools. When using Trap Technician, you may target a trap component behind Half Cover without penalty, and you may use Deadly Aim on the attack if you have Advantage from careful study or scouting. #### One Breath, One Line Prerequisite: Perfect Shot, CL 10+ When you use Perfect Shot, you may also ignore Disadvantage from one of the following for that attack: long range; Prone attacker; light obscurement; a hostile creature within 5 feet of you; firing through a narrow opening. You must still have a legal target and route. #### Formation Piercer Prerequisite: Formation Anchor Shot, CL 10+ You have Advantage on checks to identify exposed formation anchors, ward pins, talisman nodes, and similar physical foci. When you hit such a focus with a Snipe Shot, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage or suppression check. #### Heaven’s Distance Student Prerequisite: Star-Scraper Line, CL 12+ When using Star-Scraper Line, you no longer impose Disadvantage if you have an Aimed Line from a spotter, mark, formation, divination, or direct perception. Once per long rest, you may use Star-Scraper Line without spending your Bonus Action.

#### Carry Voice
Classification: Basic Sound Technique
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Timing Detail: Bonus Action or 1 minute
Factory Routing: bonus_action_plus_extended_message_procedure
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=ONE_MINUTE_EXTENDED_VOICE
Range: 120 feet normally, or longer through prepared echoes
Cost: None, or 1 CP for extended use
You can carry a brief message to one creature you can see within 120 feet. The target hears the message as a whisper, tone, bell-note, or inner vibration. This does not require the target to share a language, but the message must be understandable by ordinary means.
By spending 1 CP and concentrating for 1 minute, you may send a short message to a familiar location, prepared bell, resonant object, or creature whose voice you have studied within 1 mile. The target hears the message if a path of sound, structure, spirit resonance, or prepared anchor reasonably exists.
Carry Voice is not telepathy. Barriers, Silence, anti-divination wards, distance, or hostile territory may block it.

#### Dampen Sound
Classification: Basic Sound Technique
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Area: 10-foot cube
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Create a zone of controlled dampening.
For the duration:
ordinary sound from inside the area is muffled;
creatures outside the area have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing to notice sounds from inside;
creatures inside have Advantage on checks to move quietly if the only issue is sound;
Thunder damage dealt entirely inside the area is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus.
Dampen Sound is not full magical Silence. It does not prevent verbal components, speech, command words, or thunder damage unless a talent upgrades it.

#### Read the Vibration
Classification: Basic Sound Technique
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Listen to vibration in air, ground, water, walls, objects, weapons, or living bodies.
Make a Sound Check against a DC set by the GM or opposed by a relevant Dexterity (Stealth), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Wisdom (Perception), or cultivation concealment check.
On a success, learn one:
whether a creature moved through a nearby space recently;
whether a wall, door, vessel, bell, bridge, or barrier is hollow, cracked, tensioned, sealed, or reinforced;
whether an invisible or hidden creature is making meaningful sound within range;
whether an object or structure is resonant, brittle, or warded against sound;
whether a spoken phrase, bell, song, or chant carries supernatural influence.
Read the Vibration does not automatically reveal exact location, see through walls, identify all creatures, or bypass stealth. It provides a clue or contested perception method.

whether a wall, door, vessel, bell, bridge, or barrier is hollow, cracked, tensioned, sealed, or reinforced;
whether an invisible or hidden creature is making meaningful sound within range;
whether an object or structure is resonant, brittle, or warded against sound;
whether a spoken phrase, bell, song, or chant carries supernatural influence.
Read the Vibration does not automatically reveal exact location, see through walls, identify all creatures, or bypass stealth. It provides a clue or contested perception method.
