spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Sound Qi Expression: Primary — Sound Qi; Supporting — Thunder Qi, Breath Qi, Vibration Qi, Speech Qi. “The first lesson of Sound is that nothing is still. The second is that every stillness is waiting to be struck.” Sphere Type: Power Sphere with Martial Expressions Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Common Body Access: Throat-Thunder Body, Bell-Bone Body, Resonant Strike scriptures, and other explicit features Resources: CP for supernatural Sound talents. Body Refiners may use Stamina for Sound talents only when a talent, variant, Insight, Path synergy, or inheritance explicitly permits it. Common Effects: Thunder damage, vibration, resonance marks, object and barrier disruption, concentration pressure, deafening, silence and sound suppression, echo decoys, sonic movement, voice transmission, bell fields, soul-hearing, and world-ringing domains. ### Sound Dao Sound is the cultivation of vibration becoming command. A sword decides. A spear establishes the line. Sound enters before the guard rises. It travels through air, stone, water, bone, blood, meridians, bells, strings, drums, and the hollow places of the soul. A Sound cultivator does not merely make noise. They discover the note by which a thing admits that it can be changed. A novice learns to shout. An adept learns to listen. A master learns to strike the weakness already hidden inside the target. A sovereign learns that Heaven itself has a tone. The Sound sphere rewards: control of attention and hearing; disruption of concentration; pressure against objects, barriers, and brittle structures; battlefield communication; silence and counter-silence; echo misdirection; vibration-based sensing; bell, voice, drum, zither, whistle, clap, chant, breath, and body-resonance expression; the difference between loudness and resonance. ### The Central Question Sound asks: What frequency does the world answer when struck? It is not only volume. It is relationship between impulse, medium, target, and timing. ### Sphere Boundaries Sound governs vibration, resonance, hearing, silence, echoes, carried voice, shattering tones, sonic pressure, bell fields, sound-based sensing, sound-shaped movement, and soul-resonant calls. Air governs wind, breath, pressure currents, flight, and atmosphere. Sound may travel through air, but it does not control wind unless a technique also uses Air. Lightning governs electrical current, nerve arrest, storm charge, and sudden energetic interruption. Sound may stun or deafen through resonance, but it is not electrical control. Force governs impact, pressure, barriers, and kinetic answer. Sound may create pressure through vibration, but it does not create general force constructs. Barrage governs repeated projectile rhythm and ranged cadence. Sound can release pulses and echoes, but does not become projectile mastery. Ink governs written marks, calligraphy, scripts, and law made through inscription. Sound may resonate with names or spoken scripture, but it does not write binding law without Ink. Fate governs fortune, mandate, red-thread bonds, and rewritten consequence. Sound may carry vows and names, but it does not alter destiny by itself. Spirit governs souls, ghosts, possession, inner voice, and mental resonance. Sound can interact with spirits through Spirit synergies, but it is not the full Spirit sphere. Dreams governs sleep, dream logic, memory-symbols, and unreality. Lullabies or nightmare notes require Dreams unless a Sound talent explicitly provides a limited effect. Music, if used as a separate discipline in a campaign, governs performance patterns, emotions, inspiration, rhythm, and ritual harmony. Sound governs the physical and spiritual principle of vibration. A Sound cultivator may use music as expression, but not every Sound technique is Music. ### Cultivation Expression Many Sound talents describe possible expressions such as voice, bell, zither, drum, flute, gong, thunderclap, breath, footfall, bone resonance, insect hum, scripture chant, or silent vibration. These are visual and narrative expressions unless a feature says otherwise. They do not change damage type, range, area, targeting, conditions, saving throws, sphere interactions, stealth rules, or required resources. Expression is flexible. Mechanics are fixed. ### Core Sound Rules #### Key Ability and Save DC Use your Path key ability for Sound talents unless a Path synergy, variant, or feature says otherwise. Sound Save DC = 8 + Proficiency Bonus + your Sound key ability modifier. Sound Cultivation Attack = d20 + Proficiency Bonus + your Sound key ability modifier. #### Sound Damage Sound talents usually deal Thunder damage. Some high-Realm talents may deal Force damage when resonance becomes physical pressure, Psychic damage when sound strikes the mind or soul, or Necrotic/Radiant damage through special forbidden or purifying scriptures. A talent must explicitly say so. #### Medium and Transmission Ordinary Sound talents require a reasonable medium or line of effect. Air, water, stone, metal, wood, bone, and other solid structures can carry sound when a talent says the sound travels through them. Unless a talent says otherwise: Total Cover blocks Sound talents that target through open space; magical Silence blocks sound that requires audible transmission; vacuum, sealed anti-sound barriers, or absolute soundless domains may prevent ordinary Sound effects; a target does not need to hear the sound unless the talent says hearing is required; Deafened creatures can still be damaged by physical vibration unless a talent relies on hearing. #### Resonance Some Sound talents apply Resonance. Resonance is a short-lived pressure state showing that the target’s body, spirit, structure, or technique has begun answering your tone. Unless a talent says otherwise: Resonance lasts until the start of your next turn; one target may bear only one instance of your Resonance at a time; Resonance is not a tracking mark; Resonance does not reveal a hidden creature’s location; Resonance does not bypass Total Cover; Resonance ends early if the target enters an area of absolute Silence that suppresses the talent maintaining it. #### Resonant Objects and Structures Objects, barriers, constructs, brittle structures, instruments, bells, glass, crystal, bone, metal, stone, and Formation anchors are especially vulnerable to Sound talents that mention objects or Resonance. The GM may treat a structure as brittle, hollow, tensioned, cracked, or resonant when that makes sense. This does not automatically destroy major terrain, artifact walls, sect gates, or Realm-defining structures. #### Deafened and Silence Deafened prevents a creature from hearing. It does not automatically prevent it from being damaged by vibration. Silence suppresses audible sound. It does not automatically stop all vibration, tremor, body resonance, or spiritual sound unless the source specifically says it does. Sound talents that use “audible voice” fail in magical Silence. Sound talents that use “silent vibration,” “bone resonance,” “soul tone,” or “contact resonance” may function if the talent says so. ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Sound Initiation When you first learn Sound, choose one expression as your primary method: voice; bell; drum; zither or stringed instrument; flute or reed; whistle; clap or footfall; mantra or scripture chant; bone resonance; another GM-approved sound practice. This choice is descriptive unless a variant or feature says otherwise. You learn to create minor cultivated sound within 60 feet. As an Action, you may create one harmless sound no louder than a shout, throw your voice to a visible point, dampen one small noise, cause one unattended object to hum, or cause a small surface to vibrate. These minor sounds cannot deal damage, impose conditions, replace a check, transmit complex messages through barriers, or imitate a specific creature well enough to deceive without a check. #### Resonant Note Classification: Basic Sound Technique Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature or object you can perceive Cost: None Make a Sound Cultivation Attack against the target. Hit: The target takes Thunder damage and gains your Resonance until the start of your next turn. Damage by Cultivation Level: CL 1-4: 1d8 Thunder damage. CL 5-10: 2d8 Thunder damage. CL 11-16: 3d8 Thunder damage. CL 17-20: 4d8 Thunder damage. If the target is an unattended object, brittle structure, ordinary barrier, or construct, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage. If the target already bears your Resonance, choose one rider on a hit: the target is Deafened until the start of your next turn; the target has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn; the target cannot benefit from ordinary sound-based hiding until the start of your next turn; if the target is an object or barrier, the next damage it takes before the start of your next turn ignores ordinary Resistance to Thunder damage. #### Dampen Sound Classification: Basic Sound Technique Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Area: 10-foot cube Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 1 CP Create a zone of controlled dampening. For the duration: ordinary sound from inside the area is muffled; creatures outside the area have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing to notice sounds from inside; creatures inside have Advantage on checks to move quietly if the only issue is sound; Thunder damage dealt entirely inside the area is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus. Dampen Sound is not full magical Silence. It does not prevent verbal components, speech, command words, or thunder damage unless a talent upgrades it. #### Carry Voice Classification: Basic Sound Technique Action Type: Multi-Mode Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Timing Detail: Bonus Action or 1 minute Factory Routing: bonus_action_plus_extended_message_procedure Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=ONE_MINUTE_EXTENDED_VOICE Range: 120 feet normally, or longer through prepared echoes Cost: None, or 1 CP for extended use You can carry a brief message to one creature you can see within 120 feet. The target hears the message as a whisper, tone, bell-note, or inner vibration. This does not require the target to share a language, but the message must be understandable by ordinary means. By spending 1 CP and concentrating for 1 minute, you may send a short message to a familiar location, prepared bell, resonant object, or creature whose voice you have studied within 1 mile. The target hears the message if a path of sound, structure, spirit resonance, or prepared anchor reasonably exists. Carry Voice is not telepathy. Barriers, Silence, anti-divination wards, distance, or hostile territory may block it. #### Read the Vibration Classification: Basic Sound Technique Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: None Listen to vibration in air, ground, water, walls, objects, weapons, or living bodies. Make a Sound Check against a DC set by the GM or opposed by a relevant Dexterity (Stealth), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Wisdom (Perception), or cultivation concealment check. On a success, learn one: whether a creature moved through a nearby space recently; whether a wall, door, vessel, bell, bridge, or barrier is hollow, cracked, tensioned, sealed, or reinforced; whether an invisible or hidden creature is making meaningful sound within range; whether an object or structure is resonant, brittle, or warded against sound; whether a spoken phrase, bell, song, or chant carries supernatural influence. Read the Vibration does not automatically reveal exact location, see through walls, identify all creatures, or bypass stealth. It provides a clue or contested perception method. ### Sound Talent Tags Resonance talents apply, extend, exploit, or consume Resonance. Voice talents use speech, shout, mantra, breath, cry, command, or throat resonance. Instrument talents use bells, drums, strings, flutes, gongs, chimes, singing bowls, or other sound tools. Silence talents dampen, suppress, counter, or weaponize absence of sound. Echo talents create delays, repeats, false positions, reflected notes, or stored sounds. Shatter talents damage objects, barriers, structures, armor, Formation anchors, constructs, and brittle bodies. Hearing talents enhance perception, vibration-sense, soul-hearing, or sound analysis. Soul-Sound talents affect spirits, possession, names, emotions, or inner voices. ### Mortal Realm Sound Talents #### Thundering Voice - Voice Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 15-foot cone Cost: 1 CP Release a shout, bell-pulse, clap, or mantra burst. Creatures in the cone make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take Thunder damage and become Deafened until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and are not Deafened. Damage by Cultivation Level: CL 1-4: 2d6. CL 5-10: 3d6. CL 11-16: 5d6. CL 17-20: 7d6. #### Dissonant Pulse - Resonance Trigger: You damage a creature with Resonant Note or another Sound talent. Cost: 1 CP Use Limit: Once per turn The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of your next turn; cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn; apply Resonance until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Apply Resonance until the start of your next turn. #### Harmonic Weakness - Shatter, Resonance Prerequisite: Resonant Note When you damage an object, construct, barrier, or structure with Sound damage, mark it with Harmonic Weakness until the start of your next turn. The next time it takes damage before the mark ends, add one Sound Die to that damage. Sound Die by Realm: Mortal: 1d6. Foundation: 1d8. Core Formation: 1d10. Nascent Soul: 2d8. Harmonic Weakness cannot stack with itself. #### Muffle Footfall - Silence Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 10 minutes Cost: 1 CP Choose yourself or one willing creature within 30 feet. For the duration: the target has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to avoid sound detection; the target’s armor, gear, breathing, and footfalls are muted; ordinary loose stones, creaking boards, and dry leaves make less sound when disturbed by the target. The talent does not make the target invisible, scentless, weightless, or undetectable by tremorsense. #### Echo Position - Echo Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: 1 CP Create a false sound-position in a space you can perceive. Until the echo ends, a creature relying on hearing to locate you or one willing ally of your choice must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or treat the echo’s space as the source of the sound. This can impose Disadvantage on one attack roll made before the start of your next turn if the attacker relies on hearing or sound to locate the target. Echo Position does not fool sight, blindsight that is not sound-based, tremorsense, or true magical perception. #### Bell-Shell Guard - Instrument, Resonance Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or one ally within 30 feet takes Thunder damage, is Deafened, or fails a Concentration saving throw caused by sound, voice, thunder, or vibration Cost: 1 CP or expend Martial Focus if using an approved bell, gong, shield-chime, or body-resonance variant Reduce the triggering Thunder damage by: 1d8 + your Sound key ability modifier If the trigger was Deafened or Concentration loss, grant the target a reroll. The target must use the new result. At CL 11, increase the reduction to: 2d8 + your Sound key ability modifier #### Shatter Vessel - Shatter Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One unattended object, fragile vessel, crystal, glass, bell, bottle, lock, chime, arrow, small barrier section, or brittle structure Cost: 1 CP Make a Sound Cultivation Attack against the object’s AC or a GM-set DC. On a hit, deal Thunder damage equal to: 3d8 + Proficiency Bonus If this damage destroys the object, choose one: creatures within 5 feet make Dexterity saving throws or take 1d8 Thunder damage from the burst; create a loud report audible up to 300 feet; suppress one mundane alarm, bell, chime, or sound trap attached to the object; apply Harmonic Weakness to one connected object or barrier section. Shatter Vessel does not automatically break magic items, artifacts, sect gates, or Formation cores. #### Carrying Bell - Instrument You can prepare one small bell, chime, drum, singing bowl, tuning fork, throat bead, or resonant charm during a Long Rest. While the object is on your person: Carry Voice range doubles for targets familiar with the sound; Read the Vibration gains Advantage when examining bells, instruments, doors, locks, walls, or hollow spaces; once per short rest, use Resonant Note without sound audible beyond 30 feet. If the object is broken or stolen, you lose these benefits until you prepare another. #### Body Resonance Strike - Voice, Shatter Prerequisite: Body Refining or GM approval When you hit with an Unarmed Strike or melee weapon attack, you may spend 1 Stamina or 1 CP to release a close vibration through the target. Add 1d6 Thunder damage. If the target is wearing armor, carrying a shield, holding a weapon, or is a construct, apply Resonance until the start of your next turn. At CL 11, increase the bonus damage to 2d6. Body Resonance Strike does not turn all melee attacks into Sound talents unless another feature says so. #### Counter-Chant - Voice, Silence Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you can hear within 60 feet speaks a command word, uses a Voice talent, casts a spell with a verbal component, or begins a supernatural chant Cost: 2 CP Make a Sound Check opposed by the target’s spellcasting ability check, cultivation check, or saving throw DC converted to a check DC. Success: The target’s voice cracks. Choose one: it has Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll or ability check; one target of the triggering effect has Advantage on its saving throw; the triggering sound is audible but distorted, preventing clear communication; if the effect is harmless communication only, it fails to carry beyond 30 feet. Counter-Chant does not automatically counter spells. It disrupts voice-dependent execution. #### Tremor Listening - Hearing While touching the ground, a wall, a weapon haft, a string, a bell, a door, or another resonant object, you may use Read the Vibration through that surface. When you do, increase the range to 120 feet along the connected surface. You can detect meaningful movement, impacts, opened doors, footsteps, heavy breathing, running water, machinery, and combat through the surface when the GM agrees the vibration can travel. This does not provide blindsight. #### Silent Step Between Notes - Echo, Silence Prerequisite: Muffle Footfall Once per turn after you use the Disengage action, Dodge action, or spend Martial Focus, you may move 5 feet without making sound and without provoking opportunity attacks from one creature that relies on hearing to track you. If you are inside your Dampen Sound area, move 10 feet instead. ### Foundation Realm Sound Talents #### Resonant Shatter - Shatter Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 30-foot line or 10-foot-radius sphere Cost: 3 CP Release a frequency that finds structural weakness. Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take Thunder damage and gain Resonance. Successful Save: Take half damage. Objects, constructs, barriers, brittle structures, and Formation anchors inside take the same damage. Add one additional damage die against unattended objects and ordinary structures. Damage: CL 5-10: 5d8. CL 11-16: 7d8. CL 17-20: 9d8. A creature damaged by Resonant Shatter has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of your next turn. #### True Silence - Silence Prerequisite: Dampen Sound, CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Create a field of cultivated silence. Inside the area: creatures are Deafened; ordinary sound cannot be created or pass through; verbal components and voice-dependent talents fail unless a feature says they function without audible sound; Thunder damage is halved before other reductions; creatures have Advantage on saving throws against Voice talents that require hearing. Your own Sound talents are also restricted unless they use silent vibration, contact resonance, soul-sound, or a feature that pierces Silence. #### Soundwalk Step - Echo Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Cost: 2 CP Move along a sound you created or can hear. Teleport to one unoccupied space within range that is connected to you by audible sound, visible vibration, a bell resonance, or your active Sound talent. You cannot pass through Total Cover unless the sound path is carried by a connected object, wall, floor, string, or prepared echo and the GM agrees the path is valid. At CL 11, range increases to 60 feet. At CL 17, range increases to 90 feet. #### Echo Decoy - Echo Prerequisite: Echo Position, CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP Create a sound-body decoy in an unoccupied space. The decoy produces footfalls, breathing, speech fragments, weapon sounds, and clothing rustle appropriate to one creature you choose. A creature that uses its Action to examine the decoy may make an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) check against your Sound Save DC. On a failure, the creature treats the decoy as a plausible creature for hearing-based targeting and may waste one attack, pursuit, or reaction against it. The decoy has AC 10, 1 HP, and disappears when damaged, touched, or exposed by special senses not based on sound. #### Bell of Clarity - Instrument, Soul-Sound Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Cost: 3 CP Sound one clarifying tone. Choose creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus within range. Each target may immediately repeat one saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Deafened, magical confusion, hostile possession pressure, or an effect imposed through voice, song, command, or sound. On a success, the effect ends for that target. If the effect was caused by a creature, the source hears the bell unless blocked by Silence. #### Steal Voice - Voice, Silence Prerequisite: Counter-Chant, CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 4 CP One creature that can speak makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn, the target cannot speak above a whisper, cannot use verbal components, and cannot use Voice talents that require audible speech. Successful Save: The target’s voice cracks. It has Disadvantage on the next Charisma check, verbal command, or voice-based ability it makes before the start of your next turn. Creatures without voices are immune. #### Resonance Field - Resonance Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 15-foot-radius aura Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP Your tone saturates nearby space. Once per turn when a hostile creature enters the aura for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It gains Resonance and takes Thunder damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Successful Save: It gains Resonance only. While inside the aura, allies gain Advantage on saving throws against Deafened and hostile voice-command effects. #### Harmonic Healing Tone - Soul-Sound Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Cost: 3 CP Choose one willing creature within range. The target regains HP equal to: 2d8 + your Sound key ability modifier The target may also end Deafened or reduce one level of Exhaustion caused by sound, thunder, screams, sonic trauma, or spiritual dissonance if the GM agrees. At CL 11, healing increases to 4d8. At CL 17, healing increases to 6d8. This is limited harmonic stabilization, not the full Life sphere. #### Stone-Bell Propagation - Shatter, Hearing Prerequisite: Tremor Listening, CL 5+ When using a Sound talent against a target touching the same continuous surface, structure, bridge, wall, floor, pillar, chain, or bell network as you, increase the range by 30 feet. When Resonant Shatter affects a structure, choose one connected point within 30 feet. Harmless sound, a warning bell, or your Carry Voice message may emerge from that point. This does not allow damage to ignore Total Cover unless a talent explicitly permits propagation. #### Thousand-Pace Call - Voice Prerequisite: Carry Voice, CL 5+ You may spend 2 CP and concentrate for 1 minute to send a message up to 10 miles to a familiar creature, place, bell, shrine, instrument, sect token, or prepared echo anchor. The message may be up to twenty-five words or one brief sound-pattern. The message can be blocked by Silence, anti-divination wards, domain boundaries, sealed mountain formations, or GM-defined interference. The receiver knows the message came by cultivated sound, but not necessarily your exact location. #### Thunder-Meridian Strike - Voice, Resonance Prerequisite: Body Resonance Strike or Throat-Thunder Body, CL 5+ When you hit with a melee attack or Unarmed Strike, spend 2 Stamina or 2 CP. The target takes 2d8 Thunder damage and makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn; Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of your next turn; apply Resonance until the end of your next turn. ### Core Formation Realm Sound Talents #### World-Ringing Note - Shatter, Resonance Prerequisite: Resonant Shatter, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 60-foot line, 10-foot wide, or 20-foot-radius sphere Cost: 7 CP Release a tone that seems to strike every surface at once. Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take 8d8 Thunder damage, gain Resonance, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and gain Resonance. Objects, barriers, constructs, and brittle structures take full damage. If a connected structure is affected, you may choose one legal point on that same connected structure within the talent’s range. A harmless echo, warning tone, or Carry Voice message may originate from that point before the end of your turn. World-Ringing Note does not automatically ignore Total Cover for damage. #### Forbidden Silence Field - Silence Prerequisite: True Silence, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP Create a heavy silence that presses on voice, breath, and spirit. Inside the area: ordinary sound cannot be created or pass through; creatures are Deafened; verbal components and voice-dependent talents fail; creatures cannot benefit from hearing-based blindsight; Thunder damage is reduced by half; hostile creatures entering for the first time on a turn or starting their turns there make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: The creature cannot speak, shout, command, sing, or use Voice talents until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: No additional effect. You may use Sound talents inside the Field only if they explicitly function through silent vibration, contact resonance, soul-sound, or a special feature. #### Sonic Cage - Resonance, Shatter Prerequisite: Resonance Field, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Target: One creature bearing your Resonance Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP Rings of vibrating pressure surround the target. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target is Restrained by sonic pressure. Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. A Restrained target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the target takes Thunder damage while Restrained this way, it has Disadvantage on the next save against Sonic Cage before the end of its next turn. Sonic Cage does not create a physical cage and does not block attacks. #### Soul-Echo Hearing - Hearing, Soul-Sound Prerequisite: Read the Vibration, CL 10+ You can hear the echo of spirits, possession pressure, soul wounds, oath-shaken voices, false speech, and names spoken with supernatural weight. As an Action, make a Sound Check against a creature within 60 feet or a place you are investigating. On a success, learn one: whether a creature is possessed, spirit-bound, or haunted; whether a spoken statement carries supernatural coercion; whether a name, title, vow, or mantra was recently used with power; whether a ghost, echo, or residual scream remains in the area; whether a Silence effect is natural, magical, spiritual, or domain-based. Soul-Echo Hearing does not read thoughts or reveal lies automatically. #### Court of the World-Ringing Bell - Domain Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 60-foot-radius sphere centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 9 CP Establish a Sound Domain of bells, strings, thunder pressure, or silent resonance. When you create the Domain, choose Ringing Court or Silent Court. Ringing Court: allies inside gain Resistance to Thunder damage; allies inside may communicate in whispers across the Domain; hostile creatures that start their turn inside make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: They take 4d8 Thunder damage and gain Resonance. Successful Save: They gain Resonance. Silent Court: ordinary speech and loud sound cannot pass beyond the Domain boundary; allies inside gain Advantage on saving throws against voice, command, and sound effects; hostile creatures that start their turn inside make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: They cannot speak above a whisper until the start of their next turn. Successful Save: No additional effect. A creature can take damage from Court of the World-Ringing Bell only once per round. #### Name-Striking Tone - Voice, Soul-Sound Prerequisite: Soul-Echo Hearing, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 6 CP Speak, ring, or resonate a creature’s name, title, cultivation epithet, true voice-pattern, or battle-call. You must know a meaningful name or have heard the target’s voice during the last 24 hours. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Take 6d8 Psychic or Thunder damage and choose one: Frightened of you until the end of your next turn; cannot willingly move closer to you until the end of your next turn; Disadvantage on the next saving throw against your Sound talents before the end of your next turn; apply Resonance until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and no rider. This is not Fate’s true-name authority and does not rewrite destiny. #### Resonance Mirror - Echo Prerequisite: Echo Decoy, CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You are targeted by an attack or hostile effect from a creature that can hear, sense, or target sound within 60 feet Cost: 5 CP Create a reflected echo of your position. The attacker makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The triggering attack or effect targets your echo instead, if the echo is a legal target. If the echo is not a legal target, impose Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll or grant you Advantage on the triggering saving throw. Successful Save: No effect. After the trigger resolves, you may move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the triggering creature. #### Shatter the Chant - Silence, Voice Prerequisite: Counter-Chant, CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within 90 feet uses a spell, sphere talent, magical command, Domain order, or technique that requires audible speech, song, command, chanting, verbal component, or instrument sound Cost: 6 CP Make a Sound Check against the triggering creature’s Save DC, Cultivation Save DC, or named sphere Save DC. Success: Choose one: the triggering effect occurs, but one target has Advantage on its saving throw; the triggering effect occurs, but its range is halved; the triggering effect occurs, but it cannot affect you; if the effect is communication, command, or coordination only, it fails. Critical Success or success by 5 or more: You may also apply Resonance to the triggering creature. Shatter the Chant is not universal counterspell. It only attacks sound-dependent execution. #### Bell That Breaks the Formation - Shatter Prerequisite: Harmonic Weakness, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Target: One visible barrier, Formation Anchor, ward node, gate-bell, seal-pillar, instrument array, or resonant structure Cost: 8 CP Make a Sound Cultivation Attack against a GM-set DC. Success: Deal 8d10 Thunder damage to the target. This damage ignores ordinary Resistance and hardness. If the target is an ordinary temporary barrier or lesser ward node and the damage reduces it to 0, it breaks. If the target is a major Formation Anchor, artifact, Domain core, sect gate, or Realm-defining structure, this talent may create a weakness, suppress one minor function until the end of your next turn, or reveal a vulnerability. It does not automatically destroy it. ### Nascent Soul Realm Sound Talents #### Sound-Sovereign Incarnation Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign vessel of world-ringing vibration. For the duration: gain Resistance to Thunder and Psychic damage; gain Blindsight 30 feet based on vibration and soul-sound; Resonant Note may target two creatures within range instead of one; once per turn when a creature fails a saving throw against your Sound talent, it cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; you may speak or transmit through your own Sound talents even inside ordinary Silence; Soundwalk Step range increases by 30 feet; your Sound talents ignore ordinary Thunder Resistance. Sound-Sovereign Incarnation does not ignore immunity, artifact silence, Domain suppression, or Total Cover unless another feature says so. #### Mountain-Cracking Bell Prerequisite: Bell That Breaks the Formation, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300 feet Area: 60-foot-radius sphere or one structure, cliff face, bridge, wall, gate, tower, ship, battlefield engine, or barrier Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Strike a bell-note, shout, drumbeat, or silent vibration that shakes great structures. Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take 10d8 Thunder damage, fall Prone, and gain Resonance. Successful Save: Take half damage and gain Resonance. Objects, structures, barriers, constructs, and brittle terrain inside take double damage. The GM may allow this talent to crack cliffs, breach walls, collapse fragile towers, shatter bridges, split ice, disrupt siege engines, or suppress a Formation function for 1 round. It does not automatically destroy artifacts, mountain roots, sect gates, Domains, or immortal architecture. #### Ten-Thousand Echoes Field Prerequisite: Echo Decoy, Court of the World-Ringing Bell, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 120-foot-radius sphere centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Fill the battlefield with layered echoes, phantom footfalls, repeated commands, delayed screams, false bell-lines, and reflected mantra fragments. Allies inside: gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks relying on sound; may communicate in whispers across the Field; may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks after using a Sound talent, once per turn. Hostile creatures inside: have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing; cannot gain Advantage on attacks solely from hearing your location; make a Wisdom saving throw when they start their turn inside. Failed Save: The creature must choose either lose its Reaction until the start of its next turn or treat all spaces more than 30 feet away as lightly obscured by echo confusion until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: No additional effect. #### Silence That Swallows Thunder Prerequisite: Forbidden Silence Field, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 30-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Create a devouring silence that consumes hostile sound. Inside the area: ordinary sound cannot exist; creatures are Deafened; verbal components and voice-dependent techniques fail; Thunder damage from hostile sources is reduced to 0 unless the source succeeds on a Sound or spellcasting ability check against your Sound Save DC; hostile creatures that start their turn inside make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: The creature cannot speak, cast with verbal components, use Voice talents, or benefit from hearing until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: It can speak and act normally, but remains Deafened while inside. You and allies may use Sound talents inside only if the talent uses silent vibration, soul-sound, or contact resonance. #### Voice Heard Across the Mountain Sea Prerequisite: Thousand-Pace Call, CL 15+ Action Type: Ritual Procedure Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action Timing Detail: 10 minutes Range: Regional Cost: 8 CP Send a cultivated message across a region up to 100 miles to a familiar creature, sect bell, shrine, domain gate, named mountain, city tower, or prepared echo anchor. The message may be up to one minute of speech, music, bell-pattern, or warning tone. This talent requires one of the following: a prepared resonant anchor; a known receiving bell or instrument; a creature whose voice you know well; a sect token or oath-chime; a place where your sound has previously been welcomed. This is long-range communication, not teleportation, divination, or mind-reading. Wards, Silence, hostile Domains, distance, wrong names, or severed anchors may block it. #### World-Splitting Scream Prerequisite: World-Ringing Note, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 120-foot line, 10 feet wide Cost: 12 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Release one impossible tone down a chosen line. Creatures in the line make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take 12d10 Thunder damage, become Deafened for 1 minute, and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and become Deafened until the start of your next turn. A creature Deafened for 1 minute repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending that duration on a success. Objects and ordinary barriers inside take double damage. World-Splitting Scream leaves a visible crack, tremor trail, or echo scar in the affected terrain until the end of your next turn. ### Secret Sound Inheritance #### The First Sound Before Heaven “Before Heaven named itself, something rang. The cultivator who hears it does not speak loudly. They remind the world what it once answered to.” Classification: Secret Sound Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Sound-Sovereign Incarnation, World-Ringing Note, hidden primordial-tone scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300 feet, or one connected resonant structure within sight Area: 60-foot-radius sphere, 300-foot line, or one named resonant target Cost: 15 CP Use Limit: Once per week Release a primordial tone, absolute silence, or impossible vibration. Choose one mode. Heaven-Ringing Mode: Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws. Failed Save: Take 16d10 Thunder or Psychic damage, become Deafened for 1 minute, and become Stunned until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and become Deafened until the end of your next turn. Structure-Shattering Mode: Choose one object, barrier, structure, Formation Anchor, gate, instrument array, or terrain feature. Make a Sound Cultivation Attack or Cultivation Check against a GM-set DC. Success: Deal 20d10 Thunder damage to the target, ignoring ordinary Resistance and hardness. If the target survives, choose one ordinary function to suppress until the end of your next turn. Silence-Before-Sound Mode: Create a 60-foot-radius field until the end of your next turn. Inside the field: hostile verbal components fail; hostile Voice talents fail; ordinary sound cannot exist; Thunder damage from hostile sources becomes 0; creatures of your choice can still hear your command, bell, or soul-tone. The First Sound Before Heaven does not automatically destroy artifacts, Domains, immortal formations, permanent karmic bonds, or Realm-defining structures. It may crack, suppress, reveal, or contest them according to GM adjudication. ### Optional Sound Cultivation Variants #### Throat-Thunder Body You cultivate Sound through lungs, diaphragm, throat, bones, meridians, and impact breath rather than external instruments. You may use Constitution as your Sound key ability. You may spend Stamina instead of CP for Voice, Resonance, and Body Resonance talents you are permitted to learn. You cannot learn Instrument talents unless you also train a suitable instrument or take a separate Insight. Once per turn when you hit with an Unarmed Strike or melee weapon attack, apply Resonance if you spent Stamina on a Sound talent that turn. #### Bell Scripture You require a bell, chime, gong, singing bowl, or resonant metal focus for most Sound talents. While holding or wearing your focus: Instrument talents cost 1 less CP, minimum 1; Resonant Shatter and World-Ringing Note gain +30 feet range; Bell of Clarity affects one additional target. If the focus is broken, stolen, or silenced, you cannot use Instrument talents and have Disadvantage on Sound Checks until you replace or repair it. #### Voiceless Sound Scripture You do not use audible speech. Your Sound manifests through silent vibration, finger taps, breath pulses, mudras, written rhythm, pulse control, or bone resonance. You gain Advantage on saving throws against effects that steal your voice or require you to speak. Your Voice talents become Silent Voice talents, but they lose any benefit that depends on being heard at long range unless a feature says otherwise. You cannot use Thousand-Pace Call or Voice Heard Across the Mountain Sea unless you prepare a resonant anchor. #### Echo Hermit Scripture You specialize in echoes, false positions, and hidden sound rather than raw damage. Echo talents cost 1 less CP, minimum 1. Your Resonant Note damage die becomes d6 instead of d8. When you create Echo Position or Echo Decoy, choose one ally within 30 feet. That ally gains Advantage on the next Dexterity (Stealth) check relying on sound before the start of your next turn. #### Shatter-Monk Scripture You use Sound mainly to break objects, armor, barriers, and bodies through close vibration. You may spend Stamina on Shatter talents if you are a Body Refiner. Resonant Note range becomes 30 feet. When you hit a creature or object with a melee attack, you may apply Harmonic Weakness once per turn. #### Gentle Tuning Scripture You refuse destructive sound except as a last resort. Your Sound talents that deal damage deal half damage unless used against objects, barriers, constructs, undead, demons, possessing entities, or creatures currently harming an ally. Your Harmonic Healing Tone costs 1 less CP, minimum 1. Bell of Clarity affects one additional target. You gain Advantage on Sound Checks made to identify curses, possession pressure, emotional resonance, and spiritual dissonance through voice. ### Path Synergies #### Body Refining - Bell-Bone Circulation Use Constitution as your Sound key ability. You may spend Stamina instead of CP for Sound talents marked Voice, Resonance, Shatter, or Body Resonance if you use throat, breath, bones, or impact vibration. When Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, you may release a brief pulse. One hostile creature within 10 feet makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It gains Resonance until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No effect. #### Qi Cultivation - Harmonic Meridian Law Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Sound key ability. Once per turn when you apply Resonance, choose one: increase one Sound talent range by 30 feet; reduce the CP cost of one Sound talent by 1, minimum 1; carry one harmless voice, bell, or warning tone to one additional target within 60 feet. When you use Resonant Shatter, you may choose whether the tone is audible, sub-audible, or visible as trembling script-like waves. #### Spirit Awakening - Soul-Tone Resonance Use Wisdom as your Sound key ability. Your Sound talents affect ghosts, spirits, possessing entities, incorporeal creatures, and soul-bound creatures normally when they deal Psychic damage, use Soul-Sound, or apply Resonance through a heard name, bell, mantra, or inner tone. Once per round when a creature bearing your Resonance speaks, cries out, chants, lies under supernatural pressure, or suffers possession strain, learn one: whether the voice is its own; whether a possessing presence is influencing it; whether it is under Charmed or Frightened pressure; whether a vow, curse, or command is weighing on the voice. This does not reveal private thoughts. ### Cultivation Insights #### Bell-Bone Adept Prerequisite: Body Refining, Sound sphere, CL 4+ Your bones and breath carry cultivated vibration. Gain: use Constitution as your Sound key ability; learn Body Resonance Strike if you do not already know it; spend Stamina instead of CP for Body Resonance Strike and Thundering Voice; Resistance to Thunder damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus as damage reduction against one Thunder damage instance per round. #### Harmonic Analyst Prerequisite: Sound sphere, CL 4+ Gain Advantage on checks to identify: brittle objects; hollow walls; hidden bells or alarms; damaged barriers; unstable bridges; resonant Formation Anchors; creatures using voice-based magic. Once per short rest, when you succeed on Read the Vibration, ask one additional question from its list. #### Silent Foundation Prerequisite: Dampen Sound or Muffle Footfall, CL 5+ Once per short rest, when you would fail a Dexterity (Stealth) check because of sound, reroll the check. If you are inside your own Dampen Sound or True Silence area, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reroll. #### Counter-Chant Specialist Prerequisite: Counter-Chant, CL 8+ When you use Counter-Chant: increase range by 30 feet; if the opposed check succeeds, regain 1 CP; if the target bears your Resonance, it has Disadvantage on its opposing check. #### World-Ringing Bell Keeper Prerequisite: Resonant Shatter, CL 10+ You may prepare one large bell, gong, drum, cliff-face, shrine chime, gate bell, or resonant stone during downtime. While within 1 mile of that prepared object: Thousand-Pace Call can target it without CP cost once per day; Sound talents used to defend the site gain +1 to their Save DC; Read the Vibration can detect major impacts, gate openings, battle, or structural damage affecting the site. This Insight does not create a permanent Formation by itself. #### Soul-Hearing Listener Prerequisite: Soul-Echo Hearing, Spirit Awakening, CL 10+ When you use Soul-Echo Hearing, choose one willing creature whose voice you have heard within the last day. Until your next Long Rest, you know if that creature is possessed, silenced, screaming, or reduced to 0 HP while within 1 mile, unless blocked by wards, Silence, or a Domain. You do not know the creature’s exact location unless another feature says so.

#### Read the Vibration
Classification: Basic Sound Technique
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Cost: None
Listen to vibration in air, ground, water, walls, objects, weapons, or living bodies.
Make a Sound Check against a DC set by the GM or opposed by a relevant Dexterity (Stealth), Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Wisdom (Perception), or cultivation concealment check.
On a success, learn one:
whether a creature moved through a nearby space recently;
whether a wall, door, vessel, bell, bridge, or barrier is hollow, cracked, tensioned, sealed, or reinforced;
whether an invisible or hidden creature is making meaningful sound within range;
whether an object or structure is resonant, brittle, or warded against sound;
whether a spoken phrase, bell, song, or chant carries supernatural influence.
Read the Vibration does not automatically reveal exact location, see through walls, identify all creatures, or bypass stealth. It provides a clue or contested perception method.

#### Resonant Note
Classification: Basic Sound Technique
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or object you can perceive
Cost: None
Make a Sound Cultivation Attack against the target.
Hit: The target takes Thunder damage and gains your Resonance until the start of your next turn.
Damage by Cultivation Level:
CL 1-4: 1d8 Thunder damage.
CL 5-10: 2d8 Thunder damage.
CL 11-16: 3d8 Thunder damage.
CL 17-20: 4d8 Thunder damage.
If the target is an unattended object, brittle structure, ordinary barrier, or construct, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage.
If the target already bears your Resonance, choose one rider on a hit:
the target is Deafened until the start of your next turn;
the target has Disadvantage on the next Concentration saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn;
the target cannot benefit from ordinary sound-based hiding until the start of your next turn;
if the target is an object or barrier, the next damage it takes before the start of your next turn ignores ordinary Resistance to Thunder damage.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### Source Reading
Source Reading is the basic act of inspecting stone, earth, ore, jade, crystal, a mine face, a source object, a sealed stone, or a mineral surface.
As an Action, you may inspect one unattended mineral object, one visible seal on a mineral object, or one 5-foot section of mineral surface within reach. The GM tells you whether it has obvious active qi, obvious instability, obvious artificial sealing, obvious spiritual contamination, or obvious recent disturbance.
By spending 10 minutes, you may make a Source check against a DC set by the GM to learn one useful fact about one mineral object, chamber, vein, quarry face, ruin wall, mine tunnel, source deposit, sealed stone, or similar feature you can examine. Examples include whether it is natural or worked, whether it contains active source qi, whether it is unstable, whether it has been cut recently, whether a stronger vein lies in a visible direction, whether a seal is present, whether opening it is obviously dangerous, or whether a seal is meant to contain, preserve, warn, lock, hide, or punish.
Source Reading does not reveal exact treasure value, full maps, hidden creatures behind total cover, secret doors automatically, command words, sealed creature identities, or the full rules of another sphere. It gives one grounded fact through stone and source.

### Source Pulse
Action Type: Action
Canonical Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature touching a mineral surface, or one unattended mineral object
Cost: 0
Make a Source attack roll against the target. On a hit against a creature, the target takes 1d8 radiant damage as buried source-light snaps through the ground, wall, crystal, jade, ore, or stone under it, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. On a hit against an unattended object, the object takes the damage only.
The damage becomes 2d8 at Foundation Realm, 3d8 at Core Formation Realm, and 4d8 at Nascent Soul Realm.
The Speed reduction from Source Pulse does not stack with itself. Source Pulse cannot target a creature that is not touching an eligible mineral surface unless another talent, variant, item, or GM ruling says otherwise. Source Pulse does not damage the ground, create difficult terrain, open seals, or break objects beyond its listed damage unless a talent says it does.

### Source Seal
Action Type: Action
Canonical Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action
Range: Touch
Target: One unattended mineral object no larger than a 5-foot cube, one closed mineral container, one closed stone or metal door, one visible seal on a mineral object, or one 5-foot section of mineral surface
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 0
You place a faint source seal on the target. The seal is visible as dust-light, pressure lines, mineral frost, dull jade script, or another obvious Source mark unless a talent says otherwise.
Choose one basic effect:
- **Warning Seal.** If the target is opened, broken, moved, or spiritually disturbed while you are within 60 feet, you know that the seal was disturbed.
- **Stillness Seal.** The target has Advantage on the next saving throw or check it makes before the seal ends to avoid cracking, discharging, collapsing, or releasing stored pressure. If the target does not normally make such a roll, this has no effect.
- **Reading Seal.** The next Source Reading check you make against the target before the seal ends has Advantage.
- **Fetter Seal.** This option can be placed only on a 5-foot section of mineral surface. The first time a creature of your choice enters that section or starts its turn there before the seal ends, you may end the seal. If you do, that creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of that turn.
Source Seal does not lock the target, prevent movement except through Fetter Seal, restrain a creature, suppress a magic item, dispel a talisman, overwrite a Formation, prevent teleportation, or create a permanent mark. Talents create stronger seals by modifying or replacing this basic effect.
You can maintain a number of active Source Seals equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you create another Source Seal beyond this limit, choose one existing Source Seal you created to end.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Source Qi Types: source qi, buried-light qi, vein qi, dragon-vein qi, quarry qi, spirit-stone qi, jade qi, mineral qi, sealed-stone qi, earth-pulse qi. Related methods may involve earth qi, metal qi, star qi, formation qi, talisman qi, fate qi, death qi, spatial qi, or forbidden mine qi only when another sphere, item, Foundation, manual, or feature contributes them. "Power sleeps under stone because Heaven does not trust mortals with everything it buried." Common Name: Source Sphere Sphere Type: Restricted Power Sphere; Geomantic Reading, Source-Sealing, Buried-Vein, and Optional Scripture Sphere Primary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Body Refining through the Stone-Bone Source Body variant, a mine-body scripture, a source-bone Foundation, or another explicit body-bound initiation Key Themes: reading source, judging sealed stone, finding veins, appraising spirit-stones, listening to mineral memory, stabilizing dangerous cuts, placing short source seals, suppressing opened stone, borrowing brief pulses from the earth, surviving mines, and refusing the greed that opens every bright thing Primary Resource Hooks: Source Reading, Source Pulse, Source Seal, Source checks, source seals, mineral surfaces, existing source materials, CP, Stamina for Body Refining variants, Resonance for Spirit Awakening variants, and ordinary Tianxia resource rules Core Chassis: Source Training, Source Reading, Source Pulse, Source Seal, source-facing talents, seal talents, vein talents, realm talents, power-sphere limitation doctrine, optional variant scriptures, path synergies, Secret Inheritances, and GM-permission Forbidden branches Common Effects: Advantage on source/stone/seal checks, useful facts about mineral objects and places, safe handling of existing source materials, simple source attacks with reliable Speed pressure, small ally damage setup through fault-reading, temporary hit points, damage reduction, difficult terrain, brief no-Reaction or no-teleport riders, temporary object/surface seals, seal warning, seal stabilization, and GM prompts about buried danger ## Source Dao The Dao of Source is the Dao of buried origin. Before a pill is refined, there is a vein that nourished the ingredient. Before a sword is forged, there is ore that slept beneath pressure. Before a sect becomes rich, there is a mountain that was cut open. Before a prison is opened, there is a stone that held its breath for a thousand years. A Source cultivator does not simply mine. They ask what the land has carried, what Heaven buried, what the stone remembers, and whether the bright thing inside the rock is treasure, bait, prison, corpse, womb, curse, or warning. Source should be useful without becoming a second economy system. It reveals, judges, stabilizes, seals, and briefly borrows from what already exists. It does not create treasure because a player rolled well. The GM decides what exists in the world; Source tells the character how to approach it without dying like a fool. ## The Source Cultivation Loop Source follows a practical loop: **Read the Stone -> Find the Fault -> Judge the Seal -> Cut or Leave -> Borrow the Vein -> Close What Should Stay Closed** A novice learns not to open every promising stone. An adept can hear which vein lies sick, fat, hollow, or trapped. A master can place a short source seal, pin a battlefield to the ground for a breath, or preserve a dying life in a shell of source-stone. A forbidden master begins to treat bodies, graves, and living land as ore. ## Source's Mechanical Niche Source should not outdamage Destruction, outbuild Formations, outshape Earth, or replace Harvesting Gathering. Its special combat value is more precise: **it is one of the best spheres at turning stone, ore, ruins, caves, roads, walls, and battlefields into short control and exposed weak points.** On a normal battlefield with mineral ground, Source can do useful work every fight: Source Pulse slows a target on hit, Source Seal can prepare a small fetter point, and Source talents can turn a hit into an ally damage opening. In exploration, Source remains the best sphere for deciding whether a mineral treasure, sealed stone, mine, ruin wall, coffin-stone, or buried vein is safe, valuable, trapped, or better left closed. This means Source is a build-enabler and specialist control sphere, not only a mining sphere. A character might take it because they want anti-mobility, seal interaction, ruin safety, terrain pressure, or precision setup for allies. ## Sphere Boundary Source governs: - identifying spiritually active stone, ore, jade, crystal, source deposits, spirit-stones, coffin-stones, mineral containers, sealed ore, and dangerous source materials; - reading mountains, caves, mines, quarries, stone ruins, underground rivers, buried chambers, old battlefields, and dragon-vein traces; - appraising existing source materials without setting exact market value or creating new wealth; - safe cutting, safe handling, and warning signs around source stones and sealed mineral objects; - placing short source seals on mineral surfaces, stone doors, mineral containers, coffin-stones, sealed stones, and source hazards; - briefly suppressing, stabilizing, or warning against opened mineral seals and source discharges; - short combat effects that borrow pressure, light, resonance, or restraint from nearby stone, crystal, ore, earth, or source qi; - recognizing when stone contains a seal, living remnant, corpse, curse, prison, womb, old technique, or dangerous old qi. Source does not govern: - general treasure generation, money-making, market pricing, or automatic loot; - broad earth shaping, walls, tunnels, earthquakes, stone flight, land construction, or terrain command; use Earth; - ore refining, smithing, item forging, artifact birth, or repairing objects; use Blacksmith, Metal, or item rules; - herbal, beast, mundane survival, or general gathering systems; use Harvesting Gathering where appropriate; - formation construction, array writing, permanent nodes, sect-grade site defenses, or strategic geomantic projects; use Formations; - talisman formulae, written spell-storage, paper seals, jade slips, or scripted activation logic; use Talismans; - generic divination, future sight, luck control, or destiny reading; use Fate or The Hidden Eye; - teleportation, spatial folding, dimensional traps, pocket worlds, or void travel; use Space or Void; - permanent prisons, oath seals, soul contracts, long-duration creature seals, or control of sealed beings unless a Forbidden talent and GM-facing rule explicitly allow them. Use this test: if the effect is about **reading, judging, cutting, stabilizing, briefly sealing, or briefly borrowing from buried source**, Source may own it. If the effect is about **creating terrain, crafting items, building arrays, writing talismans, generating wealth, reading fate, commanding space, or permanently imprisoning a creature**, another system owns it. ## Source Access The Source sphere is ordinary but specialized. It may be learned from miners, stone gamblers, quarry sects, geomancers, tomb scouts, ruin delvers, border prospectors, source-reading families, mine-body schools, spirit-stone merchants, or scriptures recovered from ancient sealed mountains. When you first gain the Source sphere, choose one Source talent and gain it for free. You must meet the talent's prerequisites. Body Refining characters normally need the Stone-Bone Source Body variant, a mine-body Foundation, a source-bone scripture, a manual that makes Source body-bound, or explicit GM permission. Without that access, Source is usually too external and analytical for ordinary Body Refining. ## Realm Progression **Mortal Realm.** Source is practical reading and reliable terrain pressure. You inspect stone, recognize spiritual charge, avoid bad cuts, survive mines, notice simple seals, slow enemies with Source Pulse, and set up allies by reading a target's fault lines. **Foundation Realm.** Source enters the cultivation base. You glimpse dragon-vein direction, draw a small guard from the ground, briefly slow enemies through mineral surfaces, place simple source locks, and read more dangerous stone-born seals. **Core Formation Realm.** Source becomes a circuit. You maintain stronger source pins, empower Source Pulse, interrupt dangerous openings, suppress teleportation for a moment, identify living or cursed contents in stone, and borrow stronger dragon-vein pressure without building a Formation. **Nascent Soul Realm.** Source becomes geomantic authority. You ask deeper questions of mineral memory, mantle yourself in dragon-vein pressure, set world-nail source seals, briefly pin escape through the land, and preserve a life in sealed source-stone. **Secret and Forbidden Techniques.** Secret Source talents are mine-family scriptures, northern stone-gambler hands, dragon-vein maps, sealed tomb methods, or named geomantic lineages. Forbidden Source talents violate land, corpse, prison, sacrifice, or living source and should remain GM-permission content. ## 2024 Fifth-Edition Rules Baseline Source uses the active Tianxia and 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline. Use the normal meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, range, attack roll, saving throw, Ability Check, Advantage, Disadvantage, Temporary Hit Points, Resistance, difficult terrain, Speed, teleportation, Concentration, cover, object, carried item, worn item, total cover, short rest, long rest, and CP unless a talent explicitly changes them. A Source talent never creates treasure, ore, jade, spirit-stones, source crystals, artifacts, living prisoners, or sealed beings by itself. A successful check reveals, judges, stabilizes, or exploits something the GM has already placed or allows to exist. ## Power Sphere Doctrine Source is a power sphere, not a martial weapon sphere and not a crafting profession. It produces supernatural effects through source qi, vein pressure, buried light, and source seals. For normal Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening users, Source may use its listed ranges when the target and terrain are legal. For Body Refining users, Source must be made body-bound by a variant scripture, Insight, Foundation, manual, item, or GM permission. A Source route may also carry a limitation. These limitations are Tianxia scripture constraints, not generic spellcasting drawbacks. They define how a lineage actually works: through tools, contact, diagrams, visible source-light, terrain dependency, conservative sealing, or forbidden materials. A limitation should matter in play. If a Source route says it needs a stone compass, source needle, marked seal line, mineral surface, or visible source mark, the GM should occasionally make that condition relevant. The benefit and the limit should both appear in the fiction. Unless a variant scripture says otherwise: - variants are optional and require GM permission; - variants do not grant bonus talents automatically; - a character normally follows only one major Source variant at a time; - if a variant is retrained, ritually broken, or replaced, lose the variant's benefit and limit; - variant limits do not delete known talents, but they may make some talents unusable until the condition is satisfied; - Body Refining variants may spend Stamina only for legal body-bound or contact-origin Source effects. ## Core Source Rules ### Source Key Ability Most Source talents use your Path key ability when they call for a Source check, Source Save DC, Source attack roll, or Source modifier. - Body Refining uses Constitution only through the Stone-Bone Source Body variant or another explicit Body Refining access method. - Qi Cultivation uses Intelligence or Charisma, according to the character's cultivation key. - Spirit Awakening uses Wisdom. ### Source Check When a talent calls for a Source check, roll d20 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Source key ability modifier unless the talent states otherwise. ### Source Save DC Your Source Save DC equals 8 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Source key ability modifier. ### Source Attack Roll When a talent calls for a Source attack roll, roll d20 + your Proficiency Bonus + your Source key ability modifier. ### Mineral Surface Some Source talents require a mineral surface. Earth, stone, packed clay, cave floor, worked stone, brick, tile, crystal, jade, ore, metal-rich ground, or similar mineral material counts. A wooden floor, ship deck, open water, air, snowfield, or purely organic surface does not count unless the GM rules that enough stone, earth, ore, or source material is present. A creature wearing metal armor, carrying a jade talisman, holding a sword, or standing on a tiny pebble is not automatically treated as touching a usable mineral surface for every Source talent. A talent must name worn, carried, or token-scale material if it can use that smaller source. ### Source Token A source token is a hand-held stone, jade, ore, crystal, metal charm, source compass, mineral needle, or similar mineral object deliberately used as a Source focus. A source token is not a full mineral surface. It can satisfy a talent only if that talent, a variant scripture, an item, a Foundation, or a GM ruling says token-scale material is enough. ### Source Hazard A source hazard is a trap, environmental hazard, discharge, curse, unstable mineral seal, sealed stone, source-stone, coffin-stone, or mineral object effect that explicitly involves source qi, stone, ore, jade, crystal, mineral pressure, or a source seal. The GM decides whether a hazard qualifies. This definition does not create hazards, assign CL to hazards, or make ordinary stone dangerous by itself. ### Source Reading Source Reading is the basic act of inspecting stone, earth, ore, jade, crystal, a mine face, a source object, a sealed stone, or a mineral surface. As an Action, you may inspect one unattended mineral object, one visible seal on a mineral object, or one 5-foot section of mineral surface within reach. The GM tells you whether it has obvious active qi, obvious instability, obvious artificial sealing, obvious spiritual contamination, or obvious recent disturbance. By spending 10 minutes, you may make a Source check against a DC set by the GM to learn one useful fact about one mineral object, chamber, vein, quarry face, ruin wall, mine tunnel, source deposit, sealed stone, or similar feature you can examine. Examples include whether it is natural or worked, whether it contains active source qi, whether it is unstable, whether it has been cut recently, whether a stronger vein lies in a visible direction, whether a seal is present, whether opening it is obviously dangerous, or whether a seal is meant to contain, preserve, warn, lock, hide, or punish. Source Reading does not reveal exact treasure value, full maps, hidden creatures behind total cover, secret doors automatically, command words, sealed creature identities, or the full rules of another sphere. It gives one grounded fact through stone and source. ### Source Pulse Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action Range: 60 feet Target: One creature touching a mineral surface, or one unattended mineral object Cost: 0 Make a Source attack roll against the target. On a hit against a creature, the target takes 1d8 radiant damage as buried source-light snaps through the ground, wall, crystal, jade, ore, or stone under it, and its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. On a hit against an unattended object, the object takes the damage only. The damage becomes 2d8 at Foundation Realm, 3d8 at Core Formation Realm, and 4d8 at Nascent Soul Realm. The Speed reduction from Source Pulse does not stack with itself. Source Pulse cannot target a creature that is not touching an eligible mineral surface unless another talent, variant, item, or GM ruling says otherwise. Source Pulse does not damage the ground, create difficult terrain, open seals, or break objects beyond its listed damage unless a talent says it does. ### Source Seal Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action Range: Touch Target: One unattended mineral object no larger than a 5-foot cube, one closed mineral container, one closed stone or metal door, one visible seal on a mineral object, or one 5-foot section of mineral surface Duration: 1 minute Cost: 0 You place a faint source seal on the target. The seal is visible as dust-light, pressure lines, mineral frost, dull jade script, or another obvious Source mark unless a talent says otherwise. Choose one basic effect: - **Warning Seal.** If the target is opened, broken, moved, or spiritually disturbed while you are within 60 feet, you know that the seal was disturbed. - **Stillness Seal.** The target has Advantage on the next saving throw or check it makes before the seal ends to avoid cracking, discharging, collapsing, or releasing stored pressure. If the target does not normally make such a roll, this has no effect. - **Reading Seal.** The next Source Reading check you make against the target before the seal ends has Advantage. - **Fetter Seal.** This option can be placed only on a 5-foot section of mineral surface. The first time a creature of your choice enters that section or starts its turn there before the seal ends, you may end the seal. If you do, that creature's Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of that turn. Source Seal does not lock the target, prevent movement except through Fetter Seal, restrain a creature, suppress a magic item, dispel a talisman, overwrite a Formation, prevent teleportation, or create a permanent mark. Talents create stronger seals by modifying or replacing this basic effect. You can maintain a number of active Source Seals equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If you create another Source Seal beyond this limit, choose one existing Source Seal you created to end. ### Source Seals and Other Sealing Systems A source seal is short-lived condensed vein qi. It is not a Formation, not a Talisman, not an oath seal, not a soul contract, and not a permanent prison. A Source talent cannot seal a creature, worn or carried item, active magic item, active Formation, active Talisman, teleportation effect, Domain, artifact, or living soul unless that talent explicitly names the target and gives a duration. If more than one Source seal from the same talent would apply to the same target, only the strongest or most recent one applies unless a talent says otherwise. ### Source Talent Tags **Reading.** Improves Source Reading, appraisal, detection, or geomantic interpretation. **Vein.** Uses earth-pulses, dragon-veins, quarry lines, source lines, or mineral surfaces. **Stone.** Works on stone, ore, jade, crystal, brick, tile, metal-rich earth, or similar mineral material. **Guard.** Reduces damage, grants Temporary Hit Points, protects against hazards, or stabilizes an ally. **Pulse.** Modifies Source Pulse or other short source attacks. **Seal.** Reads, places, strengthens, stabilizes, resists, suppresses, or briefly interferes with source seals without replacing Formations, Talismans, oath magic, soul contracts, or permanent prisons. **Travel.** Helps movement, navigation, mines, caves, ruins, difficult mineral terrain, or vein-following. **Projected.** Creates an effect away from the user's body, touch, held object, or immediate surface. Body Refiners need explicit permission to use Projected Source effects. **Secret.** Requires GM permission, sect inheritance, scripture access, family lineage, rare teacher, or campaign reward. **Forbidden.** Requires explicit GM permission and carries corruption, social, karmic, sect, land, corpse, prison, or tribulation consequences. ## Path Expression **Body Refining — Source as Stone-Bone Pressure.** Body Refiners feel Source through bones, teeth, soles, scars, armor weight, breath, stance, impact, and the body’s contact with ground. They favor mine survival, grounding, impact reduction, touch seals, short pulses through fists or feet, and body-bound source tokens. **Qi Cultivation — Source as Pattern and Circuit.** Qi Cultivators read buried qi as a technical pattern. They favor appraisal, vein direction, seal analysis, projected source seals, pulse control, and careful dragon-vein borrowing. **Spirit Awakening — Source as Memory and Omen.** Spirit Awakeners hear what places remember. They favor ancestral mines, sealed beings, old battlefields, prison-stones, tomb warnings, source spirits, and the moral pressure of opening what was buried. ## Base Sphere Abilities ### Source Training Action Type: Passive Canonical Action Type: Passive Factory Combat Bucket: passive Factory Routing: passive_or_modifier Range: Self Target: Self Cost: 0 When you gain the Source sphere, choose one Source talent and gain it for free. You also gain Source Reading, Source Pulse, and Source Seal. ### Source Reading Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_exploration_procedure Timing Detail: Action in encounter time; the 10-minute use routes to the procedure ledger instead of an ordinary combat action row. Range: Touch, or examined area as described Target: One unattended mineral object, one visible seal on a mineral object or mineral surface, one mineral surface, or one examined mineral feature Cost: 0 Use the Source Reading rules above. ### Source Pulse Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action Range: 60 feet Target: One creature touching a mineral surface, or one unattended mineral object Cost: 0 Use the Source Pulse rules above. ### Source Seal Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action Range: Touch Target: One unattended mineral object, mineral container, mineral door, visible seal on a mineral object or mineral surface, or 5-foot section of mineral surface Duration: 1 minute Cost: 0 Use the Source Seal rules above. ## Mortal Realm Source Talents ### Prospector's Eye Tags: Reading, Stone You have Advantage on Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Survival) checks made to notice source signs, mineral seams, unstable stone, recent digging, worked stone, quarry marks, hidden mine supports, or spiritually active ore. This talent does not reveal a hidden object automatically. ### Source Appraiser Tags: Reading, Stone When you spend at least 1 minute examining an unattended stone, gem, ore sample, jade piece, source crystal, spirit-stone, or similar mineral object, you may make a Source check against a DC set by the GM. This talent still does not affect creatures, worn or carried items, artifacts, Domains, active Formations, talisman seals, oath seals, or soul seals unless the GM explicitly permits an opposed Cultivation Check for a specific scene. ## Source Traditions These traditions are mainly descriptive.
