spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Sword Qi Expression: Primary — Sword Qi; Supporting — Metal Qi, Severance Qi, Decision Qi, Clarity Qi. Sphere Type: Martial / Weapon-Intent Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening through Sword Qi, Flying Swords, Sword Heart, Sword Soul, or comparable explicit expressions Resource: Martial Focus for mundane sword doctrine; CP or Stamina only when a talent, Path expression, or forged technique says so Core Chassis: Sword in Hand, Sword Beyond Hand, Sword Intent, Sword Qi, Flying Swords, Sword Heart, Sword Soul Sword cultivates decision sharpened into edge. Its basic loop is to choose Sword in Hand or Sword Beyond Hand, apply Sword Intent, and develop Sword Qi, Flying Swords, Sword Heart, Sword Soul, and severing techniques. ### Rules Baseline This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Concentration, Cover, difficult terrain, Hide, Invisible, Bloodied, Exhaustion, and Damage Threshold unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### Barriers, Domains, and Formation Anchors A Barrier is a temporary supernatural barrier, including a Protection-sphere Barrier or another effect that explicitly identifies itself as a Barrier. A Domain is a high-rank cultivation effect that says it is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove a Domain unless the technique explicitly says otherwise. A Formation Anchor is an anchor point explicitly created by a Formation or identified by the GM as part of a Formation project. These spheres do not create Formation Anchors automatically. ### Core Sword Rules #### 2024 Sword Weapons and Weapon Mastery Approved Sword weapons retain their normal 2024 weapon properties and Mastery properties. | Weapon | 2024 Weapon Properties | Mastery | | --- | --- | --- | | Shortsword | Finesse, Light | Vex | | Longsword | Versatile (1d10) | Sap | | Greatsword | Heavy, Two-Handed | Graze | A weapon’s Mastery property functions only when a feature grants access to Weapon Mastery with that weapon. #### Path Expression and Talent Costs When a Sword talent lists multiple possible costs, pay exactly one legal cost unless it explicitly says otherwise. Spend CP when using Qi or Resonance to fuel the technique. Spend Stamina only when a Body Refining feature permits that expression. Expend Martial Focus only when the talent lists that option. #### Special Attacks When a Sword talent says it is a Special Attack, replace one attack when you take the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different Action Type. #### Disarm Effects A Disarm effect is any effect that forces a creature to drop a held weapon, lose control of it, or have it removed from its grasp. The 2024 core rules do not define a universal Disarm action. #### Sword Weapons The default Sword weapons are: shortsword; longsword; greatsword. The GM may approve other clearly sword-like weapons, including setting-appropriate jian, dao, saber, curved sword, or artifact-blade profiles. A talent that requires a Sword works only with an approved Sword weapon unless it explicitly creates a Sword-Qi blade. #### Sword Intent Some Sword talents apply Sword Intent. Unless a talent says otherwise: Sword Intent lasts until the start of your next turn; Sword Intent is not a tracking mark; Sword Intent does not reveal location; Sword Intent does not pierce concealment; Sword Intent does not provide exact-square knowledge; Sword Intent does not transfer automatically between creatures; one creature may bear only one instance of your Sword Intent at a time. Sword Intent represents pressure, disrupted confidence, exposed rhythm, and the sense that your next cut has already begun. #### Sword Heart Some talents require Heart of the Sword. Sword Heart is not a separate resource. It represents internal clarity developed through the Heart of the Sword talent. A cultivator with Sword Heart may still be frightened, deceived, or defeated. Sword Heart means that the sword path remains internally their own. #### Flying Sword A Flying Sword is a temporary Sword-Qi construct, levitating weapon, or spiritually controlled blade created through a Sword talent. Unless a talent says otherwise: a Flying Sword is a magical object; it is not a creature; it cannot independently improvise; it follows the controlling talent’s Action economy; it cannot move beyond the listed control range; it disappears or falls inert when the effect ends; a destroyed Flying Sword does not destroy a permanent physical sword used as its focus. ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Sword Training When you learn Sword: gain proficiency with shortswords, longswords, and greatswords; if already proficient with all three, gain +2 to attack rolls made with approved Sword weapons. This bonus does not stack with another Sword-sphere feature granting the same benefit. #### Sword Practice When you learn Sword, choose one Practice. Sword in Hand - martial expression. Sword Beyond Hand - projected Sword-Qi expression. You may gain the other Practice through Dual Practice. ##### Body Refining Restriction A Body Refiner may always choose Sword in Hand. A Body Refiner may learn Sword Beyond Hand only through: Sword-Body Adept; Swordless Sword; an appropriate inheritance; a Forged Technique; another explicit feature. When a Body Refiner gains projected Sword techniques this way, use Stamina instead of CP. #### Sword in Hand - Sword Intent Strike Classification: Martial Sword Technique Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Range: Sword reach Cost: None Replace one attack with one Sword weapon attack. Hit: Deal normal weapon damage plus: 1d8 Slashing or Force damage Apply Sword Intent until the start of your next turn. Choose the damage type when making the attack. #### Sword Beyond Hand - Sword Qi Wave Classification: Projected Sword-Qi Technique Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: None Release a crescent wave of Sword Qi. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal Slashing or Force damage and apply Sword Intent until the start of your next turn. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 1d10 | | 5-10 | 2d10 | | 11-16 | 3d10 | | 17-20 | 4d10 | Choose the damage type when making the attack. ### Sword Talent Tags #### Hand Talents A Hand talent modifies a wielded Sword, Sword Intent Strike, draw technique, parry, stance, or close-range sword attack. #### Sword-Qi Talents A Sword-Qi talent projects the edge beyond the hand. #### Flying-Sword Talents A Flying-Sword talent creates, commands, modifies, or evolves Flying Swords. #### Sword-Heart Talents A Sword-Heart talent requires Heart of the Sword and represents inner clarity, identity, and a more complete understanding of the blade. #### Severing Talents A Severing talent disrupts healing, meridians, barriers, bonds, or fate. #### Domain Talents A Domain talent creates an area in which Sword Intent becomes environmental law. #### Unique Sword Talents A Unique Sword Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another category. ### MORTAL REALM SWORD TALENTS #### Dual Practice Gain the Sword Practice you did not choose when learning the sphere. A Body Refiner must still satisfy the restriction for Sword Beyond Hand. #### Flowing Water Slash - Hand Trigger: You hit a creature with a Sword attack Use Limit: Once per turn Choose one: move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target; move around the target into one adjacent legal space; gain +1 AC against the target until the start of your next turn; if the target bears your Sword Intent, reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn. #### Sword Drawing Stance - Hand Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Until the start of your next turn Sheathe, lower, or still your Sword and prepare one decisive draw. Before the duration ends, when you draw or strike with the Sword: gain Advantage on one Sword attack roll; add Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll; apply Sword Intent on a hit. After the attack resolves, the stance ends. A Sword-Qi blade may be dismissed and reformed as part of this stance when a feature permits it. #### Sword Guard - Hand Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or one adjacent ally takes damage from a creature within your Sword reach Cost: Expend Martial Focus, 1 CP, or 1 Stamina Reduce the triggering damage: 1d8 + Path key ability modifier If the attacker bears your Sword Intent, add: +Proficiency Bonus Sword Guard competes with other Reactions normally. #### Returning Sword - Flying-Sword When a Flying Sword, thrown Sword, or Sword-Qi blade you control ends its movement: return it to your hand without spending an Action; or leave it hovering in one legal space within 30 feet. A hovering Sword created through this talent grants no attack or defensive benefit by itself. #### Flying Sword Technique - Flying-Sword, Sword-Qi Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP Create one Flying Sword in one visible unoccupied space. You may use: a physical Sword as a harmless focus; a Sword-Qi blade; a spiritually manifested sword image. ##### Flying Sword | Statistic | Value | | --- | --- | | AC | 15 | | HP | 20 | | Speed | Fly 40 feet and Hover | | Control Range | 60 feet | As a Bonus Action on later turns, command the Flying Sword to move up to its Speed and make one attack. ##### Flying Sword Strike Attack: Your Cultivation Attack Modifier Damage: 1d8 + Path key ability modifier Slashing or Force damage On a hit, apply Sword Intent until the start of your next turn. If destroyed or moved beyond control range, the Flying Sword disappears. #### Edge Against Edge - Hand While wielding a Sword, when a creature bearing your Sword Intent makes a melee attack against you: gain +1 AC against that attack; if the attack misses, move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature. Use Edge Against Edge once per round. #### Sword-Qi Infusion - Sword-Qi Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 1 CP Infuse one wielded Sword with projected edge. Once per turn when the Sword hits: add 1d6 Slashing or Force damage; the weapon counts as magical when a rule distinguishes magical and nonmagical attacks; apply Sword Intent. At CL 11, increase the extra damage to 2d6. At CL 17, increase it to 3d6. ### FOUNDATION REALM SWORD TALENTS #### Heart of the Sword - Sword-Heart Prerequisite: CL 5+ Form a stable Sword Heart. While wielding a Sword, controlling a Flying Sword, or maintaining a Sword-Qi blade: gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened; gain Advantage on checks made to resist being Disarmed; recognize whether your own Sword Intent is being suppressed, imitated, or spiritually distorted; once per round when a creature bearing your Sword Intent misses you, move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature. Heart of the Sword is a prerequisite for advanced Sword-Heart talents. #### Meridian-Cutting Strike - Hand, Severing Prerequisite: CL 5+ Trigger: You hit a creature bearing your Sword Intent with a Sword weapon attack Cost: 3 CP, 3 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per creature per short rest Choose one recognizable anatomical structure. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Apply the corresponding hindrance. | Targeted Structure | Hindrance | | --- | --- | | Arm | Disadvantage on attacks made with that arm; cannot effectively use a two-handed weapon | | Leg | Speed reduced by 10 feet; Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws | | Wing | Lose ordinary flight dependent on that wing | | Tail or similar appendage | Lose attacks or movement features primarily dependent on that appendage | Successful Save: Reduce Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn. The hindrance ends when the target: completes a short or long rest; or receives sufficient restorative healing. Creatures without recognizable anatomy are immune. Meridian-Cutting Strike is not a default dismemberment rule. #### Life-Severing Sword - Severing Prerequisite: CL 5+ Trigger: You deal Sword damage to a creature Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina Use Limit: Once per turn Until the start of your next turn: reduce healing received by the target by your Proficiency Bonus; the target cannot gain Temporary HP. If the target bears your Sword Intent, choose one additional effect: halve healing received instead; impose Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw; prevent ordinary regeneration until the start of your next turn. #### Iron Sword Body - Hand Prerequisite: Body Refining, CL 5+ While wielding a Sword: use Constitution for Sword attack and damage rolls if higher; use Constitution as your Sword key ability; spend Stamina instead of CP on Sword talents; gain +1 AC; gain Advantage on saving throws against forced Disarm effects. Iron Sword Body does not grant Sword Beyond Hand by itself. #### Sword-Qi Step - Sword-Qi Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina Move to one visible unoccupied space. This movement: does not provoke opportunity attacks; may cross occupied spaces; cannot cross sealed barriers; cannot cross a Dimensional Lock; is rapid sword-guided movement, not general Space control. If you end adjacent to a creature bearing your Sword Intent, gain Advantage on your next Sword attack against it before the end of the turn. #### Thousand Sword Formation - Flying-Sword Prerequisite: Flying Sword Technique, CL 7+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Create Flying Swords equal to: 1 + half Proficiency Bonus, rounded down Maximum: 4 Flying Swords Each uses the Flying Sword Technique statistics. As a Bonus Action: command up to two Flying Swords to move; each commanded Sword makes one attack. A creature may take damage from no more than two of your Flying Sword attacks during one turn. While at least one Flying Sword remains uncommanded, gain: +1 AC Thousand Sword Formation replaces an ordinary Flying Sword Technique while active. #### Sword-Rain Descent - Flying-Sword Prerequisite: Flying Sword Technique, CL 7+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Cost: 4 CP Sword Qi rains into the area. Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take Slashing or Force damage and gain your Sword Intent. Successful Save: Take half damage. | Cultivation Level | Damage | | --- | --- | | 7-10 | 4d6 | | 11-16 | 6d6 | | 17-20 | 8d6 | ### CORE FORMATION REALM SWORD TALENTS #### Sword Pressure - Domain “The sword remained sheathed. Failed Save: Choose one: become Frightened of you until the start of its next turn; reduce Speed by 10 feet until the start of its next turn; cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; suffer Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the start of its next turn; gain your Sword Intent. Successful Save: Gain your Sword Intent. Until the start of your next turn, its Resistance to Slashing damage does not apply to your Sword talents. #### Sword Prison - Domain, Flying-Sword Prerequisite: Thousand Sword Formation, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 6 CP Choose one creature. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Speed becomes 0; cannot take Reactions; takes 2d8 Slashing or Force damage at the start of each turn; repeats the saving throw at the end of each turn, ending the effect on a success. Successful Save: Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. Whenever the target takes damage from a creature other than you or your Flying Swords, it repeats the saving throw with Advantage. Sword Prison creates a visible ring of controlled blades. It does not automatically restrain creatures without a meaningful physical position. #### Sword Intent Manifestation - Domain, Sword-Heart “At first, the cultivator held a sword. Later, the world remembered that anything could become an edge.” Prerequisite: Sword Pressure, Heart of the Sword, CL 12+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 8 CP or 8 Stamina Manifest your Sword Intent as visible or invisible edge-lines throughout the area. When a hostile creature misses an ally with a melee attack, it takes Slashing or Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ##### Silent Killing Line Your Sword attacks and Sword-Qi attacks score a critical hit on: 19-20 against creatures bearing your Sword Intent. For the duration: gain Fly Speed 40 feet and Hover; gain Resistance to Slashing, Force, and Psychic damage; Sword Intent Strike extra damage becomes 4d10; Sword Qi Wave damage becomes 6d10; Sword Intent lasts until the end of your next turn; once per turn after applying Sword Intent, move 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks; once per turn when a creature bearing your Sword Intent misses you, make one Sword attack or Sword Qi Wave as a Reaction; ordinary disarming effects fail against you. #### One Sword, Ten Thousand Cuts Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Sword reach or 90 feet through Sword Qi Cost: 12 CP or 12 Stamina Use Limit: Once per long rest Choose one creature bearing your Sword Intent. Failed Save: Choose three: become Stunned until the end of your next turn; cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn; Speed becomes 0 until the end of your next turn; cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn; end one ordinary ongoing supernatural effect affecting it; suppress one temporary Barrier, summon, or regeneration effect until the end of your next turn; apply Meridian-Cutting Strike without spending its cost. Successful Save: Choose one. ##### Object, Barrier, or Effect Make one Cultivation Check against a GM-set DC. On a success, choose one: cut open one major breach; dispel one ordinary ongoing effect; sever one temporary supernatural tether; destroy one temporary Barrier; disable one Formation Anchor until repaired. Severing Fate does not automatically destroy: artifacts; Formation cores; Domains; Secret Inheritances; Realm-defining structures; permanent karmic bonds; major narrative destinies. Those may still be contested or meaningfully damaged according to the GM. ### OPTIONAL SWORD CULTIVATION VARIANTS A Sword variant changes what the cultivator believes a sword must become. These variants are mutually exclusive unless a feature says otherwise. #### Single Sword Scripture “Ten thousand swords are distractions. One sword understood completely is enough.” You may maintain only one Flying Sword at a time. You cannot learn Thousand Sword Formation or Myriad Sword Procession. ##### Benefits gain Heart of the Sword as a bonus talent at CL 5; choose one physical Sword as your bonded Sword focus; while wielding that Sword, gain Advantage on checks against Disarm; once per turn when that Sword hits a creature bearing your Sword Intent, add Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll; repair ordinary damage to the bonded Sword during a short rest. #### Swordless Sword “The sword was never the steel. A formation is a language.” You cannot use Sword Drawing Stance. ##### Benefits gain Flying Sword Technique as a bonus talent; increase Flying Sword control range by 30 feet; when commanding a Flying Sword, move one uncommanded Flying Sword 10 feet without spending an Action; reduce Thousand Sword Formation cost by 1 CP, minimum 1. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Body Refining - Iron Sword Body Use Constitution as your Sword key ability for Hand talents. When wielding an approved Sword: use Constitution for Sword attack and damage rolls if higher; spend Stamina instead of CP for Sword talents you are permitted to learn; reduce forced Disarm effects against you by one degree where possible; when Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, apply Sword Intent to one creature within Sword reach. Sword Beyond Hand still requires Sword-Body Adept, Swordless Sword, an inheritance, or another explicit feature. #### Qi Cultivation - Ten-Thousand Sword Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Sword key ability. Once per turn: reduce the CP cost of one Sword-Qi or Flying-Sword talent by 1, minimum 1; or increase one Sword-Qi range by 30 feet. When commanding Flying Swords, move one of them 10 additional feet. #### Spirit Awakening - Sword-Soul Resonance Use Wisdom as your Sword key ability. Your Sword talents affect: spirits; ghosts; incorporeal creatures; possessing entities; soul-bound creatures normally. When using Heart of the Sword: gain Advantage on saving throws against possession; perceive whether a visible spiritual entity bears your Sword Intent; Sword Soul may communicate through clearer symbolic impressions. Once per round when one spirit-bearing creature fails a saving throw against your Sword talent, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Sword-Body Adept Prerequisite: Body Refining, Sword sphere, CL 4+ Your body and blade circulate as one scripture. Gain: access to Sword Beyond Hand using Stamina; use Constitution for Sword attack and damage rolls if higher; use Constitution as your Sword key ability; gain Advantage on one saving throw against Disarm per short rest. #### Unclouded Sword Heart Prerequisite: Heart of the Sword, CL 8+ Once per short rest, when you fail a saving throw against Charmed, Frightened, Illusion, or hostile mental control: reroll the saving throw; use the new result. While wielding a Sword, gain Advantage on checks made to recognize false Sword Intent, counterfeit Sword Souls, and illusionary blades. #### Flying-Sword Adept Prerequisite: Flying Sword Technique, CL 8+ Gain: increase Flying Sword Speed by 20 feet; increase control range by 30 feet; when a Flying Sword applies Sword Intent, move it 5 feet without spending an Action; repair one destroyed temporary Flying Sword by spending a Bonus Action and 1 CP. #### Sword-Formation Adept Prerequisite: Thousand Sword Formation, CL 8+ When using Thousand Sword Formation: create one additional Flying Sword, still respecting the maximum of 4; command one additional Sword to move without attacking; increase the AC bonus from uncommanded swords to +2 while at least two remain uncommanded. #### Sword-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Sword sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation, artifact, sword court, or training project, use one Sword Intent, Sword-Qi, Flying-Sword, Sword-Heart, or Domain principle as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. Normal project requirements still apply. suitable swords or focuses; anchors; materials; spiritual power; maintenance; Formation-specific vulnerabilities.

This temporary talisman cannot be reusable, permanent, sold as stable goods, or used as a project component. It is visibly crude unless you have a talent that hides or refines it.
You may use Emergency Stroke a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest. Additional uses cost 2 CP each.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Talismans Qi Expression: Primary — Stored-Command Qi; Supporting — Ink Qi, Fire-Trigger Qi, Pattern Qi, Law Qi. “The brush moves. The Qi remembers. Heaven is not persuaded by ink; Heaven is persuaded by the line that survives being written.” Common Name: Talismans Sphere Sphere Type: Restricted Power Sphere; Crafting, Sealing, and Stored-Technique Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Rare Variant: Body Refining through Talisman Body, skin inscriptions, armor seals, and physical mediaPrimary Resource: CP, materials, formulae, time, prepared talisman slots Common Effects: Stored techniques, seals, wards, thrown talismans, triggered scripts, emergency reactions, talisman arrays, reusable jade slips, spirit-written talismans, body talismans, formula libraries, seal-breaking, strategic wards, sect infrastructure ### Talisman Dao Talismans are the cultivation of Qi given written obedience. A spell is breathed and gone. A sword technique lives in the hand that knows it. A formation commands a place. A talisman is different. It is a command prepared before the crisis, folded into paper, silk, bone, jade, metal, skin, armor, or empty air for one later moment of authority. The talisman cultivator asks: what may be written so clearly that Qi obeys even when the writer is not present? The recurring verb is Inscribe. ### Rules Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline unless a Talisman rule says otherwise. #### Magic Action and Use an Object Activating a talisman is not automatically the same as casting a spell. A formula states whether activation uses an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, no action trigger, or longer ritual. If a feature asks for a mundane object interaction, the ordinary rules apply. If a feature activates a supernatural talisman, use the action type listed by the formula or talent. #### Objects, Cover, and Targeting A talisman is normally a Tiny object unless its medium says otherwise. It can be attacked, stolen, burned, soaked, dispelled, suppressed, or destroyed if a rule allows the targeting method. A talisman behind Total Cover cannot normally be targeted directly. A visible talisman on a creature, door, coffin, weapon, armor, wall, flag, or floor may be targeted like an attended or unattended object as the GM judges. #### Reactions A talisman with Reaction activation uses the activator’s Reaction unless the formula says the talisman itself triggers without using a creature’s Reaction. A prepared trigger can activate even when the writer is not present, but only if the trigger and formula were legally prepared. #### Concentration A talisman formula requiring Concentration states who concentrates: the activator; the talisman itself; the original writer through a maintained resonance; no one, if the formula says it is self-sustaining. A self-sustaining talisman is usually more expensive, higher rank, shorter duration, or consumed on use. #### Saving Throws and Attack Rolls Talismans use the stored statistics recorded when they were completed unless a formula says the activator substitutes their own. A creature activating another cultivator’s talisman uses the stored Cultivation Save DC and Cultivation Attack Modifier. #### Tools Calligrapher’s Supplies, Alchemist’s Supplies, Jeweler’s Tools, Woodcarver’s Tools, Smith’s Tools, or another appropriate proficiency may help with a Talisman Crafting Check if the medium and formula fit. The base Talisman sphere grants Calligrapher’s Supplies proficiency if you lack it. #### Consumables and Treasure Talismans are built as sphere mechanics, not default shop inventory. The GM decides what formulae, materials, and markets exist. A campaign may make talisman paper common but jade slips rare, or may make all talisman formulae sect-restricted. ### Core Talisman Rules #### Formula A Formula is the written pattern that determines what a talisman can do. Each formula has: a rank; a family; a crafting DC; a minimum CL or talent prerequisite; a medium requirement, if any; an activation method; a target, range, area, duration, and cost; whether it is consumed, cracked, reusable, or permanent. Learning a formula does not automatically create talismans. It gives you permission to craft that formula when you have the materials, time, CP, and required talents. #### Formula Rank Talismans use the following rank bands. Common: CL 1+, crafting DC 12, typical material cost 25 gp, typical time 1 hour. Uncommon: CL 5+, crafting DC 15, typical material cost 100 gp, typical time 4 hours. Rare: CL 10+, crafting DC 18, typical material cost 500 gp, typical time 24 hours. Very Rare: CL 15+, crafting DC 22, typical material cost 2,500 gp, typical time 7 days. Legendary: CL 17+, crafting DC 26 or higher, typical material cost 10,000 gp plus a Heavenly Material, typical time 30 days. Secret: special requirement, special material, special time, and usually campaign permission. These are default values. A sect formula, inherited scripture, unstable copy, battlefield improvisation, rare ink, or superior medium can change the exact cost, time, or DC. #### Formula Family Each formula belongs to one or more families. Restoration: healing, stabilizing, purging minor harms. Attack: elemental strikes, force bursts, cutting scripts, curse tags. Shielding: AC, saving throws, barriers, damage reduction. Movement: falling, flight bursts, water-walking, swift steps, retrieval. Binding: restraints, demon tags, ghost locks, corpse seals, oath bindings. Detection: reveal, alarm, tracking, identification, hidden-script reading. Purification: poison, disease, curse, corruption, ghost miasma, undead taint. Communication: message slips, sound seals, sect tokens, recall tags. Formation: anchors, Nodes, Gate keys, array stabilizers. Sealing: suppression, closure, containment, sealed doors, sealed techniques. Talents may improve a family rather than a single formula. #### Talisman Medium A Medium is the physical thing that carries the formula. Common media include: Paper Talisman: cheapest, fastest, single use, vulnerable to water and fire unless treated. Silk Strip: more durable, flexible, water-resistant, good for body, weapon, and garment attachment. Wood Slip: durable, easy to carry, good for utility and travel formulae. Bone Slip: durable, throwable, suitable for ghost, death, beast, body, and ancestral formulae. Jade Slip: expensive, reusable, may recharge at dawn or during cultivation, suitable for refined formulae. Metal Plaque: slow to craft, strong, suitable for doors, vaults, gates, armor, structures, and Formation anchors. Ink Mark: temporary mark on a surface or object, fast but fragile. Skin Inscription: written on a living body; requires Talisman Body or a formula that explicitly permits it. Air-Written Seal: temporary Qi script drawn without a stable medium; usually requires a talent and fades quickly. #### Talisman Crafting Check When you craft a talisman, make a Talisman Crafting Check. Check: d20 + Proficiency Bonus + Intelligence modifier You may add one appropriate tool proficiency if the GM agrees the tool is central to the medium and you are proficient with it. If a Path synergy replaces Intelligence with another ability, use that ability instead. Before rolling, you may spend CP up to your Proficiency Bonus. Each CP spent this way adds +1 to the check. #### Crafting Procedure Use this procedure whenever a character crafts a normal talisman. Choose a Formula. You must know the formula and meet its prerequisites. Choose a Medium. The medium must be legal for the formula. Choose Activation. Use the formula’s listed activation or a legal Triggered Talisman option. Pay Materials. Spend the material cost and any special components. Spend Time. Complete the required crafting time without major interruption. Commit CP. Spend any CP required by the formula, medium, or talent. Make the Talisman Crafting Check. Compare to the formula DC. Record Stored Statistics. Record the relevant numbers when crafting succeeds. Prepare or Store. Add the talisman to your prepared talismans or store it for later retrieval. #### Crafting Results Success: Create the talisman. Success by 5 or more: Choose one permitted refinement: +1 to the stored Cultivation Save DC; +1 to the stored Cultivation Attack Modifier; add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage or healing roll; increase range by 50 percent; increase duration by 50 percent; make the talisman harder to detect; improve the trigger within GM-approved limits; reduce activation noise, glow, or obviousness. Failure by 5 or less: Create a Cracked Talisman. When activated, roll 1d6. On 1-2, it fails and is consumed. On 3-6, it functions normally but is consumed. Failure by more than 5: Materials are lost and no talisman is created. Natural 1: Materials are lost, and the crafter suffers backlash. Take Force or Psychic damage equal to 2d6 per formula rank band: Common 2d6, Uncommon 4d6, Rare 6d6, Very Rare 8d6, Legendary 10d6. Secret formula backlash is special. #### Stored Statistics When a talisman is completed, record: formula name; formula rank and family; crafter name; Cultivation Level at crafting; Cultivation Save DC; Cultivation Attack Modifier; damage or healing dice; range; area; duration; activation method; medium; charges; whether it is consumed, cracked, reusable, permanent, or secret; any refinements from success by 5 or more. A creature activating the talisman uses these stored values unless the formula says otherwise. #### Prepared Talisman Limit You may carry many talismans, but only a limited number are immediately prepared for combat use. Your Prepared Talisman Limit equals your Proficiency Bonus + Intelligence modifier, minimum 1. Prepared talismans are placed in sleeves, belt slots, talisman cases, hairpins, robe seams, armor strips, weapon wraps, skin marks, pouch positions, or other ready locations. Retrieving and readying an unprepared talisman requires an Action unless a talent says otherwise. #### Reusable Jade Limit Most talismans are consumed when activated. Reusable jade talismans require the Reusable Talisman talent or another explicit feature. You may maintain a number of reusable jade talismans equal to your Proficiency Bonus unless a talent increases this limit. A reusable talisman usually has one charge and regains one charge at dawn or after a cultivation session, as the formula states. #### Activation Methods A talisman can use one or more of the following activation methods if its formula allows it. Held Activation: you hold the talisman and activate it with the listed action. Applied Activation: you place the talisman onto a creature, object, door, corpse, weapon, armor, wall, or surface. Thrown Activation: you throw the talisman at a target or space. Unless a formula states otherwise, range is 20/60 feet. Attached Activation: the talisman is affixed ahead of time and activates from its attached place. Triggered Activation: the talisman activates when a visible, specific, legal trigger occurs. Spoken Activation: the talisman requires a command word, mantra, name, or sect phrase. Blood Activation: the talisman requires blood, breath, touch, or a similar personal mark. Formation Activation: the talisman activates as part of a Formation, Talisman Array, or site seal. #### Legal Triggers A Triggered Talisman must have a specific, observable trigger. Examples: a door opens; a creature crosses a line; a named creature touches the seal; a password is spoken; blood touches the talisman; nearby fire appears; a hostile creature attacks the attached object; undead or ghostly Qi enters the marked space; a creature removes a warded object; a Formation Node is attacked. A trigger cannot read private thoughts, predict the future perfectly, identify a secret identity with no clue, or make complex tactical choices unless the formula specifically grants such intelligence. #### Talisman Visibility and Concealment Most talismans are visible once inspected. Concealing one requires ordinary concealment, disguise, Sleight of Hand, illusion, hidden ink, coded script, or a talent. A creature can try to detect a hidden talisman with Wisdom (Perception), Intelligence (Investigation), or a relevant supernatural sense. A creature can identify a visible talisman with an Intelligence check using Arcana, Religion, Calligrapher’s Supplies, or another relevant proficiency. #### Disabling Talismans A creature that can reach a talisman can attempt to disable it as an Action. The default DC equals your Talisman Save DC. The GM may allow Dexterity with Thieves’ Tools, Intelligence with Arcana, Intelligence with Calligrapher’s Supplies, a Qiweaving Check, a Formations Check, or another appropriate method. Failure by 5 or more may trigger the talisman or cause backlash if the formula says so. #### Talisman Save DC and Attack Modifier Unless another feature replaces the ability, use Intelligence. Talisman Save DC: 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Intelligence modifier Talisman Attack Modifier: Proficiency Bonus + Intelligence modifier ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Talisman Scribe When you gain the Talismans sphere, you gain proficiency with Calligrapher’s Supplies. If you already have this proficiency, gain one additional Common formula. You learn three Common formulae of your choice. You may craft Common talismans using the Talisman Crafting procedure. You can identify your own talismans automatically. You have Advantage on checks to identify a talisman formula you personally know. #### Emergency Stroke Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: 1 CP Requirement: free hand, brush, ink, blood, chalk, or another visible writing method Duration: 1 hour or until activated You quickly draw a temporary Common talisman you know onto paper, cloth, skin, weapon wrap, wall, floor, shield, armor, or another legal surface. This temporary talisman cannot be reusable, permanent, sold as stable goods, or used as a project component. It is visibly crude unless you have a talent that hides or refines it. You may use Emergency Stroke a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest. Additional uses cost 2 CP each. #### Read the Script Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Target: one visible talisman, seal, inscription, ward tag, formula page, or written Qi mark Make an Intelligence check using Arcana, Investigation, Calligrapher’s Supplies, or another relevant proficiency. On a success, learn one: formula family; approximate rank; activation method; whether it is cracked, unstable, reusable, or permanent; whether it is connected to a Formation, corpse, spirit, door, object, or creature; whether it is safe to touch. Success by 5 or more reveals an additional fact. Read the Script does not reveal secret formulae, hidden command words, full project schematics, or the identity of the crafter unless the evidence is present. ### Talisman Talent Tags #### Formula Talents Formula talents teach new talisman formulae or families. #### Script Talents Script talents change how you write, conceal, stabilize, read, or disable talismans. #### Medium Talents Medium talents unlock silk strips, bone slips, jade slips, metal plaques, skin inscriptions, air-written seals, or other media. #### Trigger Talents Trigger talents improve attached, delayed, conditional, or remote activation. #### Array Talents Array talents arrange multiple talismans into compact talisman arrays. They may interact with Formations but do not replace Formations. #### Seal Talents Seal talents bind, suppress, lock, close, restrain, or contain. #### Spirit Talents Spirit talents animate, awaken, command, or communicate through talismans. #### Realm Evolution Talents Realm Evolution talents define how talisman cultivation changes at higher Realms. ### Mortal Realm Talents #### Healing Talisman - Formula You learn the Healing Talisman formula. Rank: Common Family: Restoration Activation: Bonus Action Range: Touch Target: one creature Consumed: yes The target regains 1d8 + your Intelligence modifier hit points. At CL 5, healing increases to 2d8 + Intelligence modifier. At CL 11, 3d8 + Intelligence modifier. At CL 17, 4d8 + Intelligence modifier. #### Ember Talisman - Formula You learn the Ember Talisman formula. Rank: Common Family: Attack Activation: Action Range: 60 feet Target: one creature or object Consumed: yes Make a Talisman Attack. On a hit, the target takes Fire damage. Damage is 1d10 at CL 1, 2d10 at CL 5, 3d10 at CL 11, and 4d10 at CL 17. #### Shield Talisman - Formula You learn the Shield Talisman formula. Rank: Common Family: Shielding Activation: Reaction, triggered when the bearer is hit by an attack Range: Self or bearer Consumed: yes The bearer gains +3 AC against the triggering attack, possibly turning the hit into a miss. #### Featherfall Talisman - Formula You learn the Featherfall Talisman formula. Rank: Common Family: Movement Activation: Reaction, triggered when the bearer or a creature within 30 feet begins falling Range: 30 feet Consumed: yes The affected creature descends safely and takes no falling damage from the triggering fall. #### Warding Talisman - Formula You learn the Warding Talisman formula. Rank: Common Family: Shielding Activation: Action Range: Touch Duration: 1 hour Consumed: yes Choose Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma. The bearer gains +1 to saving throws using that ability for the duration. A creature can benefit from only one Warding Talisman at a time. #### Revealing Talisman - Formula You learn the Revealing Talisman formula. Rank: Common Family: Detection Activation: Action Range: Self Duration: 10 minutes Consumed: yes For the duration, you have Advantage on checks to notice visible talismans, written seals, hidden ink, obvious spiritual inscriptions, and attached ward tags within 30 feet. This does not reveal invisible creatures, secret identities, or hidden memories unless another feature says so. #### Purifying Talisman - Formula You learn the Purifying Talisman formula. Rank: Common Family: Purification Activation: Action Range: Touch Consumed: yes Choose one creature or object. End one minor poison, spoiled food/water impurity, common miasma stain, minor corpse odor, or similar low-grade contamination. At CL 5+, this formula can also grant Advantage on the target’s next saving throw against Poisoned or diseased before the end of your next turn. #### Message Talisman - Formula You learn the Message Talisman formula. Rank: Common Family: Communication Activation: Action Range: 1 mile Consumed: yes Send a short written or whispered message of no more than 25 words to a creature carrying a paired talisman you crafted. The recipient receives the message as ink appearing, a whispered voice, warmth in the sleeve, or another chosen sign. #### Rapid Talisman When crafting Common or Uncommon talismans, reduce the required time by half. If you rush a talisman this way during danger, increase the crafting DC by 2. #### Talisman Master’s Ink You can brew spiritual ink during a short or long rest if you have appropriate materials. While using your own spiritual ink: gain Advantage on checks to identify inks, damaged inscriptions, forged seals, and cracked talismans; reduce the material cost of Common talismans by 25 percent; once per long rest, reroll a Talisman Crafting Check for a Common talisman. #### Triggered Talisman When crafting a talisman, you may give it one legal visible trigger instead of requiring direct activation. The trigger must be simple, observable, and written into the formula. A triggered talisman remains prepared until activated, removed, disabled, destroyed, or until the formula’s maximum storage duration expires. #### Elemental Talisman Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, or Thunder when you craft a compatible Attack formula. The formula deals that damage type instead of its normal elemental damage. When you spend at least 1 CP while crafting the talisman, add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll the talisman makes. You may learn this talent multiple times, choosing a different damage type each time. #### Talisman Affinity Choose one formula family. When you craft a talisman from that family, choose one benefit: +1 to its stored Save DC; +1 to its stored Attack Modifier; add your Proficiency Bonus to one healing roll; reduce material cost by 20 percent; reduce crafting time by 20 percent. You may learn this talent multiple times, choosing a different formula family each time. #### Hidden Sleeve Preparation Increase your Prepared Talisman Limit by 2. In addition, once per turn you may draw or stow a prepared talisman without using your object interaction. #### Seal Breaker’s Eye You gain Advantage on Read the Script checks against Common and Uncommon talismans. If you identify a talisman’s trigger, you also learn one safe method of avoiding that trigger, if such a method exists. ### Foundation Realm Talents #### Advanced Talisman Crafting - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may craft Uncommon and Rare talismans. You may reverse engineer a Common or Uncommon talisman formula after 8 hours of study and a successful Talisman Crafting Check against the formula DC + 2. A failed reverse engineering attempt does not destroy the talisman unless you fail by 5 or more. #### Battle Stroke Scripture - Script Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP For the duration, you may use Emergency Stroke as a Bonus Action instead of an Action. A talisman drawn this way must be Common unless another talent permits a higher-rank emergency formula. #### Reusable Talisman - Medium Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may craft reusable jade talismans storing Common or Uncommon formulae. A reusable talisman has one charge and regains one charge at dawn or after the bearer completes a full cultivation session, as the formula states. Creating a reusable talisman increases material cost by x50 and adds +5 CP to the crafting cost. Reusable talismans count against your Reusable Jade Limit. #### Talisman Recall - Script Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: 1 CP Choose one talisman you crafted and can perceive, or whose resonance you can clearly sense. If unattended, it flies to your hand or a legal space within your reach. If held or worn by another creature, that creature makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, the talisman returns to you. On a success, it remains where it is. Artifacts, soul-bound talismans, and talismans integrated into a Formation may require an opposed Cultivation Check. #### Binding Talisman - Formula, Seal Prerequisite: CL 5+ You learn the Binding Talisman formula. Rank: Uncommon Family: Binding Activation: Action Range: 30 feet, or thrown 20/60 feet Target: one creature Consumed: yes The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: The target is Restrained for 1 minute. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Successful Save: The target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. #### Ghost-Warding Talisman - Formula, Seal Prerequisite: CL 5+ You learn the Ghost-Warding Talisman formula. Rank: Uncommon Family: Purification, Sealing Activation: Action or Triggered Range: Touch Duration: 1 hour Consumed: yes Attach the talisman to a door, coffin, corpse, shrine, weapon, room threshold, or willing creature. For the duration, incorporeal undead, ghostly projections, possessing spirits, and similar entities have Disadvantage on the first attack roll or ability check they make each turn against the warded target or across the warded threshold. A stronger spirit may force an opposed Cultivation Check to push through. #### Qi Storage Talisman - Formula Prerequisite: CL 5+ You learn the Qi Storage Talisman formula. Rank: Uncommon Family: Sealing, Restoration Activation: Bonus Action Range: Touch Consumed: yes When crafted, you may store CP in the talisman, up to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature holding the talisman may activate it to regain CP equal to the amount stored, up to its normal maximum. Stored CP fades when you finish a long rest unless the talisman is jade, bone, or metal. #### Talisman Array - Array Prerequisite: CL 5+ Setup Time: 1 minute Cost: 3 CP plus the talismans used Area: 15-foot-radius circle Place up to your Proficiency Bonus compatible talismans inside the area. Choose one array mode. Reinforced Effect: Use multiple talismans from the same family. When one activates, consume the supporting talismans to choose one benefit per supporting talisman: +1 damage die; +1 healing die; radius +5 feet; duration +1 round; stored Save DC +1, maximum +2; range +30 feet; one target has Disadvantage on the first saving throw against the effect. Layered Array: Use up to three compatible talismans from different families. When the array triggers, resolve each effect once in an order chosen when the array is built. A Talisman Array is not a full Formation. It can be disabled by destroying or removing key talismans. #### Remote Activation Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may activate a prepared talisman you crafted within 60 feet as if you were holding it, provided you can perceive it or clearly sense its resonance. If the talisman is worn or held by an unwilling creature, that creature may make a Wisdom saving throw. On a success, your remote activation fails but the talisman is not consumed. #### Formula Copyist Prerequisite: CL 5+ When copying a formula into a formula book, jade archive, sect manual, or personal talisman scripture, reduce the time required by half. You have Advantage on checks to determine whether a copied formula is incomplete, forged, mistranslated, trapped, or deliberately corrupted. ### Core Formation Realm Talents #### Talisman Spirit - Spirit Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 6 CP Target: one prepared talisman you crafted You animate a talisman into a small talisman spirit. The talisman spirit has: AC 15; hit points equal to 5 x your Proficiency Bonus; Fly Speed 30 feet, hover; immunity to Poisoned and Prone; ability to carry one prepared talisman; ability to activate the carried talisman using your action economy if you command it; ability to take the Help action; ability to retrieve unattended talismans. It acts immediately after your turn. If reduced to 0 hit points, it is destroyed and the animated talisman is consumed. #### Talisman Bomb - Array Prerequisite: CL 10+ Preparation Time: 10 minutes Activation: Action Range: 60 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Cost: 6 CP plus consumed talismans Bundle up to your Proficiency Bonus compatible talismans. Choose one mode. Focused Bomb: All talismans must share one family. Resolve one primary effect and improve it once per additional talisman. Layered Bomb: Use up to three different compatible effects. Resolve each once. The GM may reject combinations that do not make sense together. All talismans in the bomb are consumed. #### Talisman Wall - Seal Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 30 feet Duration: 1 minute Cost: 1 CP per talisman used Arrange prepared talismans into a wall of written Qi. The wall may be up to 30 feet long, 10 feet high, and 1 inch thick. It must be contiguous and placed on a surface or suspended between legal anchor points. For each talisman consumed, the wall gains 10 hit points. The wall has AC 15 and provides Total Cover while intact. The wall does not block teleportation, possession, planar travel, or effects that do not physically cross the wall unless a formula says so. #### Permanent Talisman - Medium Prerequisite: CL 10+, Reusable Talisman You may create permanent jade, bone, or metal talismans storing Common, Uncommon, or Rare formulae. Requirements: 30 days; 5,000 gp or more in materials; 10 CP spent during final stabilization; one formula you know; GM approval for campaign availability. A permanent talisman has one charge and regains one charge at dawn, after cultivation, or under a formula-specific condition. You may maintain a number of permanent talismans equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Grand Sealing Array - Array, Seal Prerequisite: CL 10+, Formations sphere or a cooperating Formation cultivator Your talismans can reinforce Formation projects and sect-grade site seals. When contributing talismans to a Formation project, choose one benefit: reduce construction time by 10 percent; add +2 to one activation, concealment, repair, or stabilization check; permit one triggered talisman effect when a Node, Gate, or Array Eye is attacked; provide a written key that lets chosen creatures pass a Gate or ward; create a failure warning visible to the formation keeper. This does not let Talismans replace the Formations sphere’s project rules. #### Formula Library Prerequisite: CL 10+ You maintain a personal formula library. During a long rest, choose one formula family represented in your library. Until your next long rest, you gain one of the following benefits for formulae from that family: reduce crafting DC by 1; reduce CP spent during crafting by 1, minimum 0; increase prepared talisman limit by 1 for that family only; gain Advantage on Read the Script checks involving that family. #### Demon-Subduing Tag - Formula, Seal Prerequisite: CL 10+ You learn the Demon-Subduing Tag formula. Rank: Rare Family: Binding, Purification, Sealing Activation: Action or Triggered Range: 30 feet, or applied to a surface Consumed: yes Choose one fiend, demon, corrupted spirit, possessing entity, undead, or comparable unclean creature. The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: It is Restrained and cannot teleport, possess a new host, turn invisible, or willingly enter another plane until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. If the talisman is part of a prepared site seal, the failed-save duration becomes 1 minute, with a repeat save at the end of each of the target’s turns. ### Nascent Soul Realm Talents #### Legendary Talisman Crafting - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+ You may craft Very Rare and Legendary talismans. When you fail a Talisman Crafting Check, you may spend 5 CP to reroll the check. You must use the new result. You can attempt to stabilize a Cracked Talisman during a long rest. Make a Talisman Crafting Check against the original DC. On a success, it becomes stable. On a failure, it remains cracked. On a failure by 5 or more, it is destroyed. #### Talisman Reflection - Seal Prerequisite: CL 15+ Trigger: You are targeted by a single-target supernatural effect Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: 5 CP and one compatible prepared talisman Make a Talisman Crafting Check against DC 10 + the attacker’s Proficiency Bonus + the attacker’s relevant ability modifier. On a success, redirect the effect toward its source or another legal target within the effect’s original range. On a failure, the talisman is consumed and the effect resolves normally. This cannot redirect area effects, Domains, Secret techniques, Legendary actions, or effects without a meaningful target line unless the GM permits an opposed Cultivation Check. #### Talisman God Body - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+ Your intent can serve as brush and ink. You gain the following benefits: Advantage on Talisman Crafting Checks; immunity to ordinary Common, Uncommon, and Rare talisman backlash from your own talismans; automatic identification of Common, Uncommon, and Rare talismans you can clearly inspect; you may use Emergency Stroke without brush or ink, writing with visible Qi; PB times per long rest, you may use Emergency Stroke for a Common talisman without spending CP. This does not remove material requirements for stable crafted talismans, jade slips, permanent talismans, or Secret formulae. #### Heavenly Seal - Seal Prerequisite: CL 15+ You can create strategic seals protecting major locations or containing dangerous entities. A Heavenly Seal may protect or bind: vaults; tombs; compounds; sect gates; city districts; spiritual veins; sleeping monsters; demons; ghosts; sealed inheritances; forbidden scriptures. A Heavenly Seal requires: at least 30 days; at least 10,000 gp in materials; anchors; maintenance procedures; a defined weakness; a written activation condition; GM approval. A Heavenly Seal is a project, not a normal combat action. #### Ten Thousand Tags Obey Prerequisite: CL 15+, Talisman Array When you build a Talisman Array, you may include up to twice your Proficiency Bonus talismans. In addition, once per long rest, when a Talisman Array would consume one Common or Uncommon talisman, you may prevent that talisman from being consumed. #### Living Scripture Servitor - Spirit Prerequisite: CL 15+, Talisman Spirit Your Talisman Spirit improves: hit points become 10 x your Proficiency Bonus; duration becomes 10 minutes; it can carry up to three prepared talismans; it can activate one carried talisman when you use a Bonus Action to command it; you may communicate with it telepathically within 1 mile. If the spirit carries a Secret talisman, it becomes visible to any creature with supernatural senses. ### Secret Formula #### Dao-Sealing Talisman - Secret Formula Prerequisite: CL 17+, Legendary Talisman Crafting, lost scripture or sect inheritance Crafting Cost: 10,000 gp and 15 CPCrafting Time: 30 days Activation: Melee Talisman Attack or applied as part of a successful compatible technique Target: one creature Consumed: yes On a hit, the target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Choose Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, or Spirit Awakening. For 1 minute, the target cannot spend that Path’s resource or activate talents that require that Path. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. Successful Save: The target cannot spend CP until the start of your next turn. The Dao-Sealing Talisman may be removed or ended by: a successful Cultivation Check as an Action against your Talisman Save DC; a Legendary purification or seal-breaking technique; destruction of the physical talisman; a superior Secret technique; a campaign-scale counterseal. The Dao-Sealing Talisman cannot permanently remove a Path, Realm, cultivation base, class feature, or character identity unless the campaign explicitly makes that the story’s central consequence. ### Talisman Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures A Talisman drawback is an optional sphere-specific limitation that grants a bonus Talisman talent or formula while changing how your talisman art functions. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Talisman drawback when first learning the sphere or receiving a major talisman inheritance; Talisman drawbacks are mutually exclusive unless listed otherwise; if a drawback grants a talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, you gain it when you meet them; if the drawback is removed, the bonus talent or formula is lost. #### Paper-Only Scripture Your talisman art works only through paper and silk. You cannot craft jade, bone, metal, or permanent talismans. Gain Rapid Talisman as a bonus talent. #### Brushbound Scripture You cannot use Emergency Stroke without a physical brush, stylus, blood needle, or approved writing tool. If disarmed of your writing tool, you cannot use Emergency Stroke or Battle Stroke Scripture until you draw or recover one. Gain Talisman Master’s Ink as a bonus talent. #### Slow Orthodoxy Scripture You cannot use Emergency Stroke in combat. All your talismans must be crafted through the full crafting procedure. Gain Reusable Talisman as a bonus talent when you meet its prerequisite. Until then, gain one additional Common formula. #### Trigger-Only Scripture Your talismans cannot be activated directly by hand unless the formula is Restoration or Communication. All other formulae must be triggered, attached, or placed as part of a prepared arrangement. Gain Triggered Talisman as a bonus talent. #### One-Family Scripture Choose one formula family. You can craft only talismans from that family, plus Message Talisman and Revealing Talisman. Gain Talisman Affinity for the chosen family as a bonus talent. #### Blood-Ink Scripture Your talismans require blood, breath, or life-essence mixed into the ink. Whenever you craft a talisman of Uncommon rank or higher, take Necrotic or Force damage equal to the formula rank band’s backlash dice count. This damage cannot be reduced. Gain +1 to the Talisman Crafting Check for talismans made this way, and gain Hidden Sleeve Preparation as a bonus talent. #### Skin-Script Scripture You can craft only skin inscriptions, armor plaques, robe seals, and worn talismans. You cannot create unattended paper traps, remote wall tags, or talisman arrays unless you are physically inside the array. Gain Talisman Body as a bonus Insight when you meet its prerequisites. Until then, gain one additional Common formula. ### Path Synergies #### Qi Cultivation - Living Ink Qi Cultivation is the default Path for Talismans. When crafting a talisman, you may reduce the CP spent for stabilization or crafting by 1, minimum 0. Once per long rest, you may reroll a failed Talisman Crafting Check. You must use the new result. When using Emergency Stroke, you may write with condensed Qi instead of mundane ink, though the mark remains visible unless another feature hides it. #### Spirit Awakening - Spirit-Written Seal You may use Wisdom instead of Intelligence for Talisman Crafting Checks, Talisman Save DC, and Talisman Attack Modifier. Your talismans are especially responsive to names, vows, ghosts, ancestors, emotions, and spiritual resonance. When you create a Talisman Spirit, it gains: +10 hit points; telepathy with you within 1 mile; Advantage on checks to carry talismans through spiritual miasma, ghostly areas, or dreamlike spaces. #### Body Refining - Talisman Body Variant Body Refining does not normally externalize complex written Qi. A Body Refining talisman practitioner must use physical media, armor plaques, weapon wraps, scars, skin inscriptions, bone slips, or other embodied marks. If you have the Talisman Body Insight, you may use Constitution instead of Intelligence for skin inscriptions and worn talismans only. You may spend Stamina in place of CP for a skin inscription you personally bear. When you activate a skin inscription in response to being hit or damaged, you may also gain temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus after the triggering effect resolves. This synergy does not permit free air-writing, remote talisman arrays, or detached external Qi script unless another feature explicitly grants it. ### Cultivation Insights #### Talisman Body Prerequisite: Body Refining Path, Talismans sphere, CL 4+ You may inscribe temporary talismans on your skin, scars, armor, nails, bones, weapon wraps, or clothing seams. A skin talisman requires 1 hour to inscribe, uses normal materials, and fades when you finish a long rest. Skin talismans do not count against your Prepared Talisman Limit, but you may maintain no more than your Proficiency Bonus skin talismans at a time. A skin talisman cannot be transferred to another creature. When you are damaged, you may use your Reaction to activate one skin talisman that has a legal Reaction or defensive activation. You may spend Stamina in place of CP for that activation. #### Talisman Savant Prerequisite: Talismans sphere, CL 8+ A number of times per short or long rest equal to your Proficiency Bonus, you may activate a non-ritual talisman as a Bonus Action if it would normally require an Action. You cannot use this Insight with Legendary, Secret, Heavenly Seal, Talisman World, or project formulae. #### Talisman Thief Prerequisite: Talismans sphere or Scoundrel sphere, CL 4+ As a Bonus Action, attempt to steal one accessible talisman within 5 feet. Make a Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check contested by the target’s Wisdom (Perception) or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), target’s choice. On a success, you take the talisman if you have a free hand or cause it to fall into an unoccupied space within 5 feet. This does not let you safely activate, identify, or suppress the talisman. #### Seal Breaker Prerequisite: Talismans sphere, CL 8+ You have Advantage on checks to detect, identify, disable, suppress, or remove talismans. Once per short or long rest, when a talisman activates within 30 feet and you can perceive it, you may use your Reaction to make a Talisman Crafting Check against the talisman’s save DC. On a success, suppress the activation. The talisman is not consumed unless you succeed by 5 or more, in which case you may choose whether it is consumed harmlessly. #### Jade Inscription Master Prerequisite: Reusable Talisman, CL 8+ Increase your Reusable Jade Limit by 2. Jade talismans you craft may store two charges, but regain only one charge at dawn or after cultivation. #### Formula Archivist Prerequisite: Talismans sphere, CL 6+ You gain one additional Common formula and one additional Uncommon formula. When you discover a formula in play, reduce reverse-engineering time by half. #### Hidden Sleeve Adept Prerequisite: Hidden Sleeve Preparation, CL 6+ Increase your Prepared Talisman Limit by 1. Once per short or long rest, when you roll Initiative, you may immediately ready one unprepared talisman you are carrying. #### Counterseal Reflex Prerequisite: Seal Breaker, CL 10+ When you suppress a talisman with Seal Breaker, you may immediately use Read the Script against that talisman without an Action. If you learn its family, you have Advantage on the next saving throw you make against a talisman of that family before your next long rest.

#### Base Ability - Spool and Strand
Action Type: Special Trigger
Canonical Action Type: Special Trigger
Factory Combat Bucket: passive
Timing Detail: No action for ordinary handling; part of the action for Thread talents

#### Base Ability - Draw the Line
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or replace one attack when you take the Attack action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row_with_attack_replacement_mode
Split Review Decision: same_bucket_attack_replacement_mode
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_DRAW_THE_LINE->action, ATTACK_REPLACEMENT_DRAW_THE_LINE->action
Range: Mundane 20 feet, Qi Thread 30 feet.
Cost: None for mundane thread if you have thread stock; 1 CP for Qi Thread or to ignore mundane stock.
Target: One creature, object, weapon, surface, or unattended item within range.
Effect: Make a Thread Attack. On a hit, you create a Thread Line between yourself or an anchor you control and the target. The line lasts until the end of your next turn. Choose one basic effect.
Pull: Move the target 5 feet toward you or toward the anchor if it is your size or smaller. Larger creatures are not moved unless they fail a Strength saving throw.
Snare: The target’s speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.
Guide: The next attack roll you make against the target before the end of your next turn ignores half cover.
Trip: The target must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone. This option requires the target to be no more than one size larger than you.
Disarm: The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or drop one held object of your choice in its space. This option requires a mundane line, Qi Thread, or needle to reach the object.
Damage: Draw the Line does not deal damage unless you choose Cutting Thread or another talent modifies it.

#### Base Ability - Listen Through Tension
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: One active Thread Line you maintain.
Cost: None.
Effect: You read vibration, breath, resistance, and movement through a Thread Line. Until the end of your next turn, choose one benefit against the connected target or object.
You know whether the target is moving closer, farther, or staying still.
You know whether the target is holding the line, cutting the line, or ignoring it.
You have advantage on one Wisdom (Insight), Wisdom (Perception), or Dexterity (Sleight of Hand) check involving the line.
If the target is Invisible but physically connected by a mundane or Qi Thread, you know its space until the line ends, though this does not by itself let you see the target.
