spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Unmaking Qi Expression: Primary — Unmaking Qi; Supporting — Ruin Qi, Destructive Yin Qi, Severance Qi, Void-Touched Qi, Corrosion Qi, Entropy Qi, Weapon-Channel Qi, Black-Vein Qi, Sacrificial Qi. “Destruction breaks the cup. Unmaking teaches the clay to forget the cup was ever possible.” Common Name: Unmaking Sphere Sphere Type: Restricted Power Sphere; High-Risk Damage Sphere; Self-Damaging Cultivation Sphere; Anti-Structure Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining or Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Key Themes: destructive qi, black veins, self-injury, weapon disintegration, rupture of cohesion, anti-barrier force, anti-construct damage, dangerous body channeling, sacrificial burst, ruin forms, impossible damage at a price Primary Resource Hooks: CP, HP, Black Vein Strain, weapon Crack, self-damage, impaired channels, temporary healing denial --- ## Unmaking Dao Unmaking is not ordinary destruction. Destruction breaks what exists. Unmaking attacks the agreement that lets a thing continue existing. A Destruction cultivator blasts a gate from its hinges. An Unmaking cultivator cuts a line through the gate where wood, nail, ward, and hinge no longer remember how to belong together. The first lesson of Unmaking is not how to destroy an enemy. The first lesson is how to keep the technique from destroying the hand that holds it. Unmaking qi is hostile to containment. It crawls through weapons and leaves cracks. It runs through flesh and leaves black veins. It can erase barriers, ruin armor, shred temporary constructs, and produce damage beyond ordinary safe technique curves, but every serious use demands a channel. The channel pays. Sometimes the channel is a knife. Sometimes the channel is a talisman. Sometimes the channel is an arm. Sometimes the channel is the cultivator’s life. Unmaking is dangerous because it works. --- ## Design Boundary: Unmaking and Destruction The Sphere of Destruction remains the general sphere of direct destructive force: blasts, shattering, impact, explosions, breaking terrain, and overwhelming power. Unmaking is narrower, sharper, and more dangerous. It specializes in removing cohesion, burning channels, damaging objects and barriers, denying regeneration briefly, shredding temporary technique-states, and trading self-harm for extreme damage. **Destruction says:** “I break it.” **Unmaking says:** “It cannot remain itself.” Unmaking may exceed ordinary damage curves only when the user pays a visible cost: HP, Black Vein Strain, weapon Crack, impaired body channels, healing lockout, CP, destroyed tools, or backlash. Safe Unmaking is strong. Reckless Unmaking is terrifying. --- ## 2024 Fifth-Edition Rules Baseline This sphere assumes the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline used by Tianxia. Damage, objects, Cover, Concentration, saving throws, attack rolls, Resistance, Immunity, Temporary HP, healing, Incapacitated, Grappled, Restrained, Prone, and Opportunity Attacks follow ordinary rules unless an Unmaking talent changes them. Unmaking self-damage is not ordinary incoming damage unless a talent says otherwise. It cannot be reduced by Resistance, Immunity, Temporary HP, damage reduction, warding, or redirection. It represents the cost of using the technique’s own channel. If an Unmaking talent says its self-damage does not trigger Concentration checks, that exception applies only to Concentration on that same Unmaking talent. Otherwise, self-damage can threaten Concentration normally. --- ## Core Unmaking Terms ### Ruin Damage Unmaking talents record their damage as **Ruin damage**. For ordinary implementation, Ruin damage is resolved as Force or Necrotic damage, chosen when the talent is learned unless a talent specifies otherwise. A campaign may track Ruin as a special cultivation damage tag. If so, it remains a damage tag, not an automatic bypass of all Resistance or Immunity. Superior beings, artifacts, Secret Inheritances, divine bodies, stronger domains, and higher-Realm authority may resist or contest Ruin normally. ### Channel A **Channel** is the thing Unmaking qi passes through before it reaches the target. Common Channels include: - a held weapon; - an unarmed strike; - a hand, claw, limb, fist, palm, spear-hand, or pressure-point touch; - a talisman; - a needle; - a chain; - a blackened focus; - a temporary qi blade; - a formation node; - the cultivator’s own meridians. If a talent requires a Channel and none is available, the talent fails. ### External Channel A weapon, talisman, tool, construct, or object used to carry Unmaking qi. External Channels often take **Crack**. ### Internal Channel The cultivator’s body, meridians, nerves, blood, spirit vessel, or dantian used to carry Unmaking qi. Internal Channels often give **Black Vein Strain**. ### Crack **Crack** is damage to an External Channel caused by Unmaking qi. Unless a talent says otherwise: - An ordinary weapon, tool, or object can hold 2 Crack safely. - At 3 Crack, it breaks after the current attack, technique, or scene effect resolves. - A refined, spiritual, or cultivation-grade weapon can hold Crack equal to 2 + its rarity tier, if the campaign tracks rarity. - An artifact, bound treasure, or Secret-grade weapon does not gain Crack unless its owner allows it. If it would gain Crack and does not, the user takes 1d6 Ruin self-damage per Crack prevented. Crack can be removed during downtime with appropriate Blacksmith, Metal, Alchemy, Formation, or sect repair support. One ordinary Crack can be removed during a Short Rest if the wielder has suitable tools and the GM agrees the item can be patched. ### Black Vein Strain **Black Vein Strain** is a counter on the cultivator representing Unmaking qi crawling back through the body. Black Vein Strain persists until the cultivator finishes a Long Rest, receives appropriate cleansing, or uses a talent that removes it. At **3 Black Vein Strain**, choose one channel currently used by the cultivator: left hand, right hand, weapon arm, breath, dantian, eyes, legs, voice, or another appropriate channel. That channel is **Impaired** until the cultivator removes at least 1 Black Vein Strain. An Impaired channel can still be used, but the first time each turn the cultivator uses Unmaking through that channel, they take Ruin self-damage equal to their Proficiency Bonus. At **6 Black Vein Strain**, the cultivator suffers Ruin Backlash, then reduces Black Vein Strain to 3. ### Ruin Backlash When Ruin Backlash occurs, the cultivator takes Ruin self-damage equal to: **2d6 + their Cultivation Level** This damage cannot be reduced or redirected and ignores Temporary HP. Then choose one Backlash mark: - The cultivator cannot regain HP until the start of their next turn. - The cultivator cannot take Reactions until the start of their next turn. - The cultivator has Disadvantage on the next attack roll or cultivation check they make before the end of their next turn. - One held non-artifact object used as a Channel gains 1 Crack. - One Impaired channel remains Impaired until the cultivator finishes a Short Rest. Some higher-Realm talents increase Ruin Backlash. ### Overdraw **Overdraw** is the main rule that makes Unmaking damage worth its price. Once per turn, when you deal damage with an Unmaking talent, you may Overdraw. When you Overdraw: - gain 1 Black Vein Strain; - take Ruin self-damage based on your Realm; - add bonus Ruin damage to one target damaged by the talent. | Realm | Overdraw Self-Damage | Added Ruin Damage | |---|---:|---:| | Mortal | 1d6 + PB | 3d6 | | Foundation | 2d6 + PB | 6d6 | | Core Formation | 4d6 + PB | 10d6 | | Nascent Soul | 6d6 + PB | 14d6 | Overdraw self-damage cannot be reduced, redirected, or prevented by Temporary HP. It cannot be healed until the end of your next turn. If a talent says Overdraw damage applies to more than one target, that exception is part of the talent’s cost and risk. --- ## Core Unmaking Rules ### Unmaking Key Ability Use your Path key ability for Unmaking attack rolls, Unmaking Save DCs, and Unmaking Checks. Body Refining Unmaking usually uses Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution depending on the martial art or scripture. Qi Cultivation Unmaking usually uses Intelligence or Charisma. Spirit Awakening Unmaking usually uses Wisdom. ### Unmaking Check When a talent calls for an Unmaking Check, roll: **d20 + Proficiency Bonus + your Unmaking key ability modifier** ### Unmaking Control Limit You can maintain only one ongoing Unmaking effect with a duration longer than instantaneous at a time unless a talent says otherwise. Unmaking qi resists stable containment. ### Self-Damage Rule Self-damage from Unmaking features represents the channel paying the technique’s cost. Unless a talent says otherwise: - it cannot be reduced; - it ignores Temporary HP; - it cannot be redirected to another creature; - it cannot be prevented by ordinary Resistance or Immunity; - it is not optional once the technique is released; - it does not count as hostile damage for retaliation features unless the GM rules otherwise. ### Unmaking and Healing Some Unmaking talents prevent healing or regeneration briefly. This is never permanent unless a Secret Inheritance, artifact, curse, or campaign event says so. As a default rule, healing denial from ordinary Unmaking talents lasts until the start or end of the user’s next turn. ### Unmaking and Objects Unmaking is especially effective against unattended objects, barriers, constructs, temporary qi structures, armor plates, shields, talismans, and formation nodes. However, it does not automatically erase artifacts, ancient formations, divine bodies, major sect arrays, or higher-Realm domains. Those require opposed checks, narrative permissions, or Secret-grade techniques. --- ## Base Sphere Abilities When you first gain the Unmaking sphere, gain proficiency in one of the following: Intimidation, Medicine, Arcana, martial weapons, smith’s tools, or alchemist’s supplies. If you already have proficiency in the chosen option, choose one Mortal Realm Unmaking talent instead. You also learn **Ruin Channel** and **Black Trace**. ### Ruin Channel **Action Type:** Bonus Action **Range:** Self or touch **Cost:** None **Duration:** Until the start of your next turn You run Unmaking qi through one Channel you are touching. Choose one: - a held weapon; - an unarmed strike; - one hand or limb; - a talisman, needle, chain, or tool; - another object the GM agrees can briefly hold Unmaking qi. The next time before the duration ends that you hit with that Channel, deal additional Ruin damage based on your Realm. | Realm | Ruin Channel Bonus Damage | |---|---:| | Mortal | 2d8 | | Foundation | 3d8 | | Core Formation | 5d8 | | Nascent Soul | 7d8 | After the attack resolves, choose one cost: - the Channel gains 1 Crack if it is an External Channel; - you gain 1 Black Vein Strain if it is an Internal Channel; - you take Ruin self-damage equal to **1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus**, and the Channel does not gain Crack or Strain. If the attack misses, the Channel remains active until the duration ends. If the duration ends without a hit, you take Ruin self-damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Ruin Channel may be applied to a ranged weapon, thrown weapon, or ammunition only if you are touching it when you use the feature. You may Overdraw when a Ruin Channel attack hits. ### Black Trace **Action Type:** Action **Range:** 30 feet **Target:** One creature or object you can see **Cost:** None Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On hit, the target takes Ruin damage based on your Realm. | Realm | Safe Black Trace Damage | |---|---:| | Mortal | 1d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier | | Foundation | 2d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier | | Core Formation | 3d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier | | Nascent Soul | 4d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier | On hit, choose one Trace effect: **Fray.** The target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. **Crack.** If the target is an object, construct, armor, shield, barrier, or temporary qi structure, it takes additional Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. **Sting.** The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn. **Mark.** The next Unmaking talent that damages the target before the end of your next turn deals additional Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You may Overdraw when Black Trace hits. #### Unbound Trace Before making the Black Trace attack, you may make the Trace unstable. On hit, the damage becomes the Unbound Trace value instead. | Realm | Unbound Trace Damage | |---|---:| | Mortal | 2d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier | | Foundation | 4d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier | | Core Formation | 6d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier | | Nascent Soul | 8d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier | After the attack resolves, whether it hits or misses, choose one: - gain 1 Black Vein Strain; - take Ruin self-damage equal to **1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus**; - one suitable focus, needle, talisman, weapon, or External Channel gains 1 Crack. You may Overdraw when Unbound Trace hits. --- ## Unmaking Talent Tags **Channel Talents** improve Ruin Channel or create new Channels. **Black Vein Talents** use the cultivator’s body as the dangerous vessel. **Crack Talents** damage weapons, tools, barriers, armor, shields, constructs, and other objects. **Trace Talents** improve Black Trace or ranged Unmaking. **Ruin Form Talents** are the sphere’s major form techniques. They are not automatically Secret Inheritances. Most are normal Realm talents. **Overdraw Talents** create stronger self-damaging releases. **Anti-Structure Talents** target barriers, formations, talismans, constructs, wards, and temporary technique-states. **Execution Talents** punish wounded, Bloodied, impaired, cracked, or already-unmade targets. **Secret Talents** are rare inheritance-grade techniques. --- ## Mortal Realm Talents ### Ruin-Bitten Edge — Channel When you use Ruin Channel on a melee weapon, the weapon’s next hit also reduces the target’s Speed by 5 feet until the start of your next turn. If the weapon gains Crack after the attack, the target’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet instead. ### Black-Vein Palm — Black Vein When you use Ruin Channel on an unarmed strike, fist, palm, claw, spear-hand, or other Internal Channel, increase the Ruin Channel bonus damage by 1d8. If the attack hits a creature, choose one: - the target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn; - the target has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn; - the target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. After resolving the attack, gain 1 Black Vein Strain. ### Weapon Pays First — Channel When an External Channel would gain Crack from one of your Unmaking talents, you may choose to take Ruin self-damage equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus instead. If you do, the item does not gain that Crack. You may use this talent once per turn. ### Splintering Trace — Trace When Black Trace hits an object, construct, armor, shield, barrier, or temporary qi structure, add one extra d10 Ruin damage. At CL 11, add two extra d10 instead. You may Overdraw on this hit even if you have already used Overdraw this turn, but if you do, gain 2 Black Vein Strain instead of 1. ### Bitter Release — Overdraw When you Overdraw, increase the added damage by your Proficiency Bonus. If the target is Bloodied, impaired, cracked, restrained, stunned, incapacitated, or unable to take Reactions, increase the added damage by twice your Proficiency Bonus instead. ### Wound That Refuses — Execution When you damage a creature with Ruin Channel or Black Trace, the target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. If the target already had this healing denial from one of your Unmaking talents, it instead cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn. This does not prevent resurrection, regeneration, or Secret-grade healing unless a higher-Realm talent says so. ### Ruin Sheath Method — Channel You learn how to keep a dangerous Channel quiet for a few breaths. When you use Ruin Channel, its duration becomes until the end of your next turn. If the Channel expires without hitting, you may choose for the Channel to gain 1 Crack or for you to gain 1 Black Vein Strain instead of taking self-damage. ### Crack the Guard — Crack When you hit a creature using a shield, armor, parrying weapon, warding bracer, or comparable defensive implement with a Ruin Channel attack, the target must succeed on a Strength or Constitution saving throw, target’s choice. Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot add shield AC against your attacks, and the defensive implement gains 1 Crack if it is not an artifact. Successful Save: The target keeps its defense, but the defensive implement gains 1 Crack if it is not an artifact. ### Ruin Needle — Channel You may use needles, darts, hairpins, bone spikes, or similar Tiny piercing implements as External Channels for Ruin Channel. When you hit with a Ruin Needle attack, choose one: - the target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; - the target cannot regain CP until the start of your next turn; - the target has Disadvantage on the next check made to maintain a stance, form, or ongoing technique before the end of its next turn. The needle gains 1 Crack and is usually destroyed after the attack. ### Last Inch Control — Black Vein When you would gain Black Vein Strain from an Unmaking talent, you may make a Constitution saving throw against your own Unmaking Save DC. Success: Take Ruin self-damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus instead of gaining the Strain. Failure: Gain the Strain normally. You may use this talent once per turn. --- ## Foundation Realm Talents ### First Ruin Form: External Vessel Mandate — Ruin Form, Channel **Prerequisite:** CL 5+ **Action Type:** Bonus Action **Duration:** 1 minute **Cost:** 1 CP You bind Unmaking qi to an External Channel and force the weapon or implement to survive longer than it should. Choose one held weapon or implement. For the duration: - once per turn, when you hit with the chosen Channel, deal additional Ruin damage equal to 2d8; - when the chosen Channel would gain Crack, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, the Crack is delayed until the form ends; - when the form ends, all delayed Crack applies at once. If the Channel breaks when the form ends, you may immediately make one Black Trace attack against a creature within 30 feet as the weapon dies. This attack cannot Overdraw. ### Second Ruin Form: Black Palm Vessel — Ruin Form, Black Vein **Prerequisite:** CL 5+, Black-Vein Palm **Action Type:** Bonus Action **Duration:** 1 minute **Cost:** 1 CP You allow Unmaking qi to circulate through your hands and forearms. For the duration: - your unarmed strikes may deal Ruin damage instead of their normal damage type; - once per turn, when you hit with an unarmed strike, add 2d10 Ruin damage; - when you use Ruin Channel through an Internal Channel, add your Proficiency Bonus to the bonus Ruin damage; - at the end of each of your turns in which you damaged a creature with this form, gain 1 Black Vein Strain. If this would trigger Ruin Backlash, the form does not immediately end, but you cannot regain HP until the form ends. ### Ruin Wave — Trace **Prerequisite:** CL 5+ **Action Type:** Action **Range:** Self **Area:** 30-foot line, 5 feet wide **Cost:** 1 CP You release a narrow wave of Unmaking qi. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: The creature takes 6d8 Ruin damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Half damage and no Reaction loss. Objects, fragile barriers, and temporary qi structures in the line take the damage automatically. After resolving the technique, choose one: - gain 1 Black Vein Strain; - take Ruin self-damage equal to 2d6 + your Proficiency Bonus; - one External Channel used to shape the wave gains 1 Crack. You may Overdraw, adding the Overdraw damage to one creature or object that failed its save. At CL 11, damage becomes 8d8. At CL 17, damage becomes 10d8. ### Dissolve the Seam — Anti-Structure **Prerequisite:** CL 5+ **Action Type:** Action **Range:** Touch **Target:** One object, door, lock, wall section, chain, shield, ward plate, armor plate, formation tile, or temporary barrier **Cost:** 1 CP Make an Unmaking Check against the object or effect’s DC. If no DC is known, use: - DC 13 for ordinary objects; - DC 16 for reinforced objects; - DC 19 for cultivation-grade barriers; - DC 22+ for major sect or formation work. Success: Deal 8d10 Ruin damage to the target object or structure. If this breaks or disables it, the broken section leaves no clean salvage. Failure: Deal half damage, and your Channel gains 1 Crack or you gain 1 Black Vein Strain. You may Overdraw to add 6d10 Ruin damage to the object or structure instead of the normal Overdraw damage. ### Meridian Ruin Shock — Black Vein **Prerequisite:** CL 5+, Black-Vein Palm or Ruin Needle When you hit a creature with an Internal Channel or Ruin Needle, you may spend 1 CP. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the target cannot regain CP, has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration, and cannot take Reactions. Successful Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target cannot take Reactions. After resolving this talent, gain 1 Black Vein Strain. ### Shred the Temporary Shape — Anti-Structure **Prerequisite:** CL 5+ When you damage a summoned creature, temporary construct, qi clone, puppet body, spirit projection, barrier, shield effect, or ongoing technique-state with an Unmaking talent, you may spend 1 CP. The target or effect takes additional Ruin damage equal to 3d8 + your Proficiency Bonus. If this damage reduces it to 0 HP, ends it, or breaks it, you regain 1 CP. You cannot regain more than 1 CP per turn this way. ### Black-Vein Step — Black Vein **Prerequisite:** CL 5+ When you Overdraw, you may move up to 10 feet after the triggering talent resolves. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures damaged by that talent. If you end this movement adjacent to a creature damaged by the talent, you may gain 1 additional Black Vein Strain to make one unarmed strike against that creature. ### Hollow the Armor — Crack **Prerequisite:** CL 5+ When you hit a creature wearing armor or protected by a natural armored shell with Ruin Channel or Black Trace, you may spend 1 CP. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Until the start of your next turn, the target takes a -2 penalty to AC against the next attack made against it. Successful Save: The target takes a -1 penalty instead. This does not stack with itself. ### Devouring Dregs — Overdraw **Prerequisite:** CL 5+ When you Overdraw and the target is reduced to 0 HP, destroyed, or broken by the triggering damage, you may immediately remove 1 Black Vein Strain or remove 1 Crack from the Channel used. If the destroyed target was a living creature, this creates a visible black-vein flare and may be considered taboo, forbidden, or corruptive by witnesses. --- ## Core Formation Realm Talents ### Third Ruin Form: Severing Wave — Ruin Form, Trace **Prerequisite:** CL 10+, Ruin Wave **Action Type:** Action **Range:** Self **Area:** 60-foot line, 10 feet wide **Cost:** 2 CP You release a compressed blade of Unmaking qi. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: 10d8 Ruin damage. The creature cannot regain HP or CP until the end of its next turn. Successful Save: Half damage. The creature cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Objects, barriers, constructs, and temporary qi structures in the line take 12d8 Ruin damage automatically. After resolving the technique, choose one: - gain 2 Black Vein Strain; - take Ruin self-damage equal to 4d6 + your Cultivation Level; - one External Channel used to shape the wave gains 2 Crack. You may Overdraw. If you do, add the Overdraw damage to every failed-save target instead of only one target, then suffer Ruin Backlash after the technique resolves. ### Fourth Ruin Form: Black-Vein Body — Ruin Form, Black Vein **Prerequisite:** CL 10+, Second Ruin Form: Black Palm Vessel **Action Type:** Bonus Action **Duration:** 1 minute **Cost:** 2 CP Your body becomes a dangerous vessel for Unmaking qi. For the duration: - you gain Resistance to Necrotic damage and Force damage; - your melee weapon attacks and unarmed strikes may deal Ruin damage; - once per turn, when you hit with a melee attack, add 3d10 Ruin damage; - creatures that hit you with melee attacks take Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus; - you have Advantage on saving throws against being Grappled, Restrained, or Paralyzed. At the end of each of your turns, gain 1 Black Vein Strain. If you reach 6 Black Vein Strain during this form, suffer Ruin Backlash, but the added damage from this form becomes 4d10 until the form ends. When the form ends, you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn. ### Lattice Unraveling — Anti-Structure **Prerequisite:** CL 10+ **Action Type:** Action **Range:** 90 feet **Target:** One visible formation node, ward, talisman effect, barrier, summoned construct, or ongoing non-Secret technique-state **Cost:** 2 CP Make an Unmaking Check against the effect’s save DC or formation DC. Success: Suppress the target effect until the start of your next turn. If the target is a creature or construct, it instead takes 8d10 Ruin damage and has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes before the end of its next turn. Success by 5 or more: The suppression lasts until the end of your next turn. Failure: The effect is not suppressed, but it takes 4d10 Ruin damage if it has HP or structure. You gain 1 Black Vein Strain. This cannot suppress Secret Inheritances, Realm Tribulations, divine domains, ancient city formations, or superior authority without an opposed check and GM permission. ### Hollowing Field — Anti-Structure, Overdraw **Prerequisite:** CL 10+ **Action Type:** Action **Range:** 90 feet **Area:** 20-foot-radius sphere **Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute **Cost:** 2 CP You create a field where cohesion thins. When a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: 5d8 Ruin damage, and the creature cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Half damage. Objects, barriers, temporary qi structures, and summoned constructs in the area have Vulnerability to Ruin damage from your Unmaking talents while inside the field. At the end of each of your turns while maintaining Hollowing Field, choose one: - take Ruin self-damage equal to 2d6; - gain 1 Black Vein Strain; - one External Channel used to sustain the field gains 1 Crack. If Concentration breaks because of damage, suffer Ruin Backlash. ### Unmake the Answer — Reaction, Anti-Structure **Prerequisite:** CL 10+ **Action Type:** Reaction **Trigger:** A creature you can see within 60 feet creates a barrier, shield, temporary construct, talisman effect, summoned asset, or ongoing defensive technique **Cost:** 2 CP Make an Unmaking Check against the triggering effect’s save DC. Success: The effect still appears, but it begins cracked. The first time it prevents damage, grants AC, absorbs damage, or blocks movement before the end of its creator’s next turn, reduce that protection by 5d10. Success by 5 or more: Also deal 5d10 Ruin damage to the effect or its creator, chosen by you if both are legal targets. Failure: You take Ruin self-damage equal to 3d10 and gain 1 Black Vein Strain. ### Execution Through the Fault — Execution **Prerequisite:** CL 10+ When you damage a Bloodied creature with an Unmaking talent, you may spend 2 CP and Overdraw. Instead of the normal Overdraw bonus, add 10d8 Ruin damage to the target. After resolving the damage, suffer Ruin Backlash. If this reduces the target to 0 HP, you may remove 2 Black Vein Strain. If it does not reduce the target to 0 HP, you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn. ### Crack the Name of the Tool — Spirit **Prerequisite:** CL 10+, Spirit Awakening Path or GM permission When you damage a summoned creature, puppet, spirit projection, possession vessel, bound companion, or animated construct with an Unmaking talent, you may target the link holding it together. The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, it has Disadvantage on attack rolls, saving throws to maintain form, and checks to obey commands. Successful Save: It has Disadvantage on the next such roll before the start of your next turn. After using this talent, gain 1 Black Vein Strain or take Ruin self-damage equal to 2d6. --- ## Nascent Soul Realm Talents ### Fifth Ruin Form: Domain of Collapse — Ruin Form, Anti-Structure **Prerequisite:** CL 15+, Hollowing Field **Action Type:** Action **Range:** Self **Area:** 60-foot emanation **Duration:** Concentration, up to 1 minute **Cost:** 4 CP You become the center of a collapsing agreement. For the duration: - hostile creatures in the area cannot regain HP on the same turn they take Ruin damage from you; - temporary qi structures, summoned constructs, barriers, wards, and non-Secret defensive effects in the area take Ruin damage equal to your Cultivation Level at the start of each of your turns; - once per turn, when you deal Ruin damage to a creature in the area, add 4d10 Ruin damage; - when a hostile creature in the area casts, activates, or sustains a technique with Concentration or an equivalent state, it must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus d10. At the end of each of your turns while the domain persists, suffer one cost: - gain 2 Black Vein Strain; - take Ruin self-damage equal to 5d6 + your Proficiency Bonus; - destroy one non-artifact External Channel you are carrying; - reduce your current and maximum HP by 10 until you finish a Long Rest. If the domain ends because your Concentration breaks, suffer Ruin Backlash twice. ### Sixth Ruin Form: Star-Sundering Cut — Ruin Form, Execution **Prerequisite:** CL 15+, Third Ruin Form: Severing Wave **Action Type:** Action **Range:** 300 feet **Area:** 300-foot line, 10 feet wide **Cost:** 5 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest You release a single line of pure Unmaking. Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: 16d10 Ruin damage. The creature cannot regain HP or CP until the end of its next turn. If the creature is a summoned construct, puppet body, temporary clone, projected vessel, or non-true body, it takes an additional 8d10 Ruin damage. Successful Save: Half damage. The creature cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn. Objects, barriers, doors, siege engines, temporary qi structures, and non-Secret constructs in the line take 24d10 Ruin damage automatically. After resolving the cut, suffer all of the following: - gain 3 Black Vein Strain; - take Ruin self-damage equal to 8d6 + your Cultivation Level; - one External Channel used to shape the technique is destroyed unless it is an artifact; - you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn. This technique does not automatically defeat superior authority, divine bodies, Secret Inheritances, ancient formations, or higher-Realm domains. Against such targets, the GM may require an opposed Cultivation Check. On a failure, the target takes half damage after its saving throw result. ### Unbody the False Vessel — Anti-Structure, Spirit **Prerequisite:** CL 15+ **Action Type:** Action **Range:** 120 feet **Target:** One summoned creature, puppet body, clone, projection, possession vessel, construct, or temporary body **Cost:** 4 CP The target makes a Constitution or Wisdom saving throw, whichever is better for it. Failed Save: 14d10 Ruin damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 HP, the effect that created or sustained it ends immediately. Successful Save: Half damage. If the target is sustained by a visible caster, master, owner, or summoner within 120 feet, that creature also takes Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus d10 on a failed save. After using this talent, gain 2 Black Vein Strain or suffer Ruin self-damage equal to 5d6. ### Black Star Vessel — Black Vein **Prerequisite:** CL 15+, Fourth Ruin Form: Black-Vein Body When you would suffer Ruin Backlash, you may choose to become a Black Star Vessel until the end of your next turn. While in this state: - you do not reduce Black Vein Strain after the triggering Ruin Backlash; - your Ruin damage ignores Resistance; - once before the state ends, when you hit with an Unmaking talent, add 8d10 Ruin damage; - you cannot regain HP; - you have Disadvantage on death saving throws. When the state ends, suffer Ruin Backlash again. If this second Backlash would reduce you to 0 HP, you may remain at 1 HP instead, but your Black Vein Strain becomes 6 and you gain one level of Exhaustion. ### Sever the Mountain’s Memory — Anti-Structure **Prerequisite:** CL 15+ **Action Type:** Action **Range:** Touch **Target:** One structure, wall section, gate, large barrier, formation plate, bridge support, mountain seal, or comparable major object **Cost:** 4 CP Make an Unmaking Check against the target’s DC. Success: The target takes 24d10 Ruin damage and loses one major structural function chosen by the GM: support, seal, hinge, warding surface, channel alignment, load-bearing integrity, concealment, or containment. Success by 5 or more: The target also becomes unstable. The next significant impact, forced movement, tremor, siege attack, or damaging technique before the end of the scene deals maximum damage to it. Failure: The target takes half damage, and you suffer Ruin Backlash. This talent cannot casually collapse mountains, sect headquarters, city-scale formations, or divine architecture. It creates or exploits a fault; it does not overrule superior authority without a contest. --- ## Secret Unmaking Inheritance ### The Moment Nothing Answers **Secret Unmaking Inheritance** **Prerequisites:** CL 17+, Sixth Ruin Form: Star-Sundering Cut, at least two other Ruin Form talents, access to a true Unmaking inheritance, black-vein scripture, ruined-star revelation, or comparable destructive qi transmission **Action Type:** Action **Range:** 300 feet **Target:** One creature, object, barrier, construct, formation node, projected vessel, or temporary body you can see **Cost:** 6 CP Use Limit: Once per week You stop shaping Unmaking into a technique and allow one target to experience a moment where its cohesion receives no answer from Heaven. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. If the target is an object, barrier, formation node, temporary body, or construct without Constitution, use the creator’s save bonus, structure DC, or formation DC. Failed Save: The target takes 24d10 Ruin damage. Successful Save: The target takes half damage. If the target is a temporary body, projection, construct, puppet, clone, summoned vessel, non-Secret barrier, or temporary qi structure, it takes an additional 12d10 Ruin damage. If the target is Bloodied, cracked, Impaired, restrained, incapacitated, unable to take Reactions, or already under healing denial from your Unmaking, add 6d10 Ruin damage. After resolving this inheritance, suffer all of the following: - your Black Vein Strain becomes 6; - suffer Ruin Backlash twice; - reduce your current and maximum HP by 20 until you finish a Long Rest; - destroy one non-artifact External Channel used to shape the inheritance; - you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn; - you cannot use Unmaking talents other than Black Trace until the end of your next turn. Limits: This inheritance is catastrophic, but not absolute. It does not automatically erase immortals, divine bodies, ancient arrays, Realm Tribulations, Secret Inheritances, artifacts, or superior domains. Such targets may resist, halve, contest, or redirect the effect according to Realm authority and GM adjudication. --- ## Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures ### External Weapon Scripture Your Unmaking must pass through weapons, tools, needles, talismans, or other External Channels. You cannot use Ruin Channel through an unarmed strike or bare limb unless no other Channel is available and you accept 2 Black Vein Strain after the technique resolves. You gain Weapon Pays First as a bonus talent. ### Black-Vein Body Scripture Your Unmaking prefers Internal Channels. When you use Ruin Channel through a weapon or object, reduce the bonus damage by one die unless the object already has Crack. When you use Ruin Channel through an unarmed strike, palm, claw, or body part, increase the bonus damage by one die. You gain Black-Vein Palm as a bonus talent. ### Ashless Mercy Doctrine Your Unmaking rejects living targets unless they are monstrous, undead, summoned, artificial, or actively trying to kill you. You have Disadvantage on Unmaking attacks against ordinary living creatures who have not harmed you or your allies in the current scene. You gain Dissolve the Seam as a bonus talent at CL 5. Before CL 5, you gain Splintering Trace. ### Ruined Vessel Curse Your body cannot release Unmaking cleanly. Whenever you gain Black Vein Strain, take Ruin self-damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Your Ruin Channel and Black Trace damage dice increase by one size. This drawback is dangerous and should be GM-approved. ### Tool-Sacrificing Scripture Your lineage teaches that tools exist to die before the cultivator does. When an External Channel breaks because of Crack from one of your Unmaking talents, the Unmaking talent that broke it deals additional Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus d10. You gain Ruin Sheath Method as a bonus talent. --- ## Path Synergies ### Body Refining — Black Vein Tempering Body Refining Unmaking treats the body as the primary Channel. You may use Constitution as your Unmaking key ability. When you use Unmaking through an Internal Channel: - you may choose to take Ruin self-damage equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus instead of gaining 1 Black Vein Strain; - once per turn, when you take Ruin self-damage from your own Unmaking talent, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus after the talent resolves; - you have Advantage on saving throws against your own Ruin Backlash. The Temporary HP from this synergy does not absorb Unmaking self-damage. ### Qi Cultivation — Controlled Release Qi Cultivation Unmaking uses externalized qi to release ruin at distance. You may use Intelligence or Charisma as your Unmaking key ability. When you use Black Trace, Ruin Wave, Severing Wave, Lattice Unraveling, Hollowing Field, or another ranged Unmaking talent, you may spend 1 additional CP to choose one: - increase the range by 30 feet; - add your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll; - avoid gaining 1 Crack on an External Channel; - avoid gaining 1 Black Vein Strain, taking Ruin self-damage equal to 2d6 instead. ### Spirit Awakening — Unmake the Binding Spirit Awakening Unmaking attacks links, names, commands, projections, possession channels, and spirit vessels. You may use Wisdom as your Unmaking key ability. When you damage a summoned creature, puppet, spirit projection, possessed body, oath-bound construct, dream body, or temporary identity with an Unmaking talent, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage. Once per round, when such a target fails a save against your Unmaking talent, you may learn one: - whether it is sustained by a visible controller; - whether it is a true body or temporary vessel; - whether it has a possession link; - whether it has an active oath, seal, command, or contract maintaining it; - whether Unmaking is especially dangerous to the link. --- ## Cultivation Insights ### Black-Vein Initiate **Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, CL 4+ You can survive the first bite of your own qi. When you would gain Black Vein Strain while you have no Black Vein Strain, you may take Ruin self-damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus instead. You may use this benefit once per short or long rest. ### Ruin-Safe Grip **Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, CL 4+ When an External Channel would gain its first Crack from your Unmaking talent, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, it does not gain that Crack. At CL 10, this succeeds on a 4, 5, or 6. ### Asura-Hand Tempering **Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, Body Refining Path, CL 6+ When you use Black-Vein Palm or an Internal Channel Unmaking talent, add your Proficiency Bonus to the first Ruin damage roll you make on your turn. If this attack misses, you do not gain Black Vein Strain from the missed attack unless the talent says otherwise. ### Clean Severance Scholar **Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, Qi Cultivation Path, CL 6+ When you use an Unmaking talent against an object, barrier, temporary qi structure, or formation node, you may spend 1 CP to gain Advantage on the Unmaking Check or impose Disadvantage on the target’s saving throw. If the attempt fails, take Ruin self-damage equal to 2d6. ### The Hand That Pays **Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, CL 8+ When you Overdraw, you may choose to add the Overdraw bonus damage before seeing the total damage roll. If you do, increase the Overdraw bonus damage by 2d6. After resolving the talent, gain 1 additional Black Vein Strain. ### Ruin Without Hatred **Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, Spirit Awakening Path, CL 8+ You can direct Unmaking at bindings rather than bodies. When you use an Unmaking talent against a possessed creature, bound spirit, cursed victim, puppet vessel, or controlled summon, you may choose for your extra Ruin damage to affect only the controlling link. If the link breaks, the host or vessel does not take the extra Ruin damage. ### Star-Sundering Preparation **Prerequisite:** Unmaking sphere, CL 14+ When you finish a Long Rest, choose one External Channel or one Internal Channel. Until your next Long Rest, the chosen Channel can absorb the first 1 Crack or Black Vein Strain it would gain from an Unmaking talent. If you use Sixth Ruin Form: Star-Sundering Cut through the prepared Channel, increase its damage by 2d10. ---

### Black Trace
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 30 feet
**Target:** One creature or object you can see
**Cost:** None
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack.
On hit, the target takes Ruin damage based on your Realm.
| Realm | Safe Black Trace Damage |
|---|---:|
| Mortal | 1d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Foundation | 2d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Core Formation | 3d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Nascent Soul | 4d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
On hit, choose one Trace effect:
**Fray.** The target cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
**Crack.** If the target is an object, construct, armor, shield, barrier, or temporary qi structure, it takes additional Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
**Sting.** The target cannot take Reactions against you until the start of your next turn.
**Mark.** The next Unmaking talent that damages the target before the end of your next turn deals additional Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
You may Overdraw when Black Trace hits.
#### Unbound Trace
Before making the Black Trace attack, you may make the Trace unstable.
On hit, the damage becomes the Unbound Trace value instead.
| Realm | Unbound Trace Damage |
|---|---:|
| Mortal | 2d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Foundation | 4d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Core Formation | 6d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
| Nascent Soul | 8d10 + your Unmaking key ability modifier |
After the attack resolves, whether it hits or misses, choose one:
- gain 1 Black Vein Strain;
- take Ruin self-damage equal to **1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus**;
- one suitable focus, needle, talisman, weapon, or External Channel gains 1 Crack.
You may Overdraw when Unbound Trace hits.
---

### Ruin Channel
**Action Type:** Bonus Action
**Range:** Self or touch
**Cost:** None
**Duration:** Until the start of your next turn
You run Unmaking qi through one Channel you are touching.
Choose one:
- a held weapon;
- an unarmed strike;
- one hand or limb;
- a talisman, needle, chain, or tool;
- another object the GM agrees can briefly hold Unmaking qi.
The next time before the duration ends that you hit with that Channel, deal additional Ruin damage based on your Realm.
| Realm | Ruin Channel Bonus Damage |
|---|---:|
| Mortal | 2d8 |
| Foundation | 3d8 |
| Core Formation | 5d8 |
| Nascent Soul | 7d8 |
After the attack resolves, choose one cost:
- the Channel gains 1 Crack if it is an External Channel;
- you gain 1 Black Vein Strain if it is an Internal Channel;
- you take Ruin self-damage equal to **1d6 + your Proficiency Bonus**, and the Channel does not gain Crack or Strain.
If the attack misses, the Channel remains active until the duration ends. If the duration ends without a hit, you take Ruin self-damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Ruin Channel may be applied to a ranged weapon, thrown weapon, or ammunition only if you are touching it when you use the feature.
You may Overdraw when a Ruin Channel attack hits.

Action Type: No Action
Factory Combat Bucket: passive
Factory Routing: passive_or_triggered_modifier_row

Use Limit: Once per turn

Cost: 0 CP

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Verdant Growth Qi Expression: Primary — Verdant Qi; Supporting — Wood Qi, Life Qi, Root Qi, Seasonal Qi. “A stone endures by refusing to move. A tree endures by learning where to bend, where to root, and when to split the sky.” Common Name: Wood / Plant Growth Sphere Sphere Type: Living Terrain / Cultivation Sphere Rules Baseline: 2024 fifth-edition rules (5.5e) Primary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: Body Refining Resource: CP unless a feature says otherwiseCore Mechanic: Living Medium and Growth MarksCommon Expressions: roots, vines, seedlings, cultivated trees, medicinal shoots, climbing paths, living screens, brambles, grafted bark, sheltering canopies, seed-script, seasonal growth, cultivated groves, overgrowth pressure ### Verdant Growth Dao Verdant Growth is the cultivation of the living line. A novice thinks plant growth means making vines appear. An adept understands that a plant is a decision made slowly enough that the world calls it natural. A root chooses downward. A shoot chooses upward. A branch chooses division. A vine chooses contact. A seed chooses delay. A forest chooses cooperation by becoming too large for a single creature to name. The Sphere of Verdant Growth governs: seeds and germination; roots, vines, shoots, branches, thorns, bark, canopies, and cultivated groves; growth that follows a surface, wound, trellis, weapon, wall, corpse, field, or vow; living screens and shelters; climbing and bridging through plant structure; restraint through roots and tendrils; nourishment, recovery, and medicinal growth; cultivated terrain; overgrowth that claims neglected ground; grafts, root-lines, seasonal pulses, and inheritance orchards. Verdant Growth is not merely “plant control.” It asks: What is allowed to take root, and what shape will it grow into once it is fed? #### Sphere Sentence Verdant Growth cultivators plant a living claim, feed it with Growth Marks, and decide whether the living line roots, climbs, shelters, blooms, or overruns. ### Sphere Boundaries Verdant Growth overlaps with many spheres, but it does not replace them. | Sphere | Difference from Verdant Growth | | --- | --- | | Earth | Earth carries weight, foundation, ground, and burden. Verdant Growth grows through living medium and trained life. | | Water | Water nourishes, flows, cleanses, and erodes. Verdant Growth drinks water, but its identity is growth direction, roots, branches, and cultivated life. | | Wood / Objects | Ordinary wood is material. Verdant Growth concerns living wood, awakened seeds, grafts, roots, vines, and plant bodies. | | Flowers | Flowers may govern beauty, pollen, fragrance, symbolism, attraction, and delicate bloom. Verdant Growth is broader roots, vines, trees, crops, shelter, and overgrowth. | | Life | Life restores flesh, vitality, and living creatures broadly. Verdant Growth may nourish or stabilize, but only through plant life, growth, and cultivated living structures. | | Beastmastery | Beastmastery bonds with animals and beasts. Verdant Growth cultivates plant bodies and living terrain. | | Poison | Poison corrupts, sickens, and toxins. Verdant Growth may grow poisonous plants only through explicit talents or cross-sphere techniques. | | Nature / Survival | Survival is knowledge and fieldcraft. Verdant Growth makes living claims through cultivation. | | Protection | Protection wards and shields. Verdant Growth shelters by growing cover, roots, bark, and canopy. | | Force | Force answers impact directly. Verdant Growth redirects force through rooted growth, bending, and living structure. | | Yang | Yang kindles completion, vitality, and surplus expression. Verdant Growth gives that vitality a branching living form. | | Yin | Yin receives overextension and makes consequence incomplete. Verdant Growth receives nourishment and pressure and turns them into new living direction. | | Formations | Formations create maintained arrays and structures. Verdant Growth can provide groves, anchors, living walls, and seed-script, but does not replace Formation design. | Verdant Growth may use Piercing damage, Poisoned, Restrained, difficult terrain, cover, temporary hit points, healing, climbing, plant growth, or concealment as expressions. Those mechanics are not the sphere identity. The sphere identity is cultivated living direction. ### Rules Retained from Fifth Edition This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline. Verdant Growth talents supplement the normal rules for: movement; difficult terrain; Grappled and Restrained; Cover; objects and object damage; climbing; jumping; Prone; Opportunity Attacks; Concentration; healing and Temporary HP; Poisoned; obscurement; terrain and environmental hazards; the Hide, Search, Study, and Utilize actions. A Verdant Growth feature replaces a normal rule only when it explicitly says so. #### Verdant Growth Does Not Automatically Do These Things Unless a Verdant Growth feature says otherwise, Verdant Growth does not automatically: create permanent plants; create food, wealth, lumber, medicine, or cultivation materials with lasting economic value; heal creatures; remove disease, poison, curses, or exhaustion; restrain creatures; knock creatures Prone; create cover; create difficult terrain; block line of sight; block line of effect; control animals; control all plants in an area; make plants sentient; make a creature Hidden or Invisible; create a safe bridge across any distance; bore tunnels through stone; replace agriculture, apothecary craft, alchemy, Survival, or Medicine; function in a lifeless void without a feature that permits it; project qi outside a Body Refiner’s body without explicit permission. #### Living Medium Verdant Growth requires a Living Medium unless a feature says otherwise. A Living Medium is one of the following: living plants; fertile soil, loam, moss, fungus, roots, reeds, grass, bark, or seed-bearing ground; a wooden object, wooden weapon, staff, shield, paper talisman, or plant-fiber object you are touching or holding; seeds, cuttings, sap, living grafts, medicinal herbs, or cultivated plant matter you are carrying; your own body if you have a Verdant Growth talent that makes it a living graft or root vessel; a creature or object you touch that bears a Growth Mark; a temporary Living Claim created by Verdant Growth. Unless a feature says otherwise, a Living Claim cannot begin on bare metal, polished glass, clean ice, open air, empty space, or sterile stone that has no cracks, soil, plant matter, or carried seed to receive it. A feature may allow growth to cross such surfaces after it begins in a legal medium. #### Temporary Cultivation Growth Plants created by this sphere are supernatural cultivation growth. Unless a feature says otherwise, they wither, shed seed-dust, turn to harmless fiber, or sink into the earth when the feature ends. They cannot be harvested for profit, permanent medicine, rare lumber, poisons, food stores, or cultivation ingredients unless the GM uses a separate downtime or project system. #### Projected Verdant Growth Some talents are tagged Projected. A Projected talent creates or controls growth away from your body, touch, held object, or existing Living Medium. A Body Refiner cannot learn or use Projected Verdant Growth by default unless one of the following explicitly permits it: a Body Refining Path feature; a Cultivation Insight; a forged technique; a Realm evolution; a Spirit Awakening or Qi Cultivation synergy; a GM-granted breakthrough. This restriction exists to preserve the Tianxia assumption that Body Refining normally cultivates the body rather than manipulating qi freely outside it. ## CORE VERDANT GROWTH RULES ### Verdant Growth Save DC When a Verdant Growth talent calls for a saving throw, use your Cultivation Save DC unless a Path feature says otherwise. 8 + key ability modifier + Proficiency Bonus Typical key abilities: Qi Cultivation: Intelligence or Charisma; Spirit Awakening: Wisdom; Body Refining: Constitution for body, graft, contact, and held-object expressions. ### Living Claims A Living Claim is a temporary plant-growth point created by Verdant Growth. A Living Claim might appear as a seed sprout, root knot, moss patch, reed cluster, vine-ring, bark seal, herb bloom, or tiny sapling. Unless a talent says otherwise: a Living Claim occupies one 5-foot square or one object no larger than Medium; it must begin in a legal Living Medium; it lasts for 1 minute; it is obvious to creatures that can see the space unless hidden by terrain, obscurement, or a feature; it counts as plant matter for your Verdant Growth talents; it is not automatically difficult terrain, cover, restraint, food, medicine, or an obstacle. A creature may destroy an unattended Living Claim by dealing damage to it. A basic Living Claim has: AC 10; HP equal to 5 + your Proficiency Bonus + your key ability modifier, minimum 5; vulnerability to Fire damage unless a feature says otherwise; immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. ### Growth Marks A Growth Mark represents a living claim finding nourishment, contact, direction, or leverage. A creature, object, or space can have Growth Marks from you. Unless a feature says otherwise: a target can hold a maximum number of your Growth Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus; Growth Marks last until the end of your next turn; when you spend a Growth Mark, remove it; you can spend only your own Growth Marks; a Growth Mark is not a condition; a Growth Mark is visible as root-lines, leaf-veins, seed sparks, bark grain, creeping moss, or spiritual sprouting unless a feature says otherwise. #### Placing Growth Marks Your Verdant Growth features tell you when they place Growth Marks. The most common triggers are: you hit a creature with a Verdant Growth attack; a creature enters, exits, or starts its turn in one of your Living Claims; an ally accepts shelter or nourishment from your Living Claim; a creature damages, burns, uproots, or tramples one of your Living Claims; a creature uses a hostile movement or attack while in contact with your Living Claim; a creature willingly tears through your growth instead of going around it. ### Verdant Responses Many Verdant Growth talents allow you to spend Growth Marks on Verdant Responses. Unless a talent says otherwise, use no more than one Verdant Response per turn. #### Root Spend 1 Growth Mark on a creature you can see within 60 feet. Reduce the creature’s Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. If the creature is touching a Living Claim, a plant, soil, wood, or your body, reduce its Speed by 15 feet instead. #### Bind Spend 2 Growth Marks on a creature you can see within 60 feet. The creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: The creature is Grappled by your growth until the end of your next turn. The escape DC is your Verdant Growth Save DC. Successful Save: The creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn. This grapple ends early if the relevant Living Claim is destroyed or the creature is no longer in contact with a legal medium. #### Shelter Spend 1 Growth Mark on a space, object, or ally you can see within 60 feet that is touching a Living Claim or legal Living Medium. Raise leaves, bark, vines, reeds, or branches until the start of your next turn. Choose one: the ally gains Half Cover against one attack; the ally gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; the space becomes Lightly Obscured. Shelter does not block line of effect unless a feature says otherwise. #### Climb Spend 1 Growth Mark on a Living Claim or legal medium within 60 feet. Until the end of your next turn, a creature of your choice may climb through that space, along that wall, or across that surface without needing a Climb Speed, treating it as a rough natural ladder. This does not create a bridge over open space unless a talent says otherwise. #### Bloom Spend 1 Growth Mark on a Living Claim or marked creature within 60 feet. Choose one creature within 10 feet of it. That creature gains Advantage on its next Wisdom (Perception), Wisdom (Survival), Intelligence (Nature), or Wisdom (Medicine) check before the end of your next turn. Alternatively, the bloom releases bright petals, pollen, spores, leaves, or seed-lights, revealing one Invisible creature or object in the same 5-foot space until the end of the current turn. This does not end the Invisible condition. #### Thorn Spend 1 Growth Mark on a creature in contact with your Living Claim, a plant, wood, soil, or your body. The creature takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. At CL 5, increase this to 1d6 + Proficiency Bonus. At CL 11, increase this to 2d6 + Proficiency Bonus. At CL 17, increase this to 3d6 + Proficiency Bonus. Thorn is a consequence of growth gripping and splitting around pressure. It is not the sphere identity. ## BASE SPHERE ABILITIES ### Sow Living Claim Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch or 30 feet, depending on Path and medium Duration: 1 minute Cost: 0 CP Create one Living Claim in a legal Living Medium.
