The damage increases at higher level: | CL | Damage | | --- | --- | | 1-4 | 1d6 | | 5-10 | 2d6 | | 11-16 | 3d6 | | 17+ | 4d6 | If you use Seed-Thorn Strike through a wooden weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, thorn graft, or held plant medium, use the weapon’s normal reach or range. This version is not Projected. If you use Seed-Thorn Strike at range without a thrown/shot object or existing Living Medium, it is Projected. ### Feed the Root Action Type: No Action Factory Combat Bucket: passive Factory Routing: passive_or_triggered_modifier_row Trigger: You place a Growth Mark on a creature, object, or space touching one of your Living Claims Use Limit: Once per turn Choose one of your Living Claims within 60 feet. It gains one Root Feed until the end of your next turn. A Living Claim can hold Root Feed up to your Proficiency Bonus. When you use a Verdant Response from or through that Living Claim, you may spend 1 Root Feed as if it were 1 Growth Mark on the affected creature, space, or object. Root Feed represents the growth itself being fed by pressure, blood, breath, water, motion, or attention. ## VERDANT GROWTH TALENT TAGS ### Root Talents Root talents slow, anchor, grapple, stabilize, or connect creatures to a medium. ### Vine Talents Vine talents move, climb, drag, swing, bridge, or connect spaces. ### Canopy Talents Canopy talents shelter, obscure, shield, or build living cover. ### Bloom Talents Bloom talents reveal, nourish, medicate, signal, or create sensory and seasonal expressions. ### Thorn Talents Thorn talents punish tearing through growth, striking into living claims, or ignoring rooted consequence. ### Graft Talents Graft talents modify the cultivator’s body, held wooden objects, armor, or allies through controlled living growth. ### Projected Talents Projected talents extend Verdant Growth beyond body, touch, held object, or existing Living Medium. Body Refiners require explicit permission to learn or use Projected talents. ### Realm Evolutions Realm Evolutions scale the sphere’s core behavior without abandoning the chassis. ## MORTAL REALM TALENTS ### Root-Snare Step - Root When a creature with one of your Growth Marks willingly moves 10 feet or more on its turn, spend 1 Growth Mark. The creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Its movement ends after the current 5-foot step. Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the turn. Root-Snare Step does not stop teleportation. ### Bark-Back Guard - Canopy, Graft When you create a Living Claim on your body, armor, held shield, or held wooden object, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. While you have those Temporary HP, the first creature that hits you with a melee attack takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Use Bark-Back Guard once per round. ### Green Ladder - Vine When you use the Climb Verdant Response, the chosen creature also gains Advantage on the first Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check it makes to climb, balance, or move along the created growth before the end of your next turn. At CL 5+, the creature may move 5 feet as part of the response. ### Thorned Warning - Thorn When a creature damages or destroys one of your Living Claims, place 1 Growth Mark on that creature if it is within 60 feet and you can perceive it. If you spend that Growth Mark with Thorn before the end of your next turn, add your key ability modifier to the damage. ### Medicinal Sprout - Bloom When you use Shelter on an ally, choose to grow cooling leaves, clotting fiber, bitter herbs, or calming flowers. The ally gains Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn against Poisoned, disease, exhaustion from environmental exposure, or ongoing poison damage. Medicinal Sprout does not remove a condition by itself. ### Reed Screen - Canopy When you use Shelter to make a space Lightly Obscured, choose to make the screen thicker. The space remains Lightly Obscured for 1 minute or until your Living Claim is destroyed. A creature can clear one 5-foot square of Reed Screen by using the Utilize action or by dealing at least 5 Slashing, Fire, or Acid damage to the growth. ### Seed Pouch Method - Graft You carry cultivated seeds, knots, cuttings, bark slips, dried moss, and herb strings prepared for Verdant Growth. You always count as carrying a legal Living Medium for non-Projected Verdant Growth talents unless you are deprived of your equipment. In addition, you can use Sow Living Claim on your own space even on sterile ground. ### Staff Becomes Branch - Graft A staff, club, spear haft, wooden shield, bow, instrument, paper fan, brush, or similar plant-derived object you hold can serve as a Living Medium. Once per turn when you hit with a weapon made mostly of wood, place 1 Growth Mark on the target. This does not change the weapon’s damage type unless another feature says otherwise. ### Soft Step Under Leaves - Canopy While you are within 5 feet of one of your Living Claims, you may take the Hide action even if only Lightly Obscured by your own Verdant Growth. You must still meet the other requirements of the Hide action, and a creature that can clearly see your space may still find you normally. ### Farmer’s Patient Hand Gain proficiency in Wisdom (Survival), Intelligence (Nature), Wisdom (Medicine), or an appropriate tool such as herbalism kit, woodcarver’s tools, carpenter’s tools, or farming implements. If you already have proficiency in the chosen option, gain Expertise instead. Outside combat, you can identify ordinary crops, poisonous plants, medicinal herbs, plant diseases, soil exhaustion, grafting signs, and cultivation-assisted growth with a successful Study action. ## FOUNDATION REALM TALENTS ### Rooted Lineage Scripture - Root, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Your Growth Marks last until the end of your next turn plus one additional round while the marked creature remains in contact with a Living Claim, plant, soil, wood, or your body. When a marked enemy starts its turn in contact with one of your Living Claims, reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the end of that turn. ### Vine Bridge - Vine Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 1 CP Create a temporary vine, root, branch, or reed bridge up to 30 feet long and 5 feet wide between two legal anchor points. The bridge lasts for 1 minute. It can support creatures and objects up to a total weight appropriate for a normal wooden bridge of its size, as determined by the GM. A creature may destroy a 5-foot section of the bridge. Each section has AC 12 and HP equal to 10 + your CL. If you create this bridge without an existing Living Medium at both anchor points, it is Projected. ### Bramble Refusal - Thorn, Root Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a creature with one of your Growth Marks makes a melee attack against you or an ally adjacent to one of your Living Claims, spend 1 Growth Mark. The creature takes 1d8 Piercing damage and makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: It has Disadvantage on the triggering attack. Successful Save: No additional effect. ### Shelter-Grove Posture - Canopy Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you use Shelter on an ally, choose two Shelter options instead of one. If one option grants Half Cover, that cover applies only to one attack or one Dexterity saving throw before the start of your next turn. ### Graft the Wound Shut - Bloom, Graft Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Cost: 1 CP Touch one willing creature or yourself. The target spends one Hit Die and regains HP equal to the roll plus your key ability modifier. If the target is touching one of your Living Claims or a carried Living Medium, add your Proficiency Bonus to the HP regained. This is plant-assisted stabilization and medicinal growth. It does not regrow limbs, cure disease, remove curses, or restore a creature to life. ### Hungry Root Drinks the Spill - Root, Bloom Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a creature within 60 feet regains HP while touching one of your Living Claims, you may place 1 Growth Mark on that creature or on the Living Claim. If the creature is unwilling, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Successful Save: No mark is placed. This talent does not reduce the healing. ### Wild Trellis Step - Vine Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you move while touching a Living Claim, plant, wooden object, soil, or your own grafted growth, you may move across vertical surfaces and uneven plant growth during the current turn without falling during the movement. If you end the turn without a surface that could support you, you fall normally. ### Cultivated Overgrowth - Projected, Root Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 20-foot square touching a legal Living Medium Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP The area fills with roots, vines, grass, reeds, fungus, moss, or low branches. The area is difficult terrain for enemies of your choice. The first time an enemy enters the area on a turn or starts its turn there, place 1 Growth Mark on it. A creature may use its Action to clear one 5-foot square. If no Living Medium exists in the area before casting, this talent is Projected. ### Seed-Script Marker - Bloom Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may create small seed-script marks on plants, bark, paper, wooden objects, soil, or carried seeds. A seed-script mark may store a simple message of up to 25 words, a scent trail, or a harmless visual sign visible only to creatures you designate. The mark lasts 24 hours, or 7 days if placed during downtime with proper tools and no combat pressure. This does not create a magical trap by itself. ### Willow-Bend Defense - Graft Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you are pushed, pulled, knocked Prone, or moved against your will while touching a Living Medium, reduce the forced movement by 10 feet. If this reduces the movement to 0, place 1 Growth Mark on the creature or effect’s origin if you can perceive it and it is within 60 feet. ## CORE FORMATION REALM TALENTS ### Grove Domain: Court of Root and Branch - Realm Evolution “Within the grove, every path is a promise made to the roots.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Self Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you Duration: 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Use Limit: Once per short rest A temporary cultivation grove grows through legal Living Mediums in the area. If the area contains no legal medium, the Domain begins from your body, carried seeds, or touched ground and spreads as far as the GM agrees the scene can support. For the duration: create one Living Claim at the start of each of your turns without using a Bonus Action; enemies treat spaces containing your Living Claims as difficult terrain; when an enemy starts its turn in a Living Claim, place 1 Growth Mark on it; allies in a Living Claim gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns; once per round, use one Verdant Response without spending a Growth Mark. The Domain does not create permanent plants, food, lumber, medicine, or safe architecture. ### Forest Remembers the Path - Root, Vine Prerequisite: CL 10+ When a creature with one of your Growth Marks teleports, flies, jumps, or moves through a space within 60 feet, spend 1 Growth Mark. Choose one space the creature left or entered. Create a Living Claim there if the space can support it. If the movement was teleportation, the Living Claim forms at the departure or arrival point after the movement resolves. This does not prevent the teleportation. ### Canopy of Ten Thousand Leaves - Canopy Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 20-foot-radius Emanation from a Living Claim Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP A canopy of leaves, branches, reeds, or spirit-boughs spreads from the claim. Choose any number of creatures when you create the canopy. Chosen creatures gain Half Cover while inside. Other creatures treat the area as Lightly Obscured. Ranged attacks passing through at least 10 feet of the canopy have Disadvantage unless the attacker is inside the canopy and attacking a target inside the canopy. Fire damage that affects the canopy deals damage to the Living Claim normally and may destroy sections at the GM’s discretion. ### Deep Root Holds the Gate - Root Prerequisite: CL 10+ When a creature with at least 2 of your Growth Marks attempts to leave a space adjacent to one of your Living Claims, spend 2 Growth Marks. The creature makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: The creature is Restrained until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: The creature is Grappled until the end of the current turn. The restrained creature may repeat the saving throw at the end of its turn, ending the effect on a success. ### Orchard of Bitter Medicine - Bloom Prerequisite: CL 10+, Graft the Wound Shut When you use Graft the Wound Shut, choose one additional benefit: end the Poisoned condition on the target; allow the target to repeat one saving throw against a disease or poison affecting it; reduce ongoing poison damage the target takes before the start of your next turn by 2d8 + your key ability modifier; remove one Growth Mark from the target and grant Temporary HP equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus. This does not cure magical disease, curses, or corruption unless the GM rules the affliction is plant, poison, or disease based. ### Thorn Crown Reversal - Thorn Prerequisite: CL 10+ When a marked enemy deals damage to one of your allies within 60 feet and either the enemy or ally is touching one of your Living Claims, spend up to 3 Growth Marks from the enemy. For each mark spent: reduce the damage by your Proficiency Bonus; the enemy takes Piercing damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Rooted Witness Grove - Bloom, Spirit Prerequisite: CL 10+ You can Study a Living Claim to learn what passed near it. As an Action, touch one of your Living Claims that lasted at least 1 minute. Ask one of the following questions about events since the claim was created: which creatures passed within 10 feet of it; whether blood was spilled nearby; whether Fire damage affected the area; whether a creature lied, wept, prayed, or swore an oath within 10 feet; whether an undead, construct, fiend, celestial, fey, or spirit passed nearby. The answer is sensory and plantlike: pressure, scent, tremor, sap-memory, pollen, or leaf direction. It does not identify a creature by name unless the plant already knew that creature. ### Verdant Crafting Posture Prerequisite: CL 10+ During downtime, use Verdant Growth to assist agriculture, grafting, medicine preparation, orchard design, living architecture, paper cultivation, woodcraft, or herbal work. This does not replace tool checks. When you use an appropriate tool proficiency or skill for such work, add your Proficiency Bonus again if you are already proficient, or gain proficiency for that check if you are not. Long-term benefits require downtime, materials, land, caretakers, and GM approval. ### Branching Answer Scripture - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 12+ When you use a Verdant Response, choose a second different Verdant Response and apply it to the same target, Living Claim, or ally without spending an additional Growth Mark. Use Branching Answer Scripture once per round. ## NASCENT SOUL REALM TALENTS ### Verdant Incarnation: Body Becomes the Ancient Tree Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 6 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest Your body becomes a living scripture of bark, leaf, root, flower, and seed. For the duration: your reach with non-Projected Verdant Growth talents increases by 10 feet; you count as a Living Medium for all your Verdant Growth talents; you may create one Living Claim on your body at the start of each of your turns without spending an action; you gain Resistance to Poison damage and Advantage on saving throws against Poisoned; when a creature hits you with a melee attack, place 1 Growth Mark on it; when you spend Growth Marks on Root, Bind, Shelter, Bloom, or Thorn, treat the number of marks spent as one higher, maximum +1 per response. While this incarnation is active, Fire damage you take prevents you from gaining the free Living Claim at the start of your next turn. ### Forest Without Center Prerequisite: Grove Domain: Court of Root and Branch, CL 15+ When your Grove Domain is active, choose up to three Living Claims inside it. Each chosen claim becomes a Grove Node. Once on each of your turns, originate a Verdant Growth talent or Verdant Response from one Grove Node instead of yourself. A Body Refiner may use this only while the Grove Node remains connected to the Body Refiner by contiguous plant growth, touched ground, roots, wooden surfaces, or an active Domain line. ### Thousand-Root Prison Prerequisite: Deep Root Holds the Gate, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Target: One creature with at least 3 of your Growth Marks Cost: 5 CP The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: The target is Restrained for 1 minute by roots, vines, bark hoops, reeds, or living grafts. Successful Save: The target is Grappled until the end of your next turn. A restrained target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success. If the target teleports, the roots tear away and the effect ends, but the target takes 4d10 Piercing damage. Thousand-Root Prison does not prevent teleportation unless another feature says otherwise. ### Spring After Calamity Prerequisite: Orchard of Bitter Medicine, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 30-foot radius centered on a Living Claim Cost: 6 CP Use Limit: Once per long rest A burst of spring growth restores breath and direction. Choose up to six creatures in the area. Each chosen creature gains one of the following benefits: spend up to two Hit Dice and regain HP normally; end the Poisoned condition; stand from Prone without spending movement; move up to half its Speed without provoking opportunity attacks from creatures with your Growth Marks; gain Temporary HP equal to 2 x your CL. This feature does not restore dead creatures, regrow limbs, remove curses, cure all disease, or replace Life sphere healing. ### Wood Dragon Climbs the Sky Prerequisite: CL 15+, Vine Bridge or Wild Trellis Step Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 5 CP A massive vine, root, branch, bamboo column, or spirit tree-line climbs through legal anchor points. Create a connected path up to 120 feet long and 10 feet wide. The path may rise vertically, curve around obstacles, and cross gaps if both ends are anchored in legal medium or a Grove Node. Allies treat the path as normal terrain. Enemies treat it as difficult terrain. The first time an enemy enters the path on a turn or starts its turn there, place 1 Growth Mark on it. A 10-foot section has AC 14 and HP equal to 20 + your CL. If created without legal anchors or Grove Nodes, this talent is Projected. ### Inheritance Orchard Preparation Prerequisite: CL 15+ During downtime, plant an inheritance orchard, living archive, medicinal grove, temple tree, root-library, or clan shelter. This is not an ordinary combat talent and does not complete instantly. A completed project may provide story benefits such as: shelter for refugees; medicinal herb production; seed-script records; training grounds for Verdant Growth disciples; grove nodes for Formations; living witnesses to oaths; seasonal fruit that supports cultivation sessions; a sanctuary against poison, famine, drought, or corruption. The GM sets time, cost, land, caretakers, enemies, and maintenance requirements. ## SECRET VERDANT GROWTH INHERITANCE ### The Seed That Remembers the Forest “A single seed falls. The forest that has not yet been born recognizes its ancestor.” Classification: Secret Verdant Growth Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Grove Domain: Court of Root and Branch, Rooted Witness Grove, hidden seed-line scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 300 feet Area: Up to a 120-foot-radius area containing at least one legal Living Medium, Grove Node, seed, corpse, root, wooden object, or willing living creature Duration: 1 minute Cost: 10 CP Use Limit: Once per week You plant one impossible seed of your Dao into the battlefield. The area becomes a nascent forest of root-lines, branch choices, medicinal bloom, thorn law, and living witness. For the duration: create up to six Living Claims anywhere in the area when the inheritance begins; every creature of your choice that starts its turn in the area gains 1 Growth Mark; allies of your choice in the area gain Temporary HP equal to your CL at the start of their turns; enemies treat your Living Claims as difficult terrain; once per round, when an enemy with a Growth Mark damages an ally, use one Verdant Response without spending a Reaction or Growth Mark; when a creature with at least 3 Growth Marks would be reduced to 0 HP, you may either allow the death or bind it in roots at 1 HP and Restrained until the inheritance ends. When the inheritance ends, choose one of the following: the growth withers, leaving harmless leaves, seed-dust, broken roots, and disturbed soil; one noncombat seedling remains as a story mark; one willing creature carries a harmless seed-script memory of what happened; the GM preserves a living consequence for future story. The inheritance does not create permanent resources, a finished forest, free food, rare herbs, or a safe settlement unless the GM makes it the seed of a separate project. ## VERDANT GROWTH DRAWBACKS AND VARIANT SCRIPTURES Verdant Growth variants are optional cultivation scriptures that change how the sphere manifests. They are Tianxia-specific design tools inspired by drawback design, not imported casting-tradition rules. A Verdant Growth variant should grant a real benefit only if it also gives a real limitation. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Verdant Growth variant when you first learn the sphere or undergo a major Verdant initiation; variants are mutually exclusive; the drawback applies to all Verdant Growth talents you use; if a variant grants a talent whose prerequisites are not yet met, gain it when you meet them; if the drawback is retrained or removed, lose the bonus talent or benefit. ### Garden-Tender Scripture You cultivate growth as shelter, food, and medicine rather than battlefield overgrowth. You gain Medicinal Sprout as a bonus talent. When you use Shelter on an ally, increase the Temporary HP option by your key ability modifier. #### Drawback: Vow of the Tended Garden Your growth resists needless harm. You cannot use Thorn or a Verdant Growth talent to deal damage to a living creature unless that creature has damaged another creature, destroyed a Living Claim, willingly entered your hostile growth, spent CP, used a spell slot, used a supernatural feature, or caused a hostile effect since the start of its last turn. This restriction does not prevent you from: placing Growth Marks; using Root, Bind, Shelter, Climb, or Bloom; damaging undead, constructs, objects, barriers, poisons, diseases, hostile plants, hostile Formations, or environmental hazards; using plants for shelter, food projects, medicine projects, or protection. ### Thorn-Hedge Scripture You cultivate growth as refusal and punishment. You gain Thorned Warning as a bonus talent. When a creature takes damage from Thorn, it also loses 5 feet of Speed until the start of your next turn. #### Drawback: Fruitless Hedge Your growth is hard, bitter, and defensive. You cannot use Verdant Growth talents to restore HP, grant Hit Dice healing, produce medicinal benefits, or create peaceful food-bearing growth unless another sphere, item, project, or GM permission supports it. You may still grant Temporary HP through bark, shelter, and defensive growth. ### Wild Overgrowth Scripture You cultivate unpruned expansion. You gain Cultivated Overgrowth as a bonus talent when you meet its prerequisites. When you create difficult terrain with Verdant Growth, increase one affected area’s size by one 5-foot square or increase one radius by 5 feet. #### Drawback: Unpruned Path Your growth is difficult to spare from allies. The first time you create an area of difficult terrain with Verdant Growth in an encounter, choose either yourself or one ally to ignore it. All other allies are affected normally unless a later feature or action creates a safe path. ### Grafted Body Scripture You cultivate plants through the body first. You gain Bark-Back Guard as a bonus talent. You always count as a Living Medium for non-Projected Verdant Growth talents. #### Drawback: Body Is the Root You cannot use Projected Verdant Growth talents unless you are physically connected to the target space by your body, a held object, contiguous plant growth, roots, vines, wooden surfaces, or a touched Living Claim. If that connection is severed, your Projected Verdant effects from this sphere end at the end of your next turn unless you reestablish a legal connection. ### Silent Seed Scripture You cultivate delayed growth, hidden roots, and patient ambush. You gain Seed-Script Marker as a bonus talent. When you create a Living Claim outside combat and leave it undisturbed for at least 1 minute, the first Study or Search check made to notice it has Disadvantage. #### Drawback: Slow Germination During the first round of combat, your Sow Living Claim requires an Action instead of a Bonus Action unless you begin the encounter with a prepared seed-script mark, carried Living Medium, or existing plant in hand. You also cannot use Seed-Thorn Strike as a Projected attack during the first round of combat. ## PATH SYNERGIES ### Body Refining - Bark-Bone Graft A Body Refiner may cultivate Verdant Growth as living graft, bark skin, root muscle, thorn marrow, seed blood, and wooden weapon discipline. Use Constitution as your Verdant Growth key ability for: non-Projected talents; Graft talents; Verdant Growth attacks made with your body, natural weapon, unarmed strike, or held wooden weapon; Living Claims on your body, armor, or held objects. While one of your Living Claims is on your body, gain one of the following at the start of your turn: Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; Advantage on one Strength saving throw before the start of your next turn; reduce forced movement by 5 feet. Body Refining does not grant free Projected Verdant Growth. ### Qi Cultivation - Seed-Script Circulation A Qi cultivator may circulate qi through seeds, roots, paper talismans, wooden tools, medicinal herbs, and living claims. Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Verdant Growth key ability. When you create a Living Claim in a legal Living Medium within 30 feet, you may extend the range to 60 feet by spending 1 CP. Once per turn when you place a Growth Mark through a Projected talent, choose one: move the mark to another creature touching the same Living Claim; add 5 feet to the range of one Verdant Response before the end of the turn; reduce the CP cost of your next Verdant Growth talent before the end of your next turn by 1, minimum 0. ### Spirit Awakening - Root-Soul Listening A Spirit Awakener may perceive the life-pressure of roots, oaths, grief, hunger, and patient growth. Use Wisdom as your Verdant Growth key ability. When a creature gains one of your Growth Marks, learn one immediate truth: whether it is wounded below half HP; whether it intends to flee; whether it is protecting another creature; whether it is afraid of restraint, exposure, poison, fire, or hunger; whether it has damaged a plant, corpse, field, grove, or living claim in the last hour. This reads immediate pressure and spiritual growth-patterns, not private thoughts. Once per round when an ally accepts Shelter or Bloom from your Living Claim, you may also grant that ally Advantage on one Wisdom saving throw before the start of your next turn. ## CULTIVATION INSIGHTS ### Root-and-Branch Adept Prerequisite: Verdant Growth sphere, CL 4+ Increase the maximum number of Living Claims you may maintain by 1. Once per short rest, when you create a Living Claim, immediately place 1 Growth Mark on one creature or object touching it. ### Herbal Scripture Keeper Prerequisite: Verdant Growth sphere, Farmer’s Patient Hand, CL 4+ Gain proficiency with herbalism kit or Medicine. If already proficient, gain Expertise. During a short rest, prepare a number of harmless herbal aids equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature may consume one aid during the next 24 hours to gain Advantage on one saving throw against Poisoned or disease before the end of its next turn. These aids lose potency after 24 hours and cannot be sold as permanent medicine. ### Graft-Bodied Cultivator Prerequisite: Verdant Growth sphere, Body Refining Path, CL 6+ Your body counts as a Living Medium for all non-Projected Verdant Growth talents. When you use Bark-Back Guard, increase the Temporary HP gained by your Constitution modifier, minimum +1. ### Vine-Step Adept Prerequisite: Verdant Growth sphere, one Vine talent, CL 6+ Once per round when you use Climb or a Vine talent, move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from creatures touching one of your Living Claims. ### Garden-Warden Adept Prerequisite: Verdant Growth sphere, one Canopy or Bloom talent, CL 8+ When you use Shelter, choose one creature benefiting from it. That creature also gains Advantage on the next saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn against being Frightened, Poisoned, knocked Prone, or moved against its will. ### External Grove Breakthrough Prerequisite: Verdant Growth sphere, Body Refining Path, CL 8+, GM permission You have evolved beyond ordinary Body Refining limits enough to project a limited root-line outside your body. You may use Projected Verdant Growth talents if the target space is within 15 feet and there is a legal Living Medium, carried seed, touched ground, or active Living Claim between you and the target. This does not grant unrestricted ranged plant control. At CL 15+, increase the distance to 30 feet. ### Formation Grove Custodian Prerequisite: Verdant Growth sphere, Formations sphere or GM-approved Formation training, CL 8+ When helping design a Formation, you may use Living Claims, seed-script, roots, groves, paper talismans, cultivated trees, or orchard lines as anchors. This does not create the Formation automatically. It allows Verdant Growth to provide living infrastructure, vulnerabilities, maintenance needs, and seasonal behavior for a Formation project. ### Repeated Practitioner Behavior Every tier still asks the player to: plant or awaken growth; watch where pressure feeds it; mark the creature, object, or place where growth gains leverage; choose whether the living line roots, shelters, climbs, blooms, or overruns; scale from seed to grove to inheritance orchard. ### What Only Verdant Growth Should Be Known For Verdant Growth makes life-direction tactical. It is not merely vines, healing, thorns, or difficult terrain. ### Player Recognition Test A player should recognize a Verdant Growth cultivator because: the battlefield begins to grow around decisions; living claims become tactical nodes; movement feeds roots; wounds can become grafts or medicines; shelter grows rather than appears as a ward; Body Refiners cultivate bark, roots, and seed through their bodies rather than projecting free vines by default.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Void Qi Expression: Primary — Void Qi; Supporting — Absence Qi, Space Qi, Yin Qi, Nullification Qi. “The void is not darkness. Darkness is something. The void is the refusal to become anything at all.” Sphere Type: Secret Power Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Path: Spirit Awakening Rare Variant: Body Refining through Hollow-Meridian Body Resource: CP Common Effects: absence, Hollowed, nullification, cost denial, Temporary HP denial, CP recovery denial, barrier erosion, quiet gaps, anti-technique pressure, short void-steps, defensive nullification Void is the cultivation of absence. Dark hides what exists. Shadow gives the body another route. Space changes distance. Force answers pressure with pressure. Protection preserves what is behind the wall. Void denies purchase. A technique reaches for a cost reduction and finds nothing. A barrier tries to keep its shape and becomes thinner. A cultivator reaches for stored power and the meridian answers with silence. Void is a secret discipline in most sects because it attacks active techniques directly. It should feel precise, narrow, and frightening rather than broadly destructive. ### Void Dao Void is the cultivation of absence. It denies purchase: a technique reaches for a cost reduction and finds nothing, a barrier loses shape, and a meridian answers stored power with silence. ## Core Void Rules ### Void Safeguards Void attacks active advantages, not a character’s entire existence. Unless a talent explicitly says otherwise: Void cannot remove an entire Path. Void cannot remove an entire sphere. Void cannot permanently erase a creature. Void cannot automatically destroy an artifact. Void cannot automatically end a Domain, Secret Inheritance, Formation core, Realm-defining transformation, permanent karmic bond, or campaign-scale supernatural law. Void cannot suppress a permanent feature unless a talent permits a brief and narrow suppression. A creature affected by multiple Void effects suffers only the strongest version of the same named penalty. Void does not reveal a Hidden creature’s location unless a talent explicitly says so. ### Key Ability and Costs Use your Path key ability for Void talents. Qi Cultivation normally uses Intelligence or Charisma, chosen when the Path is selected. Spirit Awakening uses Wisdom. Hollow-Meridian Body uses Constitution. When a Void talent lists more than one possible cost, pay exactly one legal cost. Pay CP when using Qi or Resonance. Pay Stamina only when Hollow-Meridian Body, Void-Body Initiate, a Secret Inheritance, or another explicit feature permits it. Expend Martial Focus only when a talent lists that option. Never pay multiple listed costs unless the talent explicitly says otherwise. ### Hollowed Some Void talents make a creature Hollowed. Unless a talent says otherwise, Hollowed lasts until the start of your next turn. A Hollowed creature: cannot reduce CP, Stamina, or other printed technique costs below the listed cost; cannot regain CP or Stamina from ordinary temporary effects; cannot gain Temporary HP; cannot gain the Invisible condition from an ordinary temporary supernatural effect. Hollowed does not: reveal location; remove Cover; prevent mundane hiding; end an effect by itself; prevent normal healing unless a talent says so; interfere with long-rest restoration or a full cultivation session unless a special story effect extends Hollowed that long. ### Ordinary Temporary Effect An ordinary temporary effect is a nonpermanent spell, sphere talent, item activation, monster ability, stance, aura, or technique with a limited duration. Examples include: a temporary AC bonus; Temporary HP; a temporary Speed bonus; a temporary damage reduction; a temporary Resistance; a temporary source of Invisible; a temporary cost reduction; a short-lived supernatural aura. Unless a talent says otherwise, ordinary temporary effect does not include: a Domain; a Secret Inheritance; an artifact; a Formation core; a Path feature; a permanent class or species feature; a Realm-defining transformation; a permanent karmic bond. ### Barrier, Domain, and Formation Anchor Cross-References A Barrier is a temporary supernatural barrier, including a Protection-sphere Barrier or another effect that explicitly identifies itself as a Barrier. A Domain is a high-rank cultivation effect that says it is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove a Domain unless the technique explicitly says otherwise. A Formation Anchor is a point, object, creature, or prepared location explicitly identified as an anchor by a Formation rule, a project, or the GM. ### Void Damage and Resistance Void talents usually deal Force, Necrotic, or Psychic damage. When a Void talent says it ignores ordinary Resistance, it means Resistance created by an ordinary temporary effect. It does not ignore innate Resistance, Immunity, artifacts, Secret Inheritances, Domains, or Realm-defining protections unless the talent explicitly says so. ### Empty Step and Teleportation Empty Step is teleportation. Unless a talent says otherwise: it requires an unoccupied destination you can see; it does not provoke Opportunity Attacks; it cannot cross Total Cover; it cannot cross a sealed barrier; it cannot cross a Dimensional Lock or similar anti-teleportation effect. ### Special Attacks When a talent says it is a Special Attack, replace one attack when you take the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different Action Type. ## Base Sphere Abilities ### Void Training When you learn Void: gain Void Needle; learn one Mortal Realm Void talent for which you meet the prerequisites; choose Force, Necrotic, or Psychic as your default Void damage type. Whenever a Void talent lets you choose Force, Necrotic, or Psychic damage, you may use your default type without deciding again. ### Void Needle Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Target: One creature, object, or temporary Barrier Cost: None Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal damage of your default Void type. CL: 1-4; Damage: 1d8 CL: 5-10; Damage: 2d8 CL: 11-16; Damage: 3d8 CL: 17+; Damage: 4d8 Once per turn when Void Needle hits, choose one Void Pressure. #### Empty Vitality The target cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn. #### Cost Lock The target cannot reduce CP, Stamina, or other printed technique costs below the listed cost until the start of your next turn. #### Unsettle Invisibility The target cannot gain the Invisible condition from an ordinary temporary supernatural effect until the start of your next turn. This does not reveal a creature that is already Hidden. #### Fray Barrier If the target is a temporary Barrier, reduce its HP by your Proficiency Bonus in addition to the damage dealt. ## Void Talent Tags ### Hollow Talents Hollow talents apply Hollowed or exploit a Hollowed target. ### Null Talents Null talents erode temporary supernatural benefits, reduce barriers, suppress narrow active effects, or interfere with cost manipulation. ### Gap Talents Gap talents create short missing-step movement, displacement, or forced-positioning effects. ### Ward Talents Ward talents protect by denying part of an incoming effect. ### Quiet Talents Quiet talents create sensory absence, muted communication, and unreliable perception. ### Realm Evolutions Realm Evolutions change how Void functions at Foundation Realm or higher. ### Unique Void Talents Unique talents do not fit cleanly into another tag. ## Mortal Realm Void Talents ### Hollow Touch - Hollow Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target becomes Hollowed until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The target cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn. ### Empty Step - Gap Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 20 feet Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina Teleport to an unoccupied space you can see within range. This is teleportation and follows the Empty Step rules above. ### Erode Technique - Null Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within 60 feet gains Temporary HP, damage reduction, an AC bonus, a Speed bonus, Resistance, Invisible, or a cost reduction from an ordinary temporary effect Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina Choose one benefit created by the triggering effect. Apply one option: reduce Temporary HP gained by your Proficiency Bonus; reduce one damage reduction by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of your next turn; reduce one AC bonus by 1 until the start of your next turn; reduce one Speed bonus by 10 feet until the start of your next turn; suppress one temporary Resistance until the start of your next turn; prevent Invisible from that effect until the start of your next turn; prevent one cost reduction from reducing a cost below its listed value. Erode Technique cannot affect artifacts, Domains, Secret Inheritances, Formation cores, Realm-defining transformations, or permanent features. ### Void Ward - Ward Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: You or one ally within 30 feet takes damage Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina Reduce the triggering damage. CL: 1-10; Damage Reduction: 1d8 + key ability modifier CL: 11-16; Damage Reduction: 2d8 + key ability modifier CL: 17+; Damage Reduction: 3d8 + key ability modifier If the triggering effect is a Cultivation Attack, area talent, Barrier collision, Force damage, Necrotic damage, Psychic damage, or an effect from a creature that is Hollowed, add your Proficiency Bonus to the reduction. ### Quiet Gap - Quiet, Gap Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 10-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina Create a pocket of sensory absence centered on a point within range. Inside the area: ordinary sound becomes faint; Bright Light becomes Dim Light; creatures have Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or sight; verbal communication beyond 10 feet becomes difficult; tracking through sound becomes unreliable. Quiet Gap is not the Silence spell and not supernatural Darkness. ### Cost-Denying Needle - Null When Void Needle hits and you choose Cost Lock, the target also cannot regain CP or Stamina from ordinary temporary effects until the start of your next turn. ### Barrier Gnaw - Null When Void Needle damages a temporary Barrier, object, summoned object, Force object, or Formation Anchor, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage. If you also choose Fray Barrier, apply both benefits. ### Hollow Rebuke - Ward, Null Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A Hollowed creature within 60 feet hits you or an ally with an attack roll Cost: 1 CP or 1 Stamina Reduce the attack’s damage by your Proficiency Bonus. The attacker cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. ### Still Talisman - Null Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Touch Duration: 10 minutes Cost: 2 CP Touch one object, doorway, 5-foot square, or willing creature. Until the effect ends, the first hostile teleportation effect that would move through, into, or out of the protected target must succeed on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC. Failed Check: The teleportation fails and the Still Talisman ends.Successful Check: The teleportation succeeds and the Still Talisman ends. Still Talisman does not stop planar travel, forced movement, ordinary movement, or teleportation created by a Domain, Secret Inheritance, artifact, or Realm-defining effect unless the GM rules that the talisman was prepared for that specific phenomenon. ## Foundation Realm Void Talents ### Nullifying Strike - Hollow, Null Prerequisite: CL 5+ Trigger: You hit a creature with Void Needle, an unarmed strike, or a melee weapon attack Cost: 2 CP or 2 Stamina Deal extra Force, Necrotic, or Psychic damage. CL: 5-10; Extra Damage: 2d6 CL: 11-16; Extra Damage: 3d6 CL: 17+; Extra Damage: 4d6 The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: the target becomes Hollowed until the start of your next turn; the target cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; suppress one ordinary temporary Resistance until the start of your next turn; reduce the target’s Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: The target cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn. ### Unmake Barrier - Null Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 3 CP or 3 Stamina Choose one temporary Barrier, wall, ward, construct, Force object, Formation Anchor, structure section, or summoned object within range. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal Force or Necrotic damage. CL: 5-10; Damage: 5d8 CL: 11-16; Damage: 7d8 CL: 17+; Damage: 9d8 This damage ignores ordinary object Damage Thresholds and deals double damage to temporary supernatural Barriers. Unmake Barrier does not ignore AC, HP, Immunity, artifact protections, Formation-core protections, Domains, Secret Inheritances, or Realm-defining protections. ### Void Field - Hollow, Quiet Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: 15-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP or 4 Stamina Create a field of absence. A creature takes the field’s damage when it enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there. A creature can take this damage only once per turn. The creature makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take Force, Necrotic, or Psychic damage and become Hollowed until the start of its next turn. Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of its next turn. CL: 5-10; Damage: 3d6 CL: 11-16; Damage: 5d6 CL: 17+; Damage: 7d6 ### Void Shell - Ward, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 4 CP or 4 Stamina Wrap yourself in a thin shell of refusal. Until the effect ends: gain +1 AC; gain Resistance to Force and Necrotic damage; gain Advantage on saving throws against teleportation, banishment, and forced transformation; once per turn, when a creature hits you with a melee Cultivation Attack, it takes Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Consume Spellwork - Null, Ward Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within 60 feet activates a spell, sphere talent, or supernatural technique that targets only you Cost: 3 CP or 3 Stamina Make a Cultivation Check against: 10 + the triggering effect's CP cost or spell level + the triggering creature's Proficiency Bonus If the effect has no CP cost or spell level, use half the triggering creature’s CR or CL, rounded up. Failed Check: The triggering effect resolves normally. The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one active ordinary temporary benefit affecting the target. Suppress it while this talent lasts. This teleportation follows the Empty Step rules and does not cost additional CP or Stamina. ## Core Formation Realm Void Talents ### Court of the Empty Horizon - Void Domain Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 7 CP or 7 Stamina Every technique enters the court carrying a name. None leaves with certainty. #### You Gain +2 AC. Gain Resistance to Force, Necrotic, and Psychic damage. Use Empty Step once on each of your turns without spending CP or Stamina. #### Allies Allies inside the Domain gain Advantage on saving throws against teleportation, banishment, forced transformation, and possession. When an ally inside the Domain takes damage from a supernatural area effect, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus. #### Enemies Enemies inside the Domain: cannot reduce CP, Stamina, or other printed technique costs below the listed cost; cannot gain Temporary HP; treat the area as Difficult Terrain. When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: it takes 2d8 Force, Necrotic, or Psychic damage; it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn; it cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn; it cannot teleport until the start of its next turn; it has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of its next turn. Successful Save: It cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of its next turn. ### Void Prison - Null, Gap Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 6 CP or 6 Stamina Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: The target is enclosed in a visible cage of absence occupying its space and the spaces it occupies. Successful Save: The target is Hollowed until the start of your next turn instead. While the prison lasts: the target cannot willingly leave the prison; the target’s teleportation fails unless it first succeeds on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC; attacks and effects can pass through the prison normally unless blocked by another rule; the target has Cover only if another rule grants it. The Void Prison is an object with: Statistic: AC; Value: 15 Statistic: HP; Value: 10 x your Proficiency Bonus Statistic: Resistance; Value: Force and Necrotic Statistic: Immunity; Value: Poison and Psychic Destroying the prison ends the effect. ### Collapsing Gap - Gap Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 90 feet Area: 20-foot-radius sphere Cost: 5 CP or 5 Stamina Choose a point within range. Each creature of your choice in the area makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Pull the creature up to 20 feet toward the center and deal 4d8 Force or Necrotic damage. Successful Save: Pull the creature up to 5 feet toward the center and deal half damage. This pull is forced movement and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. A creature cannot be pulled through Total Cover, a sealed Barrier, or a solid obstacle. ### Return to Zero - Null Prerequisite: Erode Technique, CL 10+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within 60 feet gains or activates an ordinary temporary benefit Cost: 4 CP or 4 Stamina Choose one ordinary temporary benefit from the triggering effect. The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: The chosen benefit does not take effect. Successful Save: The chosen benefit is suppressed until the start of your next turn. Return to Zero cannot prevent an entire spell, talent, or technique unless its only effect is the chosen benefit. ### Barrier-Emptying Needle - Null Prerequisite: Void Needle, Unmake Barrier, CL 10+ When Void Needle damages a temporary Barrier, add one extra Void Needle damage die. If this destroys the Barrier, choose one creature adjacent to the Barrier. That creature takes Force or Necrotic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Hollow Path Step - Gap Prerequisite: Empty Step, CL 10+ When a creature misses you with an attack roll, you may spend 2 CP or 2 Stamina to use Empty Step as a Reaction. If the attacker was Hollowed, this teleportation costs 1 CP or 1 Stamina instead. ### Void Meridian Seal - Hollow, Null Prerequisite: Hollow Touch, CL 10+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 6 CP or 6 Stamina Choose one creature within range. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The target is Hollowed while this talent lasts. Successful Save: The target is Hollowed until the start of your next turn. At the end of each of the target’s turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the ongoing Hollowed effect on itself on a success. ### No-Purchase Body - Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Void Shell, CL 10+ While Void Shell is active: Opportunity Attacks against you have Disadvantage; forced movement against you is reduced by 10 feet; when a creature hits you with a melee attack, you may apply one Void Pressure from Void Needle to that creature once per turn. ## Nascent Soul Realm Void Talents ### Void-Sovereign Incarnation Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 10 CP or 10 Stamina Use Limit: Once per long rest Become a sovereign outline around a hollow center. While this incarnation lasts: gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and Hover; gain Resistance to Force, Necrotic, and Psychic damage; use Empty Step once per turn without spending CP or Stamina; your Void Needle targets up to two creatures within range; creatures hit by your Void Needle become Hollowed until the start of your next turn; when a Hollowed creature misses you with an attack roll, use Empty Step up to 10 feet without spending a Reaction. ### World of Nothing - Void Domain Evolution Prerequisite: Court of the Empty Horizon, CL 15+ When you create Court of the Empty Horizon, you may spend 4 additional CP or Stamina. If you do, the Domain becomes World of Nothing. Additional effects: allies inside the Domain may ignore Difficult Terrain created by the Domain; allies inside gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns; enemies inside cannot regain CP or Stamina from ordinary temporary effects; the first time an enemy inside the Domain gains an ordinary temporary benefit each round, that benefit is suppressed until the start of its next turn; when an enemy fails the Domain’s saving throw, it also cannot benefit from Invisible until the start of its next turn. ### Heaven-Emptying Lance - Null Prerequisite: Unmake Barrier, Void Needle, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: 12 CP or 12 Stamina Use Limit: Once per long rest Release a single line of absence. Choose one creature, temporary Barrier, object, summoned object, Force object, or Formation Anchor within range. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. Hit: Deal 10d10 Force, Necrotic, or Psychic damage. If the target is a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: It is Hollowed for 1 minute. Successful Save: It is Hollowed until the start of your next turn. At the end of each of the creature’s turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the 1-minute Hollowed effect on itself on a success. Against objects and Barriers, Heaven-Emptying Lance ignores ordinary object Damage Thresholds and deals double damage to temporary supernatural Barriers. It does not ignore Total Cover, artifacts, Formation cores, Domains, Secret Inheritances, or Realm-defining protections. ### Ten-Thousand Empty Needles Prerequisite: Void Needle, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Cost: 8 CP or 8 Stamina Choose a number of creatures, objects, or temporary Barriers within range up to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature can be affected by only one Void Pressure from this talent per use. ### Absolute Quiet Gap - Quiet, Gap Prerequisite: Quiet Gap, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 120 feet Area: 30-foot-radius sphere Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 8 CP or 8 Stamina Create a court of almost-silence and dim absence. Inside the area: ordinary sound cannot be heard from more than 10 feet away; Bright Light becomes Dim Light; Wisdom (Perception) checks relying on hearing or sight have Disadvantage; Verbal components fail unless the creature succeeds on a Constitution saving throw when beginning the casting or technique; teleportation into or out of the area requires a successful Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC. Absolute Quiet Gap is not supernatural Darkness and does not create Total Cover. ### Cause-Emptying Reversal Prerequisite: Return to Zero, CL 15+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature within 90 feet activates an ordinary temporary effect that would grant a benefit, teleport it, or reduce a cost Cost: 8 CP or 8 Stamina Make a Cultivation Check against the triggering creature’s Cultivation Save DC, spell save DC, or 8 + its Proficiency Bonus + its relevant ability modifier. Successful Check: The triggering benefit fails. If the triggering effect has other effects, they still resolve normally.Failed Check: The benefit functions, but the target becomes Hollowed until the start of your next turn. Cause-Emptying Reversal cannot cancel a Domain, Secret Inheritance, artifact, Formation core, Realm-defining transformation, or permanent feature. ## Secret Void Inheritance ### Return the Technique to Nothing Prerequisite: CL 17+, Void sphere, GM approval Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: A creature you can see within 120 feet activates a spell, sphere talent, Forged Technique, or supernatural technique Cost: 15 CP or 15 Stamina Use Limit: Once per long rest Name the technique as it forms. Make a Cultivation Check contested by the triggering creature’s Cultivation Check. You Succeed: The technique fails to take hold. Its resource cost is spent. If it was an ongoing effect already present, suppress it until the end of your next turn instead.You Fail: The technique resolves normally, and the triggering creature becomes Hollowed until the start of your next turn. Return the Technique to Nothing cannot permanently erase: a Path; a sphere; a creature; an artifact; a Domain; a Secret Inheritance; a Formation core; a Realm-defining transformation; a permanent karmic bond. A Domain, Secret Inheritance, artifact, Formation core, or Realm-defining technique may require a special scene, an opposed Cultivation Check with Disadvantage, or may simply be immune at the GM’s discretion. ## Optional Void Cultivation Variants A cultivator may normally choose only one Void variant unless the GM approves an exceptional inheritance. ### Hollow-Meridian Body This variant allows a Body Refiner to cultivate Void through empty channels carved into flesh and meridians. #### Restrictions Use Constitution as your Void key ability. Spend Stamina instead of CP for Void talents you are permitted to use. You may not learn Quiet talents above Mortal Realm unless another feature grants permission. When a Void talent requires Concentration, failing the Concentration saving throw deals Necrotic damage to you equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Benefits Gain Hollow Touch as a bonus talent. You may learn Void Needle, Hollow Touch, Empty Step, Void Ward, Nullifying Strike, Unmake Barrier, Void Shell, Empty Palm Scripture, Void Prison, Void-Sovereign Incarnation, and Return the Technique to Nothing using Stamina. While Void Shell is active, Stamina Guard may reduce Force, Necrotic, and Psychic damage by an additional amount equal to your Proficiency Bonus once per round. ### Null Scripture This variant focuses on clean anti-technique practice. #### Benefits Gain Erode Technique as a bonus talent. When you use Erode Technique, increase one numerical reduction by 1. When you use Return to Zero or Cause-Emptying Reversal and fail the check or the target succeeds on its save, regain 1 CP. This can occur once per round. ### Wandering Gap This variant focuses on missing-step movement. #### Benefits Gain Empty Step as a bonus talent. Increase Empty Step range by 10 feet. After using Empty Step, gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn. You cannot use this +1 AC benefit while wearing heavy armor unless another feature permits it. ## Path Synergies ### Qi Cultivation - Hollow Meridian Calculation When you apply Hollowed with a Void talent, you may spend 1 additional CP to choose one ordinary temporary benefit on the target that you can perceive. Suppress that benefit until the start of your next turn. ### Spirit Awakening - Soul-Gap Resonance When a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Void talents, you sense whether it is being possessed, controlled, or maintained by an external spiritual effect. You do not learn the source automatically. Once per turn, when you make such a creature Hollowed, it has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against possession, forced soul displacement, or spiritual control before the start of your next turn. ### Body Refining - Hollow-Meridian Body If you possess Hollow-Meridian Body, Void Shell, and Stamina Guard, then while Void Shell is active: Stamina Guard can reduce Force, Necrotic, and Psychic damage; once per round when Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, apply Empty Vitality or Cost Lock to the attacker if it is within 60 feet. ## Cultivation Insights ### Void-Body Initiate Prerequisite: Body Refining, Void sphere, GM approval You may learn the Hollow-Meridian Body variant. If you already possess Hollow-Meridian Body, gain one Mortal Realm Void talent for which you meet the prerequisites. ### Empty Step Adept Prerequisite: Void sphere When you use Empty Step, you may move through one occupied space during the teleportation’s visual path. You still must arrive in an unoccupied space you can see, and this does not allow passage through Total Cover or a sealed Barrier. ### Void Ward Adept Prerequisite: Void Ward When Void Ward reduces damage to 0, you may apply one Void Pressure from Void Needle to the source if it is within 60 feet. Use this once per round. ### Null-Script Adept Prerequisite: Erode Technique When you use Erode Technique, Return to Zero, or Cause-Emptying Reversal, increase the range by 30 feet. ### Hollow-Script Custodian Prerequisite: CL 10+, Void sphere When you teach, copy, seal, or defend a Void scripture during downtime, gain Advantage on one relevant Cultivation Check. Once per long rest, when a creature fails a saving throw against one of your Void talents, you may extend Hollowed on that creature until the end of your next turn.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### Command Responses
A Command Response spends Momentum to turn battlefield order into immediate action.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
spending a Momentum Mark is not an Action;
you may use only one Command Response per round;
the target must be within Command Range and able to perceive your command;
a Command Response is not magical unless the talent says otherwise.
You know the following Command Responses.
#### Step on My Count
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see starts its turn, ends its turn, or is missed by an attack roll.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally moves 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature you can see.
This movement cannot move the ally through an occupied space or through terrain it could not normally enter.
#### Brace the Line
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see is hit by an attack roll or fails a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw against an effect that deals damage.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally reduces the triggering damage by:
Proficiency Bonus + Warleader key ability modifier
If the triggering attack roll would miss after adding +2 to the ally’s AC, the attack misses instead of dealing reduced damage.
#### Strike on My Count
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see hits with an attack roll.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally adds your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll from the triggering attack.
