spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Warleader Qi Expression: Primary — Command Qi; Supporting — War Qi, Mandate Qi, Sound/Banner Qi, Human-Relation Qi. “A lone hero wins a duel. A warleader teaches ten frightened disciples to become a line that does not break.” Sphere Type: Martial / Command Sphere Rules Baseline: 2024 fifth-edition rules (5.5e) Primary Path: Spirit Awakening Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation and Body Refining Resource: Martial Focus, Momentum Marks Common Effects: battle standards, battlefield commands, rallying cries, coordinated movement, formation pressure, morale recovery, emergency defense, command presence, shouted intimidation, objective control ## Warleader Dao Warleader is the cultivation of shared action under pressure. A novice thinks command is a loud voice. An adept understands that command is a road laid through fear before anyone realizes they have begun walking it. The Warleader does not merely inspire allies. The Warleader gives a battle a shape that frightened bodies can follow. The Warleader does not move every ally by force. The Warleader names the correct motion, marks the moment when an ally follows it, and spends that gathered momentum before the enemy can break the line. Warleader governs: battle standards; tactical orders; shouted commands; formation discipline; morale recovery; coordinated attack timing; retreat without collapse; rallying frightened allies; protecting the injured by command; turning many small actions into one larger battlefield intention. ### Sphere Sentence Warleader cultivators set a battle standard, gather momentum when allies follow it, and spend that momentum to make the line move, strike, brace, or rally as one. ## Sphere Boundaries | Sphere | Boundary | | --- | --- | | Warleader | Shared battlefield action, standards, commands, rallying, coordinated timing, morale pressure. | | Jester | Public bait, mockery, reversal, and letting enemies defeat themselves by answering the joke. | | Mind | Direct influence over thought, emotion, compulsion, or mental state. | | Formations | Prepared arrays, infrastructure, fixed battlefield geometry, training halls, long-term command projects. | | Protection | Direct wards, barriers, aegis, and defensive fields. | | Force | Impact, pressure, counterpressure, and the answering world. | | Sound | Sonic vibration, destructive resonance, silence, speech pressure, and sound as a medium. | | Blacksmith | Forge process, item preparation, repair, and crafting infrastructure. | ### Warleader and Mind A Warleader command is not automatically Charmed, Frightened, or mind-affecting. Allies benefit because they hear, see, trust, or understand the command well enough to act. Enemies may be frightened or shaken by specific Warleader shouts, but only when a talent says so. ### Warleader and Formations Warleader can create temporary battle order. Formations create prepared arrays, training grounds, command halls, and strategic infrastructure. A Warleader can seed a Formation project, but does not automatically create permanent command infrastructure. ### Warleader and Sound Many Warleader techniques use the voice. This does not make Warleader the Sound sphere. Warleader uses sound to carry command. Sound cultivators cultivate vibration itself. ## Core Warleader Rules ### 2024 Fifth-Edition Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline. Warleader talents supplement normal rules for: Action; Bonus Action; Reaction; Help; Dash; Disengage; Dodge; Opportunity Attacks; Charmed; Frightened; Deafened; Exhaustion; Temporary HP; Cover; area effects; Concentration. A Warleader talent replaces a normal rule only when it explicitly says so. ### Martial Focus Warleader uses Martial Focus. Until a global Martial Focus rule replaces this reminder: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is absent. ### Warleader Key Ability and Save DC Your Warleader key ability is Charisma unless a Path synergy, Insight, or feature explicitly changes it. Your Warleader Save DC is: 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Warleader key ability modifier ### Command Range Your Command Range is 30 feet. A creature must be able to see or hear you to benefit from your Standards, Commands, and beneficial Shouts unless a talent says otherwise. A creature that is Deafened cannot benefit from a purely spoken command unless the command is also visible, telepathic, signaled through a banner, or enabled by a feature. A creature that is Unconscious, Incapacitated, Paralyzed, or otherwise unable to act cannot follow a Standard unless a talent explicitly affects such a creature. ### Commanded Allies An ally is Commanded while it is within your Command Range and can perceive your current Standard. You are always considered Commanded by your own Standard while you are conscious and able to act. A creature cannot benefit from more than one Warleader Standard at the same time. If multiple Warleader Standards could apply, the creature chooses which one applies at the start of its turn. ## Core Chassis: Standards, Momentum Marks, and Shouts ### Set the Standard Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Command Range Target: You and Commanded allies Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: None Choose one Standard you know. Until the start of your next turn, you and Commanded allies may benefit from that Standard. You know the Press the Opening Standard when you first learn Warleader. Unless a talent says otherwise: you can maintain only one Standard at a time; setting a new Standard ends your previous Standard; a Standard is not magical unless a talent says otherwise; a Standard is not a Formation; a Standard does not force an ally to act. ### Press the Opening Standard When two Commanded allies have the same hostile creature within reach, each of those allies gains a +2 bonus to the first attack roll it makes against that creature on its turn. This bonus applies only once per creature per turn. ### Momentum Marks A Momentum Mark represents the pressure gathered when allies follow your command. You can hold a number of Momentum Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus. You gain 1 Momentum Mark the first time on each turn that one of the following happens: a Commanded ally benefits from your active Standard; a Commanded ally hits a creature you have verbally or visibly identified as the objective; a Commanded ally uses the Help action to aid another Commanded ally; a Commanded ally succeeds on a saving throw after gaining a bonus or reroll from one of your Warleader talents. Momentum Marks last until combat ends, until you are Incapacitated, or until you complete a short or long rest. You cannot gain more than one Momentum Mark from the same creature on the same turn. ### Command Responses A Command Response spends Momentum to turn battlefield order into immediate action. Unless a talent says otherwise: spending a Momentum Mark is not an Action; you may use only one Command Response per round; the target must be within Command Range and able to perceive your command; a Command Response is not magical unless the talent says otherwise. You know the following Command Responses. #### Step on My Count Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see starts its turn, ends its turn, or is missed by an attack roll. Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark. The ally moves 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature you can see. This movement cannot move the ally through an occupied space or through terrain it could not normally enter. #### Brace the Line Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see is hit by an attack roll or fails a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw against an effect that deals damage. Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark. The ally reduces the triggering damage by: Proficiency Bonus + Warleader key ability modifier If the triggering attack roll would miss after adding +2 to the ally’s AC, the attack misses instead of dealing reduced damage. #### Strike on My Count Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see hits with an attack roll. Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark. The ally adds your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll from the triggering attack. ### War Shouts A Shout is an audible Warleader technique used to seize a moment, rally allies, or break an enemy’s rhythm. Unless a talent says otherwise: using a Shout requires an Action; Shouts affect creatures in a 15-foot Emanation originating from you; allies must be able to hear you to gain a beneficial Shout; enemies that cannot hear you have Advantage on saving throws against harmful Shouts; a Shout is not magical unless it says it is; you choose whether to include yourself in a beneficial Shout. You know Fierce Shout when you first learn Warleader. ### Fierce Shout Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 15-foot Emanation originating from you Duration: Until the start of your next turn Cost: None Affected allies add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage roll of the first attack they hit with before the start of your next turn. A creature can benefit from only one Fierce Shout at a time. ## Warleader Talent Tags | Tag | Meaning | | --- | --- | | Standard | Adds, changes, or expands Set the Standard. | | Command | Adds or modifies a Command Response or Momentum Mark use. | | Shout | Adds or modifies War Shouts. | | Formation-Style | Uses temporary battlefield order but is not a permanent Formation. | | Focus | Uses or restores Martial Focus. | | Morale | Interacts with fear, charm, exhaustion, collapse, or resolve. | | Realm Evolution | Expands command beyond ordinary mortal leadership. | ## Mortal Realm Warleader Talents ### Courier’s Dash - Standard When this Standard is active, Commanded allies gain +10 feet Speed until the start of your next turn. A creature gains this speed only while moving toward an enemy, ally, objective, exit, or battlefield position you have identified. ### Shieldbrothers - Standard When this Standard is active, a Commanded ally gains +2 AC while adjacent to at least one other Commanded ally. ### Ironclad Line - Standard When this Standard is active, Commanded allies reduce nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage by your Proficiency Bonus while adjacent to at least one other Commanded ally. ### Coordinated Reflexes - Standard, Command When this Standard is active, Commanded allies gain +2 on Dexterity saving throws against effects that target an area while adjacent to at least one other Commanded ally. When a Commanded ally fails such a saving throw, you may spend 1 Momentum Mark to let the ally reroll the save. The ally must use the new roll. ### Fortifying Phalanx - Standard, Command When this Standard is active, Commanded allies gain +2 on Constitution saving throws while adjacent to at least one other Commanded ally. When a Commanded ally fails a Constitution saving throw, you may spend 1 Momentum Mark to let the ally reroll the save. The ally must use the new roll. ### Militant Will - Standard, Morale, Command When this Standard is active, Commanded allies gain +2 on saving throws against the Charmed and Frightened conditions. When a Commanded ally fails such a saving throw, you may spend 1 Momentum Mark to let the ally reroll the save. The ally must use the new roll. ### Battlefield Coordination - Command When a Commanded ally makes an attack roll, saving throw, or ability check with Disadvantage, spend 1 Momentum Mark. Choose one source of Disadvantage affecting that roll. The ally ignores that one source of Disadvantage for the triggering roll. Battlefield Coordination does not grant Advantage. ### Coordinated Aid - Command When a Commanded ally takes the Help action to aid another Commanded ally, gain 1 Momentum Mark even if you have already gained a Momentum Mark this turn. In addition, you may spend 1 Momentum Mark to allow a Commanded ally to take the Help action as a Reaction to aid another Commanded ally within 5 feet. ### Reactive Position - Command Trigger: Two Commanded allies are adjacent to one another, and one of them is targeted by an attack roll or forced movement. Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark. The two allies swap places. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. If the swap places the original target outside the triggering attack’s reach or range, the attack misses. ### Call Attention - Shout Use this Shout to draw hostile attention. Until the start of your next turn: affected allies gain Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks; you automatically fail Dexterity (Stealth) checks; the first enemy that targets an affected ally other than you with an attack roll does so with Disadvantage if it can see or hear you. ### Focusing Cry - Shout, Focus Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Choose a number of affected allies up to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded up. Each chosen ally regains Martial Focus if absent. You cannot choose yourself. ### Rallying Speech - Shout, Morale Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Affected allies gain Advantage on saving throws against Charmed and Frightened for 1 minute. A creature can benefit from Rallying Speech once per short rest. ### Harangue - Shout, Morale Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Each affected ally may immediately make a new saving throw against one ongoing effect currently affecting it, using the original DC, if that effect normally allows a saving throw to end or resist it. A failed save from Harangue does not worsen an effect that worsens on a failed save. A creature can benefit from Harangue once per short rest. ### Rousing Claxon - Shout, Morale Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Affected allies gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. For 1 hour, each affected ally treats its Exhaustion level as 1 lower, minimum 0. This does not remove Exhaustion. A creature can benefit from Rousing Claxon once per short rest. ### Frightful Roar - Shout, Morale Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Hostile creatures in the Shout area make a Wisdom saving throw. Failed Save: The creature is Frightened of you until the end of your next turn. While Frightened in this way, it must use its movement to move away from you by the safest available route if it can do so. Successful Save: No effect. At CL 11+, a creature that is already Frightened and fails this save is Frightened for 1 minute instead. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. ### Breath Support - Shout When you use a Shout, choose one of the following shapes: normal 15-foot Emanation; 20-foot Cone; 30-foot Line that is 5 feet wide. At CL 11+, increase the Cone to 30 feet and the Line to 60 feet. ### Focusing Tactics - Focus A Commanded ally affected by your active Standard or one of your beneficial Shouts may use its Action to restore your Martial Focus if absent. A creature can restore your Martial Focus with this talent once per short rest. ### Quick Commands - Focus Expend Martial Focus to do one of the following: use one Shout you know as a Bonus Action instead of an Action; make your current Standard last for 1 minute without spending a Bonus Action to maintain it. If you are Incapacitated, the extended Standard ends. ### Verbal Commands - Standard Commanded allies can benefit from your Standards even if they cannot see you, as long as they can hear you. You may also center a Standard on a point you can see within Command Range. The Standard affects allies within 20 feet of that point instead of within your Command Range. You must still be able to perceive the battlefield well enough to give meaningful instructions. ## Foundation Realm Warleader Talents ### Layered Orders - Standard, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you Set the Standard, choose one primary Standard and one secondary Standard. Commanded allies may benefit from the primary Standard normally. The secondary Standard provides only its passive benefit and cannot trigger Momentum Marks or Command Responses unless another talent says otherwise. ### Deadly Herdsman - Standard, Command Prerequisite: CL 5+ When this Standard is active, once per turn when a Commanded ally damages a hostile creature with an attack, the ally may Shove the target as a Bonus Action. If the forced movement moves the target out of another Commanded ally’s reach, that other ally may make one Opportunity Attack against the target. ### Preparation - Standard Prerequisite: CL 5+ When this Standard is active outside combat, Commanded allies who can hear or see your preparations gain a bonus to Initiative equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature cannot benefit from Preparation for more than 1 hour total before completing a long rest. ### Ordered Retreat - Command Prerequisite: CL 5+ When a Commanded ally takes the Disengage action, gain 1 Momentum Mark. You may spend 1 Momentum Mark when an ally Disengages to allow one adjacent Commanded ally to move 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks. ### Marked Objective - Standard Prerequisite: CL 5+ When you Set the Standard, identify one creature, object, space, door, hazard, or visible battlefield objective within Command Range. The first Commanded ally on each turn that moves at least 10 feet toward the objective or hits the objective with an attack gains one of the following benefits: +2 to the triggering attack roll; +10 feet Speed until the end of the turn; Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### War Drum Cadence - Shout, Focus Prerequisite: Breath Support, CL 5+ When you use a Shout, expend Martial Focus to repeat a simplified echo at the start of your next turn without using an Action. The echo affects only allies and provides one of the following: Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; +10 feet Speed until the end of the turn; Advantage on the next saving throw against Charmed or Frightened before the start of your next turn. ### Banner-Signal Doctrine - Standard Prerequisite: CL 5+ You may issue Standards through banners, flags, weapon gestures, drumbeats, lanterns, or other obvious signals. A creature that can see the signal may benefit from your Standards even if it cannot hear you. If the signal is concealed, destroyed, or visually blocked, creatures relying on the signal stop benefiting until they can perceive it again. ### Roaring Reservoir - Shout, Focus Prerequisite: CL 7+ When you use a Shout that requires Martial Focus, you may use it without expending Martial Focus. If you do, your Exhaustion level increases by 1 until the end of your next turn. This temporary Exhaustion cannot be reduced or ignored by Warleader talents. ### Command the Gap - Command Prerequisite: CL 7+ When a hostile creature moves through a space within reach of two or more Commanded allies, spend 1 Momentum Mark. One Commanded ally may make an Opportunity Attack against that creature without using its Reaction. A creature can provoke this talent only once per turn. ## Core Formation Realm Warleader Talents ### Warleader Domain: Court of Moving Banners “A thousand frightened feet found the same road. The enemy realized too late that the road passed through them.” Prerequisite: CL 10+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 60-foot Emanation originating from you Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest For the duration: your Command Range becomes the Domain area; maintain one Standard without spending a Bonus Action each round; when you gain a Momentum Mark, gain one additional Momentum Mark, up to your normal maximum; use one Command Response per round without spending a Momentum Mark; when a Commanded ally drops to 0 Hit Points inside the Domain, it may fall Prone and move 5 feet before falling Unconscious. Court of Moving Banners is a Martial Domain. It is not a permanent Formation. ### Legion Unending - Standard, Morale Prerequisite: Rousing Claxon, CL 10+ When this Standard is active, if a Commanded ally would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, spend 1 Momentum Mark as a Reaction. The ally gains Temporary HP equal to: 2 x your CL Apply these Temporary HP before the triggering damage. These Temporary HP vanish at the start of your next turn. You may expend Martial Focus to use Legion Unending without using your Reaction, but doing so ends the active Standard after the triggering effect resolves. ### Recall Spirit - Shout, Morale Prerequisite: Rousing Claxon, CL 10+ Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Special: Magical. Choose one creature within your Shout area that died since the end of your last turn. The creature returns to life with Hit Points equal to: your CL + Warleader key ability modifier The creature’s Exhaustion level increases by 2, to a maximum of 5. This Exhaustion cannot be reduced below 1 until the creature completes a long rest. Recall Spirit cannot restore a creature that died of old age or whose soul is unwilling or unable to return. ### Thunder Banner Cry - Shout Prerequisite: Breath Support, CL 10+ Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Special: Magical. Hostile creatures in the Shout area make a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Take Thunder damage equal to 4d8 + Warleader key ability modifier, are pushed 10 feet directly away from you, and are Deafened for 1 minute. Successful Save: Take half damage and suffer no push or Deafened effect. A Deafened creature repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the Deafened effect on itself on a success. ### Darklands Cry - Shout, Morale Prerequisite: CL 11+ Cost: Expend Martial Focus. Special: Magical. Hostile creatures in the Shout area make a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: The creature gains 1 level of Exhaustion. Successful Save: No effect. A creature can gain Exhaustion from your Darklands Cry once per long rest. ### Command From the Hill - Standard Prerequisite: Verbal Commands, CL 10+ You may center your Standards on a point within 120 feet if you can both perceive the area and communicate with allies inside it through voice, signal, telepathy, messenger spirit, formation relay, or another explicit method. Your Command Responses still require the target to be within 120 feet unless another talent says otherwise. ### Master’s Presence - Morale Prerequisite: Rallying Speech, CL 10+ When a Commanded ally begins its turn within 5 feet of you, it gains one of the following benefits of your choice: Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; Advantage on the next saving throw against Charmed or Frightened before the start of your next turn; remove the Frightened condition if the ally can see or hear you and the effect’s source is lower CL than you. A creature can benefit from Master’s Presence once per round. ## Nascent Soul Realm Warleader Talents ### Ten Thousand Banners Doctrine Prerequisite: Layered Orders, CL 15+ When you Set the Standard, choose up to three Standards. One is primary and two are secondary. Secondary Standards still cannot trigger Momentum Marks unless a talent says otherwise, but Commanded allies may benefit from their passive effects. While you hold Martial Focus, your Command Range increases to 120 feet. ### Army Moves as One Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest Choose a number of Commanded allies up to your Proficiency Bonus. Each chosen ally may immediately use its Reaction to do one of the following: move up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks; take the Dodge action; take the Help action; make one weapon, unarmed, or Cultivation Attack against a creature within reach or range. A creature that attacks through Army Moves as One cannot add bonus damage from Fierce Shout to that attack unless it already had the benefit before this talent was used. ### Unending Loyalty Prerequisite: Recall Spirit, Legion Unending, CL 15+ You may use Recall Spirit on a creature that died within the last minute instead of since the end of your last turn. The creature returns to life with Hit Points equal to: 2 x your CL + Warleader key ability modifier After 1 hour, the creature dies again unless it has been restored by another effect capable of truly returning it to life. A creature cannot benefit from your Unending Loyalty again until it has been truly returned to life by other means. ### Imperial Mandate of the Living Line Prerequisite: Court of Moving Banners, CL 15+ While Court of Moving Banners is active: Commanded allies are immune to Frightened while they can see or hear you; once per round, when a Commanded ally fails a saving throw, use a Command Response without spending Momentum; when you use Step on My Count, the ally moves 10 feet instead of 5 feet; when you use Strike on My Count, add twice your Proficiency Bonus to the damage instead of your Proficiency Bonus. ### General’s Soul-Standard Prerequisite: CL 15+ When you are reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, you may expend Martial Focus and spend all Momentum Marks. You remain conscious until the end of your next turn. During this time: you cannot gain Hit Points except from a feature that restores you from 0 Hit Points; you may Set the Standard without spending a Bonus Action; you may use one Command Response without spending Momentum; if you are still at 0 Hit Points at the end of your next turn, you fall Unconscious normally. Use General’s Soul-Standard once per long rest. ## Secret Warleader Inheritance ### The Ten Thousand Move Before Heaven Counts “The enemy declared victory. The general answered with a road that had already reached the future.” Classification: Secret Warleader Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Moving Banners, Ten Thousand Banners Doctrine, hidden command scripture or battlefield inheritance Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: Initiative is rolled, a Commanded ally would be reduced to 0 Hit Points, or a hostile creature begins a Domain, Secret Inheritance, or battle-ending technique within 120 feet Cost: Expend Martial Focus and all Momentum Marks Use Limit: Once per week Choose up to ten allies within 120 feet that can see or hear you. Each chosen ally immediately chooses one: move up to its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks; take the Dodge action; take the Help action; make one weapon, unarmed, or Cultivation Attack; stand from Prone, end Grappled or Restrained if the escape DC is equal to or lower than your Warleader Save DC, and move 10 feet; make one saving throw against an ongoing effect that allows a save to end it. After all chosen allies resolve their choices, choose one Standard you know. That Standard becomes active for 1 minute without requiring your Bonus Action. For that minute, you gain 1 Momentum Mark at the start of each of your turns. When the minute ends, you gain 1 level of Exhaustion that cannot be reduced until you complete a long rest. The Ten Thousand Move Before Heaven Counts does not force unwilling allies to act. It gives the road. They choose whether to walk it. ## Warleader Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures Warleader variants are optional cultivation scriptures that alter how command manifests. These are Tianxia-specific design tools inspired by drawback design, not imported casting-tradition rules. A Warleader variant grants a real benefit only if it also imposes a real limitation. A character may normally choose at most one Warleader variant when first learning Warleader or undergoing a major Warleader initiation. Variants are mutually exclusive unless the GM says otherwise. If a variant grants a talent whose prerequisites are not yet met, gain that talent when the prerequisites are met. If the variant is retrained or removed, lose the granted benefit. ### Roaring Vanguard Scripture You cultivate Warleader through battle-cries, visible ferocity, and breaking enemy morale. #### Benefit Gain Frightful Roar as a bonus talent. When you use Frightful Roar, gain 1 Momentum Mark the first time each round a hostile creature fails its saving throw against it. #### Drawback: No Quiet Line You do not gain Set the Standard when you first learn Warleader. You cannot learn Standard talents unless you later buy off this drawback with a talent or appropriate initiation. Your Warleader techniques must be audible or visibly aggressive; you cannot use Verbal Commands, Banner-Signal Doctrine, or Command From the Hill while this drawback remains. ### Quiet Strategist Scripture You cultivate Warleader through signs, prior instructions, messengers, and calm tactical direction. #### Benefit Gain Verbal Commands or Courier’s Dash as a bonus talent. When you Set the Standard outside combat and allies have at least 1 minute to hear the plan, the first Momentum Mark you gain in the next combat does not count against your maximum until the end of your next turn. #### Drawback: No Battle-Cry You do not gain Fierce Shout when you first learn Warleader. You cannot learn Shout talents unless you later buy off this drawback with a talent or appropriate initiation. You may still speak commands, but you cannot use Warleader Shouts. ### Iron Banner Scripture You cultivate Warleader as line discipline, shield order, and the refusal to break. #### Benefit Gain Shieldbrothers or Ironclad Line as a bonus talent. While one of those Standards is active, the first time each round a Commanded ally reduces damage through that Standard or benefits from its AC bonus, gain 1 Momentum Mark. #### Drawback: The Line Must Hold Your Standards require visible formation discipline. A Commanded ally cannot benefit from your Standards unless it is adjacent to another Commanded ally, adjacent to you, or occupying a space you identified as part of the line when you Set the Standard. You cannot use Step on My Count to move an ally farther from all Commanded allies unless the movement prevents that ally from being reduced to 0 Hit Points or moves it toward a marked objective. ### Mercy Standard Scripture You cultivate Warleader as preservation of the line rather than conquest of the enemy. #### Benefit Gain Harangue or Rallying Speech as a bonus talent. When one of your Shouts removes or helps an ally resist Charmed, Frightened, Exhaustion, or an ongoing harmful effect, gain 1 Momentum Mark. #### Drawback: No Cruel Cry You cannot learn Shouts whose primary effect damages enemies, inflicts Exhaustion on enemies, or forces Frightened. This prevents Frightful Roar, Thunder Banner Cry, and Darklands Cry unless you buy off the drawback. You may still use Standards and Command Responses offensively. ### Bannerbound Scripture You cultivate Warleader through a visible banner, drum, command sword, officer seal, battle fan, or other command focus. #### Benefit Gain Banner-Signal Doctrine as a bonus talent. Your Command Range increases by 10 feet while the command focus is visible or audible to allies. #### Drawback: Break the Banner, Break the Road Choose one command focus. If the focus is disarmed, destroyed, silenced, stolen, covered, or made impossible for allies to perceive, you cannot Set the Standard or use Command Responses until you recover it, reveal it, replace it, or spend an Action to reestablish command through your voice alone. Replacing the command focus requires a short rest and appropriate ritual preparation. ## Path Synergies ### Spirit Awakening - Commander of Shared Intent Use Wisdom as your Warleader key ability if higher than Charisma. When you Set the Standard, choose one Commanded ally you can see. Learn one immediate battle pressure affecting that ally: it intends to advance; it intends to retreat; it is protecting someone; it is afraid; it is waiting for permission to act; it is about to overextend. This reads immediate battle pressure, not private memories or complex thoughts. Once per round when you gain a Momentum Mark from that ally, the ally gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### Qi Cultivation - Strategic Meridian Orders Use Intelligence as your Warleader key ability if higher than Charisma. When you Set the Standard, choose one 5-foot square within Command Range. Until the start of your next turn, the first Commanded ally to enter that square gains one of the following: +10 feet Speed until the end of the turn; +2 to its next attack roll before the end of the turn; +2 to its next saving throw before the start of your next turn. At CL 10+, choose two squares instead of one. ### Body Refining - Frontline Banner Body Use Constitution as your Warleader key ability for Warleader talents while you are adjacent to at least one hostile creature or at least two Commanded allies. When you use Brace the Line on another ally, you also reduce the next damage you take before the start of your next turn by your Proficiency Bonus. While holding Martial Focus, you have Advantage on saving throws against being Frightened. ## Sphere Synergies ### Warleader + Jester Jester creates public bait and turns the enemy’s answer into a punchline. Warleader creates shared order and turns allied obedience into battlefield momentum. Together, they create false retreats, morale traps, mock routs, staged collapses, and public reversals. ### Warleader + Formations Warleader can seed a Formation with command logic. A Formation can make a command hall, training ground, war drum tower, signal flag array, or strategic gate. Warleader does not create such infrastructure automatically. ### Warleader + Metal Metal carries command through bells, armor, weapons, and resonance lines. Metal does not replace Warleader’s command logic. Warleader does not automatically control metal objects. ### Warleader + Sound Sound can magnify Shouts, carry commands, protect allies from deafness, or turn a battlefield voice into vibration. Warleader remains the sphere of command, not sonic damage. ### Warleader + Spirit Awakening Spirit Awakening can read morale, fear, loyalty, and intent. Warleader can turn that reading into orders allies can follow. ## Cultivation Insights ### Standard Bearer Adept Prerequisite: Warleader sphere, CL 4+ When you Set the Standard, choose one Commanded ally. That ally gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. If the ally fulfills your Standard before the start of your next turn, gain 1 Momentum Mark. Use this Insight once per round. ### Voice That Carries Prerequisite: Warleader sphere, one Shout talent, CL 6+ Increase the radius of your Shouts by 5 feet. When you use a Shout, choose one affected ally that cannot hear you because of Deafened, magical silence, or overwhelming noise. If the ally can see you, it still gains the beneficial portion of the Shout. ### Order Ledger Disciple Prerequisite: Warleader sphere, CL 6+ When combat ends, if you have at least 1 Momentum Mark remaining, choose one ally who followed your Standard during the encounter. That ally gains Advantage on the first ability check it makes before the end of the next hour to repair, track, regroup, treat wounds, scout a retreat path, or explain the battle. ### Iron Captain Prerequisite: Warleader sphere, Shieldbrothers or Ironclad Line, CL 8+ When a Commanded ally adjacent to another Commanded ally is hit by a critical hit, spend 1 Momentum Mark. The attack is treated as a normal hit instead of a critical hit. Use Iron Captain once per short rest. ### Emergency Commander Prerequisite: Warleader sphere, CL 8+ When Initiative is rolled, immediately Set the Standard without spending a Bonus Action. If you are Surprised, this Standard begins at the start of your first turn instead. ### Battlefield Scribe Prerequisite: Warleader sphere, Qi Cultivation or proficiency with calligrapher’s supplies, cartographer’s tools, or painter’s supplies, CL 8+ During a short rest, draw a battlefield note, flag-code sheet, sand map, or written order. Choose one Standard you know. Before your next short or long rest, when you first Set that Standard, gain 1 Momentum Mark. ### No-Rout Commander Prerequisite: Warleader sphere, Rallying Speech or Harangue, CL 10+ When a Commanded ally fails a saving throw against Frightened, spend 1 Momentum Mark. The ally may move up to 10 feet toward you or another Commanded ally without provoking Opportunity Attacks, then reroll the saving throw. The ally must use the new roll.

resolved_automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### Command Responses
A Command Response spends Momentum to turn battlefield order into immediate action.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
spending a Momentum Mark is not an Action;
you may use only one Command Response per round;
the target must be within Command Range and able to perceive your command;
a Command Response is not magical unless the talent says otherwise.
You know the following Command Responses.
#### Step on My Count
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see starts its turn, ends its turn, or is missed by an attack roll.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally moves 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from one creature you can see.
This movement cannot move the ally through an occupied space or through terrain it could not normally enter.
#### Brace the Line
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see is hit by an attack roll or fails a Dexterity or Constitution saving throw against an effect that deals damage.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally reduces the triggering damage by:
Proficiency Bonus + Warleader key ability modifier
If the triggering attack roll would miss after adding +2 to the ally’s AC, the attack misses instead of dealing reduced damage.
#### Strike on My Count
Trigger: A Commanded ally you can see hits with an attack roll.
Cost: Spend 1 Momentum Mark.
The ally adds your Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll from the triggering attack.

##### Water Lash
Action Type: Action
Canonical Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Special Attack
Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or object
Cost: 0 CP
Replace one attack when you take the Attack action, or use an action if you do not have attacks to replace.
Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage and becomes Soaked until the end of your next turn.
The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17.
If the target is already Soaked, you may move it 5 feet into a legal unoccupied space after the hit. This forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
##### Shape Current
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: One 10-foot square or a 10-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You gather water into a simple Current or Basin. Choose one form when you use this ability.
Flowing Current. The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. When you create the Current, choose one creature in the area. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed or pulled 10 feet along the Current into a legal space.
Mist Basin. The area becomes Lightly Obscured. A creature inside it can attempt to Hide normally if it has appropriate cover or concealment.
Cleansing Basin. The first time each round you or an ally enters the area or starts its turn there, it may end the Soaked state on itself, extinguish ordinary flames on itself, or gain Advantage on the next saving throw before the start of its next turn against Poisoned, a disease, smoke, heat, or mundane contamination.
Pressure Basin. The area presses down and around. The first hostile creature each round that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
You may move a Basin or Current up to 10 feet as a Bonus Action on your turn.

one creature in or adjacent to it becomes Soaked;
one ally in or adjacent to it moves 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
one ordinary flame in or adjacent to it is extinguished;
you regain awareness of the nearest obvious Water Source within 60 feet.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Water Qi Expression: Primary — Water Qi; Supporting — Flow Qi, Depth Qi, Cleansing Qi, Memory Qi. “A river does not win because it is soft. It wins because every drop agrees where it is going.” Sphere Type: Power Sphere / Elemental Terrain Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Paths: Spirit Awakening; Body Refining through Tidal Body traditions Resource: CP Common Effects: Flow, pressure, currents, mist, cleansing, drowning pressure, tide courts, water travel, erosion, sacred springs, floods, and oceanic sovereignty. Water cultivates the cycle of Source, Current, Basin, and Return: shaping flow, pressure, cleansing, drowning pressure, mist, currents, sacred water, and oceanic sovereignty. ### Player-Facing Rules #### Water Dao Water is the cultivation of continuity under pressure. The first draft had the right pieces but not enough shared engine. V2 rebuilds Water so its talents do not feel like isolated spells. Every Water technique now belongs to the same cycle: Source. Water begins somewhere: river, rain, mist, gourd, bloodless spiritual moisture, damp ground, or a basin of Created Water. Current. Water moves. It pushes, pulls, carries, redirects, obscures, erodes, or gathers pressure. Basin. Water remains. It pools into terrain, shield, prison, clone, spring, or domain. Return. Water comes back into one flow. It cleanses, reclaims, dissolves fire, carries allies, and drags enemies toward the sea. A Water cultivator does not merely throw liquid. They decide where the current begins, where it must go, what it carries, what it hides, what it wears away, and what it returns to balance. This is the sphere’s central design: talents modify the Water Cycle rather than existing as unrelated abilities. ##### Core Play Pattern At the table, a Water turn usually follows one of these patterns: Strike and set up: use Water Lash to damage a target and make it Soaked, then use a talent that exploits Soaked. Shape the field: use Shape Current to create a Basin, Current, Mist, or Spring, then modify it with talents. Answer pressure: use Water Shield, Flowing Step, or Mirror-Water Reply to turn an enemy’s force aside. Escalate the flow: once a target or area is already Soaked, inside a Basin, or caught in a Current, apply Pressure, Drowning Pressure, Whirlpool, or Erosion. Return to source: pull scattered water effects back into healing, movement, cleansing, or a larger tide. ##### Realm Progression Mortal Realm. Water is a lash, bowl, step, veil, splash, cleansing stream, and small battlefield current. Foundation Realm. Water becomes spiritually continuous. The cultivator can maintain living water, extend current through air, defend with moving water, bind enemies with pressure, and travel through linked water. Core Formation Realm. The cultivator establishes a tide court. The battlefield itself gains a current, and every Water technique can be routed through that domain. Nascent Soul Realm. The cultivator becomes a sovereign oceanic law. Water answers from every direction, and the body becomes a sea that cannot be meaningfully separated from its currents. Secret Inheritance. The cultivator reveals that dry land is a temporary shape inside the memory of the sea. #### Rules Baseline Use the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline unless this sphere explicitly replaces a rule. Ranged Cultivation Attacks. Water Lash, Cutting Current, and Pressure Lance are ranged Cultivation Attacks. They follow attack-roll rules, Cover, range, Advantage, Disadvantage, and unseen-target rules unless a talent says otherwise. Saving Throws. Current movement normally uses Strength saving throws. Drowning Pressure and internal pressure normally use Constitution saving throws. Mist and misdirection use Wisdom only when a talent says so. Grappled and Restrained. When a Water talent applies Grappled or Restrained, use the 2024 condition. The talent states how the target escapes. Difficult Terrain. Floodwater, mud, slick stone, and Current areas may be Difficult Terrain. A creature with a Swim Speed or relevant Water feature ignores that terrain only if the talent says so. Underwater Combat. Ordinary underwater combat remains awkward for creatures without Swim Speed or adaptation. Water talents can grant specific exceptions. Cover and Obscurement. Mist Veil uses Lightly Obscured and Heavily Obscured. It does not automatically make creatures Hidden. Forced Movement. Unless stated otherwise, Water forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks and must move the creature into a legal unoccupied space. Fire Interaction. Water can extinguish ordinary flames and contest Fire talents when a Water talent says so. It does not automatically counter every supernatural fire. Concentration. Talents with Concentration follow the normal Concentration rules. Created Water and Economy. Created spiritual water is not automatically permanent, marketable, drinkable, or useful for agriculture unless a project or talent says so. #### Core Water Rules ##### Water Key Ability A Water cultivator normally uses the key ability of their Path. Qi Cultivation: Intelligence or Charisma, depending on the Path expression. Spirit Awakening: Wisdom when using Ocean Soul or a spiritual Water initiation. Body Refining: Constitution only through Tidal Body traditions or explicit features. ##### Water Save DC When a Water talent calls for a saving throw, use your Cultivation Save DC unless a feature says otherwise. ##### Water Source A Water technique may draw from one of the following: visible water, rain, snowmelt, mist, steam, or standing fluid; groundwater, damp earth, wet cloth, wet wood, wet stone, or recent rainfall; spiritual moisture created by your own cultivation; water carried in a flask, gourd, talisman vessel, sleeve reservoir, or prepared focus; a large natural source such as a pond, river, lake, sea, waterfall, spring, canal, cistern, or reservoir. Unless a talent says otherwise, a Water cultivator can create enough temporary spiritual water to perform a Water technique. Stronger techniques improve when a real source exists. ##### Created Water Created Water is temporary spiritual water generated by a technique. Created Water may strike, flow, obscure, cleanse, carry, pressure, and defend as described by the talent. It vanishes when the talent ends unless a feature creates persistent terrain. It cannot be stored, sold, used as long-term irrigation, created inside a sealed container, created inside a living creature, or used to solve strategic water scarcity unless a talent or project says so. ##### Real Water Advantage When a Water talent is used in direct contact with a significant real water source, choose one appropriate benefit if the GM agrees the scene supports it: increase forced movement by 5 feet; increase one area dimension by 5 feet; gain Advantage on one Water check to maintain, shape, or contest a current; reduce the CP cost by 1, minimum 1; increase the duration of noncombat utility shaping. A technique normally gains only one Real Water Advantage benefit. ##### Water Control Limit Unless a talent says otherwise, you may maintain: one Concentration Water effect; one Created Water Basin; one Water servant, clone, or similar independent construct; any number of instantaneous Water effects. If you create a new persistent effect of the same category, the old one ends unless a feature increases your limit. ##### The Water Cycle Water talents use four shared terms. Source is where the water begins. Current is water in motion. A Current can push, pull, carry, slide, obscure with spray, make terrain difficult, extinguish ordinary flame, or move loose objects when a talent says so. Basin is water that remains in an area. A Basin may be a pool, mist cloud, defensive ring, whirlpool, sacred spring, or tide court. Return is water completing its circuit. Return effects reclaim water, cleanse, heal lightly, move allies, collapse hostile effects, or gather scattered water into a stronger technique. A talent should usually tell you which part of the cycle it modifies. If a talent does not say otherwise, it does not create a new independent mode; it modifies Water Lash, Shape Current, a Basin, a Current, or a Return. ##### Soaked Some Water talents make a creature or object Soaked until the end of your next turn or until dried by significant heat, wind, or magic. Soaked is a sphere state, not a standard condition. A Soaked target suffers no penalty by itself, but Water talents may exploit it. Ordinary flames or smoke on a Soaked target are usually extinguished, and the target may leave wet traces for a short time. ##### Drowning Pressure Drowning Pressure is supernatural pressure, not automatic suffocation. It attacks breath, posture, circulation, spiritual rhythm, and the body’s relationship to surrounding current. A creature under Drowning Pressure may be unable to speak clearly, may suffer Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration, may be unable to regain Hit Points briefly, may lose Reactions, may have Speed reduced, or may be Grappled or Restrained as stated by the talent. Creatures that do not breathe are not automatically immune, but creatures without bodies, fluids, or pressure-readable forms may gain Advantage or immunity at the GM’s discretion. ##### Scouring Erosion Water erodes through repeated pressure. Against unattended mundane stone, packed earth, mud, wood, salt, clay, ash, fragile barriers, or similar materials, the GM may allow a Water Pressure talent to ignore ordinary Resistance or deal double damage if it is specifically described as cutting water, pressure drilling, or erosion. ##### Water Talent Tags Current talents modify water movement. Basin talents modify persistent water areas. Mist talents modify obscuring water. Cleansing talents modify Return effects. Pressure talents modify Drowning Pressure, restraint, piercing water, or crushing water. Tide talents affect multiple creatures or large areas. Spring talents create long-term water sites or ritual anchors. Domain talents establish battlefield law. Realm Evolutions transform how the Water Cycle functions at higher Realms. #### Base Sphere Abilities ##### Water Initiation When you first gain the Water sphere, you gain Water Lash, Shape Current, and one Mortal Realm Water talent. Make a ranged Cultivation Attack. On a hit, the target takes 1d8 bludgeoning damage and becomes Soaked until the end of your next turn. The damage increases by 1d8 at CL 5, CL 11, and CL 17. If the target is already Soaked, you may move it 5 feet into a legal unoccupied space after the hit. This forced movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. ##### Shape Current Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Area: One 10-foot square or a 10-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 1 CP You gather water into a simple Current or Basin. Choose one form when you use this ability. Flowing Current. The area is Difficult Terrain for hostile creatures. When you create the Current, choose one creature in the area. It must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed or pulled 10 feet along the Current into a legal space. Mist Basin. The area becomes Lightly Obscured. A creature inside it can attempt to Hide normally if it has appropriate cover or concealment. Cleansing Basin. The first time each round you or an ally enters the area or starts its turn there, it may end the Soaked state on itself, extinguish ordinary flames on itself, or gain Advantage on the next saving throw before the start of its next turn against Poisoned, a disease, smoke, heat, or mundane contamination. Pressure Basin. The area presses down and around. The first hostile creature each round that enters the area or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength saving throw or have its Speed reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. You may move a Basin or Current up to 10 feet as a Bonus Action on your turn. ##### Return the Flow Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 60 feet Cost: 0 CP Choose one Water effect you created within range. Move it up to 10 feet, end it early, or convert it into one of the following minor Return effects: one creature in or adjacent to it becomes Soaked; one ally in or adjacent to it moves 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; one ordinary flame in or adjacent to it is extinguished; you regain awareness of the nearest obvious Water Source within 60 feet. You cannot use Return the Flow to move a creature through a wall, closed door, Barrier, or sealed effect. #### Mortal Realm Talents ##### Flowing Step - Current When you use Return the Flow, you may target yourself instead of an ally even if you are not adjacent to the Water effect. Move up to 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from creatures that are Soaked or standing in one of your Currents or Basins. If you start your turn in rain, mist, wet ground, or a Basin you created, you may stand from Prone without spending movement once per turn. ##### Wave Burst - Current When you create a Flowing Current with Shape Current, you may make it burst outward from a point instead of flowing in a line or square. The area becomes a 10-foot-radius burst. Each creature of your choice in the area must succeed on a Strength saving throw or be pushed 10 feet away from the center and become Soaked. On a successful save, a creature is only Soaked. ##### Cleansing Water - Cleansing When you create a Cleansing Basin, improve it as follows: the area can end the Burning, covered-in-smoke, or mundane contamination state on one creature each round; an ally that benefits from the Basin gains Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus; the Basin can wash away mundane poison, acid residue, dust, ash, or filth from a creature or object. Cleansing Water does not cure magical disease, regenerate injury, remove curses, or replace the Life sphere. ##### Mist Veil - Mist When you create a Mist Basin, you may make the area a 15-foot-radius sphere instead of a 10-foot square. The area is Lightly Obscured. By spending 1 additional CP when you create it, you may make the area Heavily Obscured until the start of your next turn; after that, it becomes Lightly Obscured for the remaining duration. A creature does not become Hidden automatically. It must still use Hide or another feature. ##### Water Breathing - Cleansing / Tide You can use Shape Current to create a Breath Basin instead of one of its normal forms. The Basin occupies a 10-foot-radius area and lasts for 1 hour without Concentration. Creatures of your choice in the Basin can breathe underwater, speak normally through water, and ignore the ordinary penalties of wet lungs, smoke inhalation, or choking dust while they remain in the area. At CL 5, you may instead target up to a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. They gain this benefit for 1 hour while within 1 mile of a Water Source you have touched during the last minute. ##### Pull of the River - Current When your Water Lash hits a Soaked target, you may pull the target 10 feet instead of moving it 5 feet. If the target is Large or smaller and ends this movement adjacent to a Basin or Current you created, it must succeed on a Strength saving throw or fall Prone. ##### Cutting Current - Pressure Your Water Lash may deal slashing damage instead of bludgeoning damage. If the target is Soaked, add your Proficiency Bonus to the damage. Against unattended mundane ropes, cloth, paper, ash, salt, mud, clay, or soft stone, this damage counts as Scouring Erosion. ##### Still Surface Method - Mist When a creature inside your Mist Basin is targeted by an attack from outside the Basin, you may use your Reaction to ripple the mist. The attacker has Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll unless it can see through obscurement or the attack does not rely on sight. You may use this Reaction a number of times equal to your Proficiency Bonus per long rest, or by spending 1 CP. ##### Drinking the Rain - Cleansing When you finish a short rest while you have access to rain, mist, clean water, or one of your Cleansing Basins, choose up to six creatures who rested with you. Each chosen creature may remove one level of Exhaustion caused by heat, dehydration, thirst, smoke, forced march, or similar environmental strain. A creature can benefit from this talent once per long rest. #### Foundation Realm Talents ##### Living Current - Realm Evolution At Foundation, your created water develops spiritual continuity. Gain the following benefits: Water Lash can originate from any Basin or Current you created within 60 feet instead of from your body. Return the Flow can move one of your Basins or Currents up to 20 feet instead of 10 feet. Your Water Control Limit increases by one Created Water Basin. When a talent asks whether a creature is adjacent to your Water effect, a creature inside the effect also counts. ##### Water Shield - Current / Cleansing Trigger: You or a creature within 30 feet that you can perceive takes damage from an attack or area effect. Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: 1 CP A current rises to absorb and redirect harm. Reduce the triggering damage by 1d10 + your Water key ability modifier. If the protected creature is Soaked or inside one of your Basins or Currents, also move it 10 feet into a legal space without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At CL 11, reduce the damage by 2d10 + your modifier. At CL 17, reduce it by 3d10 + your modifier. ##### Crushing Current - Pressure When a creature fails its saving throw against your Pressure Basin, you may apply Drowning Pressure until the start of your next turn. Choose one effect: the target cannot speak clearly; the target cannot take Reactions; the target has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration; the target cannot regain Hit Points until the start of your next turn. If the target was already Soaked, you may choose two effects. ##### Restorative Waters - Cleansing / Return When you use Return the Flow, you may spend 1 CP to restore Hit Points equal to 1d8 + your Water key ability modifier to one ally in or adjacent to the Water effect. At CL 11, the healing becomes 2d8 + your modifier. At CL 17, it becomes 3d8 + your modifier. A creature can benefit from Restorative Waters once per short rest unless you spend 2 CP instead of 1 CP. This is supportive restoration, not full Life-sphere regeneration. ##### Water Whip - Current / Pressure When Water Lash hits, you may spend 1 CP to wrap the target in a whip-current. The target must succeed on a Strength saving throw or become Grappled by the water until the end of your next turn. While Grappled this way, it is also Soaked. A target can escape early by using an action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC. ##### River Passage - Tide You can use Return the Flow to carry yourself or a willing creature through connected water. If you begin adjacent to a Water Source, Basin, Current, river, canal, pond, cistern, rain curtain, or similar water path, you may teleport up to 60 feet to an unoccupied space adjacent to the same connected water system or one of your Basins. At CL 11, the range becomes 300 feet. At CL 15, it becomes 1 mile if both ends are connected to a significant Water Source. ##### Pressure Lance - Pressure When you use Water Lash, you may spend 1 CP to make it a line 60 feet long and 5 feet wide. Make one attack roll and compare it to the AC of each creature in the line. On a hit, a target takes Water Lash damage and becomes Soaked. If a target was already Soaked, add one Water Lash die to the damage. Objects in the line take damage normally. Against unattended barriers, this can count as Scouring Erosion. ##### Mirror-Water Reply - Mist / Current When a creature misses you or an ally inside your Mist Basin or while Soaked, you may use your Reaction and spend 1 CP. Choose one: move the missed creature 10 feet into a legal space if it fails a Strength saving throw; move the protected creature 10 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; make the attacker Soaked and give the next attack roll against it Advantage before the start of your next turn. ##### Drown the Flame - Cleansing / Pressure When you create or move a Basin or Current, you may attempt to quench fire in the area. Ordinary flames are extinguished. Magical flames and Fire sphere effects require a Water check against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC or an opposed Cultivation Check if the effect is especially strong. If you succeed against a Fire effect, you may make one creature in the area Soaked or end one Burning-like ongoing fire effect on a creature. #### Core Formation Realm Talents ##### Court of the Endless Tide - Domain Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 60-foot Emanation from you Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Cost: 3 CP You establish a tide court. The battlefield gains a spiritual slope toward your chosen sea. While the Domain lasts: you may maintain one additional Basin or Current; Water Lash may originate from any point inside the Domain; once on each of your turns, you may use Return the Flow without using a Bonus Action; hostile creatures treat your Basins and Currents as Difficult Terrain; allies of your choice ignore Difficult Terrain from your Water effects; when a hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of your Water effects, you may move it 10 feet into a legal space; when you create a Basin, you may choose two forms from Shape Current instead of one, such as Mist plus Pressure or Cleansing plus Flow. The Domain does not fill the entire area with physical water unless you use talents that create floodwater. ##### Tidal Wave - Tide / Current When you use Shape Current, you may spend 2 additional CP to create a wave. Choose a line up to 90 feet long and 15 feet wide, or a 30-foot cone. Each creature of your choice in the area makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 4d8 bludgeoning damage, is pushed 20 feet, falls Prone, and becomes Soaked. On a successful save, it takes half damage and becomes Soaked. If used inside your Court of the Endless Tide, you may curve the wave once around a corner or obstacle you can perceive. ##### Whirlpool Prison - Pressure / Basin When you create a Pressure Basin, you may spend 2 additional CP to make it a whirlpool. The area becomes a 20-foot-radius Basin. A hostile creature that enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, it is Restrained until the start of its next turn and suffers Drowning Pressure. On a success, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn. A creature Restrained this way can use its action to repeat the save, ending the effect on itself on a success. ##### Water Clone - Basin / Mist When you create a Mist Basin or Cleansing Basin, you may spend 2 CP to form a Water Clone in it. The clone occupies one space inside the Basin and lasts for the Basin’s duration. It cannot attack independently. When a creature you can perceive attacks you or an ally within 30 feet of the clone, you may use your Reaction to have the clone interpose. Roll a d20. On an 11 or higher, the attack targets the clone instead. The clone has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC and Hit Points equal to twice your CL. If reduced to 0 Hit Points, it bursts and makes each hostile creature within 5 feet Soaked. ##### Ten Thousand Returning Streams - Return / Tide When you use Return the Flow inside your Court of the Endless Tide, you may choose up to three Water effects you created instead of one. For each chosen effect, move it up to 20 feet, end it, or apply one minor Return effect. A creature can be moved by this talent only once per turn. If at least two chosen effects end, you may restore Hit Points equal to your Water key ability modifier + your Proficiency Bonus to one ally inside the Domain. ##### River Cuts the Gate - Pressure / Erosion When your Water Lash, Pressure Lance, Tidal Wave, or Whirlpool Prison damages an object, Barrier, gate, wall, formation anchor, or unattended structure, you may spend 1 CP to apply Scouring Erosion. For 1 minute, repeated Water damage against that target ignores ordinary Resistance to bludgeoning, piercing, and slashing damage from nonmagical sources and deals double damage to mundane objects if the GM agrees the material can be eroded. Against magical Barriers, use a Water check against the Barrier’s DC or the creator’s Cultivation Save DC. On a success, the next Water damage against the Barrier before the end of your next turn gains the same benefit. ##### Sacred Spring - Spring / Project You may perform a 10-minute rite at a clean Water Source or Cleansing Basin, spending 3 CP. For 24 hours, the site becomes a Sacred Spring. A creature that spends 10 minutes washing, drinking, or meditating there gains one benefit: remove one level of Exhaustion caused by thirst, heat, smoke, forced march, or environmental hardship; gain Advantage on the next saving throw against Poisoned or disease before the next long rest; recover additional Hit Points equal to your CL during a short rest; cleanse mundane filth, ash, smoke residue, or spiritual grime visible to ordinary senses. A Sacred Spring cannot remove curses, resurrect the dead, replace Life, or produce infinite economic water. Long-term springs require project rules, maintenance, and local spiritual geography. #### Nascent Soul Realm Talents ##### Ocean-Sovereign Incarnation - Realm Evolution Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: 5 CP Uses: Once per long rest unless a feature says otherwise You become a sovereign current. Your body, breath, defense, and water effects move as one sea. While this incarnation lasts: you gain Swim Speed equal to twice your Speed and can breathe underwater; Water Lash range becomes 300 feet; Water Lash may originate from any Water Source, Basin, or Current you control within range; once on each of your turns, you may use Return the Flow without an action; your Water Control Limit increases by two Basins or Currents; you may maintain Court of the Endless Tide without Concentration while this incarnation lasts; when a creature fails a save against your Water effect, you may apply Soaked, move it 10 feet, or impose one Drowning Pressure option; when you reduce damage with Water Shield, you may move the protected creature up to 30 feet. ##### Flood the Battlefield - Tide / Domain While your Court of the Endless Tide is active, you may spend 3 CP as an action to flood it. Until the start of your next turn, the Domain becomes waist-deep spiritual floodwater for creatures of your choice. Hostile creatures without Swim Speed treat the area as Difficult Terrain and have Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity checks made to resist your Water effects. When you activate the flood, choose up to a number of hostile creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Each makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature is knocked Prone, moved 30 feet into a legal space, and suffers Drowning Pressure until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is moved 10 feet and becomes Soaked. ##### Heaven-Falling Tsunami - Tide Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Area: 120-foot line, 30 feet wide, or 60-foot cone Cost: 5 CP Uses: Once per long rest A vertical sea descends or a horizontal tide breaks across the field. Each creature of your choice in the area makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 8d8 bludgeoning damage, is pushed up to 60 feet, falls Prone, becomes Soaked, and suffers Drowning Pressure until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage, is pushed 15 feet, and becomes Soaked. Objects and unattended structures in the area take the damage and may suffer Scouring Erosion. ##### Abyssal Pressure Seal - Pressure When a creature is Restrained by Whirlpool Prison, affected by Drowning Pressure, or inside your Court of the Endless Tide, you may use an action and spend 4 CP to seal it in abyssal pressure. The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, until the end of your next turn: it is Restrained; it cannot speak clearly; it cannot regain Hit Points; it has Disadvantage on Constitution saving throws to maintain Concentration; if it attempts to teleport, fly, or move through a planar or spatial technique, it must first succeed on a Water check contested by your Cultivation Save DC. On a successful save, it is Soaked and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. ##### River Path to the Sea - Tide / Travel You can expand River Passage into a travel rite. By spending 10 minutes and 5 CP at a significant Water Source, you may transport yourself and up to eight willing creatures to another significant Water Source you have personally visited or marked with a Water project. The destination must be within 10 miles per CL unless the journey follows a major river, coastline, sacred canal, or sea route approved by the GM. This is a travel technique, not a combat teleport. Hostile wards, sealed Barriers, drought curses, or contested water deities may block or complicate the passage. ##### Erode the Mountain’s Name - Pressure / Spring Choose one object, wall, Barrier, formation anchor, or terrain feature you can affect with Water damage. Spend 10 minutes and 5 CP directing a continuous current against it. Make a Water check against a DC set by the GM or against the creator’s Cultivation Save DC. On a success, the target gains an Erosion Mark for 24 hours. While marked, Water damage against the target ignores ordinary Resistance and deals double damage if the target is mundane and erodible. If the target is a magical Barrier or formation anchor, the next successful Water check made to disrupt it before the mark ends has Advantage. A single target can bear only one Erosion Mark from you at a time. #### Secret Water Inheritance ##### When the Sea Forgets the Shore Secret Water Inheritance Prerequisite: Ocean-Sovereign Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden oceanic scripture, sea-heart initiation, or equivalent revelation Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: 1 mile, centered on a significant Water Source or on yourself during Ocean-Sovereign Incarnation Area: Up to a 300-foot-radius region chosen by the GM and player according to terrain Duration: 1 minute Cost: 8 CP Uses: Once per week You declare that the battlefield was only temporarily dry. For the duration, the area becomes a sovereign tide region. It may manifest as floodwater, descending rain-sea, rivers rising from stone, a phantom ocean overlapping reality, or every drop in the area remembering its original sea. Choose three laws when the inheritance manifests: No Shore. Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. Allies of your choice ignore this terrain and gain Swim Speed equal to their Speed. Every Path Returns. Once per round, when a hostile creature moves, teleports, flies, or is forced to move inside the area, you may move it up to 30 feet into a legal space after that movement resolves. All Fire Drowns. Ordinary flames are extinguished. Fire effects that begin in the area or enter it must succeed on an opposed Cultivation Check or be suppressed until the start of the creator’s next turn. Pressure Has No Surface. Up to three hostile creatures of your choice each round suffer Drowning Pressure until the start of your next turn. The River Takes the Weapon. Once per round, when a hostile creature hits with a weapon attack inside the area, reduce the damage by 4d10 and move the attacker or target 30 feet into a legal space. The Sea Gives Back. Once per round, an ally of your choice inside the area regains Hit Points equal to 4d8 + your Water key ability modifier when it starts its turn Soaked or inside a Water effect. Mountains Become Silt. Objects, walls, gates, and unattended structures in the area suffer Scouring Erosion. Water damage against them is doubled if mundane and erodible. When the inheritance ends, choose one final Return: all allies of your choice in the area move up to 60 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks; one hostile creature that failed a saving throw against your Water effect during the inheritance is Restrained until the end of your next turn; one Barrier, gate, or terrain feature damaged by the inheritance gains an Erosion Mark for 24 hours; one Sacred Spring forms at the center for 24 hours. This inheritance cannot permanently flood a nation, create an endless sea, override a superior divine or sect formation without contest, or solve regional drought by itself. Those outcomes require campaign-scale projects. #### Water Drawbacks and Variant Scriptures A Water drawback is an optional sphere-specific limitation that grants a bonus Water talent or stated benefit while changing how Water cultivation functions. Choose at most one Water drawback when first learning Water or during a major Water initiation unless the GM says otherwise. If a drawback grants a talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, you gain that talent when you meet them. If the drawback is removed, the bonus talent or benefit is lost. ##### Source-Bound River Scripture Your Water techniques require a real Water Source. You cannot create Created Water except for noncombat condensation, dampening, or ceremonial effects. You gain one Current or Cleansing talent as a bonus talent. ##### Still-Pool Scripture Your Water resists violent motion. You cannot learn Pressure Lance, Tidal Wave, Heaven-Falling Tsunami, or other talents whose primary expression is violent impact unless the GM approves a still-water version. You gain Mist Veil or Sacred Spring as a bonus talent. ##### Salt-Bitter Scripture Your Water is brine, mineral, and ocean pressure. Your Cleansing talents cannot restore Hit Points or support recovery unless used at a significant natural water source. You gain Crushing Current or Drown the Flame as a bonus talent. ##### Mercy-Rain Scripture Your Water refuses drowning cruelty. You cannot use talents that impose Drowning Pressure, prevent healing, or create lethal pressure against living creatures. You gain Cleansing Water or Restorative Waters as a bonus talent. ##### Vessel-Bound Tidal Scripture Your Water must move through a vessel, gourd, sleeve reservoir, talisman flask, bowl, or carried focus. If deprived of the vessel, Water techniques cost 1 additional CP and cannot benefit from Real Water Advantage. You gain Drinking the Rain or Water Shield as a bonus talent. ##### Ice-Edged Current Scripture Your Water always carries cold edge and winter memory. Fire effects are easier to contest, but your Water is less merciful. You gain Drown the Flame as a bonus talent. When you use Restorative Waters, reduce the healing by your Proficiency Bonus, minimum 1. #### Path Synergies ##### Qi Cultivation - Refined Tidal Circulation You may use Intelligence or Charisma as your Water key ability. When you use Shape Current, you may spend 1 additional CP to choose one: move the Basin or Current immediately by 20 feet; increase one area dimension by 5 feet; cause one Water Lash before the end of your turn to originate from the Basin; reduce the CP cost of the next Water talent that modifies the same Basin by 1, minimum 1. ##### Spirit Awakening - Ocean Soul You may use Wisdom as your Water key ability. When a creature becomes Soaked or suffers Drowning Pressure from your Water talent, you may sense whether it is alive, undead, construct, spirit, possessed, or a projection if the GM agrees the creature has a readable spiritual current. Once per round, when you use Cleansing Water or Restorative Waters on an ally, that ally may also end the Frightened condition on itself if the fear is not a superior curse or Secret effect. ##### Body Refining - Tidal Body You may use Constitution as your Water key ability for Water talents that originate from your body, carried vessel, or a Basin you occupy. While Soaked or standing in one of your Basins or Currents, you gain one benefit: Advantage on checks and saves against forced movement; you may hold your breath for 10 times the normal duration; once per turn after you hit with an Unarmed Strike, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the target. #### Cultivation Insights ##### Tidal Body Prerequisite: Water sphere, CL 4+ When you become Soaked by your own Water talent, you may choose not to end the Soaked state until the start of your next turn. While willingly Soaked this way, you gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of your turn. ##### Water-Walking Immortal Prerequisite: Water sphere, CL 6+ You can stand and move across liquid surfaces as if they were solid ground during your turn. If you end your turn on liquid without support, you sink unless another feature sustains you. While moving across a Water Source, Basin, or Current, your Speed increases by 10 feet. ##### Eroding Current Prerequisite: Water sphere, Cutting Current or River Cuts the Gate, CL 8+ Once per turn, when you damage an object, Barrier, or unattended structure with Water Lash or a Pressure talent, you may apply Scouring Erosion without spending CP. ##### Cleansing Adept Prerequisite: Water sphere, Cleansing Water, CL 8+ When a creature benefits from your Cleansing Basin, choose one additional benefit: it may immediately repeat a saving throw against Poisoned or disease; it gains Advantage on its next death saving throw before the start of your next turn; it removes one mundane contamination, smoke effect, or environmental grime. ##### Tide-Court Footwork Prerequisite: Water sphere, Court of the Endless Tide, CL 12+ While inside your Court of the Endless Tide, allies of your choice may move through spaces occupied by hostile creatures if they do not end movement there. Once per round, when an ally moves through a hostile creature’s space this way, that hostile creature becomes Soaked. ##### Spring-Founding Adept Prerequisite: Water sphere, Sacred Spring, CL 12+ Your Sacred Spring lasts 7 days instead of 24 hours if you spend 1 hour performing the rite and provide a suitable anchor. A long-term spring still requires project rules for permanent settlement, agriculture, sect infrastructure, or regional drought relief.
