spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Weapons Qi Expression: Primary — Weapon Qi; Supporting — Metal Qi, Killing-Tool Qi, Discipline Qi, Form Qi. Sphere Type: Martial / Universal Weapon Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation and Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus, ordinary weapon action economy, and CP or Stamina only when a talent, Path expression, or forged technique says so Core Chassis: Legal Weapons, Weapon Families, Weapon Tags, Weapon Methods, Weapon Literacy, Ready the Implement, Apply Weapon Method Design Note: Weapons is an arsenal and implement sphere. It should not replace dedicated Sword, Spear, Dual Wielding, Sniper, Chains, or specialist weapon spheres. Common Name: Weapons Catalogue Name: Sphere of Weapons Sphere Type: Martial / Universal Weapon Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Paths: Qi Cultivation, Spirit Awakening Resource: Martial Focus, ordinary weapon action economy, and CP or Stamina only when a talent says so Core Chassis: Legal Weapons, Weapon Families, Weapon Tags, Weapon Methods Core Abilities: Weapon Literacy, Ready the Implement, Apply Weapon Method A spear has a doctrine. A sword has a judgment. A weapon has a promise: the body will not meet the world empty-handed. ## What This Sphere Is For The Sphere of Weapons is the broad martial sphere for cultivators who fight with a wide arsenal, unusual weapons, battlefield tools, officer weapons, concealed weapons, soft weapons, thrown weapons, or historical arms that do not need a full specialist sphere. Weapons is not a replacement for dedicated weapon spheres. Sword remains better for sword intent and sword doctrine. Spear remains better for spear line pressure and spear-light techniques. Dual Wielding remains better for paired weapon action economy. Sniper remains better for ranged precision. Chains or a future Soft Weapons sphere may eventually handle deeper chain-binding and flexible weapon domains. Weapons is for the cultivator who looks at the battlefield and chooses the right implement. ## Dao of Weapons The Dao of Weapons is appropriateness of form. A cultivator of Weapons does not ask, "What is the strongest weapon?" They ask: - What shape does this moment require? - What line is open? - What tool answers the enemy's posture? - What does this weapon know that my bare hand does not? The Weapons cultivator wins by changing tools without losing intention. ## Sphere Boundaries ### Sword and Spear A jian can be used with Weapons, but Sword sphere remains the specialist path for sword intent, sword qi, meridian-cutting sword arts, and deep sword doctrine. A qiang, mao, ji, or other pole thrusting weapon can be used with Weapons, but Spear sphere remains the specialist path for spear intent, line pressure, interception, and spear-light expression. ### Dual Wielding Paired weapons such as hu die dao, zi-wu, gou, paired daggers, paired axes, or paired hammers can be used with Weapons, but Dual Wielding remains the specialist path for two-weapon action economy, paired strikes, and off-hand optimization. ### Chains and Soft Weapons Soft weapons such as rope darts, meteor hammers, chain whips, and three-sectional staffs can be represented here as legal weapons. If the campaign uses a dedicated Chains or Soft Weapons sphere later, that sphere controls deeper chain-binding, extended flexible control, and exotic soft-weapon domains. ### Sniper and Projectile Weapons Bows, crossbows, flying darts, and pellet bows are legal weapons here. Sniper remains the specialist path for range dominance, precision shots, concealment, marksmanship, and head-shot style techniques. ### Improvised Weapons This sphere may make improvised weapons usable when their shape matches a listed profile, but it does not make every object a perfect weapon. The GM decides whether a chair leg is a staff, a cooking knife is a dagger, or a chain is a chain whip. ## Important Rule: Damage Die Is Not Hit Die When this sphere says a weapon has a damage die, it means the weapon's damage die for weapon attacks. It does not mean Hit Die. Cultivation Path Hit Dice still come from Path rules. ## Legal Weapon Profiles Every legal weapon should have: - common name; - Chinese name, when known; - weapon family; - proficiency class; - damage die; - damage type; - handedness and range; - properties; - weapon tags; - any special rule; - a boundary note if the weapon overlaps a specialist sphere. If a weapon is not listed, choose the nearest profile or create a profile before using it in combat. ## Weapon Properties and Tags Properties such as Finesse, Light, Reach, Thrown, Two-Handed, Heavy, Ammunition, Loading, and Versatile follow the 2024 Fifth Edition baseline unless Tianxia text changes them. The following Tianxia weapon tags do not automatically grant special attacks. They define what the weapon is good at and what talents may legally invoke. Armor-Breaking. Suitable for striking armor, shields, hard shells, and objects. Balanced Edge. Can cut and thrust with equal discipline. Bind. Can trap, catch, or interfere with another weapon or limb. Chopping Edge. Strong at hacking cuts and committed slashes. Concealed. Can be hidden on the body more easily than ordinary weapons. Disarming. Built to remove or compromise a held weapon. Flexible. Uses chain, rope, linked segments, or folding movement. Guarding Hilt. Strong defensive hand protection. Heavy-Headed. Delivers weight through a head, hammer, mace, or weighted end. Hidden. Especially suited to surprise drawing or sleeve/boot deployment. Hooking. Can catch limbs, weapons, shields, or edges. Mounted. Functions well from horseback or charging lines. Nonlethal. Designed or easily used for disabling rather than killing. Paired. Often used in pairs and qualifies for paired-weapon techniques. Pinning. Built to hold a target in place. Poison-Ready. Easy to poison or carry alchemical coatings. Pulling. Strong at dragging enemies from formation. Returning Line. Remains attached to the wielder by rope or chain. Ribbed. Sectioned impact surface useful for crushing and catching. Spinning. Uses rotation, finger-rings, or palm turns. Sweeping. Strong at wide arcs, leg attacks, and crowd pressure. Tassel. Has stabilizing or distracting tassel use. Variable Reach. Can shift between close and extended handling. ## Core Ability: Weapon Literacy Action Type: Passive Factory Combat Bucket: passive Factory Routing: passive_or_modifier_row Cost: 0 Effect: You understand the handling logic of legal weapons. When you first gain this sphere, choose one of the following options: - gain proficiency with three legal weapons from the catalogue; - gain proficiency with one weapon family, such as Short Blades, Long Polearms, Soft Weapons, or Projectile Weapons; - gain proficiency with one exotic weapon and two ordinary legal weapons; - if you already have broad martial weapon proficiency, instead choose one legal weapon as a Signature Weapon and one exotic weapon as a Familiar Weapon. You can identify a listed weapon, its damage die, damage type, tags, and obvious special handling needs after 1 minute of inspection. If you are proficient with the weapon, you can do this as part of drawing or readying it. ## Core Ability: Ready the Implement Action Type: Multi-Mode Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode Factory Combat Bucket: split_required Split Candidate Buckets: bonus_action, passive Timing Detail: Free object interaction once per turn, or Bonus Action when changing a full kit Factory Routing: split_modes_before_character_action_programming Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets Recommended Factory Realization: modes=FREE_INTERACTION_READY_IMPLEMENT->passive, BONUS_ACTION_FULL_KIT_CHANGE->bonus_action Cost: 0 Target: One legal weapon you carry Effect: You draw, stow, change grip, reverse grip, unfold, link, restring, or otherwise ready one legal weapon. Once on each of your turns, you may draw or stow one weapon as part of an Attack action, a Weapon Method, or movement. If you change from one weapon family to another during the same turn, you may use a Bonus Action to make the change cleanly. This ability does not bypass shields, restraints, disarming, being swallowed, lacking a free hand, or other physical limits. ## Core Ability: Apply Weapon Method Action Type: Linked Modifier Canonical Action Type: Linked Modifier Factory Combat Bucket: passive Timing Detail: No action, once per turn when you hit with a proficient legal weapon Factory Routing: linked_modifier_row Cost: Usually 0; some methods require expending Martial Focus Target: The creature or object hit Save DC: 8 + your proficiency bonus + the ability modifier used for the attack Effect: You apply one method that matches the weapon's tags. You may apply one minor method once per turn. You may instead expend Martial Focus to apply one major method listed below. Unless a method says otherwise, it lasts until the start of your next turn. ### Minor Methods Guarding Method. Requirement: Guard, Balanced Edge, Guarding Hilt, Nonlethal, or Staff-like weapon. The next attack the target makes against you before the start of your next turn has Disadvantage if the target remains within your reach. Pressing Method. Requirement: Cut, Smash, Thrust, or Sweep. After the hit, you may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the target you hit. Measuring Method. Requirement: Reach, Long, Projectile, or Thrust. The target's speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. Hidden Method. Requirement: Concealed or Hidden. If the target had not seen that weapon drawn this turn, add +1d4 damage of the weapon's type. You can gain this bonus only once per combat with a given hidden weapon unless a talent says otherwise. ### Major Methods To use a major method, expend Martial Focus when you hit. Hooking Method. Requirement: Hooking, Pulling, Disarming, or Flexible. The target makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, either pull the target 5 feet, prevent it from taking reactions until the start of your next turn, or give it Disadvantage on the next attack it makes with one held weapon before the start of your next turn. Pinning Method. Requirement: Pinning, Reach, Fork, Spear, Staff, or Polearm. The target makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, its speed becomes 0 until the start of your next turn. A creature more than one size larger than you has Advantage on this save. Breaking Method. Requirement: Armor-Breaking, Sword-Breaker, Heavy-Headed, Chopping Edge, or Smash. Add your proficiency bonus to the damage. If the target is an unattended object, a shield, a door, a lock, or a nonliving obstacle, add twice your proficiency bonus instead. Sweeping Method. Requirement: Sweeping, Flexible, Staff, Polearm, or Heavy-Headed. A second creature within your reach and within 5 feet of the original target takes damage equal to your proficiency bonus of the weapon's damage type. This does not trigger riders, poison, or on-hit effects unless a talent says otherwise. Casting Method. Requirement: Thrown, Returning Line, Projectile, or Hidden. If the weapon has Thrown or Returning Line, you may draw another weapon as part of the same attack sequence. If the weapon has Returning Line, you may retrieve it to your hand at the end of the attack if no creature or object restrains the line. ## Weapons / Equipment Additions Qi Types: armament qi, weapon method qi, hand-method qi, conduit qi, profile qi; related methods may add sword qi, saber qi, spear qi, metal qi, shield qi, chain qi, blacksmith qi, ancestral weapon qi, killing intent, or spirit-weapon qi only when another sphere, Foundation, manual, or feature explicitly contributes it. “A tool is honest until a cultivator teaches it ambition.” Common Name: Weapons / Equipment Additions Sphere Type: Martial Addendum; Equipment-Method Addendum; Profile Specialization and Conduit Weapon Patch Primary Paths: Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, and Spirit Awakening Secondary Path: None. This addendum exists so all Paths can express weapons differently. Key Themes: armament qi, weapon profile specialization, body-bound weapons, qi-conduit weapons, spirit heirlooms, cultivation modifier attacks, and weapon-as-method Primary Resource Hooks: ordinary Weapons sphere proficiency, CP only through talents that say so, Path key ability, Conduit Weapon, weapon profile specialty Core Chassis: Weapons Sphere Reference, Profile Lesson, Armament Conduit Chain Common Effects: weapon profile riders, cultivation/casting modifier substitution, body-bound legality, resonance focus, and armament-method expression ### Weapons Dao Weapons are not only objects. In cultivation, a weapon can be hand, intent, oath, conduit, memory, burden, tool, tyrant, companion, or ancestral command. This addendum does not replace Sword, Sabers, Spear, Chains, Shield, Axes, Sniper, Fencing, or any specific weapon sphere. It gives the broad Weapons sphere a way to support profile-specific mastery and Path-specific weapon expression. ### Sphere Boundary This addendum governs: - weapon profile specialty talents; - broad armament handling through the Weapons sphere; - weapons used as body-bound methods, qi conduits, or spirit heirlooms; - the three-investment cultivation/casting modifier chain; - low-to-mid-level weapon method expression that does not belong to a more specific sphere. This addendum does not govern: - Sword Heart, flying sword doctrine, saber execution doctrine, spear formation lines, shield fortress defense, chain binding, bow-sniper doctrine, or axe fury as full styles; - Blacksmith crafting, permanent item improvement, repair, workshop production, or artifact creation; - Metal Qi, magnetic control, ore command, or iron body cultivation; - autonomous weapon companions, full spirit weapons, intelligent artifacts, or weapon souls unless another feature grants them; - Lightning-style sovereign regional authority. If a weapon is being used as a named martial doctrine, use the specific sphere or manual when one exists. If it is mainly equipment creation, use Blacksmith. If it is broad profile handling, use this addendum. ### Weapons Access This addendum requires the Weapons sphere. It does not stand alone. A character may take these talents only if the campaign admits this addendum into the Weapons sphere or grants it as a patch module. The addendum is Foundation-facing by default. It is meant to deepen weapon choice without creating a new upper-Realm sovereign sphere. ### 2024 Fifth-Edition Rules Baseline Weapon attacks, weapon properties, ammunition, Loading, hands, thrown range, cover, improvised weapon rules, object interaction, disarm rules, and proficiency rules follow the active Tianxia and 2024 fifth-edition baseline unless a talent explicitly changes them. This addendum never grants additional proficiency beyond the base Weapons sphere or another legal source. Cultivation modifier substitution applies only through the printed chain and only to the chosen Conduit Weapon. ### Core Weapons / Equipment Rules #### Conduit Weapon A Conduit Weapon is one weapon you are proficient with and have prepared through Armament Conduit Initiate. A Conduit Weapon does not become autonomous, intelligent, flying, summoned, indestructible, or spiritually loyal unless another feature says so. #### Weapon Profile Specialty A weapon profile specialty is tied to one listed legal weapon profile. Only one weapon profile specialty can modify a single attack, reaction, or damage packet. A profile specialty is not a full style sphere. #### Ability Substitution Casting-Hand Weapon Method changes attack and damage ability modifier for the chosen Conduit Weapon. It does not change save DCs, sphere key abilities, manual DCs, or spellcasting rules unless another feature says so. ### Base Sphere Abilities #### Weapons Sphere Reference This addendum assumes the character already has the Weapons sphere. The base Weapons sphere grants its normal weapon access and proficiency package according to the active compendium. #### Profile Lesson When you gain a Foundation weapon specialty talent from this addendum, choose the listed legal weapon profile for that talent. The talent functions only with that profile unless the GM approves a near-identical weapon. ### Realm Progression Mortal Realm: Use the base Weapons sphere. This addendum normally does not add Mortal talents. Foundation Realm: The weapon becomes method: body armament, qi conduit, spirit heirloom, or profile specialty. Core Formation Realm: This addendum remains modest. Future or optional Core extensions may support paired conduits, weapon arrays, and battlefield armament circuits, but those are not included here by default. Nascent Soul Realm: This addendum does not provide native sovereign domains. Nascent weapon supremacy should come from specific spheres, manuals, artifacts, spirit weapons, or forged techniques. Secret Inheritance: Secret weapon method records can deepen the conduit chain or profile specialization, but they should not rival Lightning’s regional secret inheritances by default. ### Weapon Methods Choose one Weapon Method when you first take a Foundation talent from this addendum. #### Body Armament Method Your weapon is a limb disciplined by training. Choose one proficient weapon. While wielding it, you may describe eligible weapon talents as body-bound martial expression. This mainly supports Body Refining legality and does not add external projection. #### Qi Conduit Method Your weapon is a channel. This method supports Armament Conduit Initiate and Casting-Hand Weapon Method. #### Spirit Heirloom Method Your weapon is a vow, memory, name, ancestor, or spirit-bearing object. It may serve as a resonance focus for Spirit Awakening weapon expression. #### Profile Specialist Method Your weapon profile has a unique technical lesson. Choose one legal weapon profile specialty talent. Only one weapon specialty talent can modify a single attack, reaction, or damage packet. ### Path Expression #### Body Refining - Weapon as Limb Body Refiners express Weapons through tendon, grip, stance, armor, bone alignment, carried weight, and weapon-as-limb methods. When a Body Refiner chooses Body Armament Method, one proficient weapon may count as body-bound for features that care about held, worn, or body-bound martial expression. Once per turn when a Body Refiner hits with a body-bound weapon specialty, they may choose to gain Temporary HP equal to half their Proficiency Bonus, rounded up. This does not stack with itself. #### Qi Cultivation - Weapon as Conduit Qi Cultivators express Weapons as conduits, flying lines, talisman grips, formation-compatible foci, and scripture channels. Qi Cultivators may use Armament Conduit Initiate and Casting-Hand Weapon Method with Intelligence or Charisma, as appropriate to their cultivation key, once they meet the investment chain. Once per turn when a Qi Cultivator spends CP on a weapon talent using the Conduit Weapon, they may increase the weapon’s normal or thrown range by 10 feet for that attack if the weapon has a range. #### Spirit Awakening - Weapon as Memory Spirit Awakeners express Weapons as vows, ancestor tools, named blades, inherited burdens, spirit companions, weapon memories, and soul-bound armaments. When a Spirit Awakener chooses Spirit Heirloom Method, one proficient weapon may be treated as a resonance focus for Spirit-compatible weapon talents. It does not become an independent companion unless another feature says so. Once per short rest, after hitting with that weapon, the Spirit Awakener may ask the GM whether the target recognizes, fears, covets, disrespects, or spiritually resists the weapon’s symbolism. ### Weapons Talent Tags Conduit talents change which ability modifier a weapon uses. Profile talents make a specific weapon type feel distinct. Body Armament talents support Body Refining weapon expression. Spirit Heirloom talents support Spirit Awakening weapon expression. Profile Specialty talents are Foundation-grade weapon-profile riders. ### Foundation Realm Talents #### Body Armament Method - Body Armament Prerequisite: Weapons sphere Choose one proficient weapon. For you, that weapon may be treated as a body-bound martial implement when a Body Refining feature asks whether a martial expression is held, worn, or body-bound. This does not grant external qi projection. #### Qi Conduit Method - Conduit Prerequisite: Weapons sphere You learn to prepare weapons as qi conductors. This talent by itself does not change attack or damage modifiers, but it qualifies you for Armament Conduit Initiate and Casting-Hand Weapon Method. #### Spirit Heirloom Method - Spirit Heirloom Prerequisite: Weapons sphere Choose one proficient weapon with a name, vow, ancestor story, sect inheritance, spirit impression, or personal burden. You may use it as a resonance focus for Spirit Awakening weapon expression. It does not act on its own. #### Profile Specialist - Profile Prerequisite: Weapons sphere Choose one legal weapon profile specialty talent from this addendum. Only one weapon specialty talent can modify a single attack, reaction, or damage packet. #### Armament Conduit Initiate - Conduit Prerequisite: Weapons sphere and Qi Conduit Method Choose one weapon with which you are proficient. It becomes your Conduit Weapon. You learn to circulate your cultivation through it, but you do not yet replace its attack and damage ability modifier. #### Casting-Hand Weapon Method - Conduit Prerequisite: Armament Conduit Initiate When you attack with your Conduit Weapon, you may use your cultivation/casting modifier for attack and damage rolls instead of Strength or Dexterity. Body Refiners use Constitution, Qi Cultivators use Intelligence or Charisma as appropriate, and Spirit Awakeners use Wisdom. A campaign spellcasting modifier may be used only if the GM allows it. This does not grant additional proficiency, does not bypass ammunition or Loading, does not remove hand requirements, and does not make the weapon autonomous. ### Weapon Profile Specialty Talents #### Jian Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Jian profile only. once per turn after a hit with jian, you may add +1 to the next attack roll you make against the same target before end of turn if you do not move away. #### Duan Jian Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Duan Jian profile only. when adjacent to a creature you hit with duan jian, you may shift 5 feet around it without provoking from that creature once per turn. #### Dao Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Dao profile only. after moving at least 10 feet before a dao hit, add +1 slashing damage and make the target Guard Pressured if you also know Sabers. #### Duan Dao Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Duan Dao profile only. when you hit in cramped or adjacent fighting, ignore disadvantage caused only by close quarters unless the weapon physically cannot be used. #### Hu Die Dao Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Hu Die Dao profile only. once per turn after hitting with one butterfly saber, gain +1 AC against that target until start of your next turn if your other hand is also armed. #### Gou Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Gou profile only. after a hit, you may attempt to pull a carried weapon, shield, or limb line; target makes Strength save or cannot take Opportunity Attacks against you this turn. #### Fu Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Fu profile only. when you hit an object, shield, door, wooden barrier, or guard posture, add your Proficiency Bonus to damage once per turn. #### Tie Jian Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Tie Jian profile only. when you miss by 1 or 2 with tie jian, you may still make the target Guard Pressured until start of your next turn once per short rest. #### Tie Bian Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Tie Bian profile only. when you hit a target in armor or with natural armor, add +1 bludgeoning damage and learn whether armor or flesh is the stronger defense. #### Chui Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Chui profile only. when you hit a Large or smaller target, it makes a Strength save or is pushed 5 feet once per turn. #### Tie Chi Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Tie Chi profile only. when you hit a creature casting, forming seals, or drawing a weapon, impose disadvantage on its next opportunity attack or immediate counter before start of your next turn. #### Bi Shou Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Bi Shou profile only. when you hit a creature you had advantage against, add your Proficiency Bonus to damage once per turn. #### Zi-Wu Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Zi-Wu profile only. when a melee attack misses you, you may use your reaction to make a disarm, bind, or shove attempt with this weapon. #### Emei Ci Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Emei Ci profile only. when you hit with an Emei piercer, target cannot benefit from being hidden from you until start of your next turn. #### Qiang Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Qiang profile only. when a creature enters your reach, you may spend your reaction to make one spear attack if you have not used this talent since your last turn. #### Mao Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Mao profile only. after moving at least 20 feet before a hit, add +1d4 piercing damage once per turn. #### Gun Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Gun profile only. when you take the Dodge action while wielding a staff, your first hit before end of next turn gains +1 damage. #### Guandao/Yanyuedao Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Guandao/Yanyuedao profile only. after a hit against Large or larger creature, it makes Strength save or loses 5 feet Speed until start of your next turn. #### Yue Ya Chan Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Yue Ya Chan profile only. when you hit an undead, spirit, corpse, or buried/earth-touched creature, add +1 damage and learn whether it is spiritually restless. #### Cha/Hu Cha Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Cha/Hu Cha profile only. when you hit a creature with a weapon, limb, or natural attack, it makes Strength save or that attack has disadvantage against you until start of next turn. #### Duan Cha Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Duan Cha profile only. when grappling or adjacent, your hit may impose disadvantage on the target’s next grapple or shove check before start of your next turn. #### Ji Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Ji profile only. when you hit a mounted, flying-low, elevated, or charging creature, reduce its movement by 5 feet until start of your next turn. #### Ge Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Ge profile only. when you hit a target moving past you, you may pull it 5 feet on a failed Strength save. #### Sheng Biao Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Sheng Biao profile only. when you hit a target within 15 feet, you may pull the dart back and move one Tiny unattended object on or near it 5 feet toward you. #### Liu Xing Chui Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Liu Xing Chui profile only. when you miss a creature within range, choose another creature within 5 feet of it; that creature takes bludgeoning damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus on a failed Dexterity save. #### Jie Bian Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Jie Bian profile only. after a hit, target cannot take reactions against your movement until end of your turn once per turn. #### San Jie Gun Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method San Jie Gun profile only. when a melee attack misses you, gain +1 to your next attack roll with this weapon before end of your next turn. #### Gong Jian Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Gong Jian profile only. when you hit a target that has not moved since end of its last turn, add +1 piercing damage and reveal its space until start of your next turn. #### Nu Gong Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Nu Gong profile only. when you attack from cover or after aiming, ignore half cover on the first attack that turn. #### Dan Gong Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Dan Gong profile only. when you hit a fragile object, talisman, vial, eye-level ornament, or exposed component, add your Proficiency Bonus to object damage once per turn. #### Fei Biao Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Fei Biao profile only. when you draw and throw this weapon on the same turn, increase its normal range by 10 feet for that attack. #### Tong Zhu Specialty - Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist Method Tong Zhu profile only. when you hit a creature that has not seen this weapon used by you in the scene, it cannot take reactions against you until start of your next turn. ### Secret Weapon Method Records Secret records for this addendum are not sovereign inheritances. They are rare lessons that deepen weapon identity or conduit function. #### Thousand-Handles Armament Index - Secret, Profile Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Weapons sphere, imperial armory record, sect weapon library, or veteran instructor During a long rest, choose one weapon profile specialty you know. Until your next long rest, you may treat one near-identical weapon as that profile for that specialty. At Core Formation Realm, you may also gain Advantage on one check to identify, appraise, maintain, or counter that weapon profile before your next long rest. #### Conduit-Seal Grip Manual - Secret, Conduit Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Armament Conduit Initiate Your Conduit Weapon can hold its preparation through hardship. If you are disarmed, your Conduit Weapon remains your Conduit Weapon. Once before your next long rest, when you recover it, your next attack with it may use Casting-Hand Weapon Method even if your grip, stance, or circulation was disrupted earlier in the scene. #### Ancestral Grip Remembrance - Secret, Spirit Heirloom Prerequisite: Spirit Awakening Path, Spirit Heirloom Method Once per long rest, when you hit with your heirloom weapon, you may ask the weapon’s memory for one omen: whether the target is dishonorable, oath-bound, afraid, carrying ancestral protection, or spiritually tied to the weapon’s history. If the answer matters to the current scene, gain Advantage on your next Insight, Intimidation, History, or Religion check involving that target before the end of the scene. ### Weapons / Equipment Drawbacks and Variant Methods These variants are optional. A variant grants a benefit only if it also imposes a real limitation. #### One-Weapon Devotion Benefit: Choose one proficient weapon. Your first profile specialty hit with that weapon each combat gains +1 damage. Drawback: You cannot benefit from profile specialty talents for other weapon profiles unless you retrain this variant. #### Crude Armament Oath Benefit: You can use Body Armament Method with improvised weapons that clearly resemble a legal weapon profile. Drawback: You cannot use Casting-Hand Weapon Method with improvised weapons. #### Empty-Hand Conduit Ban Benefit: Your Conduit Weapon cannot be mistaken for unarmed spellcasting; when you use it, witnesses can clearly see the weapon is the medium. Gain Advantage on checks to prove a technique was weapon-mediated rather than spell-mediated. Drawback: You cannot hide your Conduit Weapon use without Illusion, Stealth, concealment tools, or comparable support. ### Path Synergies #### Body Refining - Grip, Bone, Weight When a Body Refiner uses a weapon profile specialty with a held or worn weapon, they may treat the specialty as body-bound for legality. This does not open ranged qi projection. Once per short rest, when a profile specialty prevents movement, pushes, pulls, or imposes a guard drawback, regain Stamina equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Qi Cultivation - Meridian Through the Handle When a Qi Cultivator uses Casting-Hand Weapon Method, the weapon counts as a qi focus for that attack. Once per short rest, when they hit with the Conduit Weapon, they may reduce the CP cost of one compatible weapon or sphere rider on that same attack by 1, minimum 0. #### Spirit Awakening - Name in the Grip When a Spirit Awakener uses Spirit Heirloom Method, they may name the weapon during a significant strike. Once per short rest, after hitting a creature with the heirloom weapon, gain Advantage on one Wisdom, Charisma, or Insight check involving the target’s reaction to the weapon, oath, memory, or lineage before the end of the scene. ### Cultivation Insights #### Careful Grip Disciple Prerequisite: Weapons sphere You have Advantage on checks to avoid being disarmed of your Conduit Weapon or chosen profile weapon. #### Profile Archivist Prerequisite: Weapons sphere, Profile Specialist You gain proficiency in History, Investigation, or smith’s tools. If you already have all three, choose another relevant tool proficiency with GM approval. #### Conduit Safety Lesson Prerequisite: Armament Conduit Initiate Once per short rest, when a failed attack with your Conduit Weapon would trigger backlash, overdraw, or a dropped-weapon complication from a compatible feature, reduce that complication by one step if the GM allows a reduction. #### Heirloom Etiquette Prerequisite: Spirit Heirloom Method You have Advantage on one social check per long rest when presenting, explaining, honoring, or negotiating around a named weapon, ancestor weapon, trophy weapon, or sect armament. #### Weapon Exchange Drill Prerequisite: Weapons sphere Once per turn, you may draw or stow one weapon as part of using a Weapons talent or profile specialty. #### Conduit Hand Correction Prerequisite: Casting-Hand Weapon Method If you miss with your Conduit Weapon by 1 or 2, you may choose to deal no damage but maintain your stance. Until the start of your next turn, you have Advantage on the next saving throw against being disarmed or losing concentration on a weapon-mediated technique. ### Automation Notes This addendum’s primary acquisition surface is Weapons Sphere Reference plus one Foundation Method. Profile Specialty talents are passive or once-turn riders tied to a weapon profile. Armament Conduit Initiate creates Conduit Weapon. Casting-Hand Weapon Method changes attack and damage ability modifier for Conduit Weapon only. AI should not treat this addendum as Metal, Blacksmith, Sword, Sabers, Spear, Shield, Chains, or a sovereign weapon domain. It is a Foundation-forward broad weapon patch. ## Mortal Talents ### Arsenal Student Gain proficiency with two additional legal weapons or one additional weapon family. You may take this talent more than once. ### Concealed Carry Method You have Advantage on checks to hide Concealed or Hidden weapons on your body. Once per combat, when you draw a Concealed or Hidden weapon against a creature that did not know you had it, you may use Hidden Method without counting against your once-per-turn Weapon Method limit. ### Hook, Catch, and Turn When you use Hooking Method, you may choose one additional result on a failed save if the weapon has both Hooking and Disarming, or both Flexible and Returning Line. ### Iron Against Iron When you use Breaking Method against a weapon, shield, or object held by a creature, the holder makes a Strength saving throw. On a failure, the item is rattled, cracked, caught, or driven out of line. Until the start of your next turn, attacks made with that item suffer a -2 penalty. This does not destroy magic items or cultivation treasures unless the GM allows it. ### Long Weapon Measure When you use a Reach weapon, creatures provoke opportunity attacks from you when they enter your reach, not only when they leave it. You may make only one such opportunity attack per round. This does not stack with specialized Spear sphere interception unless a feature explicitly says so. ### Soft Weapon Discipline You no longer suffer Disadvantage from ordinary close-quarters use of Flexible weapons. When you miss with a Flexible weapon attack, you may choose to pull the weapon back safely and avoid exposing yourself. Until the start of your next turn, the next opportunity attack against you has Disadvantage. ### Weapon Guard When you are hit by a melee attack while wielding a proficient legal weapon, you may use your Reaction to add +2 AC against that attack. If this causes the attack to miss, you may shift 5 feet or change grip on your weapon. ### Weapon Thrower's Sleeve You may draw a Thrown, Concealed, or Hidden weapon as part of each attack you make with that weapon type. When you miss with a thrown weapon, you may mark where it lands. You know its direction and distance until the end of the scene unless it is moved or hidden. ## Foundation Talents ### Adaptive Arsenal Once per turn when you switch from one weapon family to another, regain Martial Focus if the new weapon's method is meaningfully different from the method you used last round. The GM may deny this if the switch is cosmetic. ### Armory of the Road During a short rest, you may prepare a travel armory of up to your proficiency bonus legal weapons. Until your next long rest, those weapons count as familiar to you. If one is broken, lost, or disarmed, you may draw another prepared weapon as part of the same turn once per short rest. ### Binding Line When you use Hooking Method or Pinning Method with a Flexible, Returning Line, Hooking, or Pinning weapon, you may maintain a bind until the start of your next turn. While bound, the target cannot move farther from you unless it succeeds on a Strength check against your Weapon Method DC. Maintaining a bind requires one free hand or a weapon designed to lock the line. ### Break the Guard When you hit a creature benefiting from a shield, parry, guard stance, weapon ward, or similar defensive state, you may expend Martial Focus to use Breaking Method even if your weapon does not have a qualifying tag. If the hit deals damage, the target must make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, reduce one such defensive bonus by 2 until the start of your next turn. ### Formation Weapon Drill When you wield a Reach, Polearm, Staff, Fork, Halberd, or Long weapon, allies within 5 feet of you gain Advantage on ability checks or saving throws made to avoid being forcibly moved through your threatened area. ### Returning Dart Line When you use a Returning Line weapon or a thrown weapon attached to a cord, you may retrieve it without using an object interaction if the line is unobstructed. If the attack hit a creature, you may choose to leave the line attached until the start of your next turn. ### Shifting Grip Scripture When wielding a Versatile, Staff, Polearm, Flexible, or Variable Reach weapon, you may change its handling mode at the start of each of your turns. Choose one: Close Grip. You may attack adjacent creatures without penalty. Long Grip. Increase reach by 5 feet until the start of your next turn, but attacks against adjacent creatures have Disadvantage. Guard Grip. You gain +1 AC until the start of your next turn, but your speed is reduced by 5 feet. ## Core Formation Talents ### Court of Ten Thousand Weapons Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus and 5 CP or Stamina, depending on Path expression Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute Area: 20-foot aura centered on you You establish a weapon court where every tool has a correct answer. While the court lasts: - you may apply one minor Weapon Method per turn without using your once-per-turn Weapon Method limit; - you may draw or stow one additional weapon each turn; - enemies in the aura have Disadvantage on checks made to disarm you; - when an enemy in the aura misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet or change weapon grip; - once per round, when you reduce a creature's speed, prevent a reaction, or break a guard with a Weapon Method, you may regain Martial Focus. This court is martial discipline, not external qi projection unless the character's Path expression makes it qi-shaped. ### Master of Strange Implements Choose three Exotic weapons. You gain proficiency with them, and their Special property no longer imposes Disadvantage or mishap risk on ordinary attacks. If you already had proficiency, choose one additional method tag for each selected weapon, approved by the GM. ### Thousand-Change Weapon Step When you move at least 10 feet before making a weapon attack, you may draw a different legal weapon as part of the attack. If that attack hits, apply a minor method from either the old weapon's family or the new weapon's family. ### Weapon-Breaking Retort When a creature misses you with a melee weapon attack, you may use your Reaction and expend Martial Focus to make one weapon attack against the attacking weapon, shield, or limb. On a hit, deal normal damage. If the target is a weapon or shield, apply Breaking Method without additional cost. ## Nascent Soul Talents ### One Weapon, Ten Thousand Forms Choose one Signature Weapon. While wielding it, you may treat it as having one additional weapon tag from Cut, Thrust, Guard, Hook, Bind, Sweep, Smash, Pin, Cast, or Hidden. You may change this chosen tag when you finish a long rest or complete a 2-hour cultivation session. ### Empty Hand, Full Armory You may treat an improvised object as a legal weapon if its shape reasonably matches a catalogue profile. It uses the nearest weapon's damage die and tags, but loses any exotic special effect unless the GM says the object can support it. Once per short rest, when disarmed or apparently unarmed, you may draw, seize, or improvise a legal weapon as part of rolling initiative or as a Reaction when a hostile creature enters your reach. ## Weapon Catalogue The following weapon profiles are legal draft profiles for Tianxia play. They are suitable for character creation, testing, and simulation when included in a character source registry. ### Short Weapons #### Jian (劍) - Straight Sword Family: Short / Balanced Blade Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Piercing or Slashing Properties: Finesse, Versatile 1d10, Balanced Edge Method Tags: Cut, Thrust, Guard, Duel Notes: The classic straight, double-edged sword. Sword sphere remains the specialist home for jian mastery; Weapons sphere treats it as a precise balanced blade. #### Duan Jian (短劍) - Short Sword Family: Short / Concealed Blade Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Piercing or Slashing Properties: Finesse, Light, Concealed Method Tags: Cut, Thrust, Guard, Hidden Notes: A shorter jian used as a secondary or hidden weapon. #### Dao (刀) - Saber / Broadsword Family: Short / Cutting Blade Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Slashing Properties: Versatile 1d10, Chopping Edge Method Tags: Cut, Smash, Guard, Sweep Notes: A single-edged saber for slashing, cutting, and hacking. #### Duan Dao (短刀) - Short Saber Family: Short / Thrown Blade Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Slashing Properties: Light, Thrown 20/60, Paired Method Tags: Cut, Cast, Hidden Notes: A shorter saber that may be thrown or used in pairs. #### Hu Die Dao (蝴蝶刀) - Butterfly Sabers Family: Short / Paired Saber Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Slashing Properties: Finesse, Light, Paired, Guarding Hilt Method Tags: Cut, Guard, Bind, Paired Notes: Paired sabers with protective guards, suitable for cuts, traps, and close defense. #### Gou / Shuang Gou (钩 / 双钩) - Hook Sword / Double Hooks Family: Short / Hooking Blade Proficiency Class: Exotic martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Slashing Properties: Finesse, Hooking, Paired, Special Method Tags: Hook, Bind, Cut, Disarm Notes: Hook swords used for catching, disarming, linking, and unusual paired attacks. #### Fu (斧) - Short Axe Family: Short / Axe Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Slashing Properties: Light, Thrown 20/60, Armor-Breaking Method Tags: Smash, Cut, Cast Notes: A compact axe, often paired, brutal against armor and shields but less precise than a sword. #### Tie Jian (鐵鐧) - Iron Rod / Sword Breaker Family: Short / Bar Mace Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Bludgeoning Properties: Sword-Breaker, Heavy-Headed Method Tags: Smash, Bind, Break Notes: A plain iron bar mace used to batter, parry, and damage weapons. #### Tie Bian (鐵鞭) - Iron Whip / Sectioned Bar Mace Family: Short / Bar Mace Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Bludgeoning Properties: Sword-Breaker, Heavy-Headed, Ribbed Method Tags: Smash, Bind, Break Notes: A rigid bamboo-section-style iron mace, not the flexible chain whip. #### Chui (锤) - Hammer Family: Short / Heavy Mace Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Bludgeoning Properties: Heavy-Headed, Strength 13 Method Tags: Smash, Break, Guard Notes: A round hammer, often paired by very strong warriors. #### Tie Chi (铁尺) - Iron Ruler Family: Short / Officer Weapon Proficiency Class: Simple or martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Bludgeoning Properties: Finesse, Nonlethal, Disarming Method Tags: Guard, Bind, Disarm Notes: A flat metal ruler used by guards and officers for restraint and disabling. #### Bi Shou (匕首) - Dagger Family: Short / Concealed Blade Proficiency Class: Simple melee Damage Die: 1d4 Damage Type: Piercing or Slashing Properties: Finesse, Light, Thrown 20/60, Concealed Method Tags: Thrust, Cast, Hidden Notes: A common dagger, easily hidden and often carried in pairs. #### Zi-Wu (子午) - Deer Horn Knives Family: Short / Crescent Knives Proficiency Class: Exotic martial melee Damage Die: 1d4 Damage Type: Slashing Properties: Finesse, Light, Paired, Disarming, Hooking Method Tags: Hook, Bind, Cut, Disarm Notes: Overlapping crescent blades used for seizing, cutting, hooking, and disarming. #### Emei Ci (峨嵋刺) - Emei Piercers Family: Short / Piercing Rods Proficiency Class: Exotic martial melee Damage Die: 1d4 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Finesse, Light, Concealed, Paired, Spinning Method Tags: Thrust, Hidden, Bind Notes: Palm-hidden spinning piercers associated with Mount Emei. ### Long Weapons #### Qiang (枪) - Spear Family: Long / Spear Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Reach, Two-Handed, Tassel Method Tags: Thrust, Guard, Pin Notes: The Chinese spear. Spear sphere remains the specialist home for spear mastery. #### Mao (矛) - Long Spear / Lance Family: Long / Armor-Piercing Spear Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d10 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Reach, Heavy, Two-Handed, Mounted Method Tags: Thrust, Pin, Break Notes: A very long spear or lance suited to armor-piercing thrusts and cavalry or formation work. #### Gun (棍) - Staff Family: Long / Staff Proficiency Class: Simple melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Bludgeoning Properties: Two-Handed, Reach, Nonlethal Method Tags: Guard, Sweep, Smash Notes: The staff, grandfather of weapons, strong for defense, leverage, and nonlethal control. #### Guandao / Yanyuedao (关刀 / 偃月刀) - Reclining Moon Blade Family: Long / Heavy Polearm Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d10 Damage Type: Slashing Properties: Reach, Heavy, Two-Handed, Sweeping Method Tags: Cut, Sweep, Smash Notes: A heavy bladed polearm associated with Guan Yu and battlefield power. #### Yue Ya Chan (月牙铲) - Crescent Moon Spade / Monk Spade Family: Long / Spade Proficiency Class: Exotic martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Slashing or Bludgeoning Properties: Reach, Two-Handed, Hooking, Sweeping Method Tags: Hook, Sweep, Guard Notes: A Shaolin-associated traveling spade with crescent and spade ends. #### Cha / Hu Cha (叉 / 虎叉) - Fork / Tiger Fork Family: Long / Trident Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Reach, Two-Handed, Pinning Method Tags: Pin, Thrust, Bind Notes: A hunting and guard weapon used to pin, hold, and restrain. #### Duan Cha (短叉) - Short Trident Family: Short / Fork Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Light, Thrown 20/60, Pinning Method Tags: Pin, Thrust, Cast Notes: A lighter short fork, sometimes thrown or used in pairs. #### Ji (戟) - Halberd Family: Long / Halberd Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d10 Damage Type: Piercing or Slashing Properties: Reach, Heavy, Two-Handed, Hooking Method Tags: Thrust, Hook, Cut Notes: A halberd with spear and crescent-hook forms, good for thrusting and pulling. #### Ge (戈) - Dagger-Axe Family: Long / Hooking Polearm Proficiency Class: Martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Slashing Properties: Reach, Two-Handed, Hooking, Pulling Method Tags: Hook, Cut, Sweep Notes: An older L-shaped polearm used for hooking, cutting, and dragging enemies from position. ### Soft Weapons #### Sheng Biao (绳镖) - Rope Dart Family: Soft / Rope Projectile Proficiency Class: Exotic martial ranged/melee Damage Die: 1d4 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Reach 15, Finesse, Two-Handed, Returning Line, Special Method Tags: Cast, Bind, Flow Notes: A dart attached to a rope, thrown and retrieved along a controlled line. #### Liu Xing Chui (流星錘) - Meteor Hammer Family: Soft / Chain Weight Proficiency Class: Exotic martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Bludgeoning Properties: Reach 15, Two-Handed, Heavy-Headed, Flexible, Special Method Tags: Smash, Flow, Sweep Notes: A weighted chain weapon thrown in arcs to smash poorly defended targets. #### Jie Bian (节鞭) - Sectional Steel Whip / Chain Whip Family: Soft / Chain Whip Proficiency Class: Exotic martial melee Damage Die: 1d6 Damage Type: Bludgeoning or Slashing Properties: Reach 10, Flexible, Finesse, Special Method Tags: Flow, Bind, Sweep Notes: A flexible whip of short metal sections, hard to master and dangerous in motion. #### San Jie Gun (三節棍) - Three-Sectional Staff Family: Soft / Sectional Staff Proficiency Class: Exotic martial melee Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Bludgeoning Properties: Two-Handed, Flexible, Variable Reach, Special Method Tags: Guard, Flow, Sweep, Smash Notes: Three linked staves able to shift between short and long range. ### Projectile and Throwing Weapons #### Gong Jian (弓箭) - Bow and Arrow Family: Projectile / Bow Proficiency Class: Martial ranged Damage Die: 1d8 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Ammunition, Range 150/600, Two-Handed Method Tags: Cast, Mark Notes: A bow and arrow. Sniper sphere remains the specialist home for precision archery. #### Nu Gong (弩弓) - Crossbow Family: Projectile / Crossbow Proficiency Class: Martial ranged Damage Die: 1d10 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Ammunition, Range 100/400, Loading, Two-Handed Method Tags: Cast, Mark, Break Notes: A crossbow, powerful but slower to reload. #### Dan Gong (弹弓) - Pellet Bow / Sling Bow Family: Projectile / Pellet Bow Proficiency Class: Simple ranged Damage Die: 1d4 Damage Type: Bludgeoning Properties: Ammunition, Range 30/120, Quiet Method Tags: Cast, Hidden Notes: A pellet bow or slingshot-style weapon, often used for small game and subtle strikes. #### Fei Biao (飞镖) - Flying Dart Family: Projectile / Throwing Dart Proficiency Class: Simple ranged or melee Damage Die: 1d4 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Thrown 20/60, Concealed, Poison-Ready Method Tags: Cast, Hidden Notes: A small thrown dart with needle-like point, often concealed and sometimes poisoned. #### Tong Zhu (铜箸) - Brass Chopsticks Family: Projectile / Improvised Dart Proficiency Class: Simple ranged Damage Die: 1d4 Damage Type: Piercing Properties: Thrown 20/60, Concealed, Improvised-Familiar Method Tags: Cast, Hidden Notes: Metal chopsticks used as surprise projectiles; bamboo versions require greater power or technique. ### Core Weapons Rules This v1.10.5 section is a parsing map, not an additional feature grant. It names the rules below that should be treated as the sphere's core rules during character creation, dashboard import, Roll20 export, and combat simulation. - Damage Die Is Not Hit Die defines the damage-scaling boundary. - Legal Weapon Profiles define which weapons can be used without inventing unsupported equipment. - Weapon Properties and Tags define the legal vocabulary for attacks and methods. - Weapon Literacy, Ready the Implement, and Apply Weapon Method are the base sphere abilities. - Weapons does not replace dedicated weapon spheres. Use Sword for sword doctrine, Spear for spear line pressure, Dual Wielding for paired-weapon rhythm, Sniper for precision range, and Chains for binding chains. ### Cultivation Insights Weapons currently uses a light Insight package. These Insights make arsenal practice easier to run; they do not grant free magic weapons, free specialist sphere talents, or unrestricted weapon projection. #### Arsenal Memory Prerequisite: Weapons sphere, CL 4+ Choose one weapon family from the Weapon Catalogue. During a short rest, you may drill with one weapon from that family. Until your next long rest, you may use Weapon Literacy and Apply Weapon Method with that weapon even if it is unusual for your sect or background. This does not grant proficiency with every weapon in the family, and it does not grant a specialist sphere such as Sword, Spear, Dual Wielding, Sniper, or Chains. #### Hidden Implement Discipline Prerequisite: Weapons sphere, CL 4+ You gain Advantage on one Dexterity (Sleight of Hand), Wisdom (Perception), or Intelligence (Investigation) check per short rest to conceal, notice, identify, or ready a small legal weapon. If the weapon will be used as an attack in combat, it must still be listed on the character sheet before the fight begins. #### Strange Weapon Familiarity Prerequisite: Weapons sphere, CL 6+ Choose one unusual legal weapon profile approved by the GM. You treat that weapon as familiar for Weapon Literacy and may include it in your normal combat action list. This Insight does not create the weapon, bypass rarity, or ignore social restrictions on carrying it. #### Method-Bearing Grip Prerequisite: Weapons sphere, CL 8+ Once per round, when you switch from one legal weapon to another legal weapon before making an attack, you may carry one non-damaging Weapon Method benefit from the first weapon's posture into the next attack. The carried benefit must be defensive, positional, disarming, hooking, measuring, concealing, or setup-based. It cannot add extra damage dice unless a talent explicitly says so. #### Arsenal-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Weapons sphere, CL 8+ During downtime, you may create a weapon ledger, rack map, carrying kit, sect arsenal register, or training catalogue. A completed project can help allies identify, maintain, transport, or choose legal mundane weapons. It does not create magic items, rare materials, formations, or free forged techniques. #### Ten Thousand Tools Mind Prerequisite: Weapons sphere, CL 10+ Once per short rest, when you begin your turn holding a legal weapon that is poorly suited to the immediate tactical problem, you may use Ready the Implement without spending your Bonus Action if another legal weapon is already on your person and accessible. This does not increase the number of attacks you make, and it does not allow a hidden or inaccessible weapon to appear from nowhere. ## Path Expression Notes ### Body Refining A Body Refiner expresses Weapons through hand conditioning, grip, footwork, bone alignment, tendon strength, weapon-body unity, armor-body training, and tool familiarity. Body Refiners do not project ordinary external qi through a weapon unless a feature, manual, forged technique, hosted spirit, or variant scripture says so. ### Qi Cultivation A Qi Cultivator may express Weapons through weapon qi, talismanic armories, flying weapon control where a source permits it, elemental weapon mantles, formation arsenals, and scripture-driven weapon methods. ### Spirit Awakening A Spirit Awakener should express Weapons through memory, vows, lineage weapons, soul anchors, weapon spirits, ancestral impressions, fear of a blade, execution authority, or Spirit Companions. A weapon spirit's Nature belongs to the spirit. ## Character Sheet Notes When this sphere is used for a simulation-ready character, give action blocks to the combat options the character actually expects to use. Minimum useful action blocks include: - basic attack with each Signature Weapon; - Apply Weapon Method; - any Major Method expected in combat; - any Court or Domain; - any reaction such as Weapon Guard or Weapon-Breaking Retort; - any special weapon property that changes targeting, damage, movement, state, or reaction timing. A weapon can appear as equipment without having its own combat action block. If it will matter mechanically in a fight, define it before use.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### BASE ABILITY 1: READ THE SKY
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes for a careful reading
Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_careful_reading_procedure
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=IMMEDIATE_READING_ACTION, CAREFUL_READING_TEN_MINUTES, BATTLE_READING_NO_ACTION
Range: Self
Cost: 0 CP
Duration: Instantaneous
You study pressure, humidity, temperature, scent, cloud motion, insects, skin-prickle, spiritual pressure, and the shape of Heaven’s breath.
Choose one of the following readings.
##### Immediate Reading
As an Action, learn all current weather categories and their severity within 1 mile, assuming you are outdoors or in contact with air that leads outdoors.
You also learn whether the weather within 300 feet is natural, supernatural, cultivation-made, or being sustained by Concentration.
##### Careful Reading
After 10 minutes, predict natural weather within 5 miles for the next 48 hours, unless stronger cultivation, sealed terrain, divine concealment, or narrative conditions interfere.
##### Battle Reading
When you cast a Weather sphere effect, you may also identify one active Weather Sign in the scene without using an action.

Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode

As an Action, learn all current weather categories and their severity within 1 mile, assuming you are outdoors or in contact with air that leads outdoors.

After 10 minutes, predict natural weather within 5 miles for the next 48 hours, unless stronger cultivation, sealed terrain, divine concealment, or narrative conditions interfere.
##### Battle Reading
When you cast a Weather sphere effect, you may also identify one active Weather Sign in the scene without using an action.
A sign is active if its category is severity 1 or higher, if you have placed it through a Mantle or Shroud, or if you have gathered it with Gather Weather.

### BASE ABILITY 2: SKY MANTLE
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes as a ritual
Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_ritual_and_refresh_variant
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_SKY_MANTLE->action, BONUS_ACTION_REFRESH_MANTLE->bonus_action; procedures=TEN_MINUTE_SKY_MANTLE_RITUAL
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute if cast as an Action; up to 1 hour if cast as a 10-minute ritual
Cost: 1 CP if cast as an Action; 0 CP if cast as a 10-minute ritual
You wrap a creature in a weather sign so that Heaven favors its movement, breath, skin, weapon, or spirit.
When you place a Sky Mantle, choose one Weather Sign talent you know. The target gains that sign’s Mantle effect if at least one of the following is true:
the surrounding area currently has that weather category at severity 1 or higher;
you have gathered that sign with Gather Weather and the target is inside the area;
you spend 1 additional CP to force that sign through your own cultivation.
A creature can benefit from only one of your Sky Mantles at a time. Placing a new Sky Mantle from you ends the old one.
##### Refreshing the Mantle
On your turn, you may spend 1 CP and use a Bonus Action to change the Mantle to another Weather Sign talent you know, provided the new sign is active or you force it with CP.
##### Defensive Weather
When a creature with your Sky Mantle makes a saving throw against a Weather sphere effect, it has Advantage if the Mantle’s sign matches or opposes the effect’s sign.

### BASE ABILITY 3: CLOUD SHROUD
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You hang a private weather around a target: frost around the joints, rain inside the breath, dust in the eyes, heat against the skin, wind around the limbs, or thunder over the heart.
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know and apply its Shroud effect.
A creature can be under only one of your Cloud Shrouds at a time. Placing a second Cloud Shroud from you on the same creature ends the first.
Unless a sign says otherwise, a creature makes the listed saving throw when the Shroud is placed and again at the end of each of its turns. A Shroud’s damage or condition applies on a failed save. A successful save prevents that round’s damage or condition but does not end the Shroud unless the Shroud says otherwise.
##### Three-Success Escape
If a Shroud no longer requires your Concentration because of a talent or feature, it ends once the target has succeeded on three saving throws against it.
##### Objects
A Shroud can target an unattended object. The GM decides whether the object is vulnerable to that weather. For example, rain may douse flame, heat may warp wax, cold may freeze water, aridity may dry ink, and wind may scatter papers.

### BASE ABILITY 4: GATHER WEATHER
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You gather a Weather Sign you know into a local field.
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know other than Thunder Sign, unless Thunder Sign is being gathered through Storm rules. The area becomes severity 1 of that sign’s weather category.
Gathered weather counts as active weather for Sky Mantle and other Weather talents.
At Mortal Realm, Gather Weather creates atmosphere and combat-scale conditions, but it does not usually inflict long-duration travel hazards such as dehydration checks, hypothermia checks, or heat-exhaustion checks unless a talent specifically says so.
##### Shelter and Barriers
Gather Weather does not pass through sealed walls, closed rooms, airtight barriers, sealed formations, or spaces physically isolated from the area unless a feature says otherwise.
##### Opposing Weather
If you gather Cold into Heat, Heat is reduced first. If you gather Heat into Cold, Cold is reduced first. If you gather Aridity into Precipitation, Precipitation is reduced first. If you gather Precipitation into Aridity, Aridity is reduced first.
##### Storm Formation
A full storm requires Wind and either Precipitation or Aridity. If both supporting categories are severity 1 or higher, Thunder Sign and storm talents can treat the area as Storm severity equal to the lower supporting severity.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Weather Qi Expression: Primary — Weather Qi; Supporting — Wind Qi, Water Qi, Thunder Qi, Sky Qi. “The sky does not obey because the cultivator shouts. The sky obeys when the cultivator becomes the pressure it was already waiting to release.” Sphere Type: Elemental / Environmental Sphere Primary Path: Qi Cultivation Secondary Paths: Spirit Awakening, Body Refining through Inner Mantle Scripture, items, sect manuals, or Forged TechniquesPrimary Resource: CP, usually Qi; Inner Mantle Scripture uses StaminaDao: Weather cultivates condition becoming consequence. A Weather cultivator reads the condition of Heaven, plants that condition on a body or battlefield, and lets the world punish anyone who refuses to adapt.Core Engine: Read the Sky, place a Sky Mantle, hang a Cloud Shroud, or Gather Weather into a local field. Common Effects: weather reading, ally mantles, hostile shrouds, wind, rain, cold, heat, dryness, thunder, storm pressure, fog, battlefield weather, environmental resistance, and Realm-gated weather mandates. Weather is the cultivation of Heaven’s condition becoming the battlefield’s law. A Weather cultivator does not simply throw lightning, make ice, or summon rain. Those are neighboring elemental expressions. Weather asks a different question: what is the condition everyone must now obey? The answer may be wind that ruins arrows, rain that slicks the ground, heat that weakens breath, cold that steals motion, dryness that cracks flesh, or thundercloud pressure that tells the whole battlefield judgment is about to fall. ### WHAT WEATHER DOES Weather is for players who want a tactical environmental sphere built around preparation, positioning, and escalation. Weather specializes in: reading natural and supernatural weather; wrapping allies in weather favor through Sky Mantles; afflicting enemies with private hostile weather through Cloud Shrouds; gathering local fields of wind, rain, cold, heat, dryness, or storm pressure; making existing terrain, climate, shelter, visibility, and exposure matter; escalating from brief signs to battlefield weather and Realm-gated calamity mandates. Weather overlaps with elemental spheres but does not replace them. Air is direct air control, flight, currents, and wind as an element. Water is direct water shaping, currents, pressure, and water bodies. Fire is flame, ignition, burning, and pure heat as destructive essence. Ice is freezing structures, frost weapons, and direct cold formation. Lightning is direct lightning strikes, charge, arcs, and electrical judgment. Cloud, Smoke, Nature, Disaster, and Force each handle neighboring pieces of sky, obscurity, terrain, calamity, or pressure. Weather makes those spheres stronger partners. It should not make them obsolete. ### RULES BASELINE This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Concentration, Advantage, Disadvantage, Cover, Total Cover, conditions, resistance, immunity, object rules, exhaustion, suffocation, visibility, difficult terrain, and environmental hazards unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. Weather effects created by this sphere are magical cultivation effects unless a feature says otherwise. When a Weather effect calls for a saving throw, use your Weather Save DC. Weather does not bypass immunity. If a creature is immune to cold, fire, lightning, thunder, poison, or necrotic damage, that immunity applies normally to Weather effects of that damage type. Generated weather does not normally fill sealed containers, locked lungs, extradimensional spaces, or enclosed armor. A talent may drench, chill, heat, parch, buffet, or shock a creature, but it does not create infinite matter. The GM decides ordinary local weather, shelter, climate, season, altitude, terrain, and existing conditions. The Weather sphere then modifies those conditions within its rules. ### CORE WEATHER RULES #### Key Ability, Save DC, and Resources Choose Wisdom or Charisma as your Weather key ability when you first learn the sphere, unless your Path or cultivation method assigns another key ability. Weather Save DC: 8 + Proficiency Bonus + Weather key ability modifier Weather Attack Modifier: Proficiency Bonus + Weather key ability modifier When a Weather feature costs CP, use the CP pool appropriate to the Path that granted the sphere. Most Weather cultivators use Qi. Spirit Awakeners may learn Weather as omen, pressure, and heavenly response. Body Refiners usually access Weather through a body-tempering lineage, item, sect manual, Forged Technique, or the Inner Mantle Scripture described in the Variant Scriptures section. Inner Mantle Weather is not outward qi-weather. It is weather refined inside the body. #### Realm Benchmarks Weather escalates by cultivation phase. Mortal Realm: You read weather, create brief signs, place Mantles, place Shrouds, and gather severity 1 weather in small areas. Foundation Realm: You stabilize weather fields, affect groups, create severity 2 weather, and make shrouds linger. Core Formation Realm: You command battlefield-scale weather, combine signs, create severity 3 weather, and direct storms instead of merely provoking them. Nascent Soul Realm: You issue local heavenly mandates, create severity 4 calamity weather under strict limits, and contest other weather domains. This sphere uses the Tianxia phase gates CL 5, CL 10, and CL 15 as its main progression points. #### Weather Severity Scale Weather uses severity 0 through 4. These categories are descriptive and mechanical guidelines. ##### Severity 0 Normal conditions. Aridity: none. Cold: temperate. Heat: temperate. Precipitation: none. Wind: dead calm or ordinary breeze. Storm: none. ##### Severity 1 Mild but noticeable weather. Aridity: dry. Cold: cold. Heat: hot. Precipitation: light fog, mist, drizzle, or cloud cover. Wind: moderate wind. Storm: thunderclouds, distant thunder, static pressure, and harmless flashes. ##### Severity 2 Hazardous weather. Aridity: parched. Cold: extreme cold. Heat: extreme heat. Precipitation: heavy fog, heavy cloud, or steady rain/snow/hail depending on temperature. Wind: strong wind. Storm: storm with dangerous lightning or thunder. ##### Severity 3 Severe weather. Aridity: drought. Cold: arctic cold. Heat: unbearable heat. Precipitation: rain, hail, snow, or heavy obscuring cloud. Wind: gale wind. Storm: powerful storm with round-by-round danger. ##### Severity 4 Calamity weather. Aridity: desiccating supernatural dryness. Cold: supernatural cold. Heat: supernatural heat. Precipitation: torrential rain, driven hail, or blizzard. Wind: tornado winds. Storm: haboob if built from aridity and wind, or typhoon if built from precipitation and wind. ##### Opposed Weather Categories Cold and Heat oppose each other. Raising one generally lowers the other. Aridity and Precipitation oppose each other. Raising one generally lowers the other. Storm is not a free-standing weather category for large-area control. A true storm forms when Wind and either Precipitation or Aridity both reach the required severity. A personal Storm Sign can still be used for Mantles and Shrouds before a full storm exists. ### CORE WEATHER ENGINE Weather is built around four base abilities. Read the Sky: learn what condition is present, coming, or being manipulated. Sky Mantle: wrap a creature in a weather sign so it benefits from that condition. Cloud Shroud: hang hostile weather on a creature or object. Gather Weather: turn a sign into a battlefield condition. Most talents modify one of those four abilities. A simple Weather turn looks like this: Read or choose a Weather Sign. Place a Mantle on an ally, place a Shroud on an enemy, or Gather Weather in an area. Use talents to intensify, spread, combine, release, or redirect that sign. Force the enemy to adapt to the new condition or suffer its consequence. ### LEARNING THE WEATHER SPHERE When you first learn Weather, gain the following: Read the Sky. Sky Mantle. Cloud Shroud. Gather Weather. One Weather Sign talent of your choice. The six standard Weather Sign talents are Wind Sign, Rain Sign, Cold Sign, Heat Sign, Dry Sign, and Thunder Sign. If you learn Weather through a Variant Scripture, that Scripture may replace or seal parts of this starting package. Inner Mantle Scripture, for example, grants Body Refiners a self-mantle version of Weather rather than the full outward Weather engine. ### BASE ABILITY 1: READ THE SKY Action Type: Multi-Mode Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes for a careful reading Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_careful_reading_procedure Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=IMMEDIATE_READING_ACTION, CAREFUL_READING_TEN_MINUTES, BATTLE_READING_NO_ACTION Range: Self Cost: 0 CP Duration: Instantaneous You study pressure, humidity, temperature, scent, cloud motion, insects, skin-prickle, spiritual pressure, and the shape of Heaven’s breath.
