Gathered weather counts as active weather for Sky Mantle and other Weather talents. At Mortal Realm, Gather Weather creates atmosphere and combat-scale conditions, but it does not usually inflict long-duration travel hazards such as dehydration checks, hypothermia checks, or heat-exhaustion checks unless a talent specifically says so. ##### Shelter and Barriers Gather Weather does not pass through sealed walls, closed rooms, airtight barriers, sealed formations, or spaces physically isolated from the area unless a feature says otherwise. ##### Opposing Weather If you gather Cold into Heat, Heat is reduced first. If you gather Heat into Cold, Cold is reduced first. If you gather Aridity into Precipitation, Precipitation is reduced first. If you gather Precipitation into Aridity, Aridity is reduced first. ##### Storm Formation A full storm requires Wind and either Precipitation or Aridity. If both supporting categories are severity 1 or higher, Thunder Sign and storm talents can treat the area as Storm severity equal to the lower supporting severity. ### WEATHER SIGN TALENTS Weather Sign talents are the heart of the sphere. Each one gives you a Mantle expression, a Shroud expression, and a Gather expression. When a feature tells you to learn a Weather Sign talent, choose one of the following unless the feature restricts your choice. #### Wind Sign Tags: Weather Sign, Wind, Mantle, Shroud, Gather You cultivate moving air, pressure, sound, drift, and breath. ##### Mantle: Borne on Wind A creature with your Wind Mantle gains +10 feet Speed. Opportunity attacks against the mantled creature have Disadvantage if the mantled creature moved at least 10 feet during the current turn. At Foundation Realm, the Speed bonus becomes +15 feet. At Core Formation, it becomes +20 feet. At Nascent Soul, it becomes +30 feet. ##### Shroud: Battering Winds The shrouded creature makes a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, it is pushed 10 feet in a direction you choose and has Disadvantage on ranged weapon attacks until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it is not pushed but still has Disadvantage on its next ranged weapon attack before the start of your next turn. At Core Formation, the push increases to 15 feet. At Nascent Soul, it increases to 20 feet. ##### Gather: Moderate Wind Your Gather Weather creates whipping wind. The area lightly scatters mist, smoke, loose paper, dust, and Tiny unattended flames. Ranged weapon attacks that pass through the area take a -2 penalty unless the attacker is mantled by your Wind Sign. #### Rain Sign Tags: Weather Sign, Precipitation, Mantle, Shroud, Gather You cultivate rain, fog, cloud, wetness, dousing, slickness, and breath-thickening water. ##### Mantle: Mist-Wrapped Body A creature with your Rain Mantle has Advantage on ability checks made to escape a Grapple or move through a hostile creature’s space. The mantled creature also has Resistance to fire damage while the surrounding area has Precipitation severity 1 or higher or while you are forcing the sign with CP. ##### Shroud: Drenching Cloud The shrouded creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is doused, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn, and it has Disadvantage on the next saving throw it makes against a Cold Sign effect before the end of your next turn. On a successful save, it is doused until the start of your next turn but suffers no Speed penalty. A doused creature may spend a Bonus Action to shake, scrape, heat, or wipe away the water, ending the doused state from this Shroud early. ##### Gather: Fog or Rain Your Gather Weather creates mist, fog, drizzle, rain, or cloud cover appropriate to the temperature. The area is lightly obscured. Nonmagical exposed flames of Tiny size or smaller are extinguished. At Foundation Realm, you may choose whether the gathered precipitation appears as mist, fog, rain, snow, or hail if the temperature could plausibly support it or your talents force that interaction. #### Cold Sign Tags: Weather Sign, Cold, Mantle, Shroud, Gather You cultivate frost, snow, numbness, contraction, stillness, and the cruelty of the high mountain. ##### Mantle: Ice-Reading Step A creature with your Cold Mantle ignores difficult terrain caused by ice, snow, mud, shallow water, frost, or slick ground. If it moves across such terrain, it gains +10 feet Speed for that movement. At Foundation Realm, the mantled creature also gains Resistance to cold damage while the sign is active. ##### Shroud: Black Ice The shrouded creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, its Speed is reduced by half until the start of your next turn. If this reduces its Speed to less than 5 feet, it is Restrained until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of your next turn. ##### Gather: Freezing Air Your Gather Weather creates frost, rimed surfaces, chilled breath, and slick ground. The area is difficult terrain for creatures that are not mantled by your Cold Sign or otherwise adapted to ice. Small exposed nonmagical water surfaces freeze at the GM’s discretion. #### Heat Sign Tags: Weather Sign, Heat, Mantle, Shroud, Gather You cultivate shimmer, fever, glare, mirage, upward motion, and oppressive summer. ##### Mantle: Flame Zephyr A creature with your Heat Mantle gains temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of each of its turns while the Mantle remains active. These temporary hit points do not stack with themselves. At Core Formation, the mantled creature also has Advantage on saving throws against Cold Sign effects. ##### Shroud: Heat Stroke The shrouded creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes fire damage equal to 1d6 + your Weather key ability modifier and cannot benefit from nonmagical cold-weather gear until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes no damage. The damage becomes 2d6 at Foundation Realm, 3d6 at Core Formation, and 4d6 at Nascent Soul. ##### Gather: Shimmering Heat Your Gather Weather creates oppressive heat, heat shimmer, and mirage distortion. Creatures of your choice inside the area have Disadvantage on Intelligence (Investigation) checks made to pierce illusions or identify distant details through the shimmer. Tiny exposed ice or snow melts at the GM’s discretion. #### Dry Sign Tags: Weather Sign, Aridity, Mantle, Shroud, Gather You cultivate dryness, dust, thirst, exposure, preservation, and the hard lesson of the desert. ##### Mantle: Sand-Breath Body A creature with your Dry Mantle has Advantage on saving throws against poison, disease, dehydration, and Rain Sign Shrouds. It also adds your Proficiency Bonus to Strength checks made to carry, drag, lift, or keep hold of supplies, packs, ropes, and burdens. At Core Formation, the mantled creature gains Resistance to necrotic damage from desiccation effects. ##### Shroud: Dust in the Meridians The shrouded creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it is Poisoned until the start of your next turn as dust, dryness, and painful breath disrupt it. On a successful save, it has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn. Creatures that do not breathe and creatures immune to poison are immune to the Poisoned condition from this Shroud, but may still suffer other Dry Sign effects. ##### Gather: Parched Air Your Gather Weather creates dry air, dust, cracked lips, thirsty breath, and thirsty earth. The area suppresses light mist, dries Tiny unattended wet objects, and gives creatures Disadvantage on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on smell or taste. At Foundation Realm, the area may also scatter loose sand, ash, dust, or dry soil into light obscurity if such material exists. #### Thunder Sign Tags: Weather Sign, Storm, Mantle, Shroud, Gather You cultivate static charge, thunder, lightning, sudden warning, and the command hidden inside pressure. Thunder Sign can be used for Mantles and Shrouds even before a full storm exists. To Gather a true storm field, you must combine Wind with Rain or Dry through Gather Weather or existing natural weather. ##### Mantle: Lightning Nerve A creature with your Thunder Mantle has Advantage on death saving throws and saving throws against being Deafened, Stunned, or knocked Prone by thunder, lightning, or storm effects. Once during the Mantle, when the mantled creature is hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes lightning or thunder damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus. At Core Formation, the mantled creature may also teleport 10 feet as a Reaction when a lightning or thunder effect occurs within 60 feet of it. This teleport must move to a space it can see. ##### Shroud: Personal Thunderhead The shrouded creature makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it takes thunder damage equal to 1d6 + your Weather key ability modifier and is Deafened until the start of your next turn. On a successful save, it takes no damage and is not Deafened. The damage becomes 2d6 at Foundation Realm, 3d6 at Core Formation, and 4d6 at Nascent Soul. ##### Gather: Thundercloud Pressure If the gathered area already contains Wind severity 1 or higher and Rain or Dry severity 1 or higher, it becomes Storm severity 1. If those conditions are not present, the area gains thundercloud pressure but not full storm severity. Thundercloud pressure counts as an active Thunder Sign for Mantles and Shrouds, but it does not create lightning strikes unless a talent says so. ### MORTAL REALM WEATHER TALENTS Mortal talents refine the basic engine: reading, mantling, shrouding, gathering, and surviving mild weather. #### Barometric Disciple Prerequisite: Weather sphere Your Read the Sky improves. If the target is standing inside gathered weather of the same sign, add twice your Proficiency Bonus instead. ### FOUNDATION REALM WEATHER TALENTS Foundation talents let Weather become a stable battlefield method rather than a personal trick. #### Foundation Weather Field Prerequisite: CL 5+, Gather Weather Your Gather Weather improves. On a failed save, it loses Concentration. The GM may rule that certain effects are not meaningfully disrupted by a given weather sign. For example, a stone-rooted earth technique may not care about mist, but a paper talisman formation may care greatly about rain and wind. #### Weather-Borrowing Mantle Prerequisite: CL 10+, Sky Mantle When you place Sky Mantle, you may borrow one natural weather category at severity 1 or higher within 1 mile, even if it is outside your immediate battlefield. The Mantle counts that sign as active for its duration. If the borrowed weather is created or sustained by another cultivator, they may contest this with their own save DC or relevant cultivation check. On a successful contest, your Mantle still functions, but the borrowed sign ends at the end of your next turn unless you force it with CP. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM WEATHER TALENTS Nascent Soul talents turn Weather into a mandate. These should feel mythic, but bounded. #### Nascent Weather Mandate Prerequisite: CL 15+, Core Weather Field Your Gather Weather reaches calamity scale under strict limits. The radius becomes 120 feet for combat use. When you gather weather, you may create severity 4 weather by spending 8 additional CP. Severity 4 weather requires Concentration, and you cannot make it persistent without a specific Secret Inheritance or GM-approved technique. When you create severity 4 weather, choose creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus to be sheltered by your mandate. Sheltered creatures treat that weather as two severities lower for movement and environmental hazard purposes, but not for your Weather talents. You may create severity 4 weather this way once per long rest. After doing so, you cannot create severity 4 weather again until you complete a long rest, even if you still have CP. #### Typhoon-Haboob Gate Prerequisite: CL 15+, Storm Birth, Core Weather Field When you maintain Wind severity 4 and either Rain severity 4 or Dry severity 4 in the same area, you may open a typhoon or haboob gate. Typhoon: Requires Wind and Rain. Creatures of your choice that start their turn inside the area make a Strength saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d8 bludgeoning damage, are pushed 20 feet in a direction you choose, and fall Prone. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not pushed or knocked Prone. Haboob: Requires Wind and Dry. Creatures of your choice that start their turn inside the area make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 3d8 slashing damage and are Poisoned until the start of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half damage and are not Poisoned. Cover can protect against either effect at the GM’s discretion. Total Cover protects normally. #### Blizzard-Sun Furnace Mandate Prerequisite: CL 15+, Cold Sign or Heat Sign, Nascent Weather Mandate When you create Cold severity 4 or Heat severity 4, you may give it a decisive mandate. Blizzard Mandate: The area is heavily obscured by supernatural cold. Creatures of your choice that start their turn inside the area make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d8 cold damage and their Speed becomes 0 until the start of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half damage and their Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of their next turn. Sun Furnace Mandate: The area shimmers with supernatural heat. Creatures of your choice that start their turn inside the area make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, they take 4d8 fire damage and cannot regain hit points until the start of their next turn. On a successful save, they take half damage. Damage from this talent cannot be healed until the creature leaves the severity 4 area or the severity drops below 4. #### Heaven Breaks the Banner Prerequisite: CL 15+, Stormlord’s Finger When you use Stormlord’s Finger inside a storm of severity 3 or higher, you may spend 6 additional CP to call a heaven-breaking bolt. Choose a point inside the storm that you can see. Creatures in a 10-foot-radius sphere centered on that point make a Dexterity saving throw. On a failed save, a creature takes 10d10 lightning damage and is Stunned until the end of its next turn. On a successful save, it takes half damage and is not Stunned. Objects, siege engines, ordinary buildings, and unattended metal structures take double damage. Formations, barriers, magic items, sect treasures, and Secret Inheritances use their normal defenses. Once you use this talent, you cannot use it again until you complete a long rest. #### Four-Season Reversal Prerequisite: CL 15+, Twin-Season Conjunction Once per long rest, when you would take damage or suffer a condition from a weather, elemental, climate, cloud, smoke, mist, storm, or environmental effect, use your Reaction to reverse your body’s season. Choose one opposing pair. Cold becomes Heat. Heat becomes Cold. Rain becomes Dry. Dry becomes Rain. Wind becomes Stillness. Thunder becomes Silence. You gain immunity to the triggering damage and condition until the end of the current turn. Then choose one creature within 60 feet. It makes a saving throw appropriate to the reversed sign. On a failed save, it suffers the Shroud effect of the reversed sign as if you had placed Cloud Shroud on it without spending CP. #### Decree of Clear Heaven Prerequisite: CL 15+, Mantle of Clear Skies As an Action, spend 10 CP and choose a point within 300 feet. In a 120-foot-radius sphere centered on that point, reduce one weather category by up to three severity steps. If this removes the support for a storm, the storm drops accordingly. If the weather is sustained by another creature, that creature makes a saving throw using its relevant Sphere Save DC or other printed save DC. On a successful save, reduce the weather by only one severity step and you cannot use this talent against the same effect again until the end of your next turn. Decree of Clear Heaven does not erase curses, disasters, divine punishments, tribulation weather, Secret Inheritance weather, or Realm-scale formations automatically. It contests them. ### WEATHER DRAWBACKS AND VARIANT SCRIPTURES Some Weather lineages narrow the sky. These optional sphere-specific drawbacks are inspired by drawback design, not imported directly from another rules system. Unless the GM says otherwise: choose at most one Weather drawback when first learning Weather or undergoing major Weather initiation; Weather drawbacks are mutually exclusive; the drawback applies to all Weather talents you use; if a drawback grants a bonus talent whose prerequisites you do not yet meet, you gain that talent when you meet its prerequisites; if the drawback is retrained or removed, lose the bonus talent or benefit it granted. #### Single-Season Scripture The sky has many voices. Your lineage listens to one. ##### DRAWBACK: Focused Weather Choose Wind, Rain, Cold, Heat, Dry, or Thunder. You may learn and use only Weather talents matching that sign, talents marked Any Weather, and talents that reduce or oppose the opposite category. You cannot Gather opposed weather except to reduce it toward severity 0. For example, a Heat cultivator may raise Heat and reduce Cold, but cannot raise Cold. A Dry cultivator may raise Dry and reduce Rain, but cannot raise Rain. ##### BENEFIT Gain the chosen Weather Sign as a bonus talent. When you place a Mantle or Shroud of your chosen sign, reduce its CP cost by 1, minimum 0, once per turn. #### Local Cloud Scripture You do not command the horizon. You command the breath around one body. ##### DRAWBACK: Localized Weather You cannot use Gather Weather or talents that require Gather Weather. You can use Read the Sky, Sky Mantle, Cloud Shroud, and talents that modify Mantle or Shroud. You cannot learn Foundation Weather Field, Core Weather Field, Nascent Weather Mandate, Climate Scripture, Storm Birth, or other area-control Weather talents unless this drawback is removed. ##### BENEFIT Gain any Weather Sign talent as a bonus talent. Your Cloud Shroud range increases by 30 feet. At Foundation Realm, once per turn when a creature fails a saving throw against your Cloud Shroud, you may move it 10 feet or move yourself 10 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from that creature. The movement must match the sign’s fiction. #### Inner Mantle Scripture The storm is not cast into the world. It is worn beneath the skin. Inner Mantle Scripture is the Body Refining route into Weather. It is for cultivators who temper flesh, breath, skin, marrow, and meridians with season-pressure rather than projecting qi into the sky. A Body Refiner may learn Weather through this Scripture even if they would not normally qualify for outward Weather training. When they do, their Weather is called Inner Weather. ##### DRAWBACK: Body-Weather Only Your Weather cannot project active qi outside your own body. When you learn Weather through this Scripture, use the following changes. Key Ability and Resource: Use Constitution as your Weather key ability. Spend Stamina instead of CP for Weather effects unless another feature specifically says otherwise. Starting Package: You gain Read the Sky, Sky Mantle, and one Weather Sign talent of your choice. You do not gain usable access to Cloud Shroud or Gather Weather. The Shroud and Gather portions of your Weather Sign talents are sealed. Inner Mantle: You may place Sky Mantle only on yourself. When used this way, it is called Inner Mantle. It represents wind in the breath, rain in the blood, thunder in the nerves, cold in the bones, heat in the skin, or dryness in the marrow. No Outward Weather: You cannot use Weather talents to target allies, target enemies, target objects, create an area, alter environmental severity, move weather through the battlefield, create a storm field, establish a Weather Domain, or make weather persist outside your body. Existing natural weather can activate your Inner Mantle, but you cannot change that weather unless another non-Weather feature does so. Contact Exceptions: A Weather effect that triggers because a creature touches or strikes your body is allowed if it is written as a Mantle effect or Mantle modifier. Weather Backlash is allowed because the hostile creature meets the weather at your skin. This does not permit ranged Shrouds, area weather, or projected blasts. ##### ALLOWED WEATHER OPTIONS Inner Mantle cultivators can use the following parts of Weather. Read the Sky, Battle Reading, Barometric Disciple, and Scent of Coming Rain, interpreted as bodily pressure-sense, survival instinct, skin-prickle, breath-reading, and meridian response. Sky Mantle, but only as Inner Mantle on yourself. Weather Sign talents, but only their Mantle text. Their Shroud and Gather text remains sealed. Quick Mantle, Lingering Mantle, Weather Backlash, Weatherproof Mantle, Mantle of Clear Skies, Twin-Season Conjunction for your own Inner Mantle only, and similar talents whose entire effect modifies your own Mantle or your own survival against weather. Body Refining - Weathered Body Method. Cultivation Insights that improve your own reading, endurance, Mantle, or weather resistance. ##### SEALED WEATHER OPTIONS Inner Mantle cultivators cannot use the following unless the GM approves a separate Forged Technique, item, sect ritual, or later scripture that explicitly opens outward Weather. Cloud Shroud and all talents whose primary purpose is placing, improving, moving, damaging through, or persisting Shrouds. This includes Persistent Shroud, Severe Shroud, Lightning Chooses the Rod, Pressure-Cracking Shroud, Weather Cut, and similar talents. Gather Weather and all talents whose primary purpose is creating or improving an area, field, storm, route, court, mandate, or regional climate. This includes Sky-Bound Range, Foundation Weather Field, Weather Road, Sudden Shift, Rain-Follows-Mantle Method, Shelter-Piercing Draft, Storm Birth, Core Weather Field, Court of Changing Skies, Stormlord’s Finger, Climate Scripture, Heavenly Road Through Rain and Wind, Weather Eats Concentration, Nascent Weather Mandate, Typhoon-Haboob Gate, Blizzard-Sun Furnace Mandate, Heaven Breaks the Banner, Decree of Clear Heaven, and similar talents. Shared Weather Favor or any talent whose primary purpose is placing Mantles on allies. Weather-Borrowing Mantle in its normal form. An Inner Mantle version may borrow only weather that is touching you or present in your immediate space, not weather elsewhere within 1 mile. Four-Season Reversal in its normal form. An Inner Mantle version may protect your body from the triggering effect, but it cannot place the reversed Shroud on another creature unless a Forged Technique explicitly permits it. ##### BENEFIT Gain one Weather Sign talent as a bonus talent. You may use only that sign’s Mantle expression unless you later open outward Weather. When you place Inner Mantle on yourself, you may do so as a Bonus Action without learning Quick Mantle. Once per short rest, when your Inner Mantle would end because you lose Concentration, it remains until the end of your next turn. At Foundation Realm, when your Inner Mantle sign matches the natural weather touching you, reduce the Stamina cost of placing or refreshing that Inner Mantle by 1, minimum 0. ##### OPENING THE OUTER SKY This drawback can be removed only through major Weather initiation, a sect inheritance, a Forged Technique, or GM-approved retraining. When removed, you gain normal access to Cloud Shroud and Gather Weather, but you lose the bonus talent and Body-Weather benefits granted by this Scripture unless another feature preserves them. #### Courtyard Weather Scripture Your sky is small, but within it every drop knows your name. ##### DRAWBACK: Small Weather Your Gather Weather radius is halved. You cannot use Climate Scripture to affect a region larger than a battlefield, settlement courtyard, sect hall, ship deck, cave chamber, or similarly bounded location unless the GM approves a major ritual. You cannot create weather more than 300 feet away. ##### BENEFIT Gain Foundation Weather Field as a bonus talent when you meet its prerequisites. Creatures of your choice inside your gathered weather have Disadvantage on checks made to hide from you if they are exposed to that weather. #### Vessel-Bound Weather Scripture Heaven is poured from the gourd, unfolded from the fan, shaken from the bell, or released from the sleeve. ##### DRAWBACK: Atmospheric Vessel Choose a physical vessel such as a gourd, fan, bell, banner, cloud-jar, rain drum, weather bead, thunder staff, or sect talisman. You must hold, wear, or display the vessel to spend CP on Weather effects. If the vessel is broken, stolen, sealed, or more than 30 feet from you, you can still use Read the Sky but cannot place Mantles, place Shrouds, or Gather Weather until you recover, repair, or replace it. Replacing the vessel requires 8 hours of cultivation and suitable materials. ##### BENEFIT Choose one Weather Sign talent you know. Once per short rest, place a Cloud Shroud or Sky Mantle of that sign without spending its base CP cost. At Core Formation, your vessel can store one gathered severity 1 sign for up to 24 hours. Releasing it uses Gather Weather normally, but the sign counts as active even in an inappropriate climate. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Qi Cultivation - Heavenly Breath Method Qi cultivators are the default Weather practitioners. When you learn Weather through Qi Cultivation, you may use your Qi key ability as your Weather key ability. Once per turn, when you spend CP to force a Weather Sign for Sky Mantle or to sustain Gather Weather, reduce that cost by 1, minimum 0. At Foundation Realm, you may maintain Gather Weather while using Qi movement techniques, provided you do not lose Concentration. #### Spirit Awakening - Omen and Pressure Method Spirit Awakeners read weather as omen, mood, pressure, and heavenly response. When you use Read the Sky, you may also sense whether strong emotions, ghosts, spiritual wounds, possession, curses, or sect formations are influencing local weather. Your Thunder Sign, Rain Sign, Dry Sign, and Wind Sign Shrouds can affect incorporeal spirits if they can perceive the weather spiritually. Once per long rest, when a creature fails a saving throw against your Cloud Shroud, you may ask the GM one omen-question about that creature’s current emotional state, spiritual pressure, or likely next action. #### Body Refining - Weathered Body Method Body Refiners who learn Weather cultivate endurance against sky and season. Most do so through Inner Mantle Scripture, where Weather becomes body-weather rather than outward qi-weather. If you learn Weather through Inner Mantle Scripture, use Constitution as your Weather key ability and spend Stamina instead of CP for Weather effects. While you have your own Sky Mantle or Inner Mantle active, gain a bonus to Constitution saving throws against environmental hazards equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded up. When you take damage from a weather or environmental effect matching your Mantle sign, reduce the damage by your Constitution modifier, minimum 1. At Core Formation, once per short rest when you succeed on a saving throw against a weather effect, regain CP or Stamina equal to your Proficiency Bonus. This cannot exceed your normal maximum. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Sky-Reading Disciple Prerequisite: Weather sphere Your Read the Sky becomes sharper. You may use Immediate Reading as a Bonus Action. When you roll initiative outdoors or in a space connected to open air, gain temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus if you correctly name one active weather category in the scene. #### Mantle-Bearing Adept Prerequisite: Weather sphere, Sky Mantle When you place Sky Mantle on yourself, you may also place it on one willing creature within 10 feet without spending additional CP. Both Mantles must use the same sign. #### Shroud-Sealing Adept Prerequisite: Weather sphere, Cloud Shroud Once per short rest, when a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your Cloud Shroud, force it to reroll. It must use the new result. If the creature is inside gathered weather of the same sign, you regain 1 CP if it fails the rerolled save. #### Storm-Line Cartographer Prerequisite: Weather sphere, CL 8+ While you maintain Gather Weather, you always know the location of creatures inside the field that are exposed to the weather and not behind Total Cover. This does not reveal invisible creatures perfectly, but it tells you which spaces contain pressure, breath, heat, wetness, dust, or static disturbance. #### Clear-Sky Constitution Prerequisite: Weather sphere, CL 8+ You have Advantage on saving throws against natural weather hazards and Weather sphere effects of severity 1 or 2. When you use Decree of Clear Heaven or Mantle of Clear Skies, reduce the CP cost by 1, minimum 1. #### Little Storm Vessel Prerequisite: Weather sphere, Vessel-Bound Weather Scripture or GM-approved vessel training Choose one weather vessel. The vessel can hold one Weather Sign you know. After a long rest, choose the sign it holds. Once per short rest, when you place a Shroud or Mantle of that sign, increase the range by 30 feet or the duration by 1 minute.

### BASE ABILITY 1: READ THE SKY
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes for a careful reading
Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_careful_reading_procedure
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=IMMEDIATE_READING_ACTION, CAREFUL_READING_TEN_MINUTES, BATTLE_READING_NO_ACTION
Range: Self
Cost: 0 CP
Duration: Instantaneous
You study pressure, humidity, temperature, scent, cloud motion, insects, skin-prickle, spiritual pressure, and the shape of Heaven’s breath.
Choose one of the following readings.
##### Immediate Reading
As an Action, learn all current weather categories and their severity within 1 mile, assuming you are outdoors or in contact with air that leads outdoors.
You also learn whether the weather within 300 feet is natural, supernatural, cultivation-made, or being sustained by Concentration.
##### Careful Reading
After 10 minutes, predict natural weather within 5 miles for the next 48 hours, unless stronger cultivation, sealed terrain, divine concealment, or narrative conditions interfere.
##### Battle Reading
When you cast a Weather sphere effect, you may also identify one active Weather Sign in the scene without using an action.
A sign is active if its category is severity 1 or higher, if you have placed it through a Mantle or Shroud, or if you have gathered it with Gather Weather.

### BASE ABILITY 2: SKY MANTLE
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or 10 minutes as a ritual
Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_ritual_and_refresh_variant
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_SKY_MANTLE->action, BONUS_ACTION_REFRESH_MANTLE->bonus_action; procedures=TEN_MINUTE_SKY_MANTLE_RITUAL
Range: Touch
Target: One willing creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute if cast as an Action; up to 1 hour if cast as a 10-minute ritual
Cost: 1 CP if cast as an Action; 0 CP if cast as a 10-minute ritual
You wrap a creature in a weather sign so that Heaven favors its movement, breath, skin, weapon, or spirit.
When you place a Sky Mantle, choose one Weather Sign talent you know. The target gains that sign’s Mantle effect if at least one of the following is true:
the surrounding area currently has that weather category at severity 1 or higher;
you have gathered that sign with Gather Weather and the target is inside the area;
you spend 1 additional CP to force that sign through your own cultivation.
A creature can benefit from only one of your Sky Mantles at a time. Placing a new Sky Mantle from you ends the old one.
##### Refreshing the Mantle
On your turn, you may spend 1 CP and use a Bonus Action to change the Mantle to another Weather Sign talent you know, provided the new sign is active or you force it with CP.
##### Defensive Weather
When a creature with your Sky Mantle makes a saving throw against a Weather sphere effect, it has Advantage if the Mantle’s sign matches or opposes the effect’s sign.

### BASE ABILITY 3: CLOUD SHROUD
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature or unattended object
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
You hang a private weather around a target: frost around the joints, rain inside the breath, dust in the eyes, heat against the skin, wind around the limbs, or thunder over the heart.
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know and apply its Shroud effect.
A creature can be under only one of your Cloud Shrouds at a time. Placing a second Cloud Shroud from you on the same creature ends the first.
Unless a sign says otherwise, a creature makes the listed saving throw when the Shroud is placed and again at the end of each of its turns. A Shroud’s damage or condition applies on a failed save. A successful save prevents that round’s damage or condition but does not end the Shroud unless the Shroud says otherwise.
##### Three-Success Escape
If a Shroud no longer requires your Concentration because of a talent or feature, it ends once the target has succeeded on three saving throws against it.
##### Objects
A Shroud can target an unattended object. The GM decides whether the object is vulnerable to that weather. For example, rain may douse flame, heat may warp wax, cold may freeze water, aridity may dry ink, and wind may scatter papers.

resolved_automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### BASE ABILITY 4: GATHER WEATHER
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
You gather a Weather Sign you know into a local field.
Choose one Weather Sign talent you know other than Thunder Sign, unless Thunder Sign is being gathered through Storm rules. The area becomes severity 1 of that sign’s weather category.
Gathered weather counts as active weather for Sky Mantle and other Weather talents.
At Mortal Realm, Gather Weather creates atmosphere and combat-scale conditions, but it does not usually inflict long-duration travel hazards such as dehydration checks, hypothermia checks, or heat-exhaustion checks unless a talent specifically says so.
##### Shelter and Barriers
Gather Weather does not pass through sealed walls, closed rooms, airtight barriers, sealed formations, or spaces physically isolated from the area unless a feature says otherwise.
##### Opposing Weather
If you gather Cold into Heat, Heat is reduced first. If you gather Heat into Cold, Cold is reduced first. If you gather Aridity into Precipitation, Precipitation is reduced first. If you gather Precipitation into Aridity, Aridity is reduced first.
##### Storm Formation
A full storm requires Wind and either Precipitation or Aridity. If both supporting categories are severity 1 or higher, Thunder Sign and storm talents can treat the area as Storm severity equal to the lower supporting severity.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Applying a Slam
When you learn Wrestling, choose one Slam talent for which you meet the prerequisites.
You may apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you in any of the following ways:
##### Establish the Hold
When one creature gains the Grappled condition from your Unarmed Strike Grapple option or one of your Wrestling talents, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to that creature.
##### Work the Hold
When you begin your turn grappling one or more creatures, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you.
##### Punish the Escape Attempt
When a creature fails an Action check to escape one of your grapples, use your Reaction to apply one Slam talent to it.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
one use applies one Slam talent;
the target must still be Grappled by you when the Slam resolves;
the Slam lasts until the start of your next turn or until the grapple ends, whichever happens first;
a Slam requiring a saving throw uses your Wrestling Save DC.

spheres.full_exact_source_text: # Sphere of Wrestling Qi Expression: Primary — Grappling Qi; Supporting — Earth Qi, Body Qi, Contact Qi, Weight Qi. Sphere Type: Martial / Grapple / Closed-Distance Sphere Primary Path: Body Refining Secondary Path: Qi Cultivation or Spirit Awakening through meridian-binding, soul-gripping intent, or explicit Path synergy Resource: Martial Focus, Stamina for Body Refining expressions, and CP only when a supernatural Wrestling talent says so Core Chassis: Grapple control, Wrestling Save DC and Escape DC, Slams, Holds, Throws, Capture talents Wrestling cultivates the closed distance. Its basic loop is to establish a grapple under the 2024 rules, maintain direct bodily control, and apply one Slam talent through the hold. Its central distinction is simple: Brute decides where the body is moved. Wrestling decides whether the body is allowed to leave once contact has been established. ### Rules Baseline This player-facing sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline (5.5e) together with the Tianxia cultivation rules. Use the 2024 meanings of Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, Attack action, Unarmed Strike, Grapple, Grappled, Restrained, Incapacitated, Exhaustion, Utilize, Rope, Chain, and Manacles unless this sphere explicitly replaces or expands a rule. #### Barriers, Domains, and Formation Anchors A Barrier is a temporary supernatural barrier, including a Protection-sphere Barrier or another effect that explicitly identifies itself as a Barrier. A Domain is a high-rank cultivation effect that says it is a Domain. Ordinary suppression, dispelling, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove a Domain unless the technique explicitly says otherwise. A Formation Anchor is an anchor point explicitly created by a Formation or identified by the GM as part of a Formation project. Wrestling does not create Formation Anchors automatically. ### Core Wrestling Rules #### 2024 Fifth-Edition Baseline This sphere uses the 2024 fifth-edition rules baseline, sometimes called 5.5e. In those rules, a character normally initiates a grapple through the Grapple option of an Unarmed Strike. The target makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against the grappler’s escape DC. A Grappled creature may take an Action to escape by making a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against that DC. Wrestling talents supplement those rules. They replace a normal rule only when they explicitly say so. #### Martial Focus Wrestling uses Martial Focus. Until a global Martial Focus rule replaces this reminder: you may hold one Martial Focus at a time; some talents expend Martial Focus; expending Martial Focus is not an Action; you cannot expend Martial Focus if you do not currently hold it; if a talent says you regain Martial Focus, regain it only if it is absent. #### Wrestling Save DC and Escape DC Your default Wrestling Save DC and grapple escape DC are: 8 + Strength modifier + Proficiency Bonus A Path synergy, Insight, or other feature may explicitly replace Strength for Wrestling talents or grapples created through this sphere. #### Grappling Reminder When you use the Grapple option of an Unarmed Strike: choose one creature within 5 feet; the target must be no more than one size larger than you; you must have one hand or another eligible grappling body part free; the target makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which; on a failed save, it gains the Grappled condition. While Grappled: the target’s Speed is 0 and cannot increase; the target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against creatures other than the grappler; when the grappler drags or carries the target, each foot of movement costs 1 additional foot unless the target is Tiny or at least two sizes smaller than the grappler. A Grappled creature may use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against the grapple’s escape DC, ending the condition on a success. A grapple also ends if: the grappler becomes Incapacitated; the target leaves the grapple’s range; the grappler releases the target without spending an Action. #### One Grapple per Hand or Body Part One hand may maintain one grapple. A feature may permit grappling through: one hand; two hands; a weapon; a tail; a tentacle; a maw; another eligible body part. Whatever part maintains the grapple cannot be used for another purpose unless a rule explicitly says otherwise. #### Applying a Slam When you learn Wrestling, choose one Slam talent for which you meet the prerequisites. You may apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you in any of the following ways: ##### Establish the Hold When one creature gains the Grappled condition from your Unarmed Strike Grapple option or one of your Wrestling talents, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to that creature. ##### Work the Hold When you begin your turn grappling one or more creatures, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you. ##### Punish the Escape Attempt When a creature fails an Action check to escape one of your grapples, use your Reaction to apply one Slam talent to it. Unless a talent says otherwise: one use applies one Slam talent; the target must still be Grappled by you when the Slam resolves; the Slam lasts until the start of your next turn or until the grapple ends, whichever happens first; a Slam requiring a saving throw uses your Wrestling Save DC. #### Special Attacks When a Wrestling talent says it is a Special Attack, replace one attack when taking the Attack action unless the talent explicitly uses a different Action Type. #### Restraints and Utilize The 2024 equipment rules give Rope, Chains, and Manacles their own binding rules. When a Wrestling talent allows you to secure a creature with Rope, Chains, Manacles, or a similar restraint: take the Utilize action unless the talent says otherwise; satisfy the item’s normal requirements; use the item’s normal escape and break rules unless the talent explicitly replaces them. ## Base Sphere Abilities This v1.10.5 section is a parsing map, not an additional feature grant. It names the rules below that should be treated as the sphere's base package during character creation, dashboard import, Roll20 export, and combat simulation. - Wrestling Save DC and Escape DC define the sphere's contest target numbers. - Grappling Reminder and One Grapple per Hand or Body Part define the legal contact chassis. - Applying a Slam is the base method for converting a maintained grapple into Wrestling pressure. - Special Attacks define how Wrestling interfaces with ordinary 2024 Fifth Edition attack options. - Restraints and Utilize clarify when mundane binding equipment becomes part of the sphere. ### Wrestling Talent Tags #### Slam Talents A Slam talent modifies one maintained grapple when applied through the Wrestling sphere. #### Hold Talents A Hold talent improves grappling, escape prevention, dragging, carrying, pinning, or restraint. #### Throw Talents A Throw talent turns a maintained grapple into forced movement, impact, or a release technique. #### Focus Talents A Focus talent recovers, expends, or modifies Martial Focus. #### Capture Talents A Capture talent supports nonlethal restraint, binding, interrogation, or battlefield removal. #### Realm Evolutions A Realm Evolution represents bodily control beyond ordinary mortal technique. #### Unique Wrestling Talents A Unique Wrestling Talent is a distinct technique that does not fit another category. ### MORTAL REALM WRESTLING TALENTS #### Choke Hold - Slam The target cannot breathe or speak. It cannot supply Verbal components. If you apply Choke Hold to the same creature on consecutive rounds, the target is choking. At the end of each of its turns while choking, it gains one Exhaustion level from suffocation. When the target can breathe again, it removes all Exhaustion levels gained solely from this Choke Hold. Creatures that do not need to breathe are immune. #### Hard Whip - Slam, Throw End the grapple. Move the target up to 10 feet in one legal direction other than directly upward. This forced movement does not provoke opportunity attacks. #### Hammerlock - Slam, Hold Until the start of your next turn, the target has Disadvantage on checks made to escape your grapple. #### Heel Tactics - Slam Expend Martial Focus. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: Become Blinded until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: No additional effect. #### Living Weapon - Slam, Throw You may use a creature Grappled by you as an improvised melee weapon until the start of your next turn or until the grapple ends. The creature must be no larger than you, including effects that increase your effective size for grappling. You are proficient with the wielded creature. Use Strength for its attack and damage rolls. ##### Hand Requirements | Relative Size of Grappled Creature | Hand Requirement | Weapon Property | | --- | --- | --- | | At least two sizes smaller than you | One hand | Light | | One size smaller than you | One hand | None | | Same size as you | Two hands | Two-Handed | You must continue using the body part maintaining the grapple and satisfy any additional hand requirement. If you cannot satisfy the requirement, you cannot attack with the creature as a Living Weapon. ##### Living Weapon Damage | Grappled Creature Size | Damage Die | | --- | --- | | Tiny | 1d4 | | Small | 1d6 | | Medium | 1d8 | | Large | 1d10 | | Huge | 2d6 | | Gargantuan | 3d6 | On a hit: roll the listed damage die plus your Strength modifier; the attacked creature takes that Bludgeoning damage; the creature used as your Living Weapon takes the same Bludgeoning damage; apply Resistance, Immunity, and other damage modifiers separately to each creature. #### Grandstanding Slam - Focus Whenever you apply a Slam talent, expend Martial Focus. Each hostile creature other than the Slammed creature that can see you makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Become Frightened of you until the start of your next turn. Successful Save: Become immune to your Grandstanding Slam until you complete a short or long rest. #### Ground Game - Hold When you begin your turn grappling one creature, use a Bonus Action to force that creature to make a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which. Failed Save: Become Prone. Successful Save: Remain standing. When one creature successfully grapples you, use your Reaction to force it to make the same saving throw. #### Impale - Hold When you deal damage to one creature with a melee weapon wielded in two hands, use a Bonus Action to attempt to impale it. The target makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against your Wrestling Save DC. Failed Save: The target gains the Grappled condition. Successful Save: No additional effect. While the grapple lasts: the weapon maintains the grapple instead of a free hand; you must keep holding the weapon; you cannot attack another creature with that weapon; the target counts as Grappled by you for Wrestling talents; the target escapes using your Wrestling escape DC. #### Iron Clinch - Hold While one creature is Grappled by you: gain +1 AC against that creature; gain Advantage on saving throws against forced movement caused by that creature; the creature cannot gain Advantage on its escape check merely because an ally uses the Help action. #### Last Chance Grapple - Focus When one creature succeeds on its saving throw against your Unarmed Strike Grapple option, expend Martial Focus. Use a Bonus Action before the end of your turn to attempt to Grapple the same creature again. #### Opening Strike - Hold When you deal damage to one creature with a weapon attack, use a Bonus Action to attempt to Grapple it. You must have one hand or another eligible grappling body part free. The target makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against your Wrestling escape DC. #### Piledriver - Focus When making an Unarmed Strike Damage attack against one creature Grappled by you, expend Martial Focus before rolling. Hit: deal normal Unarmed Strike damage; the target becomes Prone; the target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Become Stunned until the end of your next turn. Successful Save: No additional effect. If you possess Twin Tie-Up and grapple two creatures, you may make one attack roll against each Grappled creature when using Piledriver. #### Pin - Hold, Capture Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Target: One creature Grappled by you The target makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against your Wrestling Save DC. Failed Save: Become Restrained until the grapple ends. Successful Save: No additional effect. If a creature remains Restrained through Pin until the start of your next turn, you may use an appropriate Rope, Chain, Manacles, or similar restraint on it through the item’s normal Utilize rules. Pin does not replace the item’s normal binding check, escape DC, break DC, or size restrictions. #### Pummeler - Hold Gain Advantage on attack rolls against creatures Grappled by you. #### Rest Hold - Focus, Hold While grappling one creature, use a Bonus Action and reduce your Speed to 0 until the start of your next turn. Regain Martial Focus. Until the start of your next turn, the Grappled creature grants you Half Cover against attacks made by creatures other than itself. If you possess Athletics sphere Close Quarters Training, pull the creature into your space without a check and gain Three-Quarters Cover instead. #### Slip and Strike - Hold When one creature fails to Grapple you, make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against it as a Reaction. When you voluntarily release a grapple, make one weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against the released creature as a Bonus Action before the end of your turn. #### Tackle - Hold When taking the Dash action as your Action, use a Bonus Action before the end of the turn to attempt to Grapple one creature within reach. #### Twin Tie-Up - Focus, Hold Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Cost: Expend Martial Focus Choose two different creatures within reach. Each target makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against your Wrestling escape DC. A creature that fails gains the Grappled condition. You must have one eligible free hand or grappling body part for each creature successfully Grappled. While maintaining both grapples: each creature has Advantage on checks made to escape; when applying one Slam talent through Work the Hold, apply the same Slam to both Grappled creatures; if one grapple ends, the other continues normally. ### FOUNDATION REALM WRESTLING TALENTS #### Body Lock - Hold Prerequisite: CL 5+ While moving a creature Grappled by you, ignore the additional movement cost from the Grappled condition when one of the following is true: the target is smaller than you; you hold Martial Focus; you move no more than half your Speed during the turn. Body Lock does not allow movement through illegal spaces or ignore terrain. #### Joint-Locking Scripture - Slam, Hold Prerequisite: CL 5+ The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one until the start of your next turn: cannot take Reactions; has Disadvantage on weapon attack rolls; has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws; cannot effectively use one held object requiring two hands. Successful Save: Cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. #### Clinch Reversal - Focus, Hold Prerequisite: CL 5+ Action Type: Reaction Factory Combat Bucket: reaction Factory Routing: combat_action_row Trigger: One creature within your reach misses you with a melee attack or fails an attempt to Grapple or Shove you Cost: Expend Martial Focus Attempt to Grapple the triggering creature. The target makes its saving throw normally. #### Earth-Shattering Slam - Throw Prerequisite: Berserker sphere Shatter Earth, Living Weapon, CL 5+ When using a creature as a Living Weapon, strike the ground through Shatter Earth. The creature used as your Living Weapon makes a Dexterity saving throw. Failed Save: the grapple ends; the creature becomes Restrained in the broken ground. Successful Save: the grapple ends; the creature falls Prone in one legal adjacent space. A Restrained creature may use its Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, choosing which, against your Wrestling Save DC. Successful Check: End the Restrained condition. #### Mountain-Crashing Suplex - Throw Prerequisite: CL 7+ Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Target: One creature Grappled by you Cost: Expend Martial Focus End the grapple and slam the target into one legal space within 10 feet. The target takes: 3d8 + Strength modifier Bludgeoning damage and becomes Prone. If the destination contains an ordinary solid obstacle, the target takes: +1d8 Bludgeoning damage and the obstacle takes the same total damage where appropriate. Mountain-Crashing Suplex does not automatically damage artifacts, Formation cores, or Realm-defining structures. #### Capture Specialist - Capture Prerequisite: Pin, CL 7+ When binding one creature Restrained through Pin: use the required Utilize action as a Bonus Action instead; gain Advantage on the item’s binding check; draw or ready the Rope, Chain, Manacles, or similar restraint as part of the same Bonus Action. Capture Specialist does not replace the item’s normal size restrictions or escape rules. #### Soul-Clinch Seed - Hold Prerequisite: CL 7+ Your wrestling techniques begin to hold more than flesh. When you attempt to Grapple one spirit, ghost, Incorporeal creature, or possessing entity that you can perceive: your eligible grappling hand counts as magical; you may establish a spiritual grapple even if ordinary physical contact would fail; the target uses the normal Grapple saving throw; the grapple ends if you can no longer perceive the target. Soul-Clinch Seed does not automatically end possession or pull a possessing entity free. ### CORE FORMATION REALM WRESTLING TALENTS #### Meridian-Crushing Clinch - Slam, Hold Prerequisite: Joint-Locking Scripture, CL 10+ The target makes a Constitution saving throw. Failed Save: Choose two until the start of your next turn: cannot take Bonus Actions; cannot take Reactions; has Disadvantage on attack rolls; has Disadvantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Constitution saving throws; cannot use ordinary movement modes requiring the limb or body part you are controlling; cannot provide Somatic components with the controlled limb. Successful Save: Choose one. Meridian-Crushing Clinch does not permanently injure the target. #### Meridian-Wrenching Lock - Slam, Hold Prerequisite: Pin, CL 10+ Use Limit: Once per creature per short rest Apply this Slam only to one creature Restrained through your Pin. Choose one recognizable anatomical structure. The target makes a Strength saving throw. Failed Save: Apply the corresponding hindrance. | Targeted Structure | Hindrance | | --- | --- | | Arm | Disadvantage on attacks made with that arm; cannot effectively use a two-handed weapon | | Leg | Speed reduced by 10 feet; Disadvantage on Dexterity saving throws | | Wing | Lose ordinary flight dependent on that wing | | Tail or similar appendage | Lose attacks or movement features primarily dependent on it | Successful Save: No additional effect. The hindrance ends when the target: completes a short or long rest; or receives sufficient restorative healing. Creatures without recognizable anatomy are immune. ##### Optional Severe-Injury Module At tables using lasting-injury rules, the GM may allow Meridian-Wrenching Lock to tear, sever, or permanently destroy the chosen structure on a failed save. Literal dismemberment is not the default player-facing rule. #### Cultivation-Suppressing Grip - Slam, Hold Prerequisite: CL 10+ When you apply this Slam, choose one ordinary ongoing supernatural effect affecting the Grappled creature that you can perceive. Make a Cultivation Check against: 10 + effect rank For an ordinary spell, use spell level as effect rank. For another effect without a listed rank, the GM assigns a rank based on its source and strength. Successful Check: Suppress the effect until the start of your next turn.Successful Check by 5 or More: Dispel the effect instead when appropriate. If the target is a summoned creature, the effect that summoned it may be suppressed until the start of your next turn. Cultivation-Suppressing Grip does not automatically dispel: Domains; Secret Inheritances; artifacts; Formation cores; Realm-defining transformations; permanent karmic bonds. #### Tombstone Burial - Throw, Capture Prerequisite: Berserker sphere Shatter Earth, Living Weapon, Earth-Shattering Slam, CL 10+ When Earth-Shattering Slam Restrains one target in broken ground, choose to drive it underground. Move the target downward through ordinary soil, stone, wood, or similar material: | Cultivation Level | Maximum Depth | | --- | --- | | 10-16 | 10 feet | | 17-20 | 20 feet | If the path breaks through a floor, roof, or hollow structure, the creature falls normally after emerging. While Restrained underground: the target cannot breathe unless it has an appropriate feature; it suffers the normal 2024 suffocation hazard when it runs out of breath or is choking; escaping the Restrained condition does not automatically remove it from the hole. After escaping, it must still climb, fly, burrow, teleport, or otherwise leave the burial space legally. Tombstone Burial cannot pass through: metal; artifacts; Formation cores; sealed barriers; Realm-defining structures. #### Court of the Closed Distance - Martial Domain “Inside the court, every road becomes a clinch.” Prerequisite: CL 12+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per short rest For the duration: count as one size larger when initiating or maintaining grapples; gain Advantage on saving throws and checks against Grapple, Shove, and forced movement; dragging or carrying one Grappled creature does not cost additional movement; when one creature within reach misses you with a melee attack, move 5 feet toward it without provoking opportunity attacks; once per turn when one creature fails a save against your Grapple option or fails an escape check, regain Martial Focus; one Grappled creature of your choice grants you Half Cover against creatures other than itself. Court of the Closed Distance ends early if you become Incapacitated. ### NASCENT SOUL REALM WRESTLING TALENTS #### World-Pinning Clinch - Hold, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: CL 15+ Your grapples may affect creatures up to three sizes larger than you. When you Grapple a creature larger than you: count as attached to the creature rather than automatically moving it; move with that creature when it moves unless an effect removes you; the creature cannot move you through a space too small for you; the creature has Disadvantage on attacks made against creatures other than you; you may apply Slam talents normally. If a feature increases your effective size, apply that increase before World-Pinning Clinch. #### Sovereign Grappling Incarnation Prerequisite: CL 15+ Action Type: Bonus Action Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Duration: 1 minute Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest Become an incarnation of perfect leverage. For the duration: count as two sizes larger when Grappling, Shoving, dragging, carrying, and using Wrestling talents; gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; gain Advantage on Strength checks and Strength saving throws; when a creature fails a saving throw against your Grapple option, apply one Slam talent without spending a Bonus Action once per turn; dragging or carrying Grappled creatures costs no additional movement; use Living Weapon with one creature up to one size larger than you after size increases are applied; once per turn when one Grappled creature fails an escape check, regain Martial Focus. #### Heaven-Lifting Throw - Throw Prerequisite: Mountain-Crashing Suplex, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Canonical Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Timing Detail: Special Attack Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve attack-replacement detail Target: One creature Grappled by you Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest End the grapple and throw the target up to 60 feet in one legal direction. Ignore ordinary size limits. The target and creatures within 10 feet of its landing space make Dexterity saving throws. Failed Save: Take 8d10 Bludgeoning or Force damage and become Prone. Successful Save: Take half damage and remain standing. The thrown target automatically fails if it collides with a solid surface before landing. Heaven-Lifting Throw does not automatically move: artifacts; Formation cores; Domains; creatures protected by a stronger immovability effect. Those may require a contested Cultivation Check. #### Soul-Seizing Embrace - Hold, Realm Evolution Prerequisite: Soul-Clinch Seed, CL 15+ Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Target: One spirit, ghost, possessing entity, Incorporeal creature, or soul-bearing creature Grappled by you Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per long rest The target makes a Charisma saving throw. Failed Save: Choose one: suppress one possession effect until the start of your next turn; pull one possessing entity into one adjacent legal space if it can exist there; prevent teleportation and planar travel until the start of your next turn; deal 6d10 Psychic or Force damage; impose Restrained until the end of your next turn even if the ordinary grapple ends. Successful Save: The target cannot teleport or take Reactions until the start of your next turn. Soul-Seizing Embrace does not automatically destroy a soul, end a Secret Inheritance, or overcome a Realm-defining possession effect. ### SECRET WRESTLING INHERITANCE #### The Hold Heaven Could Not Escape “Heaven attempted to withdraw. The cultivator tightened one hand and informed Heaven that the discussion was not finished.” Classification: Secret Wrestling Inheritance Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of the Closed Distance, World-Pinning Clinch, hidden restraint scripture Action Type: Action Factory Combat Bucket: action Factory Routing: combat_action_row Range: Reach Cost: Expend Martial Focus Use Limit: Once per week Choose one creature within reach. It makes a Strength or Dexterity saving throw, choosing which, against your Wrestling Save DC. Failed Save: Until the end of your next turn: the target becomes Grappled and Restrained; ordinary size limits do not apply; the target cannot teleport, travel between planes, or become Incorporeal; the target cannot be moved away from you unless you permit it; apply up to three different Slam talents you know immediately; the target has Disadvantage on saving throws and checks made to escape this hold. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success. Successful Initial Save: The target cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn. The Hold Heaven Could Not Escape does not automatically overcome: artifacts; Formation cores; Domains; Secret Inheritances; Realm-defining transformations; major narrative entities beyond the scope of ordinary combat. Those may require a contested Cultivation Check or a specific narrative condition. ### OPTIONAL WRESTLING CULTIVATION VARIANTS A Wrestling variant changes what the practitioner believes a hold is meant to accomplish. These variants are mutually exclusive unless a feature says otherwise. #### Gentle Restraint Scripture “Victory is complete when the enemy survives long enough to understand it.” You cannot learn: Choke Hold; Living Weapon; Piledriver; Tombstone Burial. ##### Benefits gain Pin as a bonus talent; gain Capture Specialist as a bonus talent at CL 7; when repositioning or binding one creature, choose for your Wrestling talents to deal no damage; gain Advantage on checks made to restrain, transport, rescue, or safely extract a willing creature; when one hostile creature becomes Restrained through your Pin, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. #### Mountain-Wrestling Scripture “A larger body is not harder to control. It merely provides more places to stand.” You cannot learn Twin Tie-Up. ##### Benefits count as one size larger when initiating, maintaining, dragging, or carrying one grapple; gain Body Lock as a bonus talent at CL 5; when a larger creature Grappled by you moves willingly, move with it unless you choose to release the grapple; gain Advantage on checks made to remain attached to a larger creature; World-Pinning Clinch allows grappling creatures one additional size larger than normal. #### Weapon-Binding Scripture “The weapon enters the body. The hold begins where the point refuses to leave.” You cannot use Opening Strike with unarmed strikes or one-handed weapons. ##### Benefits gain Impale as a bonus talent; when maintaining one Impale grapple, the weapon counts as one eligible grappling body part; apply Hammerlock or Joint-Locking Scripture to an Impaled target without spending Martial Focus once per turn; when one Impaled target fails an escape check, deal damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus; increase the reach of your Impale attempt by the weapon’s Reach property, if any. ### PATH SYNERGIES #### Body Refining - Iron-Clinch Body Use Constitution as your Wrestling key ability when higher than Strength. When creating a Grapple through your Unarmed Strike Grapple option or Wrestling talent: use Constitution instead of Strength for the escape DC if higher; count as one size larger when dragging or carrying the Grappled creature; when Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, regain Martial Focus if absent; after Stamina Guard reduces damage to 0, apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you without spending a Bonus Action once per round. #### Qi Cultivation - Meridian-Binding Circulation Use Intelligence or Charisma as your Wrestling key ability for Slam saving throws. Once per turn when you apply one Slam talent: move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the Slammed creature; or reduce the CP cost of one Wrestling Forged Technique before the end of your next turn by 1, minimum 1. When using Cultivation-Suppressing Grip, add Proficiency Bonus to your Cultivation Check. #### Spirit Awakening - Soul-Gripping Intent Use Wisdom as your Wrestling key ability for Slam saving throws. Your Soul-Clinch Seed and Soul-Seizing Embrace interact normally with: spirits; ghosts; Incorporeal creatures; possessing entities; soul-bound creatures. Once per round when one creature Grappled by you fails a saving throw against one Wrestling talent, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus. ### CULTIVATION INSIGHTS #### Iron Grip Adept Prerequisite: Wrestling sphere, CL 4+ While holding Martial Focus: count as one size larger when initiating or maintaining one grapple; gain Advantage on one check made to prevent forced movement once per short rest; when one Grappled creature attempts to move you unwillingly, reduce that movement by 5 feet. #### Living Weapon Adept Prerequisite: Wrestling sphere, Living Weapon, CL 6+ When using Living Weapon: add Proficiency Bonus to one damage roll once per turn; draw, shift, or regrip the Grappled creature without spending an Action; count the Grappled creature as one size smaller for determining the required number of hands, minimum Tiny relative handling; when the Living Weapon attack misses, the Grappled creature takes no damage. #### Pinning Adept Prerequisite: Wrestling sphere, Pin, CL 8+ When one creature fails its saving throw against Pin: it cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn; gain Advantage on the next binding check made against it before the start of your next turn; if it attempts to escape the grapple and fails, apply Hammerlock without spending a Reaction once per round. #### Soul-Clinch Adept Prerequisite: Wrestling sphere, Soul-Clinch Seed, CL 8+ Gain Advantage on checks made to: recognize possession; identify a spiritual body; distinguish an Incorporeal creature from an illusion; follow a spiritual grapple through an ordinary phase change; maintain contact with a visible spirit attempting to flee. Once per short rest, when a spiritual grapple would end because the target becomes Incorporeal, retain the grapple until the start of your next turn. #### Restraint-Script Custodian Prerequisite: Wrestling sphere, Formations sphere, CL 8+ When designing a Formation or martial training project, use one grapple, pin, restraint, capture, or soul-clinch principle you know as a seed concept. This does not create the project automatically. The project still requires: suitable terrain; restraints; reinforced surfaces; healers or safety crews; anchors where appropriate; maintenance; Formation-specific vulnerabilities.

#### Applying a Slam
When you learn Wrestling, choose one Slam talent for which you meet the prerequisites.
You may apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you in any of the following ways:
##### Establish the Hold
When one creature gains the Grappled condition from your Unarmed Strike Grapple option or one of your Wrestling talents, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to that creature.
##### Work the Hold
When you begin your turn grappling one or more creatures, use a Bonus Action to apply one Slam talent to one creature Grappled by you.
##### Punish the Escape Attempt
When a creature fails an Action check to escape one of your grapples, use your Reaction to apply one Slam talent to it.
Unless a talent says otherwise:
one use applies one Slam talent;
the target must still be Grappled by you when the Slam resolves;
the Slam lasts until the start of your next turn or until the grapple ends, whichever happens first;
a Slam requiring a saving throw uses your Wrestling Save DC.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
#### Applying a Rising Mark
You can apply a Rising Mark in three basic ways.
Kindle the Rising. As a Bonus Action, choose yourself or one willing creature, unattended object, or ongoing effect you created within 60 feet that you can perceive. The target gains one Kindled Mark.
Force the Rising. As a Reaction when a creature, object, or effect within 60 feet that you can perceive hits with an attack, forces a saving throw, regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, spends CP, uses a spell slot, uses a limited feature, teleports, becomes Hidden, becomes Invisible, creates concealment, creates an illusion, or moves at least 10 feet during its turn, you may apply one Overkindled Mark to the source after the triggering event resolves.
Rising Thread. As an Action, make a ranged Cultivation Attack against one creature or object within 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes Fire, Radiant, or Force damage, chosen when you make the attack, and gains one Overkindled Mark.
| Cultivation Level | Rising Thread Damage |
| --- | --- |
| CL 1-4 | 1d6 |
| CL 5-10 | 2d6 |
| CL 11-16 | 3d6 |
| CL 17-20 | 4d6 |
The damage is not the sphere’s identity. It is the visible symptom of qi becoming too bright, too hot, or too forceful to remain unfinished.

automatic_base_abilities.effect:
### BASE SPHERE ABILITIES
The Yang sphere uses Rising Marks. A Rising Mark is not a condition. Immunity to a condition does not grant immunity to Rising Marks unless a feature says otherwise.
A Rising Mark represents a motion, wound, breath, oath, technique, or intention that has begun to swell toward completion.
#### Mark Limit
You can maintain a number of Rising Marks equal to your Proficiency Bonus. A creature, object, or ongoing effect can have only one Rising Mark from you at a time unless a feature says otherwise.
A Rising Mark lasts until the end of your next turn, until you spend it, or until the marked subject is no longer on the same plane of existence as you.
#### Kindled and Overkindled Marks
A Rising Mark has one of two expressions.
Kindled Mark. A Rising Mark on you, a willing creature, an unattended object, or an effect you created is a Kindled Mark. You spend Kindled Marks to help an action complete.
Overkindled Mark. A Rising Mark on an unwilling creature, hostile object, enemy effect, or creature that rejects your assistance is an Overkindled Mark. You spend Overkindled Marks to make hostile exertion overcomplete, exposing or straining the source.
A willing creature may end your Rising Mark on itself at any time, no Action required.
#### Applying a Rising Mark
You can apply a Rising Mark in three basic ways.
Kindle the Rising. As a Bonus Action, choose yourself or one willing creature, unattended object, or ongoing effect you created within 60 feet that you can perceive. The target gains one Kindled Mark.
Force the Rising. As a Reaction when a creature, object, or effect within 60 feet that you can perceive hits with an attack, forces a saving throw, regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, spends CP, uses a spell slot, uses a limited feature, teleports, becomes Hidden, becomes Invisible, creates concealment, creates an illusion, or moves at least 10 feet during its turn, you may apply one Overkindled Mark to the source after the triggering event resolves.
Rising Thread. As an Action, make a ranged Cultivation Attack against one creature or object within 60 feet. On a hit, the target takes Fire, Radiant, or Force damage, chosen when you make the attack, and gains one Overkindled Mark.
| Cultivation Level | Rising Thread Damage |
| --- | --- |
| CL 1-4 | 1d6 |
| CL 5-10 | 2d6 |
| CL 11-16 | 3d6 |
| CL 17-20 | 4d6 |
The damage is not the sphere’s identity. It is the visible symptom of qi becoming too bright, too hot, or too forceful to remain unfinished.
#### Spending a Rising Mark
Once per round, when a marked subject you can perceive performs a triggering act, you may spend its Rising Mark without using an Action. Choose one Completing Response appropriate to the mark.
#### Kindled Responses
You may use these responses when you spend a Kindled Mark.
Complete Force.
Trigger: the marked subject deals damage. Add 1d6 + your Key Ability modifier to one damage roll. This bonus increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
Complete Aim.
Trigger: the marked subject makes an attack roll or forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw. Add 1d4 to the attack roll, or choose one target making the saving throw and subtract 1d4 from that saving throw. At CL 11, the die becomes 1d6.
Complete Step.
Trigger: the marked subject begins movement during its turn. Increase one of the subject’s Speeds by 10 feet until the end of the current turn, or allow it to stand from Prone without spending movement. At CL 11, the Speed increase becomes 20 feet.
Complete Breath.
Trigger: the marked subject regains Hit Points or gains Temporary HP. Increase the amount gained by your Proficiency Bonus + your Key Ability modifier.
Complete Resolve.
Trigger: the marked subject makes a saving throw against an effect that would reduce its Speed, prevent it from taking Reactions, impose Frightened, Paralyzed, Restrained, Stunned, or Unconscious, or suppress its ability to act. Add 1d4 to the saving throw. At CL 11, the die becomes 1d6.
Complete Revelation.
Trigger: the marked subject makes an attack roll, Wisdom (Perception) check, or Intelligence (Investigation) check against a creature or effect that is Hidden, Invisible, heavily obscured, disguised by illusion, or concealed by a Yin-like technique. The marked subject ignores Disadvantage from not seeing the target for that roll, provided it can still identify the target’s space or general location.
#### Overkindled Responses
You may use these responses when you spend an Overkindled Mark.
Overheat Force.
Trigger: the marked subject deals damage, makes an attack roll, or forces one or more creatures to make a saving throw. After the triggering act resolves, the subject takes Fire or Radiant damage equal to 1d6 + your Key Ability modifier. This damage increases to 2d6 at CL 5, 3d6 at CL 11, and 4d6 at CL 17.
Overexpose.
Trigger: the marked subject becomes Hidden, becomes Invisible, creates concealment, creates an illusion, or benefits from a feature that prevents others from perceiving it. Until the start of your next turn, the subject cannot benefit from being Hidden or Invisible against you, and allies you choose within 60 feet know the subject’s current space if they can perceive the area.
Overcommit Step.
Trigger: the marked subject moves at least 10 feet, teleports, or uses special movement. After the movement resolves, the subject cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn. If the movement was teleportation and the destination is within 120 feet of you, you know the destination space.
Overgrown Recovery.
Trigger: the marked subject regains Hit Points, gains Temporary HP, restores CP, or benefits from regeneration. Until the start of your next turn, the first damage roll against that subject gains a bonus equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Overstrain Technique.
Trigger: the marked subject spends CP, uses a spell slot, activates a limited feature, or uses a named cultivation technique. If the subject uses the same named spell, sphere talent, forged technique, monster action, or cultivation ability again before the end of its next turn, it gains a Rising Mark immediately after the repeated ability resolves.
#### Yang Saves
Some Yang features require a saving throw. Unless a feature says otherwise, your Cultivation Save DC equals your Cultivation Save DC.
