talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Step Through Darkness, Core Formation Realm, CL 14+Augment - 1 CP
The target must stand in Dim Light or Darkness when this Meld is granted.
The target temporarily steps out of the Material Plane and enters the shadowed border where the Material Plane touches the realm beyond ordinary light.
While traveling there:
Travel at up to 50 miles per hour.
Perceive an approximate relationship to the Material Plane.
See terrain only as blurred and unreliable outlines.
Gain no precise scouting, spying, mapping, or surveillance benefit.
The target may return to the Material Plane at any time.
When returning, roll 1d10 x 100 feet. The target appears that distance away from the desired endpoint in a random horizontal direction.
If this would place the target inside a solid object, roll 1d10 x 1,000 feet and shunt the target that distance in the same direction.
If this would still place the target inside a solid object, place it in the nearest unoccupied space and give it 1 level of Exhaustion.
Shadow Walker cannot cross a Dimensional Lock or comparable sealed boundary.

talents.full_description:
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes
Range: Touch
Target: One corpse, skull, grave marker, funerary tablet, or lingering death echo
Cost: 1 CP
You ask up to three brief questions of the dead or the death-imprint attached to the remains.
The answer is limited to what the creature knew in life, what the corpse experienced near death, what the lingering ghost remembers, or what the remains spiritually recorded.
The dead may answer in words, images, gestures, smells, cold, blood patterns, grave insects, flickering lantern light, or other signs.
The effect may fail or become unclear if:
the corpse is too damaged;
the soul has passed beyond reach;
the corpse is protected by rites;
another Death cultivator has sealed it;
the dead refuse to speak;
the question concerns secrets protected by stronger spiritual law.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot Emanation centered on you
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Required
Cost: 7 CP
You establish a grave court around yourself. The air cools, sound becomes muffled, lanterns dim, names appear on funerary paper, and every breath sounds borrowed.
While the Domain lasts:
Grave Sense functions automatically inside the Domain.
You know the location of corpses, undead, ghosts, dying creatures, and living creatures inside the Domain unless concealed by a stronger effect.
You gain Resistance to Necrotic damage.
Allies inside gain Advantage on death saving throws and Resistance to Necrotic damage.
Your Death servants inside the Domain may move through nonmagical Difficult Terrain without extra movement.
Once during each of your turns, when a creature inside the Domain cannot regain HP, you may command one Death servant inside the Domain without using your Bonus Action.
When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one effect:
the enemy takes 2d8 Necrotic damage;
the enemy cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn;
the enemy’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn;
the enemy cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Healing the enemy receives is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus until the start of its next turn.
A creature is affected by this start-of-turn effect only once per turn.

Duration: 24 hours, or until the formation is destroyed or dismissed
Cost: 8 CP
Control Load: 3
Requirement: You must have enough unused Death Control Limit to maintain the formation, and the remains must be sufficient to support its chosen size.
You bind the target remains into one Grave Formation using the Grave Formation stat block below. The formation appears in legal spaces occupied by or adjacent to the prepared remains, has full Hit Points, and is one undead asset regardless of how many corpses compose it.

A single command causes it to take one action from its stat block. If it is not commanded, it takes the Dodge action and moves only as permitted by those rules.
The Grave Formation counts as 3 Control Load. You may maintain Grave Formations only within your Death Control Limit. You may dismiss one you created without taking an action on your turn.

The Grave Formation counts as 3 Control Load. You may maintain Grave Formations only within your Death Control Limit. You may dismiss one you created without taking an action on your turn.

talents.full_description:
Blast Shape Talent
Your Destructive Blast affects one 5-foot cube within range. Creatures in that cube make a Dexterity saving throw.
Sealed Pearl
Augment - 0 CP: Instead of resolving immediately, the Destructive Blast forms as a cultivated pearl approximately the size of a sling stone.
You or another creature may throw the pearl with a normal range of 20 feet and a long range of 60 feet, hurl it with a sling using the sling’s normal range, place it carefully on a surface, or deliberately shatter it.
The pearl releases the stored Destructive Blast when shattered. If placed without shattering, it releases after 1 minute.
A creature may shatter a pearl within reach as an Action, as a Bonus Action, or by spending 5 feet of movement while passing through its space. A creature unaware of the pearl that moves through its space has a 50 percent chance of shattering it.
You cannot maintain more Sealed Pearls at one time than your Proficiency Bonus.
For rules interacting with thrown alchemical items or traps, treat a Sealed Pearl as a throwable prepared formula.
Augment - 1 CP: The Sealed Pearl persists for 8 hours. If you are within your Destructive Blast range of the pearl, you may cause it to release as a Reaction. At the end of the duration, the pearl either releases or dissipates. Choose which outcome occurs when creating it.
Augment - 1 CP: The affected area becomes a sphere with a radius of up to 20 feet.

talents.full_description:
Blast Shape Talent
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Make one of the following attacks against a creature or object within 30 feet:
a melee Cultivation Attack if the target is within your natural reach;
a ranged Cultivation Attack otherwise.
On a hit, deal your selected Destructive Blast damage and tether the target to you.
The tethered target cannot willingly move farther away from you unless you allow it. While the tether persists, neither you nor the target can move more than 30 feet from the other.
Either creature may attempt to drag the other through a contested Strength check. If the moving creature wins, it may move up to half its Speed while dragging the other creature. A creature at least two size categories larger than the opposing creature cannot be dragged and may move freely at full Speed while dragging the smaller creature.
While the tether remains, you may spend a Bonus Action to deal the stored Destructive Blast damage to the tethered target again. The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
The Blast Type and all other parameters are selected when the tether is created and cannot be changed while it remains active.
The tether has AC equal to 10 + your Proficiency Bonus, HP equal to 3 x your CL, immunity to Psychic damage, and immunity to the selected Blast Type’s damage type. The tether’s HP refreshes at the start of your turn.
Augment - 2 CP: The tether persists for its remaining duration without requiring Concentration. You may apply this augment after activating the talent on your turn without using an Action.

talents.full_description:
Blast Shape Talent
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Create one 5-foot-by-5-foot wall panel on a flat surface within range.
A creature passing through the panel suffers the damage and effects of the selected Destructive Blast.
A creature standing in the wall’s space when the panel appears makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a successful saving throw, that creature chooses which side of the wall it occupies. On a failed saving throw, you choose which side it occupies, provided the creature can fit in the selected space.
The Calamity Curtain does not normally block line of effect, sight, projectiles, or thrown objects.
A creature cannot take damage from the same Calamity Curtain more than once per turn.
The maximum number of contiguous panels increases with your Cultivation Level.
CL 1-4: 1 panel
CL 5-10: 2 panels
CL 11-16: 4 panels
CL 17+: 8 panels
Augment - 0 CP: Create a spherical or hemispherical dome instead of a linear wall. The dome’s radius cannot exceed the width or height of one panel.
Augment - 1 CP: Increase the maximum width and height of each panel.
CL 1-4: 10 feet x 10 feet
CL 5-10: 15 feet x 15 feet
CL 11-16: 20 feet x 20 feet
CL 17+: 25 feet x 25 feet
Augment - 1 CP: Create twice as many panels.
Augment - 1 CP: The Calamity Curtain blocks sight. Moving through the wall requires an additional 5 feet of movement. At CL 11 or higher, nonmagical projectiles passing through the wall are destroyed.
Augment - 2 CP: The Calamity Curtain persists for its remaining duration without requiring Concentration. You may apply this augment after activating the talent on your turn without using an Action.

talents.display_name: The Mountain Admits It Can Break
talents.exact_heading: ### The Mountain Admits It Can Break
talents.full_description:
Siege Talent
Requirement: Nascent Soul Realm
When you spend at least 10 minutes using Destructive Blast against a stationary object, wall, gate, barrier, mountain face, ship hull, formation shell, or similar target, you may conduct a siege-breaking rite.
At the end of the rite, make a Cultivation Check against a GM-set DC based on the target’s scale, material, formation support, Realm, and narrative importance.
On a success, you create one meaningful breach, crack, route, collapse point, exposed anchor, or tactical opening.
On a failure, the target is damaged and visibly weakened, but remains functional. You cannot attempt this rite against the same target again until you change tactics, gain new leverage, obtain better information, or spend significant additional resources.

| CL 11-16 | 3d8 Psychic |
| CL 17-20 | 4d8 Psychic |

Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure

Time: 1 hour
Range: Touch
Target: Up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures
Duration: One long rest

Guide the targets through a profound restorative sleep.
After completing the long rest, each target may choose two:
end one ordinary mental-stress effect;
end one ordinary nightmare;

reduce one level of ordinary exhaustion caused by lack of sleep, travel, or mental strain;
gain Advantage on its first Wisdom saving throw before its next long rest. Thousand-Night Repose does not remove curses, permanent injuries, Realm-level exhaustion, or Secret effects.

This talent does not make the object magical or grant a weapon mastery property.

Your broken rhythm becomes openly supernatural.

You may use Reeling Step along walls, railings, ropes, furniture, branches, or unstable surfaces during the movement, provided you end on a surface that can support you.

Chaos-Step Awakening does not grant flight, teleportation, phasing, immunity to falling, or movement through sealed Barriers.

Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot Emanation from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You establish a court of staggering steps, delayed Qi, laughing feints, and impossible recovery angles.
For the duration:
Reeling Step does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from any creature currently Off-Rhythm from you.
The first time each round a hostile creature in the Domain misses you or an ally with an attack roll, that creature becomes Off-Rhythm from you.
Once on each of your turns, you may use Reeling Step without spending a Bonus Action.
When you use Swaying Guard inside the Domain and the attack misses, you may move up to 15 feet instead of 5 feet.

Allies of your choice inside the Domain may move 5 feet when an Off-Rhythm creature misses them with an attack roll. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from the triggering creature.
The Domain moves with you. It does not create physical cover, difficult terrain, or a Barrier.

Prerequisite: CL 15+, Court of Broken Rhythm
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You manifest the sovereign body of impossible imbalance: a laughing silhouette, a robe of false falls, footsteps that land before your weight moves, afterimages in collapsing postures, or a soul that sways half a heartbeat outside the world’s rhythm.
For the duration:
You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed and can Hover, but only while moving in visibly irregular, swaying, or broken paths.
Reeling Step increases to 30 feet.
You may move through hostile creatures’ spaces, though you cannot end in them.
You do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures Off-Rhythm from you.
Once per round, you may use Swaying Guard without spending your Reaction or Martial Focus.
You gain one additional Reaction each round, which can be used only for Drunken Style talents.
The first time each round you would be hit by an attack roll from an Off-Rhythm creature, you may force that attack to be rerolled. The attacker must use the new result.
When a creature misses you by 5 or more, it becomes Off-Rhythm from you until the end of your next turn.
This incarnation does not grant random luck, immunity to damage, teleportation, or the ability to ignore sealed Barriers.

talents.exact_heading: ### The Step Heaven Could Not Predict
talents.full_description:
Secret Drunken Style Inheritance
Prerequisite: Sovereign Chaos-Step Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden chaos-step scripture, impossible survival, or recognition by a master of broken rhythm
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: split_required
Split Candidate Buckets: action, reaction
Timing Detail: Reaction or Action
Factory Routing: split_modes_before_character_action_programming
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=REACTION_WRONG_BEAT->reaction, ACTION_OFF_RHYTHM_FIELD->action
Range: 120 feet
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per week
For one breath, the battlefield’s prediction fails.
Use this inheritance in one of two ways.
As a Reaction
Trigger: A creature you can perceive within range makes an attack roll, activates a technique that targets one or more creatures, begins a movement technique, or forces a saving throw.
Choose one:
Wrong
Target: The attack or single-target technique targets a different legal creature within range of the original effect.
Wrong Place: Move yourself and up to a number of willing creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus up to 30 feet each to legal spaces you can perceive. If this makes the original effect illegal, it fails against those creatures.
Wrong Beat: The triggering creature becomes Off-Rhythm from you, loses its Reaction, and has Disadvantage on the triggering attack roll or grants Advantage on the triggering saving throw.
Wrong Certainty: If the triggering effect would hit you or make you fail a saving throw, turn that hit into a miss or that failed save into a success.
As an Action
Choose up to a number of creatures equal to your Proficiency Bonus within range. Each target must make a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is Off-Rhythm from you for 1 minute. While Off-Rhythm this way, it suffers all of the following:
it cannot take Opportunity Attacks;
it cannot benefit from Advantage on attack rolls against you;
the first time each round it misses an attack roll, falls Prone or moves 15 feet in a legal direction you choose;
when it activates a technique that targets you, you may move 15 feet before the technique resolves.
A target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Save: The target becomes Off-Rhythm from you until the end of your next turn and cannot take Reactions until the start of your next turn.
This inheritance cannot automatically override artifacts, Secret Inheritances, divine mandates, Lair actions, Legendary actions, fate-sealed attacks, or campaign-scale calamities. Against such effects, it may grant an opposed Cultivation Check, create a partial escape, redirect a lesser portion of the effect, or become the seed of a Forged Technique or larger cultivation project.

talents.full_exact_source_text:
#### Three-Sword Style - Unique Dual Wielding Talent
Prerequisite: Dual Wielding sphere, CL 5+
You learn to wield a third weapon.
If you possess an additional hand, tail, prehensile limb, telekinetic grip, or another explicitly approved method, you may use it to wield the third weapon.
If you possess no such method, you may wield the third weapon in your teeth.
The third weapon must be a one-handed melee weapon that lacks the Two-Handed property.
While holding a weapon in your teeth:
you cannot provide Verbal spell components;
you cannot speak clearly;
you cannot make an ability check that requires clear speech or singing;
you may still communicate in a garbled fashion when the GM determines that communication is possible.
##### Third Strike
Trigger: You make your Paired Strike while wielding a third weapon.
Cost: Expend your Reaction.
Use Limit: Once per turn.
Make one additional melee weapon attack with the third weapon as part of the same Bonus Action, or as part of the same Attack action if the Paired Strike was moved into that action by Ambidexterity or Nick.
The Third Strike:
does not add a positive ability modifier to damage unless another rule explicitly permits it;
is not a Paired Strike;
cannot receive a Pair talent;
cannot be used if your Reaction is unavailable.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Humble Wall, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch, or 60 feet if Projected Earth is legal for you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Raise a wall of packed earth, stone, clay, terrace-brick, or root-threaded ground.
Create up to six connected 5-foot wall sections. Each section is up to 10 feet high, 5 feet wide, and 1 foot thick.
Each section has AC 15, Hit Points equal to 20 + twice your Cultivation Level, and immunity to Poison and Psychic damage.
A wall section provides Total Cover through its space and blocks movement through that space. It does not automatically block teleportation, planar travel, incorporeal movement, burrowing beneath it, or effects that do not physically cross the wall.
If created under a creature’s space, that creature chooses which side of the wall to occupy. This talent cannot trap a creature inside a wall.

talents.exact_heading: ### Burden the Flying Thing - Burden, Projected
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
You can make Earth answer a creature that tries to escape all ground.
When a creature with your Burden Mark flies, levitates, jumps, teleports, hovers, or is otherwise unsupported within 60 feet of a legal Earth surface, spend the mark.
The creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It descends up to 30 feet toward the nearest legal Earth surface and cannot gain altitude until the start of its next turn. If it reaches a surface, it falls Prone.
Successful Save: It descends 10 feet and cannot gain altitude until the end of the current turn.
This talent does not affect creatures on another plane, creatures protected by a Realm technique that explicitly ignores grounding, or creatures whose flight is purely narrative scale unless the GM permits it.
Body Refiners require an external projection permission to use this talent unless the creature is within reach or the effect originates from a surface they touch.

When a creature inside your Foundation Spaces teleports, burrows, phases, becomes incorporeal, or uses a supernatural movement mode to leave the space, use your Reaction and expend 2 CP.

The Grave Refuses the Step does not stop Secret Inheritances, artifact movement, story-scale divine movement, or movement that does not begin inside your Foundation Spaces.

talents.display_name: The Burden of Ten Thousand Steps
talents.exact_heading: ### The Burden of Ten Thousand Steps
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Buried Foundation Remembers, CL 15+
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature you can perceive within 120 feet moves at least 30 feet in one turn, teleports, Dashes, or crosses three or more of your Foundation Spaces
Cost: 5 CP
The creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, it gains one level of Exhaustion that lasts until the end of the encounter, and it falls Prone if touching a surface.
Successful Save: Its Speed is halved until the end of its next turn.
A creature can suffer temporary Exhaustion from this talent only once per long rest.
This Exhaustion represents crushing burden, not starvation, sleep deprivation, or disease.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 15+
When a creature within 30 feet of you would drop to 0 Hit Points while touching a solid surface, use your Reaction and expend 5 CP.
The creature drops to 1 Hit Point instead and is immediately moved up to 10 feet along the surface without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
The place where it would have fallen becomes a Foundation Space until the end of your next turn.
Use Earth Carries the Fallen once per long rest.
If the triggering damage was from a critical hit or a Secret Inheritance, the creature must also succeed on a Constitution saving throw against the attacker’s save DC or your Earth Save DC, whichever is higher. On a failure, it drops to 0 Hit Points as normal.

talents.display_name: The World Rests on My Palm
talents.exact_heading: ### The World Rests on My Palm
talents.full_description:
“The immortal lowered one hand. The army did not fall. It simply discovered what it had always been standing on.”
Classification: Secret Earth Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Bearing Ground, hidden earth-root scripture
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on a point on the ground you can perceive or have ritually marked
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per month or once per major story arc, as determined by the GM
You claim the burden of a battlefield, valley, mountain pass, city gate, sect courtyard, mine, tomb complex, or other grounded region.
Choose one principle when you activate this inheritance.
Nothing Unmoored May Rule
Creatures hostile to you cannot teleport into, teleport out of, burrow through, phase through, or use planar movement through the area unless they succeed on a Charisma saving throw against your Earth Save DC.
On a success, the movement works, but the creature gains one Burden Mark and takes 6d10 Force damage as the world makes it pay the weight of departure.
This does not block deity-scale movement, artifact-scale movement, or GM-declared story-scale passage.
The Ground Bears the Innocent
Choose any number of creatures you can name, see, or ritually identify as protected.
While a protected creature touches ground in the area:
it has Advantage on death saving throws;
it cannot be moved against its will by ordinary forced movement;
the first time each minute it would take damage, reduce that damage by 10d10;
if it would be buried, trapped, crushed, or fall into a fissure caused by terrain, move it to the nearest safe ground you choose within 60 feet.
The Burden Returns to the Violent
The first time each round that a hostile creature in the area deals damage, forces movement, destroys terrain, collapses a structure, or kills a creature, it gains one Burden Mark.
When you spend that mark, add 5d10 Bludgeoning damage or 5d10 Force damage to the Earth Response.
If the creature is already marked, it instead makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: It falls Prone, its Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn, and it cannot teleport until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
The World Rests on My Palm does not create permanent political ownership, legal title, or divine authority over the region.
It makes the region briefly answer your Dao of foundation and burden.

talents.exact_heading: #### Marked by the Ledger - Word, Curse
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Canonical Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Magic Action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row; preserve named 5.5e action detail
Range: 60 feet
Target: One creature
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is marked by your ledger. Once per turn when you hit the target with an attack or a sphere talent deals damage to it, the target takes an additional 1d6 Psychic or Necrotic damage.
When you place the mark, choose one:
ability checks using one ability score of your choice have Disadvantage;
you have Advantage on Wisdom (Perception) and Wisdom (Survival) checks made to find or track the target.
If the target drops to 0 HP before the duration ends, you may use a Bonus Action on a later turn to move the mark to a new target within 60 feet.

talents.display_name: First Spark That Burned the Sky
talents.exact_heading: #### First Spark That Burned the Sky
talents.full_description:
“Before there were lamps, there was hunger. Before there was hunger, there was the first refusal to remain cold.”
Classification: Secret Fire Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Fire-Sovereign Incarnation, hidden primordial-flame scripture
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one creature, object, Barrier, or 30-foot-radius area.
The First Spark appears.
Creature
The target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 16d10 Fire damage, become Burning, and lose Fire Resistance until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and become Kindled until the end of your next turn.
If this reduces the target to 0 HP, its space becomes Fire Terrain for 1 minute and creates one Ash Remnant if the Ash sphere is involved in a Forged Technique.
Object, Barrier, or Structure
Deal 20d10 Fire damage.
This ignores an ordinary object’s Damage Threshold and deals double damage to objects vulnerable to heat. It must still affect the object’s AC and reduce its HP.
Area
The area becomes Fire Terrain for 1 minute.
At the start of your next turn, the area erupts.
Creatures inside make Dexterity saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 10d10 Fire damage.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
The First Spark cannot be used subtly. Creatures within 1 mile may see or sense the ignition unless blocked by a major supernatural barrier.

talents.exact_heading: ### Court of Returning Water - Flowing River Domain
talents.full_description:
“Within this court, every hard line learns it has already bent.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You establish a 30-foot-radius Domain centered on yourself. It moves with you.
While the Domain lasts:
You
may use Flowing Response twice per round, but no more than once during the same turn;
regain Martial Focus once per round when a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack;
may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker whenever a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack.
Allies
Allies of your choice inside the Domain gain Advantage on saving throws against being knocked Prone or moved against their will.
Once per round, when a hostile creature misses one of those allies with a melee attack, that ally may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from the attacker.
Enemies
Once per turn when a hostile creature inside the Domain misses with a melee attack or fails to Grapple, Shove, move, or knock a creature Prone, you may force it to make a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Move it 10 feet to one legal space inside the Domain, or give it the Prone condition.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the start of its next turn.
The Domain ends early if you become Incapacitated.

talents.exact_heading: ### The River That Returns the Blade Before It Is Drawn
talents.full_description:
Prerequisites: Flowing River sphere, No Center Under Heaven, CL 17+
“The master did not dodge the sword. The river had already persuaded the sword to regret its path.”
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature you can perceive hits you with a melee attack, Grapples you, Shoves you, knocks you Prone, Restrains you, or moves you against your will
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Declare that the attack or controlling force has already entered the river.
Cancel the triggering hit, Grapple, Shove, Prone effect, Restrained effect, or forced movement against you.
Then choose up to three of the following effects:
move yourself up to half your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
move the triggering creature up to 15 feet to one legal space you can see;
give the triggering creature the Prone condition;
force the triggering attack to resolve against one other legal target within the attacker’s reach;
end one Grappled or Restrained condition currently affecting you;
regain Martial Focus at the start of your next turn.
If you choose to redirect the attack against another target, use the original attack roll.
This inheritance does not cancel area effects, ranged attacks, teleportation, possession, mental influence, or effects that do not physically express force through the body unless the GM rules the scene’s metaphysics make the force directly receivable.

talents.exact_heading: ### Court of the Answering World - Force Domain
talents.full_description:
“The enemy mistook the courtyard for empty ground. The courtyard had already chosen a side.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Every meaningful surface inside the Domain remembers how to answer pressure.
While the Domain persists:
You
Treat every solid surface inside the Domain as one of your Pressure Anchors.
Use Impact from one legal origin inside the Domain without needing a prepared external anchor.
Use Counterpressure when its protected target is within 5 feet of any solid surface inside the Domain.
Use Pressure Step once per turn without spending CP.
Allies
Gain Advantage on saving throws and contested checks made to resist forced movement and falling Prone.
Reduce falling and collision damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
After a hostile creature misses an ally with a melee attack, that ally may move 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks.
Enemies
Treat the Domain as difficult terrain while moving across a solid surface.
Have Disadvantage on Strength checks made to break one of your Barriers.
When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain while touching a solid surface, it makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
push it 10 feet along the surface;
knock it Prone;
reduce its Speed to 0 until the start of its next turn;
deal 2d8 Force or Bludgeoning damage.
Successful Save: Reduce its Speed by 5 feet until the start of its next turn.
A creature makes this saving throw only once per turn.
Court of the Answering World does not grant telekinesis, flight, or control over creatures that are not touching a meaningful surface.

talents.full_description:
“The avalanche descended. The elder raised one finger. For one breath, the world remembered that falling was not the same as arriving.”
Classification: Secret Force Talent
Prerequisite: CL 17+, World-Bracing Incarnation, hidden Force scripture
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: One visible physically traveling attack, collapsing structure, avalanche, siege release, breath weapon, line effect, cone, or comparable disaster would cross one point within 300 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Create one sovereign Barrier centered on the chosen point.
Choose one shape:
a wall up to 120 feet long and 60 feet high;
a hemispherical dome with a radius up to 60 feet;
a sealed sphere with a radius up to 30 feet.
The Barrier has:
| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| AC | 22 |
| HP | 30 x CL |
| Resistances | All damage except Force and Void effects |
| Damage Immunities | Poison, Psychic |
When the Barrier appears, it stops the triggering effect at its boundary if that effect must physically cross the Barrier.
If the Barrier is destroyed, remaining damage or physical consequence continues through it when appropriate.
One Finger Holds Back Heaven may temporarily contest a narrative-scale physical disaster, but it does not automatically erase that disaster. A collapsing mountain, divine weapon, city-destroying array, or similar threat may continue to exert pressure each round or require a dedicated scene to resolve.
The inheritance does not automatically stop:
teleportation;
planar travel;
gaze attacks;
mind-affecting effects;
curses;
effects originating inside the protected boundary;
a threat that does not physically cross the Barrier.

Blood or Poison: the target has Disadvantage on the next Constitution saving throw it makes before the start of your next turn.
Force: if the target is Large or smaller, push it 5 feet along a Flow Line.

When you complete a Prepared Array, you may spend 2 additional CP to make it self-sustaining.
A self-sustaining array lasts 24 hours and does not require your attention to Pulse. When you create it, choose one of its Pattern Pulses and one trigger condition. The array automatically Pulses when that trigger occurs, no more than once per round.
A self-sustaining array cannot move, cannot change keyed creatures after completion unless you physically access its Eye, and cannot be dismissed from a distance unless you know a talent that allows it.

talents.exact_heading: #### COURT OF THE NINEFOLD ARRAY - DOMAIN
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 12+
“Do not look for the formation. You are standing inside it.”
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Area: 40-foot-radius circle centered on a point you can see
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
Instantly establish a battlefield Domain-formation with one Eye and nine spiritual Nodes. Choose two Basic Patterns or Pattern talents you know. The Court gains both Pattern Layers.
While the Court lasts:
keyed allies ignore its Difficult Terrain and may move through its Gates safely;
hostile creatures treat the Court as Difficult Terrain;
once during each of your turns, you may Pulse one of its Pattern Layers without using a Bonus Action;
when a hostile creature fails a saving throw against one of the Court’s Pattern Pulses, you may move one Node up to 10 feet;
when a Node moves through a hostile creature’s space, that creature takes Force damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
you may use Formation Step inside the Court without knowing the Formation Step talent.
Destroying the Eye or five of the nine Nodes collapses the Court.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A hostile technique, sphere effect, spell-like effect, or active Qi pattern crosses the boundary of one of your arrays
Cost: 3 CP
Make a Formation Check against the effect’s save DC, or against 10 + the effect’s Pattern Rank, spell level, CP cost, or equivalent power rating.
Success: The array catches part of the technique. Choose one:
reduce the effect’s damage by 4d8;
give keyed creatures inside Advantage on the saving throw against that effect;
prevent the effect from crossing the boundary this turn;
suppress one ongoing non-Secret effect until the start of your next turn if its source remains inside the array.
At CL 17, the damage reduction becomes 6d8.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
You may link two Prepared Arrays you control within 1 mile if both have stable Eyes and at least three intact Nodes.
A keyed creature standing inside one linked array may use an Action and spend 1 CP, or cause the array to spend 1 stored charge if it has one, to teleport to an unoccupied space inside the other linked array.
After a linked teleport is used, you must spend 3 CP before the end of your next turn or both arrays become dormant for 1 minute.
At CL 15, the maximum distance increases to 10 miles if both arrays are built on spiritual veins, sect territory, or long-prepared sites.

When you use Formation Devours Technique and succeed, you may spend 3 additional CP to store the caught force inside the array.
Before the end of your next turn, when you Pulse the array, you may release the stored force against one target inside or crossing the array.
Make a Formation Attack roll.
Hit: The target takes damage equal to the amount prevented or reduced, maximum 10d8.
If not released before the end of your next turn, the stored force dissipates harmlessly.

talents.full_description:
Secret Formation Inheritance
Prerequisites: Sovereign of the World-Diagram, Heavenly Grand Formation, CL 17+, lost scripture, celestial revelation, sect-defining inheritance, or world-array transmission
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Timing Detail: Action, or 1 minute if used as a prepared ritual
Factory Routing: combat_action_plus_prepared_ritual_variant
Split Review Decision: single_combat_action_plus_procedure_variant
Recommended Factory Realization: procedures=ONE_MINUTE_PREPARED_RITUAL
Range: Self
Area: 300-foot-radius sphere centered on you, or one prepared site up to a comparable scale
Duration: 10 minutes
Cost: 20 CP
Use Limit: Once per week. If used to overwrite a major existing Grand Formation, once per month.
You unfold the World-Array Scripture. For a short time, the surrounding world is treated as if it had always been built from your Nodes, Gates, and Flow Lines.
Choose five World Laws from the list below. The area becomes a World Array with those laws.
Law of the Eye: You always know the location of creatures inside the area unless hidden by a Secret technique or stronger effect. You do not learn their thoughts, statistics, or secrets.
Law of the Gate: Keyed allies may teleport up to 60 feet inside the area as a Bonus Action. Hostile creatures attempting to teleport inside, out of, or through the area must succeed on a Charisma saving throw or the teleport fails.
Law of the Locked Road: Hostile creatures treat the entire area as Difficult Terrain. Once per round when a hostile creature moves more than 10 feet, you may force it to make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, its movement ends.
Law of the Hidden Road: Keyed allies have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks and may Hide while Lightly Obscured inside the area. Hostile creatures have Disadvantage on checks made to find your Nodes, Eyes, hidden Gates, or concealed keyed allies.
Law of the Killing Line: Once during each of your turns, choose a line up to 120 feet long inside the area. Hostile creatures on that line make Dexterity saving throws. A creature takes 8d8 Force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success.
Law of the Returning Breath: Once per round when a keyed ally inside the area is reduced to 0 Hit Points but not killed outright, it instead drops to 1 Hit Point and is moved up to 30 feet to a legal space inside the area. A creature can benefit from this law only once per use of the inheritance.
Law of the Suppressed Current: The first time each round a hostile creature spends CP inside the area, it must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the CP is spent and the effect fails. On a success, the effect works, but the creature cannot benefit from this law again until the start of its next turn.
Law of the Shattered Formation: Choose one non-Secret Formation, Barrier, Domain, or prepared magical battlefield effect inside the area. Make a Formation Check against its creator’s save DC. On a success, suppress it while this inheritance lasts. On a failure, suppress one of its minor benefits until the end of your next turn.
Law of the Nine Palaces: Divide the area into up to nine visible or invisible palaces. Once per turn, when a hostile creature crosses from one palace into another, it must make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, choose whether it becomes lost, slowed, or exposed until the start of your next turn. A lost creature cannot willingly move closer to a chosen objective. A slowed creature’s Speed is halved. An exposed creature cannot benefit from Invisible or Half Cover.
Law of the World Anchor: Create nine Anchors. Each Anchor has AC 19, Hit Points equal to 15 × your Proficiency Bonus, and Immunity to Poison and Psychic damage. The World Array does not require Concentration while at least five Anchors remain. If fewer than five remain, you must Concentrate to maintain it. If fewer than three remain, it collapses.
While this inheritance lasts, you may Pulse one Pattern Layer or World Law once during each of your turns without using an action.
Limits: This inheritance does not permanently create territory, erase a kingdom, make you omnipotent, automatically kill creatures, rewrite the past, or suppress a stronger Secret Inheritance without a contested scene. It does, however, allow a Formation master to fight like a sect defending its ancestral mountain.

talents.full_exact_source_text:
### Glass-Bone Guard
Your body may serve as your primary Glass Surface.
When you use Temper Glass Surface on your own body, choose one benefit until the effect ends:
gain +1 AC while not wearing heavy armor;
reduce the first Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage you take each round by your Proficiency Bonus;
when a creature hits you with a melee attack, place a Faultline Mark on that creature.
This talent does not create glass outside your body.

Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Touch a solid surface no larger than a 5-foot square or one Medium or smaller object.
The touched surface becomes a Glass Surface. It remains in place and keeps its original size and shape.
If a creature breaks, opens, crosses, strikes through, or relies on the surface for Cover, you may place a Faultline Mark on that creature.
Contact Pane does not create a free-floating pane. It changes the behavior of a surface you physically touch.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Qi Cultivation, Spirit Awakening, or external-projection permission
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 1 CP
Create one transparent Glass Pane in an unoccupied space you can see within range.
The pane is a 5-foot-by-5-foot square. It must be vertical, horizontal, or angled, and must be anchored to a solid surface or another Glass Pane.
The pane has:
AC equal to 12 + your Proficiency Bonus;
HP equal to 5 x your CL;
immunity to Poison and Psychic damage;
vulnerability to Thunder damage.
When reduced to 0 HP, the pane shatters and creates Shattered Glass Terrain in its space until the end of your next turn.
At CL 5, create two connected panes. At CL 11, create three connected panes. At CL 17, create four connected panes.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Raised Pane Scripture, CL 7+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Create a narrow transparent road of glass panels across open space, water, mud, broken ground, or a gap.
The road can be up to 30 feet long and 5 feet wide. It must begin from a solid surface within range.
Creatures may move across it normally.
When a hostile creature willingly moves across the road, you may place a Faultline Mark on it once per turn.
If the road is reduced to 0 HP or you dismiss it, creatures standing on it fall unless they have another legal support.
A Body Refining cultivator may learn this talent only with external-projection permission.

talents.display_name: Glass Domain: Court of Visible Faults
talents.exact_heading: ### Glass Domain: Court of Visible Faults
talents.full_description:
“Every pane showed a different angle. Every angle agreed on where the enemy was already broken.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Create a court of visible faultlines around yourself.
For the duration:
your body counts as a tempered Glass Surface;
each ally inside may treat their worn armor, held weapon, or held shield as a Glass Surface for your Glass talents;
the first time each round that a hostile creature inside damages an ally, crosses a Glass Surface, attacks through a Glass Surface, or damages a Glass Surface, you may place a Faultline Mark on that creature;
once per round, you may use a Refraction Response without spending your Reaction;
Shattered Glass Terrain you create inside the Domain lasts until the Domain ends.
If you are a Body Refiner, this Domain manifests as glass-bone pressure radiating from your stance and contact points. It does not require you to create free-floating panes.

Prerequisite: Walking Pane Body, CL 10+
When your body is a tempered Glass Surface, gain the following benefits:
Resistance to Slashing damage;
Advantage on saving throws against being Blinded;

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Hidden Crack Study, CL 10+
When a marked creature casts a spell, spends CP, or activates a supernatural feature while you can see it through a Glass Surface, use your Reaction and spend the mark.
The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
reduce the damage of the triggering effect by 2d8 + your Proficiency Bonus against one target;
one target of the effect gains Advantage on one saving throw against it;
if the effect requires Concentration, the creature has Disadvantage on the first Constitution saving throw it makes to maintain that Concentration before the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: The triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Spell-Line Crack does not cancel the triggering effect.

talents.full_exact_source_text:
### Flaw Within the Golden Technique
Prerequisite: Spell-Line Crack, CL 15+
When a creature with a Faultline Mark uses a Domain, Realm Evolution, major forged technique, or other high-cost supernatural feature within 60 feet, use your Reaction and spend the mark.
The creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
reduce the triggering effect’s damage against all targets by 4d8;
one ally affected by the triggering effect automatically succeeds on one saving throw against it;
reduce the triggering effect’s duration by 1 round, minimum 1 round;
the creature cannot use the same feature again until the end of its next turn.
Successful Save: One ally affected by the triggering effect gains Resistance to one damage type dealt by the effect until the end of the current turn.
Flaw Within the Golden Technique does not affect Secret Inheritances unless the GM says the inheritance has already exposed a visible faultline.

Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Target: One willing, unconscious, Petrified, dying, cursed, poisoned, diseased, or spiritually unstable creature
Duration: 24 hours
Cost: 5 CP
Encase the target in a transparent preservation shell.
While encased:
the target is Incapacitated and has Total Cover;
the shell has AC 15 + your Proficiency Bonus and HP 10 x your CL;
poison, disease, bleeding, ordinary decay, and ongoing environmental exposure do not worsen;
the target does not need to breathe;
hostile creatures can see the target clearly, but cannot touch the target without breaking the shell.
You may end the shell as an Action while touching it.
Glass Coffin Without Death preserves a state. It does not heal the target by itself.

talents.full_description:
“The cultivator lifted one finger. Every pane in the world agreed where the impossible technique was already cracked.”
Classification: Secret Glass Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Glass Domain: Court of Visible Faults, hidden glass scripture or equivalent inheritance
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature you can see within 120 feet declares an attack, spell, sphere talent, Domain, Realm Evolution, Secret Inheritance, or other supernatural technique
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Before the triggering effect resolves, choose one visible or spiritually perceptible faultline in the declared action.
The triggering creature makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
split the effect: one target of your choice is unaffected by it;
refract the effect: choose one legal target within 30 feet of the original target to suffer half of the effect’s damage or consequence instead;
shatter the effect’s path: reduce all damage dealt by the triggering effect by half;
expose the technique: the triggering creature loses all benefits of Invisible, Hidden, or unseen-origin effects until the end of your next turn, and every enemy who can see it may place one narrative or tactical question to the GM about the technique’s visible weakness.
Successful Save: The triggering effect resolves normally, but the creature gains three Faultline Marks. These marks can exceed your normal limit and last until the end of your next turn.
This inheritance does not make Glass a universal counterspell. It works only because the declared action exposed a line, target, path, boundary, or contradiction that Glass can reveal.

Your Body Lightening improves.
Benefits while Body Lightening is active:
Your Speed increase becomes 15 feet.
You ignore the first 30 feet of falling when calculating falling damage.

talents.full_description:
Classification: Secret Gravity Talent.
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Gravity Domain, lost scripture, heavenly revelation, or mountain-star inheritance.
“The heavens have always pressed downward. I simply decide where they press hardest.”
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet.
Cost: 15 CP or Stamina.
Use Limit: Once per week.
Choose one creature or object no larger than Gargantuan. The target makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Initial Save: For 1 minute, the target suffers Heaven’s Weight.
A creature under Heaven’s Weight:
is Restrained;
cannot fly;
cannot teleport;
cannot be moved voluntarily;
has Disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws;
takes 4d10 Force damage at the start of each of its turns.
At the end of each of its turns, the creature repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.
Successful Initial Save: Until the start of the target’s next turn, its Speed becomes 0, it cannot fly, and it cannot take Reactions.
Objects and Structures: A structure failing the save begins collapsing under its own weight. The exact result depends on size, construction, and narrative scale.
Secret Limitation: Heaven’s Weight cannot be used casually. Each use creates a visible heavenly pressure mark: cracked clouds, bending starlight, a bell-like pressure in the bones, or a mountain-shadow falling where no mountain exists. Sects, spirits, and rival cultivators may recognize the inheritance.

### Disruptive Patrol — Zone Talent
Prerequisite: CL 7+
When a hostile creature inside your Patrol Zone begins activating a supernatural effect that requires an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction, it provokes a Patrol Response from you before completing the activation.
If your Patrol attack deals damage, the creature makes a Constitution saving throw as though maintaining Concentration.
Failed Save: The activation fails. The Action is spent, but CP, spell slots, and comparable limited-use resources are not spent.
Successful Save: The activation resolves normally.
Disruptive Patrol does not interrupt:
passive effects;
effects requiring no Action;
Domains already active;
Secret Inheritances unless they explicitly permit interruption.

talents.full_description:
“Behind me.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You become the living center of a defensive court.
For the duration:
You
Increase your Held Harm Pool maximum by your Cultivation Level.
Reduce forced movement affecting you by 20 feet.
Gain Advantage on checks and saving throws made to resist Grappled, Prone, or Restrained.
Use Interpose once per round without spending your Reaction.
Allies Inside the Court
Gain +1 AC.
Gain Advantage on saving throws against Frightened.
Reduce forced movement affecting them by 10 feet.
Gain Half Cover while within 10 feet of you.
Enemies Inside the Court
Treat spaces adjacent to you as difficult terrain.
Provoke opportunity attacks from you when entering your melee reach.
Court of the Unbroken Gate ends early if you become Incapacitated.

Prerequisite: CL 10+
Trigger: You hit one creature with a melee weapon attack, unarmed strike, or natural weapon attack while your Held Harm Pool contains damage
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per round
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take additional damage equal to the current damage stored in your Held Harm Pool.
Successful Save: Take half as much additional damage.
The additional damage has the same type as the triggering attack.
Punishment Returned does not empty or reduce your Held Harm Pool.
If you are delaying one effect through Durable or Cold Iron Call, you may choose to attempt to transmit one delayed effect instead of dealing the additional damage.
The target makes the saving throw originally allowed by that effect, using its original DC where available or your Cultivation Save DC otherwise.
Failed Save: The transmitted effect applies to the target.
Successful Save: The transmission fails.
Whether the transmission succeeds or fails, the delayed effect ends for you.
A Domain, Secret Inheritance, curse, or major narrative effect cannot be transmitted this way unless it explicitly permits it.

While you remain on the same plane and within:
10 miles × your Cultivation Level
you immediately know:
that the creature called;
its approximate direction;
whether it is uninjured, Bloodied, Unconscious, or dying.

I Will Hear is a supernatural guardian bond, not telepathy. It does not reveal an exact square, transmit a conversation, or compel you to answer.

### Adamant Guardian Incarnation
“The gate did not hold because it was made of stone. It held because I stood there.”
Classification: Unique Guardian Talent
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Transform into a perfected defensive incarnation.
For the duration:
gain +4 AC;
gain Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Force damage;
gain Immunity to Prone;
become immune to forced movement unless you willingly allow it;
increase your melee reach by 5 feet;
gain one additional Reaction each round; this explicitly overrides the ordinary one-Reaction limit;
still use only one Reaction for any single trigger.
#### Shelter the Weak
At the start of each of your turns, choose a number of allies within 20 feet up to your Proficiency Bonus.
Until the start of your next turn, each chosen ally gains Resistance to the first instance of damage it takes.

talents.full_description:
You can judge ordinary crops, herbs, seed grain, soil moisture, rot, pests, mold, and harvest timing at a glance.
After 10 minutes inspecting a mundane field, garden, orchard, storehouse, or herb bed, make a Gathering Check.
DC 10: Learn whether the crop is healthy, threatened, ready, immature, or overripe.
DC 15: Identify one practical mundane intervention such as drying, pruning, sorting, pest removal, drainage, shade, harvest timing, or storage adjustment.
During downtime, if you supervise an ordinary farm or herb bed for at least 7 days during a season, reduce mundane spoilage, waste, or storage loss by a meaningful amount set by the GM.
This does not make plants grow faster and does not create spiritual herbs.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
You may Read the Sign for Rare Resource Sites, including old spirit herbs, hidden mineral veins, dangerous mushrooms, spirit springs, weather-fed groves, ancient beast dens, and battlefield-remnant materials.
When you spend at least 1 hour surveying a region and succeed on a Gathering Check, the GM reveals one major Resource Site or confirms that none is reasonably present.
This does not reveal sites hidden by stronger Formations, Secret Inheritances, active guardians, divine concealment, or story locks unless your result exceeds the relevant DC.

This talent does not create ingredients and does not refine pills.

talents.exact_heading: ### Cleansing at the Source - Cut, Seal
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+.
When you harvest a Lot that would be Bruised, poisoned, diseased, spiritually muddy, blood-tainted, curse-touched, or contaminated, spend 3 CP and make a Gathering Check.
On success, remove one contamination or treat the Lot as Normal quality.
On success by 5 or more, treat it as Pure quality.
On failure, the Lot remains contaminated.
This is not a replacement for Alchemy purification recipes, but it can make a material safe enough to bring home.

talents.full_description:
You may use Wisdom (Survival) when attempting to Analyze a creature.

After resolving the attack, compare your recorded Dexterity (Stealth) check against the Passive Perception of each creature that could detect you. A creature whose Passive Perception equals or exceeds your recorded check finds you.
Assassinate overrides only the normal rule that making an attack roll ends your hidden state. You still stop being hidden if another rule ends it, such as making a sound louder than a whisper or moving into a position where concealment is no longer possible.

talents.full_description:

You always know the direction of your rival while you and your rival are on the same plane of existence.
If your rival is within 1 mile, you also know its approximate distance from you.

No Footstep Escapes the World is a magical cultivation effect. It does not reveal a path through an impassable barrier, permit teleportation, or grant sight of the rival.

talents.display_name: Heaven Keeps No Secret from the Patient Eye
talents.exact_heading: ##### Heaven Keeps No Secret from the Patient Eye
talents.full_description:
“The world did not betray you. It answered the questions you asked with every careless breath.”
Prerequisite: Hidden Eye sphere, CL 17 or higher
Time: 1 Action
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature you can perceive or your current rival
Duration: 1 minute
Uses: Once per week
Open the perfected record of the target’s revealed existence.
The target becomes Analyzed by you for the duration even if it would normally be protected from Analyze. Learn every Analyzable Characteristic the target possesses that is not concealed by an artifact, a Realm-defining protection, or another Secret Inheritance of equal or greater narrative weight.
For the duration:
you know the target’s direction and approximate distance while it remains on the same plane;
the target cannot benefit from being hidden from you;
you perceive the target if it is Invisible and not behind Total Cover;
allies of your choice within 120 feet treat the target as Analyzed by you for the purpose of one Research talent you know, chosen when you activate the Inheritance;
once during each of your turns when you damage the target, choose one known Damage Resistance to suppress until the start of your next turn;
once during the duration when you damage the target, you may treat one known Damage Immunity as Resistance for that instance of damage.
This Inheritance does not automatically defeat a superior Realm, destroy an artifact, negate a Formation core, reveal a creature behind Total Cover, or overwrite another Secret Inheritance without a cultivation-scale contest.

Prerequisite: Foundation Realm
When you help reduce a meaningful beast, spirit beast, monster, demon beast, monstrosity, dragon, or comparable creature to 0 HP, your first Refine the Meal check using one of its Essence Portions before your next long rest gains a +2 bonus.
If the creature was a major threat for your party or your cultivation stage, gain Advantage instead.
This talent does not apply if the creature was helpless, trapped only for farming, conjured, summoned, or not a meaningful opponent.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
Your Taste the Qi can sense appetite at soul depth.
When you use Taste the Qi on a creature, you may ask one additional question:
- What does this creature spiritually crave right now?
- What kind of nourishment, fear, vow, vengeance, recognition, bloodline pressure, or breakthrough hunger is strongest in it?
- Has this creature recently used a forbidden consumption method?
- Is this creature carrying Appetite Stain, daemonic corruption, undead hunger, ghost famine, or comparable spiritual predation?
If the target is unwilling, make the normal contested Hunger Check.
This talent reveals symbolic hunger, not a complete plan or private memory.

Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm
When you activate Digestive Mantle using at least two Satiety from different beast, monster, or demon-beast sources, choose one of the following sovereign adaptations:
- Winged Hunger: gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed until the end of your next turn. You fall if you are airborne when this benefit ends unless another feature keeps you aloft.
- Burrowing Hunger: gain a Burrow Speed of 20 feet through earth, sand, loose stone, or snow until the end of your next turn. You cannot burrow through worked stone, metal, formations, or sealed barriers.
- Armored Hunger: when Thick Hide reduces damage, reduce it by three times your Proficiency Bonus instead of by your Proficiency Bonus.
- Venom Sovereign: the first time each turn that Venom Belly deals extra damage, the target must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or be Poisoned until the start of your next turn.
Once you choose a sovereign adaptation, you cannot choose another until you activate a new Digestive Mantle.

talents.exact_heading: ### Heavenly Gourmand's Thousand-Flavour Canon - Secret, Meal
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, secret gourmand canon
When you use Refine the Meal, you may name a flavor principle before rolling: bitter, sweet, sour, salty, spicy, fresh, smoky, metallic, cold, burning, earthy, bloody, floral, rotten, clean, or empty.
On a success, the Satiety gains that flavor principle.
When you later use that Satiety for Digestive Mantle, choose one additional minor benefit based on the flavor:
- Bitter: Advantage on the next saving throw against Poisoned before the Mantle ends.
- Sweet: gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- Sour: increase Speed by 5 feet until the end of your next turn.
- Salty: Advantage on the next Constitution check before the Mantle ends.
- Spicy: add +1 damage to the first damage roll you make before the end of your next turn.
- Fresh: reduce Impurity by 1 when the Mantle ends if the Satiety was not Corrupted.
- Smoky: gain Advantage on the next Dexterity (Stealth) check before the Mantle ends.
- Metallic: the first time Thick Hide triggers, reduce damage by 2 additional points.
- Cold: Cold Gut lasts until the end of your next turn instead of until the start of your next turn.
- Burning: Furnace Belly deals +1 additional damage.
- Earthy: Advantage on the next saving throw against being knocked Prone.
- Bloody: when you hit a Bloodied creature, gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus once before the Mantle ends.
- Floral: Advantage on the next Charisma check made in a peaceful social scene before your next long rest.
- Rotten: Advantage on the next saving throw against Disease before your next long rest.
- Clean: ignore 1 Impurity that would be gained when the Mantle ends.
- Empty: if the Mantle ends while you have 0 Satiety, gain Advantage on your next Taste the Qi check.
The GM may reject a flavor principle that does not fit the ingredient.

talents.exact_heading: ### Famine-Surviving Saint Method - Secret, Survival, Banquet
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, famine lineage, wandering saint, refugee kitchen, or sect disaster office inheritance
During a short rest, you may spend 3 CP and one Essence Portion to prepare a famine bowl for up to your Proficiency Bonus willing creatures.
Each participant ignores ordinary hunger, thirst, and forced-march penalties for 24 hours and gains Advantage on the next Constitution saving throw against Exhaustion before its next long rest.
If used to feed helpless refugees, starving commoners, disaster victims, or noncombatants in genuine need, you regain 1 CP after the rest and reduce Impurity by 1.
This talent cannot create food from nothing. It stretches meaningful nourishment through cultivation.

talents.exact_heading: ### The Last Meal Before Immortality - Secret, Banquet, Mantle
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, major story permission
When a willing creature shares a meal with you before a breakthrough, duel, exile, execution, tribulation, last stand, or other life-defining threshold, you may perform a 1-hour rite and spend 8 CP.
Choose one participant, which may be you.
Until that creature finishes its next long rest, it gains one Last Meal die, a d8.
Once during that duration, the creature may roll the Last Meal die and add it to one saving throw, Cultivation Check, death saving throw, or ability check made to endure fear, hunger, poison, disease, forced march, hostile weather, spiritual pressure, or a breakthrough consequence.
After the die is used, the creature gains a symbolic hunger chosen by the GM or player: return home, avenge someone, eat again, protect a disciple, finish a vow, see dawn, or take one more step.
A creature can benefit from only one Last Meal Before Immortality at a time.

talents.display_name: The World Becomes a Single Crystal
talents.exact_heading: #### The World Becomes a Single Crystal
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, GM permission
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 120-foot-radius sphere centered on you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 10 CPRecharge: Once per Long Rest
Tags: Secret Inheritance, Domain, Lattice
You reveal the forbidden completion of the Ice Dao: for one minute, every path in the battlefield is part of a single crystal.
For the duration:
all ground, walls, ceilings, liquids, bridges, stairs, and similar surfaces in the area count as your Frost Lattice;
this lattice does not count against your Lattice Limit;
hostile creatures cannot benefit from being safe on your lattice unless you choose them;
the first time each hostile creature moves at least 5 feet on its turn, it gains a Fracture Mark;
you may spend Fracture Marks twice per round instead of once per round;
when you use Shatter Space, you may choose not to end the Lattice Space if that space is part of the Secret Inheritance’s area rather than a separate Lattice Space you created.
Once during the duration, when a creature with a Fracture Mark within the area begins movement, makes an attack roll, forces a saving throw, teleports, or activates a named technique, you may declare that the world has found the crack in that act. The creature must make a saving throw appropriate to the act: Strength for physical movement or melee force, Dexterity for ranged attack or evasive motion, Constitution for breath/body/meridian pressure, Intelligence for spell geometry or Formation logic, Wisdom for spiritual pressure, or Charisma for teleportation, command, or soul assertion.
On a failed save, the triggering act still begins, but its path freezes before completion. The movement is reduced to 0, the attack misses, one target automatically succeeds on the saving throw, the teleport fails to move the creature, or the named technique loses its first damage roll or movement effect, as appropriate to the trigger. On a success, the triggering act resolves normally, but the creature takes Cold or Piercing damage equal to twice your Shard Needle damage and loses its Fracture Mark.
This Secret Inheritance cannot erase an event that has already fully resolved. It freezes the path before completion.
When the duration ends, all ice created by this Secret Inheritance cracks at once. Each hostile creature of your choice standing on the lattice must succeed on a Dexterity saving throw or fall Prone.

The trigger can be as general or detailed as you like, but it must be based on visual, audible, tactile, scent, aura, or simple environmental conditions that occur within 30 feet of the figment’s location.

If you also use an effect that makes the figment permanent, it resets after its sequence ends and waits for the trigger again.

talents.exact_heading: #### Illusion Domain: Court of False Premises
talents.full_description:
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CPConcentration: Required
Tags: Premise, Image, Veil
You establish a Domain in which the first interpretation is never safe.
When you create the Domain, choose one dominant illusion: false battlefield geometry, a crowd of illusory bodies, false weather, a false sect hall, an impossible mirrorless court, a false moonlit road, a ritual stage, a phantom army, or another strong premise approved by the GM.
While the Domain lasts:
your Illusion talents have their range increased by 30 feet while targeting a creature or space inside the Domain;
once per round, when a hostile creature inside the Domain fails a saving throw or Study check against your Illusion talent, you may trigger a Misdirection Response without ending that talent;
creatures of your choice have Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth), Charisma (Deception), and Charisma (Performance) checks made inside the Domain;
your figments and glamers inside the Domain may include sight and sound without paying the 1 CP augment.
A hostile creature that starts its turn inside the Domain and can perceive it may use its Action to Study the Domain. On a success, that creature ignores the Domain’s broad false scenery, but not your individual Illusion talents.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Illusion, CL 17+, GM permission
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature, object, area, or event the target can perceive
Duration: 1 round
Cost: 12 CP
Saving Throw: Wisdom
Tags: Premise, Phantasm, Secret Inheritance
You establish one false premise so completely that the target’s immediate reality organizes around it.
Choose one premise that can be expressed in a single sentence, such as:
“The bridge is safe.”
“The assassin is behind you.”
“The gate is already open.”
“Your ally has betrayed you.”
“The wound came from elsewhere.”
“The elder’s command was spoken.”
“The treasure is in my hand.”
The target makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn, the target treats the premise as true for the purpose of one immediate choice. The premise cannot force self-destruction, make the target choose an illegal action, rewrite long-term loyalty, create physical matter, teleport a creature, or override direct divine, artifact, or Secret Inheritance-level protection.
When the target acts on the premise, choose up to two Misdirection Responses and apply them. The target then immediately recognizes that something impossible occurred, but may not know what part was false.
Successful Save: The target is not affected and is immune to this Secret Inheritance until you finish a Long Rest.
Overreach: If the premise contradicts something the target is currently touching, suffering, holding, or directly experiencing, the target has Advantage on the saving throw.

talents.full_description:
You can command the quality of weapons, armor, shields, tools, and improvised objects.
Imbue - Temper. Place Mandate can target a weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, armor, shield, clothing treated as armor, or improvised weapon. The target counts as magical. A weapon or natural weapon gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to half your Proficiency Bonus, rounded down. Armor, clothing treated as armor, or a shield gains the same bonus to AC. This does not stack with an existing magical bonus of the same kind; use the higher value.
Fray - Suppress Temper. Fray Mandate can target a weapon, natural weapon, armor, shield, or similar object. Magical bonuses to attack, damage, or AC from that target are suppressed for the duration. Artifact-grade or soul-bound items may require an opposed Cultivation Check.

#### Sharpen and Dull - Mandate
You command edge, impact, and killing profile.
Imbue - Sharpen. Place Mandate can target one weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, or improvised weapon. Choose one:
attacks with the Vessel score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20;
once per turn, the Vessel deals extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
the Vessel counts as a chosen common material for overcoming Resistance or Immunity, such as silvered, cold iron, jade-edged, blessed bronze, or another material approved by the GM.
Fray - Dull. Fray Mandate can target one weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, or improvised weapon. Attacks made with it cannot score critical hits, and once per turn when it deals damage, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.

talents.full_description:
You command durability.
Imbue - Harden. Place Mandate can target one object, weapon, armor, shield, door, tool, or unattended structure section no larger than a 10-foot cube. It gains Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage for the duration. If the target is armor or a shield, the wearer also gains temporary hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of each of their turns while wearing or wielding it.
Fray - Brittle. Fray Mandate can target one object, weapon, armor, shield, door, tool, or unattended structure section no larger than a 10-foot cube. It loses Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage. If it had no such Resistance, it gains Vulnerability to the next instance of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage it takes before the start of your next turn.
Augment 2 CP. You can apply Harden or Brittle to a creature. A creature affected by Harden gains Resistance to one of Bludgeoning, Piercing, or Slashing damage, chosen when you place the Mandate. A creature affected by Brittle loses one such Resistance, or takes extra damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus the next time it takes damage of the chosen type before the start of your next turn.

talents.full_description:
You command a weapon or vessel to carry a surface element.
Imbue. Place Mandate can target one weapon, natural weapon, unarmed strike, or damaging tool. Choose Acid, Cold, Fire, Lightning, Necrotic, Radiant, or Thunder. Once per turn, an attack with the Vessel deals an extra 1d6 damage of the chosen type.
At CL 5, the extra damage increases to 2d6. At CL 11, it increases to 3d6. At CL 17, it increases to 4d6.
A Vessel cannot benefit from more than one Elemental Mantle at a time. This talent does not create independent elemental terrain or replace elemental spheres.
Fray - Elemental Dimming. Fray Mandate can target one weapon or natural weapon currently dealing extra elemental damage from a spell, sphere, item, or technique. On a failed save, reduce one extra damage die from that effect by one step, to a minimum of no extra die, until the Mandate ends. Stronger effects may require Counter-Mandate.

On a failed save, reduce one extra damage die from that effect by one step, to a minimum of no extra die, until the Mandate ends. Stronger effects may require Counter-Mandate.

talents.full_description:
You command sound.
Imbue - Quiet. Place Mandate can target one creature or object. Sounds it creates are muffled. Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear it have Disadvantage, and the target has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks that rely on sound.
Fray - Resound. Fray Mandate can target one creature or object. Sounds it creates are amplified. Wisdom (Perception) checks to hear it have Advantage, and affected creatures or creatures carrying affected objects have Disadvantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks.
Quiet does not create magical silence and does not automatically prevent verbal components. Resound does not deal thunder damage unless another feature says so.

talents.full_description:
You command weight.
Imbue - Lighten. Place Mandate can target one object or willing creature. The target’s weight is halved. If the target is a creature, it has Advantage on checks made to climb, jump, balance, or avoid falling, and its carrying capacity is doubled. If the target is an object, creatures have Advantage on checks to lift, drag, throw, or carry it.
At CL 5, you may make a Tiny object or Tiny willing creature weightless. At CL 11, Small. At CL 17, Medium. A weightless creature or object falls slowly and can be moved by pushing, wind, telekinesis, or physical contact.
Fray - Burden. Fray Mandate can target one creature or object. The target’s weight doubles. A creature’s Speed is reduced by 10 feet, and it cannot take the Dash action. It also has Disadvantage on checks made to avoid being knocked Prone, shoved, dragged, or pulled.

talents.full_description:
You command motion.
Imbue - Quicken. Place Mandate can target one willing creature or object capable of movement. A creature gains a +10-foot bonus to one movement speed it possesses. The bonus increases to +15 feet at CL 5, +20 feet at CL 11, and +25 feet at CL 17.
Fray - Slow. Fray Mandate can target one creature. Choose one movement speed it possesses. That speed is halved.
Augment 1 CP. When applying Slow, also prevent the target from taking the Disengage action while the Mandate lasts.
Augment 1 CP. When applying Slow, suppress one special movement mode, such as flying, climbing, swimming, or burrowing. If this suppresses natural flight, the target descends safely at 60 feet per round unless another effect causes falling.
