talents.full_description:
You command reaction timing.
Imbue - Ready Reflex. Place Mandate can target one willing creature. The target has Advantage on Initiative checks. Once per round, the target may make one Opportunity Attack without expending its Reaction. If this Mandate is applied after Initiative has been rolled, the target may reroll Initiative with Advantage and use the higher result if it would improve its turn order starting next round.
Fray - Lagging Reflex. Fray Mandate can target one creature. The target has Disadvantage on Initiative checks and cannot make Opportunity Attacks. If this Mandate is applied after Initiative has been rolled, the target rerolls Initiative with Disadvantage and uses the lower result if it would worsen its turn order starting next round.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Target: One unattended Tiny or Small object
Duration: Concentration, up to 10 minutes
Cost: 2 CP
You command motion into an object. The object becomes an animated vessel that obeys simple commands such as move, guard, carry, pull, open, close, strike, hide, or follow.
Use the following local statistics unless the GM provides better object stats:
Tiny Object: AC 18, HP 20, Speed 30 feet or Fly 30 feet (Hover) if it lacks legs, attack bonus = your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier, hit 1d4 + key ability modifier Bludgeoning/Piercing/Slashing depending on form.
Small Object: AC 16, HP 25, Speed 30 feet or Fly 30 feet (Hover), attack bonus = your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier, hit 1d8 + key ability modifier.
An animated object is a construct-like vessel with Intelligence 3, Wisdom 3, and Charisma 1. It understands your simple commands but is not a true creature with personality unless awakened by another feature.
Commanding one or more animated vessels uses your Bonus Action. If you issue no command, they Dodge, Disengage, Hide, or continue the last safe command.
At CL 11, you may animate a Medium object. At CL 17, you may animate a Large object.

The bearer makes a Dexterity saving throw.

a held weapon or tool imposes Disadvantage on attacks or checks made with it;

A soul-bound, artifact-grade, or strongly awakened item may require an opposed Cultivation Check before Rebel Vessel can affect it.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Place Mandate can target one object, tree, corpse, construct, or creature with Intelligence 3 or lower. Spend 1 CP.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
You can command direction into a ranged weapon, thrown weapon, or ammunition.
Imbue - Pursuant Shot. Place Mandate can target one ranged or thrown weapon. Attacks made with it treat the target’s Cover as one degree lower. Total Cover becomes Three-Quarters Cover only if there is a gap, crack, murder-hole, arrow slit, window, or other path the ammunition could physically pass through.
Fray - Treacherous Shot. Fray Mandate can target one ranged or thrown weapon. Attacks made with it have Disadvantage. If an affected attack misses and one of the attacker’s allies is within 30 feet of the original target, the ammunition veers toward the nearest such ally. Compare the original attack roll to that ally’s AC; the GM may reroll if the line is impossible.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
This talent is intentionally narrow. It supports poison-adjacent Imbuement but does not replace Alchemy or Poison spheres.
Imbue - Corrosive Venom. Place Mandate can target one dose of poison, natural weapon that deals Poison damage, or object coated with poison. The next time it would deal Poison damage, it deals Acid damage instead.
Imbue - Virulent Edge. Place Mandate can target one dose of poison or natural weapon that inflicts Poison damage or the Poisoned condition. The next creature that saves against that poison before the Mandate ends has Disadvantage on the save.
Fray - Stale Venom. Fray Mandate can target one dose of poison, poison effect, or natural weapon producing poison. Creatures have Advantage on saving throws against that poison effect.

talents.exact_heading: #### Court of Ten Thousand Mandates - Domain
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 12+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP; once per short or long rest
You establish a court where every vessel briefly answers to your authority.
When you create the Court, choose one Mandate family you know: Sharpen/Dull, Harden/Brittle, Lighten/Burden, Quicken/Slow, Quiet/Resound, Clarify/Cloud, Physique/Weakness, Fortify/Expose, or Suppress Function.
For the duration:
your Mandate Load increases by your Proficiency Bonus;
once on each of your turns, you may use Place Mandate or Fray Mandate from the chosen family without spending an Action, targeting a legal Vessel inside the Court;
objects inside the Court count as in range for your Read the Vessel;
when a hostile creature inside the Court succeeds on a saving throw against one of your Fray Mandates, you may spend 1 CP to make the Mandate linger until the start of your next turn in a lesser form chosen by the GM;
when a willing creature inside the Court receives one of your Imbue Mandates, it gains temporary hit points equal to your key ability modifier.
The Court does not override artifacts, permanent soul contracts, sect treasures, Secret Inheritances, or unwilling creatures without saving throws.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Speak to the Vessel, CL 12+
You can awaken a more durable temporary vessel spirit.
When you use Speak to the Vessel, you may spend 3 CP to give the Vessel a temporary spirit for 24 hours. It gains Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma 10, can speak one language you know, and can make simple judgments about its surroundings.
If the target is an animated object you control, it can continue following your last command without your Bonus Action, though commanding it to change tasks still requires your Bonus Action.
If the target is a magic item, tree, crafted body, or prepared vessel, the awakened spirit may develop preferences. It begins friendly but not enslaved unless a separate binding effect applies.
This is not permanent sentience. Permanent awakening is a strategic project, Secret Inheritance, or major story result.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Lighten and Burden, CL 12+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius Sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
You create an area where weight obeys your Mandate.
Choose Light Field or Heavy Field.
Light Field. Creatures and unsecured objects in the area are half-weight. Creatures have Advantage on jumping checks and Disadvantage on checks to resist being pushed or pulled. Falling creatures descend at half speed and take half falling damage.
Heavy Field. The area is Difficult Terrain. Creatures have Disadvantage on jumping checks, cannot take the Dash action unless they succeed on a Strength saving throw at the start of their turn, and unsecured objects weigh twice as much.
As a Bonus Action on later turns, you may switch the field between Light and Heavy.

talents.exact_heading: #### Reverse the Weight of Heaven - Domain
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Heavy-Light Field, CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Area: Up to ten contiguous 10-foot cubes
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP; once per long rest
You reverse or redirect gravity inside the area.
Choose one direction: up, down, north, south, east, west, or toward a visible anchor point. Unsecured objects and creatures in the area fall in that direction until they strike a surface, exit the area, or reach the boundary.
A creature that can grab a fixed object may make a Dexterity saving throw to secure itself and avoid falling. Creatures with a fly speed may use their movement to resist as normal. When the effect ends, normal gravity resumes.
This is a magical cultivation effect and can be countered by Qiweaving, Space, Earth, Force, or comparable superior gravity law.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Awaken Vessel Spirit, CL 15+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: 24-hour ritual
Range: Touch
Target: One tree, beast with Intelligence 3 or lower, magic item, crafted body, corpse prepared by legal rites, or long-used personal object
Cost: 10 CP and a major material or narrative cost determined by the GM
You attempt to awaken a true vessel spirit. Make an Imbuement Check. The DC is set by the GM based on the target’s nature, usually 20 for simple vessels, 25 for magic items or crafted bodies, and 30+ for ancient trees, sect treasures, corpses with unresolved karma, or complex vessel spirits.
Success: the target gains lasting sentience or awakens as a story creature, item spirit, awakened beast, or vessel-person. Its exact stat block, loyalty, and rights are determined by the GM. It is initially friendly if treated well, but not mindlessly enslaved.
Failure: the awakening fails and the GM chooses one backlash: a flawed spirit, hostile vessel, incomplete sentience, curse, possession opening, broken item spirit, or sect-level consequence.
This talent is intentionally a story procedure, not a routine combat buff.

Area: 120-foot-radius Sphere or one colossal visible Vessel
Duration: Until the end of your next turn; some lesser effects last 1 minute
Cost: 10 CP; once per week
You speak an Edict that briefly renames one property of the battlefield.
Choose one Edict:
All Blades Remember Hunger. Willing allies’ weapons in the area count as magical, ignore Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage, and deal extra damage equal to your Cultivation Level once before the duration ends. Hostile weapons must save or become Dull.
All Armor Forgets Mercy. Willing allies’ armor and shields reduce incoming damage by your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier. Hostile armor and shields must save or lose magical AC bonuses until the end of your next turn.
All Weight Obeys My Palm. Choose up, down, inward, outward, or toward one visible point. Unsecured objects and creatures that fail a Strength saving throw fall or slide in that direction up to 60 feet, taking damage as appropriate if they collide.
All Voices Are Mine to Permit. Willing allies can speak, transmit commands, and use verbal techniques through noise, silence, or distance inside the area. Hostile creatures must save or be unable to speak clearly, use verbal components, or issue command words until the end of your next turn.
All Vessels Wake and Bow. Unattended objects up to Large size in the area animate until the end of your next turn and obey one simple command. Attended objects may save through their bearer. Magic items and artifacts may resist with opposed Cultivation Checks.
All Weakness Becomes Obvious. Until the end of your next turn, you and allies in the area know which of Strength, Dexterity, Constitution, Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is lowest for each hostile creature you can perceive. The first saving throw each hostile creature makes against that ability before the duration ends has Disadvantage.
All False Nature Is Denied. Choose one ongoing enhancement, degradation, polymorph, item buff, weight change, speed alteration, false vigor, animated object, or similar property-changing effect on each hostile target in the area. Make one Imbuement Check against the highest relevant DC. On a success, suppress all chosen effects until the end of your next turn.
Failure or Resistance. A creature, artifact, sect treasure, Secret Inheritance, or superior Realm effect may resist with an opposed Cultivation Check. On a failed Edict against a superior effect, you take psychic or force damage equal to twice your Cultivation Level and cannot use this inheritance again until you complete a major cultivation session.
This inheritance does not permanently rewrite reality, create permanent sentience, forge artifacts, replace Talismans/Formations/Alchemy, or grant ownership of another cultivator’s soul-bound treasure. It is one impossible command, not a new world.

talents.full_description:
Opening Line: “Everything has a name. A thing written correctly cannot pretend to be anything else.”
Classification: Secret Ink Talent.
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Immortal Scripture, and discovery of the target’s True Name.
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 15 CP.
Use Limit: Once per week.
Effect: Write one creature’s True Name into the air. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: For the duration, the target cannot become Invisible, cannot change shape, cannot teleport, cannot benefit from a disguise or illusion, has Disadvantage on saving throws against your Ink talents, and you always know its location while it remains on the same plane and within 1 mile. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot become Invisible or change shape until the start of its next turn.
True Name
Requirement: Discovering a True Name should require meaningful research, investigation, oath testimony, spirit interrogation, ancestral records, karmic proof, or narrative access. A nickname, public title, legal name, sect name, or assumed name is not enough unless the campaign defines it as true.
Boundary: True Name Calligraphy reveals and fixes identity. It does not by itself command fate, steal a soul, rewrite a life, or permanently erase a being.

talents.exact_heading: ##### Court of One Hundred Forms - Martial Domain
talents.full_description:
“The enemy saw one body. The mistake was counting only two hands.”
Prerequisite: CL 12+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Create a 30-foot Emanation of disciplined martial pressure. Within the Court, every step, turn, breath, and stance change becomes part of a larger form.
For the duration:
your Unarmed Strike reach increases by 5 feet;
once per turn when you Open a creature, apply one Form talent you know without counting against your normal one-Form limit;
once per turn when you hit an Opened creature with an Unarmed Strike, regain Martial Focus if absent;
when you take the Dodge action, make one Unarmed Strike before the end of that action;
hostile creatures you have Opened treat spaces adjacent to you as difficult terrain;
when a hostile creature misses you with a melee attack, you may move 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks from that creature.
Court of One Hundred Forms ends early if you become Incapacitated.
This Domain does not create independent duplicates, command allies, or turn the entire battlefield into difficult terrain. It represents your body controlling the nearby exchange.

talents.display_name: The Fist That Taught Heaven to Flinch
talents.exact_heading: ##### The Fist That Taught Heaven to Flinch
talents.full_description:
“Heaven did not fall. It only stepped back. For one breath, that was enough.”
Classification: Secret Iron Fist Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Sovereign Iron-Body Incarnation, hidden iron-body scripture
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Reach, or 60 feet through Breath-Extended Strike
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per week
Make one Unarmed Strike against one creature, object, temporary Barrier, or supernatural defensive effect.
Before rolling:
gain Advantage;
ignore Disadvantage;
treat the target as Opened;
your attack ignores Resistance to Bludgeoning, Thunder, and Force damage;
if the attack targets an object or temporary Barrier, ignore ordinary object Damage Thresholds.
Hit: Add 12d10 Force or Thunder damage.
If the target is a creature, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose three consequences.
The target is Stunned until the end of your next turn.
The target falls Prone and cannot stand until the start of your next turn.
The target cannot take Reactions for 1 minute.
The target’s Speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.
Suppress one non-Secret bodily, martial, or movement technique affecting the target for 1 minute.
Apply three seals from Meridian-Sealing Palm for 1 minute. The target repeats the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending one seal on a success.
Move the target up to 30 feet in one legal direction without triggering Brute Collision talents.
You immediately move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
Successful Save: Choose one consequence other than Stunned.
If the target is an object, temporary Barrier, Formation Anchor, or defensive effect, deal double total damage and make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s rank or DC.
Successful Check: Breach, suppress, or shatter one defensive layer until the end of your next turn.
Failed Check: The target is damaged but not breached.
The Fist That Taught Heaven to Flinch does not automatically destroy:
artifacts;
permanent Formations;
Domains;
Secret Inheritances;
Realm-defining structures;
cosmic offices;
living worlds;
Heaven itself.
Those may still be meaningfully damaged, humiliated, interrupted, or turned into the subject of a campaign.

talents.exact_heading: ### Court of Words Without Offense - Martial Domain
talents.full_description:
“Everyone heard the joke. Nobody agreed on who the fool had been.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short rest
For the duration:
creatures inside can hear you clearly unless Deafened or prevented by a stronger effect;
use Set the Scene once at the start of each of your turns without spending a Bonus Action;
when one ally inside is missed by an attack roll, it moves 5 feet without provoking opportunity attacks from the attacker;
when one Foil inside becomes Flustered, choose one ally inside to gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus;
once per round, deliver one Punchline without spending your Reaction.
You may still use your Reaction for a different Punchline when legal.
Court of Words Without Offense does not force creatures to laugh, understand your language, or become Charmed.

talents.full_description:
You can store healing inside yourself as a reserve of refined vitality.
When you use Mend the Pulse, you may choose to store the healing instead of applying it immediately. Roll the healing normally. The result becomes stored healing.
You can store a maximum amount of healing equal to 10 times your Cultivation Level.
Stored healing lasts until you finish a long rest.
As an Action, you may touch one creature and release any amount of stored healing into that creature, up to the amount remaining in your Fount of Life. The target regains that many Hit Points. The released amount is subtracted from your stored healing.
Healing stored with Fount of Life cannot be created from delayed healing or regeneration effects.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Minute-Gate Resuscitation.
You can return the dead to life through a full soul-return rite.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: 1 hour
Range: Touch
Target: One dead creature
Duration: Instantaneous
Cost: 5 CP
You return a dead creature to life, provided it has been dead no longer than 10 days.
If the creature’s soul is willing and at liberty to rejoin the body, the creature returns to life with 1 Hit Point.
This neutralizes poisons and cures nonmagical diseases that affected the creature at the time it died.
This does not remove magical diseases, curses, soul bindings, cultivation deviations, or similar effects. If those effects are not removed before resurrection, they resume when the creature returns to life.
The body must possess the organs and structure necessary for survival. If the creature lacks a head or another body part essential to survival, Resurrection fails unless another talent restores the missing part first.
Coming back from death is an ordeal. The target suffers a -4 penalty to attack rolls, saving throws, and ability checks. Each time the target finishes a long rest, this penalty is reduced by 1 until it disappears.
Resurrection cannot return undead to life unless the GM determines the undead creature’s original soul is willing, available, and not transformed beyond recovery.

talents.full_description:
Your own soul remembers the pattern of your body.
When you would die while you have at least 1 CP remaining, you may spend all remaining CP, minimum 1 CP, to preserve a Soul-Lamp.
The Soul-Lamp lasts for 1 minute.
While the Soul-Lamp persists, you are dead, but your soul has not fully departed. A creature can use One-Breath Resuscitation, Minute-Gate Resuscitation, Resurrection, or a comparable effect on you as though your body were still within the valid time limit.
If your body is mostly intact when the Soul-Lamp ends, you may make a Constitution saving throw against DC 20.
Success: You return to life with 1 Hit Point and 1 level of Exhaustion.
Failure: You die normally.
Soul-Lamp Continuity cannot function if your soul is destroyed, consumed, imprisoned, or if your body is destroyed beyond recognition.

talents.full_description:
You can read the taste of lightning before it becomes visible.
You have Advantage on checks to notice or identify recent lightning damage, charged metal, storm-charged objects, active Lightning techniques, overloaded talismans, unstable formation circuits, creatures currently carrying a Lightning Charge, lightning-aspected herbs, and electrical traps.

At Core Formation Realm, you can identify whether a visible Lightning effect is primarily external, internal, thunder-based, conductive, or formation-disruptive.

Current Beyond the Skin does not grant sustained weather control, free flight, storm creation, or automatic formation-breaking.

Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Cost: 1 CP
You move up to 30 feet in a straight line to an unoccupied space you can see. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks from creatures whose reach you leave during the movement.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature you can see within 60 feet activates a talisman, stored-command technique, scroll, charm, seal, or comparable prepared qi medium
Cost: 1 CP
Make a Lightning Check against the user’s Cultivation Save DC or the item’s DC.
Success: The talisman or prepared medium sputters. The triggering effect still occurs, but its range, duration, or damage is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus x 5 feet, one round, or your Proficiency Bonus damage, as appropriate. The GM chooses the relevant reduction if unclear.

talents.exact_heading: ### Court of Charged Paths - Circuit, Domain
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+, Current Beyond the Skin
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 60-foot emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You establish a court of lightning logic around yourself.
For the duration:
- Your Charge limit increases by your Proficiency Bonus.
- Once on each of your turns, you may use Gather Charge without an action.
- Your Lightning Lash may originate from any Charged space or Charged object inside the court that you can see.
- When a hostile creature starts its turn Charged inside the court, you may move the Charge to another visible creature, object, or space within 10 feet of it.
- The first time each round a hostile creature inside the court takes lightning damage from one of your talents, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- Allied creatures of your choice inside the court have Advantage on saving throws against lightning and thunder effects you create.
The court ends early if you are Incapacitated.
Court of Charged Paths is a Lightning domain, not Weather. It does not create sustained weather or Weather severity.

You can stabilize charged lattices at larger scale.
During 10 minutes of work, you may create a charged lattice around a chest, ritual circle, corpse, small altar, medicine cabinet, crystal vessel, or formation component no larger than a 10-foot cube.

talents.exact_heading: ### Lightning Sovereign Incarnation - Realm Evolution, Lightning Body
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Court of Charged Paths
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You become a sovereign center of lightning, nerves, thunder, and charged consequence.
For the duration:
- You gain a Fly Speed of 60 feet and can Hover.
- You have Resistance to lightning and thunder damage.
- Your Lightning Lash range becomes 300 feet.
- Your Charge limit doubles.
- Once on each of your turns, you may use Lightning Lash or Gather Charge without an action.
- The first time each round you deal lightning damage to a creature, that creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
- You may use Static Guard without spending your Reaction once per round.
- You may treat visible non-Secret formation nodes, talisman circuits, qi constructs, and summoned asset anchors within 120 feet as Conductive.
The incarnation ends early if you are Incapacitated.
This incarnation does not create regional weather. If used inside a Weather storm created by another effect, the GM may describe the signs as stormlike, but the mechanics remain Lightning unless a talent says otherwise.

talents.exact_heading: ### Thunder That Answers First - Thunder, Reaction
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Thunder Breaks Command
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A hostile creature you can see within 300 feet begins a technique, command, domain activation, formation order, Secret preparation, or battlefield-wide instruction
Cost: 3 CP
The triggering creature makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Thunder arrives before the command completes. The triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn, has Disadvantage on the triggering technique’s attack roll or save DC contest if any, and allied creatures relying on that command do not gain Advantage from it.
Successful Save: The triggering creature cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
If the triggering effect is Secret, artifact-backed, or higher Realm, this talent does not cancel it by itself. It imposes the listed penalties unless the opposing authority defeats your Lightning Check.

talents.exact_heading: ### Return Stroke Through the Void - Movement, Arc
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Ride the Return Stroke
When a creature you can see within 300 feet takes lightning damage or loses a Charge from one of your Lightning talents, you may spend 2 CP to move to an unoccupied space within 10 feet of that creature.
This movement follows a visible or spiritual lightning path and does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. It can pass through openings, around corners, along Conductive paths, or through active lightning arcs. It cannot pass through sealed anti-space barriers, superior Void separation, or a closed space with no symbolic or conductive path unless you win an opposed Lightning Check against the obstacle.
After you arrive, you may make one Lightning Lash against the triggering creature without using an action. You cannot use Return Stroke Through the Void again until the start of your next turn.

Secret Lightning Inheritance
Prerequisites: CL 17+, Lightning Sovereign Incarnation, Formation-Splitting Bolt, True Lightning-God Mantle, and access to a true lightning scripture, tribulation scar, heavenly thunder inheritance, or equivalent revelation
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on you
Duration: Instantaneous, with aftermath until the end of your next turn
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You command the instant when potential becomes judgment.
Choose up to three decrees:
The Circuit Was Always One. Choose any number of Charged creatures, objects, formation nodes, talismans, qi constructs, or spaces you can perceive in the area, up to three times your Proficiency Bonus. Each hostile creature chosen this way makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes 8d8 lightning damage and cannot take Reactions until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
The Ward Forgets Its Shape. Choose one non-Secret ward, barrier, talisman array, qi construct, or formation segment in the area. Make a Lightning Check against the effect’s DC. On a success, suppress it until the end of your next turn. On a failure, reduce one of its major numerical effects by your Cultivation Level until the end of your next turn.
The Body Becomes Thunder. Until the end of your next turn, you gain a Fly Speed of 120 feet, Hover, Resistance to lightning and thunder damage, and Advantage on Dexterity saving throws. The first time you hit each turn with a Lightning attack, it deals additional lightning damage equal to 4d8.
The Command Arrives Too Late. Hostile creatures of your choice in the area that are issuing commands, maintaining Concentration, controlling formations, directing summons, or sustaining technique-states make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, they cannot take Reactions, issue audible commands, or grant allies Advantage until the end of their next turn. On a success, they cannot take Reactions until the start of their next turn.
The Sky Writes the Shortest Path. You may move up to 1 mile to a location you can see, a Charged target you can perceive, or a Conductive path you have marked within the last minute. This movement does not provoke Opportunity Attacks. It cannot enter sealed spaces protected by superior authority without an opposed check.
The Thunder Speaks After. After all other decrees resolve, creatures of your choice within 120 feet of any target damaged by this inheritance make a Constitution saving throw. On a failure, a creature is Deafened and Frightened of you until the end of its next turn. On a success, it is Deafened until the start of its next turn.
Limits: When Potential Becomes Judgment does not permanently change weather, erase mountains, shut down ancient city arrays by default, kill breathless creatures automatically, bypass immunity, or defeat stronger domain-scale authority without an opposed Cultivation Check.

• Immunity to Fire, Poison, and Psychic damage.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP
Create a volcanic construct from molten stone.
Only one Lava Beast created by you may exist at a time.
Lava Beast statistics:
• AC: 14 + your Proficiency Bonus;
• HP: 7 × your CL;
• Speed: 30 feet;
• Size: Large;
• Immunity: Fire, Poison, Psychic;
• Resistance: nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing.
Molten Slam:
• Attack: your Magma Cultivation Attack Modifier;
• Reach: 10 feet;
• Damage: 2d10 + your key ability modifier Fire or Bludgeoning damage.
Furnace Hide:
A creature that starts its turn Grappling the Lava Beast takes Fire damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Molten Trail:
The beast leaves Molten Terrain in spaces it moves through. The terrain lasts until the start of your next turn.
The beast acts immediately after your turn.
As a Bonus Action, command it to Attack, Dash, Dodge, Grapple, Help, or Shove.
Without a command, it Dodges.

Make a Magma Cultivation Attack against AC or a GM-set DC.

talents.full_description:
“The mountain opened. The world beneath the world rose to answer.”
Classification: Secret Magma Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Volcano-Sovereign Incarnation, hidden primordial-magma scripture
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 150 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Flood the area with impossible volcanic force.
The area becomes a sea of molten stone, furnace pressure, volcanic ash, and rising obsidian teeth.
When a creature enters for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature takes 8d10 Fire and 8d10 Bludgeoning damage, falls Prone, becomes Burning for 3d10 Fire damage until the end of its next turn, and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: The creature takes half damage, cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn, and suffers Heat Pressure until the start of its next turn.
A creature takes damage from Sea of Molten Heaven only once per turn.
Melting Pressure:
Structures, objects, vehicles, Barriers, and exposed Formation Anchors inside take triple damage from your Magma talents.
Your Magma talents ignore ordinary Fire Resistance, ordinary material hardness, and mundane heat shielding inside the area.
Volcanic Aftermath:
After the talent ends, the area becomes visibly altered and filled with difficult terrain, unstable volcanic debris, cooled lava, and Obsidian Terrain.
Sea of Molten Heaven does not automatically destroy:
• entire cities;
• divine structures;
• Secret Formations;
• world-scale terrain;
• legendary artifacts;
• Realm-defining geography.
It can, however, make those things bleed.

talents.exact_heading: ### White Tiger Seven-Slaughter Canon - Secret, White Tiger, Edge
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, White Tiger teacher, killing-edge scripture, execution hall inheritance, or comparable revelation
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You open the White Tiger killing star inside your Metal Qi. Your eyes, breath, weapon, nails, needles, or aura take on a pale cutting radiance. Until the state ends, your Metal talents become Seven-Slaughter expressions.
While the Canon is active, once on each of your turns when you hit a creature with a Metal talent, weapon attack carrying Metal Qi, or White Tiger Method talent, choose one slaughter sign:
- **No Mending Under the Star.** The target cannot regain HP or gain Temporary HP until the start of your next turn.
- **Cut the Coward Road.** The target cannot benefit from teleportation, phasing, burrowing, or invisibility to escape you until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Wisdom saving throw.
- **Open the Guard.** The next attack against the target before the start of your next turn gains a bonus to the attack roll equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
- **Sever the Command.** The target cannot grant allies Advantage, command a formation, or issue a battlefield order until the start of your next turn unless it succeeds on a Charisma saving throw.
- **Tiger Eats the Fear.** If the target is Bloodied, it makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, it is Frightened of you until the start of your next turn.
Once while the Canon is active, when you reduce a meaningful enemy to 0 HP or score a critical hit with a Metal talent, you may immediately regain CP equal to your Proficiency Bonus and end one Frightened or Charmed effect on yourself.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the first slaughter sign you choose each round may affect one additional creature within 30 feet that you damaged with a Metal talent this turn.
This Canon is not subtle. Orthodox witnesses recognize it as a temple-grade or execution-grade killing scripture.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, magnet mountain inheritance, imperial mine office, loadstone teacher, ore-heart jade slip, or comparable source
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Area: 30-foot-radius sphere centered on a point you can see
Duration: Until the end of your next turn
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You declare a loadstone court. Metal-bearing objects, weapons, armor, coins, nails, chains, gates, ore veins, and exposed metal tools in the area answer your direction for one brutal moment.
Choose up to a number of creatures or objects in the area equal to twice your Proficiency Bonus. A chosen creature must be wearing metal, carrying metal, made partly of metal, standing in ore-rich ground, struck by your Metal Qi this turn, or otherwise metal-bearing.
Each chosen creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
- pull the creature up to 30 feet toward the center;
- push the creature up to 30 feet away from the center;
- knock the creature Prone if it is Large or smaller;
- force it to drop one non-artifact metal object it is holding;
- pin it against a metal object, ore-rich surface, gate, chain, armor rack, or comparable anchor, reducing its Speed to 0 until the start of your next turn.
Successful Save: You may move the creature 5 feet, but it suffers no other effect.
Unattended non-artifact metal objects in the area can be moved up to 60 feet, gathered into a pile, slammed into a surface, opened, shut, barred, or scattered. This cannot open sealed treasures, defeat superior formations, or steal worn items from a creature that succeeded on its save.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the area becomes a 60-foot-radius sphere, and one failed-save creature of your choice also takes bludgeoning or piercing damage equal to **4d8 + your Metal key ability modifier**.

talents.exact_heading: ### Bell-Monastery Listening Sutra - Secret, Bell, Resonance
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, bell monastery, resonance teacher, ancestral bell, formation-auditor office, or comparable inheritance
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: split_required
Split Candidate Buckets: action, reaction
Timing Detail: Action or Reaction
Factory Routing: split_modes_before_character_action_programming
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=ACTION_LISTENING_SUTRA->action, REACTION_LISTENING_SUTRA->reaction
Range: 120 feet
Target: One creature, object, barrier, construct, formation node, armor, weapon, gate, bell, chain, talisman frame, or metal-bearing technique you can perceive
Cost: 2 CP
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You strike a soundless bell in your Metal Qi and make the target confess its flaw.
If used as an Action, make a Metal Check against the target's AC, save DC, formation DC, creator's Cultivation Save DC, or a GM-set DC.
Success: Learn the target's most useful structural weakness, then choose one:
- the next attack against it before the end of your next turn has Advantage;
- reduce its AC by 2 until the start of your next turn;
- suppress one non-Secret metal, armor, ward, lock, talisman frame, construct joint, or formation-node benefit until the start of your next turn;
- cause a visible crack, ring, or flaw-sign that allows allies to ignore half cover from the target until the start of your next turn.
Success by 5 or More: Choose two effects instead of one.
If used as a Reaction, the trigger is a visible metal-bearing attack, ward, construct action, formation pulse, talisman frame, armor technique, or weapon technique within range. On a successful Metal Check, impose Disadvantage on the triggering roll, or reduce its damage, damage reduction, shield value, or movement by your Cultivation Level.
At Nascent Soul Realm, if the target is non-Secret and lower Realm than you, success by 5 or more may suppress it until the end of your next turn instead.
This Sutra is perception and resonance, not broad Sound sphere control.

talents.exact_heading: ### Indestructible Iron Marrow Sutra - Secret, Iron-Body
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Body Refining Path or Iron-Body Method, iron-marrow teacher, ancestral body scripture, or comparable inheritance
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You turn bone, marrow, teeth, nails, blood-iron, and meridian walls into a single iron scripture.
For the duration:
- gain Temporary HP equal to **twice your Cultivation Level**;
- gain Resistance to non-Secret Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage;
- you cannot be moved against your will while conscious unless the moving effect wins an opposed check against your Metal Check;
- once per round when damage would reduce you to 0 HP, you may make a Constitution saving throw against your own Metal Save DC. On a success, you drop to 1 HP instead and the Sutra ends.
While the Sutra is active, your Speed is reduced by 10 feet, and you have Disadvantage on Dexterity checks that require subtle movement.
At Nascent Soul Realm, the first time the Sutra prevents you from dropping to 0 HP, metal thorns burst outward. Hostile creatures of your choice within 10 feet take piercing damage equal to **3d8 + your Constitution modifier**.
This Sutra is powerful, obvious, and body-changing. When it ends, your joints ring like cooling iron until you finish a short rest.

talents.exact_heading: ### Ten-Thousand-Metal Sovereign Edict - Secret, Metal Sovereign
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, at least three Metal Methods, and access to a sovereign metal scripture, White Tiger mandate, immortal mine-heart, ancestral bell, imperial armory seal, or comparable revelation
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 1-mile-radius region centered on you
Duration: Instantaneous, with aftermath until the end of your next turn
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You declare that every piece of metal in the region remembers Heaven's command. The edict can act only through metal-bearing creatures, metal objects, weapons, armor, ore-rich terrain, mineralized structures, formation metal, ringing bells, battlefield armaments, or targets carrying your Metal Qi. This keeps the inheritance comparable in scale to heavenly lightning decrees while preserving Metal's boundary: it rules what bears metal, not everything under the sky.
Choose up to three decrees:
**All Weapons Bow.** Hostile creatures of your choice in the region that are holding metal weapons, wearing metal armor, carrying metal tools, made partly of metal, standing in ore-rich ground, or directly connected to battlefield metal make a Strength saving throw. On a failure, a creature is pulled 30 feet, pushed 30 feet, knocked Prone, or forced to drop one non-artifact metal object, your choice. On a success, it is moved 5 feet or keeps its grip, your choice.
**The Edge Finds the Gap.** Choose up to twice your Proficiency Bonus metal-bearing creatures, armored creatures, weapon-bearing creatures, constructs, or creatures carrying your Metal Qi that you can perceive in the region. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw. On a failure, it takes **8d8 slashing or piercing damage** and cannot regain HP until the end of its next turn. On a success, it takes half damage and can regain HP normally.
**The Bell Names the Flaw.** Choose one visible or spiritually perceived non-Secret ward, barrier, armor technique, formation node, talisman frame, construct, gate, chain, seal, armory defense, or metal-bearing technique in the region. Make a Metal Check against its DC. On a success, suppress it until the end of your next turn. On a failure, reduce one of its major numerical benefits by your Cultivation Level until the end of your next turn and learn one of its protection rules.
**The Ore Remembers the Mountain.** Choose a point on metal-bearing ground, stone with ore, a mine, a forge floor, a battlefield covered with weapons, an armory, a city gate, or comparable terrain. Until the end of your next turn, the ground in a 60-foot radius becomes difficult terrain for hostile creatures, and the first time each hostile creature moves more than 10 feet through it, it takes piercing damage equal to your Cultivation Level.
**The Tiger Passes Judgment.** Hostile creatures of your choice in the region that are Bloodied, Frightened, carrying your Metal Qi, holding a weapon, wearing armor, standing among battlefield metal, or maintaining a violent technique make a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, a creature cannot take Reactions, cannot benefit from Invisibility against you, and has Disadvantage on its next attack roll before the end of its next turn. On a success, it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
**The Body Becomes a Bell of Iron.** Until the end of your next turn, you gain Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, Slashing, Lightning, and Thunder damage; cannot be forcibly moved unless the enemy wins an opposed check against your Metal Check; and your first Metal talent hit each turn deals additional damage equal to **4d8**.
Limits: Ten-Thousand-Metal Sovereign Edict does not permanently steal weapons, destroy artifacts, erase mountains, shut down ancient city arrays by default, bypass immunity, command nonmetal creatures without a metal-bearing condition, or defeat stronger domain-scale authority without an opposed Cultivation Check.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 7+
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: You take damage, fail a Dexterity saving throw, or become Grappled or Restrained
Cost: 4 Stamina or 4 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
Chain Role: Reversal
Move up to half your Speed without provoking opportunity attacks.
You may move through hostile spaces and across vertical surfaces during this movement.
If this movement places you outside the triggering effect’s area or reach, choose the appropriate result:
avoid the triggering attack’s damage;
avoid the triggering area effect’s damage;
escape the Grappled or Restrained condition if the condition depended on the original reach, grasp, net, or restraint position.
You leave behind a harmless decoy such as a cloak, shoe, stolen fruit, puff of dust, discarded staff, or laughing afterimage.
If this movement changes elevation, moves through a hostile space, or uses a prop or handhold, create a Monkey Link that lasts until the end of your next turn.
The GM may rule that restraints physically locked to you, magical bindings, or sealed Barriers require an additional check or cannot be escaped with movement alone.

talents.full_description:
“Why remain one thing when the world contains so many useful shapes?”
Classification: Secret Monkey Style Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Great Sage Equal to Heaven, hidden transformation scripture
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 hour
Cost: 10 Stamina or 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Chain Role: Transformation, Engine
Transform into one ordinary or supernatural beast form you have studied.
Choose one form template.
Tiny Scout: Tiny size, Speed 30 feet, Climb 30 feet, Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth).
Swift Beast: Speed 60 feet, Advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics).
Climbing Beast: Climb Speed 50 feet, Advantage on Strength (Athletics).
Aquatic Beast: Swim Speed 60 feet and can breathe underwater.
Flying Beast: Fly Speed 50 feet. You do not gain Hover unless the studied form has Hover and the GM permits it.
Powerful Beast: Large size, Advantage on Strength checks, natural weapon 1d12.
Armored Beast: +3 AC, Speed reduced by 10 feet.
Burrowing Beast: Burrow Speed 30 feet through ordinary soil, sand, loose earth, or similar material.
You retain:
HP;
Stamina or CP;
mental ability scores;
cultivation talents;
personality;
Path features.
You gain only the listed template benefits.
You do not copy:
full monster stat blocks;
Legendary actions;
Lair actions;
Innate Spellcasting;
entire creature abilities;
unique boss traits;
Secret Inheritances.
Your transformation remains visibly unusual under close spiritual inspection.
While transformed, any template movement that changes elevation, slips through a hostile space, climbs, flies, swims, burrows, or uses beast agility may create a Monkey Link once per turn.

talents.exact_heading: #### Symphony of Heaven and Earth - Domain, Chord
talents.full_description:
“The mountain hums. The river keeps time. The battlefield becomes an instrument.”
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 60-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: 1 minuteConcentration: Not required
Cost: 15 CP, 15 Stamina, or expend Martial Focus and 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose two movements when activating the Symphony.
Movement of War
Allies inside gain:
+2 to weapon attack rolls;
+10 feet Speed;
Advantage on saving throws against Frightened.
Movement of Mercy
At the end of each of your turns, choose up to your Proficiency Bonus allies inside.
Each regains 2d8 + your Music key ability modifier HP.
A creature can receive this healing only once during the Symphony.
Movement of Ruin
When an enemy starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 4d8 Thunder or Psychic damage.
Successful Save: Take half damage.
Movement of Silence
Enemies inside:
cannot take Reactions;
have Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws;
cannot benefit from audible command effects.
Movement of Courage
Allies inside are immune to Charmed and Frightened.
You may change one selected movement as a Bonus Action.

talents.full_description:
the Forgotten Name
“The note was so pure that, for one breath, the world forgot what the enemy was called.”
Classification: Secret Music Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Symphony of Heaven and Earth, hidden musical inheritance
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 90 feet
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one creature that can hear or spiritually perceive you.
The target makes a Wisdom or Charisma saving throw, chosen by the GM according to the connection being targeted.
Failed Save: Choose one narrow identity-linked connection.
Examples include:
recognition by one group;
ability to issue commands to one bonded creature;
benefit from one named title or authority;
access to one named transformation;
use of one named technique;
control of one summoned creature;
one specific oath-linked benefit;
one musical, spiritual, or voice-based identity mark.
The chosen connection is suppressed for 1 hour.
Successful Save: The connection is suppressed until the start of your next turn.
Song of the Forgotten Name does not erase the target’s entire identity, memories, ancestry, cultivation base, character sheet, or existence. It suppresses one named connection that can be meaningfully sung out of tune.

A creature that does not need to breathe or lacks a comparable vulnerable organ is immune to Bleed Air.

talents.full_description:
A Serious Ingrained Toxin has stages. At the end of each long rest, the target makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Success: The poison stage decreases by 1. If it would decrease below Stage 1, the poison ends.
Failure: The poison stage increases by 1, to a maximum of Stage 4.
A creature cannot suffer more than one Serious Ingrained Toxin at a time.
Stage 1 - Bitter Channels. The target has Disadvantage on the first Cultivation Check it makes each day, and cannot reduce CP costs below their printed values.
Stage 2 - Numb Meridian Flow. The target’s maximum CP is reduced by your Proficiency Bonus, and it has Disadvantage on concentration saving throws. This maximum CP reduction ends when the poison ends.
Stage 3 - Foundation Corrosion. The target’s Hit Point maximum is reduced by your Cultivation Level, and the target regains only half as much CP from short-rest or scene-based recovery. This maximum Hit Point reduction ends when the poison ends.
Stage 4 - Life-Gate Closing. The target cannot regain CP above half its maximum CP, cannot gain Temporary HP, and has Disadvantage on death saving throws. If the target fails three daily saves while at Stage 4, it dies unless the GM decides the poison instead triggers a major cultivation injury, coma, sealed meridians, or story crisis.

At the end of every 10 days, the target repeats the saving throw. On a success, the Dao Venom becomes dormant for 10 days. On a second consecutive success, the Dao Venom ends. On a failure, it remains active.
Thousand-Day Dao Venom is not a casual combat technique. It should require story, materials, access, investigation, social risk, antidote counterplay, and GM oversight.
It should not permanently destroy a player character’s cultivation unless the table explicitly wants that story.

talents.full_description:
“The immortal prepared ten thousand answers. The master touched the silence before the first one began.”
Classification: Secret Pressure Points Inheritance
Prerequisite: Sovereign Nine-Gate Hand, CL 17+, hidden meridian scripture or personal enlightenment
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 90 feet
Cost: Expend Martial Focus and 6 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one creature you can perceive. A single impossible point appears in its body, spirit, technique, shadow, or fate-like rhythm for one breath.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw. If the target lacks ordinary anatomy but has a readable spiritual, mechanical, elemental, or conceptual structure, it makes a Wisdom saving throw instead.
Failed Save
The target is sealed until the end of its next turn.
While sealed this way:
it is Incapacitated;
its Speed is 0;
it cannot speak clearly or provide Verbal components;
it loses Concentration;
ongoing non-Secret body-enhancing, movement-enhancing, and technique-channeling effects on it are suppressed;
it cannot take Reactions, Bonus Actions, Legendary Actions, or similar extra actions;
the next attack roll made against it before the seal ends has Advantage and deals an extra 6d10 Force or Psychic damage on a hit.
Successful Save
The target is partially sealed until the start of your next turn.
While partially sealed this way:
it cannot take Reactions;
its Speed is halved;
it has Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws;
the next attack roll made against it before the partial seal ends has Advantage.
Limits
The Point Between Heartbeats cannot permanently disable a creature, erase a Path, remove a Realm, destroy a soul, suppress a Secret Inheritance automatically, or rewrite destiny.
A creature of superior Realm, divine office, or narrative-scale authority may convert the failed-save result into the successful-save result by winning an opposed Cultivation Check, at the GM’s discretion.

talents.full_description:
Attempts to conceal, disguise, or obfuscate creatures inside the Ward are hindered.
When the Ward appears, make one Cultivation Check against each:
illusion;
concealment effect;
magical disguise;
magical item creating those effects. Successful Check: Suppress that effect while it remains inside the Ward.
Failed Check: The effect continues normally.
A creature attempting to activate an illusion, concealment effect, or disguise inside the Ward must succeed on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC.
A creature inside also makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: It cannot activate ordinary abilities that disguise or conceal itself while it remains inside.
Successful Save: It may use nonmagical concealment normally, but supernatural concealment still faces the Cultivation Check.

talents.full_description:
Aegis
A creature attempting a violent action or offensive supernatural effect against the bearer makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The action fails. Any CP or limited-use resource spent is lost.
Successful Save: The Peacebound Aegis ends immediately.
If the bearer takes an offensive action, the Aegis ends immediately.
Ward
A creature attempting a violent action or offensive supernatural effect while inside the Ward makes a Wisdom saving throw.
Failed Save: The action fails. Any CP or limited-use resource spent is lost.
Successful Save: The Peacebound Ward ends for all creatures.
When a creature breaks your Peacebound Ward in this way, creatures inside become immune to your Peacebound Ward until the next dawn.

talents.full_description:
“When the formation shattered, the mountain burned, and every oath failed, the wall remained because one cultivator had not yet agreed to let the people behind it die.”
Classification: Secret Protection Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Barrier Ward, Buttress, Bulwark, hidden guardian inheritance
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: One of the following:
you or an ally benefiting from your Aegis would drop to 0 HP;
a Barrier Ward you created would be destroyed;
a creature inside one of your Wards would fail a saving throw against an effect that would incapacitate it.
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one:
The protected creature drops to 1 HP instead of 0 HP.
The Barrier remains at 1 HP and negates overflow damage from the triggering effect.
The protected creature succeeds on the triggering saving throw.
Sacrifice one Aegis on the protected creature without requiring it to be Persistent and activate one Succor talent you know.
Immediately create Barrier Ward centered on the protected creature without spending an Action or CP. Until the end of your next turn:
your Barrier Wards cannot be shoved or overrun;
Buttress restores maximum possible HP;
creatures benefiting from your Aegises gain Resistance to all damage;
your Wards cannot be made permanent or converted into Formation infrastructure through this effect.

talents.exact_heading: ### The Body That Heaven Forgot Was Mine
talents.full_description:
“Cut the hands. Burn the doll. Break the stage. The thread was never between the puppet and the master. It was between motion and the world.”
Classification: Secret Puppetry Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Thousand-Puppet Incarnation, hidden marionette scripture, GM approval
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: You or one active puppet vessel within 120 feet is targeted by an attack, harmful effect, Domain, Realm Evolution, or Secret Inheritance
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Before the triggering effect resolves, designate one of the following as the True Body until the end of the current turn:
yourself;
one active puppet vessel;
one prepared puppet vessel within 120 feet;
one valid vessel destroyed since the end of your last turn.
The triggering effect treats the True Body as the primary target if it is a legal target.
If it is not a legal target, choose one:
the triggering attack has Disadvantage, or you gain Advantage on the triggering saving throw;
reduce the triggering damage by 10d10;
move yourself and up to three active puppet vessels to legal spaces within 30 feet of their current positions;
apply Tension Marks to up to five hostile creatures you can see within 120 feet.
After the triggering effect resolves, every active puppet vessel you control may immediately move up to its Speed and make one Puppet Strike, dividing attacks among legal targets as you choose.
Then all Tension Marks you control end.
If the GM determines the inheritance was used to deny a karmic, oathbound, or tribulation consequence without paying any substitute price, the inheritance may create a new debt instead of erasing the old one.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Qi Bond Package, CL 5+
Your Qi Bond may target an Active Qi Pattern directly even when you cannot target the creature bearing it, provided you can perceive the pattern and it is not behind Total Cover.
While bonded to an Active Qi Pattern, you may apply Bond talents to the pattern rather than to a creature.
Examples:
Read Current identifies the pattern’s sphere resonance and Pattern Rank category.
Throttle Current increases the CP cost of the next attempt to sustain or extend the pattern.
Draw Current can drain 1 CP from a maintained pattern if it has stored CP or a sustaining creator.
The GM determines which Bond talents make sense for a non-creature pattern.

talents.exact_heading: #### Court of Ten Thousand Currents - Domain
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 4 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You establish a Domain in which active Qi patterns become visible as braided currents.
While the Domain lasts:
you know the location of Active Qi Patterns inside the Domain that are not behind Total Cover;
you have Advantage on Qiweaving Checks made against patterns inside the Domain;
your Unweave Pattern and Qi Bond range extends to any valid target inside the Domain;
once during each of your turns, you may apply one Modulation talent you know to a technique you activate without paying that Modulation’s additional CP cost, unless the talent’s cost is 3 CP or higher;
when a willing creature inside the Domain activates a sphere technique, you may use your Reaction to grant it a +1 bonus to its Cultivation Save DC for that activation;
when a hostile creature inside the Domain activates a sphere technique that costs CP, you may use your Reaction to force it to pay 1 additional CP or make a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, the technique is visibly distorted, and creatures have Advantage on the first saving throw they make against it before the end of the turn.
A creature can be affected by only one cost increase from this Domain per turn.
Court of Ten Thousand Currents is a Domain. Ordinary dispelling, sundering, or object-breaking text does not automatically remove it unless the technique explicitly affects Domains.

#### Reversible Pattern
Prerequisite: Modulation Package, CL 10+
Cost: +2 CP
When you activate a sphere technique with a duration of at least 1 minute, inscribe a reversible pattern into it.
Once before the technique ends, you may use a Bonus Action to reverse one non-damaging directional choice made when the technique was created.
Examples include:
reverse the direction a rotating field moves;
change which side of a line-shaped effect is safe;
swap the inward or outward pressure of an area;
reverse a permitted push into a pull if the original technique could plausibly support it.
Reversible Pattern cannot change targets, change damage into healing, alter a saving throw type, or rewrite a technique’s basic identity.

talents.exact_heading: #### Return the Ten Thousand Currents to One Breath
talents.full_description:
Classification: Secret Qiweaving Inheritance
Prerequisite: Sovereign Qiweaver Incarnation, CL 17+, hidden Qiweaving scripture or equivalent sect transmission
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You name the first current beneath the battlefield. For one breath, every active technique inside the area remembers that it is only borrowed Qi.
Choose any number of Active Qi Patterns inside the area that you can perceive.
Make one Qiweaving Check with Advantage.
Compare the result to each chosen pattern’s DC.
Success Against a Mortal, Foundation, or Core Pattern
The pattern ends.
Success Against a Nascent Soul Pattern or Domain
The pattern is suppressed until the end of your next turn.
If the pattern’s text allows it to be ended by superior unweaving, it ends instead.
Success Against a Secret Inheritance, artifact, Formation project, or campaign-scale working
The pattern is not ended.
Choose one:
suppress one non-central function until the start of your next turn;
reveal one structural weakness, anchor, cost, or condition required to challenge it;
prevent it from expanding, moving, or being reinforced until the start of your next turn;
shield a number of creatures up to your Proficiency Bonus from one immediate expression of it.
Failure Against a Pattern
The pattern is exposed until the start of your next turn.
Attacks and Qiweaving Checks against exposed patterns have Advantage, and creatures have Advantage on saving throws against exposed hostile patterns.
Aftermath
After resolving the inheritance, choose a number of willing creatures inside the area up to your Key Ability modifier, minimum 1.
Each chosen creature regains 1 CP or gains 1 Temporary CP if it is already at maximum CP.
Then you lose access to Sovereign Qiweaver Incarnation until you finish a long rest.
Return the Ten Thousand Currents to One Breath cannot permanently remove a Path, Realm, bloodline, soul, artifact, sect Formation, or destiny. It can reveal how such things are being sustained and create a moment in which they may be challenged.

Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Cost: 3 CP
Touch one willing creature and choose one:
end Poisoned;
remove one ordinary disease;
end Charmed or Frightened;
suppress one curse for 1 hour;
cleanse ordinary spiritual contamination;
allow the target to immediately repeat a saving throw against possession or corruption with Advantage.
A stronger curse, disease, possession, or spiritual contamination may require a Cultivation Check against the creator’s Save DC or an appropriate DC set by the GM.
Burning Purification
Instead of cleansing a willing creature, make a melee Cultivation Attack against one Unclean creature within reach.
Hit: Deal 4d8 Radiant damage. The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls until the start of your next turn.
At CL 11, increase the damage to 6d8.
At CL 17, increase the damage to 8d8.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Purifying Radiance, CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Touch
Cost: 4 CP
Touch one creature affected by possession, spiritual contamination, curse pressure, or an attached unclean entity.
Make a Cultivation Check against the effect’s Save DC or a DC set by the GM.
Success: Suppress one visible possession, corruption, or curse-derived temporary benefit until the end of your next turn. If the effect is ordinary for the target’s Realm, also grant the host Advantage on its next saving throw to resist or end that effect.
Failure: The target becomes Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn, but the effect is not suppressed.
Radiant Exorcism Palm does not automatically end a major possession, remove a bloodline curse, or destroy a bound spirit.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 30 feet
Cost: 1 CP
Step through a line of dawnlight to an unoccupied space you can see.
The origin or destination must be in Bright Light, bear your Glow, or be adjacent to a creature or object bearing your Dawnmark.
This movement:
does not provoke Opportunity Attacks;
does not pass through solid objects;
cannot cross a sealed Barrier or Dimensional Lock;
leaves a visible streak of radiance until the start of your next turn.
Dawn Step is short spiritual movement, not the high-speed optical movement of the Light sphere.

Consecrated Boundary is not a physical Barrier and does not block movement by ordinary creatures.

Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Area: 20-foot-radius, 20-foot-high cylinder
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP
Create a gate of vertical dawnlight.
Choose one creature type, force, or condition when creating the Ward, such as undead, demons, possession entities, creatures bearing a specific corruption, or creatures currently maintaining magical Darkness.
A creature matching the chosen category that attempts to enter or leave the area must make a Charisma saving throw.

Successful Save: It may move normally, but it cannot benefit from ordinary Invisible or visual concealment until the start of your next turn.
Dawn Gate Ward is not a complete prison. It does not block teleportation, planar travel, ethereal movement, or superior movement techniques unless a Forged Technique or higher-Realm feature says otherwise.

talents.full_description:
“The night did not end. It was simply made too honest to continue.”
Prerequisite: CL 15+, Solar Radiance Form
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute Concentration: Not required
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Transform into an incarnation of sovereign dawn.
For the duration:
gain Fly Speed 60 feet and Hover;
gain Immunity to Radiant damage;
gain Resistance to Necrotic, Fire, and Psychic damage;
shed Bright Light in a 120-foot radius and Dim Light for another 120 feet;
suppress non-Legendary magical Darkness, ordinary illusion concealment, ordinary invisibility, and ordinary fear auras inside your Bright Light;
Radiance Strike deals 8d10 Radiant damage instead of its normal damage;
once per turn when Radiance Strike hits an Unclean target, suppress one visible corruption-derived temporary benefit until the start of your next turn.
Solar Aura
When a hostile creature starts its turn within 20 feet of you, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 4d10 Radiant damage and become Blinded until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
A creature is affected by Solar Aura only once per turn.
Dawn Wave
While Heavenly Radiance is active, when you use Radiance Strike, you may instead release one of the following:
a single-target beam with a range of 120 feet;
a 60-foot line, 10 feet wide;
a 30-foot cone.
The line and cone require Dexterity saving throws for half damage instead of attack rolls. Creatures that fail are Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn.
When the transformation ends, gain 1 level of Exhaustion unless you ended the encounter with at least half your maximum CP remaining.

talents.full_exact_source_text:
##### World of Revealed Morning
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 12 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Fill the area with overwhelming revealed morning.
Inside the area, allies you designate gain:
Resistance to Necrotic and Radiant damage;
Advantage on checks made to detect hidden creatures, possession, curses, and spiritual contamination;
Advantage on saving throws against Charmed, Frightened, possession, and corruption;
immunity to ordinary Blinded effects caused by light or darkness;
the ability to ignore ordinary Darkness and ordinary visual concealment.
Hostile creatures inside suffer:
ordinary Invisible fails;
ordinary illusions and disguises visibly shimmer;
ordinary Darkness disappears;
corruption marks, undead residue, possession anchors, and fresh spiritual stains become visible;
Unclean creatures cannot regain HP and cannot gain Temporary HP.
When a hostile creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or starts its turn inside, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Take 4d8 Radiant damage and become Blinded until the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn.
A creature takes this damage only once per turn.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 15+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Choose one creature you can see that is possessed, spiritually contaminated, or serving as an anchor for an Unclean force.
Make a Cultivation Check against the possessing or corrupting effect’s Save DC. If the effect has no Save DC, use the responsible creature’s Save DC or a DC set by the GM.
Success: Suppress the possession or corruption until the end of your next turn. During that time, the host may immediately repeat one saving throw or contested check to end or weaken the effect with Advantage. If the effect is ordinary for its Realm, it ends instead.
Failure: The effect is not suppressed, but the host gains Advantage on its next saving throw against it before the end of your next turn.
If the possessing or corrupting entity is present within 60 feet, it becomes Dawnmarked until the end of your next turn and takes 6d8 Radiant damage.
Sever the Possessing Shadow does not automatically destroy a soul, kill a host, erase a campaign-defining curse, or override a Secret Inheritance.

talents.full_description:

Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction

Trigger: A willing creature within 60 feet would drop to 0 HP due to damage from an Unclean creature, Necrotic damage, a curse, possession, or corruption

Use Limit: Once per long rest
A dawn breath catches the creature at the edge of collapse.
The creature drops to 1 HP instead of 0 HP.

suppress one possession or corruption effect on the creature until the start of your next turn;
move the creature up to 20 feet to an unoccupied space you can see without provoking Opportunity Attacks;
deal 4d8 Radiant damage to the triggering creature if it is within 60 feet and not behind Total Cover.
Resurrection of the Morning Breath is not full resurrection and cannot restore a dead creature.

talents.display_name: Answer Before the Question Is Spoken
talents.exact_heading: ### Answer Before the Question Is Spoken
talents.full_description:
“The strike did not interrupt the technique. For one breath, cause and answer simply arrived in the wrong order.”
Classification: Secret Retribution Inheritance
Prerequisites: Court of the Awaiting Blade, Spell Breaker, CL 17+
Use Limit: Once per long rest
When a creature you can perceive within 60 feet begins an Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, or willing movement, invoke this inheritance before the triggering activity resolves.
Move up to your Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
This movement may cross liquids and vertical surfaces without falling until the movement ends, but it cannot pass through occupied spaces, Total Cover, sealed barriers, or impossible routes.
If you end within reach of the triggering creature, make one melee weapon attack or Unarmed Strike against it.
This attack counts as a Counterstrike and may apply one Counter talent.
Hit: Deal normal Counterstrike damage. The target then makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: The triggering activity fails before it resolves. Any Action, Bonus Action, Reaction, spell slot, CP cost, item charge, or other committed resource is lost. If the trigger was movement, the movement ends immediately.
Successful Save: The triggering activity continues normally after the attack resolves.
Answer Before the Question Is Spoken may interrupt an activity that would not ordinarily be a legal Counterstrike trigger.
It cannot prevent an effect that has already resolved.

talents.full_description:
Secret Saber Manuals are rare battlefield lineages, executioner records, cavalry scriptures, frontier army inheritances, bandit-king scars, or named-blade teachings. They are powerful, but Sabers is not intended to have Lightning-style regional sovereignty by default.
Manual of the Red Gate Charge - Secret, Battleline
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Sabers sphere, battlefield dao inheritance or military teacher
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Cost: 3 CP
Move up to your Speed in a straight or gently curving line. During this movement, you may pass through spaces occupied by hostile creatures, but you cannot end there.
Choose up to three creatures whose spaces you passed through or moved adjacent to. Each makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: 4d8 slashing damage and knocked Prone if Large or smaller.
Successful Save: Half damage and not Prone.
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest.
At Core Formation Realm, the damage increases to 6d8 and you may affect up to five creatures.
Execution Platform Sutra - Secret, Execution
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Execution Saber Method or executioner inheritance
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
For the duration, the first time each turn you hit a Guard Pressured, Restrained, Prone, Stunned, Incapacitated, or Bloodied creature with a Sabers talent, choose one:
- add 3d8 slashing damage;
- suppress one non-Secret reaction, parry, guard, or defensive stance until the end of the target’s next turn;
- force a Constitution saving throw; on failure, the target cannot regain HP or CP until the start of your next turn.
This sutra does not kill helpless targets automatically. It makes execution mechanically possible under combat rules.
Black Banner Cavalry Dao - Secret, Pursuit, Battleline
Prerequisite: Core Formation Realm, Cavalry Crescent Method or cavalry/frontier inheritance
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest.
For the duration, when you move at least 20 feet on your turn, your next Sabers hit before the end of that turn deals +2d8 slashing damage and pushes the target 10 feet on a failed Strength save.
Once during the duration, when a creature you damaged attempts to move farther away from you, you may use Red Trail Pursuit without spending your Reaction.
If you are mounted, your mount also ignores nonmagical difficult terrain created by crowds, mud, grass, shallow water, snow, or loose battlefield debris for the duration.
This manual does not grant Horse-Soul, mount intelligence, or warband command.
Tiger-Butcher Short Saber Manual - Secret, Cruel
Prerequisite: Foundation Realm, Duan Dao Close-Cut Method or butcher/assassin/sect-police short-saber teacher
When you hit a creature within 5 feet with a short saber, duan dao, or butterfly saber, you may spend 2 CP.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: It takes 3d8 slashing damage and suffers one Saber Wound.
Successful Save: It takes half damage and no Saber Wound.
If the target is larger than you, Guard Pressured, or grappled by you or an ally, it has Disadvantage on the save.
Use Limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest.

Your Sand techniques become openly supernatural.

You may use Gather Sand without an existing Sand Source by spending 1 CP, even on worked floors, stone, rooftops, ships, or other surfaces that contain mineral dust or can bear conjured sand.
