You may move one Sand Terrain square you control up to 20 feet when you use Gather Sand’s Bonus Action movement.
Your Sand Terrain can affect creatures with magical flight if grains can physically reach them, but it does not automatically ground them unless a talent says so.
Your Sand talents count as magical or cultivation effects for overcoming resistance to nonmagical damage.
Dune-Heart Sand still cannot pass through sealed Barriers, sealed containers, Total Cover without a route, or a creature’s intact body unless a talent says otherwise.

talents.exact_heading: #### Court of Ten Thousand Dunes - Domain
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 11+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP; once per short or long rest
You establish a domain of commanded sand, mirage heat, unstable dunes, and listening grains.
For the duration, the area around you becomes your Court. The Court moves with you.
Within the Court:
ground spaces of your choice become Shallow Sand Terrain when they enter the Court;
as a Bonus Action, you may change a number of Sand Terrain squares in the Court up to your Proficiency Bonus into Deep or Storming Sand Terrain until the start of your next turn;
hostile creatures treat all Sand Terrain in the Court as Difficult Terrain;
once on each of your turns, you may use Scouring Hand, Sand Drag, Dust Veil, or Dune Bank without spending an Action, Bonus Action, or Reaction;
you know the location of any creature touching Sand Terrain in the Court unless it is protected by a stronger concealment, Void effect, or superior stealth technique;
when a hostile creature falls Prone, becomes Buried, or fails a saving throw against your Sand talent in the Court, you may move one Sand Terrain square up to 20 feet.
The Court does not create solid walls, block teleportation, prevent flight by itself, or suppress other Domains automatically. If two Domains contest the same area, use the campaign’s Domain conflict rules or an opposed Cultivation Check.

talents.display_name: The Mountain Remembers It Is Dust
talents.exact_heading: #### The Mountain Remembers It Is Dust
talents.full_description:
Secret Sand Inheritance
Prerequisite: Sand-Sovereign Incarnation, CL 17+, discovery of a desert-ending scripture, burial of a mountain oath, or inheritance from an ancient dune sovereign
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 300 feet
Area: One battlefield feature, formation section, structure, army-line, massive creature, or 60-foot-radius terrain area
Duration: Instantaneous, then 1 minute
Cost: 8 CP; once per week
You speak the first erosion scripture: the law that every shape is temporary.
Choose one legal target within range. The target must be a battlefield-scale physical feature, a structure, a terrain zone, a formation section with physical anchors, a siege engine, a wall, a bridge, a gate, a vehicle, a mass of troops, or one Huge or larger creature touching a surface. Pure ideas, souls, memories, laws, oaths, and nonphysical effects are not legal targets unless the GM treats them as having a physical anchor.
Resolve one of the following modes.
Grind the Shape
A structure, wall, gate, bridge, siege engine, vehicle, or formation anchor section takes 12d10 Force damage. This damage represents supernatural erosion and ignores resistance to nonmagical damage. If this reduces the target to 0 Hit Points or overcomes its threshold, it collapses into Sand Terrain under your control.

talents.full_description:
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Target: One object revealed from your concealed preparations
Use Limit: Once per Short or Long Rest
Cost: None
Reveal one plausible Tiny mundane object that you prepared or acquired before the current scene and could reasonably have concealed on your person. You do not need to name the specific object before using this talent, but the object must have been reasonably available to you and must fit your established preparations, clothing, containers, and circumstances. The GM decides whether a proposed object is plausible.
Place the object in one of your free hands. If you have no free hand, place it in your space or in one accessible worn container you possess.
The revealed object is a real, ordinary object. It remains after being revealed until it is used, lost, destroyed, or discarded. Revealing it does not activate, Utilize, apply, throw, plant, or attack with it; any later use follows the object's normal rules and action economy.
The object cannot be magical, alchemical, poisonous, unusually valuable, an item that could not reasonably have been acquired before the scene, or a substitute for another sphere talent. It cannot be a complete tool kit, a costly consumable, or an object whose possession would bypass a meaningful security, scarcity, or story restriction.
Examples include chalk, a coin, one ordinary lockpick, a tiny mirror, a nail, a ceramic shard, a fishhook, a key blank, a small folding tool, or a short weighted cord.

When you succeed on Dirty Trick or Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus to steal the breath, cadence, or spiritual pressure by which its voice enters the world.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw against your Cultivation Save DC.
Failed Save: Until the end of its next turn:
it cannot speak clearly;
it cannot provide Verbal spell components;
it cannot activate an ability that explicitly requires intelligible speech;
it has Disadvantage on checks requiring speech.
Successful Save: It has Disadvantage on its next check requiring speech before the end of its next turn.
At CL 10+, on a failed save the effect lasts for up to 1 minute. At the end of each of its turns, the target repeats the saving throw, ending the effect on a success.
Steal Voice does not prevent every technique merely because the technique has a name or command phrase in its description. The technique must genuinely require speech.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
When you succeed on Steal against a creature, expend Martial Focus and name one skill proficiency the target possesses or that you reasonably believe it possesses.
For 1 minute:
the target loses proficiency in that skill;
gain proficiency in that skill;

A creature affected by your Steal Skill cannot be affected by it again until you finish a short or long rest.

Grand Switcheroo does not affect a technique with no accessible anchor or automatically overcome an artifact.

Prerequisite: CL 10+

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Empty-Sleeve Hand, CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
Choose a number of hostile creatures inside the area up to your Proficiency Bonus.
Each target makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one result for that creature:
steal one accessible held item;
move the creature up to 15 feet along the ground into legal spaces;
give it the Prone condition;
prevent it from taking Reactions until the end of your next turn;
apply Exploited Opening;
cause one ordinary accessible item it carries to fall into one legal space within 30 feet of you.
Successful Save: Apply Exploited Opening or move the creature 5 feet along the ground into one legal space.
Objects stolen or dropped through this talent appear in legal spaces of your choice inside the area.

#### HEAVEN’S TREASURY WAS NEVER LOCKED
“The sovereign checked their sword. Their sword remained. They checked their cultivation. Their cultivation remained. Only when they tried to act did they discover the thief had stolen the reason any of it mattered.”
Classification: Secret Scoundrel Inheritance
Prerequisite: Sovereign of Ten Thousand Empty Sleeves, CL 17+, hidden heaven-robbery scripture
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 90 feet
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per week
Choose one creature you can perceive.
Make a Scoundrel Check against its Cultivation Save DC. A superior defense may replace this with an opposed Cultivation Check.

talents.full_description:
You know how to turn repetitive work into recognized merit.
When you complete a Duty that involves ordinary labor, service, cleaning, farming, copying, cooking, carrying, sorting, or tending, regain one spent Merit Die.
You can regain a Merit Die this way once per Long Rest.
In addition, when you spend at least 1 hour helping with ordinary sect chores during downtime, you can secure food and safe lodging for yourself and up to five companions of equal or lower Standing for the next 24 hours.
This does not create food. It obtains a proper share from existing stores, kitchens, dormitories, hostels, or village households.

talents.full_description:
You read mission boards like weather signs.
When you inspect a task board, public notice, tithe list, duty roster, or mission writ for at least 1 minute, make a Sect Check.
On a success, ask the GM two questions:
Which task is safer than it looks?
Which task is more dangerous than it looks?
Which task is underpaid?
Which task is politically sensitive?
Which task has a hidden sponsor?
Which task matches my current Role or Duty?
Which task would improve my Standing fastest?
Which task is likely to require a sphere or talent we lack?
On a success by 5 or more, ask one additional question.
This talent does not reveal secret traps automatically, but it gives the GM a clear way to signal obvious institutional risk.

talents.full_description:
You understand the quiet backbone of sect life: who cooks, who harvests, who cleans, who carries water, who repairs tools, and who gets blamed when no one planned the work.
When you spend 10 minutes organizing ordinary labor for a farm, kitchen, dormitory, stable, laundry, medicine yard, or storehouse, choose a number of willing ordinary workers up to your Proficiency Bonus + Sect Stewardship key ability modifier.
For the next 4 hours, those workers have Advantage on checks made to perform the assigned ordinary labor safely and efficiently.
This does not magically grow crops, increase yields beyond what good labor could accomplish, or replace the Harvesting and Gathering sphere.

talents.full_description:
You know how to apologize without making the insult larger.
When a non-combat social scene worsens because of a minor etiquette mistake, missed honorific, late arrival, improper form, or accidental slight, you may spend one Merit Die and make a Sect Check.
On a success, reduce the immediate social consequence by one step. An offended person may still be annoyed, but they do not escalate the matter unless they already intended to do so.
This does not undo deliberate insults, crimes, betrayals, public humiliation, or loss of face caused by serious failure.

The team avoids combat and danger. If placed in combat, disaster, or lethal hazard, they flee, hide, surrender, or require rescue.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You can turn a lesson into usable cultivation structure.
When you attend or organize a public lecture for at least 1 hour, choose a topic: a Path, sphere, Realm principle, sect law, ethical rule, cultivation hazard, historical example, or practical duty.
A number of willing listeners up to your Proficiency Bonus + Sect Stewardship key ability modifier may benefit.
Before each listener’s next Long Rest, they may add one Merit Die to one of the following:
a Daily Cultivation Meditation check related to the topic;
a Study check to understand the topic;
an Insight check to apply the topic socially;
a check to avoid a known cultivation mistake described in the lecture.
A creature can benefit from only one Public Dao Lecture per Long Rest.
This does not grant automatic CXP. It helps the listener make better use of ordinary cultivation and study.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You know how to move a dispute from the courtyard to the arbitration bench.
When a non-combat dispute between sect members, workers, villagers, or guests is about to escalate into punishment, humiliation, expulsion, duel, or public scandal, spend one Merit Die and make a Sect Check.
On a success, the immediate escalation is delayed long enough for one formal hearing, apology, witness statement, elder review, or negotiated settlement.
This does not prove anyone innocent. It creates procedure.
A creature who wants violence for its own sake may ignore this talent, but doing so can create a social consequence if the institution values procedure.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+.
You can secure a place where people can breathe.
When you spend downtime in an institution where you have at least Outer Standing, you may spend one Merit Die to secure modest private or semi-private space for yourself and a small group for 24 hours.
The space may be a guest room, side courtyard, shed, classroom, empty shrine room, unused lecture alcove, medicine cot, or supervised cultivation room.
While using the space for rest, study, crafting, ordinary healing, or cultivation meditation, one creature may add your Merit Die to one relevant non-combat check.
This talent cannot create luxury, privacy against high-ranking inspection, or a room inside a forbidden area.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 15+.
You can read a sect as a living circulation system.
After spending at least one day reviewing reports, rosters, ledgers, petitions, stores, and mission outcomes for a large institution, spend one Merit Die and make a Sect Check.
On a success, learn the answer to three of the following:
Which hall is under-resourced?
Which duty is creating resentment?
Which mission category is consuming too many disciples?
Which storehouse is being quietly drained?
Which elder’s policy is failing in practice?
Which group is about to revolt, desert, or collapse?
Which ordinary workers are holding the sect together?
Which resource shortage will become a crisis next season?
Which branch is lying in its reports?
Which junior or clerk deserves promotion?
On a success by 5 or more, also identify one practical reform that would help without requiring combat.
This talent gives administrative truth, not automatic political power.

talents.display_name: COURT OF TEN THOUSAND TURNING FACES
talents.exact_heading: #### COURT OF TEN THOUSAND TURNING FACES - DOMAIN
talents.full_description:
“The enemy found an opening and struck. The opening turned sideways.”
Prerequisite: Projected Shield Face, CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per Short Rest
Establish a Court of orbiting Shield-Qi surfaces, reflected angles, shield shadows, and ancestral ramparts.
For the duration:
Projected Shield Face and Cover Ally may protect any ally inside the Court when you can perceive the incoming route.
Once per round, use Active Defense inside the Court without spending a Reaction or expending Martial Focus.
When you establish Flexible Cover, choose up to three different edges or connected 5-foot segments inside the Court. Each becomes a projected Shield Face until the start of your next turn.
When an attack misses because of your Active Defense, move one projected Shield Face up to 10 feet to another legal edge or connected segment inside the Court without spending an Action.
Allies of your choice inside the Court gain Half Cover against ranged attacks originating outside the Court.
When you use Redirecting Shield, the new target may be any legal target inside the Court that the redirected attack can reach after touching one of your projected Shield Faces.
The Court does not automatically:
create Total Cover;
stop teleportation;
block possession or gaze effects;
protect against effects originating inside a protected space;
become permanent Formation infrastructure;
redirect a narrative-scale calamity without a higher-Realm talent.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your Smoke Veil can preserve the immediate traces of violence.
When a creature drops to 0 HP or dies inside your Smoke Veil, you may spend 1 CP as a Reaction.
Until the end of your next long rest, the space where it fell retains a visible or spiritual Smoke Trace that records:
the direction from which the last harmful effect came;
whether the harm was weapon, spell, sphere, poison, disease, or environmental hazard;
whether Fire, Poison, Necrotic, Radiant, or Psychic damage was involved.
This does not identify the attacker by name unless another feature would.

talents.display_name: Smoke Domain: Court of Hidden Witnesses
talents.exact_heading: ### Smoke Domain: Court of Hidden Witnesses
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: Three connected 20-foot cubes within 120 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
You create a court of smoke that remembers every passage.
The area is Dense Smoke.
For the duration:
you may place one additional Smoke Trace each round;
your Smoke Traces inside the Domain last until the end of your next turn after they leave the Domain;
when a hostile creature starts its turn inside the Domain, you may place a Smoke Trace on it;
when you use Follow the Soot inside the Domain, the direction remains known for 1 minute;
once per round, you may use Blind the Line, Follow the Soot, or Slip the Chimney Path without spending the Smoke Trace.
The Domain does not create solid walls or true Cover.

talents.display_name: The Last Breath Hides the Empire
talents.exact_heading: ### The Last Breath Hides the Empire
talents.full_description:
“The palace burned for three days. No one agreed where the emperor went. The smoke remembered, but it did not testify.”
Classification: Secret Smoke Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Court of Hidden Witnesses, hidden smoke scripture
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: One creature you can see or hear within 120 feet declares an attack, harmful effect, Domain, Realm Evolution, Secret Inheritance, escape technique, or public accusation
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per week

talents.full_description:
You take careful aim at a weak point: head, eye, throat, heart-line, exposed joint, control gem, pressure valve, skull seam, or equivalent vulnerable structure.
When making a Head Shot, you cannot make additional attacks from the Extra Attack feature during the same Attack action.
If you would have been able to make additional attacks through Extra Attack, increase this attack’s damage by +1d8 for each additional attack you gave up.
Multiattack counts as Extra Attack for this purpose when converting a monster or NPC technique; only ranged attacks after the first count as additional attacks.
If this attack deals damage equal to at least half the creature’s current Hit Points, you may expend Martial Focus to force the target to make a Constitution saving throw.
On a failed save, choose one:
the target is Stunned until the end of your next turn;
the target falls Prone and cannot take Reactions until the end of your next turn;
if the target is a non-legendary creature whose current Hit Points after damage are no more than your Sniper level or CL plus your Proficiency Bonus, it drops to 0 Hit Points.
The GM may rule that creatures without discernible weak points, oozes, swarms, amorphous bodies, or beings with distributed anatomy are immune to the drop-to-0 option unless a higher-Realm talent applies.

talents.full_description:
Your attack pierces the target and can strike another creature in line behind it.
To use this talent, you must be able to trace a line from your space through the first target and into the second target’s space.
On a hit against the first target, make a secondary ranged attack against the second target. The secondary attack has Disadvantage and cannot extend beyond the weapon’s long range.
If the secondary attack hits and damages its target, the projectile may continue to a third target in the same line. Each additional attack has Disadvantage, and the GM may limit the number of targets based on weapon, ammunition, terrain, and creature size.
You cannot apply additional Snipe talents to secondary attacks unless another feature says so.

talents.exact_heading: #### Court of the Unerring Line - Domain
talents.full_description:
Prerequisites: Qi-Line Sight, CL 11+
“When the court is established, every exposed angle becomes testimony.”
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 120-foot Emanation from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
You establish a Court of the Unerring Line. Within the Court, your spirit marks trajectories, ricochet surfaces, exposed weak points, and careless movements.
For the duration:
You know whether each creature you can perceive inside the Court has Half Cover, Three-Quarters Cover, or Total Cover from your current position.
Once during each of your turns, you may make one Snipe Shot without applying the normal one-Snipe-talent limit to your Attack action. This does not grant an extra attack; it changes one attack you make.
You may apply two different Snipe talents to one Snipe Shot if at least one is a Line or Mark talent.
Your Bouncing Shot can turn up to three times, using total distance traveled.
When a hostile creature inside the Court makes a ranged attack, casts a ranged spell attack, or activates a line-based technique, you may use Intercepting Shot against it even if the attack is not a mundane projectile. If the attack is a spell attack or cultivation technique, you must expend Martial Focus or spend 1 CP.
When you reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with a Snipe Shot inside the Court, choose one other hostile creature that can see the shot. That creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.
The Court does not let you attack targets whose exact location is unknown, ignore sealed Total Cover, or shoot through a sealed Barrier unless another talent allows it.

On a failed save, the target drops the item as normal and also cannot activate abilities requiring that implement until it retrieves, replaces, or re-centers it.
On a successful save, the target keeps the item but cannot use Reactions and has Disadvantage on Concentration saving throws until the start of your next turn.
Artifacts, soul-bound items, and office-bearing regalia may require an opposed Cultivation Check or be immune until first weakened.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisites: Court of the Unerring Line, CL 15+
Your sight, breath, weapon, and projectile become parts of one hunting principle. Distance becomes a quantity you measure, not a protection the enemy owns.
Gain the following benefits while holding Martial Focus:
You can perceive your own Aimed Lines as visible, audible, or spiritual threads.
Your Snipe Shot range increases by 300 feet, and long range does not impose Disadvantage.
Once per round, when you miss with a Snipe Shot, you may move the projectile up to 30 feet after the miss and make a Scoot Shot against an unattended object, exposed mechanism, or fragile surface.
You may use Intercepting Shot against ranged spell attacks and ordinary projectile-like cultivation attacks without spending CP, though you still need a Reaction.
When a talent requires exact location, you may satisfy it through a spiritual Mark you created even if the target is currently unseen.
You may apply Sniper talents to ranged spell attacks if the spell attack is a single-target attack roll and you can describe a clear line of delivery.
This does not turn every spell into a projectile, does not affect saving-throw-only spells, and does not let you shoot unknown targets.

talents.exact_heading: #### The Arrow That Arrived Before the Bowstring
talents.full_description:
Secret Sniper Inheritance Prerequisites: Heaven-Hunting Eye, Phasic Shot, CL 17+, a hidden scripture of impossible trajectory
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 1 mile, or farther by story/project/formation at GM discretion
Target: One creature, object, formation anchor, vehicle weak point, siege engine, exposed spirit channel, or battlefield command focus whose exact location you know
Cost: Expend Martial Focus and spend 3 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You lower your breath until the world forgets you are about to act.
Then the shot arrives.
Make one ranged weapon attack or single-target ranged spell attack. This attack has the following properties:
it ignores normal and long range;
it has Advantage;
Deadly Aim applies;
it ignores Half Cover and Three-Quarters Cover;
it ignores Total Cover unless the target is inside a sealed Barrier, sealed vault, demiplane, divine refuge, artifact enclosure, or equivalent absolute protection;
it can pass through one non-absolute obstruction as though using Phasic Shot;
it can apply up to three Snipe talents you know;
it counts as magical, cultivation-enhanced, and spiritually significant.
On a hit, the attack deals normal damage plus 10d10 damage. Then choose three different Decisive Line effects:
Line Through the Heart: The target makes a Constitution saving throw. On a failed save, it drops to 0 Hit Points if its remaining Hit Points are equal to or less than half its maximum Hit Points.
Line Through the Hand: The target drops one held item, command implement, weapon, talisman, seal, or focus. If the item is protected, win an opposed Cultivation Check.
Line Through the Foot: The target’s Speed becomes 0 and it cannot teleport until the end of its next turn.
Line Through the Breath: The target cannot speak, chant, roar, provide verbal components, or use breath-keyed techniques until the end of its next turn.
Line Through the Eye: The target is Blinded until the end of its next turn, and invisibility or ordinary concealment does not protect it from you for 1 minute.
Line Through the Formation: Suppress one exposed formation anchor, ward node, barrier segment, domain focus, siege engine component, or command device until the end of your next turn.
Line Through the Technique: End one non-Secret ongoing effect on the target if its Pattern Rank or equivalent is not higher than your Proficiency Bonus; otherwise make an opposed Cultivation Check.
Line Through the Command: One order, command aura, battlefield signal, prepared reaction, or commanded servant sequence from the target fails or is delayed until the end of its next turn.
Line Through the Escape: If the target would move, teleport, or be carried away before the end of its next turn, you may use your Reaction to force it to make a Charisma saving throw. On a failure, the movement fails.
On a miss, the shot still finds a lesser line. Choose one Decisive Line effect other than Line Through the Heart, and apply it if the target fails the relevant saving throw or opposed check.
Limits: This inheritance cannot automatically kill a major villain, destroy an artifact, invalidate a whole fortress, erase a divine refuge, or ignore a superior Secret Inheritance. Against such targets, success may instead create the one opening needed for the party, project, sect, army, or next scene to exploit.

Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 10 minutes

Choose yourself or one willing creature within 30 feet.
For the duration:
the target has Advantage on Dexterity (Stealth) checks made to avoid sound detection;
the target’s armor, gear, breathing, and footfalls are muted;
ordinary loose stones, creaking boards, and dry leaves make less sound when disturbed by the target.
The talent does not make the target invisible, scentless, weightless, or undetectable by tremorsense.

Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Until the start of your next turn
Cost: 1 CP
Create a false sound-position in a space you can perceive. Until the echo ends, a creature relying on hearing to locate you or one willing ally of your choice must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw or treat the echo’s space as the source of the sound.
This can impose Disadvantage on one attack roll made before the start of your next turn if the attacker relies on hearing or sound to locate the target.
Echo Position does not fool sight, blindsight that is not sound-based, tremorsense, or true magical perception.

#### Carrying Bell - Instrument
You can prepare one small bell, chime, drum, singing bowl, tuning fork, throat bead, or resonant charm during a Long Rest.
While the object is on your person:
Carry Voice range doubles for targets familiar with the sound;
Read the Vibration gains Advantage when examining bells, instruments, doors, locks, walls, or hollow spaces;
once per short rest, use Resonant Note without sound audible beyond 30 feet.
If the object is broken or stolen, you lose these benefits until you prepare another.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Echo Position, CL 5+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 3 CP
Create a sound-body decoy in an unoccupied space.
The decoy produces footfalls, breathing, speech fragments, weapon sounds, and clothing rustle appropriate to one creature you choose.
A creature that uses its Action to examine the decoy may make an Intelligence (Investigation) or Wisdom (Perception) check against your Sound Save DC.
On a failure, the creature treats the decoy as a plausible creature for hearing-based targeting and may waste one attack, pursuit, or reaction against it.
The decoy has AC 10, 1 HP, and disappears when damaged, touched, or exposed by special senses not based on sound.

talents.exact_heading: #### Court of the World-Ringing Bell - Domain
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 9 CP
Establish a Sound Domain of bells, strings, thunder pressure, or silent resonance.
When you create the Domain, choose Ringing Court or Silent Court.
Ringing Court:
allies inside gain Resistance to Thunder damage;
allies inside may communicate in whispers across the Domain;
hostile creatures that start their turn inside make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: They take 4d8 Thunder damage and gain Resonance.
Successful Save: They gain Resonance.
Silent Court:
ordinary speech and loud sound cannot pass beyond the Domain boundary;
allies inside gain Advantage on saving throws against voice, command, and sound effects;
hostile creatures that start their turn inside make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: They cannot speak above a whisper until the start of their next turn.
Successful Save: No additional effect.
A creature can take damage from Court of the World-Ringing Bell only once per round.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Thousand-Pace Call, CL 15+
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: 10 minutes
Range: Regional
Cost: 8 CP
Send a cultivated message across a region up to 100 miles to a familiar creature, sect bell, shrine, domain gate, named mountain, city tower, or prepared echo anchor.
The message may be up to one minute of speech, music, bell-pattern, or warning tone.
This talent requires one of the following:
a prepared resonant anchor;
a known receiving bell or instrument;
a creature whose voice you know well;
a sect token or oath-chime;
a place where your sound has previously been welcomed.
This is long-range communication, not teleportation, divination, or mind-reading. Wards, Silence, hostile Domains, distance, wrong names, or severed anchors may block it.

talents.full_description:
“Before Heaven named itself, something rang. The cultivator who hears it does not speak loudly. They remind the world what it once answered to.”
Classification: Secret Sound Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Sound-Sovereign Incarnation, World-Ringing Note, hidden primordial-tone scripture
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 300 feet, or one connected resonant structure within sight
Area: 60-foot-radius sphere, 300-foot line, or one named resonant target
Cost: 15 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
Release a primordial tone, absolute silence, or impossible vibration.
Choose one mode.
Heaven-Ringing Mode:
Creatures in the area make Constitution saving throws.
Failed Save: Take 16d10 Thunder or Psychic damage, become Deafened for 1 minute, and become Stunned until the end of your next turn.
Successful Save: Take half damage and become Deafened until the end of your next turn.
Structure-Shattering Mode:
Choose one object, barrier, structure, Formation Anchor, gate, instrument array, or terrain feature.
Make a Sound Cultivation Attack or Cultivation Check against a GM-set DC.
Success: Deal 20d10 Thunder damage to the target, ignoring ordinary Resistance and hardness. If the target survives, choose one ordinary function to suppress until the end of your next turn.
Silence-Before-Sound Mode:
Create a 60-foot-radius field until the end of your next turn.
Inside the field:
hostile verbal components fail;
hostile Voice talents fail;
ordinary sound cannot exist;
Thunder damage from hostile sources becomes 0;
creatures of your choice can still hear your command, bell, or soul-tone.
The First Sound Before Heaven does not automatically destroy artifacts, Domains, immortal formations, permanent karmic bonds, or Realm-defining structures. It may crack, suppress, reveal, or contest them according to GM adjudication.

talents.full_description:
Tags: Reading, Seal, Stone
You know how to tap the edge of a seal without pretending to own it.
When you make a Source check to examine a visible magical seal, ward, binding mark, trap mark, or suppression mark on a mineral object or mineral surface, you have Advantage on the check.

Tags: Vein, Seal, Projected

A creature of your choice that starts in the area or enters it for the first time on a turn must make a Constitution saving throw against your Source Save DC before teleporting out of the area. This talent does not reduce Speed, Restrain creatures, block walking or flying movement, create a wall, or affect creatures that are not touching the mineral surface. It requires Concentration and ends early if you are Incapacitated.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Nascent Soul Realm, Dragon-Vein Glimpse
Tags: Reading, Vein, Stone
By spending 10 minutes using Source Reading in a mine, cave, mountain, stone ruin, battlefield, tomb, or source-rich place, you may ask the GM up to three questions about mineral memory in the examined area.
Valid questions include recent excavation, strongest source direction, obvious sealed chambers, major collapses, unnatural stone movement, whether something living was sealed in stone, or whether there are visible signs of ritual damage to the place.
The GM answers with brief truthful impressions if the earth, stone, or source can carry that memory. This talent does not reveal names, passwords, full maps, hidden thoughts, or future events.

talents.full_description:
Tag: Pocket Art.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 10 minutes.
Cost: 2 CP.
Create a personal folded storage space linked to a sleeve, ring, pouch, bracelet, tattoo, scabbard, book, gourd, mirror, or ripple in the air.
Capacity:
Weight capacity equals 50 pounds times your CL.
Maximum volume equals 5 cubic feet times your Proficiency Bonus.
You may open or close the storage as an Action.
The storage:
cannot contain living creatures;
preserves ordinary objects;
does not preserve unstable explosives or volatile formulae unless the GM allows it;
cannot bypass attunement, curse restrictions, ownership seals, or soul-bound items;
collapses harmlessly if you die, placing contents beside your body or in the nearest available space.
At CL 10, you may maintain two separate storage spaces. At CL 15, you may maintain three.

Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 2 CP.
Choose one creature, object, doorway, portal, or 10-foot cube you can see within range.
If the target is a creature, it makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The creature cannot teleport, enter portals, open extradimensional storage, willingly enter a pocket space, or benefit from a spatial displacement effect. At the end of each of its turns, it repeats the save, ending the effect on itself on a success.

If the target is an object, doorway, portal, or area, teleportation and portals through that target are blocked unless the opposing effect succeeds on a Cultivation Check against your CSDC.

Tag: Gate Art.

Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 3 CP.
Create two linked openings on surfaces or in open spaces you can see within range. Each opening is up to 5 feet in diameter.
A creature entering one opening exits the other.
Rules:
A creature can pass through the gate only once on each of its turns.
A creature must have enough movement to enter the gate.
The gate does not pull creatures by itself.
A hostile creature forced toward a gate may make a Dexterity saving throw. On a success, it stops at the boundary. On a failure, it passes through.
A creature may not end its turn halfway inside the gate.
At CL 11, each opening may be up to 10 feet in diameter by spending 1 additional CP.
At CL 15, the range becomes 240 feet, but both openings must still be visible or anchored by a talent that explicitly allows otherwise.
Close Gate is battlefield portal work, not long-distance teleportation.

Tag: Pocket Art.
Prerequisite: Spatial Storage.
Your Spatial Storage can briefly hold movement as well as objects.
Once per short rest, when you or a willing creature within 5 feet would fall, be pushed, be pulled, or be moved by a non-damaging forced movement effect, you may use your Reaction to store up to 20 feet of that movement.

If not released, the stored movement fades harmlessly.
This talent cannot store teleportation, damage, a creature’s whole body, or a fall from more than 100 feet.

talents.full_description:
Tag: Domain Art.
“No one is near. No one is far. They are only where the formation permits them to be.”
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 7 CP.
While the Domain is active, local distance becomes unreliable.
Your Movement: Once per turn, you may teleport up to 15 feet to an unoccupied space you can see inside the Domain without spending CP or using an action.
Allies: Allies inside the Domain may move through the spaces of other allies and do not provoke Opportunity Attacks from movement that begins and ends inside the Domain.
Enemies: The first time on each enemy’s turn that it moves more than 10 feet while inside the Domain, it makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Speed becomes 0 until the end of the current turn.
Successful Save: Its Speed is reduced by 10 feet until the end of the current turn.
Teleportation: An enemy attempting to teleport out of, into, or within the Domain must make a Charisma saving throw. On a failed save, the teleport fails and the action is wasted, but CP or limited uses are not spent unless the enemy willingly forced the attempt against an obvious seal.

Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: Ritual
Time: 8 hours.
Cost: Special.
Create a stable sect-scale gate network between prepared Spatial Anchors within a single territory.
This is not a normal combat talent. It is a strategic project requiring money, materials, permission, and security.
Requirements:
at least two permanent Spatial Anchors;
rare spatial jade, mirror-stone, threshold ink, void-thread, or equivalent materials;
a secure formation foundation;
a successful Cultivation Check;
GM approval for political and logistical consequences.
Default Limits:
A sect network connects a known compound, mountain, city, valley, or protected region.
It does not cross nations casually.
It does not cross planes.
It does not function through imperial dimensional interdiction.
It can be attacked, taxed, regulated, sealed, infiltrated, or sabotaged.
This talent exists because Space should be able to build gates, but gate infrastructure is not the same as personal True Teleport.

talents.full_description:
Tag: Pocket Art, Domain Art.
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet.
Area: 30-foot cube.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 9 CP.
Fold an area into a repeating local maze.
Creatures of your choice treat the area normally.
Other creatures experience the following:
The area is Difficult Terrain for them.
The first time each turn they move more than 10 feet inside the area, they make a Wisdom saving throw.
On a failed save, they emerge in a different unoccupied space in the area chosen by you.
On a successful save, they avoid being repositioned until the end of that turn, but the area remains Difficult Terrain.
Ranged attacks through the area have Disadvantage unless the attacker is one of your chosen creatures.
Spatial Maze is real folding, not an illusion. Truesight does not automatically defeat it, though spatial senses and Formations may help.

talents.full_description:
Tag: Seal Art, Anchor Art.
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: You or an ally within 60 feet is teleported, banished, shifted into a pocket space, or moved between planes against their will.
Cost: 5 CP.
The affected creature makes its saving throw or contest against the triggering effect with Advantage.
If the creature still fails and the effect moves it, you may mark the departure point with a return anchor until the end of your next turn.
Before the mark ends, you may use your Action to return the creature to the marked space if the creature is on the same plane or in a pocket space connected to the triggering effect.
Return From Elsewhere cannot retrieve a creature from death, reincarnation, sealed immortal prisons, or a completed True Teleport beyond your Realm.

talents.full_description:
Classification: Secret Spatial Talent.
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Spatial Domain, hidden inheritance.
Action Type: Multi-Mode
Canonical Action Type: Multi-Mode
Factory Combat Bucket: split_required
Split Candidate Buckets: action, reaction
Timing Detail: Reaction or Action
Factory Routing: split_modes_before_character_action_programming
Split Review Decision: split_required_distinct_combat_buckets
Recommended Factory Realization: modes=REACTION_VANISH_BETWEEN_WORLDS->reaction, ACTION_OPEN_VOID_BETWEEN_WORLDS->action
Cost: 15 CP.
Use Limit: Once per week.
“There are places between places. Most minds were not shaped to survive them.”
Choose one use.
Vanish Between Worlds: As a Reaction when you would take damage, fail a saving throw, be trapped, or be forcibly teleported, you disappear into the void between places until the start of your next turn.
While absent:
you cannot be targeted;
you take no damage from the triggering effect;
you cannot act;
you cannot perceive ordinary space clearly;
you return to your previous space or the nearest open space.
Cast Beyond the Threshold: As an Action, choose one creature within 60 feet. The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target disappears until the end of your next turn. When it returns, it takes 8d10 Psychic damage and cannot teleport for 1 minute.
Successful Save: The target takes 4d10 Psychic damage and cannot teleport until the start of its next turn.
Void Between Worlds does not permanently erase a creature and does not allow True Teleport.

talents.full_description:

As part of a short rest, you may prepare a minor shrine, token, charm, cup, ribbon, carved bone, blood mark, flower garland, incense bowl, blade knot, or similar object.

If the shrine is destroyed, the spirit is forced to manifest or retreat, increasing Bond Strain by 1.

### Avatar Hosting
A willing spirit may descend into you as an avatar.
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Choose one willing Major Spirit Bond that is hosted in you or touching you.
For the duration, you and the spirit act as one avatar.
You gain:
- one major physical or spiritual transformation based on the spirit's Nature;
- one active Nature Expression without needing to separately command the spirit;
- Advantage on saving throws against fear, possession, and forced separation;
- resistance to one damage type tied to the spirit's Nature;
- the ability to originate body-bound or aura-bound Nature Expressions from yourself.
At the start of each of your turns, if your intended action violates the spirit's Nature or Taboo, make a contested key ability check against the spirit.
If you fail, choose one:
- your action is altered by the spirit's Nature;
- Bond Strain increases by 1;
- the avatar ends.
Avatar Hosting does not allow a Body Refiner to freely project unrelated qi. The avatar may externalize the spirit's Nature only where the talent or spirit expression permits.

You create a temporary domain where spirits can safely manifest and bargains become visible.

Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row

A Sword Soul is a spiritual combat ally, not an ordinary permanent artifact.
##### Sword Soul Manifestation
| Statistic | Value |
| --- | --- |
| AC | 15 + Proficiency Bonus |
| HP | 5 x Cultivation Level |
| Speed | Fly 60 feet and Hover |
| Control Range | 120 feet |
The Sword Soul acts immediately after your turn.
As a Bonus Action, command it to:
Attack;
Dash;
Disengage;
Dodge;
Help;
Search.
Without a command, it Dodges.
##### Soul-Cutting Strike
Attack: Your Cultivation Attack Modifier
Damage: 2d8 + Path key ability modifier Slashing, Force, or Psychic damage
On a hit, apply Sword Intent.
The Sword Soul may communicate through:
emotion;
pressure;
brief images;
simple spiritual impressions.
It cannot independently learn talents, reveal private information, or replace a Bonded Companion.

talents.full_description:
Dao-Sealing Talisman - Secret Formula
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Legendary Talisman Crafting, lost scripture or sect inheritance
Crafting
Cost: 10,000 gp and 15 CPCrafting
Time: 30 days
Activation: Melee Talisman Attack or applied as part of a successful compatible technique
Target: one creature
Consumed: yes
On a hit, the target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, or Spirit Awakening. For 1 minute, the target cannot spend that Path’s resource or activate talents that require that Path. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot spend CP until the start of your next turn.
The Dao-Sealing Talisman may be removed or ended by:
a successful Cultivation Check as an Action against your Talisman Save DC;
a Legendary purification or seal-breaking technique;
destruction of the physical talisman;
a superior Secret technique;
a campaign-scale counterseal.

### Secret Formula
#### Dao-Sealing Talisman - Secret Formula
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Legendary Talisman Crafting, lost scripture or sect inheritance
Crafting
Cost: 10,000 gp and 15 CPCrafting
Time: 30 days
Activation: Melee Talisman Attack or applied as part of a successful compatible technique
Target: one creature
Consumed: yes
On a hit, the target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose Body Refining, Qi Cultivation, or Spirit Awakening. For 1 minute, the target cannot spend that Path’s resource or activate talents that require that Path. The target repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Successful Save: The target cannot spend CP until the start of your next turn.
The Dao-Sealing Talisman may be removed or ended by:
a successful Cultivation Check as an Action against your Talisman Save DC;
a Legendary purification or seal-breaking technique;
destruction of the physical talisman;
a superior Secret technique;
a campaign-scale counterseal.
The Dao-Sealing Talisman cannot permanently remove a Path, Realm, cultivation base, class feature, or character identity unless the campaign explicitly makes that the story’s central consequence.

talents.full_description:
Talent Type: Spirit.
Prerequisite: CL 10 and Spirit Awakening or GM approval.
Effect: You can create Spirit Threads. A Spirit Thread can connect to a creature you can see within 60 feet if it fails a Wisdom saving throw. While connected, you know the creature’s emotional direction toward you in broad terms: hostile, fearful, loyal, curious, indifferent, guilty, indebted, or concealed.
Combat Use: Once per turn when you affect a creature connected by Spirit Thread with a Thread talent, you may deal Psychic damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus.
Limits: Soul-Silk Thread cannot read exact thoughts, compel obedience, rewrite memory, or replace Spirit Awakening’s deeper soul arts.

talents.full_description:
Talent Type: Defense.
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: You are hit by a ranged attack or line effect.
Cost: 2 CP.
Effect: You weave a dense mesh of silk, qi, and angles. Reduce the damage by your Threaded Guard amount. If this reduces the damage to 0 and the effect was a ranged weapon attack, ranged spell attack, or similar projectile, you may redirect it to another target within 30 feet of you. Make a Cultivation Attack roll using your key ability. On a hit, the new target takes the remaining or redirected effect as appropriate.
Limits: You cannot redirect an area explosion, mental effect, curse, or effect that could not plausibly be caught in a web.

Talent Type: Spirit and Social.
Prerequisite: CL 10.
Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Canonical Action Type: Ritual Procedure
Factory Routing: procedure_ledger_not_combat_action
Timing Detail: 1 minute
Range: Touch.
Duration: 24 hours.
Cost: 3 CP.
Target: One willing creature with whom you share a promise, debt, oath, rescue, rivalry, or meaningful relationship.
Effect: You tie a symbolic red thread between yourself and the target. While on the same plane and within 1 mile, each of you knows the rough direction of the other if the other is conscious and willing to be found. Once during the duration, either creature may tug the thread as a Bonus Action, allowing the other to sense urgency, danger, grief, or summons.
Limits: This is not Fate. It does not guarantee reunion, enforce romance, compel obedience, or change destiny. A creature may willingly break the thread as an action.

Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self.
Area: 60-foot radius.
Duration: 1 minute.
Cost: 6 CP.
Effect: Threads fill the domain: visible silk, qi lines, spiritual connections, vibrating sutures, red cords, and hidden hooks. Hostile creatures treat the area as Difficult Terrain. You may maintain any number of Thread Lines inside the Domain without counting them against your normal limit, but only a number equal to your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier can be used for reactions or active talent effects each round.

Domain Pressure: A hostile creature that starts its turn Restrained or Grappled by your Thread effect in the Domain takes Force or Psychic damage equal to your Thread sphere damage.

talents.full_description:
Talent Type: Defense and Transformation.
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self or touch.
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute.
Cost: 5 CP.
Effect: You wrap yourself or a willing creature in a cocoon of silk and qi. The target is Restrained and has Total Cover against attacks and effects that cannot penetrate the cocoon. The cocoon has AC equal to your Cultivation Save DC and hit points equal to 10 times your CL. It is resistant to nonmagical Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage.
Refinement: At the start of each of the target’s turns while inside, choose one benefit.
The target regains hit points equal to your Proficiency Bonus + key ability modifier.
The target ends one Poisoned or Bleeding effect.
The target gains advantage on one saving throw before the start of its next turn.
The target may spend one Hit Die and regain additional hit points.
Emergence: When the cocoon ends, the target may stand, move 10 feet, and end one Grappled or Restrained effect currently affecting it.

talents.full_description:
Talent Type: Battlefield Control.
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 120 feet.
Cost: 5 CP.
Effect: Choose two creatures, two objects, or one creature and one object that you can see. You cut the line of cooperation, pursuit, or reinforcement between them. Each unwilling creature makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, until the end of your next turn the two targets cannot willingly move closer to each other, cannot provide Help to each other, and cannot use reactions to protect, counter for, or benefit each other.
On
Success: The affected target can act normally, but the next time it tries to move closer to the other named target before the end of your next turn, its speed is reduced by 10 feet.
Limits: This does not break emotional bonds, Fate threads, command structures, telepathy, or allied status. It temporarily cuts the tactical line between two points.

Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 60 feet.
Cost: 5 CP.
Target: One creature connected by at least two of your Thread Lines.
Effect: The target makes a Wisdom saving throw. On a failure, you force one immediate simple movement: drop one held object, take one step of up to 5 feet, make one weapon attack against a target you choose within its reach, fall Prone, or waste its Reaction until the start of its next turn.
On

Forbidden Note: This is the edge where Thread approaches Puppetry. Repeated public use is likely to draw sect attention, moral suspicion, and counter-scripture development.

Talent Type: Emergency Restoration.
Prerequisite: CL 15.
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: A creature within Thread range is reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright.

Effect: You stitch the creature’s life-line to its body. The target instead drops to 1 hit point, falls Prone, and becomes Restrained by your thread until the end of its next turn. While restrained this way, it cannot take reactions, and its speed is 0.
Cost of Survival: The target gains one level of Exhaustion after the immediate danger passes. A creature can benefit from Life-Line Stitch once per Long Rest.
Limits: Life-Line Stitch cannot reverse instant death, old age, soul destruction, scattered cultivation base, or a death explicitly claimed by Fate, Heaven, or a stronger narrative power unless the GM allows it.

talents.full_description:
Talent Type: Secret Inheritance.
Prerequisite: CL 17+, GM approval, and a major Thread inheritance.
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 300 feet.
Duration: Instantaneous, then 1 minute.
Cost: 8 CP.
Effect: You perceive one line of connection running through the battlefield: weapon to hand, killer to victim, oath to speaker, spell to caster, wound to blade, door to key, anchor to gate, master to puppet, or life to body. Choose one connection you can perceive or reasonably name. The GM may require a Cultivation Check for hidden, divine, Fate-protected, or higher-Realm connections.
On a success, choose one miracle.
Sever: End or suppress the chosen connection for 1 minute.
Bind: Prevent the chosen connection from being broken for 1 minute.
Draw: Pull one endpoint up to 60 feet toward the other endpoint if movement is physically possible.
Stitch: Restore a broken immediate connection, such as a disarmed weapon to hand, a breached seal to its door, or a dying creature’s life to its body.
Reveal: Make the connection visible to all creatures for 1 minute.
Limits: This cannot casually rewrite Fate, destroy a divine oath, enslave a soul, sever a campaign-defining bond, or bypass an artifact-level protection. If used against something greater than the cultivator’s Realm, the effect may partially succeed, reveal the stronger power, or create a backlash.
Backlash: After using this Secret Inheritance, you cannot use it again until you finish a Long Rest. If the connection involved life, death, oath, or destiny, the GM may also impose a story cost.

talents.full_description:
Create a weighted net, cable bundle, or entangling mechanism.
Dart Use
Replace the Dart Mechanism attack roll and damage with a Dexterity saving throw by the targeted creature.
Snare Use
A creature triggering the snare makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save
The creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes or the net is destroyed.
A Restrained creature may take the Utilize Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success.
The net uses your trap’s AC and HP.
talents.full_exact_source_text:
### Net — Dart Talent, Snare Talent
Create a weighted net, cable bundle, or entangling mechanism.
#### Dart Use
Replace the Dart Mechanism attack roll and damage with a Dexterity saving throw by the targeted creature.
#### Snare Use
A creature triggering the snare makes a Dexterity saving throw.
#### Failed Save
The creature has the Restrained condition until it escapes or the net is destroyed.
A Restrained creature may take the Utilize Action to make a Strength (Athletics) or Dexterity (Acrobatics) check against your Cultivation Save DC, ending the condition on itself on a success.
The net uses your trap’s AC and HP.

talents.exact_heading: ### Aerial Rigging — Trigger Talent, Realm Evolution
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 5+
Your traps may threaten flying creatures above their occupied spaces.
Aerial trigger height:
CL 5–9: 10 feet
CL 10–14: 20 feet
CL 15+: 30 feet
A trap can threaten aerial spaces only when its wires, hooks, launched net, overhead anchors, suspended mechanism, or terrain make that threat physically plausible.
When an aerial trap causes a flying creature to gain the Prone condition or reduces its Fly Speed to 0, that creature falls unless it can Hover.
When Net or Noose affects a hovering creature, pull that creature harmlessly into one of the trap’s spaces before applying the remaining effect.

talents.exact_heading: ### Court of the Hidden Nail — Martial Domain
talents.full_description:
“The battlefield was not empty when you arrived. You were merely allowed to believe it was.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: Expend Martial Focus
Use Limit: Once per short or long rest
Establish a 30-foot-radius Emanation centered on yourself.
While the Court persists:
your active trap limit increases by your Proficiency Bonus;
once per turn, set one trap in an unoccupied space within your reach without spending an Action;
a trap set this way lasts until the Court ends or until triggered;
your warned allies do not trigger your traps inside the Court;
when one of your traps triggers, move up to 5 feet without provoking Opportunity Attacks, or regain Martial Focus if it is absent;
you know which of your traps inside the Court triggered, was disarmed, or was destroyed.
Court of the Hidden Nail ends early if you have the Incapacitated condition.

talents.exact_heading: ### Falling-Sky Mechanism — Dart Talent, Realm Evolution
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Aerial Rigging, CL 10+
When you set Dart Mechanism, orient it upward, downward, or diagonally through aerial spaces.
If the dart hits a flying creature, that creature makes a Strength saving throw.
Failed Save: Its Fly Speed becomes 0 until the start of its next turn.
A creature that cannot Hover falls normally.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Aerial Rigging, CL 15+
When you set Net or Terrain Trap, create a physically anchored lattice extending upward through the full height of Aerial Rigging.
The trap affects legal aerial spaces throughout that height.

A creature restrained by Heaven-Net Battlefield is pulled to the nearest legal anchored space rather than automatically falling.

talents.exact_heading: ### The Route Was Chosen Already — Deployment Talent
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 17+
When Initiative is rolled, reveal up to your Proficiency Bonus concealed traps that you prepared during the previous hour.
Each revealed trap must occupy a legal space within 60 feet that you could physically have reached during your preparation.
A revealed trap counts against your active trap limit.
This talent does not conjure traps into impossible locations. It represents advance planning, cached mechanisms, disguised components, and preparation so subtle that the battlefield seemed empty until the first breath of violence.
Use this talent once per long rest.

talents.display_name: The Empty Road Was Never Empty
talents.exact_heading: ### The Empty Road Was Never Empty
talents.full_description:
“A careless enemy enters a battlefield. A wise enemy asks who decided where the battlefield begins.”
Prerequisite: Trap sphere, Court of the Hidden Nail, CL 17+
Action Type: Reaction
Factory Combat Bucket: reaction
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Trigger: Initiative is rolled, or one hostile creature enters a space within 60 feet that you can perceive
Use Limit: Once per long rest
For 1 minute, establish a 60-foot-radius Emanation centered on yourself.
When you activate the inheritance, place a number of temporary traps equal to your Proficiency Bonus in legal unoccupied spaces within the Emanation.
For the duration:
your active trap limit increases by your Proficiency Bonus;
each trap you set may use two compatible Trigger talents without expending Martial Focus;
once per turn, after a hostile creature moves at least 5 feet inside the Emanation, relocate one untriggered trap you set to one legal unoccupied space within 10 feet of its previous location;
a relocated trap remains physical and must have a plausible route, anchor, and mechanism;
warned allies do not trigger your traps;
you immediately know when one of your traps inside the Emanation triggers, is disarmed, or is destroyed.
This inheritance does not create permanent infrastructure. It expresses preparation at mythic speed and scale for one decisive scene.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Script-Sealed Mechanist, CL 5+
Rig one magic item that requires activation into Activation Trap.
If activating the item takes longer than an Action, setting the trap takes at least that long.
If activation requires an ability check, make that check when setting the trap.
When triggered:
a targeted effect targets the triggering creature if legal;
an area effect originates from one of the trap’s spaces chosen when set;
a Cone or Line uses an orientation chosen when set;
one charge or use is consumed normally.
The trap remains armed while the item has legal remaining uses.
When the trap ends, recover the item with its remaining charges or uses.
Magic Trigger is magical.

talents.full_exact_source_text:
### Scripted Release — Script Talent
Prerequisite: Script-Sealed Mechanist, Magic Trigger, CL 10+
When you set Activation Trap, spend the CP cost of one compatible technique you know and store that technique inside the trap.
The technique must:
have an activation time of one Action or Bonus Action;
target one creature or create an area with a legal point of origin;
have an instantaneous duration or Concentration duration no longer than 1 minute;
be approved by the GM as physically and metaphysically compatible with a prepared trigger.
When the trap triggers, release the technique from the trap’s space.
If the technique requires Concentration, you begin Concentrating when the trap triggers. If you cannot Concentrate at that moment, the technique fails.
A trap can store only one technique through Scripted Release.

talents.exact_heading: ### Thaumic Sink — Script Talent, Secret Technique
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: Script-Sealed Mechanist, CL 17+
Cost: 8 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
Create an antimagic trap.
Choose one form when setting the trap.
Dart Form
On a hit, the target is affected as though inside an Antimagic Field until the end of your next turn.
A creature may take the Utilize Action to remove the embedded dart, ending the effect on itself and taking Piercing damage equal to the Dart Mechanism’s minimum possible damage.
Snare Form
When triggered, create a 10-foot-radius Sphere centered on one trap space.
The area functions as Antimagic Field until the end of your next turn.
Thaumic Sink is a magical effect.

talents.display_name: First Ruin Form: External Vessel Mandate
talents.exact_heading: ### First Ruin Form: External Vessel Mandate — Ruin Form, Channel
talents.full_description:
**Prerequisite:** CL 5+
**Action Type:** Bonus Action
**Duration:** 1 minute
**Cost:** 1 CP
You bind Unmaking qi to an External Channel and force the weapon or implement to survive longer than it should.
Choose one held weapon or implement. For the duration:
- once per turn, when you hit with the chosen Channel, deal additional Ruin damage equal to 2d8;
- when the chosen Channel would gain Crack, roll a d6. On a 5 or 6, the Crack is delayed until the form ends;
- when the form ends, all delayed Crack applies at once.
If the Channel breaks when the form ends, you may immediately make one Black Trace attack against a creature within 30 feet as the weapon dies. This attack cannot Overdraw.

talents.full_description:

**Action Type:** Bonus Action
**Duration:** 1 minute

You allow Unmaking qi to circulate through your hands and forearms.
For the duration:
- your unarmed strikes may deal Ruin damage instead of their normal damage type;
- once per turn, when you hit with an unarmed strike, add 2d10 Ruin damage;

- at the end of each of your turns in which you damaged a creature with this form, gain 1 Black Vein Strain.
If this would trigger Ruin Backlash, the form does not immediately end, but you cannot regain HP until the form ends.

talents.exact_heading: ### Sixth Ruin Form: Star-Sundering Cut — Ruin Form, Execution
talents.full_description:
**Prerequisite:** CL 15+, Third Ruin Form: Severing Wave
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 300 feet
**Area:** 300-foot line, 10 feet wide
**Cost:** 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per long rest
You release a single line of pure Unmaking.
Each creature in the line makes a Dexterity saving throw.
Failed Save: 16d10 Ruin damage. The creature cannot regain HP or CP until the end of its next turn. If the creature is a summoned construct, puppet body, temporary clone, projected vessel, or non-true body, it takes an additional 8d10 Ruin damage.
Successful Save: Half damage. The creature cannot regain HP until the start of your next turn.
Objects, barriers, doors, siege engines, temporary qi structures, and non-Secret constructs in the line take 24d10 Ruin damage automatically.
After resolving the cut, suffer all of the following:
- gain 3 Black Vein Strain;
- take Ruin self-damage equal to 8d6 + your Cultivation Level;
- one External Channel used to shape the technique is destroyed unless it is an artifact;
- you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn.
This technique does not automatically defeat superior authority, divine bodies, Secret Inheritances, ancient formations, or higher-Realm domains. Against such targets, the GM may require an opposed Cultivation Check. On a failure, the target takes half damage after its saving throw result.

talents.exact_heading: ### Unbody the False Vessel — Anti-Structure, Spirit
talents.full_description:
**Prerequisite:** CL 15+
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 120 feet
**Target:** One summoned creature, puppet body, clone, projection, possession vessel, construct, or temporary body
**Cost:** 4 CP
The target makes a Constitution or Wisdom saving throw, whichever is better for it.
Failed Save: 14d10 Ruin damage. If this damage reduces the target to 0 HP, the effect that created or sustained it ends immediately.
Successful Save: Half damage.
If the target is sustained by a visible caster, master, owner, or summoner within 120 feet, that creature also takes Ruin damage equal to your Proficiency Bonus d10 on a failed save.
After using this talent, gain 2 Black Vein Strain or suffer Ruin self-damage equal to 5d6.

talents.full_description:
**Prerequisite:** CL 15+
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** Touch
**Target:** One structure, wall section, gate, large barrier, formation plate, bridge support, mountain seal, or comparable major object
**Cost:** 4 CP
Make an Unmaking Check against the target’s DC.
Success: The target takes 24d10 Ruin damage and loses one major structural function chosen by the GM: support, seal, hinge, warding surface, channel alignment, load-bearing integrity, concealment, or containment.
Success by 5 or more: The target also becomes unstable. The next significant impact, forced movement, tremor, siege attack, or damaging technique before the end of the scene deals maximum damage to it.
Failure: The target takes half damage, and you suffer Ruin Backlash.
This talent cannot casually collapse mountains, sect headquarters, city-scale formations, or divine architecture. It creates or exploits a fault; it does not overrule superior authority without a contest.
---

talents.full_description:
**Secret Unmaking Inheritance**
**Prerequisites:** CL 17+, Sixth Ruin Form: Star-Sundering Cut, at least two other Ruin Form talents, access to a true Unmaking inheritance, black-vein scripture, ruined-star revelation, or comparable destructive qi transmission
**Action Type:** Action
**Range:** 300 feet
**Target:** One creature, object, barrier, construct, formation node, projected vessel, or temporary body you can see
**Cost:** 6 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You stop shaping Unmaking into a technique and allow one target to experience a moment where its cohesion receives no answer from Heaven.
The target makes a Constitution saving throw. If the target is an object, barrier, formation node, temporary body, or construct without Constitution, use the creator’s save bonus, structure DC, or formation DC.
Failed Save: The target takes 24d10 Ruin damage.
Successful Save: The target takes half damage.
If the target is a temporary body, projection, construct, puppet, clone, summoned vessel, non-Secret barrier, or temporary qi structure, it takes an additional 12d10 Ruin damage.
If the target is Bloodied, cracked, Impaired, restrained, incapacitated, unable to take Reactions, or already under healing denial from your Unmaking, add 6d10 Ruin damage.
After resolving this inheritance, suffer all of the following:
- your Black Vein Strain becomes 6;
- suffer Ruin Backlash twice;
- reduce your current and maximum HP by 20 until you finish a Long Rest;
- destroy one non-artifact External Channel used to shape the inheritance;
- you cannot regain HP until the end of your next turn;
- you cannot use Unmaking talents other than Black Trace until the end of your next turn.
Limits: This inheritance is catastrophic, but not absolute. It does not automatically erase immortals, divine bodies, ancient arrays, Realm Tribulations, Secret Inheritances, artifacts, or superior domains. Such targets may resist, halve, contest, or redirect the effect according to Realm authority and GM adjudication.
---

talents.exact_heading: ### Grove Domain: Court of Root and Branch - Realm Evolution
talents.full_description:
“Within the grove, every path is a promise made to the roots.”
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Bonus Action
Factory Combat Bucket: bonus_action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: Self
Area: 30-foot Emanation originating from you
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 5 CP
Use Limit: Once per short rest
A temporary cultivation grove grows through legal Living Mediums in the area. If the area contains no legal medium, the Domain begins from your body, carried seeds, or touched ground and spreads as far as the GM agrees the scene can support.
For the duration:
create one Living Claim at the start of each of your turns without using a Bonus Action;
enemies treat spaces containing your Living Claims as difficult terrain;
when an enemy starts its turn in a Living Claim, place 1 Growth Mark on it;
allies in a Living Claim gain Temporary HP equal to your Proficiency Bonus at the start of their turns;
once per round, use one Verdant Response without spending a Growth Mark.
The Domain does not create permanent plants, food, lumber, medicine, or safe architecture.

While this incarnation is active, Fire damage you take prevents you from gaining the free Living Claim at the start of your next turn.

talents.display_name: The Seed That Remembers the Forest
talents.exact_heading: ### The Seed That Remembers the Forest
talents.full_exact_source_text:
### The Seed That Remembers the Forest
“A single seed falls. The forest that has not yet been born recognizes its ancestor.”
Classification: Secret Verdant Growth Inheritance
Prerequisite: CL 17+, Grove Domain: Court of Root and Branch, Rooted Witness Grove, hidden seed-line scripture
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 300 feet
Area: Up to a 120-foot-radius area containing at least one legal Living Medium, Grove Node, seed, corpse, root, wooden object, or willing living creature
Duration: 1 minute
Cost: 10 CP
Use Limit: Once per week
You plant one impossible seed of your Dao into the battlefield.
The area becomes a nascent forest of root-lines, branch choices, medicinal bloom, thorn law, and living witness.
For the duration:
create up to six Living Claims anywhere in the area when the inheritance begins;
every creature of your choice that starts its turn in the area gains 1 Growth Mark;
allies of your choice in the area gain Temporary HP equal to your CL at the start of their turns;
enemies treat your Living Claims as difficult terrain;
once per round, when an enemy with a Growth Mark damages an ally, use one Verdant Response without spending a Reaction or Growth Mark;
when a creature with at least 3 Growth Marks would be reduced to 0 HP, you may either allow the death or bind it in roots at 1 HP and Restrained until the inheritance ends.
When the inheritance ends, choose one of the following:
the growth withers, leaving harmless leaves, seed-dust, broken roots, and disturbed soil;
one noncombat seedling remains as a story mark;
one willing creature carries a harmless seed-script memory of what happened;
the GM preserves a living consequence for future story.
The inheritance does not create permanent resources, a finished forest, free food, rare herbs, or a safe settlement unless the GM makes it the seed of a separate project.

talents.exact_heading: ### Court of the Empty Horizon - Void Domain
talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Area: 30-foot-radius aura centered on you
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 7 CP or 7 Stamina
Every technique enters the court carrying a name. None leaves with certainty.
You
Gain +2 AC.
Gain Resistance to Force, Necrotic, and Psychic damage.
Use Empty Step once on each of your turns without spending CP or Stamina.
Allies
Allies inside the Domain gain Advantage on saving throws against teleportation, banishment, forced transformation, and possession.
When an ally inside the Domain takes damage from a supernatural area effect, reduce that damage by your Proficiency Bonus.
Enemies
Enemies inside the Domain:
cannot reduce CP, Stamina, or other printed technique costs below the listed cost;
cannot gain Temporary HP;
treat the area as Difficult Terrain.
When an enemy starts its turn inside the Domain, it makes a Constitution saving throw.
Failed Save: Choose one:
it takes 2d8 Force, Necrotic, or Psychic damage;
it cannot take Reactions until the start of its next turn;
it cannot regain HP until the start of its next turn;
it cannot teleport until the start of its next turn;
it has Disadvantage on its next Concentration saving throw before the start of its next turn.
Successful Save: It cannot gain Temporary HP until the start of its next turn.

talents.full_description:
Prerequisite: CL 10+
Action Type: Action
Factory Combat Bucket: action
Factory Routing: combat_action_row
Range: 90 feet
Duration: Concentration, up to 1 minute
Cost: 6 CP or 6 Stamina
Choose one creature within range.
The target makes a Charisma saving throw.
Failed Save: The target is enclosed in a visible cage of absence occupying its space and the spaces it occupies.
Successful Save: The target is Hollowed until the start of your next turn instead.
While the prison lasts:
the target cannot willingly leave the prison;
the target’s teleportation fails unless it first succeeds on a Cultivation Check against your Cultivation Save DC;
attacks and effects can pass through the prison normally unless blocked by another rule;
the target has Cover only if another rule grants it.
The Void Prison is an object with:
Statistic: AC; Value: 15
Statistic: HP; Value: 10 x your Proficiency Bonus
Statistic: Resistance; Value: Force and Necrotic
Statistic: Immunity; Value: Poison and Psychic
Destroying the prison ends the effect.
